listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Invictus Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: In this heroic woody-fresh fragrance, the lively meets the muscular. INVICTUS embodies the two clashing forces of intense freshness and animalistic sensuality. In this fragrance with magnetising patchouli, sensual guaiac wood and amber, the sea breezes dominate the exploding grapefruit, while the virile woods ignite and assert themselves. A scent of double victory.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Aqua de Dora Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Aqua de Dora Eau de Parfum Spray by Pana Dora Sweden is an olfactory homage to the unspoilt nature of the Swedish island of Öland in the Baltic Sea. The fragrance captures the unique atmosphere created by the encounter of fresh sea breeze, dense forests and the air after a summer rain. The opening is an invigorating composition of tangy grapefruit and lemon zest, which is given a modern depth by the clear, mineral facet of ambroxan. A fascinating contrast unfolds at the heart of the fragrance, where the gentle, fruity sweetness of fig meets the earthy and warm flavour of chestnut. This interplay leads to a persistent and expressive base. Here, the soft, woody notes of cashmeran and creamy sandalwood merge with the characteristic scent of pine resin, creating an aura of self-assured serenity. The composition is presented in a simple, elegant bottle with a striking cap in the shape of a stag's head, emphasising the deep connection to nature. A fresh, aquatic fragrance with warm, woody notes. Inspired by the nature and atmosphere of the Swedish island of Öland. Fragrance composition of grapefruit, fig, chestnut and sandalwood. Presented in an elegant bottle with a stag's head cap.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Dorasima Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Dorasima by Pana Dora Sweden is an intoxicating and intense fragrance experience. Floral and fruity with a woody base, it seems to bring a sense of cosiness to the cold Swedish winters. The unisex fragrance from 2022 is the creation of Ibrahim Al Zouabi. He founded Pana Dora Sweden in 2019. The Syrian-Swedish perfumer has been creating exceptional fragrances with passion and dedication ever since. The eau de parfum spray Dorasima also combines rare ingredients to create a breathtaking fragrance. The eau de parfum spray comes in a crystal-shaped perfume bottle. It is crowned by the majestic head of a golden stag. Energy and aesthetics of lush flowering gardens and forests The freshness of orange, lemon and bergamot opens the fragrance of Eau de Parfum Spray Dorasima by Pana Dora Sweden with a magnificent top note. The heart note reveals an almost intoxicating floral accord of rose and jasmine. They are accompanied by the scent of delicate violets, orange blossom and lily of the valley. In the base, the sea of flowers transforms into a woody atmosphere. Here, earthy tones of sandalwood, cedar and agarwood combine to create a beguiling blend. The composition is accompanied by flavours of vanilla, leather and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Imperial Wood Extrait de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Pana Dora Sweden Imperial Wood Extrait de Parfum Spray combines woody and spicy notes with cocoa to create a slightly oriental fragrance. Warm unisex fragrance, refined with fine spices The unisex fragrance Imperial Wood is offered here as an extrait de parfum spray, which is highly concentrated so that you only need to apply one spritz to be enveloped in a long-lasting, seductive fragrance. The perfume has been available since 2021 and was created by the head of the House of Pana Dora Sweden, the talented perfumer Ibrahim Al Zoabi. The Imperial Wood Extrait de Parfum Spray is based on an exotic base that combines rough leather, incense, ambergris and agarwood. The mysterious character of the fragrance is emphasised by the heart note, which consists of velvety cocoa combined with exciting spices such as cloves, cardamom and cinnamon. The top note also contains a spirited blend of spices, which here meets the cosy scent of tobacco. Fresh safflower and thyme blossoms liven up the composition and have a stimulating and invigorating effect.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Emblem Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Emblem Homme for discerning men The house of MontBlanc stands for sophisticated taste, style, design and exclusivity. In the new fragrance creation Emblem Homme , Mont Blanc presents an eau de toilette spray that satisfies even the highest demands. The perfume is already visually characterised by its exquisite design. The black bottle with the typical Mont Blanc logo on the top has a hexagonal, rounded shape. The deep, shimmering black is a subtle hint of the luxurious contents. Elegant ingredients for the man with style The fragrance is as promising as the packaging. The Eau de Toilette Spray Emblem Homme from MontBlanc exudes elegance and esprit right from the top note. Cardamom, grapefruit and clary sage form the prelude. This spicy-fruity blend paves the way for the heart note, which is characterised by cinnamon leaf and violet. The perfume becomes masculine and dominant with various woods in the base note, rounded off by the extravagant tonka bean . The masculine aura of the new fragrance captivates with timeless elegance and an outstanding fragrance experience - it does not seem presumptuous to say: "A star is born!"

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Signature Eau de Parfum Spray Absolue 90 ml
listings.description: The Montblanc Signature Absolue Eau de Parfum Spray is a soothingly fruity and floral fragrance for women. Sweet and yet elegant, it envelops you with its individual charm at first sniff. Luxurious fragrance with character Even the bottle represents pure luxury , as it comes in a mix of white and gold colours. This makes the fragrance perfect as a gift! The exquisite liquid is hidden inside, also in a gold-like colour. Open the bottle and the enchanting fragrance journey through the world of fruit and flowers begins. Enjoy a precious break from everyday life with the Montblanc Signature Absolue Eau de Parfum Spray! The top note is all about mandarin, which makes you want more and immediately spreads its positive energy. You'll already be in a good mood and feel ready for life's adventures! The heart note of Montblanc Signature is floral and sweet, centred around ylang-ylang. A girlish aspect that can take you back to your youth and reveal romantic feelings! However, the base note of amber skilfully softens the sweet character and gives the Absolue Eau de Parfum Spray its pleasant touch of sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Miro Femme Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Miro Femme Eau de Parfum Spray is a versatile fragrance composition. The opening is characterised by a fruity freshness in which notes of mandarin, melon and blackcurrant unfold. This opening is accompanied by the delicate nuances of ylang-ylang. As the fragrance progresses, a floral heart develops, characterised by jasmine, lily of the valley and violet. This combination gives the fragrance its clear and balanced character. The base rounds off the olfactory experience with warm accords of musk, iris and vetiver, which provide a gentle depth. Bottled in an elegantly faceted glass bottle, this fragrance is suitable for a variety of everyday occasions and special occasions. A fruity-floral fragrance character. Tangerine, melon and ylang-ylang top notes. A heart of jasmine, lily of the valley and violet. A base note of musk, iris and vetiver. Presented in a faceted glass bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Miro Magic Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Miro Magic Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that exudes an aura of grace and elegance. This composition is created for people who want to emphasise their gentle yet self-confident side. The fragrance opens with an invigorating top note of bergamot and orange, which provides a fresh and sparkling prelude. A harmonious bouquet of rose and jasmine unfolds in the heart, giving the perfume a classic, floral depth. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with warm and earthy accords. Here, patchouli and vetiver combine to create a long-lasting and pleasant base that lingers on the skin. The eau de parfum is presented in a faceted glass bottle, whose pale pink liquid refracts the light in an appealing way and emphasises the elegant design. A floral fragrance character with fresh accents. Top notes of bergamot and orange. Heart notes of rose and jasmine. Base note of patchouli and vetiver. Presented in an elegant, faceted bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Miro Cabal Pour Homme Eau de Toilette Spray 75 ml
listings.description: The Miro Cabal Pour Homme Eau de Toilette Spray unfolds a composition of aromatic and spicy notes. The fragrance opens with a fresh combination of bergamot, cardamom and mint, which provides an invigorating prelude. As the fragrance progresses, a heart note develops in which lavender comes to the fore together with other aromatic accords. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with warm and earthy components. Here, musk and a hint of vanilla meet green vetiver and sandalwood, giving the eau de toilette a pleasant depth. The design of the bottle is simple and straightforward, with a shiny black body and a silver-coloured cap. Fragrance direction: Aromatic and spicy Head notes: Bergamot, cardamom, mint Heart notes: Lavender, aromatic notes Base notes: Musk, vanilla, vetiver, sandalwood Product type: eau de toilette spray

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY LES PARFUMS MYTHIQUES Eau de Toilette Spray Givenchy III 100 ml
listings.description: As part of the iconic "Les Parfums Mythiques" collection, Givenchy III embodies the rich heritage and timeless elegance of the House of Givenchy. This classic fragrance, whose origins date back to 1970, is an outstanding example of the chypre family with a distinctly floral-green character. The composition unfolds with a striking, resinous accent of hyacinth in the top note, which provides a clear opening. This is followed by an elegant, powdery heart of precious Moroccan iris concret, which gives the fragrance its soft centre. Finally, Indonesian patchouli provides an earthy, sensual depth in the base note, rounding off the creation in a woody and long-lasting way. The result is an exceptionally harmonious and balanced fragrance experience of classic sophistication. The fragrance is suitable for everyday wear as well as for special occasions and emphasises a style that deliberately sets itself apart from modern mass tastes. The eau de toilette is presented in a purist bottle that reflects the authentic aesthetics of the brand. Fragrance family: Chypre with a floral-green character Fragrance notes: Hyacinth, Moroccan iris and Indonesian patchouli Character: Classic, elegant and harmoniously balanced Collection: A timeless classic from the "Les Mythiques" range

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY LES PARFUMS MYTHIQUES Eau de Toilette Spray Monsieur 100 ml
listings.description: As an integral part of the "Les Parfums Mythiques" collection, this eau de toilette embodies a return to the essential values of classic perfumery. A striking hespéridé note characterises the first impression as the essence of Italian sfuma lemon unfolds its sparkling and clear facets. This fresh opening flows smoothly into an aromatic heart, which is defined by high-quality French lavandin and lends the fragrance a structured, herbaceous nuance. The long-lasting finish is provided by Indonesian vetiver in the base note, which leaves a warm, woody signature and grounds the composition. The bottle reflects this straightforwardness: a transparent, cylindrical glass body reveals the light yellow liquid and is topped with a simple, black lid. On the front, a white label with the words "MONSIEUR GIVENCHY" adorns the glass, backed with a subtle embossing of the brand logo. The overall result is an olfactory experience that combines freshness with an elegant woody note while always remaining discreet. Fragrance family: A classic composition from the Hespéridé-Boisé family (citrusy-woody). Main notes: Contains essences of Italian sfuma lemon, French lavandin and Indonesian vetiver. Collection: Part of the Heritage range "Les Parfums Mythiques". Design: Cylindrical glass bottle with black lid and iconic logo label. Character: Combines aromatic freshness with a warm, woody base.

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY LES PARFUMS MYTHIQUES Eau de Toilette Spray Eau de Givenchy 100 ml
listings.description: As part of the "Les Parfums Mythiques" collection, Givenchy presents a fragrance composition that is characterised by its timeless elegance. The Eau de Givenchy Eau de Toilette Spray unfolds with a clear and invigorating note of bergamot, which provides a fresh opening. At the heart of the composition is the delicate orange blossom, which gives the fragrance a floral yet light character. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a base of musk, which leaves a gentle and lasting warmth on the skin. The interplay of these selected ingredients results in a harmonious fragrance that is reminiscent of the lightness of warm days. The transparent glass bottle with its simple, white cap reflects Givenchy's clear and purist aesthetic and emphasises the sophisticated character of the fragrance. Fragrance family: Floral-fruity Head note: Bergamot Heart note: orange blossom Base note: musk

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY LES PARFUMS MYTHIQUES Eau de Toilette Spray Ysatis 100 ml
listings.description: As part of the 'Les Mythiques' Heritage collection, Givenchy presents Ysatis, an iconic fragrance that embodies the multifaceted femininity between myth and elegance. This floral chypre composition, created by perfumer Dominique Ropion, is a tribute to timeless beauty. It opens with the radiant and sparkling essence of Sicilian mandarin, which gently fades into an opulent heart of white flowers. Here, the notes of jasmine, rose, tuberose and iris combine to create a full, floral accord. The base gives the fragrance its unmistakable depth and character: intense Indonesian patchouli is supported by earthy accents such as oakmoss and vetiver as well as warm nuances of sandalwood and Tahitian vanilla. The eau de toilette is presented in a redesigned, faceted bottle whose clear design reflects the aesthetic codes of the House of Givenchy, while the original fragrance formula remains unchanged. Fragrance direction: Floral, Chypre Character: A multi-faceted composition that pays homage to femininity Fragrance notes: A bouquet of white flowers, carried by patchouli and warm woody notes. Collection: Part of Givenchy's iconic 'Les Mythiques' Heritage collection.

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Spray Angélique Rouge 50 ml
listings.description: Discover L'Interdit Angélique Rouge Eau de Parfum - a limited edition and the second evolution of the Fleurs Interdites fragrance line. At the centre of the composition is angelica, which gives the fragrance its characteristic floral intensity. The classic trio of white flowers that defines L'Interdit is complemented by the red angelica flower - a note that is as expressive as it is mysterious, adding a new facet to the perfume.

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY LES PARFUMS MYTHIQUES Eau de Toilette Spray Extravagance D'Amarige 100 ml
listings.description: Mythical classics collection - Extravagance d’Amariage from the year 1998 is an ebullient fragrance that embodies fantasy-filled femininity, daring and cheerfulness. The radiant top notes are defined by an explosive mix of tagetes and green tangerines. Sensuously subtle, the core of jasmine and orange blossoms is highlighted by a very personal note of wisteria. The seductively intense reverberation from the radiantly light wood remains like a tattoo on your skin.

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY LES PARFUMS MYTHIQUES Eau de Toilette Spray Vetyver 100 ml
listings.description: Mythical masculine classics collection - vetyver from the year 1959 is an incredibly mascuilne fragrance with characteristic woody accents. In the prelude, the first vetiver accents meet the acidic freshness of bergamot. In the core, the full range of the vetiver root is then unleashed - subtly accentuated by notes of coriander. The finale is defined by the sensuous warmth of sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY PI Eau de Toilette Spray Extreme 100 ml
Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum Spray Vanille Couture 50 ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent presents Libre Vanille Couture, a limited-edition interpretation of the well-known fragrance. As an amber-gourmand composition, a warm and cosy fragrance experience unfolds. It opens with a combination of neroli and mandarin accompanied by the sweetness of bourbon vanilla. At the heart of the creation, orange blossom from the Ourika Gardens, jasmine sambac and French lavender combine to create a floral bouquet, whereby the typical Libre DNA remains recognisable, but is simplified and less harsh. A base of rum absolute and patchouli gives the fragrance a pleasant depth and rounds it off. A special feature is the "vanilla caviar" from Madagascar used, which develops a special richness through 18 months of maturation. The eau de parfum spray comes in a textured, metallic gold bottle with a design reminiscent of the luxury of couture fashion. Warm amber gourmand fragrance with a sweet floral character. Composition with notes of bourbon vanilla, orange blossom and rum absolute. Contains an 18-month matured "vanilla caviar" from Madagascar. Limited edition in a golden couture bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Kouros Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Kouros by Yves Saint Laurent is a fragrance composition that has been recognised for its unmistakable presence since its launch in 1981. The fragrance belongs to the aromatic fougère family and was created by perfumer Pierre Bourdon. The olfactory experience opens with a top note in which aldehydes meet the spicy notes of coriander and sage and the freshness of bergamot. At the heart, a complex interplay of clove, patchouli and cinnamon unfolds, complemented by floral accents of jasmine and geranium. The base note gives the fragrance its depth and long-lasting character through a combination of honey, leather, tonka bean and amber. The base is rounded off with musk, moss and a hint of vanilla. This composition creates a sensual, spicy fragrance that is particularly suitable for the evening hours and the cooler months of the year. Fragrance family: Aromatic fougère Character: Sensual and spicy Occasion: Suitable for the evening, autumn and winter seasons Fragrance notes: A composition of spicy, floral and leathery-sweet accords

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Nordhaven Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: With the Pana Dora Sweden Nordhaven Eau de Parfum Spray, the Swedish niche perfume house offers a multi-faceted unisex fragrance suitable for a wide range of occasions. The clear glass bottle, with its pale yellow essence and distinctive gold-coloured stag’s head cap, adds an appealing visual touch. The fragrance opens with fresh bergamot and juniper, creating a crisp, invigorating scent experience immediately upon spraying. As the fragrance develops, spicy caraway and incense unfold. This harmonious combination lends a distinctive yet unobtrusive presence, making it ideal for everyday business life or an evening out. The base notes of patchouli, guaiac wood and labdanum resin skilfully round off the profile. These deep, woody nuances ensure a long-lasting scent on the skin, meaning the fragrance remains noticeable for many hours and eliminates the need to reapply in the afternoon. Thanks to the balanced blend of the individual notes, the Eau de Parfum adapts flexibly to each person’s individual body chemistry and subtly emphasises one’s own style without being overpowering. A versatile unisex fragrance for everyday work and evening occasions An invigorating top note with bergamot and juniper for a fresh start A long-lasting base of guaiac wood and patchouli means you don’t need to reapply frequently Adapts flexibly to your individual body chemistry Eye-catching bottle design with a gold-coloured stag’s head cap

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Daydream Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Pana Dora Sweden Daydream Exclusive Perfume envelops you in a multi-layered fragrance composition inspired by Drottningholm Palace in Sweden. The balanced blend of earthy patchouli, smoky incense and warm guaiac wood gives you a distinctive aura for special occasions or the demands of everyday life. Subtle notes of tiger nut, labdanum resin, caraway and juniper round off the olfactory profile and leave a pleasant impression on those around you. Thanks to the high fragrance concentration of this Eau de Parfum, just a few sprays are enough to accompany you throughout the day with a lasting scent. This versatile unisex fragrance adapts to your individual skin chemistry and emphasises your personal touch in a distinct yet unobtrusive way. A striking cap in the shape of a stag’s head crowns the angular glass bottle, providing stylish storage for your fragrance collection. A complex unisex fragrance with a base of woody and spicy notes High fragrance concentration ensures a long-lasting experience throughout the day Economical to use thanks to the highly concentrated eau de parfum formulation Enhances your individual charisma in everyday life and at special events

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Sea Rose Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The name of the "Cool Water Sea Rose" eau de toilette spray from Davidoff says it all. The fine fragrance exudes floral and fresh essences that are never too intense or overpowering despite their unspoilt and natural nature. Instead, the rose fragrance combines with a cool breeze of fresh sea air to create a charming and delicate creation for women of all ages. The top note is composed of peony, freesia and nashi pear. A full-bodied fragrance with an oriental touch The exotic fragrance is rounded off by a base note of sensual and woody nuances , which is perfected by the top notes of musk and cedarwood. The individual ingredients of Davidoff Cool Water Sea Rose Eau de Toilette Spray thus complement each other in a unique way, creating a holistic, unmistakable fragrance that loses none of its effervescence and surprising moment even after repeated use.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Eau de Toilette Spray Reborn 125 ml
listings.description: Davidoff Cool Water Reborn is a reinterpretation of the well-known fragrance classic. The composition opens with an aromatic note of rosemary, which blends with the zesty freshness of galbanum. This invigorating top note creates a crisp and dynamic opening. As the fragrance develops, the heart note unfolds, with the woody facets of vetiver playing a central role. This earthy component lends the eau de toilette its distinctive character and a pleasant depth. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience and ensures a harmonious finish. The vegan formula consists of 94 per cent ingredients of natural origin and is presented in a modern bottle, whose colour gradient from dark to light blue reflects the fragrance’s aquatic inspiration. Fragrance type: Aromatic fougère Top notes: Rosemary, galbanum Heart note: Vetiver Formula: Vegan, 94% ingredients of natural origin

listings.rawTitle: Miro Rebel Eau de Parfum Spray 75 ml
listings.description: The Miro Rebel Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Intense offers a modern fragrance composition for everyday use. The top note of cardamom and bergamot opens the fragrance experience and gives a fresh radiance straight away in the morning. Lavender and cedarwood then unfold their character in the heart note, which supports a confident presence in the office or during leisure time. Finally, musk and vetiver in the base note round off the profile and leave a long-lasting, striking impression. The bluish tinted glass bottle with silver-coloured details emphasises the elegant direction of the fragrance. The balanced combination of nuances makes this creation ideal as a daily companion for a wide variety of occasions. One or two sprays from the practical atomiser are enough to apply the fragrance evenly. This makes it easy and time-saving to integrate the perfume into your morning routine. Modern fragrance composition with cardamom, cedarwood and vetiver Practical atomiser for even and easy application Versatile use for the office, everyday life and leisure Long-lasting base note for a striking presence

listings.rawTitle: Miro Secrets Eau de Parfum 75 ml
listings.description: The Miro Secret Eau de Parfum gives everyday life a floral, fruity fragrance that is suitable for a wide variety of occasions. The minimalist clear glass bottle with its silver spray head blends elegantly into the perfume collection. After spraying, fruity nuances of mandarin, blackcurrant, pineapple and melon unfold a fresh opening that can give a pleasant feeling straight away in the morning. Floral accords of rose, jasmine, violet and lily of the valley then combine to create a floral centrepiece. This combination creates an unobtrusive but clear presence that is suitable for both the office and evening events. The soft base of musk, vetiver, iris and a hint of peach harmoniously rounds off the fragrance experience. Thanks to these deep notes, the fragrance remains perceptible on the skin for a long time without being overpowering. Thanks to the balanced fragrance pyramid, the perfume can be flexibly integrated into the daily routine and emphasises a confident appearance in any situation. Floral-fruity fragrance composition for versatile everyday use Fresh opening with notes of mandarin, pineapple and melon Harmonious centrepiece of floral accords such as rose and jasmine Long-lasting perceptibility thanks to a base of musk and vetiver Unobtrusive character to support a confident appearance

listings.rawTitle: Miro Purple Musk Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray from the Purple Musk range by Miro is a unique fragrance that is uniquely beautiful too. Musk and vanilla belong to the category marked “sensual and seductive”. Rose and sandalwood give the fragrance a floral note, with rosewood adding a classy touch. The fragrance for warm summer nights spent together as a couple.

listings.rawTitle: Miro Blue Star Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
Miro Soleil Eau de Parfum Spray 75 ml
listings.description: Soleil by Miro is a really sunny, warm and zesty fragrance that also evokes memories of the summer when it is used during the winter and allows you to start the day with a suitable feeling of lightness.

listings.rawTitle: Miro Femme Eau de Parfum Spray 75 ml
listings.description: Miro Femme is a floral and fruity fragrance made up of bergamot, rosewood and ylang-ylang. It also carries with its a very sensual note thanks to jasmine and violet in the fragrance, with a seductive ensemble of musk, vetiver and violet finishing it off.

listings.rawTitle: Michael Kors Wonderlust Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Do you love Michael Kors fashion, perhaps just for everyday wear, on special occasions or on holiday? Then you might also love the Wonderlust Eau de Parfum Spray from the same brand. It is one of the fashion designer's fragrances that make you lust for the sea and exploring the world . A mix of the English word for "wonder" and "wanderlust" reveals that the fragrance is anything but boring and is aimed at fashionable women with wanderlust. Wanderlust and moments full of wonder Where does the world take you? Either way, Michael Kors' Wonderlust can be part of the party! Look forward to individual fragrances that come together as a harmonious eau de parfum spray for almost any holiday. The top note refreshes with mandarin and bergamot, spices up with pepper and cools with almond milk. The heart note transports you to an oriental floral world with exotic jasmine, heliotrope and carnation and reveals the wonders of nature, while the base is pleasantly grounding with soft cashmere and warm woods. The motto of Wonderlust is: Follow the longing of your heart! Discover the world and rely on the eau de parfum spray as a fragrant companion.

listings.rawTitle: Michael Kors Gorgeous! Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Michael Kors Gorgeous! is a floral-woody eau de parfum designed as a modern interpretation of a classic white floral bouquet. Launched in 2021, this fragrance celebrates feminine confidence with an elegant and optimistic aura. The composition opens with the sparkling freshness of mandarin orange, which meets the subtle spiciness of pink pepper for an invigorating opening. At the heart of the fragrance, an opulent floral arrangement of tuberose, jasmine sambac and orange blossom unfolds. An unexpected tobacco accord lends this heart note a fascinating, smoky depth. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a warm, woody base in which notes of guaiac and cedar wood merge with cashmeran, tonka bean and a hint of suede to create a long-lasting and luxurious base. A multi-faceted, floral-woody fragrance for women. Combines an opulent bouquet of white flowers with a surprising tobacco accord. Warm base note with woody nuances, tonka bean and suede. Presented as an eau de parfum spray.

listings.rawTitle: Michael Kors Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Spray Absolu 30 ml
listings.description: The Michael Kors Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Spray is a woody, spicy and citrusy composition from 2024 that reflects the invigorating energy and warmth of the ocean. The fragrance is characterised by its versatile character and is suitable for everyday wear as well as for professional life or special occasions. Its intense and long-lasting formulation ensures a present and fresh radiance. The Italian-made eau de parfum is presented in an elegant glass bottle with clear, rectangular lines. A striking, textured pattern in the centre, reminiscent of chain links, and the cap engraved with the brand name emphasise the stylish design of the fragrance. The fragrance experience opens with a lively top note of bergamot, complemented by pink pepper and lavandin. At the heart of the composition, an aromatic note of sage unfolds, accompanied by geranium and a fresh sea wave accord. This combination reinforces the feeling of freshness and a pleasant masculinity. The base of vetiver, patchouli and grey amber provides depth and a warm, velvety finish, giving the fragrance an elegant and modern finish.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Only the Brave Eau de Toilette Spray The Original 35 ml
listings.description: Diesel Only The Brave is an eau de toilette that embodies a powerful and urban character. The fragrance composition opens with a sparkling top note of lemon, mandarin and coriander leaves, which provides an invigorating prelude. Aromatic nuances of violet leaves, rosemary and the resin of the styrax tree then unfold at the heart of the creation. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a warm and striking base note, in which chords of leather, labdanum, amber and benzoin combine to create a long-lasting impression. This interplay creates a balance between fresh and deep, woody-leathery facets. The bottle underlines the fragrance's statement with its unmistakable design in the shape of a clenched fist, symbolising strength and originality. Fragrance character: Powerful and masculine with woody, leathery notes. Fragrance composition: An interplay of fresh citrus accents and warm accords of leather and amber. Head notes: Lemon, mandarin and coriander leaves. Flacon: Unmistakable design in the shape of a clenched fist.

listings.rawTitle: KENZO Kenzo Homme Eau de Toilette Spray 60 ml
listings.description: The KENZO HOMME Eau de Toilette Spray is a timeless, woody-maritime composition by perfumer Christian Matthieu. The fragrance opens with a fresh sea breeze characterised by aquatic and iodine notes, reminiscent of the vastness of the ocean. The clear, woody aromas of pine and cedar unfold in the heart, lending a natural depth. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a base of warm sandalwood, earthy oakmoss and vetiver. The bottle itself is a symbol of strength and flexibility, inspired by a bamboo cane. Its bevelled cap is reminiscent of the cut of a katana, the traditional samurai sword. Ecological aspects were also taken into account in the design by using 10% recycled glass and reducing the use of plastic in the cap. A woody fragrance for men with maritime and aquatic notes Fragrance composition of marine accord, pine, cedar and sandalwood Bamboo-design bottle with a cap reminiscent of a katana Consists partly of recycled glass and has a plastic-reduced cap A modern yet elegant fragrance for everyday wear

listings.rawTitle: KENZO FLOWER BY KENZO Eau de Parfum Spray Le Rouge 30 ml
listings.description: LE ROUGE FLOWER Eau de Parfum by KENZO reinterprets the iconic FLOWER signature in a powerful and sensual way. This floral-gourmand fragrance for women stands for intensity, depth and emotional radiance and is aimed at women who embody strength and elegance in equal measure. The opening is clear and pure: delicate musk meets fine rice vapour and gives the fragrance a modern, almost floating lightness. At the heart, the Damask rose unfolds in a more intense, multi-faceted form that redefines floral sensuality. The base seduces with a warm, enveloping composition of vanilla and sandalwood, enhanced by Amberever®, a powerful woody molecule that gives the fragrance depth and a long-lasting presence. As an olfactory interpretation of the colour red, LE ROUGE FLOWER combines vibrant energy with the Japanese DNA of the Maison KENZO and at the same time stands for a conscious commitment to sustainability. Intense floral-gourmand fragrance for women Pure opening of musk and rice vapour Powerful damask rose with new depth Warm base of vanilla, sandalwood and Amberever® Fragrance with a high proportion of ingredients of natural origin

listings.rawTitle: KENZO L'EAU KENZO Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: L'EAU KENZO is a tribute to the vitality and purity of water, captured in an eau de toilette that has been inspiring since 1996. The fragrance opens with an invigorating composition of fresh mint, mandarin and a subtle hint of pink pepper. At the centre of the creation is the delicate lotus blossom, whose aquatic facets are complemented by juicy peach and give the fragrance its characteristic lightness. A base of white musk and cedar wood provides a gentle and clear finish. The composition leaves an unobtrusive, fresh impression that is reminiscent of the feeling after a refreshing shower and is particularly suitable for the day and the spring and summer months. The commitment to nature is also reflected in the minimalist bottle, which is made from recycled glass and presented in packaging made from sustainable materials. listings.rawTitle: KENZO FLOWER BY KENZO Eau de Parfum Spray Ikebana Sakura 40 ml
listings.description: The KENZO FLOWER BY KENZO Ikebana Eau de Parfum Spray is an olfactory homage to Kenzo Takada's love of flowers and the art of living. Inspired by the Japanese art of flower arranging, Ikebana, a floral-woody composition created by perfumers Alexandra Monet and Alberto Morillas unfolds. At the centre of the fragrance is a balance of three distinctive notes: It opens with the unique aroma of sobacha tea, followed by the delicate sakura cherry blossom, enhanced by Indian tuberose absolute. A warm base of Australian sandalwood, cedarwood and vetiver gives the fragrance a lasting depth. Made in France, the eau de parfum consists of around 90% ingredients of natural origin. The bottle, which is reminiscent of a Japanese kakemono, emphasises the brand's conscious approach through the use of recycled materials and a recyclable cap. A floral-woody fragrance inspired by the Japanese art of ikebana. Main notes of sobacha tea, sakura cherry blossom and Australian sandalwood. Consists of around 90% ingredients of natural origin. listings.rawTitle: KENZO Kenzo Homme Eau de Parfum Spray Indigo 60 ml
listings.description: The KENZO HOMME Indigo Eau de Parfum Spray is a men's fragrance composition inspired by the power of nature. It opens with fresh, marine accords reminiscent of the clear coastal air. A creamy, woody iris extract with musky facets unfolds at the heart of the fragrance. The base note anchors the composition with a warm leather accord, which is characterised by smoky nuances and the depth of Akigala wood, sandalwood and vetiver. Kenzo pursues a sustainable approach with this perfume, which is reflected in the formula with around 95% ingredients of natural origin. The alcohol used comes from French farms that are switching to regenerative agriculture. The design of the bottle picks up on this closeness to nature: The opaque, indigo blue lacquer with a matt texture is reminiscent of a bamboo cane, while the bevelled cap is inspired by the shape of a katana samurai sword. listings.rawTitle: KENZO Kenzo Homme Eau de Toilette Spray Marine 60 ml

Luminous ylang-ylang joins in later, lending the fragrance an unexpected, sunny facet. The cap is modelled on the samurai's katana sword and completes the sophisticated design of this versatile fragrance. Elegant, maritime men's fragrance for versatile occasions. Fresh marine notes meet sunny ylang-ylang, sandalwood and musk. Formulated with approx. 95% ingredients of natural origin. Unique bottle inspired by bamboo and the katana sword.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia Eau de Parfum Spray Colonia Il Profumo 50 ml
listings.description: Experience the quintessence of Italian perfumery with Acqua di Parma's Colonia Il Profumo Eau de Parfum Spray. This exclusive perfume is a timeless unisex fragrance that captures the Mediterranean lifestyle in its purest form. The sparkling top note opens with a fascinating interplay of sun-ripened bergamot, juicy blood orange and refreshing grapefruit, refined by the elegant spice of petitgrain. This citrus symphony blends harmoniously into a floral, aromatic heart, where delicate orange blossom combines with tart rosemary and exotic ylang-ylang to create a seductive composition. Sensual unisex fragrance by Acqua di Parma for special occasions The full strength of character of the fragrance unfolds in the base note through the combination of earthy patchouli and woody vetiver, which give the perfume its unmistakable depth and persistence. Colonia Il Profumo is an aromatic-citrusy eau de parfum spray that is perfect for people who are looking for something special. The classic flacon design with the characteristic yellow label emphasises the timeless elegance of this extraordinary creation. A fragrance that skilfully blurs the boundaries between masculine and feminine, creating an exclusive aura that delights from morning to night. The perfect choice for individualists who value Italian craftsmanship and authentic luxury products.</p

Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Eau de Toilette Spray Mirto di Panarea 50 ml
listings.description: Panarea: The smallest and oldest Aeolian island radiates peace and tranquillity. Fragmented bays, bordered by luminous olive groves, are lapped by emerald-green waters. The myrtle plant grows among wild pistachios, agaves and broom. Even the goddess Venus wanted to adorn herself with a myrtle wreath when she was chosen by Paride. Myrtle has always symbolised beauty and love, and in the Middle Ages its fragrance was known as "angel's water". The fragrance of Mirto di Panarea caresses the skin and soul with a pleasant, intensely regenerating breeze from the Italian Mediterranean. The unmistakable scent of myrtle spreads slowly and pleasantly. The fragrance opens with an elegant, sparkling top note, characterised by citrus accents such as Calabrian lemon and sweet orange. It is emphasised by the simple and unadulterated aroma of basil. The heart note unfolds a blossoming core of velvet and elegance, where accents of jasmine, rose and lilac meet a light sea breeze and traces of blackcurrant. A feeling of deep well-being that reaches its full perfection in the woody base note with the aromatic scents of wild pistachio and juniper as well as cedarwood and amber.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Sandalo 50 ml
listings.description: Sandalo is a fresh and woody eau de parfum spray from the exclusive Milanese boutique Acqua di Parma. Launched in 2016, the unisex fragrance is characterised by a harmonious composition full of elegance and freshness . Very precious and rare sandalwood from India, which is characterised by the particular richness and intensity of its aromas, is the olfactory theme of this perfume. The citrus notes typical of the Colonia creation create a fascinating arc of tension. Timeless elegance in a trendy style Acqua di Parma Sandalo opens sparklingly fresh with a wide range of citrusy notes. The multi-faceted fragrance of petit grain, the oil from the leaves of the bitter orange, is joined by sparkling notes of subtly tart bergamot, ripe lemon and juicy orange. In the heart note, Acqua di Parma Sandalo Eau de Parfum Spray presents an irresistible play of colours and aromas. The intense, unmistakable scent of lavender from Provence is given additional character and depth by spicy, creamy accents of cardamom. In the base of the fragrance, the precious sandalwood impressively brings its elegance to the fore. Delicious, opulent tonka bean and soft ambergris bring this enchanting eau de parfum spray to an impressive close with a hint of irresistible sensuality. A unisex perfume that fascinates with its sophisticated composition and the intensity of its notes.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Oud & Spice 50 ml
listings.description: The Oud & Spice Eau de Parfum Spray from the Signatures Of The Sun fragrance line by Acqua di Parma combines exquisite spices with warm woody and appealing oriental fragrance accords. With spirited pepper and elegant agarwood The Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Oud & Spice Eau de Parfum Spray is a self-confident fragrance for men, based on a slightly tart base, which is livened up by sparkling fruity nuances in the top note. An exquisite blend of spices rounds off the fragrance, which has been available since 2021, and gives it temperament. Upon application, Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Oud & Spice Eau de Parfum Spray initially envelops you in an invigorating blend of tangy bergamot and seductive raspberries, which combine with an elegant rose nuance. The heart note consists of pink pepper , cloves and cinnamon and gives the creation strength and an excitingly passionate tone. The base has a gentle and calming effect: warm agarwood meets creamy ladan resin and oriental patchouli, which has a pleasantly rough and masculine effect.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Quercia 50 ml
listings.description: The Colonia Quercia fragrance dates back to 2016 and was released as an eau de parfum spray by Acqua di Parma in 2019. The fragrance of the masculine eau de parfum spray is spicy and woody . It is debatable whether the perfume is more of a unisex fragrance or a men's fragrance. However, you won't argue about the elegant composition, the chic black bottle or the enormous longevity and sillage. Querica by Acqua di Parma is not an eau de parfum spray for everyone. The fragrance is aimed at people who are looking for the extraordinary , but don't want to find it in screamingly loud compositions. They are not looking for a fragrance with rough edges, but something expressive. Intensity sends its regards The top note of Acqua di Parma Quercia consists of pink pepper, petitgrain, lemon and bergamot. The heart note combines rose geranium, cardamom and cedarwood. Patchouli, tonka bean absolute and oakmoss absolute round off the eau de parfum. Acqua di Parma Quercia is suitable for everyday wear, but can also be worn in the evening. The eau de parfum spray has the all-round qualities typical of the Milanese label, which is aimed at the modern man of today, who feels just as comfortable in jeans as in a suit.

Patchouli, tonka bean absolute and oakmoss absolute round off the eau de parfum. Acqua di Parma Quercia is suitable for everyday wear, but can also be worn in the evening. The eau de parfum spray has the all-round qualities typical of the Milanese label, which is aimed at the modern man of today, who feels just as comfortable in jeans as in a suit.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Oud 50 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Oud is a new fragrance from Acqua di Parma. Launched in 2019, the Eau de Parfum Spray is a variation of Colonia Oud, which has been available since 2012 and is an Eau de Cologne Concentrée. Of course, both woody-spicy fragrances are men's fragrances, but some women also like to wear them. The eau de parfum spray from Acqua di Parma is naturally significantly stronger in its presence and has enormous longevity and sillage, just as you would expect from an eau de parfum spray from the traditional Milanese brand. A fragrance that definitely stands out The top note of Acqua di Parma perfume begins with Italian orange and Calabrian bergamot. It gives way to heart notes of Russian coriander, Haitian amyris and, of course, precious oud. In the almost opulent base, the flavours of Atlas cedar meet Indonesian patchouli, fine sandalwood and musk. The result is a noble masculine composition that is particularly suitable for wearing on cooler days, but can also be worn on summer evenings. Acqua di Parma Oud is a fragrance that flatters the modern man of today. This is because the fragrance has a clear but not overpowering presence.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Osmanthus 50 ml
listings.description: Acqua di Parma Osmanthus is a floral-fruity unisex perfume from 2019. The eau de parfum spray is a wonderful addition to the 'Signature of the Sun' fragrance line, which presents particularly precious olfactory ingredients against a radiant, sun-drenched backdrop. Acqua di Parma Osmanthus invites you to take an unforgettable walk through the green forest landscape of south-east Asia . This is the home of the shrub from whose flowers the irresistibly fruity-scented absolute that gives the eau de parfum spray its name is extracted. Its delicate, delicious peach aromas carry subtle nuances of wood and leather and ensure elegant sensuality. An elegant floral fragrance with a sparkling opening Acqua di Parma Osmanthus opens sparkling and fresh with juicy, green mandarin from Sicily and fragrant neroli oil, which powerfully reveals its citrusy richness. The top note brings subtly sensual accents into play. The floral fragrance of delicate peony is joined by beguiling ambrette with its soft, creamy musky scent. A hint of pink pepper discreetly limits the intense notes and gives the eau de parfum spray a fascinating tingle. In the base of the perfume, the star of the show, the osmanthus fragrance, unfolds all its magic. Mossy, woody patchouli supports its sensual elegance with mossy, woody accents.

Acqua di Parma Ginepro di Sardegna Eau de toilette spray 30 ml
listings.description: The eau de toilette spray Ginepro di Sardegna comes from the product repertoire of the brand Acqua di Parma. The perfume is designed as a unisex fragrance and emits a touch of freshness, which lasts for the whole day. The special thing about the eau de toilette spray is that it reflects the Mediterranean feeling of the coast of Sardinia. The fragrance is dynamic and light: Juniper berry essences imitate warm rays of the sun and a salty sea breeze. It is simply a masterful fragrance composition, which is captivating with its versatile aromatic notes. A breath-taking fragrance The perfume Ginepro di Sardegna is based on the essences of juniper berries, bergamot and various spices. The heart note is based on cypress and sage. Cedar and Virginia create a harmonious balance of contrasts, which creates a lot of excitement and variation. Only one spray spreads the feeling of the Mediterranean attitude to life, which is a huge success from an olfactory point of view. The elegance and versatility of the Acqua di Parma fragrances still remains unrivalled. Let yourself be covered by a true everyday companion, which guarantees elegance and style in any situation!

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Yuzu 50 ml
listings.description: The citrus-aromatic Eau de Parfum Spray Yuzu is the latest member of the 'Frutti d'Oro' family from the traditional luxury perfume house Acqua di Parma. Launched in 2019, the unisex fragrance by French star perfumers Nicolas Bonneville and François Demachy is dedicated to Japan's most delicious fruit , the yuzu. Its unique, bitter-sweet aroma combines with the citrusy accents so typical of Acqua di Parma fragrances to create a tingling, fresh fragrance experience with an addictive character. A sparkling fragrance with plenty of elegance and a touch of sensuality The Eau de Parfum Spray opens with a revitalising cocktail in which an intense yuzu accent is joined by the aromas of juicy bergamot from Calabria and sparkling Szechuan pepper. Delicate, graceful blossoms unfold their magic in the heart of the perfume. It presents an elegant, white bouquet of noble lotus, delicate mimosa and fragrant jasmine, gently framed by a green nuance of violet leaf. The extraordinary base of the Eau de Parfum Spray from Acqua di Parma is decidedly sensual. Soft, warm musk, precious sandalwood and liquorice and a hint of liquorice bring the fragrance to an impressive close.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Magnolia Infinita 50 ml
listings.description: Italian sophistication and discreet luxury: this is what Acqua di Parma has stood for since it was founded in 1916. Created by Baron Carlo Magnani from Parma for personal fragrances, Acqua di Parma has maintained its reputation as a centre of elegant fragrances to this day. The Signatures Of The Sun series with the composition Magnolia Infinita Eau de Parfum Spray is a testament to the craftsmanship of Italian perfumery. The creation for women combines the radiant scent of magnolia with the vibrancy of fresh citrus notes. Released in 2022, Magnolia Infinita Eau de Parfum Spray is still a relatively new addition to the Acqua di Parma fragrances. Elegant and floral fragrance cocktail in an iconic bottle The Magnolia Infinita Eau de Parfum Spray from the Signatures Of The Sun series combines the scent of Calabrian bergamot and the fresh aroma of orange and lemon in the top note. A few moments later, the intense and lush heart note surprises with a combination of magnolia, jasmine, rose and ylang-ylang. The sensual notes of musk and patchouli meet in the base. The transparent black bottle of Magnolia Infinita Eau de Parfum Spray is iconic. It is adorned with the black Signatures of the Sun label. With its golden lettering, it interprets the vibrant rays of the sun.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Luce di Rosa Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: If you are looking for an exclusive and exquisite perfume, we recommend the eau de parfum spray Luce di Rosa from the Acqua di Parma label. This fragrance is characterised by both modernity and dynamism and pampers the olfactory senses in a unique way thanks to its composition of floral, woody and rosy notes. A perfume that knows how to refresh Luce di Rosa owes its incomparably fresh fragrance to a sophisticated fragrance pyramid. The top notes are bergamot, longoza oil and pink pepper , while the heart notes are rose oil, geranium and fresh black pepper . Finally, the base note is composed of vetiver oil, guaiac wood and cedar wood . It is therefore not surprising that this eau-de-perfume spray casts a very special spell over its wearer and their surroundings. Acqua di Parma is a unisex fragrance, making it suitable for couples who want to show that they belong together. It is no coincidence that this perfume is so captivating, as the Acqua di Parma company has existed since 1916 and can therefore look back on a long tradition. This eau-de-parfum spray, which is typical of the Italian art of living, is the result of a wealth of experience.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Iris Nobile Eau de parfum spray 50 ml
listings.description: The embodiment of feminine Italian elegance and a sensual new interpretation of the iris - that’s Iris Nobile. A feminine fragrance through and through from the house of Acqua di Parma, it was exclusively created for the confident woman with elegance and style. listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Eau de Toilette Spray 75 ml
listings.description: Davidoff Cool Water Eau de Toilette Spray is an iconic fragrance that evokes the untamed power and freshness of the ocean. Since its launch in 1988, this fragrance has been regarded as a timeless classic. It opens with an intense, aromatic wave in which marine notes blend with fresh mint, coriander and lavender. As the fragrance develops, the composition transitions into a heart of sandalwood, jasmine and neroli, which lends the scent a clear yet subtle depth. The base note ensures a long-lasting and warm finish, with nuances of musk, ambergris and cedarwood blending harmoniously. Presented in the distinctive blue bottle, the atomiser allows for easy and precise application. The eau de toilette unfolds best when sprayed from a short distance onto warm areas of skin such as the wrists. A timeless fragrance classic with a fresh and aquatic character. A composition of marine top notes, a woody heart and a warm musk-amber base. Ideal as an invigorating fragrance for everyday wear. Eau de Toilette in the iconic blue spray bottle.

The composition opens with an invigorating note of pink pepper, creating a spicy and dynamic opening. At the heart of the fragrance, the distinctive aroma of vetiver unfolds. This special ingredient is sourced from Haiti as part of a sustainable and ethical partnership, lending the fragrance an earthy yet authentic depth. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a base of creamy sandalwood, which leaves a long-lasting, warm and masculine signature on the skin. This interplay creates a fresh, woody fragrance that exudes strength and sophistication. A fresh, woody men’s fragrance with an elegant signature. A clear fragrance pyramid of pink pepper, vetiver and sandalwood. Contains ethically sourced vetiver from a sustainable partnership in Haiti. Combines the characteristic freshness of Cool Water with warm, woody notes.

With its base note of hand-harvested saffron, the composition gains a striking depth that lends a confident presence to everyday life. listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Night Dive Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Cool Water Night Dive: Fresh in a new way Davidoff stands for quality and innovative men’s fragrances without doubt. With the perfume Cool Water Night Dive perfumer Jean-Christophe Hérault has succeeded in creating a perfume that is a cut above the rest. Hérault learnt his trade from scratch with Pierre Bourdon, who created a milestone with Cool Water in the history of perfumery a quarter of a century ago. The Eau de Toilette Spray from Davidoff that is currently conquering the market is paying homage to the great master. A clear and sensual perfume for men The new scent is green-oriental, a vital prerequisite for the mysterious aura that surrounds this otherwise cool and composed perfume. The basis of the scent is the wood of the pistachio , an extremely valuable and rarely used raw material that is also known as mastic wood. The precious Eau de Toilette Spray develops opening with a note of fresh fruit and mint that is an ideal match for the sensual woody note. A hint of cashmere adds an oriental component to the mix. The successful composition is rounded off through typically male ingredients such as amber, sage, black pepper, tobacco and musk. And yet, words alone can’t do it justice. Cool Water Night Dive from Davidoff is a clear enticement to get a sniff of it.

listings.description: The True Icon eau de parfum spray from Aigner is characterised by a multi-faceted fragrance structure that harmoniously combines apparent opposites. With cedar wood, bitter leather and basil, an oriental and energising perfume is created, which creates an atmosphere of well-being.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Baby Touch Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Anyone who likes Baby Touch by Burberry but finds it too strong for everyday wear will be delighted with the fragrance's Gentle Eau de Toilette Spray. The bottle is pale green, shaped like a cone and sits comfortably in the hand. In the Citrus Gourmand fragrance family, the Gentle Eau de Toilette Spray by Baby Touch is fresh and light, soft and pleasant. It is always present, but not overpowering, so that even young mothers enjoy wearing this alcohol-free fragrance. The fragrance carries the British chic of Burberry around the globe and has been inspiring not only the ladies' world since 2002. A delicate fragrance that always fits In contrast to the original Baby Touch by Burberry, the Gentle Eau de Toilette Spray has verbena, mandarin, rhubarb, orange peel and spearmint in the top note. The heart note is made up of jasmine, lily of the valley, cyclamen, orange blossom and jasmine. The base note is particularly interesting. This is because it does not contain the usual suspects, but moss, vanilla and milk. This composition makes the fragrance incomparable, almost unique. It is just right for every occasion and at any time of year. And because the fragrance is alcohol-free , it is also suitable for sensitive skin.

The composition unfolds as a multi-layered fragrance experience for all genders. It opens with a fresh yet sweet combination of Italian bergamot, crisp apple and a delicate hint of honeycomb. The heart of the creation combines floral notes of jasmine and rose with a warm honey accent that lends the fragrance a gentle and inviting depth. The base provides a long-lasting and creamy finish, combining tonka bean, heliotropin, musk and hawthorn to create a harmonious and balsamic blend. This fragrance embodies Trussardi's typical Italian elegance and captures the feeling of an endless day of shopping in a stylish bottle. A multi-layered unisex fragrance with sweet, fruity and creamy facets. Composition of bergamot, apple, honey, rose and tonka bean. Inspired by the elegant atmosphere of Milan's Via della Spiga. listings.rawTitle: Trussardi Primo Eau de Parfum Spray Notte Blu 30 ml
listings.description: The Trussardi Primo Notte Blu Eau de Parfum offers an intense fragrance experience that emphasises a modern and magnetic aura in everyday life. listings.rawTitle: Trussardi 1911 Donna Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Trussardi 1911 Donna Eau de Toilette Spray is a composition that embodies modern elegance and a bright, dynamic radiance. Created by the renowned perfumer Nathalie Lorson, this fragrance captures the essence of timeless femininity. listings.rawTitle: Trussardi Le Vie di Milano Eau de Parfum Spray Behind The Curtain Piazza Alla Scala 100 ml
listings.description: Behind The Curtain Piazza Alla Scala is an olfactory homage to the famous Teatro alla Scala opera house in Milan and part of the exclusive Le Vie di Milano collection. listings.rawTitle: Trussardi Le Vie di Milano Eau de Parfum Spray Musc Noir Perfume Enhancer 100 ml
listings.description: The Musc Noir Perfume Enhancer from the Le Vie di Milano collection by Trussardi is a tribute to the versatility of modern fragrances. Cedarwood in the base provides a clear structure and a pleasantly warm depth. This woody-floral unisex fragrance embodies the subtle elegance of Milan and is a creation for all those who appreciate the special in the unobtrusive. listings.rawTitle: Trussardi Le Vie di Milano Eau de Parfum Spray Alba Sui Navigli 100 ml

listings.rawTitle: Trussardi Le Vie di Milano Eau de Parfum Spray I Vocoli Via Fiori Chiari 100 ml
listings.description: The narrow cobbled streets of Milan's artistic district of Brera are the inspiration for Trussardi Le Vie di Milano I Vicoli Via Fiori Chiari Eau de Parfum Spray. The fragrance itself presents itself as a complex interplay of different aromas that evoke a bohemian atmosphere. The top note opens with an invigorating blend of star anise, cardamom and tangy lemon. This is followed by a heart note full of character, in which the spiciness of black pepper is combined with the deep, earthy accents of patchouli. The base, which combines creamy Madagascar vanilla with an intense liqueur accord, ensures a long-lasting finish. The design of the bottle echoes the elegance of the contents: A rectangular, brown glass body is crowned by a golden stopper in the shape of a stylised greyhound's head. listings.rawTitle: Guess Iconic Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The popular Eau de Parfum Spray Iconic from the luxury label Guess is a typical fougère fragrance. The name Iconic already refers to a worthy cult figure, so the fragrance pyramid also begins with a leather accord, vetiver and the noble, white cyst rose in the base note. The sweet grass in the fragrance composition is the symbol of the fougère fragrance. In the top note, nuances of black pepper, sweet mandarin and Sichuan pepper provide an invigorating change. The heart note rounds off the pyramid in a sophisticated way with spicy sage, geranium and Maté Absolute, which provides a moment of green tea. All the flavours are perfectly coordinated in this perfume. Eau de Parfum Spray Iconic by Guess with seductive fragrance notes for everyday wear The intense perfume from the cosmetics house Guess is bottled in an artistically designed bottle. The rectangular, flat bottle made of transparent glass is enclosed by a narrow leather band. The logo G of the label looks like a belt buckle on the front of the bottle. The clasp is also designed with leather. White stitching on the leather straps catches the eye. This eau de parfum spray is therefore bottled in a glass bottle that perfectly matches the fragrance. The perfume is packed in a cardboard box.

listings.rawTitle: Histoires de Parfums Ceci n'est pas un flacon Bleu Eau de Parfum Spray Blue 1.2 15 ml
listings.description: Ceci n'est pas un flacon Bleu, this is not a blue bottle, is also the name of the Eau de Parfum Spray Blue 1.2 by Histoires de Parfums. Why the brand has named the fragrance this way, even though the bottle is clearly blue and decorated with lots of colourful dots, is one of those mysteries that invite you to puzzle over it. The name Eau de Parfum Spray Blue 1.2 somehow makes more sense. In any case, the floral and fresh fragrance from Histoires de Parfums is aimed at both men and women. Luca Maffei created the fragrance and gave it a top note of ivy and pink pepper. The heart combines lily of the valley, ylang-ylang and lilac. Sandalwood, white musk and vanilla come together in the base. Ceci n'est pas un flacon Bleu or is it? Eau de Parfum Blue 1.2, often referred to as "This is not a blue Bottle 1.2", is the perfect fragrance for all year round: during the day, when going out, at work or in your free time. It delights with its freshness, its lightness , its sillage and its casual nonchalance . Then the Eau de Parfum Spray Blue 1.2 by Histoires de Parfums can also be called Ceci n'est pas un flacon Bleu. Perhaps there need to be more enchanting fragrances that confuse the senses a little.

listings.rawTitle: Histoires de Parfums Library of Scents Eau de Parfum Spray 1899 60 ml
listings.description: Inspired by a literary legend, the Histoires de Parfums 1899 Eau de Parfum Spray tells a story full of elegance and character. This olfactory creation from the French fragrance house pays homage to Ernest Hemingway and captures the atmosphere of a legendary Parisian bar. It opens with an invigorating blend of Italian bergamot, juniper berries and a hint of black pepper. At the heart of the composition, a bouquet of orange blossom and Florentine iris unfolds, refined by the warm spice of cinnamon. The base note anchors the fragrance with the gentle sweetness of vanilla, earthy vetiver and warm ambergris, resulting in a long-lasting and multi-faceted fragrance experience. 1899 is a complex, spicy-aromatic fragrance that creates a sophisticated balance between freshness and warmth and leaves an unobtrusive but present sillage. A multi-layered, spicy-aromatic fragrance character. Composition of fresh, floral, spicy and woody notes. Inspired by Ernest Hemingway and the Paris of the 1940s. A creation from the French niche perfume house Histoires de Parfums.

This vegan eau de parfum is a tribute to the simple rituals that accompany the start of a new day. listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens COLLECTION NOIRE Eau de Parfum Spray Fleurs d´Oranger 50 ml
listings.description: The Fleurs d'Oranger Eau de Parfum Spray from the COLLECTION NOIRE by Serge Lutens is an olfactory journey inspired by the perfumer's arrival in Morocco in 1968. The composition captures the vivid memory of women picking the precious white blossoms of the bitter orange tree. At the heart of this fragrance, the radiant and pure note of orange blossom unfolds, accompanied by opulent Egyptian jasmine and delicate white rose. Facets of tuberose and hibiscus lend the creation an additional floral dimension, while a hint of cumin and a subtle animalic nuance provide an unexpected depth. The experience is rounded off with warm musky notes and woody accords. Presented in the brand's signature minimalist and clean bottle, Fleurs d'Oranger is a sophisticated unisex fragrance that captivates with its classic yet uncompromising composition. A floral fragrance from the Collection Noire. Centred fragrance notes of orange blossom, Egyptian jasmine and white rose. Sophisticated, classic unisex composition. Presented in a minimalist and clear bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens COLLECTION NOIRE Eau de Parfum Spray Ambre Sultan 50 ml
listings.description: Inspired by a piece of amber discovered in Marrakech and kept in a thuja wood casket, Ambre Sultan reveals a unique and resinous fragrance signature. The composition from Serge Lutens' Collection Noire is characterised by its complexity, in which warm and spicy notes form a harmonious combination. The fragrance opens with aromatic accents of bay leaf, coriander and oregano, which lead into a heart of amber, labdanum and various balsams. A base of vanilla, patchouli and sandalwood rounds off the fragrance experience and lends it a pleasant depth. The minimalist, straightforward bottle emphasises the clear and unmistakable character of the fragrance and reflects the brand's aesthetic. An eau de parfum from the Collection Noire. Combines spicy, resinous and woody notes. Contains amber, vanilla and patchouli, among others. Presented in a minimalist and straightforward bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens COLLECTION NOIRE Eau de Parfum Spray L'Orpheline 50 ml
listings.description: With an ethereal yet profound aura, the eau de parfum L'Orpheline is an integral part of Serge Lutens' renowned Collection Noire. Launched in 2014, this olfactory creation represents a return to purist and clear structures. A striking note of incense unfolds at the centre of the composition, giving the fragrance an almost sacred, cool and enveloping character. This smoky main accord is accompanied by the fine, vibrant spiciness of black pepper, which creates a spicy dynamic without overwhelming the senses. The base is defined by nuances of dry woods, which create a consistent and elegant depth. This creation deliberately dispenses with lush floral elements and instead focuses consistently on a minimalist, woody-smoky signature that moves beyond classic gender categorisations as a versatile unisex fragrance. This uncompromising straightforwardness is also reflected visually: the striking, rectangular bottle made of clear glass reveals a dark, almost black liquid that forms an aesthetic contrast to the simple black label with the white "SERGE LUTENS" lettering and the iconic SL logo. A round, black cap completes the harmonious overall look of this niche fragrance. Fragrance character: A purist composition with woody, smoky and spicy facets. Main notes: Dominated by incense, accentuated by black pepper and dry woods. Collection: Part of the minimalist and elegant Collection Noire by Serge Lutens. Target group: Designed as a unisex perfume without floral heaviness. Design: Rectangular glass bottle with black liquid, black label and SL logo.

listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens COLLECTION NOIRE Eau de Parfum Spray Féminité du Bois 50 ml
listings.description: Féminité du Bois from the Collection Noire by Serge Lutens is a fragrance creation that is considered a milestone of the 1990s. The eau de parfum is characterised by an extraordinary composition in which a dominant cedarwood note defines the character. This woody presence is accompanied by a fruity plum note and a warm, spicy aura. Facets of cardamom, cinnamon and clove lend the fragrance a special depth, while floral accents such as orange blossom, violet and rose in the heart note ensure a multi-layered development. Sweet notes of honey, beeswax and musk round off the fragrance experience in the base. This fusion of traditionally feminine and masculine elements creates an innovative fragrance. The creation is presented in a simple, geometric bottle that reflects the clear and sophisticated style of the Serge Lutens brand. listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens COLLECTION NOIRE Eau de Parfum Spray La fille de Berlin 50 ml
listings.description: A fragrance that captures the fascinating duality of a rose is at the centre of this expressive composition from the renowned Collection Noire. Serge Lutens dedicates this creation to the city of Berlin, creating an olfactory portrait full of strength of character that tells a story. The top note opens abruptly with the striking, spicy pungency of black pepper, which immediately creates a certain tension. An intense rose then unfolds in the heart, which deliberately avoids excessive sweetness. Instead, metallic and spicy accents make the blossom almost thorny, explosive and defensive. This floral centre is accompanied by harmonious nuances such as clove and geranium, which lend the bouquet additional complexity. Warm amber woods and white musk in the base note provide a long-lasting, profound finish. The minimalist design of the rectangular bottle with its clear, architectural lines and black label draws all the attention to the essence. A stylised logo rounds off the visual appearance. The formula is also vegan-certified and, as a unisex fragrance, is aimed at anyone who appreciates narrative fragrances beyond the mainstream. Fragrance character: Floral and spicy with striking notes of rose and black pepper. Composition: A complex blend with metallic accents, amber woods and white musk. Design: Minimalist, rectangular bottle in the typical style of the Collection Noire. Features: Vegan-certified formula, suitable for all genders.

listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens COLLECTION NOIRE Eau de Parfum Spray La Fille Tour de Fer 50 ml
listings.description: A new facet of the renowned Collection Noire is revealed with this creation from 2024, which was developed in collaboration with perfumer Christopher Sheldrake. At the centre of the composition is an unconventional rose duo of Turkish and Bulgarian flowers, which offers a modern and multi-layered interpretation of classic floral notes. These floral accords meet the powdery, elegant nuances of iris, which lend the arrangement a certain depth. The bouquet is complemented by natural pink berry, which adds a spicy and fresh accent. The character of the eau de parfum deliberately plays with contrasts and wraps the delicate flower in metaphorical armour, giving the fragrance a rebellious and metallic note. The result is an olfactory impression that is both dark and luminous and emphasises independence. The purple liquid shimmers through the transparent, rectangular glass bottle, while a black label with white lettering and the stylised SL logo rounds off the minimalist design. A round, black cap completes the overall aesthetic look. The certified vegan formula is aimed at all genders and dispenses with rigid categorisation. Fragrance composition: Contains notes of Turkish and Bulgarian rose, iris and pink berry. Design: Transparent, rectangular bottle with purple-coloured liquid and black cap. Collection: Part of the Collection Noire, launched in 2024. Special feature: Certified vegan formula with unisex character.

listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens COLLECTION NOIRE Eau de Parfum Spray Le Perce-vent 50 ml
listings.description: A fascinating interplay of coolness and warmth characterises this composition, which expands the Collection Noire in 2025. The olfactory journey begins with an intense, almost camphor-like freshness that is immediately present and evokes associations with icy, clear air. At the centre of the creation is clary sage, whose herbaceous and slightly tart nuances lend the fragrance a striking yet calm structure. Serge Lutens takes up the image of the eye in a cyclone here by gently transforming this cool opening into a luminous centre. White amber and soft musk form the reliable foundation and ensure an earthy, steady finish that harmoniously cushions the initial sharpness. Optically, the eau de parfum spray has the familiar aesthetic of the line. The rectangular, transparent bottle allows a clear view of the liquid, while the black label with stylised white lettering and the spherical cap underline the minimalist claim. This unisex creation deliberately dispenses with unnecessary embellishments and focuses entirely on the purity of the selected essences. Fragrance notes: A combination of clear sage, white amber and musk. Character: Starts with a menthol-like freshness and develops into a warm, earthy base. Design: Minimalist, rectangular bottle with black label and spherical cap from the Collection Noire. Concept: Olfactory interpretation of a calm centre in the storm ("eye of the cyclone"). Target group: Unisex fragrance for lovers of straightforward and conceptual perfumes.

listings.rawTitle: Serge Lutens COLLECTION NOIRE Eau de Parfum Spray La nuit tombée 50 ml
listings.description: A fragrance like a whisper of the night: this composition from the Serge Lutens universe unfolds quietly, profoundly and full of poetic intensity. Inspired by the transition between light and darkness, the result is a chypre fragrance that interweaves memories, silence and emotions. Frankincense opens with a mysterious, smoky aura, while cedarwood gives the fragrance structure and clarity. Patchouli rounds off the composition with earthy depth and creates a sensual, almost meditative atmosphere. The minimalist, purist fragrance line is also reflected in the iconic bottle - clear, angular and uncompromisingly elegant. For decades, Serge Lutens has been synonymous with olfactory works of art with extraordinary expressiveness that are more than just fragrances: they are personal stories captured in a subtle, fascinating signature. - Mystical chypre fragrance with incense, cedarwood and patchouli - Inspired by the poetic mood of the night - Expressive, elegant and deliberately minimalist composition - Iconic, purist bottle with clean lines - Fragrance with emotional depth and an individual signature

listings.description: Inspired by the carefree beauty of a wildflower meadow, Coach Wild Rose unfolds as a delicate yet expressive fragrance. listings.rawTitle: Coach Pure Platinum Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Coach For Men Eau de Toilette Spray 60 ml offers an aromatic, woody fragrance that brings modern, cosmopolitan New York style straight into your everyday life. Spraying the eau de toilette onto warm areas of the body, such as the neck or wrists, allows the aroma to develop particularly well. A metallic, gleaming bottle featuring an engraved horse-drawn carriage and an elegant pendant stylishly houses the fragrance. listings.rawTitle: Coach Open Road Eau de Toilette Spray 40 ml
listings.description: Enjoy your road trip across America - with Open Road by Coach! Because the eau de toilette spray was inspired by this adventure. It is one of those fragrances that transports you to another world after a few fragrant moments. Perhaps you are even planning a real road trip? Then use Open Road as a companion to remind you of your journey every time you smell it! A fast-paced scented journey The top note of the Coach fragrance begins with spicy pepper, tickling your nose and awakening your thirst for adventure. Get ready for the road trip! Fresh accords of apple and lemon complete the opening and make you want to discover the nature of the USA. The heart note of lavender and clary sage does not promise too much either. It blends the two fragrances for a pleasant contrast, just as your journey through the USA will certainly be full of contrasts between city and country. Sometimes you will constantly meet like-minded people, sometimes you will be travelling alone for hours through the wilderness. A breath of freedom! The Open Road Eau de Toilette Spray ends in a base of vetiver and woods - a feeling of arrival. Just as your road trip should end.

The composition opens with an explosion of citrusy freshness from bergamot, which blends harmoniously with the spicy notes of coriander and pepper. As the fragrance progresses, a rhythmic woody foundation unfolds, giving the perfume its characteristic crystalline woodiness. Notes of cedarwood and patchouli provide a striking structure, while soft musk gently rounds off the composition. Aqaysos creates a fascinating balance between lightness, transparency and a subtle sensual effect, making the fragrance an elusive yet present companion. An eau de parfum from the Black Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris. Versatile fragrance with a characteristic crystalline woodiness. Fragrance composition of citrus, spicy and woody notes. With bergamot, coriander, cedarwood and musk.
