listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Beyond Collection Extrait de Parfum Le Musc & La Peau 50 ml
listings.description: The Le Musc & La Peau Extrait de Parfum from the Beyond Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris is a concentrated and newly orchestrated version of the iconic fragrance. This composition unfolds as a woody-amber fragrance with a deep and direct musky character that appears more intense than the original eau de parfum. At its centre is a complex accord of seven different types of musk that recreates the sensory impression of human skin without resorting to animal or soapy notes. This extraordinary base is complemented by an innovative rosemary milk that gives the creation a special facet. Finely balanced notes of ylang-ylang, ambergris, cedar and sandalwood round off the olfactory experience and create an intimate aura close to the skin. Conceived as the brand's first extrait, this fragrance pays homage to human closeness and is suitable for wearing on its own or as an individual base for other perfumes. Intense extrait de parfum version of the iconic fragrance Le Musc & La Peau. Woody-ambery fragrance family with a deep musky character. Unique composition with rosemary milk, ylang-ylang, ambergris, cedar and sandalwood. Based on an accord of seven types of musk for a particularly close-to-the-skin fragrance experience.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 31 Tonka Bodykon 50 ml
listings.description: 31 Tonka Bodykon from the Numbered Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris is a fragrance that deliberately seeks closeness to the body and feels like a second skin. This unisex composition pays homage to the tonka bean, which is embedded as a central component in a sweet and soft amber structure. Inspired by the colour palette of a sunset, the eau de parfum is reminiscent of a fine tonka liqueur, enhanced by balsamic and fruity nuances. The fragrance journey begins with top notes of amber-coloured rum and the eponymous tonka bean. A gourmand accord of crisp apple, golden honey and soft vanilla unfolds in the heart. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a base note of pistachio and the warm resin of benzoin, which give the fragrance a pleasant depth and a long-lasting presence. The result is a body-conscious fragrance for anyone who appreciates a subtle yet expressive sillage. Fragrance character: Sweet amber composition with tonka bean at the centre Fragrance family: Gourmand, amber Speciality: Skin-friendly and body-conscious unisex fragrance Concentration: Eau de Parfum

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Black Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Liqueur Charnelle 50 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the multifaceted aromas of a fine cognac, Liqueur Charnelle is an eau de parfum spray from the Black Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris. The composition interprets the five characteristic notes of the distillate in an olfactory way and combines vanilla, plum, caramel, orange and apricot to create a harmonious opening. This bouquet is complemented by floral and fruity facets of dried lime blossom, violet and pressed grapes. Spicy accents of pink berries, elemi and black pepper lend the fragrance a special depth, while a base of tonka bean, light tobacco and powdery woods provides a sensual finish. Depending on the wearer, the fragrance unfolds its complexity in different ways, sometimes spicy and woody, sometimes characterised by a gentle sweetness. Its warm radiance makes it a suitable companion for the autumn and winter months. Inspired by the characteristic flavours of a high-quality cognac . A multi-layered fragrance composition with notes of vanilla, plum, caramel and spices. Unfolds individually on the skin and reveals both spicy-woody and soft-sweet facets. Part of the exclusive Black Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris. Especially suitable for the cooler seasons.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Morning in Tipasa 50 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Morning in Tipasa 7.2 is a composition reminiscent of a sunny morning on the Mediterranean coast. This fragrance from the Numbered Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris unfolds with a clear and aromatic presence. The top note is characterised by wild lemongrass and refreshing peppermint, which convey an invigorating lightness. As the fragrance progresses, notes of Mediterranean pine and bergamot are added, giving the fragrance a green, citrusy facet. A subtle, honey-like note of jujube tree rounds off the composition and ensures a gentle, skin-loving finish. The simple and modern design of the bottle reflects the elegant character of the fragrance. Morning in Tipasa is an uncomplicated companion that is characterised by its refreshing yet subtle nature. A citrusy, aromatic fragrance for all genders . Combines notes of lemongrass, peppermint and pine. Rounded off with bergamot and a hint of jujube honey. Part of the minimalist Numbered Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Alphaora 50 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the blossom of an albizia tree, Alphaora 30 from the Numbered Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris unfolds a multi-layered and clear fragrance composition. The opening is characterised by the tangy note of blood orange, which lends the fragrance a pleasant freshness. At the centre of the creation is the floral facet of albizia blossom, which is complemented by the woody aroma of hinoki wood oil. Hedione ensures a remarkable presence and diffusion of the fragrance. The base rounds off the experience with a composition of ambergris, dried fruits, blond tobacco and a hint of sage. The result is a balanced eau de parfum that captivates with its sweet yet fresh notes and is presented in a minimalist, elegant bottle. listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Cruise Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Entre Ciel Et Mer 50 ml
listings.description: Between the sky and the sea, a fragrance composition unfolds that interprets maritime impressions in a dry, almost mineral way. Entre Ciel Et Mer Eau de Parfum Spray from the Cruise Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris opens with a combination of aquatic and vegetal notes. At the heart of the creation, lavender and thyme combine with the juicy sweetness of pear, complemented by the special accents of lichen and ambergris. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with moss and sandalwood, giving it a warm, calming character. The transparent glass bottle with its blue liquid and simple black cap reflects the clear and elegant nature of the fragrance. An aquatic fragrance with dry, mineral facets. Combines maritime notes with lavender, pear and thyme. Based on a warm foundation of moss and sandalwood. Part of the exclusive Cruise Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris. Presented in an elegant, minimalist bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 14.2 Costume Liquide 50 ml
listings.description: A composition that feels like a tailor-made garment: this is Costume Liquide 14.2 by Pierre Guillaume Paris. Haitian vetiver provides a solid base, giving the creation an earthy depth and a timeless character. The eau de parfum is presented in a clear glass bottle with a simple, round label that reflects the brand's minimalist yet expressive aesthetic. A spicy floral fragrance character with powdery iris at the centre Opens with notes of pepper and basil. A heart of iris, peony and violet leaf. Rounded off with a base of Haitian vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris White Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Intime.Extime 50 ml
listings.description: The Intime.Extime eau de parfum from the White Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris is defined as a powdery and floral-amber fragrance experience. This creation is a modern skin jewellery that addresses the delicate balance between private intimacy and public charisma. At the olfactory centre is a dominant accord of iris powder, which gives the fragrance a soft and decidedly dry texture. This powdery note is accompanied by the clear freshness of white tea, which provides an invigorating yet restrained lightness. The composition is given complex depth through the targeted use of exotic itauba wood and a hint of incense, which gives structure to the arrangement. Gentle vanilla rounds off the profile and combines the individual components to form a harmonious whole on the skin. The bottle consistently reflects the purist aesthetic of the brand. A rectangular glass jar, refined with a characteristic white ceramic element, protects the precious liquid. On the front, a round, silver sticker with the words EXTIME adds a modern accent, while the simple silver cap finalises the elegant design. This unisex fragrance is suitable for lovers of subtle but present compositions. Fragrance character: Powdery, floral and with warm amber nuances. Main notes: Iris powder, white tea, incense, vanilla and itauba wood. Collection: Part of the White Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris. Design: Rectangular glass bottle with white ceramic insert and silver details. Concept: Unisex fragrance, designed as olfactory skin jewellery.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Beyond Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Staelios 50 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the rare beauty of Russian reindeer leather, Staelios unfolds a multi-layered and elegant fragrance composition. This fragrance from the Beyond Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris opens with a fresh, spicy note of davana and ashanti pepper leaf. At the centre of the composition is a striking violet-leather accord, which is accompanied by the warm nuances of cedarwood, lavender and a subtle spice blend of cinnamon and clove. The base rounds off the olfactory experience with sandalwood, ambergris and musk, giving the eau de parfum a long-lasting presence. The design of the bottle reflects the sophisticated character of the fragrance with its colour gradient from violet to orange and the gold-coloured label. Staelios is a modern interpretation of a leather fragrance that focuses on woody and spicy elements. A fragrance with a striking violet-leather accord. Combines fresh, spicy top notes with a woody heart. The base consists of warm notes such as sandalwood, ambergris and musk. Part of the Beyond Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris. Presented in an elegant bottle with a colour gradient.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Beyond Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Volupté Noire 50 ml
listings.description: Balsamic & magnetic: Volupté Noire is an olfactory interpretation of ambrosia, the mythical food of the gods. Inspired by the high plateaus of the Moroccan Atlas Mountains, where a powerful floral nectar is harvested: euphorbia honey. The fragrance radiates with an opening of bergamot, davana and medjool date. A delicate bouquet of white flowers, lime blossom, acacia and jasmine unfolds in the heart, interwoven with the sweet tannins of black oak. The powerful amber and musky scent of euphorbia honey covers the fragrance like a golden veil, leaving behind the noble sillage of a velvety floral embrace.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Collection Parfumerie Générale Eau de Toilette Spray 09 Yuzu Ab Irato 50 ml
listings.description: Crystal-clear freshness is at the centre of 09 Yuzu Ab Irato from the renowned Collection Parfumerie Générale. With this composition, Pierre Guillaume Paris creates an olfactory bridge between the tranquillity of a Japanese garden and the lively vegetation of the Mediterranean. The eau de toilette spray opens dynamically with the striking citrus note of yuzu, which is given a special lightness by the green coolness of spearmint leaves. A multi-layered bouquet then unfolds in the heart of the fragrance, in which the floral tones of jasmine, hyacinth and magnolia harmoniously complement each other. The use of hyssop adds aromatic depth to the arrangement, which breaks up the floral character in an interesting way. A base of musk rounds off the experience and lends the creation a gentle presence. The design of the bottle reflects this clarity: a rectangular glass jar with yellowish contents, topped with a cylindrical black cap and a minimalist label. This unisex fragrance is classified as floral-aromatic and is characterised by its unobtrusive yet present sensual freshness. Fragrance family: Floral-aromatic eau de toilette for all genders. Top note: Sparkling yuzu combined with cool spearmint leaves. Heart note: A floral bouquet of jasmine, hyacinth, magnolia and hyssop. Base note: Gentle finish with musky accords. Character: A combination of Japanese clarity and Mediterranean nature.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Toilette Spray 11.1 Indian Wood 100 ml
listings.description: The composition 11.1 Indian Wood from the Numbered Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris interprets the theme of the spicy-aromatic fragrance family in a nuanced and multi-layered way. Reminiscent of an olfactory walk through an exotic forest during the monsoon season, this creation skilfully plays with fascinating contrasts between coolness and warmth. The opening is initially invigorating and fresh thanks to the combination of peppermint, lemon and cardamom, with nutmeg adding a spicy note. This cool top note is followed by a complex heart that combines dry jasmine with the striking accords of cedarwood and allspice. The base harmoniously rounds off the fragrance, blending balsamic notes of fir balsam, vetiver and oakmoss with the creamy softness of coconut milk and sandalwood. Launched in 2016, the eau de toilette is considered an independent evolution of the classic Harmatan Noir and is characterised by its balance between spicy sharpness and soft, woody facets. The fragrance is presented in a simple, rectangular clear glass bottle with the characteristic black label, which draws attention to the high-quality essence. Fragrance: Spicy-aromatic with woody and fresh accents. Top note: A fresh combination of peppermint, nutmeg, lemon and cardamom. Base note: Warm finish with sandalwood, vetiver, fir balsam and coconut milk. Character: A contrast of cool freshness and balsamic warmth, inspired by Indian forests. Collection: Part of the Numbered Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris (11.1).

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 28 Peau d'Ambre 50 ml
listings.description: Historical Mediterranean trade routes in the 6th century BC serve as the inspirational framework for this special olfactory composition. With the Numbered Collection 28 Peau d'Ambre, Pierre Guillaume Paris presents an eau de parfum spray that is characterised above all by a complex interplay of precious resins. A striking and powerful accord of frankincense and fir balsam forms the aromatic backbone of the fragrance. This base is complemented by the warm nuances of opoponax and benzoin, which together create a deep, smoky signature. The resulting aroma is subtly reminiscent of antique leather containers in which precious oils were once transported across the sea. Mineral accents also lend the creation a certain airiness, reminiscent of coastal landscapes at dusk. The clear, rectangular glass bottle emphasises the simple elegance of the contents with its smooth, slightly rounded edges. On the front, a round, black label with white lettering and the central number 28 indicates that the fragrance belongs to the numbered collection. A cylindrical, matt black cap harmoniously rounds off the visual appearance. Lovers of amber and leather notes will find a balanced interpretation here that combines tradition and modernity. Harsh, smoky fragrance character with warm amber nuances Contains notes of frankincense, fir balsam, opoponax and benzoin Inspired by the Mediterranean trade routes of antiquity Accords of leather meet fresh, mineral accents Rectangular glass bottle with striking black label

A striking and powerful accord of frankincense and fir balsam forms the aromatic backbone of the fragrance. This base is complemented by the warm nuances of opoponax and benzoin, which together create a deep, smoky signature. The resulting aroma is subtly reminiscent of antique leather containers in which precious oils were once transported across the sea. Mineral accents also lend the creation a certain airiness, reminiscent of coastal landscapes at dusk. The clear, rectangular glass bottle emphasises the simple elegance of the contents with its smooth, slightly rounded edges. On the front, a round, black label with white lettering and the central number 28 indicates that the fragrance belongs to the numbered collection. A cylindrical, matt black cap harmoniously rounds off the visual appearance. Lovers of amber and leather notes will find a balanced interpretation here that combines tradition and modernity. Harsh, smoky fragrance character with warm amber nuances Contains notes of frankincense, fir balsam, opoponax and benzoin Inspired by the Mediterranean trade routes of antiquity Accords of leather meet fresh, mineral accents Rectangular glass bottle with striking black label

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 22.1 Tigre d'Eau 50 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the symbolism of the tiger, 22.1 Tigre d'Eau unfolds as a multi-layered fragrance composition. The fragrance opens with an invigorating freshness that comes from the combination of tangy grapefruit peel and clear coconut water. A hint of pink pepper lends this top note a subtle spiciness. As the fragrance progresses, green accords develop, giving the eau de parfum a natural and clear facet. The base rounds off the fragrance experience with the gentle warmth of tonka bean and a subtle hint of salted caramel. These elements combine to create a balanced and pleasantly wearable fragrance character that harmoniously combines both creamy and fresh notes. The simple, elegant design of the glass bottle with its striking black cap reflects the modern aesthetic of the Pierre Guillaume Paris brand. Fragrance direction: Balmy Fougère Head notes: Coconut water, grapefruit peel, pink pepper Heart notes: Green accords Base notes: Tonka bean, salted caramel Character: Fresh, creamy, balanced

This fragrance unfolds with a sparkling top note in which the vegetal freshness of rhubarb meets the gentle sweetness of apricot and the aromatic spiciness of basil. Bottled in a simple, elegant bottle, the design reflects the clear and modern aesthetic of the brand. listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Toilette Spray 2.1 Cozé Verde 50 ml
listings.description: With 2.1 Cozé Verde, Pierre Guillaume Paris is expanding its Numbered Collection with an olfactory reinterpretation of the familiar theme of Cozé. Launched in 2012, the fragrance is defined by its woody orientation, which is kept neutral and has no specific gender classification. The characteristic tobacco leaf is at the centre of this creation, but here it is placed in a different context. Instead of heaviness, a green, vegetal freshness dominates, which is largely characterised by accords of lime and fig tree juice. These citrus and herbal nuances lend the composition a certain lightness. Cocoa pods and amyl salicylate complement the fragrance, while liquorice provides a subtle, woody spiciness. The result of this combination is often perceived as cool, fresh and informal. The eau de toilette spray is housed in a simple, rectangular glass bottle with transparent walls that reveals the light yellow liquid. A round, black cap and the corresponding round label with white lettering round off the visual appearance. Woody fragrance character with green and vegetal facets. Centred notes of tobacco leaf, lime and fig tree juice. Spicy notes of liquorice and cocoa pod. Released in 2012 as part of the Numbered Collection. Transparent glass bottle with black cap.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Toilette Spray 22 Djhenné 50 ml
listings.description: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection 22 Djhenné captures the complex olfactory essence of a shady oasis in the middle of a vast, sun-drenched sandy landscape. This aromatic-woody fougère fragrance is characterised by an exciting interplay between initial cool freshness and an evolving warm dryness. At the beginning, a clear, concise note of grey lavender and mint unfolds, which has an almost mineral character and forms an invigorating prelude. As the fragrance develops, the profile shifts noticeably towards warmer, earthier accords, which are largely characterised by blond leather and sun-bleached cedarwood. Fine, powdery nuances of cocoa pod combine harmoniously with the subtle floral accents of seringa blossom to create a remarkably complex structure. A solid base of myrrh and wheat rounds off the composition and lends it a gentle, balsamic depth that lingers for a long time. Visually, the heavy, rectangular glass bottle with its black, cylindrical cap and striking round label emphasises the purist elegance of the collection. The light yellow eau de toilette embodies artisanal sophistication and offers a multi-layered fragrance experience. Fragrance family: Aromatic-woody fougère with leathery and sandy facets. Head notes: Fresh grey lavender, cool mint and seringa blossom. Heart and base notes: Blond leather, cocoa pod, cedarwood, myrrh and wheat. Character: An interplay of mineral freshness and balsamic, powdery warmth. Design: Minimalist glass bottle with the characteristic black Parfumerie Générale label.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 24 Papyrus de Ciane 50 ml
listings.description: The inspiration for this olfactory creation comes from the lush papyrus gardens on the banks of the River Ciane in Sicily, a place full of historical and botanical significance. As a modern interpretation of a green chypre fragrance, the eau de parfum combines complex facets that artfully alternate between light and dark nuances. The opening presents itself with a striking freshness, characterised by bitter-green galbanum and sparkling bergamot, which create an invigorating dynamic. As the fragrance progresses, the eponymous papyrus unfolds, its dry, woody character harmoniously complemented by the honey-like accents of broom and delicate neroli. These green and floral elements rest on a deep base that combines the classic mousse de saxe with earthy vetiver and soft white musk. Incense and cedarwood also contribute to the multi-layered structure and lend the arrangement a subtle, smoky depth. Visually, the rectangular, transparent glass bottle with its black cylindrical lid reflects the clear lines of the Numbered Collection. The characteristic black round label with the number 24 indicates that it belongs to this series by Pierre Guillaume Paris. It is a composition that combines naturalness with the French art of perfumery and radiates timeless elegance. Fragrance family: Green chypre fragrance with a balance of bitter, fresh and earthy notes. Main components: Galbanum, papyrus, broom, mousse de saxe and white musk. Inspiration: The wild vegetation and papyrus stands along the Sicilian river Ciane. Design: Minimalist glass bottle with black lid and numbered label (no. 24). Character: Complex interplay of dry woods, green freshness and subtle smoke.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Toilette Spray 19.1 Néroli ad Astra 50 ml
listings.description: An airy and radiant interpretation of orange blossom is revealed in the creation 19.1 Néroli ad Astra from the renowned Numbered Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris. This fragrance is characterised by a clear, floral-vegetable composition that rearranges familiar nuances in a modern way and offers a fresh perspective. At the olfactory centre is the precious neroli from Morocco, which is complemented by the characterful addition of agave blossom from Mexico and juicy pear. This harmonious combination gives the eau de toilette spray a noticeable lightness and transparency, while at the same time maintaining a constant presence on the skin. As a variation on theme 19, which is traditionally dedicated to orange blossom, this number focusses on brightness and expansiveness. Visually, the solid, transparent glass bottle emphasises the purity of the contents and reveals the clear liquid. A cylindrical, black cap and the characteristic round label with the white number "19.1" round off the minimalist and timeless design, which fits seamlessly into the brand's aesthetic. Fragrance direction: A fresh, floral-vegetable composition with a radiant character. Main notes: Contains accords of Moroccan neroli, Mexican agave flower and pear. Collection: Part of the Numbered Collection as a variation on the orange blossom theme. Design: Minimalist, transparent glass bottle with black cylinder cap and striking 19.1 logo. Character: Conveys impressions of airiness, transparency and brightness.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 16.1 Bois Naufragé 50 ml
listings.description: As part of the renowned Numbered Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris, the Eau de Parfum Spray 16.1 Bois Naufragé is an artful olfactory interpretation of driftwood. Launched in 2010, the composition is dedicated to the overarching theme of figs (Theme N°16), but approaches it from an emphatically mineral and woody perspective. Inspired by the photograph "Nu au bois flotté" by Lucien Clergue, the fragrance captures the poetic image of an Egyptian fig tree moulded by the tides and the elements. In the opening, green mint and fine salt flower combine with the characteristic green notes of the fig tree to create an invigorating prelude. As the fragrance develops, a complex structure unfolds in which the cool minerality of salt crystals meets the subtle warmth of ambergris. A solid base of fractionated vetiver emphasises the striking driftwood character and lends the arrangement a long-lasting depth. This fragrance from the Woody Fougère category is characterised by its ability to develop individually on the skin and offers a multi-layered fragrance experience that combines raw naturalness with French perfumery. Fragrance category: Woody fougère with a mineral character . Head notes: A fresh combination of salt flower, fig tree and mint. Base: A base of fractionated vetiver and driftwood notes. Special feature: Part of the Numbered Collection and inspired by the photograph "Nu au bois flotté". Character: Mineral, woody and multi-faceted thanks to the combination of ambergris and salt crystals.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Toilette Spray 26 Isparta 50 ml
listings.description: The Numbered Collection by French perfumer Pierre Guillaume is dedicated to the famous summer rose from the Turkish province of the same name with the creation of 26 Isparta. This special rose forms the centrepiece of the eau de toilette spray and unfolds a voluminous, floral bouquet. Red fruits open the composition in the top note and contribute fruity accents that form an exciting contrast to the floral centre. Behind the initial freshness lies a complex structure of resinous and woody elements that define the Chypre Floral fragrance family. Peru balsam and benzoin lend the fragrance a balsamic warmth, while calamus adds a slightly spicy note. A base of dark patchouli and fine oud is responsible for the distinctive character. Frankincense adds a subtle, smoky facet that gives the arrangement depth. The olfactory experience is rounded off with soft nuances of musk and ambroxan. Visually, the perfume is presented in a simple, transparent glass bottle that reveals the light yellow liquid and is enhanced by a round, black label with white lettering. Fragrance: Chypre Floral with a dominant note of Turkish summer rose from Isparta. Head and heart notes: A combination of red fruits, Peru balsam and calamus. Base accords: Deep, woody nuances of patchouli, oud, incense and benzoin. Design: Minimalist glass bottle with black cap and Numbered Collection label.

With its woody-green and musky character, a fragrance experience unfolds that subtly captures the essence of a Mediterranean garden. listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Toilette Spray 05 L'Eau de Circé 50 ml
listings.description: A complex interplay of floral and fruity notes characterises Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection 05 L'Eau de Circé. Originally launched in 2005, this creation is part of the French house's established Numbered Collection. The olfactory journey begins in the top note with a fine accord of osmanthus absolute, delicate orange blossom, white peach and fresh mandarin. As the fragrance progresses, a multi-layered bouquet unfolds, combining floral elements such as jasmine, orchid, ylang-ylang and damask rose. The composition is given a warm and lasting depth by the carefully balanced base notes, in which earthy patchouli meets woody accents, amber and a hint of honey balsam and plum. The eau de toilette spray is characterised by a sweet floral radiance that is harmoniously accompanied by powdery and slightly bitter nuances. Visually, the fragrance is presented in a rectangular, transparent glass bottle that reveals the clear liquid. A black, circular label with white lettering and the striking number 05 rounds off the minimalist design. This composition is designed as a unisex fragrance and can be worn regardless of gender norms. listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Toilette Spray 10.1 Bouquet Massaï 50 ml
listings.description: The Numbered Collection by French perfumer Pierre Guillaume Paris presents an exciting olfactory evolution within the line with 10.1 Bouquet Massaï. As a modern reinterpretation of the original Aomassai theme, the focus of this creation clearly shifts towards a floral arrangement without losing the characteristic depth of the series. The fragrance opens with a striking and contrasting accord in which roasted notes of coffee meet soft cashmere wood. This initial, rather dark impression changes gently as it progresses, paving the way for a multi-faceted centrepiece. This is where the bright aromas of peony and magnolia unfold, giving the eau de toilette spray a lively, almost fruity and floral aura. Finally, the base provides a warm and velvety finish, combining tolu balsam with fiery wood tones and creamy sandalwood. Visually, the bottle emphasises the purist elegance of the brand with its clear, rectangular glass design, which is crowned by a solid black cap. On the front, a round, black label with white lettering and the number 10.1 indicates the exact affiliation to the series. listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Toilette Spray 06 L'Eau Rare Matale 50 ml

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Toilette Spray 7.1 Cologne Grand Siècle Intense 50 ml
listings.description: With the creation of 7.1 Grand Siècle Intense, Pierre Guillaume Paris reinterprets the theme of a classic cologne in a contemporary and intense way. Released in 2021, this version stands out as an eau de parfum due to its concentration and thus offers a long-lasting presence on the skin. At the centre of the fragrance development is a radiant accord of hesperides, in which the sparkling notes of bergamot, lemon and orange unfold dynamically. These citrusy facets are accompanied by a subtle mint note that provides a cool freshness. At the heart of the composition, a fine veil of powdery iris and sweet honey gently covers the arrangement. These softer tones form an interesting contrast to the profound chypre background that characterises the perfume. In the base, earthy vetiver and spicy cypress merge with nuances of tobacco, dry hay, patchouli and oakmoss. The absence of typical aromatic herbs creates a clear structure that combines the bitterness of citrus fruits with a woody, rounded depth. The result is a fragrance that exudes both invigorating freshness and elegant persistence. listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Toilette Spray 19 Louanges Profanes 50 ml
listings.description: A harmonious combination of floral and resinous notes characterises the Louanges Profanes eau de toilette spray from the Numbered Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris. Launched in 2008, the fragrance opens with a fresh top note in which the aromas of neroli and hawthorn unfold. At the heart of the composition, the purity of white lily meets the deep, smoky nuance of incense, creating an interesting tension. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a warm base of benzoin and guaiac wood, which lends the perfume a gentle woody flavour. This creation is often described as luminous and immaculate, which emphasises its elegant character. Pierre Guillaume has created an interplay between floral lightness and balsamic depth. The fragrance signature is designed so that it can be worn regardless of gender. Visually, the yellowish liquid is presented in a classic bottle with a black cap and the characteristic round label bearing the number 19. Fragrance character: An elegant blend of floral, woody and resinous notes. Main components: Neroli, hawthorn, white lily, frankincense, benzoin and guaiac wood. Collection: Part of the Numbered Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris. Target group: Designed as a unisex fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Eisenberg Les Secrets Eau de Parfum Spray SECRET N°VIII SOUFFLE DU DÉSIR 30 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Secret VIII Souffle du Désir from the exclusive Les Secrets collection by EISENBERG presents itself with an artful balance of warmth and spice. The top note opens the olfactory experience with a striking yet velvety blend of fruity plum, elegant saffron and a hint of smoky incense. This powerful opening flows smoothly into a multi-layered heart that combines the classic floral nuances of rose with the deep, earthy tones of patchouli and cistus. The base provides a long-lasting and harmonious finish, combining soft sandalwood and gourmand vanilla with a rich amber accord. The complex interplay of the selected ingredients creates an aura that is often described as mysterious and alluring. The product also sets visual accents: The bottle is made of clear, bulbous glass and reveals the amber-coloured liquid inside. The container is enhanced by a shiny gold cap and a textured ring on the neck of the bottle, which gives the design a special feel. The name of the fragrance and a reference to the fragrance direction can be found on the front, rounding off the elegant appearance. Fragrance direction: Amber-influenced composition with spicy and floral facets. Top notes: A combination of plum, saffron and incense. Heart note: A multi-layered interplay of patchouli, cistus and rose. Base note: Warm finish with vanilla, amber and sandalwood. Design: Bellied glass bottle with golden cap and visible amber-coloured essence.

listings.rawTitle: Eisenberg L'Art du Parfum Eau de Parfum Spray BACK TO PARIS 50 ml
listings.description: Parisian flair and a sophisticated lightness characterise the composition of Eisenberg L'Art du Parfum Back To Paris. This eau de parfum opens with a lively freshness created by the interplay of tangy rhubarb, juicy mandarin and bergamot, while pink pepper and blackcurrant add subtle accents. As the fragrance progresses, a floral heart note unfolds, combining the powdery facets of iris and violet with the timeless character of rose and jasmine. A warm depth defines the finish, in which woody accords of patchouli, sandalwood and cedarwood merge with the sweetness of vanilla, tonka bean and musk. Visually, the creation is presented in a minimalist, cubic glass bottle that reveals the golden yellow liquid and is crowned by a clear lid and a golden spray head. The formula is free from microplastics, parabens and palm oil and focuses on the complex fragrance structure. Chypre floral fragrance with top notes of rhubarb and mandarin Floral heart with powdery nuances of iris and violet Warm base notes of woods, vanilla and musk Cubic glass bottle with golden spray head Formulated without microplastics, parabens and palm oil

listings.description: The Tentation Irrésistible eau de parfum spray from Eisenberg's L'Art du Parfum line is full of character and complexity. This composition belongs to the spicy and powdery fragrance family and is characterised by a harmonious interplay of contrasting accords. Initially, a fruity, fresh top note unfolds, in which sparkling bergamot and mandarin meet the subtle spiciness of pink pepper berries. At the centre of the creation is a floral heart that combines the classic notes of jasmine and violet with an unexpected, fresh marine accord. This combination gives the fragrance a special depth. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a warm base that combines creamy sandalwood with the gentle sweetness of vanilla, creating a long-lasting, powdery finish. Visually, the transparent glass bottle with its clear, rectangular cap underlines the aesthetics of the product and reveals the gold-coloured liquid inside, with the central inscriptions characterising the design. Design: High-quality glass bottle with gold-coloured liquid and clear cap.

listings.rawTitle: Eisenberg L'Art du Parfum Émulsion Parfumée Corps I am 150 ml
listings.description: The Émulsion Parfumée Corps I AM from Eisenberg Paris represents an elegant combination of high-quality texture and olfactory art. As an integral part of the L'Art du Parfum collection, this product picks up on the characteristic fragrance signature of the perfume of the same name and translates it into a light body emulsion. The fragrance composition combines floral notes of magnolia and rose with fruity raspberry accents, while a warm base of sandalwood and amber adds depth. These harmonious elements remain on the body as a subtle, long-lasting veil. Visually, the glossy black tube features a striking, artistic motif on the front, which depicts two people in a picturesque scene and bears the name I AM. Users can use the emulsion to support the intensity of the accompanying eau de parfum or simply to give the skin a gentle hint of the fragrance. Without leaving a heavy film, the product provides a refreshing sensation. Light, fast-absorbing texture Leaves the skin feeling soft and supple Decent fragrance with floral and fruity notes Elegant black tube with artistic motif Ideal complement to the I AM Eau de Parfum

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray by Juicy Couture delights with an exquisite fragrance that is glamorous, daring and feminine at the same time. It owes these characteristics to its sophisticated composition of diverse accords. The top note opens the fragrance with wild berries and fresh, wonderfully juicy mandarin. This is followed by a heart note that provides floral accents with honeysuckle, jasmine and gardenia. The long-lasting base note provides woody and sweet notes and impresses with a mixture of caramel, vanilla, praline, sandalwood and amber. An eau de parfum with an extravagant design The Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray by Juicy Couture not only stands out with its fragrant scent, but also with its opulent design . You can look forward to an elegant glass bottle with a bright pink bow and a detachable pendant. Thanks to this beautiful design, the Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray by Juicy Couture is also a great gift idea.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray Gold Couture 30 ml
listings.description: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray Gold Couture is a fruity-floral women's fragrance full of glamour and elegance. Launched in 2014, the artful composition by master perfumer Honorine Blanc is full of emotion and exudes a flair of irresistible feminine elegance. Fresh, fruity accords harmonise wonderfully with accents of delicate white flowers and a whole palette of sensual nuances. Like all creations by the trendy Californian cult label Juicy Couture, the perfume's artful, playful bottle immediately catches the eye. It is now very popular with collectors. Juicy wild berries framed by delicate white flowers The Eau de Parfum Spray Gold Couture from the lively, vibrant Viva La Juicy fragrance line opens sparkling and fresh with a cocktail of delicious, aromatic wild berries. The heart note of the fascinating fragrance features dreamy, sensual nuances with dewy white flowers of Arabian jasmine and graceful honeysuckle. The foundation of Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray Gold Couture celebrates exhilarating femininity. Irresistible notes of delicious caramel combine with the sweetness of delicious vanilla. Exquisite sandalwood gently restrains the sweet notes and prevents the perfume from being too heavy. Golden yellow ambergris brings the fragrance experience to a discreetly sensual and harmonious close.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray Rose 50 ml
listings.description: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray Rose is an elegant floral fragrance for women from 2015. The romantic, very feminine composition from the exclusive Californian cult label combines a colourful array of intense, precious floral notes with gourmand, fruity and sensual, elegant accents. The luxurious perfume uses particularly precious ingredients to ensure its wearer makes an impressive appearance both during the day and in the evening. The ornate, playful bottle of the fragrance with a pink silk bow is an instant eye-catcher and has achieved cult status, and not just among collectors. Enchanting flowers with a radiantly sunny ambience The stars of Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray Rose, delicate blossoms, already make their presence felt in the radiantly fresh fragrance opening. Tangy, juicy Italian mandarin and seductively sweet Williams pear are joined by blossoming, aromatic jasmine. The heart note of the perfume is dominated by the beguilingly sweet scent of the hundred-petalled rosa centifolia, the nuances of white peony and dewy, Arabian jasmine sambac, which give the eau de parfum an imposing frame. Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray Rose sounds decidedly elegant with a hint of feminine sensuality. A multi-faceted absolute of iris root picks up on the floral theme and is given depth of character by sweet, leathery benzoin notes and the soft, balsamic fragrance molecule ambroxan.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray Le Bubbly 100 ml
listings.description: The Le Bubbly Eau de Parfum Spray by Juicy Couture is an already iconic reinterpretation of Viva La Juicy , a fragrance that has countless fans worldwide. The fragrance is irresistible and decidedly sparkling: a real mood booster that carries summer with it all year round. This is ensured by the champagne alone, which gives Le Bubbly Eau de Parfum Spray a fascinating and almost sparkling aura. But the temperamental composition is also impressive in every respect. Juicy Couture gave the perfume juicy blood orange and bright mandarin in the top note, floral notes of gardenia, jasmine, vanilla and orchid in the heart note and finally warm nuances of amber, wood and delicious praline as a seductive finishing touch. The reinterpretation of Viva La Juicy: fireworks for the senses The Le Bubbly Eau de Parfum Spray by Juicy Couture gives you an unrivalled experience and is a real guarantee for a good mood. Speaking of "giving": It is also unbeatable as a gift, which is not only due to the wonderful fragrance, but also to the gorgeous pump bottle. It is so breathtakingly beautiful and stunningly feminine that every beauty-conscious woman will want to have it!

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Just Moi Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml

The top notes of watermelon, apple, passion fruit and water hyacinth open the fragrance experience and add a fresh touch to the start of the day. This is followed by the heart notes of rose, tuberose and lily, which unfold a crisp aroma. This combination is ideal for a wide range of situations, whether at work or during leisure activities. The curved glass bottle, with its pink-coloured liquid and golden details, adds a striking visual touch. Thanks to the balanced blend of fruity and sweet elements, the fragrance offers a simple way to subtly enhance your personal style. listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum Spray Noir 30 ml
listings.description: Exclusive women's fragrance brings real joie de vivre If you are one of those fun-loving, young women, the Viva La Juicy Noir Eau de Parfum Spray could inspire you. With this perfume from Juicy Couture , parfumdreams.co.uk offers you a creation that is attractive and true to life. The eau de parfum spray is available in 30 ml and 50 ml versions. The choice of the right components makes for a successful fragrance This eau de parfum spray from the Viva La Juicy series develops perfection thanks to the perfect choice of individual fragrances. Overall, it is a typical perfume for women that is equally appealing to men. The top note opens fresh and fruity with mandarin and blackcurrant. Elegant floral notes of gardenia, honeysuckle and jasmine follow in the heart. The base note rounds off with amber, caramel, praline, sandalwood and vanilla. Viva La Juicy Noir by Juicy Couture is a highly interesting creation.

listings.rawTitle: Hollister Festival Vibes Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Hollister Festival Vibes Festival Vibes is floral, fruity-sweet and girly. The new fragrance from the well-known fashion label Hollister was launched in 2018. The perfumer is Steve DeMercado. His message with the eau de parfum spray is summer, sun, music, fun. Everything you can experience at festivals. What could be better than dancing and partying into the evening in glorious sunshine to the music of your favourite bands? You want to keep this atmosphere, this drive, forever. Festival Vibes epitomises this feeling of freedom, music and festival fun. Feel the beat and enjoy the vibrant atmosphere The fragrance makes a statement with its floral, fruity charm. The eau de parfum spray is cool, carefree and expressive. The top note starts with fruity notes of goji berry, Italian bergamot and quince. Nuances of vanilla orchid, coral hibiscus, peony and osmanthus lend the fragrance freshness and the wonderful feeling of the first balmy summer evenings. Hollister Festival Vibes is rounded off with musk, tonka bean and cashmere wood in the base note. They give this eau de parfum spray a slightly spicy character that adds the finishing touch to the fragrance. The pink and rose-coloured bottle for the eau de parfum spray is perfectly coordinated with the fragrance message. The silicone coating ensures optimum grip.

listings.rawTitle: Hollister Festival Nite Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Hollister Festival Nite Eau de Parfum Spray is a multi-faceted composition that harmoniously combines floral nuances with fruity accents. The opening already surprises with a fresh combination of coconut, mandarin and pink freesia, which together create a tropical impression. As the fragrance develops, this top note transitions gently into a floral heart, which is characterised by accords of blackcurrant, apple blossom and tiger orchid. A solid base of vanilla, marshmallow and amber rounds off the olfactory experience and lends the perfume a creamy, gourmand character. The fragrance also sets clear visual accents with its round bottle, which is completely in a shiny purple colour. While the upper part of the bottle has a smooth design, the lower section attracts attention with a strikingly glittering surface. Large silver letters on the front and the embossed logo of a stylised bird on the sparkling segment harmonise with the cylindrical cap. Due to its specific formulation as an eau de parfum, this fragrance has a comparatively high concentration of fragrance oils, which ensures a long-lasting presence on the skin. Floral and fruity fragrance character with creamy gourmand notes Top notes of coconut, mandarin and pink freesia Base note with vanilla, marshmallow and amber Striking, purple-coloured bottle with glitter effects and silver lettering Long-lasting eau de parfum spray

listings.rawTitle: Hollister Festival Vibes Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Hollister Festival Vibes Eau de Toilette Spray captures a carefree and lively atmosphere in a fragrance. The composition opens with a fresh sea breeze that combines with the fruity note of pineapple and the tart facet of birch leaf. As the fragrance progresses, green and woody accords unfold, which are given an interesting depth by the spicy warmth of ginger and bay leaf. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with the earthy tones of oak moss, the sweet presence of tonka bean and the gentle note of ambergris. This aromatic fougère fragrance is a pleasant everyday companion that supports a positive and dynamic aura. The bottle itself reflects the character of the fragrance: the bluish-turquoise glass and embossed lettering are reminiscent of summery days and a relaxed mood. Fragrance family: Aromatic fougère Top notes: marine accord, pineapple, birch leaf Heart notes: Green notes, woody notes, ginger, bay leaf Base note: oakmoss, tonka bean, ambergris

listings.rawTitle: Hollister Free Wave Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Hollister Free Wave Fresh, floral and fruity is the character of Hollister's eau de parfum spray. The fashion label's summer fragrance pays homage to cool holidays by the sea. It symbolises summer, sun and fun. The play of the waves breaking on the beach with foaming spray. The surfers dancing on the crests of the waves to the beat of the beach clubs. The message of Free Wave is clear: enjoy the here and now with friends while the sun kisses the sea and the beach. Hollister's Eau de Parfum Spray perfectly showcases this drive. Who wouldn't want to remember the feeling of sun, summer and freshness with a few spritzes of Free Wave ? Enjoy life and freedom to the full , that's what this fragrance stands for. Adventure, holidays, friendship - that's what this fragrance embodies. The top note starts with fruity-sweet mandarin, sparkling-spicy blackberry and lovely agave nectar. In the heart note, fresh nuances of apple blossom, elegant water lily and mysterious wild orchid take command. Hollister's Eau de Parfum Spray is rounded off with velvety green moss, patchouli and orcanox (amber-like). The bottle is lilac-coloured. Free Wave is a fragrance experience for the day. The character of this eau de parfum spray is spirited and tantalising.

listings.rawTitle: Hollister Canyon Sky Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The eau-de-parfum spray from the Canyon Sky series by the Hollister label pampers its wearer with an incomparable fragrance that is her faithful companion for the day. It transports her senses to California, where she finds herself surrounded by a fascinating rocky landscape and gazes relaxed into the sky. The scent of freedom The Hollister company is known for its laid-back lifestyle that epitomises coolness and freedom. This is also visualised by the logo of a flying seagull. In this eau-de-parfum spray, a sophisticated fragrance pyramid is responsible for the unique fragrance experience. The top note consists of bergamot, raspberry and redcurrant. The heart note is made up of heliotrope, peony and orange blossom. Finally, the base notes include musk, praline and sandalwood . This creates a fruity and floral fragrance. To match the fragrance, the bottle is an appealing yellow colour with a transparent logo and transparent lettering. The name of the Canyon Sky series, on the other hand, is in a chic pink colour. And it's not just because the bottle comes in creatively designed packaging that the product is also ideal as a gift. It can also be used as a partner fragrance, as there is also a version of this series for men.

listings.rawTitle: Hollister Feelin' Good Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Hollister Feelin' Good Eau de Parfum Spray creates a good mood - as the colourful bottle, which depicts a cool colour gradient from orange to violet to blue, makes clear. The perfume suits women of all ages, regardless of whether they are still young or at least young at heart. Thanks to the many open, light accords, the perfume is also an ideal choice for spring and summer. However, the Hollister Feelin' Good Eau de Parfum Spray could just as easily bring joy and lightness to the dreary winter - there are no limits to your creativity in this respect. A perfume that pulsates with energy and joie de vivre The Hollister Feelin' Good Eau de Parfum Spray is almost a small attitude to life - because feeling good often starts in the mind. That's where fruity accords open this fragrance, in the top note. Orange, clementine and grapefruit are brought together to create a delicious fruit basket that you can't eat, but you can smell in all its splendour. The heart of the composition is somewhat fresher thanks to mint, while powdery and soft accords of peach and freesia skilfully round it off, while the base notes of musk, vetiver and wood remain discreetly in the background.

listings.rawTitle: Halloween Man X Eau de Toilette Spray 75 ml
listings.description: Halloween Man X by Jesus Del Pozo is an eau de toilette spray that is characterised by its multi-faceted composition. The fragrance opens with an invigorating top note of fresh lemon, aromatic lavender and spicy cardamom. The heart then unfolds, in which notes of coffee, whiskey and leather meet warm cinnamon and a mineral accent. This combination creates a special character. The base note, which harmoniously combines tonka bean, amber and incense, ensures a long-lasting finish. The result is a creation with a spicy, woody character. The spray is applied to the neck and wrists from a distance of around 10 cm for ideal fragrance development. The most up-to-date list of ingredients can be found on the product packaging. Fragrance character: Spicy and woody Heart notes: A composition of coffee, whiskey and leather Base notes: Accords of tonka bean, amber and incense Fragrance type: Eau de toilette

listings.rawTitle: Halloween Man Mystery Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Discover the Halloween Eau de Parfum Spray by Man Mystery - the mysterious aura of the modern man, captured in an irresistible fragrance. This eau de parfum is a tribute to the unfathomable depth and complexity of the masculine character. The Halloween Eau de Parfum Spray surprises you with its unexpected top note, which combines tangy mandarin, peach blossom and lavandin. This refreshing yet warm introduction flows seamlessly into the heart note, where the masculine flavours of geranium and hazelnut unfold. In the base, patchouli and vetiver combine to create a base note that ensures a lasting presence and rounds off the overall picture of this sophisticated perfume. Seductive fragrance for the modern man The Halloween Eau de Parfum Spray by Man Mystery is more than just a fragrance. It is an olfactory narrative that tells of mystery and adventure and celebrates the uniqueness of the modern man. Each spray plunges you into a world of seduction, intrigue and masculinity that invigorates your senses and fills your day with a touch of mystery. The modern and elegant bottle fits perfectly in any bathroom or travelling bag. It is designed to fit comfortably in the hand and allows for precise application. A simple spray on the neck, wrists or clothing is all it takes to unleash the "Man Mystery Experience".

listings.rawTitle: Halloween Man Eau de Toilette Spray 75 ml
listings.description: With Halloween Man Eau de Toilette Spray, Spanish designer Jesus del Pozo has created a fragrance that is as individual as it is suitable for everyday use . Sweet, fruity notes meet tart leather and emphasise a masculine aura. On the market since 2012, Halloween Man Eau de Toilette Spray is aimed at men who love the uncomplicated and want to embark on an adventure every day. Halloween Man - masculine, fruity-sweet and suitable for everyday use Perfumer Clément Gavarry has combined the individual accords in the eau de toilette spray to create a fine-tuned composition . He chose fruity mandarin and lively martini for the top note and rounded off this composition with spicy basil and lovely violet leaf. In the heart note, ginger and orange blossom as well as lavender unfold their aromas and gain a spicy accord through cinnamon. A base of ambergris and leather lends the fragrance its masculine aura. Musk and vanilla complete the successful impression.

listings.rawTitle: Halloween Halloween Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Halloween eau de toilette spray is an irresistible fragrance from the brand of the same name. Let yourself be enveloped by nuances from the fruity, woody and floral range and enjoy the oriental flair of the eau de toilette. A multifaceted fruit and floral journey The top note of the eau de toilette spray is a distinctive mix of fruits, characterised by lime and banana. This blend transports you to a fresh orchard! But before your mouth starts to water, floral accords take you to a flower meadow. Here, violets, magnolia and tuberose compete in fragrance and lend the wearer of Halloween a romantic, playful aura. The floral heart then leads into a warm base with incense, sandalwood and vanilla. A classically intense finish for the eau de toilette spray, which is concealed in a magical purple bottle with silver accents. This feminine, exotic fragrance full of sensuality and sophistication has been making its mark on more than just the Spanish perfume market for several years. It was created by the Halloween brand, which can look back on decades of history and has also made a name for itself as a designer.

listings.rawTitle: Halloween Blue Drop Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: A floral fragrance with a touch of lightness: the Halloween Blue Drop Eau de Toilette Spray by Jesus del Pozo is aimed at women who want to emphasise their feminine charisma . Floral fragrance notes give the perfume a sensual aura. It is not too heavy, so the fragrance creation can also be worn on warm days and guarantees a successful appearance for any occasion. Halloween Blue Drop Eau de Toilette - as sensual as it is exhilarating The finely balanced components make Halloween Blue Drop Eau de Toilette Spray a unique fragrance experience. Sparkling citrus fruits and fresh green apple unfold their flavours in the top note, supported by spicy lavender. As soon as the top note fades, the heart note comes with the floral accords of jasmine and white flowers, rounded off with lovely violets. Amber, cinnamon, spices and musk give the fragrance a warm base. The bottle is as uncomplicated and light as the fragrance. Blue glass and silver elements in round shapes emphasise the feminine impression that the perfume leaves behind.

listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Classic Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Muse Eau de Parfum Spray by Zarkoperfume is a tribute to purity and clarity. Inspired by the scent of freshly washed laundry, this fragrance exudes an aura that is both clean and distinct. Launched in 2020, this composition by the Danish brand eschews a traditional fragrance pyramid. Instead, the notes blend directly with the skin to create a highly personal scent signature. It opens with delicate cotton blossom, followed by a heart of warm, white oud. In the base, white musk ensures a long-lasting, powdery and gently woody finish. Conceived as a niche product, this unisex fragrance is ideal for anyone who appreciates something special yet understated. The perfume is also produced without animal testing. A clean, fresh fragrance reminiscent of freshly washed laundry. A composition of cotton blossom, white oud and white musk. Designed as a unisex fragrance for individual expression. Develops a personal and unique signature on the skin. Produced without animal testing.

listings.description: ZARKOPERFUME THE MUSE BREEZE Eau de Parfum enriches everyday life with a multi-layered fragrance composition. The minimalist glass bottle with its golden cap blends elegantly into any perfume collection. Immediately after spraying, the top notes of sweet lemon, green lime, mandarin and dragon fruit ensure a fresh start to the day. As the fragrance develops, the heart notes of toffee, peach, cedar and white chocolate unfold a pleasant warmth that lends the scent a special depth. Finally, the base notes of musk, vanilla, a warm amber accord and dark wood create a well-rounded finish on the skin. This harmonious combination offers a long-lasting fragrance experience that subtly enhances your personal charisma. This unisex perfume is ideal for a wide range of situations, from everyday office life to special evening occasions. listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Classic Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Pink Molécule 090.09 Eau de Parfum Spray by Zarkoperfume is an olfactory interpretation of the Nordic landscape. The composition opens with a zesty freshness of elderflower and juicy apricot, complemented by the subtle elegance of black orchid. A distinctive element is the eponymous pink molecules, which lend the fragrance a mineral-like lightness. In this creation, Danish perfumer Zarko Ahlmann Pavlov breaks with the classic fragrance pyramid and deliberately omits a heart note. As a result, the top note blends seamlessly with the warm base of fine mahogany, creamy accords and dark woods. Developed in Denmark, this vegan fragrance really comes into its own on warmer days in spring and summer. Fragrance profile: Fruity and floral Fragrance notes: Elderflower, apricot, black orchid, mahogany Special feature: Composition without a traditional heart note Characteristic: Vegan eau de parfum

listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Cloud Collection Gift Set Cloud Collection No. 1 10 ml + Cloud Collection No. 2 10 ml Cloud Collection No. 3 10 ml / 1 Stk.
listings.description: The Zarkoperfume Cloud Collection gift set provides fascinating access to the world of molecular fragrances and combines three characterful eau de parfums in an elegant box. Included are the creations Cloud Collection No. 1, No. 2 and No. 3, each of which is bottled in handy 10 ml spray bottles, making them the ideal size for travelling. Characteristic of this line is the complex interplay of high-quality perfume oil and water, which is initially visible in the transparent glass flacons as separate phases in the colours orange, blue and green. Before use, the container should be shaken for around four seconds, causing the liquids to mix and briefly take on a milky, cloud-like appearance. The compositions are based on special molecules that can develop individually on the skin and react subtly to the environment, the weather and personal radiance. While No. 1, for example, picks up on nuances of sea buckthorn, jasmine and dark woods, the other variants add further olfactory facets from the Danish manufacturer to the spectrum. The minimalist design with golden accents makes this compilation a stylish way to fully discover the versatility of the collection. Contains Cloud Collection No. 1, No. 2 and No. 3 as eau de parfum (10 ml each) Based on molecular perfumery for customised fragrance development Visual effect thanks to activatable two-phase texture Compact glass bottles in a minimalist design, ideal for travelling

listings.description: The Zarkoperfume Oud’ish Eau de Parfum Spray offers a light and crisp interpretation of the precious fragrance note of oud. At the heart of the fragrance, the characteristic oud unfolds, its woody depth complemented by gentle, earthy nuances. This heart note blends harmoniously with the warmth of ambergris, lending the perfume a subtle complexity. In the base, white musk provides a soft and velvety finish that elegantly rounds off the individual components. The result is a fragrance that is both woody and fresh, captivating with its perfect balance. The creation is presented in a minimalist, cylindrical glass bottle with golden accents, reflecting the brand’s modern aesthetic. A woody and fresh unisex fragrance Combines notes of Indian green tea and oud With warm accents of ambergris Rounded off with a base of white musk

listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Classic Collection Eau de Parfum Spray The Beach 100 ml
listings.description: Molecule C-19 The Beach Eau de Parfum Spray by Zarkoperfume is an olfactory tribute to carefree summer days on the beaches of Hornbaek. This unisex fragrance opens with the exotic warmth of coconut molecules, which immediately conjure up images of sun and sea. In the heart note, a crisp whitewood accord lends a bright, woody dimension, reminiscent of sun-bleached driftwood and salty air. The base note harmoniously rounds off the composition with soft, sweet musk and a hint of creamy vanilla. This combination lends the fragrance a pleasant depth and a long-lasting character. As an Eau de Parfum, this creation – launched in 2023 – features a high concentration of fragrance oils, ensuring it lingers for many hours. It is a fragrance that captures the essence of an endless summer in a bottle. A unisex fragrance, inspired by a summer’s day on the beach. A composition of coconut notes, light wood, musk and vanilla. A long-lasting fragrance experience thanks to a high concentration of perfume oils. A fragrance launched in 2023.

listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Classic Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Dreamer 100 ml
listings.description: With the Classic Collection Dreamer Eau de Parfum Spray, the Danish brand Zarkoperfume presents a fragrance that captivates with its clarity and subtle depth. Released in 2025, perfumer Zarko Ahlmann Pavlov dedicated this creation to his son Isak, seeking to capture a balance between fresh energy and serene constancy. A lively opening combines fruity notes of apple and Sicilian bergamot with the green freshness of fig leaves. This initial impression is complemented by spicy ginger and marine accords, which lend the fragrance an invigorating quality. At the heart of the fragrance, aromatic facets of rosemary, sage and juniper berry unfold, blending with the floral character of geranium. Ambroxan lends the heart note an additional modern structure. A warm base of cedarwood, vetiver and tonka bean rounds off the olfactory experience, whilst incense and musk provide a grounded finish. Designed as a unisex fragrance, this eau de parfum is aimed at anyone who appreciates herbaceous and woody notes. The cylindrical glass bottle offers a glimpse of the pale yellow liquid and is visually enhanced by a gold-metallic cap and an elegantly framed label. A fresh, herbaceous fragrance profile with woody accents and maritime notes A multi-layered composition of apple, sage, ambroxan and cedarwood Unisex perfume from the Classic Collection, launched in 2025 High-quality glass bottle with a metallic gold cap Inspired by quiet strength and the perfumer’s personal dedication

listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Ménage à Trois Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Danish fragrance house Zarkoperfume presents ‘Ménage à Trois’, an eau de parfum based on a unique concept. At the heart of the composition are three large musk molecules, which form a harmonious blend and define the fragrance’s aromatic character. This gives rise to a fresh and dynamic olfactory experience, complemented by a crisp note of watermelon. Conceived as a molecular perfume, Zark Ahlmann Pavlov’s creation develops individually on the skin and is suitable as a unisex fragrance for all wearers. Launched in 2016, the Eau de Parfum is also vegan and was produced without animal testing. Aromatic and fresh fragrance character A composition of three musk molecules and watermelon Molecular unisex perfume Vegan and not tested on animals

listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Cloud Collection Eau de Parfum Spray No. 1 100 ml
listings.description: A fascinating interplay of contrasts defines the character of Zarkoperfume Cloud Collection Eau de Parfum Spray No. 1. Zarko Ahlmann Pavlov developed this composition to re-explore the boundaries of classical perfumery and create a fragrance that can respond to the individual’s aura. Visually, the creation immediately catches the eye with its striking orange-coloured liquid in a clear glass bottle, which emphasises the vibrancy of its contents. Olfactorily, Danish sea buckthorn opens the experience, imparting a fruity, slightly tart note that instantly captures the attention. At the heart, the elegance of French jasmine absolute then unfolds, lending the composition a floral yet refined depth. The bouquet is rounded off by a warm driftwood accord in the base, which provides a consistent, woody nuance and grounds the lighter notes. Launched in 2017, the Eau de Parfum is often classified as floral-woody and is characterised by its complex layering. The result is an olfactory composition that harmoniously superimposes lighter and darker facets. The understated elegance of the bottle, with its black cylindrical cap and repeated lettering, reflects the brand’s modern, Nordic approach. Fragrance family: Floral-woody with fruity accents. Main notes: Danish sea buckthorn, French jasmine absolute and a driftwood accord. Special feature: The orange-coloured liquid symbolises the fragrance’s high-contrast layered concept. Design: Transparent glass bottle with a black cap and minimalist typography. Background: Created by perfumer Zarko Ahlmann Pavlov, launched in 2017.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Patchouli Dust Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: In 2023, the niche label Pana Dora Sweden presents the extrait de parfum Patchouli Dust. It is unisex and has a green-woody fragrance . The eye-catching bottle with the deer head is typical of the luxury label and gives it an exceptional recognition value. Perfumer Ibrahim Al-Zoubi is behind the Patchouli Dust fragrance. He has created a top note of artemesia, saffron, cardamom, cypress and patchouli. The heart note contains the aromas of nutmeg, vetiver and Taif rose. The extrait de parfum Patchouli Dust is rounded off with cedar, amber, oud, tonka bean and vanilla. For everyone, but definitely not for everyone Pana Dora Sweden is well aware that the fragrance is offputting, but that is intentional. The company is proud to be a niche label and is happy in the role of olfactory outsider. The extrait de parfum Patchouli Dust divides opinion, either you love it or you can't do anything with it. Those who love it are thrilled by an unusual creation that is so gloriously non-conformist and, like its wearers, is simply something special. The Pana Dora Sweden label is as far removed from the mainstream as the people for whom a special fragrance is part of their normal demeanour because they are also beyond the mainstream.

listings.rawTitle: EL GANSO Limoncello Eau de Toilette Spray 125 ml
listings.description: The Spanish label EL GANSO is introducing the Limoncello Season eau de toilette spray in 2021. EL GANSO Limoncello Season Eau de Toilette Spray fulfils these requirements with lightness and a Mediterranean flair.

The base note is deliberately natural and just as fresh, thanks primarily to the cedarwood. However, sandalwood and vetiver should not go unmentioned as counterparts in the base note of the EL GANSO Sunday Mood Eau de Toilette Spray fragrance. And the bottle? It's definitely a chic eye-catcher!

listings.description: EL GANSO Hey Sunshine Eau de Toilette Spray is dedicated to summer, sunshine and the endless expanse of the world's oceans. This makes Hey Sunshine by EL GANSO a real eye-catcher in any bathroom. The eau de toilette spray was designed under the motto "Girls just wanna have sun now!" - undoubtedly an allusion to the world-famous song with a slightly different title. However, the fragrance is also an interesting highlight - which is primarily, but by no means exclusively, suitable for hot summer days. Open, vitalising and exciting fragrance The top note of EL GANSO Hey Sunshine Eau de Toilette Spray is immediately juicy and fruity - thanks to the extracts of ripe peaches and pears. The heart note is just as sweet, this time with a soft and powdery fragrance composed of jasmine and rose, framed by gardenia accords. With a natural base note consisting of various woods and musk, the top and heart notes can radiate in full intensity and strength - much to the delight of the wearer of this great fragrance.

listings.description: The eau de parfum spray L'Empreinte by Courrèges is a modern interpretation of a classic fragrance from 1971. The bottle reflects the modern elegance of the brand with its minimalist design in glossy red. listings.rawTitle: Courrèges L'Eau de Liesse Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: L'Eau de Liesse by Courrèges is an eau de parfum that captures the carefree atmosphere of a sunny afternoon in a fragrance. Launched in 2022, this modern creation is aimed at anyone who appreciates floral and sensual compositions. The fragrance initially unfolds with the luminous freshness of neroli, which introduces a slightly citrusy facet. At the heart, the powdery elegance of iris combines with jasmine sambac and heliotrope to create a multi-layered, floral bouquet. The base note, in which warm white musk meets ambroxan, ensures a long-lasting and soft finish. The result is a radiant fragrance that leaves a velvety aroma on the skin. The composition is presented in a simple and elegant bottle that reflects Courrèges' characteristic design. listings.rawTitle: Courrèges L'Eau Pâle Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: L'Eau Pâle by Courrèges captures the olfactory landscape of a Mediterranean island on a summer’s evening. The fragrance opens with a zesty freshness of lemon essence, pink pepper and petitgrain. At its heart, a clear, aromatic depth unfolds through the combination of lavender absolute and a subtle hint of vanilla, which gently underpins the composition. A long-lasting, warm base of vetiver essence, iris concrete and balsamic notes rounds off the fragrance experience. Overall, this feminine Eau de Parfum presents itself as a multi-layered creation that combines lightness with a nostalgic, soapy note. The clean, modern design of the bottle reflects the character of the fragrance: a cylindrical container and a spherical cap are finished in a uniform, pale shade of blue, emphasising the simple elegance of the composition. A feminine fragrance with fresh, light and delicately soapy notes. A composition of zesty lemon, aromatic lavender and a warm, woody base. Inspired by the atmosphere of a summer’s evening on a Mediterranean island. Presented in a minimalist, pale blue bottle. Made in France.

listings.rawTitle: Emil Élise Choose Happiness Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Choose Happiness eau de parfum spray by Emil Élise offers a very special olfactory experience. Even the opening surprises with a fruity freshness in which tangy bergamot meets the sweetness of pear and exotic lychee. This lively start is complemented by subtle accents of peony and blackcurrant bud, which immediately gives the composition a dynamic radiance. As the fragrance progresses, a multi-layered heart unfolds, combining floral notes of hibiscus and rose with the distinctive, slightly smoky character of incense and leather. This complex combination creates an interesting depth that clearly stands out from classic floral arrangements. The base note, dominated by creamy vanilla and amber, ensures a long-lasting and warm finish. The arrangement is rounded off with soft musk and woody nuances that give the unisex perfume a sensual permanence on the skin. The bottle emphasises this clarity with a purist design made of transparent glass with a simple black cap and a focused label. Fruity top notes of bergamot, pear and lychee Complex heart of hibiscus, rose, incense and leather Warm, long-lasting base with vanilla, amber and musk Minimalist glass bottle with black cap Balanced unisex composition

listings.rawTitle: Emil Élise Twisted Sin Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Twisted Sin Eau de Parfum Spray reveals a complex fragrance structure that harmoniously combines fruity vibrancy with spicy depth and woody accents. Released in 2024, this creation begins with a striking top note that blends the citrusy freshness of bergamot and mandarin with the spicy pungency of pink and black pepper. Immediately afterwards, a voluminous heart unfolds, combining sweet apple nuances with the intoxicating flavours of rum and cinnamon as well as resinous labdanum. This gourmand character transforms into a dense, warm base as the fragrance progresses. In the base note, soft cashmere wood and dry wood merge with the sweetness of vanilla, while musk and amber ensure a long-lasting presence on the skin. The olfactory experience is often described as an interplay between initial freshness and a later, misty veil of spices. Visually, the transparent, cylindrical bottle reflects the essence of the contents. A simple white label with black lettering and a round, black cap round off the design, with the yellowish colour of the perfume shimmering through the glass. Fruity and spicy fragrance profile with woody undertones Top notes of bergamot, mandarin and pepper Heart notes of apple, rum, cinnamon and labdanum Warm base of cashmere wood, vanilla and amber Unisex composition in a modern glass flacon

listings.rawTitle: Emil Élise Dancing On Goosebumps Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Dancing On Goosebumps is an unusual eau de parfum spray from Emil Élise. The young company based in Essen is tapping into a new audience that traditional perfume manufacturers are unable to reach. Individuality is the key. The fragrance creations are not categorised. They are intended for anyone who wants to wear them. This eau de parfum spray is also a creative unisex fragrance for everyone who loves perfumes. Dancing On Goosebumps: a fragrance for individualists Emil Élise takes a fresh look at the perfume world. Men, women and fragrance categories do not play a role. Instead, each individual person with their own characteristics is important. Modern fragrances are just as flexible and multi-layered as the people who wear them. Dancing On Goosebumps is a successful example of how this concept works. The notes of the creation are spicy, woody, smoky and invite you to rediscover the fragrance again and again. The citrus elements dominate at the beginning: Bergamot and petitgrain create a sparkling accord. The heart note continues in an unusual way. It consists of a combination of pink pepper and incense. The final chord is earthy and woody. Cashmere wood and papyrus meet vetiver. The base note is rounded off with amber.

listings.rawTitle: Emil Élise Going Bang Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
