Leather, vetiver, cedarwood and patchouli form a solid foundation that gives the fragrance an expressive and long-lasting character. The minimalist design of the bottle reflects the modern and clear focus of the fragrance composition. An eau de parfum with fruity, spicy and woody notes. The top note combines grapefruit, pink pepper and incense. The heart features geranium, jasmine, cardamom and nutmeg. The base consists of leather, vetiver, cedarwood and patchouli. Presented in a simple, elegant glass bottle.

The fragrance is designed to be long-lasting and is suitable for people who appreciate expressive and characterful compositions. listings.rawTitle: Emil Élise Melting Lust Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Melting Lust by Emil Élise is an eau de parfum spray that is characterised by a multi-faceted, sweet-fruity and spicy signature. The composition opens with a strong top note in which juicy cherry meets the warmth of rum, accompanied by the resinous nuances of benzoin and elemi. This intense introduction flows smoothly into a heart note in which floral accents of rose and lavender combine with the balsamic tones of Peru balsam and the smoky character of guaiac wood. The base provides a long-lasting depth, concluding the fragrance with earthy notes of patchouli and moss and the warmth of amber and musk. Designed as a creative unisex fragrance, Melting Lust emphasises the individual personality through its complex and unconventional fragrance development. Fragrance direction: Sweet, fruity and spicy Main notes: A composition of cherry, rum, amber and musk Character: Creative and unconventional unisex fragrance Base: Depth through patchouli, moss and woody notes

listings.rawTitle: Emil Élise Hangover Meditation Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Hangover Meditation by Emil Élise is characterised by a fascinating interplay of freshness and warmth. Vitalising nuances of lemon and bergamot open the composition and provide a sparkling start. Crisp apple adds a fruity accent that blends harmoniously with the fine spice of cardamom. As the fragrance progresses, soft plum notes meet floral accords, giving the fragrance an interesting depth. The base forms a calm contrast with warm amber and musk. Woody facets reminiscent of driftwood round off the olfactory profile and ensure a dry, lasting finish. This unisex creation combines aquatic lightness with an earthy signature. Visually, the product is presented in a cylindrical glass bottle that reveals the slightly yellowish liquid. A white label with clear typography and a black lid complete the minimalist design. The fragrance is suitable for lovers of compositions that combine both invigorating and gentle elements. Unisex fragrance with a balance of aquatic freshness and musky warmth. Top notes of lemon, bergamot, apple and spicy cardamom. Base of amber, musk and woody driftwood accords. Minimalist, cylindrical glass bottle with black cap.

listings.rawTitle: Mihan Aromatics Petrichor Plains Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Petrichor Plains: an insider tip from Down Under. The charismatic unisex fragrance comes from Mihan Aromatics. The young company prefers to use raw materials from sustainable production. This also means that it primarily uses substances that are native to Australia. The result fascinates perfume connoisseurs all over the world. This is because these fragrance creations stand out from the classic perfumes of European origin - reason enough to try out this exciting eau de parfum spray. Petrichor Plains by Mihan Aromatics: the scent of rain The fifth continent is rich in breathtaking landscapes and unique natural phenomena. They don't just attract tourists. They also serve as inspiration for wonderful perfumes. This unusual eau de parfum spray is inspired by the petrichor phenomenon . It occurs when raindrops fall on dry, warm rocky ground. This creates a very specific scent that can often be experienced in Australia. Aquatic, woody, green : this is how the perfume can be described. However, these three terms do not fully capture the multi-faceted creation. The top note is dedicated to the main protagonist: rain. A hint of iris gives it a tart floral accent. The heart note is multi-layered: violets, fresh, spicy rosemary and cardamom blend to create a seductive accord. The harmonious base consists of amyris and Australian Buddha wood.

listings.rawTitle: Mihan Aromatics Sienna Brume Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Sienna Brume Eau de Parfum Spray is a fragrance by Mihan Aromatics that epitomises elegance and finesse. From the very first encounter, a delicate aroma of floral and woody notes envelops the senses. An olfactory dance begins, characterised by nuances that evoke memories of dawn and dusk. When this eau de parfum spray is applied, a sensual symphony unfolds, the tones of which reflect the vastness of Australian landscapes. The base of this perfume is characterised by a deep, warm complexity that lingers on the skin for a long time. But the special thing about Sienna Brume lies in the nuances: this is where freshness and depth, lightness and darkness come together to merge in perfect harmony. Sensual perfume with that certain something Delicate, almost whispering accords combine with powerful, striking elements. The result is a fragrance that is as multi-faceted as a gemstone in the morning light. Whether for a special occasion or everyday wear, this perfume from Mihan Aromatics always makes a clear statement without being overpowering. The flacon design of this eau de parfum spray complements the olfactory masterpiece with its simple yet elegant appearance. Clear, elegant and with a pinch of mysticism. With Sienna Brume, Mihan Aromatics offers more than just a perfume - it is an invitation to rediscover your own sensuality and savour every moment to the full.

listings.rawTitle: Mihan Aromatics Guilty Story Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Mihan Aromatics Guilty Story Eau de Parfum Spray focuses on spontaneity and an unconditionally lived moment. It is up to the wearer of this unisex fragrance to decide whether this took place on a wild night of partying or on a lonely walk along a sandy beach swept clean in the early hours of the morning. This perfume is always intoxicating, an unrecognisable passion is immediately apparent with the first spritz of Mihan Aromatics Guilty Story Eau de Parfum Spray. The Australian brand also uses Australian sandalwood in this perfume, which adds a slightly more intense note - without losing its fresh fragrance character. A touch of the Orient - framed by exclusive woods While the Mihan Aromatics Guilty Story Eau de Parfum Spray opens with neroli, the heart note becomes even more oriental with saffron and cinnamon. The base note combines cedarwood, sandalwood and musk, while vanilla, also contained in the perfume, adds a sweet accent. This recognisable fragrance has become a real insider tip since its market launch in 2018 - and a great choice for anyone who loves oriental notes with subtle woody accords. The minimalist, elongated bottle with a black cap acts as an effective contrast to the multi-layered and sometimes exotic essences.

listings.rawTitle: Mihan Aromatics Kirra Curl Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Kirra Curl Eau de Parfum Spray by Mihan Aromatics is a fantastic fragrance that is suitable for all genders It has been on the market since 2021. Its unique fragrance composition enchants with sparkling marine notes and woody accords. It transports you to a sun-drenched beach in Australia, where countless surfers ride the waves and a refreshing sea breeze invigorates the senses. This irresistible perfume is the ideal choice for self-confident, sporty people who love adventure. Fascinating perfume for many occasions The Kirra Curl Eau de Parfum Spray by Mihan Aromatics is the perfect fragrance for many occasions thanks to its sparkling facets. It combines aquatic accents with spicy woody notes. Its top note combines sea salt with refreshing lemon peel. In the heart note, the strong aroma of leather meets the characteristic tones of surf wax. Finally, the unmistakable notes of Australian buddhawood and sandalwood surprise, harmoniously rounded off by a sweet hint of vanilla. Experience unforgettable moments with the seductive fragrance from Mihan Aromatics!

listings.rawTitle: Mihan Aromatics Sinful Rose Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Mihan Aromatics Sinful Rose Eau de Parfum Spray is as imaginative as it is a little intimate. Not surprisingly, given the name of this perfume, its fragrance world revolves entirely around the unmistakable accords of the sinful rose . The perfume wants to whisk you away: To a remote, tangled and completely secluded rose garden somewhere in Mediterranean climes, where you can savour the tranquillity of the moment as well as a pinch of passion to the full. In this Mihan Aromatics Sinful Rose Eau de Parfum Spray, the Turkish rose is present in both the top and heart notes and is therefore omnipresent in all fragrance phases. An almost mystical dance of flowers The perfume, whose bottle is discreetly understated, opens with the eponymous Turkish rose and a hint of geranium and bergamot. Mihan Aromatics Sinful Rose Eau de Parfum Spray then moves on to tonka bean, vanilla and ginger extracts in the heart note, framing this trio in the powdery, velvety scent of rose. The base note, meanwhile, is somewhat more powerful and spicy, thanks in particular to the eaglewood and oud accords and benzoin resin. This gives the fragrance an intimate yet mature and sophisticated feel.

listings.rawTitle: Mihan Aromatics Mikado Bark Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Mikado Bark is a harmonious, characterful unisex fragrance from Mihan Aromatics. The Australian perfume manufacturer has established itself on the market with its creations. Typical Australian ingredients are just as much a part of the company's philosophy as the use of high-quality sugar cane as an alternative to conventional ethanol. Each perfume is characterised by a distinctive Australian aspect and invites you to get to know the fifth continent better. Mikado Bark: a nostalgic fragrance for men and women Familiarity is an important aspect of the fragrances from Mihan Aromatics. The perfumers use ingredients that evoke memories and associations in everyone who comes into contact with the fragrance. It is hardly surprising that the eau de parfum spray is designed for men and women. Unisex fragrances appeal to everyone. They are not bound to gender. This also applies to this fresh, green-spicy fragrance composition. The perfume opens with the scent of damp earth. Whether it is dew or rain is up to the wearer to decide. This is complemented by the intensely spicy aroma of fresh sage leaves. The heart note brings autumnal memories: Cinnamon bark and cloves give it a dry, spicy character. The eau de parfum spray ends with green and woody notes: Patchouli and Virginia cedar form a natural, dreamy final chord.

It is a fragrance that evokes memories and sparks emotions. With every spray, a bouquet of carefully selected essences unfolds, reminiscent of the wild nature of Australia. Deep and grounding, the perfume begins with notes of fresh bergamot and spicy pepper. This is followed shortly afterwards by a sweet surprise in which warm woody tones meet juicy fruity notes. The base, mysterious and lasting, combines vetiver with delicate incense and leaves an unforgettable impression. Exclusive perfume for every occasion Sophisticated in every facet, the bottle reflects the aesthetics of the Mihan Aromatics brand. Clear, elegant and minimalist - it not only holds the coveted fragrance, but also embodies the vision behind this work of art. A fragrance that is suitable for both day and evening, emphasising the wearer's character with sophistication and depth. Munlark Ash Eau de Parfum Spray is more than just a fragrance. It is an ode to nature, a story that is retold with every drop. A masterpiece for all those who are looking for something special.

listings.rawTitle: Headspace Collection Extrait de Parfum Spray Tabac 50 ml
listings.description: The Headspace Tabac Extrait de Parfum Spray offers a woody and amber-scented fragrance composition that ensures a lasting presence in everyday life. The spicy top notes of aniseed, ginger and clove open the fragrance experience and create a striking start to the day. This is followed by a heart note of coffee, hay and tonka bean, which lends the fragrance a multi-layered structure and rounds off the wearing experience. Finally, the base note of tobacco leaves, ambroxan and vanilla rounds off the profile, leaving a warm trail on the skin. Perfumer Julien Rasquinet developed this fragrance for the French niche brand to strike a balance between spicy and soft elements. Thanks to its high fragrance concentration as an ‘Extrait de Parfum’, just a few sprays are enough to achieve an expressive result, allowing for efficient and economical use. The minimalist, transparent glass bottle with a black label and fluted cap blends unobtrusively into any perfume collection. A woody and amber-scented composition for a lasting presence A distinctive opening with aniseed, ginger and clove A multi-layered heart note of coffee, hay and tonka bean A warm base note with tobacco leaves, ambroxan and vanilla Extrait de Parfum allows for economical and efficient use

listings.rawTitle: SENSAI The Silk Body Emulsion 200 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the unrivalled softness and gentle sheen of fine silk, SENSAI The Silk Body Emulsion envelops the body in a luxurious sensation. This emulsion is characterised by its light, milky texture, which spreads effortlessly over the skin and leaves a smooth, silky-soft finish. The application becomes a special moment, accompanied by a subtle fragrance that combines fresh components with the warm, sensual depth of amber. The composition is designed for use on all skin types and contains selected ingredients such as silk hydrolysate, which echo the theme of the product line. Presented in an elegant, white pump dispenser with fine golden decorations, the packaging epitomises the simple elegance of the SENSAI brand. Lightweight body emulsion for a silky-soft skin feel. Fragrance composition of fresh notes and sensual amber. Suitable for all skin types. Elegant design in a white pump dispenser with gold accents.

listings.rawTitle: Tabac Tabac Original After Shave Lotion 50 ml
listings.description: Since 1959, this striking fragrance classic has stood for consistency and tradition in the world of upscale body care. Tabac Original After-Shave Lotion is an alcohol-based aftershave lotion specially designed to finish off a wet or dry shave. A tart and spicy aroma unfolds immediately after application and provides vitalising refreshment on the shaved areas. The top notes are dominated by pepper, petitgrain and sparkling bergamot, while the heart of the composition is characterised by floral and spicy accords of lavender, cloves and geranium. The long-lasting base is formed by warm tones of sandalwood, vetiver and musk, which lend the whole a woody depth. The liquid leaves the skin feeling clarified and can help to tone the complexion after shaving. The product is quickly absorbed without leaving an oily film. Packaged in the iconic white opal glass bottle with the brown cap, the design reflects the timeless aesthetic of the brand. Spicy-woody fragrance profile with notes of pepper, lavender and sandalwood Classic alcohol-based formulation for a refreshing skin feel Absorbs quickly with no greasy residue Traditional product from Germany since 1959

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez NARCISO Hair Mist 30 ml
listings.description: A delicate veil of fragrance envelops the hair with NARCISO Hair Mist, creating a long-lasting, elegant aura that is gently released with every movement. The olfactory composition picks up on the line's characteristic musky heart, which is harmoniously complemented by floral notes of rose and gardenia and a warm, woody base of vetiver and cedarwood. The formulation has been specially developed as a particularly light mist that lays delicately on the hairstyle without weighing down the hair structure or leaving an oily film. The eau de toilette is a versatile companion that is characterised by its fresh yet profound character. The round, blue-green bottle reflects the colours of the ocean depths and completes the overall look of this classic fragrance. Fragrance direction: Aromatic-aquatic with an invigorating freshness. listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari BVLGARI MAN Eau de Parfum Spray Wood Essence 60 ml
listings.description: Bvlgari Man Wood Essence was launched as a new men's fragrance in 2018 and belongs to the woody fragrance family. The striking fragrance composition is just the right eau de parfum spray for nature-loving men who also like to surround themselves with an aura of originality, closeness to nature and authenticity when it comes to body care. The intense fragrance by Bvlgari skilfully plays with woody and citrus scents that complement each other harmoniously. The overall result is an unobtrusive, refreshing men's fragrance that is just as well suited to a full-bearded bloke as it is to a bank employee in a pinstripe. An authentic fragrance for the modern man with character The eau de parfum spray Bvlgari Man Wood Essence was created by its creator Alberto Morillas from a variety of specially selected ingredients. The top note is characterised by the aroma of lemon peel, sugared citrus fruits and coriander leaf. Essences of vetiver, cedar and cypress provide the typical woody fragrance in this Eau de Parfum Spray for Man. A base note of benzoin resin forms the harmonious foundation on which the woody-aromatic fragrance components can unfold. The overall result is a masculine yet finely composed fragrance that can be worn for both professional and private occasions.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Omnia Eau de Toilette Spray Amethyste 30 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the noble and pure radiance of amethyst, Bvlgari Omnia Amethyste unfolds as a composition full of elegance and lightness. This eau de toilette opens with a sparkling freshness of pink grapefruit, accompanied by green notes for an invigorating start. A delicate, floral bouquet of precious iris and the fine aroma of Bulgarian roses unfolds at the heart of the fragrance creation. This combination gives the fragrance its feminine depth and powdery softness. The base note harmoniously rounds off the olfactory experience with gentle heliotrope and warm woody notes, leaving a subtle and pleasantly long-lasting impression. Omnia Amethyste is a versatile companion that is characterised by its unobtrusive yet present aura. It is suitable for a variety of everyday situations and special occasions, although its fresh character is particularly suited to the spring season. listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal pour Homme Eau de Toilette Spray Refillable 50 ml

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Eau de Parfum Spray Scandal Intense 30 ml
listings.description: The Scandal Intense Eau de Parfum Spray by Jean Paul Gaultier is a composition for women that is characterised by a distinct ambery and floral signature. The carefully balanced fragrance pyramid unfolds gradually and begins with the spicy presence of cardamom in the top note, which creates a striking yet inviting first impression. At the heart of the fragrance is the exotic and full-bodied blossom of ylang-ylang. This floral heart note gives the perfume an opulent depth and a multi-faceted character. The foundation of this creation is formed by the base note, in which warm, creamy vanilla provides a gentle and enveloping finish. The interplay of these selected elements results in an intense and expressive fragrance experience that belongs to the amber-floral fragrance family. Conceived as an eau de parfum spray, the fragrance can be spread delicately on the skin, where it can unfold its multi-layered notes. Fragrance direction: amber-floral Head note: cardamom Heart note: ylang-ylang Base note: Vanilla Product type: Eau de Parfum Spray

This long-lasting fragrance with its distinct presence is presented in an iconic bottle. The cone-shaped corset design is adorned with amber gold accents and reflects the character of the contents. For an ideal development of the aroma, it is recommended to apply the spray to pulse points such as the neck or wrists. Direct contact with textiles should be avoided and the bottle should be protected from heat and sunlight. Intense, floral-amber eau de parfum . listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Les Femmes Eau de Parfum Spray La Belle Rosea 30 ml
listings.description: The Jean Paul Gaultier La Belle Rosea Eau de Parfum gives everyday life a floral-aquatic fragrance that leaves a pleasantly fresh feeling on the skin. Finally, a fine spray head ensures even distribution of the liquid, making it easy to use sparingly and precisely. listings.description: The Gaultier Divine Eau de Parfum Refill is an easy and environmentally friendly way to refill the bottle of Jean Paul Gaultier's fragrance, which was launched in 2023. The 200 ml refill bottle is equipped with an innovative system that automatically fills the original bottle after unscrewing and stops as soon as it is full. This reduces waste without sacrificing the luxurious character of the fragrance. Refill bottle with 200 ml for the Gaultier Divine Eau de Parfum. listings.description: In 2012, the J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin label, which was originally founded in 1856 and was even a purveyor of fragrances to the court, was revived. One of these fragrances was the eau de parfum spray Trance, which was also relaunched in 2012. The resinous-floral unisex fragrance brings with it a touch of the Orient and delights men and women, especially in winter and on cool autumn days. Like some of the label's other fragrances, Trance is also a recreation. With this fragrance, the makers take a bow to the pulsating city of Berlin . It is intense, moving and clearly ambiguous. Modernity and tradition unite to create timeless elegance The flacon is classically cool, understated and almost sober. The fragrance pyramid of the eau de parfum spray is short, but all the more interesting for it. The top note of Trance by J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin is characterised by Turkish roses. The heart note is formed from candied flowers and delicate powder. Finally, balsam resin and absinthe meet in the base. The unisex fragrance is not subtle, yet surprisingly honest, and is suitable for all occasions. You can even wear the eau de parfum spray by J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin in the evening and when going out. The unisex fragrance is not subtle, yet surprisingly honest, and is suitable for all occasions. You can even wear the eau de parfum spray by J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin in the evening and when going out. listings.rawTitle: J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin Rosa Centifolia Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: A cool yet multi-faceted interpretation of the rose is revealed in this creation from Berlin. With Rosa Centifolia, J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin dedicates itself to the "Rose de Mai" and presents this blossom in a modern, unsentimental way. The opening surprises with a spicy freshness in which invigorating cardamom meets the tart, greenish notes of petitgrain. This entrée is complemented by fruity accents of osmanthus before the floral heart unfolds. Here, the absolute of the eponymous centifolia rose takes centre stage, which is given a multi-layered depth by bourbon geranium and jasmine sambac. Unlike many traditional floral arrangements, the impression here remains transparent and earthy. The base note gives the eau de parfum spray a warm consistency and a gentle finish. Woody accords of sandalwood and bourbon vetiver combine harmoniously with the resinous note of Namibian myrrh. The light yellow liquid is encased in a transparent glass bottle with a golden fluted cap, which emphasises the simple elegance of the brand. It is a fragrance that balances floral and woody elements and moves beyond classic gender categorisations. Fragrance character: Floral-woody composition with a modern, cool rose note. Head notes: A fresh combination of petitgrain, cardamom and osmanthus. Heart notes: Rosa centifolia forms the centre, accompanied by geranium and jasmine. Base: Warm base of sandalwood, bourbon vetiver and myrrh. Design: Minimalist glass flacon with golden cap in the typical style of the Berlin manufactory.

listings.rawTitle: J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin Altruist Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin label is an insider tip for artful niche perfumes . Its fragrances are the olfactory realisation of colours and paintings. Launched in 2017, the unisex eau de parfum spray Altruist by star perfumer Veronique Nyberg was created in collaboration with Austrian painter Paul DeFlorian. He also designed the colourful artwork paper bag that holds the spartan bottle and its outer packaging. Fascinating fragrance accords as a counterpart to colours J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin Altruist Eau de Parfum Spray opens sparkling and fresh. Sweet and tart bergamot, juicy lemon, AqualTM and aromatic, spicy ginger make the fragrance sparkling and invigorating. The clear, cool fragrance notes are conceived as an olfactory realisation of the turquoise-green sections of DeFlorian's artwork. The heart of the fragrance is given an elegant note by dewy rose and graceful, sensual orange blossom. Nutmeg and black pepper, a fragrance variation of orange-coloured brushstrokes, bring a warm nuance into play. Vetiver, patchouli, soft ambergrisTM and resinous, aromatic cedarwood provide an elegant finish with subtle sensuality. The dense, intense accord is reminiscent of the smell of colour on damp paper. J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin Altruist Eau de Parfum Spray is a fascinating citrusy-woody art perfume with pure, clear accents. It captivates with fresh lightness and discreet elegance.

listings.description: The Acqua Wood Eau de Toilette Spray from Collistar is a fascinating fragrance for men. Daphné Bugey was inspired by various Italian traditions when creating the composition. The fragrance initially unfolds with a fresh top note of bergamot and orange, which is accompanied by lavender and coriander. At the heart of the fragrance, the eponymous amaryllis combines with jasmine sambac, magnolia and a hint of incense, giving the perfume its special character. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with warm and soft components. This is where sandalwood, tonka bean and vanilla meet benzoin resin and tolu balsam. The result is a balanced perfume that feels pleasant on the skin and is suitable for all-day wear. The creation is presented in an elegant, white bottle with golden accents, reflecting the classic aesthetic of the Panama 1924 brand. Fragrance direction: Flowery-woody Head notes: bergamot, orange, lavender, coriander Heart notes: amaryllis, jasmine sambac, magnolia, incense Base notes: sandalwood, tonka bean, vanilla, musk

listings.rawTitle: Boellis 1924 Panama 1924 Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Panama 1924 Eau de Parfum Spray by Boellis 1924 is a timeless men's fragrance whose composition is based on a traditional recipe dating back to 1924. The opening is characterised by an invigorating freshness that combines tangy lemon, juicy mandarin and a hint of peppermint. Shortly afterwards, the spicy heart of the fragrance unfolds with notes of cinnamon, coriander and lavender, which are harmoniously complemented by classic rose accents. Over time, the creation develops into a warm and full-bodied base. This is where creamy sandalwood and sweet vanilla meet distinctive tobacco notes, giving the fragrance its unmistakable and elegant character. The balance between fresh, spicy and warm elements makes this fragrance a dynamic companion that unfolds in a multi-faceted way throughout the day. Timeless men's fragrance with an elegant character Faceted composition of citrus freshness, spices and warm notes With notes of lemon, cinnamon, sandalwood and tobacco Based on a traditional recipe from 1924

listings.rawTitle: Boellis 1924 Panama 1924 2.0 Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Boellis Panama 1924 2.0 Eau de Parfum Spray is a contemporary evolution of the traditional line, which was conceived as a modern reinterpretation of the classic. This niche creation is characterised by a complex woody-spicy fragrance structure that combines smoky elements with warm accents. The opening surprises with a fascinating combination of precious saffron, smoky birch and the slightly fruity nuances of davana. As the fragrance progresses, an accord full of character unfolds in the heart, combining the spiciness of black pepper with a distinctive whisky note and the delicacy of white flowers. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a solid base in which amber, soft vanilla and white musk combine harmoniously with deep oak wood notes. Visually, the fragrance impresses with a clear glass bottle in a rectangular shape, which is enhanced by rounded edges and a silver cap with a fluted ring. The red logo with the lettering "1924 Panama" and the addition "2.0" provides a deliberate colour accent to the otherwise minimalist design of this eau de parfum. Fragrance family: Woody-spicy with a modern twist. Top notes: A blend of saffron, birch and davana. Heart note: Complex whisky accord paired with black pepper and white flowers. Base note: Warm finish with amber, vanilla, musk and oak wood. Design: High-quality glass bottle with silver cap and red logo detail.

listings.rawTitle: Boellis 1924 Panama 1924 Fefé Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The sparkling bergamot and lemon accords are joined by a pinch of tarragon, giving the top note of Panama 1924 Fefé Eau de Parfum Spray an extravagant touch . The heart note is gentle and exquisite with nuances of orange blossom, jasmine and saffron. Masculine and charming, the men's fragrance is rounded off with woody notes, musk, ambergris and patchouli. This unusual composition from the Boellis fragrance range remarkably captures the long tradition of the family business and the elegance of Italian menswear . Extraordinary signature for the well-groomed man In 1924, Antonio Boellis founded a barber shop in Naples, which initially developed into a flourishing hairdressing salon and later into a fine label for exceptional fragrances and cosmetics for men. Fefé is a Sicilian nickname for exceptionally fashion-conscious and distinguished men, which was common in the 19th century. The Panama 1924 Fefé Eau de Parfum Spray captures the timeless elegance of these gentlemen as well as the self-confidence of the modern gentleman .

listings.rawTitle: Isabey Paris Prends-moi Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: A fragrance full of contrasts and passionate notes - that's Prends-moi by Isabey Paris. The composition, which has its origins in the early 1930s, opens with a sparkling combination of bergamot, fruity raspberry and rose berries. A multi-layered bouquet unfolds in the heart, in which the delicacy of rose meets the intense presence of tuberose. Spicy cardamom, powdery iris and an unusual lipstick accord lend the fragrance a special depth and a touch of extravagance. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a warm and velvety base of creamy sandalwood and cocoa, which leaves a lasting impression. The creation is presented in a striking red bottle that visually captures the essence of the fragrance. A floral and powdery fragrance with warm accents Heart notes of rose, tuberose, cardamom and a lipstick accord A velvety base with notes of cocoa and sandalwood

listings.rawTitle: Isabey Paris Lys Noir Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Lys Noir Eau de Parfum Spray by Isabey Paris is a sensual fragrance for women that combines oriental notes with elegant floral tones. Elegant lilies are rounded off with fine pepper The perfume house Isabey was founded by Maurice Loewe in Paris in 1924. The label's fragrances quickly became a success and received numerous awards. The house was forced to close at the beginning of the Second World War, but the brand was revived in 2006. The successful fragrances of the 1920s were revived in a slightly modernised version and have not lost their beguiling effect to this day. With Lys Noir Eau de Parfum Spray by Isabey Paris, a fragrance was launched in 2014 that enchants sensual women who love oriental fragrances . Lys Noir Eau de Parfum Spray by Isabey Paris has a mysterious, heavy base of exotic patchouli, musk and elegant ebony and sandalwood . The heart note is characterised by fragrant lilies that blend harmoniously with heliotrope, narcissus and tuberose. The top note consists of spicy pepper, which lends the arrangement spiciness and passionate temperament .

listings.rawTitle: Isabey Paris Tendre Nuit Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Tendre Nuit eau de parfum spray by Isabey Paris is a composition characterised by its floral and velvety notes. The fragrance initially unfolds with a warm note of almond, accompanied by the subtle spiciness of pink pepper. At the heart of the composition is a rose accord, which is given a multi-faceted depth by rose oil and rose absolute. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a base of ambroxan, cashmeran, benzoin and a hint of vanilla. This combination gives the perfume a pleasant warmth and a soft texture. The design of the bottle emphasises the character of the fragrance: the solid, violet glass body in a cubic shape and the matching cap convey a simple elegance. Tendre Nuit is a fragrance that lies gently on the skin and unfolds an unobtrusive presence. Fragrance direction: Floral Head notes: Almond, pink pepper Heart notes: Rose oil, rose absolute, ambrette seed Base notes: Ambroxan, cashmeran, benzoin, vanilla Character: Velvety, warm, soft

listings.rawTitle: Isabey Paris Fleur Nocturne Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Fleur Nocturne Eau de Parfum Spray by Isabey Paris has a seductively feminine effect with its notes of apricot blossom, vanilla and magnolia. Lovely fragrances combine with sensual oriental tones The Isabey perfume house was founded in 1924 by Maurice Loewe. His fragrances soon enjoyed great success and were showered with awards. In 1941, at the beginning of the Second World War, the house was forced to close, but was revived by Panouge in 2006. Even today, the perfumes are still produced - slightly modernised - according to the old recipes . The Fleur Nocturne Eau de Parfum Spray was on the market in the 1920s under the name "Bleu de Chine" and has lost none of its appeal to this day. Fleur Nocturne Eau de Parfum Spray by Isabey Paris is an enchanting fragrance for women that is based on an oriental base of patchouli and a pinch of sweet vanilla . The heart note is fragrant and light and offsets the astringency of the base with its blend of magnolia, gardenia and jasmine. The top note provides refreshment, combining the tantalising notes of peach and apricot blossom with tangy mandarin orange.

listings.rawTitle: Accendis The Whites Eau de Parfum Spray Luna Dulcius 100 ml
listings.description: Accendis presents an eau de parfum spray with a versatile fragrance in The Whites collection. Luna Dulcius impresses with the scent of coconut and vanilla, enriched with other flavours that make a woman's heart beat faster. The result is a sophisticated contrast of innocent playfulness and deep sensuality. The coconut symbolises happiness in many regions - no wonder Accendis chose it as the top note for the fragrance Luna Dulcius. In addition to coconut, a hint of bergamot fills the wearer's nose, while grapefruit and various red fruits also come to light. Floral accords of hawthorn, rose and peony unfold in the heart note, while the base note surprises with woody elements. Cedarwood, musk, vanilla and tonka bean are found here, giving the perfume a smoky, seductive finish. Every Accendis perfume comes in a striking bottle, including this eau de parfum spray, which is finished in delicate white and opulent gold. The box's surprising velvet interior emphasises the femininity of the fragrance from The Whites collection. The eau de parfum spray emphasises the wearer's own, strong personality and ensures a sense of well-being from the very first spritz.

listings.rawTitle: Accendis The Whites Eau de Parfum Spray Fiorialux 100 ml
listings.description: The women's eau de parfum spray Fiorialux is a brand new addition to The Whites range from Accendis. It is a fruity-floral fragrance with soft notes. Fiorialux reveals its affiliation with The Whites at first glance, as the unusual bottle is in ivory white and gold. The label print and name are gold, as are the spray head and the decoration. The eau de parfum spray has been available since 2018 and delights with its feminine presence, which is neither playful nor romantic, but instead offers a wonderful sensuality . Sensuality without heaviness, simply marvellous Apricots, lemons, grapefruit, bergamot and davana rise up in the top note of Accendis The Whites Fiorialux. They meet marigolds, iris, osmanthus and suede accords in the heart note. The final note of Accendis is soft and even more sensual. Musk, amber, patchouli and vetiver give the fragrance a long lasting and sillage. With the Eau de Parfum Spray, Accendis is aimed at all women who appreciate high-quality fragrances with a certain lightness . At the same time, the fragrance also has a spiritual side, which is reflected in the name of The Whites range. For the label, white stands for many positive feelings and thoughts, for purity, for the divine and the spiritual.

listings.rawTitle: Accendis The Whites Eau de Parfum Spray Nooria 100 ml
listings.description: The Nooria Eau de Parfum Spray by Accendis is a fine fragrance for women from the elegant The Whites collection. The eau de parfum spray impresses with a floral fragrance and is suitable for day and evening wear. The fine fragrance for women was created by the well-known and experienced master perfumer Christian Carbonnel. The unique and appealing eau de parfum spray has a seductive effect on men and makes women's hearts beat faster. Flowery women's fragrance for the modern woman of today - Nooria Eau de Parfum Spray by Accendis When composing Nooria Eau de Parfum Spray by Accendis, the master perfumer reached deep into his bag of tricks. The heart note consists of tuberose, ambergris, sandalwood, guaiac wood, patchouli and jasmine. Vanilla, tonka bean and musk form the base of the fragrance. The fragrance from The Whites collection is presented in a wonderful bottle, which is also a favourite object for collectors.

Burberry My Burberry Body Mist 100 ml

listings.rawTitle: Knize Ten Toilet water spray 30 ml
listings.description: With the Knize Ten Toilet Water Spray , you are opting for a classically conservative men's fragrance whose tradition dates back to Vienna in the 1920s. A powerful leather accord dominates the interior of the fragrance building. Spicy sandalwood and cedarwood notes form the supporting pillars. In the volatile periphery of the top note, fresh orange scent and the ethereal aromas of rosemary and bergamot are in harmonious balance. This men's fragrance is just as at home in executive conference rooms as it is on the golf course or polo field. The highest handicap of this gentleman's sport, "+10", is the namesake of the Ten Toilet Water Spray .

listings.rawTitle: Knize Ten Toilet water splash bottle 225 ml
listings.description: An olfactory classic that has its origins in the 1920s, Knize Ten Toilet Water is presented in a traditional pouring bottle. This classic presentation as a splash version allows for customised dosing directly from the rectangular, clear glass bottle, which is fitted with a black, square cap and a round label. The composition opens with a fresh top note in which bergamot, lemon, petitgrain and orange meet green accents of galbanum, tarragon and rosemary, accompanied by subtle aldehyde notes. As the fragrance progresses, a complex heart develops, combining floral elements such as jasmine, iris, heliotrope and geranium with the spice of clove and cinnamon. However, it is the rich base that gives Toilet Water its unmistakable character. Striking leather notes dominate here, accompanied by warm sandalwood, patchouli, vetiver and amber. Animal nuances of castoreum and musk round off the fragrance experience and lend it a special depth and persistence. Due to the nature of the ingredients, the liquid can stain light-coloured clothing, which is why applying it directly to the skin is preferred. Classic pouring bottle: Traditional application as a splash version without atomiser. Complex top note: Fresh blend of citrus fruits, herbs and aldehydes. Striking base: Dominant leather notes combined with woods, amber and animalic accents. Historical relevance: An unchanged fragrance composition from the 1920s.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Les Femmes Eau de Parfum Spray Gaultier Divine 30 ml
listings.description: The Gaultier Divine Eau de Parfum Spray by Jean Paul Gaultier is a tribute to modern femininity in all its facets. This creation by perfumer Quentin Bisch celebrates a powerful yet radiant aura. The fragrance composition opens with an extraordinary top note in which the aquatic calypsone molecule meets the fruity sweetness of red berries and the tangy freshness of bergamot. This opening creates a fascinating contrast. At the heart of the fragrance, an elegant, floral bouquet of sunny lily, jasmine and exotic ylang-ylang unfolds, giving the fragrance its feminine depth. The versatile fragrance experience is rounded off by a warm and sensual base note that combines sweet meringue with soft musk and a hint of earthy patchouli. The creation is presented in an iconic bottle in the shape of a female torso adorned with a golden corset. The bottle is also refillable to enable more sustainable use. Fragrance character: Floral and gourmand with an aquatic opening. Heart notes: A floral bouquet of lily, jasmine and ylang-ylang. Base notes: A warm composition of meringue, musk and patchouli. listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 27 Limanakia 50 ml

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Toilette Spray 11 Harmatan Noir 50 ml
listings.description: The Numbered Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris presents a spicy, aromatic composition with the Eau de Toilette Spray 11 Harmatan Noir. This creation picks up on the characteristics of a warm wind and translates them into a multi-faceted olfactory experience. A refreshing opening of lemon mint and aromatic mint tea provides an invigorating note that is immediately present. As the fragrance progresses, a complex heart unfolds, combining Jamaican allspice with precious woods. Cedarwood meets dried jasmine blossoms, giving the fragrance a subtle, woody-floral depth. The profile is rounded off by nuances of sandalwood and oakmoss, which give the eau de toilette a lasting base. The transparent glass bottle with the round, black label and the light yellow liquid emphasises the simple elegance of the Parfumerie Générale brand. listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 23 Drama Nuuï 50 ml
listings.description: Drama Nuuï is the twenty-third work to join Pierre Guillaume's established Numbered Collection. The composition from 2008 presents itself as a complex, woody-floral arrangement that thematically focuses on various teenage nuances. Wormwood tea and a fine selection of spices open the fragrance experience in the top note and gently lead the way. The character of jasmine tea then unfolds in the heart, creating a harmonious link to the deeper accords. There, guaiac wood and musk provide a solid finish. Olfactorily, this interplay creates impressions reminiscent of osmanthus blossom and nuances of apricot and black tea, with delicate, leathery aspects also perceptible. The clear, rectangular glass bottle allows a clear view of the light yellow liquid, in which occasional fine air bubbles form an interesting optical structure. The container is crowned by a black, cylindrical cap. A round, black label with the white number 23 clearly indicates that it belongs to the Parfumerie Générale line. This eau de parfum is designed so that it can be used as a unisex fragrance regardless of gender assignments. listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 08 Intrigant Patchouli 50 ml
listings.description: The Numbered Collection by French perfumer Pierre Guillaume pays olfactory homage to the chypres of the 1940s with number 08. Intrigant Patchouli presents itself as a complex elixir that takes the classic patchouli theme in an aristocratic yet bohemian direction. At the centre of the composition is an animalistic patchouli that is supported by precious Mysore sandalwood. Spicy ginger opens the fragrance and blends harmoniously with the earthy sweetness of the base notes. Nuances of benzoin, amber and musk provide a warm depth, while leathery accents give the eau de parfum a distinctive character. The yellowish liquid shimmers through the clear glass of the rectangular bottle, creating an attractive contrast to the black, round label and the cylindrical cap. The number 08 on the front indicates that the fragrance belongs to the established Parfumerie Générale range. This unisex fragrance dispenses with rigid categorisations and unfolds its sensual presence individually on the skin. listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Toilette Spray 15 Ilang Ivohibé 50 ml
listings.description: The eau de toilette spray Ilang Ivohibé from the Numbered Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris is characterised by a harmonious interplay of different fragrance families. This creation bears the number 15 and exemplifies the brand's artisanal approach. The composition opens with a gentle combination of aromatic lavender and sweet vanilla, which together form an inviting prelude. The heart of the fragrance then unfolds with the eponymous ylang-ylang, whose exotic floral notes are complemented by the fine, powdery nuances of orris. This floral centre finally transitions into a persistent base in which earthy patchouli provides a characterful and rounded finish. Overall, the olfactory profile is perceived as a successful balance between floral lightness and powdery depth. Visually, the design emphasises this clarity: the fragrance is housed in a simple, rectangular glass bottle that reveals the light yellow liquid inside. A black, round sticker on the front clearly bears the name of the fragrance and the striking number 15, while a cylindrical, black cap completes the minimalist and elegant design of Parfumerie Générale. listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 04 Musc Maori 50 ml
listings.description: Pierre Guillaume Paris presents the Numbered Collection 04 Musc Maori, an eau de parfum spray characterised by a sophisticated gourmand signature. At the centre of the composition is a milky-smooth accord of cumaru wood, olfactorily reminiscent of the warmth of tonka beans. This gentle base meets contrasting, green nuances of coffee tree blossom, creating an exciting balance between sweetness and freshness. White musk envelops the delicate elements of cocoa and milk chocolate, while amber and vanilla provide a deep, persistent presence. Bergamot adds a subtle effervescence that softens and refines the creamy profile. The fragrance skilfully plays with the contrast between woody facets and soft notes that can evoke associations with hot chocolate. The creation is packaged in a transparent, rectangular glass bottle, which features a black, cylindrical cap and a striking, circular label with the number 04. The clear liquid inside emphasises the minimalist design of the Numbered Collection. It is an olfactory interpretation that places familiar flavours in an elegant and modern context. listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 17 Tubéreuse Couture 50 ml
listings.description: The Numbered Collection 17 Tubéreuse Couture by Pierre Guillaume Paris is dedicated to a detailed olfactory analysis of tuberose. The French perfumer breaks down the fragrance of this flower into its elementary components and reassembles them to create an image of high fashion sophistication. Calamanzi oil and green jasmine shoots open the composition with a striking brightness that is very clear and defined. This fresh opening serves as a deliberate contrast to the lush, creamy nature of Indian tuberose, which forms the unmistakable centrepiece of the eau de parfum. The floral theme is accompanied by ylang-ylang and sugar cane, which contribute a subtle, velvety sweetness and harmoniously round off the green notes. In the base, papyrus and Sumatran benzoin provide a resinous finish that lends depth to the arrangement. The fragrance specifically highlights the five different facets of tuberose, from solar to green to slightly animalistic nuances. The creation is packaged in a heavy, rectangular glass bottle with clean lines, the front of which is adorned with a simple, black label with white typography, elegantly presenting the yellow-coloured contents. Floral-fresh unisex fragrance with a focus on Indian tuberose and its many facets. Head notes of calamanzi oil and green jasmine shoots provide brightness. Base of papyrus and Sumatran benzoin lends a resinous depth. Minimalist glass bottle with black cap and elegant typography.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 8.1 L'Ombre Fauve 50 ml
listings.description: The creation 8.1 L'Ombre Fauve occupies a special place within the Numbered Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris. Released in 2007, the eau de parfum spray is dedicated to a profound interpretation of amber. This fragrance is characterised by its distinct woody-animalic orientation, which is based on a classic structure. At the centre of the formula is the so-called chevrone base, a complex combination of labdanum, civet and ambergris. This special blend gives the perfume a captivating intensity with balsamic and sweet undertones. The olfactory picture is complemented by precious woods, which form a solid base. Patchouli contributes an earthy and almost nocturnal quality, while incense provides smoky accents. Musk softly rounds off the composition and harmoniously combines the spicy and powdery elements. The high proportion of natural ingredients creates a sensual and elegant aroma on the skin. Made in France, the unisex perfume dispenses with unnecessary embellishments and focuses entirely on the power of the darker facets of ambergris. It is a modern homage to vintage formulas that exudes elegance and opulence. listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 5.1 Suede Osmanthe 50 ml
listings.description: The 5.1 Suede Osmanthe creation adds a multi-faceted composition to the Numbered Collection of the French house Pierre Guillaume Paris, which was launched in 2017. The eau de parfum spray is characterised by a special olfactory concept that creates the impression of osmanthus blossom, although this ingredient is deliberately absent from the formulation. Floral aldehydes meet the flavours of black tea and fruity notes of apricot, which together evoke an association with fine, soft suede. listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Cruise Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Rivages Noirs 50 ml
listings.description: The Rivages Noirs eau de parfum spray from the renowned Cruise Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris is an olfactory image of a coastal landscape at night. Since its release in 2015, this creation has exemplified the line's thematic exploration of movement, islands and the sea. The very first impression reveals a complex, spicy-woody interplay in which fruity melon and pungent ginger meet a warm spice blend of cinnamon, saffron and cardamom. This dynamic opening leads smoothly into a heart inspired by the rugged elegance of the ocean. Here, striking notes of whisky and ozone dominate, accompanied by Mediterranean cypress, which evokes immediate associations with a salty breeze. A solid foundation of various woods ensures a long-lasting finish. Amber, cedar leaves and oak moss lend the composition the necessary depth, while a subtle hint of vanilla provides a gentle rounding. The visual design also skilfully emphasises the maritime character of the contents. In a sturdy, rectangular glass bottle, the liquid shines in an intense blue colour, stylishly contrasted by a black, round label with white lettering and a matching cylindrical cap. Spicy, woody fragrance character with maritime influences and whisky accents. Faceted top notes of melon, ginger, cinnamon, saffron and cardamom. Base of amber, cedar leaves, vanilla and oakmoss. Part of the themed Cruise Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris. High-quality glass flacon with strikingly bright blue liquid.

A luminous heart then unfolds, in which aquatic notes combine harmoniously with magnolia and Indian jasmine, while Himalayan cedar adds a woody accent. The base note gives the eau de parfum a powdery character created by the interplay of vetiver, vanilla and tonka bean. It is a unisex fragrance that combines green, silky elements with a warm sillage. Fragrance: A combination of woody, floral and powdery notes. listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Cruise Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Lune d'Eau 50 ml
listings.description: The eau de parfum Lune d'Eau comes from the renowned Cruise Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris and presents itself as an olfactory interpretation of a cool body of water in the moonlight. Clarity and freshness are at the centre of this sophisticated composition, which is often classified as a modern "dry fougère". A striking ice accord combines harmoniously with mineral facets, creating an almost palpable coolness reminiscent of the clear air above a still mountain lake. This arrangement is complemented by the aromatic spiciness of juniper, which forms an invigorating contrast to the watery notes. The soft, woody notes of amyris provide a dry and stable base that gives the fragrance depth. This character ensures a timeless elegance that deliberately transcends classic gender classifications and is therefore universally wearable as a unisex fragrance. Visually, the bottle consistently picks up on the theme of water: The turquoise-coloured liquid shimmers intensely through the transparent, rectangular glass, crowned by a simple, black cylinder cap. The round, black label adds a minimalist accent to the design. Lune d'Eau embodies the atmosphere of calm and movement at the same time and offers a refreshing, grounded fragrance experience. Fragrance character: Fresh, mineral and woody with a modern fougère profile. Main notes: Ice accord, mineral notes, juniper and amyris wood. Collection: Part of the Cruise Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris. Target group: Unisex composition for lovers of clear, cool fragrances. Design: Rectangular bottle with turquoise-coloured liquid and black cap.

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Black Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Animal Mondain 50 ml
listings.description: The Animal Mondain Eau de Parfum Spray from the Black Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris pays homage to the modernism of the 1930s. Inspired by the elegant atmosphere of a fumoir, a gourmand, spicy composition unfolds, skilfully balancing animalistic impulses and social elegance. At the centre of the fragrance is Turkish tobacco absolute, which is accompanied by notes of pear leaf and warm mahogany wood. This combination creates a passionate yet charming tobacco fragrance with sweet and powdery accents. The unisex fragrance emphasises an aura of self-confidence and stylish extravagance and is suitable all year round, especially for milder and cooler days. The concept is rounded off by the clear, classic black bottle, which reflects the elegance of the collection. listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Black Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Shermine 100 ml
listings.description: The Shermine Eau de Parfum Spray is an integral part of the Black Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris and presents itself as a multi-faceted unisex composition. A powdery iris is at the centre of this fragrance, but it is not reduced to its mere floweriness. Instead, the blossom undergoes an aromatic transformation through the addition of spicy cardamom and hot pepper. These spicy notes are livened up by the freshness of Argentine lemon, while Paraguayan guaiac wood and rosewood provide a warm, woody base. Lavender and violet are added to the bouquet, rounded off with a hint of vanilla. Technologically, the creation is based on phyto-perfumery, a process that precisely reproduces the natural complexity of plant substances and harmonises them with synthetic elements. Instead of a classic top, heart and base note structure, different olfactory spheres interact with each other here. The rectangular bottle allows a view of the dark-coloured liquid through the glass, which visually emphasises the character of the contents. Woody, powdery unisex fragrance with a central note of iris Complex composition of cardamom, pepper, lavender and guaiac wood Use of phyto-perfumery technology for a natural fragrance profile Overcoming the classic fragrance pyramid in favour of harmonising spheres Rectangular bottle with visible, dark-coloured liquid

The composition is presented in an elegant, black bottle, whose clear and modern design emphasises the character of the fragrance. A complex, woody fragrance composition . listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 29 Itabaia 50 ml
listings.description: As part of the Numbered Collection, the Eau de Parfum Spray 29 Itabaia is dedicated to the fascinating theme of "Hesperimental", a creative reinterpretation of Hesperides notes. Pierre Guillaume Paris has created an olfactory journey inspired by the dynamism and warmth of Brazilian capoeira dancers on Itacaré beach. Sparkling citrus accords open the composition and blend harmoniously with the green, vibrant nuances of pineapple leaves. The exotic fruitiness of passion fruit unfolds in the heart, accompanied by the rare jurema blossom, which gives the fragrance a special signature. An unusual contrast is provided by a special hemp accord, which meets soft vanilla and hibiscus wood to round off the experience. This neo-chypre fragrance skilfully combines fruity freshness with a powdery depth. Visually, the creation is presented in a rectangular glass bottle with clear contents, which is enhanced by a round, black label with the striking number 29 and a cylindrical lid. listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 11.2 Spicematic 50 ml
listings.description: The creation 11.2 Spicematic from the Numbered Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris presents itself as a modern interpretation of spicy and aromatic notes. At the centre of this composition is a fascinating interplay of contrasts that is often associated with the coolness and hardness of marble. The combination of spearmint and fresh ginger provides a lively opening, immediately establishing a clear presence. This initial freshness meets the precious note of saffron, which gives the fragrance a refined structure. As the fragrance progresses, a mineral incense accord unfolds, which radiates a certain coolness. This almost stone-like impression is balanced by warm, organic elements. Resinous Siberian pine and red cedar provide a woody base that grounds the fragrance experience. The eau de parfum spray is rounded off with soft musk, which harmoniously combines the different facets. Visually, the rectangular, transparent bottle with its black cap and central round label reflects the clarity of the contents. It is a fragrance that combines both cool minerality and resinous warmth and radiates timeless elegance. Fragrance: Spicy and aromatic with a distinctive mineral note. Head notes: A fresh combination of spearmint, spicy ginger and saffron. Base: Warm and resinous accents of Siberian pine, red cedar and musk. Character: A modern interplay of cold incense and organic woods, often described as "marble water".

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 17.1 Dilshad 50 ml
listings.description: With the creation of 17.1 Dilshad, Pierre Guillaume Paris is expanding the renowned Numbered Collection with a multifaceted reinterpretation of floral accords. Launched in 2024, this eau de parfum spray is dedicated to an olfactory study of pistachio combined with classic tuberose. Inspired by the traditional enfleurage technique, in which flowers release their aromas into fats, the result is a harmonious interplay of different textures. The name Dilshad comes from the Persian and can be translated as "the one who brings happiness", which emphasises the bright and inviting character of the fragrance. A crisp, slightly bitter note of Iranian pistachio forms the green prelude to the composition. This freshness merges with a creamy heart of almond milk, which gently embeds the opulence of tuberose. Musk and opoponax in the base lend the arrangement a subtle depth and persistence. Visually, the fragrance is presented in a minimalist, rectangular glass bottle that reveals the light-coloured liquid and is accentuated by a round label and a black cylinder cap. It is a variation on the 17 theme, but develops its own milky green signature. Floral fragrance profile with an accord of green pistachio and tuberose Creamy heart note thanks to the use of almond milk Base of musk and opoponax for long-lasting depth Part of the Numbered Collection as a variation on theme 17 Minimalist glass bottle with striking 17.1 lettering

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 27.1 Le Chant des Sirenes 100 ml
listings.description: The Numbered Collection 27.1 Le Chant des Sirènes by Pierre Guillaume Paris reinterprets the theme of aquatic fragrances in a modern, mineral way. As the second draft of the "27 Minéral" theme, this composition is both airy and substantial, deliberately setting itself apart from classic marine notes. The fragrance opens with an unusual top note in which the green facets of rosewood leaves meet the tangy fruitiness of carambola. This aromatic freshness flows smoothly into a warm heart characterised by the soft nuances of almond wood and the balsamic character of opopanax. A salty, woody base forms the foundation, with creamy sandalwood and sea fennel reminiscent of the rough vegetation of a coastal landscape. The eau de parfum spray thus evokes the image of a vegetal wave with both fruity and herbaceous accents. The creation is packaged in a minimalist, clear glass bottle with sharp edges that reveals the transparent liquid. A black, cylindrical cap and the characteristic round, black label with white lettering round off the overall aesthetic look. Aquatic-mineral fragrance character with herbal accents Top notes of rosewood leaves and carambola Salty-woody base with sandalwood and sea fennel (Criste Marine) Minimalist glass bottle with black label Part of the exclusive Numbered Collection

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Numbered Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 29.1 À L’Heure Des Catleyas 50 ml
listings.description: With the Eau de Parfum Spray 29.1 A L'Heure Des Cateleyas, Pierre Guillaume Paris presents a floral-fruity unisex fragrance that blends seamlessly into a variety of everyday situations. The fragrance comes in a simple, transparent glass bottle with a black cap that looks elegant on any shelf. Immediately after spraying, fresh citrus fruits give a clear fragrance experience. The eponymous cateleyas orchid then unfurls a floral aroma that creates a pleasant presence without being overpowering. The base note combines tonka bean, musk and the scent of warm sand. This blend creates a gentle, amber-like depth that lingers on the skin for a long time and reliably accompanies you throughout the day. As a unisex creation, the perfume adapts to individual preferences and is suitable for the office as well as for leisure time. Thanks to the balanced combination of fresh and warm elements, the fragrance in the 50 ml and 100 ml sizes offers versatile wearability for different occasions. Floral-fruity unisex fragrance for versatile everyday wear Citrus fruits provide a fresh opening for a clear fragrance experience Floral heart note with cateleyas orchid for a pleasant presence Warm base of tonka bean, musk and sand accords for an ambery depth Available in the practical sizes 50 ml and 100 ml

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris White Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Sunsuality 50 ml
listings.description: The Sunsuality Eau de Parfum Spray by Pierre Guillaume Paris evokes the carefree feeling of sun-kissed skin. As part of the White Collection, which is inspired by light and well-being, a citrus-fresh composition with a remarkably velvety texture unfolds. A striking kumquat-sandalwood accord characterises the fragrance and gives it a soft, sunny and slightly creamy radiance. The opening is lively and sparkling with notes of kumquat, lemon and a hint of ginger. This is followed by a delicate heart of lemon blossom, which gently fades into a base of creamy sandalwood and soft musk. Launched in 2019, this unisex fragrance from the French niche house leaves a fresh yet gentle impression. Fragrance: Citrusy, fresh, velvety Character: A sunny fragrance reminiscent of warm skin Centrepiece: A special accord of kumquat and sandalwood Category: Unisex fragrance as an eau de parfum

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris White Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Swim / SX 50 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Swim / SX from the White Collection by Pierre Guillaume Paris offers an olfactory snapshot of salty, sun-warmed skin after a dip in the sea. This complex composition opens with the gentle yet striking woody notes of rosewood, which immediately appeal to the senses. At the centre of the fragrance experience is a multi-faceted heart in which aquatic accords of algae and seaweed meet the mineral freshness of sea salt. This maritime bouquet is complemented by the exotic floral notes of ylang-ylang and a subtle nuance of Indian hemp, which lends the arrangement an unexpected depth. The base note provides a long-lasting finish, characterised by the warmth of okoume wood and the purity of white musk. This combination creates a fragrance that combines floral, fresh and solar elements with an animalistic undercurrent. The transparent glass bottle with its softly rounded edges and shiny silver cap visually picks up on the theme of light and well-being. A round, silver label with black lettering rounds off the aesthetic appearance and clearly categorises the fragrance in the House's elegant design language. Woody floral fragrance character with aquatic and solar accents Head note of rosewood meets a heart of sea salt, seaweed and ylang-ylang Warm base note with okoume wood and white musk Contains a special nuance of Indian hemp (cannabis) Transparent bottle in shadow design with silver details

listings.rawTitle: Eisenberg Les Secrets Eau de Parfum Spray SECRET N°I ROSE TALISMAN 30 ml
listings.description: The Eisenberg Les Secrets Secret I Rose Talisman Eau de Parfum Spray offers an olfactory experience thanks to its multi-layered composition of high-quality ingredients. First, a fruity top note unfolds, dominated by the sweet flavours of cassis and raspberry. These berry accords are complemented by a subtle hint of saffron, which adds an interesting spiciness to the opening. A lush floral bouquet then takes centre stage, with the rose as the eponymous protagonist. Jasmine and iris make an accompanying appearance, while cedarwood and patchouli give the floral heart an earthy and persistent structure. The fragrance profile is gently rounded off by a base of rosewood and sandalwood, which blends harmoniously with the creamy note of tonka bean. Visually, the bulbous bottle reflects the contents by combining warm orange and yellow tones with golden elements. A black ribbon on the neck of the bottle bears a filigree key, symbolising the hidden secret of the collection. This composition combines fresh fruitiness with floral elegance and a warm, woody foundation to create a whole full of character. Fruity opening with notes of cassis, raspberry and saffron Floral centrepiece of rose, jasmine and iris, accompanied by cedar wood Warm base note with sandalwood, rosewood and tonka bean High-quality bottle with decorative key ring

listings.rawTitle: Eisenberg Les Secrets Eau de Parfum Spray SECRET N°VI CUIR D'ORIENT 30 ml
listings.description: A fascinating olfactory secret is revealed in this eau de parfum spray from the exclusive Les Secrets collection by Eisenberg. Secret VI Cuir d'Orient is characterised by an artful combination of powerful leather accords with a surprising, fruity vibrancy. The opening initially presents itself with a spicy note of pepper and precious saffron, which harmoniously meets the fine sweetness of cassis and raspberry. A complex heart then unfolds at the centre of the composition, in which smoky incense and striking leather are surrounded by elegant floral nuances such as violet, rose and jasmine. The multi-layered fragrance experience is completed by a warm base of rosewood and sandalwood, which is given a gentle depth and persistence by amber, cist, praline and musk. The product also sets visual accents: The rounded, bulbous glass flacon provides a clear view of the soft orange-coloured liquid and bears the golden lettering "THE LATIN ORIENT" at the bottom. A golden key attached to the neck on a black ribbon serves as a visual symbol for the hidden facets of this creation. This fragrance is aimed at personalities who prefer an expressive yet refined signature and appreciate the skilful contrast between piquant spice and floral elegance. Characterful fragrance composition: a combination of dominant leather accords, smoky incense and fruity notes. Layered top notes: Contains flavours of cassis, raspberry, pepper and saffron. Floral heart: leather and incense are complemented by violet, rose and jasmine. Warm base: A foundation of rosewood, sandalwood, amber, praline and musk. Elegant design: bulbous glass bottle with decorative golden key and black ribbon.

listings.rawTitle: Eisenberg Les Secrets Eau de Parfum Spray SECRET N°III VOILE DE CHYPRE 30 ml
listings.description: EISENBERG Les Secrets Secret III Voile de Chypre is a composition based on the interplay of freshness and depth. The fragrance opens with a lively top note that combines sparkling bergamot, lemon and grapefruit with fruity accents of peach and rhubarb. A hint of pink pepper lends a subtle spiciness to the opening. A classic floral bouquet of jasmine, rose and violet unfolds in the heart, giving the eau de parfum its elegant centre. The base note anchors the creation with earthy and warm nuances. This is where patchouli, vetiver and oakmoss meet the gentle notes of musk and ambergris, which ensure a long-lasting and memorable character. The result is a balanced chypre fragrance that conveys a sophisticated and mysterious aura. The bottle itself emphasises this impression with its elegant design, gold-coloured cap and decorative key. Fragrance family: Chypre-floral Head notes: bergamot, lemon, grapefruit, peach, rhubarb, pink pepper Heart note: jasmine, rose, violet Base notes: patchouli, vetiver, oakmoss, musk, ambergris

listings.rawTitle: Eisenberg Les Secrets Eau de Parfum Spray SECRET N°IV RITUEL D'ORIENT 30 ml
listings.description: Powerful contrasts and a deep woody note characterise Secret IV Rituel d'Orient from the exclusive Les Secrets collection by Eisenberg. This complex fragrance composition opens with a direct freshness created by the sparkling, citrusy accords of bergamot and lemon in the top note. As the fragrance unfolds, a multi-layered heart reveals itself, in which the striking and precious aroma of eaglewood, also known as oud, meets the elegant, floral nuances of rose and jasmine. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a long-lasting and structured base that combines smoky guaiac wood and earthy patchouli with the gentle warmth of amber, vanilla and musk. Crafted in France, the fragrance is presented in an artfully designed glass bottle with an orange colour that is enhanced by a golden, spherical cap. A black ribbon on the neck of the bottle holds a decorative key with an antique look, while the gold lettering and stylised logo on the front complete the design. The formulation deliberately avoids ingredients such as parabens or silicones. Fragrance: Woody, spicy eau de parfum with a central note of oud. Top note: Fresh accents of bergamot and lemon. Base: Warm composition of patchouli, amber, vanilla and musk. Design: High-quality glass bottle with golden cap and decorative key detail. Properties: Made in France, without parabens and silicones.

listings.rawTitle: Eisenberg Les Secrets Eau de Parfum Spray SECRET N°VII VELOURS DE NUIT 50 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Secret VII Velours de Nuit from the Les Secrets line by Eisenberg presents itself as an olfactory homage to the mysterious atmosphere of the night. At the beginning, a top note full of character unfolds, in which striking leather accords meet the subtle spiciness of pink pepper and are complemented by delicate nuances of rose. At the centre of the composition is a harmonious interplay that combines earthy patchouli with the soft sweetness of vanilla. The fragrance experience is completed by a rich base note that combines warm amber accents with creamy sandalwood, labdanum and musk. This complex structure lends the fragrance a woody yet ambery signature. The bulbous, transparent glass flacon skilfully showcases the gold-coloured liquid inside and is crowned by an ornate cap. A golden sphere and a ring with geometric patterns in gold and white emphasise the value of the design. Both the carefully selected ingredients and the aesthetic presentation reflect the brand's philosophy. listings.rawTitle: Eisenberg L'Art du Parfum Émulsion Parfumée Corps LOVE AFFAIR 150 ml
listings.description: The L'Art du Parfum Love Affair Émulsion Parfumée Corps by EISENBERG envelops the skin with a delicate fragrance and a pleasant texture. This body emulsion is designed to support the feeling of suppleness on the skin. Its light formula is quickly absorbed and leaves the skin feeling soft and nourished without weighing it down. The fragrance composition is based on the eau de parfum of the same name and combines floral and woody notes to create a harmonious overall picture. Nuances of cassis and pink berries meet a heart of jasmine, rose and violet. A base of sandalwood, amber, heliotrope and musk rounds off the fragrance experience. The emulsion is suitable for daily use and can discreetly complement the presence of the perfume. A body emulsion with a light, refreshing texture. Supports a supple and soft skin feel. Leaves behind the floral, woody scent of Love Affair. Ideal to complement the matching eau de parfum. Suitable for daily use.

listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Molécule No.8 Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Behind the striking phrase ‘Wooden Chips’ on the black-and-gold label lies a unique artisanal feature that gives this fragrance its unmistakable identity. During the development process, perfumer Zarko Ahlmann Pavlov opted for traditional ageing in wooden barrels, which were additionally enriched with shavings of precious agarwood. This process gives the composition a complex, organic structure whilst retaining the Nordic transparency characteristic of the brand. The olfactory experience opens with a surprisingly light burst of zesty mandarin, which immediately conveys a crisp freshness. This blends seamlessly into the heart notes, where the intense Turkish rose absolute contributes a floral yet understated elegance. The rich base notes of earthy patchouli and the dark accents of black agarwood provide an intriguing contrast to this light opening. As a molecular Eau de Parfum, the creation is designed to form a symbiosis with one’s own body odour, allowing the fragrance to unfold uniquely on every skin type. Visually, the simple glass bottle with its golden cap and pale yellow liquid emphasises the premium character of this unisex fragrance. listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Cloud Collection Eau de Parfum Spray No. 3 100 ml
listings.description: Visually, the transparent bottle captivates with its striking green liquid, which immediately hints at the fragrance’s natural inspiration. Zarkoperfume Cloud Collection Eau de Parfum Spray No. 3 unfolds as a floral-woody-musky composition, often associated with the atmosphere of Nordic forests. The olfactory journey begins with a fruity interplay of pear, mandarin and red berries. This fresh opening flows seamlessly into a complex heart, where floral accords of rose, white magnolia and tulip meet a distinctive ozone note. The base notes of the fragrance are anchored in a warm structure of Madagascan vanilla, sandalwood and light woods, rounded off by an earthy musk nuance. Developed in Denmark, this Eau de Parfum is a balanced unisex creation that harmoniously combines fresh and warm elements. The minimalist design, featuring a black, cylindrical cap, emphasises the brand’s modern aesthetic and draws attention to the essence within. listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Cloud Collection Eau de Parfum Spray No. 2 100 ml
listings.description: The cool, silver-grey atmosphere of the Danish coast serves as a source of inspiration for this extraordinary Eau de Parfum. As a floral-aquatic composition, the fragrance combines fresh and deep elements to create a harmonious whole. The top note unfolds with the crisp aroma of lemongrass, which gently transitions into a floral heart of jasmine. A lasting base of seawater accords, white musk and woody notes anchors the olfactory experience. What makes the Cloud Collection No. 2 so special is the visible separation of its ingredients when at rest. Shaking the cylindrical glass bottle for four seconds causes the light blue phases – comprising high-quality oils, esters and water – to blend together. It is only through this mechanical process that the fragrance formula is fully activated and the liquid becomes temporarily cloudy. This visual effect is reminiscent of clouds over the sea. A simple, black cap crowns the minimalist design, which draws attention to the movement of the molecules within. Zarko Ahlmann Pavlov has thus created a fragrance that reflects Nordic nature. Floral-aquatic fragrance character with lemongrass and jasmine Base notes of seawater, white musk and woods Innovative two-phase technology (oil, esters and water) Fragrance molecules are activated by shaking the bottle Minimalist design with light blue liquid
