listings.rawTitle: Karl Lagerfeld Karl Eau de Toilette Spray Hamburg Alster 60 ml
listings.description: The "Karl Lagerfeld" brand continues to enjoy great popularity and constant demand. It stands for exclusive cosmetic products and fashion. Karl Otto Lagerfeld was born in Hamburg in 1933, but lived and worked mainly in Paris. Lagerfeld developed his own style, which still characterises the brand today. The career of the famous fashion designer developed continuously. It began in the mid-1950s, when Karl Lagerfeld started working for famous names in the fashion world. He also worked as a costume designer and photographer. Born in Hamburg, he had a formative influence on fashion. His clear signature was also expressed in the fragrances he created for men and women. His white powdered plait, Kent collar and sunglasses were his very personal trademarks. Karl Hamburg Alster - a striking eau de toilette spray Karl Hamburg Alster is the new eau de toilette spray for the style-conscious gentleman who knows what he wants. This fragrance contains a combination of mint and mandarin flavours in the top note. The heart note of Karl Hamburg Alster is restrained and elegant with the scent of freesia, sage and lavender. The base note is dark and mysterious with notes of moss, wood and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Karl Lagerfeld Les Parfums Matières Eau de Toilette Spray Bois d'Ambre 50 ml
listings.description: Each and every one of us probably has the desire to appear attractive and appealing to our fellow human beings. This is confirmed by a quote from Karl Lagerfeld: "I think perfume must always have something intensely sensual about it. You don't just wear a perfume to smell nice, but to feel beautiful and desirable." The jack-of-all-trades Lagerfeld has not only created exclusive fashion, but also exquisite fragrances for men and women. These include the men's fragrance Les Parfums Matières - Eau de Toilette Spray Bois d'Ambre . Les Parfums Matières has transformed this aromatic fragrance into a new perfume line. Full of charm, the sensual fragrance envelops its wearer. The Karl Lagerfeld Eau de Toilette Spray Bois d'Ambre combines a high-contrast potpourri of warm, powerful woody tones and fresh fruity notes. Orange, bergamot and plum harmonise in the top note. The heart note combines the fruity, sparkling aromas of clary sage, cedarwood and gardenia. The creamy base note is characterised by amber, tonka bean and gujac wood. They give the fragrance an intense finish. The Karl Lagerfeld Eau de Toilette Spray Bois d'Ambre by Les Parfums Matières is offered for sale in a 100 ml pump flacon. With its stylish and functional design, the bottle is sure to suit the tastes of most men.

listings.rawTitle: Karl Lagerfeld Les Parfums Matières Eau de Parfum Spray Fleur de Thé 50 ml
listings.description: With the Les Parfums Matières line, Karl Lagerfeld has dedicated himself to reinterpreting the essential fragrance notes of haute parfumerie. Fleur de Thé Eau de Parfum Spray focuses on a harmonious combination of citrus freshness and floral elements. The opening is sparkling with an interplay of mandarin, lemon and neroli. These bright nuances lead into a heart characterised by the eponymous note of green tea. The central tea accord is complemented by floral facets of Sambac jasmine and camellia blossom, which lend the composition an elegant depth. The base note forms a gentle contrast to the initial freshness, with light woods, musk and amber providing a warm finish. Visually, the transparent glass bottle with its turquoise-coloured liquid underlines the clear character of the fragrance. The design remains minimalist and timeless. listings.rawTitle: Karl Lagerfeld Karl Eau de Toilette Spray Vienna Opéra 60 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the city of Vienna, Karl Lagerfeld presents a charming men's fragrance with woody and spicy notes . The potpourri from the Karl collection invites you to take a trip to the Vienna Opera House, which is exactly why it bears this name: Vienna Opéra! The eau de toilette spray entices you to take a sensual break from everyday life, even on occasions other than an event at the theatre. Opera feelings like in Vienna Let fragrances by Karl Lagerfeld whisk you away to distant worlds; this time to the vibrant capital of Austria. Vienna is characterised by pure elegance and artistic flair . The Vienna Opéra fragrance by Karl Lagerfeld skilfully captures both. The fragrance from the Karl collection opens with a mix of fruity grapefruit, spicy basil and black pepper that tickles the nose. The seductive art of the men's fragrance then culminates in the heart note of gentle sage, garnished with lavender and a hint of apple. In the base, warm scents such as vetiver, sandalwood and cedarwood bring you back to the here and now and provide a classic finish to the Vienna Opéra Eau de Toilette Spray. Become a star in your life with just a few spritzes of the eau de toilette spray!

listings.rawTitle: Karl Lagerfeld Les Parfums Matières Eau de Parfum Spray Fleur de Pivoine 50 ml
listings.description: As part of the Les Parfums Matières collection, Karl Lagerfeld interprets the peony as the central element of a floral-fruity composition with Fleur de Pivoine. The Eau de Parfum Spray opens with a clear top note that combines the sparkling freshness of mandarin with the fine acidity of redcurrant and green accords. This invigorating start flows smoothly into a velvety heart that focuses on the eponymous blossom. A bouquet of peony, jasmine and lily of the valley creates a delicate, floral depth that always remains transparent and light. To give the fragrance stability and warmth, a combination of white cedar and amber was chosen for the base, which gently rounds off and grounds the floral notes. The design of the bottle also reflects the characteristics of the fragrance: The glass is translucent, revealing the pink liquid inside, while the transparent cap features a colour-coordinated insert. Packaged in a white case with a leather look, the product emphasises a modern, purist aesthetic that focuses on the essentials. Fragrance family: Floral-fruity with an accentuated peony note Top note: Combination of mandarin, redcurrant and green notes Heart note: Floral bouquet of peony, jasmine and lily of the valley Base note: Warm finish with white cedar and amber Design: Translucent bottle with pink-coloured liquid and matching lid insert

listings.description: The Green Tea Eau Parfumée Scent Spray by Elizabeth Arden is a composition that has been appreciated for its refreshing and light nature since its launch in 1999. Subtle accents of fennel, clove and celery spices lend the fragrance an interesting complexity. The finish is gentle and persistent with a base of warm amber, earthy oakmoss and a subtle hint of musk. A light and sparkling fragrance for women. listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The White Tea Eau de Parfum by Elizabeth Arden is a finely crafted composition that combines floral freshness with woody warmth. It opens with sparkling notes of Italian mandarin and clary sage, which are given a clear lightness by a maritime touch. At the heart of the creation is a present white tea accord that blends harmoniously with the richness of mate absolute, delicate jasmine petals and a subtle rose water. The base of sun-dried tonka bean, a trio of musks and warm amberwood gives the fragrance a gentle depth and ensures a long-lasting, pleasant finish. Developed using VivaScentz™ technology, the individual notes are brought into a particularly balanced relationship. With its elegant and unobtrusive character, this fragrance proves to be a versatile companion for a wide variety of occasions. The minimalist, linear design of the bottle with its satin finish and gold-coloured cap emphasises the pure character of the perfume. This eau de toilette opens with a composition of fresh notes of bergamot, melon and peach. A floral bouquet unfolds in the heart, harmoniously combining jasmine and cyclamen. The base rounds off the fragrance experience with warm accords of sandalwood and moss, giving it a gentle depth. The result is a balanced, floral-fruity fragrance that feels pleasant on the skin and supports a positive aura. The simple, transparent bottle with the engraved sunflower reflects the clear and carefree character of the fragrance. Sunflowers is a timeless companion for everyday wear. Fragrance family: Floral-fruity Head note: bergamot, melon, peach Heart note: jasmine, cyclamen Base note: sandalwood, moss

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The White Tea Eau de Toilette Spray by Elizabeth Arden is a woody-floral composition that is characterised by its clear yet multi-layered elegance. It opens with an invigorating blend of sparkling Italian mandarin and the herbal essence of clary sage. A sensual sea breeze accord and the green note of Japanese white fern give the top note a special freshness. At the heart of the fragrance, the eponymous white tea extract unfolds, accompanied by mate absolute from Paraguay and a graceful accord of white iris. Facets of Turkish rose and the warm, nutty nuance of paradise nut add a subtle depth. The base note anchors the composition with a warm and velvety melange. Madras wood, ambrette seed and Venezuelan tonka bean combine with Ambermax® and a harmonious musk triad to create a long-lasting finish. Fragrance direction: woody-floral Head note: Italian mandarin and sea breeze accord Heart note: White tea extract and white iris Base: Warm wood, musk and amber notes

listings.description: A composition that evokes the carefree lightness of a sunny day. The White Tea Eau Fraiche Eau de Toilette Spray by Elizabeth Arden is a fresh interpretation of the classic White Tea fragrance. listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Red Door Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Since its launch in 1989, Red Door by Elizabeth Arden has been a timeless fragrance classic that epitomises elegance and sensuality. The composition is an opulent bouquet made up of a variety of rare and precious flowers. It opens with a fruity-floral blend of peach, plum and aniseed, accompanied by delicate violets, rose and orange blossom. At the heart of the fragrance, the full floral splendour unfolds with notes of freesia, jasmine, lily of the valley, orchid and ylang-ylang, rounded off with a hint of honey. The base note provides a long-lasting and warm finish, in which sandalwood, cedar and vetiver meet the soft nuances of musk, amber and oakmoss. This complex and expressive fragrance is particularly suitable for the cooler seasons and emphasises the feminine charisma of its wearer. A timelessly elegant fragrance classic since 1989 Opulent, floral composition with a heart note of rare flowers Warm and long-lasting finish with sandalwood, musk and honey Especially suitable for the cooler months of the year

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Eternal Aura Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Elizabeth Arden eternal AURA Eau de Parfum Spray adds a long-lasting fragrance composition to your daily routine. The transparent glass bottle with its golden, openwork cap and pale pink liquid is a stylish eye-catcher. The high fragrance concentration of the eau de parfum offers an intense fragrance experience. As a result, the aroma remains present for many hours and reliably accompanies everyday life. The integrated spray head enables fine, even distribution on the skin or clothing. The perfume adapts to different situations and is suitable for the normal working day as well as for evening events. High fragrance concentration for a long-lasting fragrance experience Fine spray head for even and easy distribution Time-saving application thanks to a few, targeted sprays Versatile use for everyday life and evening occasions

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau de Toilette Spray Gingerlily 30 ml
listings.description: The Elizabeth Arden White Tea Ginger Lily Eau de Toilette Spray combines floral warmth with a spicy dynamic to create a multi-layered composition. The top note opens with an invigorating blend of sparkling bitter orange, bergamot and mandarin, which is complemented by the subtle nuances of neroli. At the centre of the creation is the eponymous ginger lily blossom, which, together with white ginger root and delicate violet leaves, develops a fresh yet floral character. These lively accords merge gently into a harmonious base characterised by white cedarwood, tonka bean and mate absolute. Musk lends the fragrance profile an earthy depth and provides a warm finish. The fragrance is presented in an elegant, rectangular glass bottle whose clean lines are emphasised by a white, square cap and a golden ring. The red lettering "GINGER LILY" on the front adds a visual accent to the transparent glass. Due to its concentration as an eau de toilette, the spray is ideal for everyday use as it has a pleasant presence without being heavy. The formulation makes partial use of modern approaches and utilises ingredients that enable a balanced fragrance experience. Customised fragrances can also be created by layering the spray with other fragrances from the White Tea collection as desired. Fragrance family: Warm spicy and floral notes with musky accents. Main ingredients: Bitter orange, ginger lily blossom, white cedarwood and tonka bean. Design: Transparent, rectangular glass bottle with white cap and gold ring. Application: Suitable as a light eau de toilette for everyday wear and can be combined with other fragrances in the collection.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau de Toilette Spray Wild Rose 30 ml
listings.description: The name Elizabeth Arden stands for high-quality and luxurious cosmetics that are popular all over the world. Her name was Florence Nightingale Graham and she was the daughter of Scottish-English immigrants. She spent her youth in poor circumstances in the Canadian province of Ontario. She moved to New York in 1908 and opened her beauty parlour on Fifth Avenue with a business partner in 1910, where she became very successful. Initially she sold toners and creams, which she soon had created by the company's own chemists. She developed her own range of products. As a result, her customer base and the popularity of her products continued to grow. After Elizabeth Arden's death in 1966, the company was initially sold to several groups. Since 2003, the Elizabeth Arden Group has belonged to FFI Fragrances, a US company that now operates under the name Elizabeth Arden Inc. The White Tea Wild Rose fragrance is available as an eau de toilette spray The White Tea Wild Rose eau de toilette spray is available in a practical fragrance diffuser. Enjoy these wonderful scents of white tea and wild rose. A subtle note of madras wood, ambrette seed absolute and musk lend the White Tea Wild Rose Eau de Toilette Spray its subtle sensuality. Let this incredibly feminine fragrance work its magic on your senses.

The fragrance character is perceived as elegant and intense without being too sweet. An amber-floral fragrance with an intense musky heart. listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez NARCISO Eau de Parfum Spray Poudrée 30 ml
listings.description: The NARCISOPoudrée Eau de Parfum Spray by Narciso Rodriguez is a tribute to feminine elegance. Created in 2016 by perfumer Aurelien Guichard, the composition opens with a delicate bouquet of Bulgarian rose, Sambac jasmine and orange blossom. The characteristic musk unfolds at the heart of the fragrance, giving the perfume its unmistakable warmth and depth. This central note is supported by a base of woody accents such as vetiver and cedar, which is subtly complemented by coumarin and patchouli. The interplay of these elements creates a soft, powdery fragrance that creates a soft yet sophisticated aura. As part of the iconic NARCISO collection, the perfume has a lasting, finely tuned presence. The minimalist design of the bottle emphasises the timeless character of the creation with its clean lines. Powdery-floral fragrance character with musk at the heart. Composition of Bulgarian rose, jasmine, vetiver and cedar. A soft, feminine fragrance that epitomises sensual elegance. Presented in a minimalist bottle with clean lines.

listings.description: The for her Eau de Parfum Spray by Narciso Rodriguez is an elegant fragrance composition that unfolds around a warm heart of musk. As a more intense interpretation of the original eau de toilette, this fragrance was created in 2004 by the renowned perfumers Christine Nagel and Francis Kurkdjian. The central musky note is caressed by delicate floral accents of rose and the fruity sweetness of peach. This harmonious combination lends the perfume a graceful lightness and feminine radiance. In the base, warm notes of amber and earthy patchouli ensure a long-lasting depth and unforgettable sillage. The fragrance family can be described as floral, with the characteristic musky accord always taking centre stage and giving the perfume its modern yet timeless signature. A floral fragrance with a central, warm musk accord. Combines floral notes of rose with peach, amber and patchouli. A more intense composition than the original eau de toilette. Created by perfumers Christine Nagel and Francis Kurkdjian.

The fragrance opens with a fresh combination of sparkling bergamot, delicate freesia and orange blossom, which gently fades into a floral heart. Here, a bouquet of rose and white jasmine unfolds, elegantly enveloped by the characteristic softness of musk. The base note, which combines warm cedarwood, cashmere and benzoin, ensures a long-lasting and sensual depth. With around 85% of ingredients of natural origin, the result is an eau de parfum that leaves an unforgettable aura. A luminous, floral-woody fragrance Composition of fresh bergamot, floral rose and warm cedarwood Inspired by the inner radiance and reflection of a crystal Consists of around 85% ingredients of natural origin

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez for him Eau de Parfum Spray Intense Musc Santal 50 ml
listings.description: The Narciso Rodriguez for him Eau de Parfum Spray Intense Musc Santal presents an olfactory interpretation of modern contrasts in which freshness meets depth. The composition opens with a clear accord of juniper, sage and green cardamom, which is given an invigorating facet by Italian bergamot. The characteristic heart of musk unfolds at the centre of the fragrance, which is nuanced by three different variants and accompanied by Virginian cedarwood and labdanum. This heart note flows smoothly into a warm base that combines creamy sandalwood with earthy patchouli and benzoin. The transparent glass bottle allows a view of the liquid inside and is topped with a black cap in a textured, matt wood look, which visually picks up on the woody notes of the perfume. Florian Gallo created this fragrance as a balancing act between cool, aromatic elements and a warm, intense base structure. Fragrance: Musky-spicy-woody-floral with creamy and fresh accents. Head note: An aromatic blend of juniper, sage, green cardamom and bergamot. Heart note: An intense musk accord, complemented by virgin cedarwood and labdanum. Base note: Warm finish with sandalwood, patchouli and benzoin. Design: Transparent glass bottle with a matt wood-effect cap.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez all of me Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The eau de parfum spray all of me by Narciso Rodriguez is a modern, floral fragrance composition from the year 2023. It opens with a delicate magnolia essence that transitions into a multi-faceted heart of rose centifolia, geranium bourbon and white peony. Powdery black iris and tuberose round off the floral bouquet. A unique blend of six different musky notes and warm sandalwood unfolds in the base, giving the fragrance a sensual yet elegant aura. The result is a floral, creamy fragrance that is perceived as subtle and unobtrusive and is suitable as a daytime companion all year round. The composition, which consists of 88% ingredients of natural origin, is presented in a simple, matt gold-coloured bottle. A multi-faceted, creamy floral fragrance for women . Composition of magnolia, rose, geranium, musk and sandalwood. Long-lasting eau de parfum, ideal for everyday wear. Consists of 88% ingredients of natural origin.

listings.description: The For Him Vetiver Musc Eau de Toilette Spray by Narciso Rodriguez is a woody, aromatic fragrance creation. It begins with an invigorating top note, in which the spicy facets of juniper, cardamom and nutmeg interact and create a striking first impression. The heart of the fragrance then unfolds, characterised by the unmistakable musk note. This central component is harmoniously surrounded by bourbon geranium, lavender and the nuances of red algae and incense, which lend the fragrance a special complexity. The base note rounds off the olfactory experience. Here, earthy vetiver notes combine with warm patchouli and clear cedarwood to create a harmonious finish. The vegan formulation of the eau de toilette is presented in a bottle with a minimalist and modern design that emphasises the brand's aesthetics. A fragrance from the woody-aromatic fragrance family. Composition of cardamom, characteristic musk and earthy vetiver. The product is available as an eau de toilette. It has a vegan formulation.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez for him Parfum Bleu Noir 50 ml
listings.description: Narciso Rodriguez for him Bleu Noir perfume is a composition that exudes a mysterious and intense aura. Created by master perfumer Sonia Constant, a multi-layered fragrance experience unfolds. It opens with an invigorating blend of cardamom, cypress, bergamot and mandarin. In the heart of the composition, the powdery elegance of iris is combined with musk and a hint of suede, giving the fragrance a special depth. The base is long-lasting and striking, characterised by notes such as tonka bean, sandalwood, leather, vetiver and Atlas cedar. As a perfume version, this fragrance stands out with its intense, leathery facets and has a cooler, smokier base than other variants in the line. The design of the bottle, with its translucent blue glass and matte navy blue cap, visually captures the elegant nature of the fragrance. listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez all of me Eau de Parfum Spray Floral 30 ml
listings.description: The all of me Floral Eau de Parfum Spray by Narciso Rodriguez is an intensely floral and warm composition and a new interpretation of the well-known "all of me" signature. The fragrance initially unfolds with a fresh top note of a tangy lychee accord. At the heart of the creation is a luminous bouquet that combines the essences of geranium bourbon with delicate floral blossoms. An amber-musk heart, complemented by the warmth of guaiac wood essence, provides a sensual and long-lasting base. Developed by perfumers Dora Baghriche and Daphné Bugey, this fragrance consists of 90% ingredients of natural origin and is also vegan-certified. The design of the bottle picks up on the floral theme: A pink colour gradient from matt to transparent reveals the peach-coloured perfume inside. The bottle itself is made from 15% recycled glass. listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK Everyone Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Calvin Klein CK Everyone Eau de Parfum Spray is a modern and multi-faceted fragrance composition that deliberately avoids gender-specific categorisation and is designed for everyone. listings.description: Calvin Klein Eternity for Men fragrance is an intense and multi-faceted interpretation of the fougère fragrance family with gourmand accents. listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Intense Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Eternity Intense Eau de Parfum Spray by Calvin Klein is a modern homage to the iconic original fragrance CK Eternity from 1988. The composition is inspired by the romantic atmosphere of an encounter at sunset and unfolds an intense floral-spicy character. It opens with a striking top note of Sichuan pepper, which arouses curiosity about the heart of the fragrance. A bouquet of precious Turkish rose absolute and feminine Arabian jasmine absolute unfolds there. The base note, which combines warm sandalwood with cashmeran, ensures a long-lasting and sensual depth. The vegan formula is based on the use of sustainably sourced and partially upcycled ingredients. We recommend spraying the fragrance onto warm areas of skin such as the wrists or neck for ideal fragrance development. The well-known, iconic bottle underlines the fragrance character with its feminine colouring in a delicate nude-pink. Fragrance family: floral-spicy Fragrance character: Intense and sensual Heart notes: Turkish rose absolute and Arabian jasmine absolute Special feature: Vegan formulation with sustainably sourced ingredients

This composition is bottled in a distinctive, faceted glass bottle in the shape of a garnet, whose pale pink colour elegantly reflects the contents. Its multi-layered nature makes Flowerbomb a suitable companion for everyday wear as well as for special occasions. listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Spicebomb Eau de Toilette Spray by Viktor & Rolf is a composition based on an exciting interplay of contrasts. Created in 2012 by perfumer Olivier Polge, the fragrance unfolds with a fresh top note of bergamot and grapefruit, which is given a special vibrancy by the accents of pink pepper and elemi. At the heart of the composition, the warmth of cinnamon and saffron meets the intensity of red pepper. This spicy heart note transitions into a base of notes of vetiver, tobacco and white leather, which give the fragrance its deep and masculine character. The eau de toilette is particularly suitable for the cooler seasons and the evening. The experience is rounded off by the iconic bottle in the shape of a hand grenade, which visually emphasises the nature of the fragrance. Fragrance direction: Spicy-woody Character: Lively, powerful and masculine Fragrance notes: A composition of citrus fruits, intense spices and a base of tobacco and leather Occasion: Ideal for the cooler months and for evening occasions

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Eau de Parfum Spray Nightvision 50 ml
listings.description: The Spicebomb Nightvision Eau de Parfum Spray by Viktor & Rolf is an intense and multi-faceted fragrance composition that was launched in 2020. The fragrance opens with an exciting top note in which the freshness of grapefruit, lemon and green apple meets an ensemble of warm spices such as cardamom, clove and nutmeg. A hint of chilli provides an unexpected accent. At the heart, an aromatic depth unfolds with notes of lavender, rosemary, clary sage and coriander, which are given a special nuance by mastic resin. The base gives the fragrance its dark and long-lasting character. Here, woody and resinous accords of cedarwood, fir balsam and incense merge with the warmth of Peru balsam and patchouli to create an elegant and masculine signature. This composition differs fundamentally from the eau de toilette of the same name and is particularly recommended for the evening and the colder months of the year. An intense fragrance with an elegant, dark and mysterious character. A complex fragrance pyramid of fresh, spicy, aromatic and woody-resinous notes. The composition differs significantly from Spicebomb Nightvision Eau de Toilette. Ideal for the evening hours and the cooler months of the year.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum Spray Ruby Orchid 30 ml
listings.description: The Flowerbomb Ruby Orchid Eau de Parfum Spray by Viktor & Rolf is a composition that has been enriching the world of fragrances since 2021. The fragrance unfolds with a fruity top note of vine peach and freesia, which creates a lively opening. At the heart of the creation is a floral bouquet that combines jasmine with the eponymous ruby orchid. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a warm and sweet base note consisting of red vanilla pod and fine bourbon vanilla. This combination of floral, fruity and gourmand elements gives the perfume an intense and sensual character. For a long-lasting presence, the spray can be applied from a short distance to warm areas of skin such as the inside of the wrists or behind the ears. Flowerbomb Ruby Orchid is a fragrance for anyone who appreciates an expressive composition. Sensual, floral-fruity fragrance with gourmand notes. Composition of vine peach, ruby orchid and bourbon vanilla. An intense eau de parfum from 2021. It is particularly suitable for spring and daytime wear.

listings.rawTitle: Viktor & Rolf Flowerbomb Eau de Parfum Spray Tiger Lily 100 ml
listings.description: The Flowerbomb Tiger Lily Eau de Parfum Spray by Viktor & Rolf, released in 2023, is a floral-fruity composition for women that transports you to a sunny, exotic location. The fragrance opens with a creamy accord of coconut milk, whose gentle sweetness is balanced by the tangy freshness of bergamot. This inviting top note transitions into an opulent floral heart. The eponymous tiger lily takes centre stage here, lending the fragrance a striking, wild facet and accompanied by delicate jasmine and freesia. This bouquet creates a multi-layered floral depth. The composition finds its warm conclusion in the base note. A juicy mango accord provides a fruity sweetness that blends harmoniously with the resinous warmth of benzoin. The overall result is a sunny and warm fragrance with an unmistakable solar character. Fragrance family: Floral, Fruity, Solar Head note: coconut milk, bergamot Heart note: tiger lily, jasmine, freesia Base note: mango, benzoin Fragrance character: Warm, sunny, exotic

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Intuition Eau de Parfum Spray 10 ml
listings.description: With Intuition Eau de Parfum Spray, Aramis presents a modern evolution of the traditional art of fragrance, which is technically categorised as Woody Green Neo-Fougère. Launched in 2025, this creation skilfully combines green accents with a woody depth and stands for contemporary elegance. The olfactory opening is characterised by a crisp grapefruit note that lends the fragrance an immediate, citrusy clarity. Aromatic lavender then unfolds at the centre of the composition, creating a harmonious link to the more complex base notes as a classic element. The foundation of earthy vetiver and the special Cuirissima LXR, an exclusive accord that creates a warm and leathery signature, is particularly influential for the character of the perfume. Accompanying nuances of patchouli, amber and orris round off the fragrance experience and lend it a subtle persistence. Visually, the purity of the fragrance is reflected in a slim, cylindrical bottle made of transparent glass, which reveals the clear liquid. A silver cap and vertical lettering on the front complete the minimalist design. The projection of the eau de parfum changes from an initial freshness to a subtle, body-hugging warmth as it is worn. Fragrance family: Woody Green Neo-Fougère with woody and green facets. Top notes of tangy grapefruit and heart notes with aromatic lavender. Base note with earthy vetiver and exclusive Cuirissima LXR leather accord. Minimalist, cylindrical glass bottle with silver cap. Evolution from citrusy freshness to warm, leathery depth.

The olfactory opening is characterised by a crisp grapefruit note that lends the fragrance an immediate, citrusy clarity. Aromatic lavender then unfolds at the centre of the composition, creating a harmonious link to the more complex base notes as a classic element. The foundation of earthy vetiver and the special Cuirissima LXR, an exclusive accord that creates a warm and leathery signature, is particularly influential for the character of the perfume. Accompanying nuances of patchouli, amber and orris round off the fragrance experience and lend it a subtle persistence. Visually, the purity of the fragrance is reflected in a slim, cylindrical bottle made of transparent glass, which reveals the clear liquid. A silver cap and vertical lettering on the front complete the minimalist design. The projection of the eau de parfum changes from an initial freshness to a subtle, body-hugging warmth as it is worn. Fragrance family: Woody Green Neo-Fougère with woody and green facets. Top notes of tangy grapefruit and heart notes with aromatic lavender. Base note with earthy vetiver and exclusive Cuirissima LXR leather accord. Minimalist, cylindrical glass bottle with silver cap. Evolution from citrusy freshness to warm, leathery depth.

listings.rawTitle: Jean-Charles Brosseau Ombre Rose Parfum Flakon 15 ml
listings.description: This classic fragrance envelops its wearer in a timeless aura and is reminiscent of the elegant art of perfumery in 1981. The composition begins with a harmonious blend of rosewood and peach, refined with nuances of honey and ylang-ylang. At the centre is a powdery bouquet that combines iris, lily of the valley and rose to create an unmistakable character. Base notes such as sandalwood, vanilla and musk ensure a warm and lasting finish. Unlike modern spray bottles, this Parfum Splash uses a traditional application method. The dark-coloured, octagonal bottle is decorated with botanical relief patterns and has an extra slim neck under the round cap. This enables the liquid to be dabbed onto the pulse points, allowing the intensity to be customised and avoiding a fine mist. Classic fragrance composition from 1981 with powdery and floral notes Contains accords of rose, iris, vanilla, sandalwood and musk Parfum Splash format for traditional application without atomiser Enables precise dabbing and dosing on the skin Decorative, octagonal bottle with botanical relief structures

listings.description: Max Mara Le Parfum Eau de Parfum (35 ml) offers a woody-floral fragrance composition for everyday use. The vegan formulation and the predominantly recyclable packaging also support a conscious lifestyle. listings.rawTitle: Aramis Intuition Eau de Parfum Intense Spray 10 ml
listings.description: With its expressive fragrance composition, Aramis Intuition Intense Eau de Parfum Spray emphasises a confident presence in everyday business life as well as at evening events. The fragrance is presented in an elegant, deep-blue glass bottle with a contrasting silver cap. Immediately after spraying, the combination of juniper berry and black pepper imparts a spicy freshness that can create a pleasantly invigorating sensation. As the fragrance develops, lavender and osmanthus reveal their aromatic facets, lending the composition a harmonious depth. This intense formulation offers a long-lasting fragrance experience, meaning that reapplication during the day is often unnecessary. The base notes of oakwood, vanilla and the characteristic Aramis leather essence round off the profile and leave a warm, memorable impression. The fine spray nozzle allows the perfume to be dispensed precisely and sprayed evenly. Expressive fragrance composition with spicy, floral and woody notes Long-lasting fragrance experience thanks to the intense Eau de Parfum formulation A practical atomiser allows for precise and fine application Versatile enough for everyday wear as well as special occasions

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Wanted Perfume Spray The Most Wanted 50 ml
listings.description: Azzaro Wanted The Most Wanted Le Parfum unfolds as a profound fougère-amber composition characterised by spicy, woody and sweet notes. It opens with the powerful spiciness of red ginger, which immediately creates a present and fiery first impression. At the heart of the fragrance creation are complex, smoky woody notes that lend the perfume a dark and magnetic depth. The base is characterised by warm bourbon vanilla, which adds a gentle, balsamic sweetness and harmoniously rounds off the composition. The result is a fragrance with a charismatic and self-confident aura. The bottle picks up on this character: In an elegant, matt-glossy black, it retains the iconic cylindrical shape of the Wanted range. The fragrance is characterised by good longevity and develops into a pleasant, close-to-the-skin presence over hours. listings.description: Bvlgari Omnia Crystalline envelops you gently like a crystal with enchanting notes. The distinctive blend of fruity top notes and intense floral heart notes leaves you with a pleasant feeling of freshness and femininity right from the start. The eau de toilette spray also scores as a timeless perfume for your collection, as the flacon, typical of Bvlgari, immediately catches the eye and yet does not appear obtrusive with its monochrome design. Exotic freshness and vibrant diversity The top note of Omnia Crystalline is characterised by naschi fruit, an exotic, sweet all-rounder that immediately puts you in a good mood and provides refreshing motivation in everyday life. listings.description: This unisex fragrance, Eau de Toilette Spray Concentrée, from the house of Cartier has a sense of clarity, freshness and vitality with a scent that is as uncomplicated as the look of the flaçon. A stylised water droplet is worked into the base of the flaçon giving the perfume additional aesthetic appeal. It has produced a simple, straightforward and puristic perfume, from which it acquires its unmistakable character and its strength.

At the heart of the creation is a harmonious bouquet of rose centifolia, jasmine from Grasse and gardenia, which is given a special sophistication by ylang-ylang and cloves. The fragrance is presented in an elegantly curved glass bottle with a cap crowned by two embracing doves - a timeless symbol of peace and love. With its elegant and feminine aura, L'Air du Temps is a versatile companion for any occasion. A timeless, floral-spicy fragrance classic. Composition of carnation, rose, jasmine and sandalwood. Elegant bottle with dove stopper as a symbol of peace. Character: feminine, elegant and long-lasting.

listings.rawTitle: Nina Ricci Nina Eau de Parfum Spray Illusion 50 ml
listings.description: Spices, citrus fruits, sweet fruits and patchouli The Illusion Eau de Parfum Spray Nina by Nina Ricci impresses with its successful coordination in the fragrance pyramid. It is available at parfumdreams.de in 30 ml, 50 ml and 80 ml pump bottles. With an attached blossom and green cord bow on the front, the bottles attract attention as soon as you look at them. The Illusion Eau de Parfum Spray Nina by Nina Ricci is a perfume that inspires many modern women and many men. On the market since 2024 and as an interesting perfume as popular as tried-and-tested products. The effect of spices in combination with fruits and patchouli! Fragrance pyramid harmonises perfectly with the illusion The Illusion Eau de Parfum Spray proves just how important a well-harmonised fragrance pyramid is for the success of a perfume. The top note opens with fresh citrus scents and light spices. Sweet raspberry and fruity orange clearly define the heart note, while vanilla and patchouli create a pleasant, slightly exotic finish. Sesqui terpenes are responsible for relaxation and stimulation. The Nina Spray from Nina Ricci owes its spiritual effect to the ideal blend of natural ingredients. When the right components complement each other perfectly, as they do here, the result is fantastic!

listings.description: The Moschino Toy 2 Eau de Parfum Spray, created by perfumers Alberto Morillas and Fabrice Pellegrin, was launched in 2018. This fragrance for women belongs to the floral-woody musk family and has a multi-layered character. It opens with a lively top note of juicy mandarin and crisp Granny Smith apple, accompanied by the floral elegance of magnolia. The Eau de Parfum is presented in a distinctive bottle that echoes the iconic shape of a teddy bear. listings.rawTitle: Moschino Toy Boy Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Moschino’s Toy Boy Eau de Parfum Spray is a fragrance full of contrasts and playful elegance. Created by perfumer Yann Vasnier, this composition belongs to the spicy-woody fragrance family and surprises with floral and fruity notes. The opening unfolds with a lively blend of Italian bergamot, pear and the subtle heat of pink pepper and Indonesian nutmeg. This is followed by the heart note, in which a bouquet of magnolia, rose absolute and flax blossom blends with the spicy warmth of clove. The base note leaves a lasting impression, creating a warm, earthy depth with Haitian vetiver, sandalwood and Ambermax®. The fragrance’s distinctive character is also reflected in the bottle’s design: a black teddy bear that serves as an ironic statement, emphasising the dynamic side of the creation. listings.description: Inspired by Swedish nature and culture, Kropp & Själ by Pana Dora Sweden unfolds as a multi-layered eau de parfum. The composition created by Ibrahim Al-Zouabi begins with a lively and spicy top note in which ginger, cardamom and a hint of saffron meet the tangy freshness of bergamot and blood orange. At the heart of the fragrance, a floral bouquet of jasmine and orange blossom unfolds, which gains depth through the accents of Spanish broom, amber, patchouli and iris. The base note provides a warm finish, harmoniously combining woody components such as balsam spruce and cedar with the gentle sweetness of vanilla, rounded off with amber and musk. The olfactory concept is visually reflected in the bottle, whose artfully designed lid is in the shape of a stag's head - a tribute to the Swedish heraldic animal. Unisex eau de parfum with a spicy, gourmand fragrance character. Layered composition of citrus, floral and warm woody notes. Inspired by the nature and culture of Sweden. Presented in a bottle with an ornate cap in the shape of a stag's head.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Emanuele Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Emanuele is a glamorous eau de parfum spray from fragrance house Pana Dora Sweden. Launched in 2024, the unisex niche perfume is an exciting creation by Swedish-Syrian perfumer Ibrahim Al Zouabi , the founder of the exclusive label. The famous marble corridors of the Milan Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II inspired him to create this sophisticated floral-oriental composition. An exceptionally wide range of precious notes and aromas capture the breathtaking beauty and timeless elegance of Milan's landmark with olfactory accords. The perfume is presented in a beautiful crystal bottle adorned with the golden head of a Swedish stag. A magnificent rose garden with a mosaic of delicate flowers The eau de parfum spray by Pana Dora Sweden opens with floral fireworks , reminiscent of the wonderful mosaics in the Galleria. Accents of peony, tuberose, Bulgarian and Turkish rose are gently framed by notes of delicate narcissus, sparkling Sicilian bergamot, warmly aromatic nutmeg and polygonum, the knotweed. The heart note of Emanuele picks up on the floral theme with an accord of dewy lily of the valley and petalia. Deliciously sweet vanilla intensifies the fragrance experience. Oriental accents bring the perfume by Pana Dora Sweden to an elegant close. Nuances of cashmeran, Haitian vetiver, papyrus and almond are joined by a hint of incense.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Orchestra Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Orchestra Eau de Parfum Spray by Pana Dora Sweden is a complex fragrance composition that harmoniously combines its notes. The opening opens with a spicy freshness of nutmeg and bergamot, which meets the fruity sweetness of white peach and davana. A subtle hint of soft suede gives the top note a special texture. In the heart of the creation, an aromatic interplay of rosemary, earthy vetiver and a striking leather accord unfolds, giving the fragrance depth and character. The base rounds off the experience with a warm and long-lasting fond. This is where precious agarwood (oud) and a pinch of cardamom meet the gentle warmth of vanilla and white musk. This unisex fragrance from the Swedish brand Pana Dora, founded in 2019, conveys a sense of elegance and is ideal for the cooler months or special evening occasions. Layered fragrance with spicy and woody notes Composition of nutmeg, leather, agarwood (oud) and vanilla Designed as a unisex fragrance for different occasions Creation of the Swedish brand Pana Dora

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden XVI Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Pana Dora Sweden XVI Eau de Parfum Spray envelops you in an elegant fragrance that is also pleasantly fresh and natural thanks to its green notes. A revitalising unisex fragrance with exotic patchouli and fresh bergamot When creating the Pana Dora Sweden XVI fragrance, the master perfumer of Pana Dora Sweden, Ibrahim Al Zouabi, was inspired by Drottningholm Palace in Stockholm, which was built in the 17th century. The palace exudes grace, but also appears cool and elegant thanks to its marble columns. The XVI Eau de Parfum Spray has an elegant, oriental-inspired base in which exotic patchouli and incense meet warm guaiac wood, soft tiger nuts and creamy ladan resin. The base is refined with a pinch of caraway and juniper, whose tingling spiciness adds a temperamental nuance to the creation. The heart note is wonderfully refreshing and natural thanks to a blend of green notes and combines with invigorating bergamot in the top note. In the final step, the bouquet is rounded off with a touch of mugwort, whose herbal flavour has a pleasantly stimulating effect.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Scandic Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Scandic by Pana Dora Sweden represents an olfactory journey that is deeply rooted in Swedish tradition. The striking, rectangular bottle with its clear edges and gold-coloured cap in the shape of a detailed stag's head visually underlines the brand's exclusive claim. The yellowish liquid of this eau de parfum, which was designed as a unisex fragrance, shimmers inside the transparent glass. The composition belongs to the amber floral fragrance family and opens with a multi-layered top note accord. Fruity elements such as raspberry, peach and grapefruit meet the floral and herbaceous tones of white hyacinth, lavender and myrtle. The bouquet then develops into a spicy-floral heart note characterised by cassia, sandalwood blossom, carnation and Bulgarian rose. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a complex base in which white musk, birch and labdanum combine with the soft nuances of heliotrope and honey. A hint of camphor gives the creation an interesting contrast at the end and provides depth. Eau de Parfum in the Amber Floral fragrance family Top notes of raspberry, grapefruit and hyacinth Base notes of musk, birch and honey Design bottle with gold-coloured stag's head cap Unisex composition from Sweden

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Dux Orientes Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Pana Dora Sweden presents Dux Orientes - a mesmerising eau de parfum spray that enchants the senses. This exquisite unisex perfume combines woody and oriental notes to create a seductive composition. Dux Orientes takes you on an olfactory journey that begins with a refreshing top note. Tangy bergamot and juicy mandarin merge with the sweet lightness of melon, while tangelo adds an exotic citrus nuance. This invigorating overture awakens the senses and arouses curiosity for more. The heart of the Eau de Parfum Spray reveals a surprising combination: fresh seaweed meets the exotic sweetness of lychee. This unusual combination gives the perfume a modern, almost avant-garde note that is both refreshing and seductive. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with depth and persistence. This is where the full power of synthetic ambroxan unfolds, lending the fragrance a velvety, woody warmth. Sensual musk provides an animalistic facet, while precious oud lends the fragrance an oriental, slightly smoky note. Exciting eau de parfum spray from Pana Dora Sweden Dux Orientes is aimed at self-confident men and women who appreciate a distinctive fragrance. It is the ideal choice for anyone who wants to stand out from the crowd. The high-quality, natural ingredients used by Pana Dora Sweden for this perfume are particularly noteworthy. The long-lasting formula ensures that the fragrance stays with you all day long. Whether in the office, at a romantic dinner or at an elegant event - Dux Orientes is the perfect companion for all occasions where you want to leave a lasting impression.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Stricker Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Pana Dora Sweden Stricker Eau de Parfum Spray is the latest achievement from the iconic Swedish fragrance house. The real highlight of this perfume is, of course, its fragrance, but visually alone, the creation immediately catches the eye: The stylishly designed bottle, with the large deer head as a lid, not only houses all the fine essences of this creation, but is also guaranteed to be an eye-catcher in the bathroom. The fragrance of Pana Dora Sweden Stricker Eau de Parfum Spray takes you on a journey to the Orient - which is why the many spicy accords in this unisex creation should come as no surprise. With a soft, unique and elegant presence The top note of this perfume opens with two classics from the Orient: accords of thyme and saffron set the tone before the Pana Dora Sweden Stricker Eau de Parfum Spray transitions to a duet of Bulgarian rose and aldehydes in the heart note. The base note of the fragrance creation uses the rather heavy but very elegant Assam oud, which is given a soft and warm envelope by ambroxan and white musk. This perfume, a new release from 2025, is a versatile fragrance that always knows how to score points with elegance, openness, warmth and sophistication.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Opuluxe Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: With the Eau de Parfum Spray Opuluxe, the label Pana Dora Sweden presents an olfactory creation that is characterised by its spicy and warm amber nuances. The fragrance opens with a complex top note that combines precious saffron and Brazilian rosewood with the herbaceous accents of basil, sage and coriander. This multi-layered opening is complemented by a hint of myrrh and earthy vetiver. A harmonious interplay of floral osmanthus and intense spices such as cinnamon and clove, rounded off with thyme, then unfolds at the heart of the composition. The base note ensures a long-lasting and sustaining finish by combining mineral tones with the softness of suede, musk and sandalwood. Elements such as oud, benzoin, castoreum and vanilla give the extrait de parfum additional depth and a distinctive character. The design of the bottle also reflects the Nordic identity of the brand: A solid, clear glass vessel with rounded edges allows the yellowish liquid to shine through. An engraved silver label and the artistically designed silver cap in the shape of a stag's head with antlers emphasise the exclusivity of this unisex fragrance. Fragrance family: Amber Spicy with a complex structure. Head notes: Saffron, rosewood, basil, myrrh and coriander. Base: Deep accords of suede, oud, musk, sandalwood and vanilla. Design: High-quality glass bottle with striking silver deer head cap. Concentration: Intense extrait de parfum for a long-lasting fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Onyx Black Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Pana Dora Sweden Onyx Black Eau de Parfum Spray combines a multi-layered fragrance composition with a warm and inviting aura. The harmonious complexity of the extrait de parfum is characterised by the special combination of fresh, spicy and woody notes. The top notes combine saffron, nutmeg, cinnamon, lemon and bergamot, creating a lively opening with spicy and citrusy freshness. The heart of the fragrance captivates with the deep warmth of ambergris, olibanum and cypriol oil. These ingredients give the composition its characteristic core, which is rounded off in an atmospheric way by the base of cedar, spruce resin and labdanum. The interplay of resinous and sweet notes creates a fascinating depth. Suitable for anyone who appreciates an expressive and versatile fragrance, Onyx Black exudes elegance and unisex character.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Skadi Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Inspired by Skadi, the Norse goddess of winter and the mountains, the Pana Dora Sweden Skadi Exclusive Perfume unfolds a fragrance full of fascinating contrasts. It opens with a crisp, refreshing blend of pear, apple and zesty citrus fruits, accompanied by subtle notes of hazelnut and olibanum. At the heart of the fragrance, a velvety bouquet of osmanthus, rose and a hint of saffron unfolds, complemented by mossy and sweet, floral amberette accents. The base notes round off the olfactory experience with warm, balsamic notes of labdanum, creamy vanilla and a modern blend of various musk accords. This unisex composition is presented in an elegant glass bottle, whose cap – shaped like a intricately detailed stag’s head – serves as a visual highlight and emphasises the perfume’s mythological character. A unisex fragrance that combines the contrast between fruity freshness and warm sensuality. A composition of fruity top notes, a floral-spicy heart and a base of amber, vanilla and musk. Inspired by the mythology of the Norse winter goddess Skadi. An intricately designed bottle with a stag’s head as its cap.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Grand Musk Extrait de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The silver stag's head sits majestically on the heavy crystal bottle and heralds a fragrance experience that symbolises the wild nature of Sweden. Grand Musk Extrait de Parfum Spray by Pana Dora Sweden reveals itself as an intense composition that emphasises woody and animal notes. The opening already fascinates with a spicy alliance of cardamom and coriander, which is harmoniously complemented by floral accents of Bulgarian rose and lavender. As the fragrance progresses, a multi-layered heart develops in which warming spices such as cinnamon, clove and nutmeg meet the subtle sweetness of vanilla, blueberry and magnolia. This complex blend gives the fragrance an unmistakable character. The olfactory foundation of this extrait de parfum is characterised by deep accords of leather, incense and cedarwood, which together with guaiac wood and amber create a striking and long-lasting finish. The high concentration of fragrance oils allows the aroma to unfold with particular intensity. The rectangular bottle with the detailed emblem visually emphasises the exclusivity of the Pana Dora Sweden brand. Highly concentrated extrait de parfum for an intense fragrance experience Multi-layered composition of woody, animal and spicy notes Striking bottle with silver cap in the shape of a stag's head Complex base note with leather, incense, amber and guaiac wood Contains essences of Bulgarian rose, blueberry and cinnamon, among others

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Swedish Wood Extrait de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Pana Dora Sweden Swedish Wood Extrait de Parfum Spray is reminiscent of the dense and fertile forests of Sweden with its woody fragrance components combined with aromatic spices. Pleasantly natural fragrance for women and men Pana Dora Sweden Swedish Wood is a unisex fragrance that is suitable for men and women who prefer unobtrusive, natural fragrances. Here you get an extrait de parfum that is even more concentrated and of higher quality than a normal perfume - just a few drops of the precious liquid are enough to wrap yourself in a pleasant aroma all day long. Available since 2019, Swedish Wood Extrait de Parfum Spray is based on a warm blend of agarwood and vetiver, which are combined with rough patchouli. Creamy ladan resin and tiger nuts skilfully soften the astringency in the next step. The heart note consists of fragrant floral tones and cloves, which lend the composition an excitingly spirited nuance. The top note is also spicy, combining pink pepper with rosemary . Added to this is the juicy aroma of fresh green apples, which provides wonderful revitalisation and refreshment.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Majestic Amber Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: If you are looking for the luxurious and sublime in a perfume, this eau-de-parfum spray, which bears the noble name Majestic Amber, is the perfect choice. This product from Pana Dora Sweden knows how to convey the feeling of nobility in a fragrance in a unique way. To celebrate the special moments Because life is also characterised by exclusive occasions that make you feel very special - because you are attending a glamorous event or want to treat yourself to something extraordinary - this eau de parfum spray was developed by Pana Dora Sweden. An exquisite blend of pink pepper, orris root, saffron, violet and nutmeg was added to the top note , which epitomises elegance. The heart notes include tuberose, cashmere wood, ambergris, fir resin, amberwood and orange blossom , which symbolise dignity. Finally, the base notes include oak moss, dry wood, papyrus, leather, vanilla, cedar and benzoin , which radiate warmth and depth. The bottle is also designed to match this perfume. After all, it has a chic shape and its striking cap is also pleasing to the eye. It is also encased in extremely attractive packaging. Majestic Amber is therefore ideal as a gift for yourself or for a loved one.

listings.rawTitle: Headspace Collection Extrait de Parfum Spray Oud 50 ml
listings.description: The OUD HEADSPACE Extrait de Parfum Spray from the modern French niche brand Headspace offers a fruity-woody fragrance experience suitable for a wide range of everyday occasions. The minimalist glass bottle, with its black label, blends elegantly into any fragrance collection. Immediately upon spraying, the top notes of pineapple, pear and lemon unfold with a fresh presence, providing a crisp start to the day. As the fragrance develops, the heart notes emerge, with geranium, orange blossom and peony creating a floral balance. This combination creates a subtle yet perceptible aura, ideal for the office or evening events. Finally, the base notes of leather, oud and patchouli ground the composition, leaving a long-lasting, distinctive impression. Thanks to the high fragrance concentration of the Extrait de Parfum, just a few sprays are enough to ensure the scent lingers. This makes the unisex fragrance easy to use and subtly enhances your individual charisma. A fruity-woody fragrance composition for versatile everyday use Top notes of pineapple, pear and lemon for a fresh opening A floral heart of geranium, orange blossom and peony Base notes of leather, oud and patchouli for a long-lasting impression High fragrance concentration allows for economical and efficient application

listings.rawTitle: Headspace Collection Extrait de Parfum Spray Safran 50 ml
listings.description: The SAFRAN HEADSPACE Extrait de Parfum Spray adds a special touch to everyday life with its multi-layered fragrance composition. The simple glass bottle with a black label offers a view of the yellowish liquid. Immediately after spraying, galbanum, cardamom, pepper and Lapsang Souchong tea release a spicy aroma that ensures a distinctive start to the day. As the fragrance develops, iris, mate, saffron and frankincense blend in the heart notes to create a complex olfactory experience that harmoniously adapts to the individual’s skin chemistry. Finally, leather, osmanthus and patchouli form a deep base. These fragrance notes leave a long-lasting impression that makes a pleasant statement, particularly at evening events or formal occasions. Thus, this unisex fragrance in the 50 ml size offers a distinctive companion for a wide variety of situations. A multi-layered unisex fragrance composition for a wide range of everyday occasions Top notes of galbanum, cardamom, pepper and Lapsang Souchong tea Heart notes of iris, mate, saffron and frankincense Base notes of leather, osmanthus and patchouli for a long-lasting scent Practical 50 ml size for regular use

listings.rawTitle: Headspace Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Cèdre 30 ml
listings.description: Headspace Collection Cèdre Eau de Parfum Spray is a tribute to the timeless elegance of cedar wood. The composition unfolds with spicy notes of nutmeg and caraway, creating an invitingly warm atmosphere. This opening is reminiscent of the first flickering of a fireplace, accompanied by a fiery yet gentle spice. At the heart of the fragrance, the multi-faceted nuances of Atlas and Virginia cedarwood take centre stage. While the Atlas cedar with its resinous and leathery notes is reminiscent of old tree trunks, the Virginia cedar brings dry, spicy accents into play. This combination lends the fragrance a depth reminiscent of the quiet majesty of a forest. The composition is rounded off by a warm base of vanilla, amber and a hint of leather, which give the perfume a lingering presence and a gentle embrace. This perfume is more than just a fragrance – it is an olfactory journey that gives the feeling of lingering in a Parisian bookshop, surrounded by yellowed pages and the scent of old paper. A perfect choice for anyone who values a balanced yet characterful fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Headspace Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Genievre 30 ml
listings.description: The Genievre Eau de Parfum Spray from the Headspace Collection is an olfactory homage to the carefree atmosphere of a summer sunset, savoured with a chilled glass of gin. The composition of this unisex fragrance begins with an invigorating top note in which juicy mandarin meets the fine, spicy flavour of pink pepper. At the heart of the creation is the striking, slightly tart essence of Balkan juniper berries, a clear allusion to the perfume's alcoholic inspiration. A warm and grounding base is provided by notes of elegant cedarwood, which combine harmoniously with the balsamic, slightly smoky character of olibanum resin. The overall result is a multi-layered fragrance experience that skilfully balances fresh, citrusy notes with spicy, woody accords. The formulation, which consists of around 92.5% ingredients of natural origin, reflects the focus on high-quality raw materials. The eau de parfum unfolds best on warm areas of skin such as the wrists or neck. A multi-layered unisex fragrance with fresh, citrusy and spicy-woody notes. Fragrance composition with mandarin, pink pepper, juniper berry, cedarwood and olibanum. Inspired by the atmosphere of a gin cocktail at sunset. Formulated with approx. 92.5% ingredients of natural origin.

The composition unfolds a creamy, powdery character with pronounced gourmand notes. At the centre of the fragrance experience is the gentle presence of pistachio, which blends harmoniously with the warmth of cashmere and the depth of ambergris. This interplay creates a soft and sensual impression. A velvety vanilla nuance, whose aroma is reminiscent of fine marzipan, adds a special facet and emphasises the gourmand profile. A hint of bergamot provides a balanced finish, bringing a subtle freshness to the composition. The perfume can be applied to both the skin and hair. Fragrance direction: Creamy, powdery, gourmand Fragrance notes: Pistachio, cashmere, ambergris, vanilla, bergamot Properties: unisex fragrance, vegan Origin: Handmade in Cologne

listings.rawTitle: VALJUES Special Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 19 | NINETEEN 10 ml
listings.description: The VALJUES Special Collection 19 | NINETEEN Eau de Parfum Spray offers an olfactory snapshot of summer. Aquatic accords of salty seawater meet the floral freshness of orange blossom and violet in the top note, immediately evoking associations of warm days and a light breeze. This maritime opening transitions gently into a creamy heart in which the powdery notes of iris combine with lily and other white flowers. Soft nuances of peach and white musk in the base note provide a warm, close-to-the-skin finish, harmoniously rounded off by clean linen accords. The composition is designed as a unisex fragrance and is completely free from animal ingredients, which means it is classified as vegan. Visually, the clear bottle with its rounded edges and cylindrical cap in a natural wood look emphasises the purist character of the body scent. A beige-coloured textile tag indicates that it belongs to the limited Special Collection. As this is a one-off launch, this eau de parfum is a special addition for lovers of exclusive niche fragrances. Fragrance character: Aquatic, floral and creamy with notes of salty seawater, iris and white musk. Special feature: Part of the limited Special Collection and designed as a one-off launch. Features: Vegan unisex fragrance with fruity peach and clean linen accords. Design: Minimalist bottle with wooden-look cap and textile tag.

listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Soft & Sensual 7 | SEVEN by VALJUES is a multi-layered fragrance composition that combines fruity, floral and woody notes. The fragrance opens with an exciting combination of spicy pink pepper and a strong cherry note. In the heart note, a bouquet of velvety, dark rose unfolds, which is given a special depth by warm cashmeran and soft, powdery accents. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a base of precious woods, musk, amber and a subtle hint of blond tobacco. With a perfume oil content of over 25%, this is a highly concentrated eau de parfum. Developed in Cologne and hand-filled in Germany, the creation is designed as a genderless fragrance and is aimed at anyone who appreciates complex and sensual compositions. listings.rawTitle: VALJUES Soft & Sensual Eau de Parfum Spray Forbidden Fixation 10 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Forbidden Fixation adds a unique note to the Soft & Sensual collection of the VALJUES brand. Released in 2025, this creation is characterised by a sweet-synthetic fragrance profile that builds on the well-known "Better than skin" x Cashmere base. The fragrance is handcrafted in the atelier in Cologne, whereby no animal ingredients are used. A special feature of the formulation is its suitability for different areas of application, as the spray can be worn both on the skin and in the hair. listings.rawTitle: Kylie Jenner Fragrances Cosmic Eau de Parfum Spray 10 ml
listings.description: The Cosmic Eau de Parfum Spray by Kylie Jenner Fragrances is a floral-ambery fragrance composition that exudes a warm and sensual aura. This feminine perfume opens with a fresh yet sweet top note that combines star jasmine with tangy blood orange to create a lively opening. A warm bouquet of golden amber and an accord of red peony then unfolds at the heart of the creation, giving the fragrance its magnetic and elegant depth. The base note ensures a long-lasting and inviting finish, combining soft vanilla musk with a hint of cedar wood to create a harmonious whole. The entire composition presents itself as an unobtrusive and uncomplicated fragrance that is suitable as a companion for the day as well as for special occasions in the evening. The perfume is captured in an artistic, sculptural bottle, whose shiny chrome surface reflects the light differently depending on the angle of view and nestles in the hand like a sculpture. Flowery, ambery fragrance with a warm, feminine radiance Composition of star jasmine, blood orange, amber and vanilla musk. Unobtrusive character, suitable for day and evening wear. Presented in a unique, sculptural bottle with a chrome sheen.

listings.rawTitle: Kylie Jenner Fragrances Cosmic Eau de Parfum Spray Intense 10 ml
listings.description: With a deep and warm character, Cosmic Eau de Parfum Spray Intense presents itself as a richer interpretation of the original fragrance classic. This composition unfolds as an ambery-gourmand experience that captivates with its creamy texture and enhanced presence. It opens with a vibrant blend of star jasmine and blood orange, creating a bright yet grounded opening. At the heart of the fragrance, a golden amber accord blends with notes of red peony, which flow seamlessly into the base. Here, vanilla and a soft musk accord create a long-lasting, warming character that envelops the senses. The sculptural bottle, in a deep, fiery red, reflects the intensity and the refined depth of the essence it contains. The emphasis on vanilla and benzoin lends the perfume a distinctive creaminess that settles gently on the skin and lingers there. Fragrance family: Ambery-Gourmand with warm and creamy nuances. Top note: A combination of star jasmine and blood orange. Heart note: A golden amber accord and red peony accords. Base note: Vanilla and a musk accord for depth and longevity. Design: A sculptural bottle in a rich shade of red.

listings.rawTitle: Attar Collection Khaltat Night Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Discover a mysterious masterpiece from Attar Collection with Khaltat Night Eau de Parfum Spray, which captures the magic of oriental nights in a bottle. This luxurious perfume pays homage to the centuries-old tradition of Arabian perfumery and takes you on a sensual journey through the enchanted world of the Orient. A mesmerising fragrance composition Khaltat Night Eau de Parfum Spray by Attar Collection unfolds like a precious treasure from the Orient. The first notes open with a seductive interplay of noble spices and precious resins that immediately captivate the senses. At the heart of the fragrance, intoxicating floral scents merge with exotic essences to create a seductive symphony. The base notes of precious woods, sweet ambergris and sensual musky accords leave an unforgettable impression that lingers on the skin like a velvety veil and creates a magical aura. Timeless elegance in the bottle The exquisite bottle of Khaltat Night embodies oriental opulence in perfect form. The sophisticated design with its ornate details and precious materials perfectly reflects the value of its contents and makes this perfume a coveted collector's item for fragrance lovers. Every glance at this work of art awakens a longing for the mysteries of the Orient. Created for special moments Eau de Parfum Spray Khaltat Night is a statement perfume from Attar Collection for connoisseurs and lovers of the extraordinary. The intense formulation unfolds its full splendour in the evening hours and on special occasions when you want to create an irresistible aura of luxury and mystery. The long-lasting fragrance will accompany you through magical nights and leave you with lasting memories.</p

listings.rawTitle: Attar Collection Hayati Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Hayati Eau de Parfum Spray from Attar Collection is a gourmand, fruity fragrance creation that is reminiscent of a sun-drenched garden full of berries and flowers. The composition starts with a tangy top note of raspberry and pineapple. A creamy accord unfolds in the heart, combining cream, blackcurrant, honey and plum with delicate floral notes. The base provides a soft and long-lasting signature, ending with notes of vanilla ice cream, musk and ice cream. This elegant yet playful fragrance tells a story of carefree joy and is suitable for anyone who appreciates sweet and creamy perfumes. Gourmand and fruity fragrance character Composition of raspberry, cream, honey and vanilla ice cream Elegant and playful character at the same time Suitable as a unisex fragrance

listings.rawTitle: Attar Collection Crystal Love For Her Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in a world of elegance and sensual seduction. The Eau de Parfum Spray Crystal Love for Her from Attar Collection is a declaration of love to the modern woman who celebrates her femininity with self-confidence. Like a precious gemstone, this exquisite perfume unfolds in multiple facets. The first notes greet you with a sparkling freshness that immediately awakens the senses. The heart of the perfume reveals a seductive floral bouquet full of depth and warmth, while the base notes linger on the skin with their velvety intensity and leave an unforgettable impression. A brilliant perfume composition for special moments The artfully designed bottle made of sparkling crystal glass catches the light like a cut diamond and makes Crystal Love for Her a real gem on your toiletry table. The Attar Collection combines oriental fragrance expertise with timeless elegance in this eau de parfum spray. Whether for a glamorous evening or as a daily companion that emphasises your natural charisma - Crystal Love for Her enchants for every occasion and envelops you in an aura of luxury and sophistication. Experience the magic of a fragrance that becomes like a second skin and perfectly expresses your unique personality.

listings.rawTitle: Attar Collection Azora Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Attar Collection Azora Eau de Parfum Spray is somewhat reminiscent of a walk through a seemingly endless green meadow, while in the background the sunset envelops your skin in an almost mysterious veil. Icon Miroslav Petkov is responsible for the fragrance and has created a creation that is as elegant as it is changeable and sparkling. The Attar Collection Azora Eau de Parfum Spray can be worn by both men and women, and the bottle is always a real eye-catcher in the bathroom thanks to its particularly elegant silhouette and colour scheme. Flowery, fruity and full of lovely details The perfume opens with a trio of orange, lychee and sparkling bergamot in its top notes. All three play skilfully with contrasts, with the rather silky-soft lychee cleverly taming the bergamot. The heart note of Attar Collection Azora Eau de Parfum Spray is a floral bouquet - jasmine, peach and various floral accords evoke memories of a spring and summer that will hopefully never end. The base note of this perfume grounds the entire creation. Various woody accords meet a rather warm musky note, which is why the fragrance cuts a fine figure both during the day and in the evening at a romantic dinner.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Eau de Parfum Spray 40 ml
listings.description: The eau de parfum spray I Want Choo by Jimmy Choo was launched in 2021. With its fruity and floral presence, the fragrance is aimed at women and delights with its above-average longevity and wonderful sillage. Happy, light and summery , yet sensual, elegant and very feminine , Jimmy Choo proves once again that he can do so much more than create shoes. The label has long been synonymous with outstanding perfumes, and rightly so. To give the eau de parfum spray I Want Choo its extraordinary presence, the unnamed perfumer blends a top note of mandarin juice and peaches. Jasmine and red spider lilies are used for the heart note. This flower is known in Japan as the flower of the equinox, among other things. Vanilla appears as a soloist in the base. Unusual and such a must-have Dressed in a luxurious bottle, the I Want Choo eau de parfum spray is a real visual and olfactory delight. Jimmy Choo has created this fragrance for all women who don't want to miss out on that certain something during the day, who like to treat themselves to something special and express this in their fragrances. And just as the various Jimmy Choo shoes are suitable for all occasions, the fragrance of I Want Choo always fits.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Le Parfum 40 ml
listings.description: With the Jimmy Choo I Want Choo perfume, you get a fragrance that is as feminine as it is playful, as confident as it is glamorous and as unique as its wearer. The luxury brand, which is known above all for its beautiful shoes, has already gone all out with the bottle. It has a peach-coloured look with a golden cap and a brand logo that is also inlaid in gold. The curved shape of the Jimmy Choo I Want Choo perfume is guaranteed to be an eye-catcher in the bathroom - but the real highlight is the sweet, fruity and floral fragrance. Pure joie de vivre in a sugar-sweet bottle The Jimmy Choo I Want Choo fragrance was created by the clever minds and fine hands of a trio of perfumers: Sonia Constant, Louise Turner and Antoine Maisondieu are experts in their field and combine prominent peach accords with a hint of citrusy, sour mandarin juice in the top note. In the heart note, the suspenseful red spider lily meets jasmine sambac, while the base note utilises a duo of vanilla and benzoin. The result is a sensual, feminine fragrance that exudes joie de vivre and is a strong choice 365 days a year with its elegant fragrance silhouette and the pithy echo of benzoin - and with its peach accord is a guarantee for a good mood.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Forever Eau de Parfum Spray 40 ml
listings.description: The eau de parfum spray I Want Choo Forever was launched in 2022. Designer Jimmy Choo sees the fruity-sweet fragrance for women as a continuation of I wand Choo, which was launched in 2020. Just as with his world-famous shoes, Jimmy Choo also wants his fragrances to enchant women. That's why he enlisted the help of Louise Turner and Sonia Constant for the I want Choo Forever Eau de Parfum Spray. They give the perfume a top note of pink pepper, rose and bitter almond. For the heart note, they use the scents of jasmine sambac, black cherry liqueur and vetiver. The creation is rounded off with tonka beans, moss and vanilla. Sensual elegance for all seasons Jimmy Choo's Eau de Parfum Spray I Want Choo Forever is aimed at all women who are comfortable with their femininity. They are at peace with themselves and are just as feminine in jeans and shirts as they are in a summer dress or evening gown. They like feminine, feminine fragrances that are elegant yet not heavy . The bottle of the Jimmy Choo Eau de Parfum Spray is shaped like a dress and has an elegant colour gradient to match. In contrast to the original, the colour gradient of I Want Choo Forever changes from clear to black and the letters JC are in gold.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love Eau de Parfum Spray 60 ml
listings.description: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo With Love is an eau de parfum spray that is characterised by its floral, fruity and ambery signature. The composition opens with a lively top note of juicy raspberry, delicate orange blossom petals and the essence of Italian mandarin. A rich floral bouquet unfolds at the heart of the fragrance creation, combining the elegance of rose with exotic hibiscus and airy freesia. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a warm and sensual base of creamy vanilla, fine sandalwood and soft musk, which provides a pleasant depth. The fragrance embodies modern elegance and harmoniously combines fresh, floral and warm accents. Its delicate, sweet and powdery character makes it a suitable companion for the day, especially in spring and summer. The design of the bottle emphasises the luxurious character of the perfume. The slim, curved silhouette made of pale pink glass is adorned with a gold-coloured ball cap and the stylish JC monogram. For optimal development, we recommend applying to pulse points such as the inside of the wrists or the neck. <p
