listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray 40 ml
listings.description: The Jimmy Choo Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray is a composition full of contrasts and elegance. This modern, fruity chypre fragrance opens with a sparkling combination of green notes and the flavour of sweet Italian orange. As the fragrance progresses, the centrepiece of the perfume unfolds: the exotic tiger orchid, which lends the fragrance an expressive yet graceful facet. The base provides an unforgettable finish, in which the sweet warmth of creamy toffee meets the deep, earthy nuances of Indian patchouli. This combination creates a velvety and intense sillage that makes the fragrance a stylish companion. Fragrance direction: fruity-chypre Character: Warm, intense and woody Heart of exotic tiger orchid Base with notes of toffee and patchouli

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Fever Eau de Parfum Spray 40 ml
listings.description: The Jimmy Choo Fever Eau de Parfum Spray is a captivating fragrance creation characterised by a distinctly sweet and fruity character. Since its launch in 2018, this fragrance has embodied a confident and glamorous aura. The composition opens with a vibrant top note in which the dark sweetness of plum meets the exotic freshness of lychee and the tangy accents of grapefruit. This interplay creates an inviting and multi-faceted opening. The heart of the fragrance, an elegant floral bouquet, unfolds as the fragrance progresses. Here, the notes of jasmine and orchid combine with the powdery warmth of heliotrope to create a harmonious blend. The lasting impression is left by the base note, which gives the fragrance its depth and warmth. A creamy and rich combination of sandalwood, roasted tonka bean and sweet vanilla, subtly complemented by benzoin and a hint of almond, ensures an unforgettable finish. With its intense presence, Fever is an ideal companion for special occasions in the evening and unfolds its full potential especially in the cooler autumn and winter months. A sweet and fruity eau de parfum with a warm character. Fragrance composition of plum, jasmine and roasted tonka bean. Intense fragrance, ideal for the evening. Especially suitable for the autumn and winter months.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Floral Eau de Toilette Spray 40 ml
listings.description: With Jimmy Choo Floral Eau de Toilette Spray, the name says it all. Floral accords harmonise here with soft, warm and woody notes. It is a creative fragrance that embodies the casual light-heartedness and refreshing liveliness of modern times. Jimmy Choo, the charismatic Malaysian shoe designer, always proves that he can not only create exclusive shoe fashion, but also extravagant and unmistakable fragrances. With the Floral Eau de Toilette Spray, he gets to the heart of the matter, as the skilfully coordinated fragrance components make this perfume extremely self-confident, feminine and romantic. Jimmy Choo lets flowers speak The top notes of bergamot, nectarine and mandarin open the enchanting fragrance experience. Magnolia, sweet pea, apricot blossom, peach blossom and sweet pea follow in the heart note and steer the fragrance in a floral-sweet direction. Ambroxan, musk and chords of precious woods refine the effect of the perfume and round off the overall impression of the fragrance in a sophisticated way. The oval, transparent glass bottle is intricately structured and looks very opulent and elegant. The cube-shaped cap creates an exciting contrast to the otherwise soft contours of the bottle. The Jimmy Choo Floral Eau de Toilette Spray is perfect for the day, the office and leisure time. However, the floral fragrance also comes into its own in the evening or on special occasions.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Man Ice Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: With the Eau de Toilette Spray Man Ice , Jimmy Choo presents an aromatic, fresh fragrance for men. Typical of the fragrance brand's success story are its casual confidence and incredible self-assurance, with which Man Ice also exudes pure masculinity. The powerful yet sensual fragrance was created by designer Michel Almairac. Unlike the other Jimmy Choo man fragrances, this eau de toilette spray presents a passionate, playful facet in the top note, which provides a seductive contrast to the otherwise often dark masculinity. The manufacturer perfectly captures the cool freshness of the fragrance with the design of the bottle. The Eau de Toilette Spray Man Ice refreshes and seduces The fragrance by Jimmy Choo captures the game of seduction between man and woman in an exciting composition. At the same time, it reveals a surprising new side to the Man range with dynamic complexity and powerful sensuality . The refreshing top note starts the fragrance experience with essences of bergamot, cedrat extracts and a striking citrus breeze of mandarin. The fragrance becomes more intense in the middle, where woody vetiver, patchouli essence, cedarwood and fresh apple take over. At the base of the Eau de Toilette Spray Man Ice by Jimmy Choo, musk, moss and ambroxan complete the composition.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Man Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: The Jimmy Choo Man fragrance offers a multi-faceted scent composition that is ideal for the evening and special occasions. The gold-coloured bottle, with its textured cap, presents the product in a visually appealing way. listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Man Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Man by Jimmy Choo was released in 2014 and marks the first men's fragrance by the renowned designer. The eau de toilette spray comes in a rectangular, silver bottle with a staked cap and an almost transparent brand and series inscription on the front. The minimalist impression of this perfume is a welcome counterpart to the extremely interesting top and heart notes, where not only many exotic essences are used, but also some rarities that are usually only rarely found in fragrances. The tone of this fragrance is set by British actor Kit Harington, who appears as the face of this new creation in advertising campaigns. Exclusive perfume and masculine debut from Jimmy Choo The eau de toilette spray, simply named "Man", relies on a mixture of lavender, honeydew melon and mandarin in the top note, with the delicate honeydew melon being the striking accord in this trio. The heart note again relies on a trio, this time consisting of rose geranium, pink pepper and pineapple leaf as the defining accord , which once again skilfully underlines the fruity texture of this perfume. The base note is more classic, but by no means less spectacular. Ambry woods meet patchouli and slightly harsher suede, providing a contrast to the fruity nuances.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Urban Hero Eau de Parfum Spray Gold Edition 50 ml
listings.description: Jimmy Choo Urban Hero Eau de Parfum Spray Gold Edition is a spicy, powdery men's fragrance that is as extraordinary as it is exciting. It is aimed at men who savour life to the full and enjoy being in the spotlight. The fragrance is intense and sparkling, but never overpowering . Jimmy Choo always manages to set new trends - both with its fragrances and its fashion. Even though the company has since been taken over by Michael Kors, Urban Hero Eau de Parfum Spray Gold Edition clearly bears the unmistakable "signature" of the Malaysian shoemaker. A creative fragrance composition that motivates and revitalises Sweet pineapple and blood orange form the top note of this extraordinary fragrance. At the heart, floral notes of Provençal lavender and tonka bean nestle into the composition. The fragrance is rounded off with sandalwood and oakmoss in the base. The fragrance is particularly suitable for the warmer seasons and can envelop its wearer in a masculine, powerful and sensual aura in any situation. The design of the flacon perfectly matches the direction of the fragrance - black and gold give the perfume an elegant, strong and noble aura . Urban Hero Eau de Parfum Spray Gold Edition by Jimmy Choo is therefore a real eye-catcher in any bathroom.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum Spray Intense 50 ml
listings.description: 2024 sees the launch of the Eau de Parfum Spray Intense K by Dolce&Gabbana. The perfume from Dolce&Gabbana is for men and has a fresh, oriental fragrance . Created by the grand mistress Nathalie Lorson and Daphné Bugey, this perfume only needs three ingredients to develop its casual elegance. Without a fragrance pyramid, the Eau de Parfum Spray Intense K by Dolce&Gabbana blends figs, leather and saffron. Dolce&Gabbana has succeeded in creating an expressive, sensual fragrance for men that is both elegant and casual, perceptible but not overpowering. A true all-rounder with depth Masculine fragrances are often over-present and, especially at work, men prefer to wear a fragrance that doesn't arrive 5 minutes before they do. The Eau de Parfum Spray Intense K by Dolce&Gabbana is just such a fragrance. It accompanies its wearer with a perceptible presence, but without imposing itself. Dolce&Gabbana's perfume is just as perfect for leisure as it is for work, regardless of the season. The stylish, dark blue bottle with a silver crown conceals a perfume that men like to wear and women like to notice on their counterparts. The more intense version of K from 2020 is simply ravishing .

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Q by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum Spray Intense 30 ml
listings.description: Dolce&Gabbana awakens the queen in you ! With Q by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum Spray Intense, you can emphasise your feminine and self-confident style. Give your everyday life a royal touch: the perfume combines heliotrope with citrus fruits, sweet fruits and individual flowers as well as a charming base of woods and amber. Who could resist this potpourri? Discover your royal charm with Dolce&Gabbana Experience the diversity of Q by Dolce&Gabbana! The Eau de Parfum Spray Intense is as individual as your look. It starts with a revelation of cherry and citrus fruits, then moves into a heart of heliotrope and cherry and garnishes the whole thing with a hint of jasmine. It is mysterious and almost unapproachable, but the sweetness makes it playful again. In the base, accords such as amber and cedarwood are true classics that prove themselves time and time again. Overall, the different components create a sophisticated, expressive fragrance that skilfully interweaves tradition and modernity. Feel like a queen at every moment with Q by Dolce&Gabbana! This is achieved on the one hand by the fragrance itself and on the other by the royal flacon, which is closed with a crown.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Dolce Eau de Toilette Spray Lily 75 ml
listings.description: Dolce Lily celebrates the charisma of the pink lily - a symbol of femininity and tenderness since time immemorial. The fragrance is a fresh, fruity, floral composition in which the delicate floral notes of the lily meet exotic passion fruit on a bed of soft, sensual musk. Powerful fruity notes open the composition - the sparkling citrus notes of Italian bergamot play with a touch of tropical passion fruit. This exotic touch leads into the floral heart note, in which sparkling pink lily blends with sophisticated rose tones. The radiance of these flowers contrasts with the soft musky notes that form a subtly sensual accord beneath and behind them. Sandalwood grounds the composition with its own depth, and vanilla tones allow the composition to linger long on the skin. The bottle picks up on the feminine elegance of the original Dolce silhouette, but now dresses in a bold pink, from which the vivacious personality of the Dolce girl shines out into the world. The familiar floral cap comes in the same vibrant pink and anticipates the fresh lily accord of the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Spray 35 ml
listings.description: The GIVENCHY L'INTERDIT Eau de Parfum Spray is a composition based on the fascinating contrast between light floral and dark earthy notes. It opens with an invigorating combination of fresh Calabrian bergamot, spicy ginger from Madagascar and delicate orange blossom, which creates a sparkling first impression. An opulent bouquet of white flowers unfolds at the heart of the fragrance, combining jasmine, tuberose and Arabian jasmine to create an intense floral signature. Vetiver, patchouli and sandalwood provide a warm, earthy depth and a long-lasting impression in the base. This versatile interplay creates a woody-floral fragrance for women that emphasises a fearlessly elegant and sensual aura and stylishly expresses femininity and self-confidence. The creation is presented in a simple and elegant bottle, whose minimalist design emphasises the luxurious feel of the perfume and makes it a timeless object. listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Woman Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the invigorating power of the ocean, Davidoff Cool Water Woman Eau de Toilette Spray is a timeless fragrance classic with a floral-aquatic character. The composition opens with an exceptionally fresh and fruity top note, in which juicy melon, pineapple and quince blend with the crispness of lotus and lemon. This aquatic opening gives way to a floral heart that unfolds a bouquet of delicate water lily, jasmine and lily of the valley, refined with a subtle hint of honey. The fragrance experience finds its warm and sensual conclusion in the base notes. Notes of sandalwood and musk blend with hints of blackberry, peach and vanilla to create a gentle depth. The fragrance is characterised by its light, crisp character and is an ideal everyday companion. Fragrance type: Floral, Aquatic Character: Fresh, light and sensual Top note: A fruity, aquatic composition of melon, pineapple and lotus. Heart note: A floral bouquet of water lily, jasmine and lily of the valley. Base note: Warm accords of sandalwood, musk and blackberry.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born In Roma Uomo Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: As a tribute to the eternal city of Rome, Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Eau de Toilette Spray captures a unique, woody-aromatic signature. The fragrance opens with a striking freshness in which mineral notes meet a salty breeze and the delicacy of violet leaves. This lively top note transitions into a spicy heart of aromatic sage and invigorating ginger, which adds depth to the composition. An unforgettable finish is provided by a base of earthy, slightly smoky vetiver nuances and warm woody notes. The eau de toilette embodies a modern elegance that combines classic elements with an unconventional spirit. The overall look is rounded off by the iconic bottle, whose design is inspired by the Valentino rivet and reflects the brand's couture roots. Woody, aromatic fragrance for men Top notes of mineral notes, sea salt and violet leaves Heart note with spicy ginger and aromatic sage Base note with smoked vetiver and woody accents A fragrance that combines classic elegance and modern informality

This chypre composition with fruity and ambery notes unfolds a fascinating complexity and a new intensity. The opening is a sparkling combination of juicy peach and bright bergamot, which provides an immediate freshness. At the heart of the fragrance, the unmistakable musky accord unfolds, enveloped by an opulent bouquet of sunny, white flowers, giving the perfume its unmistakable, elegant character. The base of warm vanilla and earthy vetiver creates a long-lasting, woody-amber finish and rounds off the fragrance experience. The fragrance develops as an expression of grace and inner strength. listings.rawTitle: Trussardi My Name Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The My Name Eau de Parfum Spray by Trussardi is an olfactory composition that belongs to the floral-musky-amber fragrance family. It opens with a gentle top note that combines the powdery accents of white violet with heliotrope florals. This introduction creates a light and inviting first impression. A floral bouquet of lilac blossom and the unmistakable cala flower then unfolds in the heart of the fragrance, characterising the soft floral character of the creation. The base note gives the perfume its depth and consistency. This is where warm musk nuances meet amber and are rounded off with a subtle hint of vanilla. This foundation provides the fresh, intense finish to the fragrance experience. The perfume develops its notes best when applied from a distance of 15 to 20 cm to warm areas of the body, such as the inside of the wrists or the skin behind the earlobes. Fragrance family: Floral-musky-amber Head note: White violet, heliotrope flora Heart note: Lilac blossom, cala flower Base note: musk, amber, vanilla Fragrance character: Soft-floral and fresh-intense

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Eau de Parfum Spray - refillable Ocean 50 ml
listings.description: The Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum is a modern, woody-ambery composition based on fascinating contrasts. The fragrance opens with the sparkling freshness of grapefruit, which gives the top note a clear and dynamic radiance. As it progresses, an elegant combination of smoky incense and striking woody notes unfolds in the heart, lending the creation a special depth and luxurious character. The multi-layered fragrance experience is rounded off by a warm and enveloping base that combines vanilla with a sophisticated amber accord. A special feature here is the use of the innovative AmberXtreme™ molecule, which emphasises the intensity of the base notes and ensures a long-lasting impression. The eau de parfum is presented in a deep blue bottle, the design of which is characterised by a red line as a distinctive brand symbol. The bottle is designed to be refillable and therefore supports the conscious use of resources. Scent direction: woody-amber Fragrance notes: Grapefruit, incense, vanilla-amber accord Character: Fresh, deep, intense Special feature: Refillable bottle for a sustainable approach

listings.rawTitle: Chopard Wish Eau de Parfum Spray 75 ml
listings.description: The Chopard Wish Eau de Parfum Spray is a multi-faceted fragrance composition for women that has been inspiring since 1999. Captured in a bottle whose design is reminiscent of an artfully cut diamond, the outer appearance already reflects the character of the contents. The fragrance opens with a playful top note, in which fruity flavours of strawberry, pear and coconut combine with the delicate blossoms of honeysuckle and acacia. The heart of the fragrance then unfolds, a harmonious combination of floral notes such as violet and orchid, which is given a special depth by sweet accents of honey and milk. The base forms a long-lasting and warm finish. This is where creamy notes of vanilla, caramel and toffee meet the woody elegance of sandalwood and the sensuality of amber and incense. The result is a complex and feminine fragrance that leaves behind an unmistakable aura. A multi-faceted fragrance with floral and sweet notes. Iconic bottle in the design of a cut diamond. Composition of fruity, floral and warm gourmand accords. Created by perfumer Nathalie Lorson in 1999.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La vie est belle Eau de Parfum Spray refillable 30 ml
listings.description: La Vie Est Belle by Lancôme is an eau de parfum that embodies joie de vivre in a fragrance. At the centre of the composition is the noble iris pallida from France, which is accompanied by the depth of sustainably sourced patchouli from Bali and a warm gourmand vanilla accord. The fragrance is housed in the iconic "le Sourire de Cristal" bottle, whose shape is reminiscent of a smile. A grey ribbon on the neck symbolises freedom. This version of the eau de parfum spray is refillable, enabling a more conscious use of resources. The bottle can be easily refilled at home: The spray attachment is unscrewed, the refill is put on and the filling process stops automatically as soon as the bottle is full. For optimum development, the perfume is applied to warm areas of skin such as the wrists or décolleté. Fragrance composition with iris pallida, patchouli and a gourmand vanilla accord. Iconic glass bottle "le Sourire de Cristal" (the crystal smile). Refillable design for reduced material consumption. Simple refill mechanism with automatic stop.

listings.rawTitle: Liquides Imaginaires Les Eaux Imaginaire Eau de Parfum Spray Île Pourpre 50 ml
listings.description: The olfactory journey to the "purple island" begins with an unusual, green freshness. Shiso leaves combine with the fine acidity of Italian bergamot and the subtle spiciness of ginger in the top note, while angelica seeds and incense add the first aromatic accents. The characteristic, dark fruity aroma of black fig then unfolds at the centre of the composition. This heart note is given a complex and multi-layered depth by the addition of fenugreek, davana and iris. The eau de parfum is supported by a solid base of cedar, patchouli and cashmeran, which is rounded off with ambroxan and provides a woody finish. As part of the Les Eaux Imaginaire collection, this creation represents the artisanal expertise of the Parisian brand Liquides Imaginaires. The design also emphasises its mystical character: the cylindrical bottle has a dark red body emblazoned with the silver lettering "ÎLE POURPRE". A solid silver cap with an engraved diamond pattern on the neck of the bottle completes the overall aesthetic look of this unisex fragrance produced in France. Fragrance: Aromatic and spicy with a distinctive note of black fig and shiso. Collection: Part of the Les Eaux Imaginaire line from Liquides Imaginaires. Design: Dark red glass bottle with silver cap and diamond engraving. Base: Warm accords of cedar, patchouli, cashmeran and ambroxan. Origin: High-quality eau de parfum, made in France.

listings.rawTitle: Jean-Charles Brosseau Ombre Rose Eau de Toilette Spray L'Original 30 ml
listings.description: Ombre Rose L'Original by Jean-Charles Brosseau is a classic fragrance that has captivated with its timeless elegance since its launch in 1981. Created by perfumer Françoise Caron, the composition unfolds as a subtle, floral-powdery experience. The opening is characterised by a blend of aldehydes, rosewood, peach and geranium. The heart of the fragrance combines a rich floral bouquet of rose, ylang-ylang, violet and lily of the valley with the characteristic note of orris root. Sandalwood and cedarwood add a soft, woody facet. The base anchors the composition with the warmth of musk, tonka bean, honey and a hint of vanilla, giving the eau de toilette a sophisticated character. With its moderate fragrance intensity, it is a suitable companion for the day at any time of year. Timeless, floral-powdery fragrance character Created in 1981 by the perfumer Françoise Caron Complex fragrance pyramid with rose, iris root, sandalwood and warm base notes Moderate intensity, suitable for everyday use

The Eau de Toilette Spray Girl by Rochas is clearly perceptible, but not overpowering or heavy. This all-rounder is for you Girl is a women's fragrance that really always works. The eau de toilette spray scores just as well in your free time as it does at work, in the evening or when going out. No matter where you go, Rochas Girl will accompany you. After all, the fragrance is aimed at all women who go through life in a relaxed manner, who can laugh at themselves and who feel just as comfortable in jeans as they do in a dress. With this fragrance, you appear groomed and elegant , but also casual and casual . And because it is a Rochas Eau de Toilette, it also offers that certain luxury.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Dolce Eau de Toilette Spray Rose 50 ml
listings.description: Dolce&Gabbana Beauty adds another flower to the Dolce bouquet: DOLCE ROSE. The lively and beguiling eau de toilette shows the world another facet of the Dolce girls. Bold, optimistic and sociable, they say what they think and light up the streets with their feminine spontaneity. Dolce Rose captures this carefree joy in a fragrance that is as powerful and spirited as any Dolce Girl. The first eau de toilette in the Dolce collection, Dolce Rose celebrates the queen of flowers, a symbol of love, beauty and femininity and a signature motif in Dolce&Gabbana's work. Created by master perfumer Violaine Collas, the fragrance combines delicate rose absolute and fresh centifolia notes with soft musk and tangy redcurrant. Full of energy and joie de vivre, Dolce Rose is an irresistibly enchanting composition. Intense fruity top notes open the composition in a triad of fresh green apple, juicy mandarin and tangy redcurrant. In the heart note, white peach appeals to our sense of taste and opens our senses to a floral bouquet of velvety magnolia blossoms and majestic roses. The unique character of the fragrance is created from a composition of two rose notes: The dewy clarity of a centifolia essence combines with the soft sensuality of rose absolute to create an unmistakable rose fragrance. This powerful note is embedded in a mantle of soft musk tones, to which sandalwood and other noble light wood notes lend a beguilingly sensual quality. The bottle shares its soft curves and elegantly feminine silhouette with the original Dolce fragrance, but now dips its glass in a rose-red colour in which the eponymous blossom seems to glow. The unmistakable flower cap is now also dressed in a bold red colour that expresses the personality of the Dolce girl and the fascinating facets of the fragrance.

As the fragrance progresses, a multi-layered heart unfolds, combining classic floral accords of white jasmine, rose and violet with the delicate nuances of hibiscus and heliotrope to create a harmonious bouquet. The complex base note, which combines the woody depth of sandalwood and cedarwood with incense, labdanum and a velvety suede accord and musk, ensures a long-lasting and warm finish. The design of the bottle picks up on this clear line visually: A slender, rectangular glass body with rounded corners and pale yellow contents is topped by a cylindrical cap with a textured, gold-coloured surface. On the front, the characteristic gold-coloured crocodile logo is emblazoned on a vertical label, discreetly underlining the affiliation with the brand. Created by Olivier Cresp, this fragrance stands for an understated elegance that radiates creativity and a sense of style. Fragrance family: Floral-woody with musky nuances Top notes: Combination of freesia, black pepper and green apple Base: Warm accords of sandalwood, incense and suede Design: Elegant glass bottle with gold-coloured accents and crocodile logo

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Murakami Eau de Parfum Spray Pink Limited Edition / 50 ml
listings.description: Welcome to the dream world of Daisy Murakami Pink Limited Edition: an eau de parfum that transports you to an enchanting garden where fantasy and Murakami's flowers blossom. A creamy gourmand take on classic floral elegance, this fragrance invites you to experience the playful, iconic Marc Jacobs' Daisy as a surreal interpretation of Takashi Murakami's colourful universe. The fragrance, which belongs to the floral gourmand family with creamy, delicate, playfully sweet notes, opens with a soft, sun-kissed note of coconut that instantly transports you to a place full of warmth and far away from everyday life. A delicate white peony unfolds in the heart note, providing a seductive, floral freshness and feminine grace. The base note of smooth nougat lets the fragrance linger with a sense of well-being, charm and gentle sweetness. Elegant but unexpected, Daisy Murakami Pink is the fragrance equivalent of a pastel-coloured daydream. Ideal for a day out, a brunch in the countryside or simply to add a playful, sophisticated touch to everyday life. The bottle is a collector's item that celebrates artistic creativity. It shines in bright pink and is the epitome of a perfect combination: Murakami's vibrant, signature flower and Marc Jacobs' iconic Daisy design, interpreting the classic silhouette of Daisy in a way that is both timeless and exciting. Created in collaboration between Marc Jacobs, Takashi Murakami and Coty, this unique piece embodies the essence of two artistic icons blossoming together in imaginative splendour. Daisy Murakami Pink is more than a perfume - it is a carefree expression of art, fragrance and fantasy. Let it enchant you and bring colour and joie de vivre into your world. Enjoy a unique gourmand invitation to enter Murakami's surreal garden of blooming flowers, where creamy coconut is enhanced by delicate white peony. Classic floral elegance with an unexpected, charming twist in limited edition pink.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Murakami Eau de Parfum Spray Blue Limited Edition / 50 ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Daisy Murakami Blue is a fragrance full of energy and joy. It is a limited edition eau de parfum that combines lively fruity, floral and cosy base notes to create a fragrance that is both playful and sophisticated. A colourful journey into the surreal floral world of Takashi Murakami. The fragrance, which belongs to the fruity-floral fragrance family with radiant, gently sensual notes, opens with a sparkling medley of pear, apple and orange - lively, fruity and absolutely invigorating. A lush, floral bouquet unfolds in the heart notes: delicate white peony, raspberry, rose absolute, lychee and a hint of geranium to give the fragrance depth and charm. The fragrance ends with a warm base note of nougat, musk and amberwood, which provide warmth and softness. A fragrance that lingers on the skin for a long time. A fragrance that captures the feeling of biting into an incredibly juicy fruit on a summer's day - fresh, sweet and absolutely irresistible. Wear it when you want to feel confident, fun-loving and special with a little twist. The bottle is a collector's item for fragrance lovers. Shining in bright blue and topped with Murakami's iconic flowers, it transforms the original design of Marc Jacobs Daisy into a pop art highlight. Designed by Marc Jacobs and Takashi Murakami in collaboration with Coty, the bottle symbolises the perfect combination of eccentricity and expressive artistry - an invitation to play, dream and blossom. With Daisy Murakami Blue, fragrance becomes a statement. Let it transport you to a supernatural flower garden where every splash is a splash of colour - and every moment is full of possibilities.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Murakami Eau de Parfum Spray Green Limited Edition / 50 ml
listings.description: Sun-ripened banana, luminous jasmine and creamy vanilla come together in a fruity gourmand fragrance that is as unexpected as it is irresistible. It is inspired by Murakami's artistic universe: bright colours, playful motifs and a feeling of pure joie de vivre come to life. Just as Murakami's art combines tradition and modernity, this fragrance combines classic, floral elegance with an unexpected, playful twist. Radiant floral, fruity and seductive facets make this playful but finely balanced fragrance composition an olfactory experience and give rise to a lively, modern scent. A striking, unexpected fragrance where delicate, sophisticated nuances of banana meet a warm, luminous amber note to create a perfume that is as irresistibly fun-loving as it is effortlessly elegant. What makes this fragrance so unique is the expressive composition with banana, brought to life by the Blue Java banana accord. This unexpected fruity accord transforms a familiar note into something playful, modern and sophisticated, giving the composition a creamy, almost surreal feel. A bold fragrance statement - vibrant, seductive and unforgettable. The bottle, designed by Marc Jacobs and Takashi Murakami in collaboration with Coty, is a reinterpretation of the classic Daisy bottle in bright green, in which the radiant Marc Jacobs Daisy icon and the imaginative world of Murakami merge.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Murakami Eau de Parfum Spray Yellow Limited Edition / 50 ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in a garden beyond reality, where fantasy blossoms and flowers give you a smile. The Marc Jacobs Daisy Murakami Yellow Limited Edition Eau de Parfum is an imaginative meeting of two iconic worlds: the playful Daisy world of Marc Jacobs and the vibrant flowers of Takashi Murakami. The fragrance, which belongs to the floral-fruity family, is sweet and earthy with radiant citrus accents. A citrusy cocktail with a tangy note, the fragrance opens with a sparkling scent of mandarin, grapefruit, pink pepper and kumquat. In the heart note, delicious strawberry and raspberry merge with delicate gardenia and fresh rosebud to create an enchanting, floral-fruity bouquet. A warm base note of cedarwood and nougat provides earthy depth and allows the radiant fragrance to linger with gentle sensuality. Composed for moments of optimism and wonder, this fragrance is your invitation to see the world through a more colourful lens. Whether on golden afternoons or dreamy evenings, it adds a cheerful and charming touch to all occasions. The bottle has the charm of a coveted collector's item. Designed in sunny yellow and adorned with a veritable firework of colourful flowers, it pays homage to Murakami's iconic floral motifs while celebrating Daisy's classic silhouette. Jointly developed by Marc Jacobs, Takashi Murakami and Coty, this is more than a fragrance - it is a work of art. Daisy Murakami Yellow is a fragrance that combines the magic of iconic art with the sophistication of masterful perfumery. Let yourself be transported to a blooming, supernatural world where fragrance becomes a spectacle and joy never fades.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Chloé Eau de Parfum Spray Rose Naturelle Refillable / 100 ml
listings.description: Chloé Eau de Parfum Spray Rose Naturelle is a modern tribute to the timeless elegance of the rose, captured in a vegan fragrance. Created by perfumer Michel Almairac, the fragrance centres on the iconic Chloé rose, which is imbued with a lively lightness thanks to fresh notes of neroli and zesty lemon accents. Hints of blackcurrant and delicate mimosa complement the floral heart, before a base of warm cedarwood lends the fragrance a woody depth. The formulation consists of 100 per cent naturally derived fragrance notes, naturally sourced alcohol and water, with a deliberate absence of filters and artificial colourants. This conscious approach is also reflected in the design: The bottle is partly made from recycled glass, the hand-tied ribbon is 100 per cent recycled, and the outer packaging is also made partly from recycled cardboard. Furthermore, the perfume is refillable to promote sustainability. A woody-floral fragrance with rose, neroli and cedarwood. Vegan formulation with 100% naturally derived fragrance notes. listings.description: Christina Aguilera Violet Noir Eau de Parfum Spray is a vibrant women's fragrance with sensual tonka beans, sweet honey and exotic lychees. Lovely fragrance with a mysterious oriental undertone Christina Aguilera is not only a world-famous singer, but has also been successfully launching fragrances on the market since 2004. The Violet Noir Eau de Parfum Spray has been available since 2014 and enchants with a combination of sweet and fruity notes with mysterious tonka beans. The fragrance is suitable for women who prefer very feminine arrangements and go through life carefree and cheerful. Christina Aguilera Violet Noir Eau de Parfum Spray is based on a base of warm sandalwood and ambergris, which merge with oriental tonka beans. In the heart note, precious roses meet delicate magnolia and violet leaves, which are given a seductively sweet accent by sweet honey. The top note provides refreshment and contains juicy pears, exotic lychees and invigorating bergamot. A pinch of pink pepper gives the creation a slight spiciness that symbolises passion, sensuality and temperament.

listings.rawTitle: Christina Aguilera Eau So Beautiful Eau de Parfum Spray 15 ml
listings.description: Christina Aguilera Eau de Parfum Spray - Product Information You are beautiful - who doesn't know the unmistakable hit by Christina Aguilera? Her new fragrance Eau So beautiful is just as unmistakable as her number 1 hit: the Eau de Parfum Spray is fruity and fresh and is reminiscent of a wonderful day in summer after a refreshing rain shower - a fragrance like a flower child: rich, soft and full of energy and strength. All the scents of a warm, clear summer's day are combined in this fragrance. The top notes of wild strawberry, pomelo and violet provide freshness, while the heart notes of white petals such as jasmine, lily of the valley, gardenia and magnolia create a soft, gentle aroma. The base is a warm blend of vanilla, sandalwood and musk for the grounding aspects of this extraordinary fragrance. Application Spray one or two pumps of Eau So beautiful on the pulse points of your skin, e.g. on the inside of your wrists and on the soft areas behind your ears, and the day can begin. A small spritz of the perfume on your hair envelops you in a warm, fruity and fresh cloud of fragrance for the whole day without being overpowering - for more freshness, cheerfulness and energy!

listings.rawTitle: Lalique Amethyst Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Lalique Amethyst Eau de Parfum Spray combines the tradition of French glass art with a modern, fruity-floral fragrance signature. Created by perfumer Nathalie Lorson, the composition opens with a striking top note in which the intense aromas of blackberry, blackcurrant and raspberry unfold. These fruity accents are complemented by the fresh green of blackberry leaves before the fragrance slowly transitions into a floral heart. The floral nuances of wild rose, peony and ylang-ylang meet in the heart note, which is given an interesting structure and depth by a subtle pepper nuance. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a soft base of musk, vanilla and woody accords, which lend the perfume a pleasant persistence. The product also reflects the history of the brand visually: the striking, purple glass bottle is based on the design of René Lalique's famous "Épines" bathroom accessories from 1920 and is decorated with stylised vine motifs and floral patterns. Handmade in France, this eau de parfum stands for a harmonious balance between lively freshness and elegant warmth. Fragrance: A fruity-floral composition with a base of musk and wood. listings.rawTitle: Lalique Encre Noire Sport Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Get to know Encre Noire Sport by Lalique The eau de toilette spray from Lalique's new men's fragrance has only been produced since 2013. Naturally, the same standards are applied to Lalique fragrances as to all other products. The flavours and fragrance components of Encre Noire Sport also come from sustainable cultivation . The top notes are grapefruit, cypress, lavender and bergamot. The rich heart of the eau de toilette spray boasts nutmeg, bourbon vetiver, Haitian vetiver and aquatic accords. The strong yet gentle base of the men's fragrance by Lalique is characterised by musk and cashmere wood. Encre Noire Sport thus sets out to conquer the hearts of many men. The gentle yet very spicy fragrance is not only particularly good for sports, the eau de toilette spray is also the perfect companion for everyday working life and leisure time.

Lalique Soleil Vibrant Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Lalique launched the Eau de Parfum Spray Soleil Vibrant in 2022. The sweet and creamy fragrance is for women and was created by Nathalie Lorson and Alexandra Monet. For the top notes, they blend the flavours of juicy pears with delicate Corsican clementines and bergamot. The floral heart note combines Indian jasmine sambac absolute, orange blossom and delicate saffron. Aromatic bourbon vanilla absolute and cedarwood form the base. The elegant, feminine, sensual creation comes in an enchanting flacon that is intricately designed like a flower and has a clear golden colour gradient. You immediately want to pick it up and apply the fragrance. All-rounder for warm days and evenings It is not at all difficult to see the sun shining in a summer sky and spreading good humour in the Soleil Vibrant Eau de Parfum Spray by Lalique. The fragrance emphasises the personality of its wearer and her casual yet elegant manner. The woman who wears Soleil Vibrant feels just as feminine in jeans and trainers as she does in a summer dress or an elegant outfit at work. With this eau de parfum spray, Lalique proves that a feminine fragrance does not have to be overly opulent or even heavy to be absolutely feminine .

listings.rawTitle: Lalique L'amour Eau de Parfum Vaporisateur 30 ml
listings.description: Lalique L'amour Eau de Parfum Vaporisateur : This perfume is a sensual tribute to the land of the rising sun, whilst also celebrating femininity at the same time too. When designing the atomiser, the designers derived their inspiration from the unbridled creativity of René Lalique, who designed four magnificent glass doors for the Japanese Imperial Palace alongside other truly masterful creative achievements. The fragrance reflects the rich sensual pleasure of a woman as clearly and with as many facets as the reflective surface of a lake in the summertime on a dreamy June afternoon. The lavish scents of tuberose, gardenia and jasmine superimpose onto the delicate yet spicy base of cedar wood and musk extracts. Rose chords, a touch of neroli and essential bergamot float over the top in a light and elusive manner. And the overall verdict? With Lalique L'amour Eau de Parfum Vaporisateur, you are buying a fragrance for women that celebrates your femininity in a vivid yet discreet manner.

listings.rawTitle: Lalique Rêve d'Infini Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Rêve d'Infini by Lalique is a fragrance that could hardly be more contrasting: Dazzling cheerfulness and freshness are combined with sensuality and hints of melancholy . This eau de parfum spray is like a bouquet of fresh flowers. Fragrance composer Richard Ibanez has put together the finest fragrances to create an incomparable ensemble: Bergamot, freesia, lychee, jasmine - a dream of summer and passion. Rêve d'Infini by Lalique is a queen among fragrances. However, the eau de parfum spray is not content with fruity notes, but culminates in an incredibly feminine, sensual note: rose absolute, combined with peach and cedarwood, makes this perfume so unmistakable - spicy and striking and yet mild and gentle . A velvety vanilla scent joins in delicately, soothing and at the same time arousing curiosity. This perfume has the potential to become a classic fragrance that will not go out of fashion any time soon. Rêve d'Infini is an eau de parfum spray from Lalique that is a pleasant accompaniment to any occasion. The bottle is also a feast for the eyes: Elegant design meets purist modernity , a piece of jewellery for any dresser. Lalique fragrances are a tribute to femininity. Give this perfume to your best friend, your loved one - or simply to yourself.

listings.rawTitle: Lalique Encre Noire à L'Extrême Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Encre Noire à l'Extrême was composed as a homage to a classic fragrance by Lalique. For approximately ten years the men’s fragrance Encre Noire has fascinated with its masculine sophistication due to the presence of vetiver . The new fragrance for men follows the same olfactory strategy. A trio composed of bergamot, cypress and elemi opens the bouquet as spicy and fresh before a masculine accord of vetiver asserts itself. Insense and iris join before the base note completes the Eau de Parfum Spray Encre Noire à l'Extrême with benzoin, patchouli and sandalwood. Pure luxury from Paris Lalique is able to look back on a long tradition. The company had established itself as far back as the 19th century with exquisite jewellery and fascinating works of art made of crystal glass. The perfumes are oriented towards the exceptional reputation and luxurious character of the company. It is not only the olfactory compositions that impress with extraordinary sophistication. An excellent aesthetic also distinguishes the flaçons which are coveted by collectors. In line with the masculine clarity of the fragrance, the French brand has chosen a minimalist design in elegant black.

listings.description: Lalique de Lalique was the first fragrance range created in-house by the perfume house Lalique in 1992, and has continued to mesmerise ever since. A radiant and feminine fragrance with a floral top note and a delicately fruity heart. Chords of vanilla and musk give it its seductively radiant feel.

listings.rawTitle: Lalique Lalique White Eau de Parfum Spray White in Black 125 ml
listings.description: In 2021, the White in Black Eau de Parfum Spray will be released as an addition to the Lalique White range. The Lalique fragrance is sweet and resinous and was created by Karine Dubreuli-Sereni. It features incense with grapefruit and Italian bergamot in the top notes. Provençal lavender opens the heart note, where it meets pink pepper, cardamom and elemi resin. Finally, patchouli, tolu balsam, white cedarwood, vanilla and ambroxan are used in the base. White in Black is an eau de parfum spray that is masculine and sexy , luxurious and elegant . It not only impresses fans of the Lalique White range, it also has unique olfactory characteristics. Sensuality for men, with an aromatic sweetness The White in Black Eau de Parfum Spray by Lalique shows its quality especially in autumn and winter, in the evening and when going out. It gently emphasises the personality of its wearer. It is masculine and present without overwhelming the wearer and exudes a calm sophistication. One should not make the mistake of confusing this fragrance with the Lalique White Eau de Toilette. It is the same Lalique range, but a completely different fragrance. It is best to convince yourself of its charisma, which goes just as well with a suit as it does with jeans and a shirt.

listings.description: Lanvin Arpege is a precious fragrance with a long tradition. Jeanne Lanvin created this fragrance back in 1927. The floral-feminine composition was reinterpreted in 1993. The result is a fragrance that combines the uniqueness of the original with the demands of a modern luxury perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Lanvin Éclat d‘Arpège Eau de Toilette Spray Sheer 100 ml
listings.description: The Éclat d'Arpège Sheer eau de toilette spray comes from Lanvin's Éclat collection. It was launched in 2020 and features a floral and fruity fragrance for women. In a pearl-like bottle with a silver cap, you will find a delicate, feminine and elegant fragrance that is light and carefree. Created for summer, Éclat d'Arpège Sheer Eau de Toilette Spray has top notes of lotus leaves, mandarin and dragon fruit. Water jasmine, lily of the valley and peony make up the floral heart note. Finally, white musk, amber and cedarwood complete the subtle composition. More than a hint, so wonderfully subtle and yet present Anyone expecting an olfactory bomb will certainly be disappointed by Éclat d'Arpège Sheer. But those who like it decent, light and sophisticated will love this eau de toilette spray. It is the perfect companion for both work and leisure. Lanvin shows that summer fragrances literally score with lightness. This fragrance is romantic and mature , light and elegant, feminine and wonderfully wearable. And it puts you in a good mood. Let yourself be seduced by Lanvin and the lightness of the Eau de Toilette Spray Éclat d'Arpège Sheer by getting to know the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Laura Biagiotti Laura Eau de Toilette Spray 25 ml
listings.description: The women's fragrance by Italian fragrance artist Laura Biagiotti impresses with a fruity top note created by the addition of lychee and watermelon. This is rounded off by a woody and somewhat tart base created by sandalwood. To ensure that the fragrance remains floral, there is a secondary base note of vanilla, which is rounded off by the floral heart note of peach and rose . The result is an eau de toilette spray that is ideal for spring and summer thanks to its lightness. The traditional fragrance for every occasion The eau de toilette spray is a perfume that lives from its effervescence and lightness. This lightness, which Laura Biagiotti also enjoyed during her childhood, is perfectly reflected in the women's fragrance from the "Laura" range. The perfume comes in either a 25 ml, 50 ml or 75 ml bottle with a gold and blue decorated lid and an oval shape. Due to the similar fragrances, it can be perfectly complemented with other "Laura" products.

listings.rawTitle: Laura Biagiotti Nero Estremo Eau de Parfum Intense 40 ml
listings.description: A fragrance that captures the many facets of a Roman night: Laura Biagiotti Roma Uomo Nero Estremo is an Eau de Parfum Intense with a woody-spicy character. The fragrance opens with an invigorating freshness of bergamot and winter lemon, complemented by the distinctive note of Belanis®. At its heart, a harmonious blend of geranium, lavandin and clary sage unfolds, lending the fragrance an aromatic depth. The base notes round off the olfactory experience with warm and earthy accords. listings.description: Eau de toilette for modern women The Ambrosia Aurea Eau de Toilette Spray AQVE ROMANE by Laura Biagiotti is available at parfumdreams.de. The pretty, fluted 100 ml glass bottle with a simple, silver-coloured spray head contains a high-quality perfume for women. The floral, woody fragrance exudes a touch of mysticism. The magic of ancient Rome can be felt, mixed with elegance and self-confidence. A pleasant, light perfume that modern women can wear on almost any occasion. The creation from the Aqve Romane series by Laura Biagiotti is a great success as Ambrosia Aurea Eau de Toilette Spray. Harmoniously complementary fragrance nuances create a great effect This Ambrosia Aurea Eau de Toilette Spray by Laura Biagiotti is characterised by the perfect combination of interesting fragrance notes. The top note offers a blend of soft camomile, floral narcissus, fruity, fresh orange and soft, sweet vanilla. The heart note combines spicy angelica with earthy, woody carrot and sweet lily. Relaxation and romance are combined with aphrodisiac aspects. Chestnut, musk and tonka bean play their part in the base note. In the end, the enchanting flair of romance flickers around again, combined with a powerful zest for life, self-confidence and a feeling of new wisdom. Aqve Romane - perfume created for the clever ladies!

listings.rawTitle: Otto Kern Signature Man Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Signature Man extends the range launched by Otto Kern in 2008. The fragrance is naturally for men and has a masculine elegance . An unnamed fragrance artist has created a top note of cardamom, bergamot and artemisia for the spicy, creamy fragrance . The heart note continues with the flavours of lavender and cinnamon, which are complemented by orange blossom. Finally, tonka beans and musk are wrapped in fine leather. Signature Man by Otto Kern is an eau de parfum spray that appeals to all men who want to appear well-groomed but not obtrusive. And the fragrance fulfils precisely these requirements with an almost careless lightness . All-rounder with signature potential Of course, if an eau de parfum spray is called Signature Man, it must also be a signature fragrance. Far from it. But Otto Kern has succeeded in doing just that. After all, the eau de parfum spray fits just as well in leisure time with jeans and a shirt as it does at work with a suit and tie and everything in between. The men's fragrance is clearly perceptible, but does not impose itself, a fact that not only the wearers of Otto Kern Signature Man like. And if you are already a fan of the eau de toilette spray, you will be even more so now.

The base note provides a solid finish, combining the resinous tones of cistus with creamy vanilla and tonka bean to create a warm accord. This fragrance is part of the fougère family and is characterised by an interplay of synthetic, sweet and fruity accents. The composition was designed for an elegant and intense radiance that reflects the character of the Gentle Man's Code line. A grooved, cylindrical cap harmoniously rounds off the visual appearance of the spray. Nuxe Le Matin des Possibles Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
Glamfume White Heaven Beach Men Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: "Dance with the waves, move with the sea. Let the rhythm of the water set your soul free." They still exist, the small wonders of this earth - and we love them precisely because they are so hidden and so fantastically beautiful. The best place to get to from Hamilton Island is the 8-kilometre-long Whitehaven Beach, a beach on the east coast of Australia's Whitsunday Island. With a quartz content of almost 99%, it is considered one of the whitest beaches in the world and is one of the ecological highlights and cleanest beaches in the world. With a bit of luck, you can swim with giant turtles and dolphins in this wonderful place. Magically attracted and moved by the irresistibly beautiful nature here, Chris and Criss are overwhelmed by a state of tense calm that turns into a feeling of deep emotion and peaceful gratitude. What the two of them experience here cannot be put into words. Bliss and humility are the best words to describe their feelings. If the colours in this memory were fragrant, it would be crystal turquoise, quartz silver, ultramarine and heart red. Pure, timeless and indescribably beautiful. Chris and Criss have captured this unique spectacle of colours in the new fragrance duo WHITE HEAVEN BEACH. The design of the bottles reflects the purist approach of Whitehaven Beach. The white bottle is reminiscent of the glistening sandy beaches, while the rose gold symbolises the special light of the sun. And the silver is reminiscent of the wild waters of the neighbouring ocean. WHITE HEAVEN BEACH MEN is an exciting, refreshing attitude to life in a perfume bottle. Stimulating and calming at the same time, like a natural spectacle that hypnotically casts its spell over us. The top note consists of the energetic aromas of white grapefruit, geranium and bergamot blossom with woody fragrance accords. The heart of the fragrance is characterised by aquatic notes that capture the mood of WHITE HEAVEN BEACH MEN and are rounded off with a hint of oriental patchouli. Masculine amber paired with vetiver and an accord of white leather paired with labdanum give the fragrance an attractive power - which is irresistible to many women.

The delicate blend of zesty raspberry leaves, elegant Turkish rose and warm suede musk creates an appealing aura that lasts all day long. Thanks to the handy spray, you can apply the fragrance effortlessly and precisely to the pulse points on your neck and wrists. There, the individual fragrance notes unfold particularly intensely thanks to your natural body heat. This versatile creation discreetly accompanies you through your everyday life, whether at the office or in your free time. At the same time, in the evening on special occasions, the perfume elegantly emphasises your individual style. A stylish glass bottle with the brand’s signature details safely preserves the fragrance essence and feels comfortable in the hand. With just a few sprays, you can add a special, fragrant touch to your look that skilfully highlights your personality. A floral-fruity fragrance composition for an appealing aura A practical atomiser allows for precise and effortless application Versatile for everyday wear and special occasions Intense fragrance release when applied to pulse points Easy to use thanks to the functional bottle design

listings.rawTitle: Widian Sapphire Collection Eau de Parfum Spray New York 50 ml
listings.description: A tribute to the pulsating energy of a global metropolis, captured in an extrait de parfum. Widian New York from the Sapphire Collection unfolds as a multi-layered composition that begins with sparkling notes of Italian bergamot, mandarin and lemon. This fresh opening is complemented by the subtle spice of pink pepper, coriander and juniper. At the heart of the fragrance, a floral bouquet of rose, jasmine and iris combines with the depth of Indonesian patchouli and a hint of caramel. The base anchors the creation with warm and earthy accents. Notes of vetiver, white musk, amber, vanilla and tonka bean merge with a subtle hint of tobacco and olibanum to create a harmonious and long-lasting fragrance experience. The unisex perfume is presented in an artfully designed blue bottle, which is decorated with golden details and visually reflects the essence of the fragrance. Fragrance family: floral amber Concentration: Extrait de Parfum Character: Complex, warm, spicy Head notes: Bergamot, mandarin, pink pepper Base notes: Vetiver, white musk, tobacco

listings.rawTitle: Widian Sapphire Collection Extrait de Parfum Aswan 50 ml
listings.description: The Aswan extrait de parfum from Widian's Sapphire Collection pays homage to the ancient beauty and cultural heritage of Egypt. The composition opens with a sparkling note of Italian bergamot, accompanied by the light spiciness of pink pepper and the fruity sweetness of raspberry. The powdery accents of violet leaves unfold in the heart, meeting the woody warmth of Virginia cedarwood and amber-like facets. The base rounds off the fragrance experience with a deep and complex blend of leather, musk and tobacco, complemented by the earthy tones of patchouli and the gentle sweetness of vanilla and coumarin. The fragrance presents itself as an elegant and charming creation, captured in a bottle with an intense blue gradient and golden embellishments that reflect the character of the contents. A fragrance composition inspired by the historic city of Aswan on the Nile . Combines fruity top notes with a heart of woody accents and a base of leather, tobacco and vanilla. Presented as a highly concentrated extrait de parfum. Bottled in an elegant bottle with a blue colour gradient and golden details.

listings.rawTitle: Widian Limited Collection Extrait de Parfum Limited 71 50 ml
listings.description: Inspired by 1971, the year the United Arab Emirates was founded, Widian presents Limited 71 as an exclusive extrait de parfum. This creation, limited to 900 bottles worldwide, is a unisex fragrance that combines opulence and mystery in a complex composition. The fragrance experience opens with a fresh and aromatic top note of bergamot, sage and lavender. A warm and spicy melange unfolds in the heart, combining bay leaf, dry amber, akigalawood and velvety cashmeran. The base note anchors the fragrance with a deep and long-lasting presence of noble oud, earthy patchouli, amber and vetiver. The result is a balanced, warm and resinous fragrance character with a velvety texture. The luxurious impression is underlined by the elegantly curved glass bottle, which is a visual highlight with its gentle colour gradient and golden lettering. A warm, spicy and resinous unisex fragrance . Complex composition with bergamot, amber, oud and patchouli. Highly concentrated extrait de parfum. Limited edition of 900 pieces worldwide.

listings.rawTitle: Widian Limited Collection Extrait de Parfum Luban 50 ml
listings.description: The Luban Extrait de Parfum from Widian's Limited Collection is part of the exquisite series of high-quality fragrance nuances. Exceptional, extravagant, sophisticated and high-quality - these are attributes that can be used without question for this perfume. The high quality is reflected in the composition of Luban Extrait de Parfum. The top note consists of pepper, cardamom, bergamot and strawberries. Rose and geranium are used for the heart notes. Amber, oud, musk, cedar, tonka beans and sandalwood are used in the base note of the Widian perfume, creating an unrivalled unisex fragrance . Widian - the extraordinary & extravagant perfume Luban Extrait de Parfum - a fragrance experience that inspires. What's more, the perfume from Belgium not only stands out with its high-quality ingredients . With the elegant shape of the 50 ml pump bottle and the extravagant cap, the label's designers have achieved a great success. The decorated glass with a Widian Luban extrait de perfume engraving in the lower third of the bottle complements the brand's sophisticated style. A fragrance for all the senses - the Limited Collection Women and men alike will enjoy the perfume, which has been delighting lovers of fine fragrances since 2023. The fragrance is woody and fruity with additional creamy, sweet and spicy notes. The Luban Limited Collection contains an oriental-floral fragrance that is sensually accentuated with incense. <p

listings.rawTitle: Widian Velvet Collection Extrait de Parfum Hili 50 ml
listings.description: Hili Extrait de Parfum from the Velvet Collection series by Widian is a special journey into the world of Asian fragrances. The perfume awakens a longing for distant destinations and at the same time offers the opportunity to wear Far Eastern ambience on the skin. It balances the emotions and ensures harmony and well-being for the wearer. The top note contains fresh bergamot as well as the power of cinnamon. The spice is very intense and unfolds all the fragrance notes of the top note. Ylang-ylang stimulates the senses In the heart note, Hili Extrait de Parfum unfolds its floral note with fresh accents and a light sweetness. Ylang-ylang is responsible for this, which unites various fragrance notes on its own and brings them all to the fore in combination with jasmine. Widian has created an unforgettable fragrance with the Velvet Collection perfume. Whether as a gift or for yourself, the perfume lends itself to being worn for various occasions. The base note is dominated by a blend of classic fragrances such as amber, vanilla and cedarwood. What makes Hili Extrait de Parfum so special is the scent of coconut milk. This has a soothing effect and gives the skin a smooth touch.</p

listings.rawTitle: Widian Velvet Collection Extrait de Parfum Baniyas 50 ml
listings.description: The luxury perfumes of the Widian brand are characterised by their home country of Abu Dhabi. They celebrate oriental fragrances and the traditional art of perfumery. At the same time, they build a bridge to the western world. Influences from both cultures can be found in every perfume. With Baniyas Extrait de Parfum, the popular perfume manufacturer presents a sweet and spicy unisex fragrance with oud accents. Baniyas from the Velvet Collection: exquisite fragrance for connoisseurs The Velvet Collection by Widian is inspired by the properties of velvet. It stands for elegance, luxury and sensuality . These qualities are valued equally in Western countries and in the Orient. Velvet therefore stands for luxury that knows no cultural boundaries. Baniyas Extrait de Parfum also succeeds in harmoniously combining oriental and western elements. The Widian creation combines sensual Arabian fragrance notes with cool Western elegance. Refreshing bergamot, lavender blossom and the tart herbal notes of artemisia blend to create an invigorating top note. Geranium meets precious cedarwood in the characterful heart note. The intense scent of oud unfolds and gives the perfume its oriental character. The base note of Baniyas Extraits de Parfum is sensual and warm. It consists of sandalwood, vetiver and patchouli. The mossy, earthy accents of evernyl emphasise the fragrance accord.

listings.rawTitle: Widian Velvet Collection Extrait de Parfum Yasat 50 ml
listings.description: Widian and Yasat Extrait de Parfum - an outstanding combination. With the Velvet Collection, the perfumers have created a graceful and highly effective unisex fragrance for men and women. This fragrance is inspired by faraway destinations that invite you to dream . Housed in a high-quality 50 ml pump bottle, the Widian perfume itself is a special visual feature. The perfume from the Velvet Collection Yasat is the name of an island in Abu Dhabi surrounded by sky-blue waters. Delicately scented flowers and the flair of the coast and fresh sea breeze give the perfume its name. Which ingredients create the unmistakable fragrance experience of Yasat Extrait de Parfum? Firstly, the top note: bergamot and cardamom define this part of the Widian fragrance. The heart note: Cedarwood, sandalwood and caramel round off the fragrance. The final note is a base of amber, vanilla and musk, creating an enchanting fragrance experience. Beautiful packaging completes the luxurious overall impression of the Velvet Collection. Yasat Extrait de Parfum - beguiling and elegant The perfume in the Velvet Collection contains floral and sensual oriental fragrances that transport all users into a magical world of elegance and grace. With the Yasat Extrait de Parfum from Widian, the world of perfume can be experienced anew every day.</p

listings.rawTitle: Widian Rose Arabia Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Almond 100 ml
listings.description: Discover an olfactory treasure with Almond Eau de Parfum Spray from the exclusive Rose Arabia Collection by Widian that enchants the senses and transports you to the fairytale world of the Orient. This masterful perfume creation combines the nobility of precious almonds with the luxurious heritage of Arabian perfumery to create an unforgettable fragrance experience. Fascinating fragrance composition by Widian Almond Eau de Parfum Spray from the Rose Arabia Collection opens with the delicate sweetness of crunchy almonds, whose irresistible nuances immediately captivate the senses. At the heart of the fragrance, precious rose essence and exquisite blossoms merge into a seductive bouquet that celebrates the legendary Rose Arabia in all its splendour. The base notes of precious woods, velvety amber nuances and a hint of oriental spices lend the perfume a mesmerising depth and majestic radiance that lingers on the skin for hours. Luxurious presentation The elegant flacon of Almond Eau de Parfum Spray by Widian is a true work of art and a symbol of the highest craftsmanship and perfect design. The elegant shape with golden accents reflects the value of the precious contents and makes the perfume an exclusive piece of jewellery for your collection. The luxurious presentation emphasises the character of this exceptional fragrance. For connoisseurs and lovers of the extraordinary Almond Eau de Parfum Spray from the Rose Arabia Collection is created for discerning fragrance connoisseurs who are looking for the extraordinary. This distinguished fragrance accompanies self-confident personalities with an understated yet unmistakable aura of elegance and sophistication.</p

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Classic Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Aurelia 100 ml
listings.description: The spicy, aromatic unisex fragrance Giardino Benessere Classic Collection Aurelia Eau de Parfum Spray, launched in 2017, uses olfactory notes to create an impressive painting of the legendary Via Aurelia with a view of the Italian Mediterranean coast. The fascinating composition combines the scent of wild Mediterranean herbs with an impressive synthesis of intensely elegant and subtly sensual components. Like all creations from the Italian cult label of the Terenzi siblings, this perfume is also characterised by the powerful aura of natural essences . A fascinating journey to the Tyrrhenian Mediterranean coast Giardino Benessere Classic Collection Aurelia Eau de Parfum Spray opens with a sparkling fresh sea breeze of juicy Calabrian bergamot. Aromas of dewy thyme, spicy cardamom and nutmeg frame it full of character and give the accord a lot of depth. The heart note of the perfume is decidedly elegant with noble accents of cedar and precious guaiac wood. The fragrance is impressively intensified by artemisa and aromatic mugwort. The delicious tonka bean adds a subtle sensual nuance. The base of Giardino Benessere Classic Collection Aurelia Eau de Parfum Spray picks up on the elegant, sensual flair of the composition. The fragrance ends impressively with a potpourri of bitter-sweet patchouli, spicy coumarin, precious amber and irresistible vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Classic Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Hashabis 100 ml
listings.description: Hashabis Eau de Parfum Spray is one of the fragrances from the Giardino Benessere Classic Collection. It is a unisex fragrance created by the well-known perfumer Paolo Terenzi. He has created a fruity top note of raspberries, blueberries, redcurrants, dewdrops and hemp. Hemp flowers and hemp define the heart note, where they are framed by juniper. Paolo Terenzi uses the scents of musk, cedarwood and allspice for the base. Hashabis Eau de Parfum Spray is therefore a green and spicy fragrance that may require a little courage due to the distinct hemp note. In any case, Paolo Terenzi has once again succeeded in creating a fragrance that is not mainstream and that divides opinion. Courage to be different is rewarded Fragrances from Giardino Benessere are olfactory luxury. They are unusual, sometimes a little provocative or play with the "forbidden". The Hashabis Eau de Parfum Spray from the Classic Collection combines all of these attributes. In spring and summer, you can wear the fragrance during the day and in the evening, in your free time or to go out. After all, the Giardino Benessere label uses the fresh flowers and leaves of the hemp plant, which have a completely different scent. They are fresh, slightly woody and give the Classic Collection Hashabis Eau de Parfum Spray its uniqueness .

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Classic Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Tuberose 100 ml
listings.description: The Tuberose eau de parfum from Giardino Benessere's Classic Collection is a harmonious combination of floral and fruity notes. Visually, the fragrance is characterised by a rectangular, transparent glass bottle that reveals the slightly yellowish liquid and is adorned with a silver cap and a matching round label. The first impression is of a top note that combines fruity accents of ripe apricot and sweet orange with the delicate lightness of water jasmine. As the fragrance develops, the creation reveals its floral centrepiece, which significantly shapes the identity of this perfume. Here, the eponymous tuberose, jasmine, ylang-ylang and gardenia merge into a multi-faceted bouquet. Finally, a solid base gives the composition its stability and depth by bringing together creamy woods such as cedar and guaiac wood with a gentle note of musk. This unisex fragrance was developed by Paolo Terenzi in 2015 and is characterised by a classic, timeless character. The careful coordination of the individual components ensures a balanced fragrance experience that combines woody undertones with the freshness of white flowers without being overpowering. Unisex fragrance with a floral-fruity character and woody accents Top notes of ripe apricot, sweet orange and water jasmine Floral heart with tuberose, jasmine and ylang-ylang Base note with musk, cedarwood and guaiac wood Transparent glass bottle with silver details

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Classic Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Back To Musk 100 ml
listings.description: The Giardino Benessere Back To Musk Eau de Parfum Spray from the Classic Collection is an oriental-spicy unisex fragrance with floral and woody nuances . It is aimed at men and women who enjoy life with confidence and are ready to take on any challenge. The Back To Musk Eau de Parfum Spray fragrance from the Classic Collection by Giardino Benessere offers a rush for the senses. It seductively envelops its wearer in an unmistakable aura - skilfully emphasising individuality. An exclusive perfume that puts the note of musk centre stage The top note is characterised by musk, Bulgarian rose, Calabrian bergamot, saffron and pear. Indian jasmine sambac, ylang-ylang, magnolia, violet, lily of the valley and guaiac wood nestle in the heart notes. The base note combines the sounds of ambergris, Australian sandalwood, musk and Madagascan vanilla blossom to create a profound and unique fragrance experience . This makes Giardino Benessere Back To Musk Eau de Parfum Spray from the Classic Collection a luxurious fragrance far removed from the mainstream . A fascinating fragrance creation in a class of its own, the intensity of which comes into its own in the cooler months of the year. It puts its wearer in a well-deserved spotlight on special occasions and at evening events. The sleek, minimalist glass bottle undoubtedly indicates that this is a glamorous, sophisticated fragrance .

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Classic Collection Extrait de Parfum Spray Sandalo e Mirra 100 ml
listings.description: The Giardino Benessere Sandalo e Mirra Extrait de Parfum Spray offers a harmonious fragrance composition that enriches everyday life with a woody, spicy presence. The top note opens the fragrance experience with a clear blend of bergamot and rose geranium, accompanied by warm cinnamon and nutmeg. This combination provides a pleasant freshness immediately after application. Lavender, teakwood and oakmoss then unfold their aromatic character. Sandalwood and myrrh are the eponymous main elements that characterise the fragrance and lend it a long-lasting depth. Thanks to the high fragrance concentration, just a few sprays are enough to leave a subtle but perceptible impression throughout the day. The gender-neutral profile makes this creation a versatile companion that is just as suitable for the office as it is for special evening events. The simple glass bottle with its silver label and metallic lid elegantly rounds off the overall look. Woody, spicy fragrance composition with central notes of sandalwood and myrrh High fragrance concentration for a long-lasting presence with just a few sprays Versatile, gender-neutral fragrance profile for different occasions Fresh opening with bergamot and rose geranium top notes

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Oud Republic Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: A new extrait de parfum from Pana Dora Sweden will be released in 2023. The fragrance is called Oud Republic, is floral-oriental and was created for men and women. With its above-average longevity and elegant sillage, the fragrance in the signature bottle with the large deer antlers casts a spell over fans of extraordinary fragrances. Created by Ibrahim Al-Zoubi, the Oud Republic extrait de parfum has top notes of grapefruit, thyme, saffron, jasmine and grapefruit. Lavender and cardamom form the spicy opening in the heart note and combine with cypress, amber, Bulgarian rose and woods. Finally, the base frames everything with cedar, fir balsam, sandalwood, musk, amber, vanilla, vetiver and oud. Olfactory luxury with that certain something The name suggests that the fragrance is extreme. And it is. It is extremely fine. Elegant and wonderfully wearable, the Oud Republic extrait de parfum proves that oriental fragrances can also be light. The niche label Pana Dora Sweden has developed a carefree fragrance that is pleasant, that always fits and that is never too much or even overwhelming. Especially in spring, autumn and winter, the Extrait de Parfum Oud Republic by Pana Dora Sweden is a glorious companion for all occasions.

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Moonlight Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Moonlight Eau de Parfum Spray by Pana Dora Sweden is a fascinating fragrance composition that combines sweet gourmand notes with fruity freshness. It opens with juicy mandarin and ripe plum, which then fade into a heart of further fruity nuances, clove leaves, delicate chocolate and peach. In the base, a warm and multi-layered depth unfolds through the interplay of cedarwood, musk and amber. Chords of vanilla, honey and white chocolate lend a creamy sweetness that is rounded off by a fine tobacco note. The unisex fragrance, which was released in 2023, is characterised by above-average longevity and sillage and can be worn all year round. A special detail is the bottle, whose cap in the shape of a deer's head symbolises the Swedish animal kingdom. Sweet-gourmand unisex fragrance from the year 2023 Composition of fruity, chocolaty and woody-spicy notes Above-average longevity and sillage Flacon with iconic stag's head cap

listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Forever Love Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Pana Dora Sweden - the label from the far north has created Forever Love an extra-fresh fragrance with its eau de parfum spray that will not only delight fans of the North. The top notes of bergamot, mandarin, grapefruit, orange blossom and lime are combined with heart notes of ginger and iris, mugwort and geranium as well as lavender and lily of the valley, neroli, mango and melon. The eau de parfum spray also has a base note of amber, vetiver, sandalwood and tonka bean. This high-quality and diverse blend provides the user, whether male or female, with a long-lasting and unique fragrance experience. Forever Love - the exclusive perfume from Pana Dora Sweden Peace, serenity and relaxation, the vastness and beauty of Nordic nature - Pana Dora combines all of this in its fragrance. A unisex fragrance with 100 ml content , which Pana Dora offers in an unusually designed perfume bottle. The cap of the slightly tapered perfume bottle is designed in the shape of a stag's head - an extravagant idea that reflects the understanding of Swedish nature. Forever Love, the eau de parfum spray from Pana Dora Sweden, awakens and revitalises the senses with a variety of citrus fruits, which flow into a powerful aroma. Forever Love is also an ideal fragrance for anyone who favours sweet and sparkling scents.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana L'Impératrice Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Dolce&Gabbana L'Impératrice Eau de Toilette Spray is an exclusive and extraordinary fragrance that is noble, graceful and luxurious . The name translates as "The Empress". There is therefore no doubt that this is an extravagant perfume that envelops women in a distinguished, aristocratic aura . Fruity-sweet notes meet fresh and floral influences and give every woman a romantic, seductive and extremely attractive aura. A touch of decadence is used here as a playful stylistic device. Modern, decadent and elegant - a fragrance with an aristocratic signature Fruity notes of redcurrant, kiwi and rhubarb open the unmistakable fragrance composition in the top note. The heart note is perfectly complemented by the sounds of pink cyclamen and watermelon. The Dolce&Gabbana L'Impératrice Eau de Toilette Spray is rounded off in the base with accords of grapefruit wood, musk and sandalwood. This is where the fragrance gains its depth and intensity. The perfume was launched back in 2009 and released in a new edition in 2020. Due to its lightness , L'Impératrice Eau de Toilette Spray by Dolce&Gabbana is particularly effective in the warmer seasons.
