listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: K by Dolce&Gabbana A new era of masculinity . In an instant, the warm, cosy embrace of K by Dolce & Gabbana evokes the Italian countryside and the Mediterranean midday sun, evoking the fresh, earthy scent of the wooded Tuscan hills. The fragrance invigorates the senses with an intense combination of the citrus freshness of blood orange and Sicilian lime, amber accents of clary sage, sparkling geranium and energising lavender, a fresh hint of juniper berry and a spark of fiery allspice essence. Then a sensual cedarwood note emerges, merging with earthy vetiver before giving way to the sweet spice of patchouli to enhance the intrinsic charisma of the modern king that wears K by Dolce&Gabbana .

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in a world of passion and elegance with the Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Spray. This intensified version of the popular Devotion fragrance is a tribute to the timeless beauty and power of love. With its unique fragrance composition, this perfume takes you on a sensual journey. Intense perfume for intense moments The fragrance profile opens with an aromatic top note of hazelnut, which immediately captivates your senses. The floral elegance of orange blossom unfolds at the heart of the perfume, lending the fragrance a delicate, feminine note. The base note rounds off the composition with warm, sweet vanilla, which ensures a long-lasting, seductive fragrance. The Eau de Parfum Intense Spray by Dolce&Gabbana is characterised by its particularly concentrated formulation, which ensures a long-lasting fragrance. The elegant bottle with its characteristic golden cap is not only a container for the precious fragrance, but also a real piece of jewellery for your dressing table. To optimise the fragrance, it is recommended to apply the perfume to pulse points such as the wrists, neck and décolleté. It is particularly suitable for special occasions and evening events, but also gives you an aura of luxury and sophistication in everyday life. Let yourself be enchanted by the unique combination of nutty, floral and sweet notes. Dolce&Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Spray is more than just a perfume - it is an expression of devotion and elegance that accompanies you throughout the day and emphasises your individual personality.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: With K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum , Dolce&Gabbana Beauty offers a fragrance for men that is as unique as it is sensual . Intense, attractive and sensual at the same time, K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum tells the story of an authentic and modern man. Right from the start, the perfume creates a sparkling opening with the fusion of fresh citrus fruits, tangy blood orange and fine essences of lemon torchio. The fragrance is intensified by a spicy note of cardamom and a hint of pimento essence. A combination of fresh geranium, soothing clary sage and exquisite lavender, refined by the addition of creamy fig milk, brings a hint of delicate sweetness to the heart of this delicate yet powerful fragrance. Finally, a sensual hint of wood, patchouli and vetiver is sprinkled through a warm Nagarmotha wood. K by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum is a woody and spicy fragrance that offers an intimate glimpse into the heart of a modern king.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum Intense 30 ml
listings.description: The One Eau de Parfum Intense is a fascinating reinterpretation of the well-known classic. Perfumer Quentin Bisch is responsible for this composition, which combines tried-and-tested elements with new accents. Bright notes of spicy pink pepper meet the freshness of mandarin and the fruitiness of blackcurrant in the opening. At the centre of the creation is a striking jasmine note that gives the fragrance a distinct floral character. This heart note transitions gently into a persistent base. Here, creamy vanilla and rich amber accords come together to create a harmonious finish. This combination creates an aura of opulence and warmth that remains perceptible for several hours. The high-quality content is also reflected visually. A heavy, rectangular bottle made of amber-coloured glass with clear, rounded edges houses the golden liquid. A wide, shiny metallic cap in a gold tone rounds off the design harmoniously. Black letters on the front provide a clear contrast to the warm colour of the glass and underline the modern elegance of the presentation. The eau de parfum is available in different quantities, such as 50 ml or 100 ml, to suit different needs. Intense reinterpretation of the classic fragrance by Quentin Bisch Composition of pink pepper, jasmine, vanilla and amber Rectangular amber-coloured glass bottle with gold accents Available in different sizes such as 50 ml and 100 ml

listings.rawTitle: KENZO Kenzo Homme Eau de Parfum Spray 60 ml
listings.description: The KENZO HOMME Eau de Parfum Spray by perfumer Quentin Bisch is a woody-maritime fragrance composition. At the centre of the fragrance, a maritime accord combines with the warmth of leather and the earthy depth of patchouli to create a multi-faceted and expressive character. The bottle itself makes a clear statement: inspired by the vertical strength of bamboo, it comes in deep black with bluish nuances. The design of the cap is reminiscent of the diagonal cut of a katana. The concept also takes sustainable aspects into account. The bottle is made from 15% recycled glass and the weight of the glass has been reduced by 23% to allow for 10 ml more perfume in the 110 ml size. The cap saves 34% plastic, while the outer packaging is made from untreated kraft cardboard and FSC®-certified paper. Scent direction: woody-maritime Fragrance notes: Maritime accord, leather, patchouli Design: Bamboo-inspired bottle with a katana-cut cap Sustainability: bottle made from recycled glass and packaging from responsible sources

listings.description: KENZO AMOUR Eau de Parfum is an olfactory interpretation of a journey full of love and gentle impressions. Created by Daphné Bugey in 2006, the fragrance unfolds with delicate notes of cherry and frangipani blossom. listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Pour Femme Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Dolce & Gabbana Pour Femme Eau de Toilette combines a harmonious fragrance composition that exudes both delicate elegance and subtly seductive depth. Floral accents of jasmine and the gentle intensity of orange blossom characterise the heart note and lend the fragrance a floral warmth. A delicious blend of creamy sandalwood, soft vanilla and sweet marshmallow unfolds in the base, which is gently rounded off by the slightly powdery heliotrope. The fragrance embodies a distinctive character that is sensual, caring and passionate in equal measure. Thanks to its deliberate formulation, the eau de toilette is not only a fragrant companion, but also a thoughtful choice. It is free from parabens, silicones and sulphates, contains no oily ingredients or palm oil and is also vegan. These properties make the fragrance experience accessible to more sensitive skin without compromising on quality. A versatile fragrance that can impress in both day and evening situations thanks to its harmonious balance.

listings.description: The floral signature of Dolce&Gabbana Dolce Eau de Parfum stands for elegant romance, with the beauty of Sicily and the gardens covered in a refreshing sea of white flowers forming the sources of inspiration for this decidedly feminine fragrance. Dolce presents itself as a timeless eau de parfum with a mix of glamour, nostalgia and modernity. This elegant composition is presented in a beautiful bottle with a cap reminiscent of the ornate marzipan flowers in the shop windows of Sicilian pastry shops.Dolce announces itself radiantly and explosively with a sweet yet sophisticated top note of neroli and papaya blossom. A lush white amaryllis, used for the first time in perfumery, defines the heart note. Its fragrance is obtained in a process that requires a skill as admirable as skilful embroidery. Musk and cashmeran form a sensual, soft echo in the base note and leave a lasting impression.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Q by Dolce&Gabbana Perfume 30 ml
listings.description: Majestic, seductive and irresistible, Q by Dolce&Gabbana is an eau de parfum that celebrates the essence of modern femininity. In this extraordinary fragrance creation, regal elegance and contemporary sensuality merge into a harmonious unity that lends every wearer an unmistakable aura of strength and grace. The tangy freshness of Sicilian lemons unfolds right at the beginning, merging as if by magic with the seductive sweetness and subtle acidity of juicy cherries. This contrasting interplay in the top note creates a fascinating fragrance experience that emphasises the vibrancy of the composition and enchants the senses. Q by Dolce&Gabbana - a regal perfume composition for self-confident women The sophisticated perfume creation by Dolce&Gabbana is rounded off with intense woody notes that lend depth and strength of character to the base. This masterful balance between freshness and warmth makes Q an unmistakable signature fragrance for all those women who know how to elegantly combine their natural authority with grace. As the crowning glory, a golden crown sits atop the elegant heavy glass bottle, its bright cherry red colour symbolising the power of passion and the energy of love. Every detail of the sophisticated design reflects the royal character of this exquisite fragrance composition from Dolce&Gabbana.</p

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana K by Dolce&Gabbana Perfume 50 ml
listings.description: K by Dolce&Gabbana - a fascinating fragrance composition that embodies masculine elegance in its purest form. In this expressive eau de parfum by Dolce&Gabbana, Mediterranean freshness, aromatic spice and precious woods merge into an irresistible symbiosis. Exclusive perfume by Dolce&Gabbana for the modern man The elegant flacon presents itself like a precious treasure, its striking, handcrafted crown guarding a royal composition. Underneath, the sun-drenched sweetness of Italian blood orange first unfolds, immediately transporting the wearer to a Mediterranean garden and enchanting them with its invigorating freshness. While the citrusy notes of K by Dolce&Gabbana gently fade away, a perfectly balanced liaison of herbaceous, fresh sage and floral, spicy geranium develops at the heart of the fragrance. This aromatic combination creates a sophisticated masculinity that is both powerful and elegant in equal measure. In the depths of the composition, noble cedar and exotic nagarmotha come together in an impressive interplay. This precious root, also known as cypriol, enhances the woody-spicy character of the fragrance and ensures a long-lasting, unforgettable fragrance experience on the skin. K by Dolce&Gabbana thus embodies the perfect choice for the modern gentleman who values timeless elegance and a presence full of character - a seductive fragrance from Dolce&Gabbana that celebrates Italian perfumery craftsmanship at its finest.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Dolce Eau de Parfum Spray Shine 50 ml
listings.description: A sparkling highlight for your grand entrance: this is the Dolce Eau de Parfum Spray Shine from Dolce&Gabbana. A sunny, radiant jewel in perfume form awaits you, both visually and in terms of fragrance. Look forward to a fragrance that is both fruity and floral and will put you in the mood for the beautiful moments of spring! As beautiful as the sun ... and a similar eye-catcher is the Dolce Eau de Parfum Spray Shine with its shiny yellow-gold bottle. As is typical for Dolce&Gabbana, the fragrance is concealed in elegant packaging decorated with a bow. Even at first glance, it recalls the kiss of the sun as it peeks out from between the trees or helps a colourful meadow of flowers to take on its colourful splendour. The composition itself also evokes such a scenario: The fruity mango and grapefruit enchant in the top notes, accompanied by the equally cheerful and fresh quince. Welcomed by such a sparkling fragrance, you will certainly not find your daily tasks difficult. In the heart note, the soft floral accords of jasmine and orange blossom envelop you, wonderfully accentuated by salty notes reminiscent of a holiday. Light woods, musk and sandalwood round off the perfume in a warm and feminine way.

listings.description: The Bvlgari Man Glacial Essence Eau de Parfum Spray is a composition inspired by the unbridled power and pure freshness of the air. This woody fougère fragrance for men, launched in 2020, opens with a sparkling top note of juniper berry, ginger and geranium, reminiscent of an icy breeze. This initial liveliness transitions into an aromatic heart in which the powdery facets of iris combine with the spiciness of artemisia and the warmth of sandalwood. Notes of Alaskan cedarwood, a modern clearwood accord and soft musk provide a persistent and striking base, giving the fragrance a long-lasting signature. This fragrance creation was developed by the renowned master perfumer Alberto Morillas. Made in Italy, the eau de parfum spray embodies a crystalline freshness and powerful radiance. Fragrance direction: Woody fougère fragrance Top notes: juniper berry, ginger and geranium Heart notes: sandalwood, iris and artemisia Base notes: Alaskan cedarwood, clearwood accord and musk Creation by master perfumer Alberto Morillas

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari BVLGARI MAN Eau de Parfum Spray Rain Essence 60 ml
listings.description: The Bvlgari Man Rain Essence Eau de Parfum Spray is like a cleansing downpour that washes away everything old and restores strength for something new. The fragrance comes in a matching silver-transparent bottle, with the luxury manufacturer's brand logo clearly engraved on the lid. The Bvlgari Man Rain Essence Eau de Parfum Spray has a woody, natural and very fresh silhouette , evoking memories of a sudden summer rain. This makes the creation a powerful all-rounder that is equally at home on men in the office, during sport or on any other occasion. Pithy accords masterfully brought together Accords of ripe oranges and green tea open the fragrance of Bvlgari Man Rain Essence Eau de Parfum Spray before it turns into a duet in the heart note: white lotus and musk provide gentle and natural fragrance accents. Mineral accords and guaiac wood form the base note of this fragrance. The combination is sparkling and fresh across all fragrance phases and is also intended to symbolise the modern and self-confident man who does not shy away from adverse conditions but consistently goes his own way.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Rose Goldea Eau de Toilette Spray Blossom Delight 50 ml
listings.description: Bvlgari Rose Goldea Blossom Delight is an eau de toilette spray for women. The fragrance is floral and woody . Launched in 2022, it puts you in a good mood and makes you want summer. After all, Rose Goldea Blossom Delight Eau de Toilette Spray is a perfect fragrance for warm days. Not only in summer, but also in spring and autumn, it is a beautiful companion for everyday life. Unfortunately, Bvlgari does not reveal who is behind the composition, but it is enchanting. It exudes a delicate, feminine elegance that not only suits very young women. Ladies who prefer light fragrances will also love the Rose Goldea Blossom Delight Eau de Toilette Spray. Strength can also be delicate ...and vice versa. The top note begins with the scent of lily of the valley and grapefruit. The heart note continues with peony and rosebuds. White musk and cedarwood skilfully round off the Rose Goldea Blossom Delight Eau de Toilette Spray by Bvlgari. You simply want to wear the fragrance all the time - with a simple T-shirt, jeans and trainers as well as with an airy summer dress. This versatility is simply wonderful. Although the eau de toilette has a delicate presence, it is also a particularly strong fragrance for women .

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Goldea Eau de Parfum Spray 25 ml
listings.description: When Bvlgari launches a women’s fragrance, it’s often impatiently awaited. That was certainly the case with Goldea, the Eau de Parfum Spray which came out in 2015. The round flaçon is comfortable to hold and arouses curiosity about its contents with its simple yet incredibly classy exterior. The flowery sweet scent is clear and deserves its name, as it is truly golden. In order to develop the Goldea Eau de Parfum spray, Bvlgari combined crystal musk, raspberries, orange absolute and bergamot absolute in the top note. In the heart, rare golden musk appears with jasmine and ylang ylang. Precious feminine luxury for your senses The long lasting finish continues to be unusual. Here, amber mixes with patchouli and musk with Egyptian papyrus. This combination of well known and rare aromas makes Goldea a must have for all women who like delicate and elegant perfumes. The Eau de Parfum Spray from Bvlgari is not aimed at young girls, but rather suits women who know themselves and have found their style. The scent is as classy as it is elegant, as delicate as it is present, and not only visually but also olfactorily simply enchanting.

listings.description: When Bvlgari launches a women’s fragrance, it’s often impatiently awaited. That was certainly the case with Goldea, the Eau de Parfum Spray which came out in 2015. The round flaçon is comfortable to hold and arouses curiosity about its contents with its simple yet incredibly classy exterior. The flowery sweet scent is clear and deserves its name, as it is truly golden. In order to develop the Goldea Eau de Parfum spray, Bvlgari combined crystal musk, raspberries, orange absolute and bergamot absolute in the top note. In the heart, rare golden musk appears with jasmine and ylang ylang. Precious feminine luxury for your senses The long lasting finish continues to be unusual. Here, amber mixes with patchouli and musk with Egyptian papyrus. This combination of well known and rare aromas makes Goldea a must have for all women who like delicate and elegant perfumes. The Eau de Parfum Spray from Bvlgari is not aimed at young girls, but rather suits women who know themselves and have found their style. The scent is as classy as it is elegant, as delicate as it is present, and not only visually but also olfactorily simply enchanting.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Aqva pour Homme Marine Aftershave Balm 100 ml
listings.description: Aqva pour Homme Marine aftershave balm by Bvlgari is presented as an intense experience of pure, untouched nature . A spectacular homage to the never ending depths of the ocean, as invigorating as fresh morning dew. Aquatic, fresh, mysterious and profound – bitter orange and mandarin combines with santolina and posidonia. The blend is framed by a bouquet of mineral-rich ambergris and clary sage. This earthy, unadulterated fragrance is the ideal perfume for men who walk their own way and experiences and enjoys nature very intensely. Also suitable with the aftershave balm you can fin the eau de toilette spray, the deodorant stick and the shower gel from the Aqva pour Homme Marine range. Italian brand with Greek roots For more than a hundred years the Bvlgari brand has stood for contemporary Italian style in jewellery making. The company’s success story leads back to the Greek silversmith Sotirio Bulgari who left his homeland at the end of the 19th century to settle in Italy. Today, the luxury brand is one of the most important representatives in its industry. In addition to jewellery and watches the product portfolio now also includes leather and silk accessories, glasses, hotels and perfume such as “Cologne au thé vert” and “Bvlgari pour Femme”.

listings.rawTitle: Bvlgari Pour Homme Soir Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml

No matter whether at work, at home or at an evening event. A perfume with masculine character The eau de toilette spray Pour Homme Soir consists of different essences that create a distinctive fragrance. The woody undertone gives the men’s fragrance a very special sensual note that attests to the elegance and cosmopolitanism of the wearer. Be inspired by an absolute classic in the perfume industry!

This fruity opening leads to an expressive heart in which a striking leather accord meets the powdery notes of violet and forms a special connection. In the finish, a rich base makes a lasting impression: warm amber, creamy vanilla and fine oak wood combine with earthy moss and the resinous aroma of labdanum. This fragrance emphasises a confident and individual style. The creation is presented in a cuboid, metallic-brown bottle that reflects the elegance of the contents. The creation unfolds with top notes characterised by the fresh spiciness of pink pepper and the subtle coolness of basil. At the heart of the fragrance, the earthy depth of patchouli combines with the striking note of geranium to create a harmonious interplay. The base note anchors the composition with warm, woody accents of suede, labdanum and a hint of tonka bean. listings.rawTitle: Baldessarini Cool Force Eau de Toilette Spray Sport 50 ml
listings.description: The Baldessarini Cool Force Sport Eau de Toilette Spray is a dynamic and striking fragrance composition for men. The fragrance opens with a lively top note in which fruity accents of tangerine and pear meet the spicy freshness of cardamom and bergamot. As the fragrance progresses, the aromatic heart unfolds, which is given an aquatic character by maritime notes in combination with rosemary, neroli and aldehydes. The base provides a long-lasting impression, concluding the fragrance experience with warm, woody accords of patchouli, sandalwood, cedarwood and musk. The composition is bottled in a puristic and elegant bottle made of heavy glass, which reflects the sporty energy of the fragrance. The spray is applied to pulsating areas such as the neck or wrists for ideal fragrance development. A men's fragrance with a fresh, sporty and distinctive character. Fragrance composition of fruity, spicy, aquatic and woody notes. Evolves from a sparkling top note through an aromatic heart to a warm, woody base. Presented in a purist, heavy glass bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Tommy Hilfiger Tommy Eau de Toilette Spray Poolside Edition 100 ml
listings.description: The Tommy Hilfiger Eau de Toilette Poolside Edition captures the relaxed atmosphere of a sunny afternoon by the water. The woody fragrance opens with a zesty blend of mandarin, lemon and pink pepper, leaving a refreshing sensation immediately after application. At the heart of the fragrance, a salty accord unfolds in combination with crisp apple. These notes are reminiscent of a light sea breeze and bring a carefree lightness to everyday life. The base notes of cedarwood, amber and moss lend the fragrance its depth and ensure a long-lasting, pleasant finish on the skin. The fine atomiser ensures even distribution, allowing the eau de toilette to be applied sparingly and precisely. This limited edition is ideal for warm days or as a subtle companion at the office and during leisure time. The clear, slightly bluish glass bottle with a silver cap visually emphasises the fresh character of its contents. Limited-edition fragrance composition with woody-fresh notes Top notes of mandarin, lemon and pink pepper for a refreshing opening Salty accords and apple in the heart notes bring a sense of lightness to everyday life Base notes of cedarwood, ambergris and moss ensure a long-lasting finish A fine atomiser allows for even and easy application

listings.description: With the Burberry Her Parfum Spray, the British fashion house presents a particularly intense interpretation of the popular Her fragrance line, which captures the creative and eclectic spirit of London. This composition is characterised by a complex structure that combines fruity accents with warm gourmand elements. The fragrance opens with a delicate cherry note that lends the fragrance an immediate, juicy presence. This fruity beginning flows smoothly into a heart characterised by a rich amber accord that can provide depth and warmth. The olfactory experience is rounded off with vanilla absolute in the base, which can lend the perfume a creamy and enveloping character. The bottle reflects the modern aesthetics of the contents: the rectangular glass container is presented in an opaque deep pink colour with a matt finish. A golden rim at the top and the embossed BURBERRY lettering add elegant accents, while the light pink cap harmoniously completes the design. As the most intense version of the collection, this perfume offers a dense sillage that may be particularly suitable for the evening hours or cooler weather. Fragrance family: Fruity-ambery gourmand fragrance with a warm character. Top note: Delicate, juicy cherry notes for a fruity opening. Base: Combination of amber accord and vanilla absolute for depth. Intensity: The most concentrated variant within the Her collection. Design: Opaque, deep pink glass bottle with golden details and matte finish.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry My Burberry Blush Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: In 2017, the eau de parfum spray My Burberry Blush follows the extremely successful My Burberry. The fragrance is floral and fruity and enjoys unbroken popularity. The great Francis Kurkdjian composes a top note of pomegranate and lemon. The heart note features roses, rose geraniums and green apples. Blue rain introduces the base and combines with jasmine. The My Burberry Blush Eau de Parfum Spray has thus become a worthy flanker for the My Burberry range. The fragrance is as young and modern as its wearers, even if you expressly do not want to specify an age. After all, age means nothing, but a good feeling means everything. Stylish all-rounder for all occasions Whether at work or at play, during the day or in the evening - My Burberry Blush puts you in a good mood. The fragrance is casual and casual , sensual and playful and far from being heavy or even overwhelming. You don't have to think about whether the eau de parfum spray is perhaps too much, even if the sillage is clearly perceptible. My Burberry Blush, like Burberry fashion, is inspired by the elegant style of London, which blends so many styles that it is impossible to be underdressed.

listings.description: AQUAKENZO POUR HOMME is one of the aromatic fragrances from KENZO . It is an eau de toilette spray that is packaged in a charming, ocean-blue bottle. The fragrance makes you want to go on holiday - and the aquatic notes hidden inside give the wearer the feeling that they have already arrived there. Whether it's a beach holiday or a magical trip through the tropics, KENZO has an exciting mental journey in store with AQUAKENZO POUR HOMME. Fruit essences, woods and a gentle sea breeze AQUAKENZO POUR HOMME consists of fruity, nutty and woody notes that gradually unfold on the wearer's skin. These include pink pepper and apple, which make a bold and fruity statement in the top note. The heart note continues with intense hazelnut, aquatic notes and a hint of sesame. The base notes surprise with warm woody tones of sandalwood and cedar, amber and tonka bean as well as musk, which skilfully rounds off the KENZO fragrance. The eau de toilette spray is a fragrance for men who are in the centre of life and would like to treat themselves to a mental break by the sea. Ane Ayo and Philippe Romano are behind this exciting new creation.

Especially on cool and cold days, the fragrance scores with its smoky and fruity, partly balsamic presence, which you absolutely must get to know. And the eau de parfum spray will certainly surprise you. Because Sharisme Insencé by Rancé is not just a fragrance for the evening, it can absolutely also be worn during the day. The Rancé manufactory has proven why it has been one of the absolute insider tips in the world of fragrances since 1795 - even Napoleon fell for it. Olfactory works of art are normal for this house The eau de parfum spray opens with top notes of juniper berries, clary sage, blackcurrant, black pepper, incense and bergamot. Maritime notes, leather, pine and mastic resin carry the heart note before the base of Virginia cedar, musk, vanilla, amber and patchouli sets in. With Sharisme Insensé, Rancé has created a fragrance that is something special , mystical and dark , seductive with a distinct masculine presence and wonderfully elegant. In other words, this eau de parfum spray is the finest luxury for the senses.

Rancé Eau Superbe Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Eau Superbe Eau de Toilette Spray by Rancé 1795 is defined by a harmonious balance between vitalising freshness and warm spice. The opening already impresses with its clear structure, in which the sparkling aromas of grapefruit and green mandarin are mixed with the green facets of petitgrain and cool mint leaves. As the fragrance progresses, a multi-layered heart unfolds, skilfully contrasting the delicate florality of rose with spicy elements such as cardamom, cinnamon and black pepper. The creation is rounded off by a solid base note that combines earthy patchouli and white woods with amber crystals and a pronounced leather accord. As an eau de toilette, the composition offers a pleasant intensity that is present without being overpowering. Visually, the bottle reflects this classic elegance. The square glass container with its transparent contents is topped with a gold-coloured cap and accentuated by a striking blue bow on the neck of the bottle. Two gold-coloured labels on the front bear the lettering and logo and round off the overall aesthetic look. Fresh opening with grapefruit, mandarin, petitgrain and mint Spicy centrepiece of cinnamon, cardamom, pepper and rose Deep base note with leather, amber, patchouli and white woods Square glass bottle with gold-coloured accents and blue bow

Rancé Hélène Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Hélène from the traditional house of Rancé 1795 is a modern interpretation of a historic recipe. This creation was originally dedicated to Hélène, which gives the fragrance a special historical depth. The top note surprises with a multi-faceted interplay of neroli and ylang-ylang, which is complemented by the spice of cardamom and cinnamon. The composition then glides gently into a floral heart, in which aromas of orange blossom, Sambac jasmine and rose combine with the subtle sweetness of tonka bean. The base note provides a harmonious finish, combining warm nuances of sandalwood, iris and musk with heliotrope and benzoin. The product also reflects classic elegance visually. A transparent, round glass flacon provides a clear view of the clear liquid inside. The design is enhanced by a large, beige-coloured bow made of transparent fabric on the neck of the bottle and a gold-coloured cap. The label with an ornate frame and a small crown rounds off the overall aesthetic. This fragrance embodies a balance of fresh, floral and woody elements. Fragrance character: A fresh, aromatic and floral composition with woody undertones. Top notes: Contains neroli, ylang-ylang, cinnamon and cardamom. Heart note: Captivates with orange blossom, Sambac jasmine, rose and tonka bean. Base note: Finishes with sandalwood, iris, musk, heliotrope and benzoin. Flacon design: Round glass container with beige fabric bow and gold cap.

Rancé Eleonore Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: As an integral part of the Imperial Collection from Rancé 1795, Éléonore Eau de Parfum is a complex and elegant fragrance creation. The visual design is characterised by a round bottle made of clear glass, which reveals the golden liquid and is topped with a transparent, faceted cap. A striking orange-coloured ribbon wraps around the neck of the bottle, while the ornate label with its emblem in gold, red and blue tones sets historical accents. The fragrance begins with a lively opening in which the freshness of Sicilian lemon and the fruitiness of peach blend with the resinous notes of myrrh and hedione. A warm blend of Tahitian vanilla and precious saffron then unfolds at the centre of the composition. A long-lasting base rounds off the olfactory experience, with patchouli, sandalwood and incense meeting soft accords of amber, tonka bean and musk. Floral, fruity and spicy elements intertwine and reflect the inspiration of a story of love and escape. Head note: A blend of Sicilian lemon, peach, myrrh and hedione. Heart note: Warm accords of Tahitian vanilla and saffron. Base note: Multi-layered finish with patchouli, sandalwood, incense, amber, tonka bean and musk. Design: Round glass bottle with golden liquid, faceted cap and orange-coloured ribbon. Collection: Part of the historic Imperial Collection by Rancé 1795.

listings.rawTitle: Rancé Triomphe Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Francois Rancé, Napoleon's court perfumer, wanted to pay homage to the emperor with a fragrance created especially for him. The name: Triomphe. This fragrance was one of His Majesty's favourite scents and continued to secure the Rancé family's position at the French court. He combined the notes of ripe lemons with the scent of rose and orange blossom. Jasmine from Grasse and Florentine iris lend the composition its unmistakable character. Cedarwood, musk and a hint of vanilla provide an intense base. Jeanne Sandra Rancé preserved the original character of the 18th century composition in her revision of the original recipe.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Buongiorno Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Acqua di Parma Buongiorno Eau de Parfum opens with a multi-faceted fragrance composition that creates a harmonious balance of citrus freshness and aromatic herbal notes. The top note combines refreshing nuances of Roman mint and lemon with the spicy green accents of basil, rosemary and petitgrain. This lively lightness leads into the heart note, where wild lavender blossom and mandarin leaf create a sophisticated interplay of floral softness and plant freshness. The base note gives the fragrance an elegant depth. Warm chords of cedar wood combine with the soft, sensual tones of amber and white musk. The result is a fragrance that is both invigorating and subtle - a successful balance between freshness and sophistication. As a unisex creation, Buongiorno appeals to all those who value lightness paired with a clear, sophisticated character. Inspired by the morning atmosphere of the Italian countryside, this fragrance conveys moments full of vitality and elegance.</p

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Fico di Amalfi Eau de Parfum Spray La Riserva 50 ml
listings.description: The Fico di Amalfi La Riserva Eau de Parfum Spray is part of the Acqua di Parma perfume product line. The famous brand was founded in Italy in 1916. Today, it stands for fashion consciousness and Mediterranean quality of life. The recipe for this product is based on high-quality essences and traditional processing methods in which fragrances are concentrated slowly and with great care. An exclusive Mediterranean fragrance composition The name already says what this perfume from Acqua di Parma promises. Fico di Amalfi alludes to the Figs of the Amalfi Coast . They have a strong place in the fragrance composition. La Riserva Eau de Parfum Spray begins with a fruity hint of blood orange, grapefruit, mandarin and lemon. The heart note is a combination of fig scent, lemon and orris. Tonka bean and orcanox round off the perfume perfectly. As a unisex fragrance, Fico di Amalfi La Riserva Eau de Parfum Spray can be worn by both men and women. Mediterranean fruit notes, citrus freshness and the elegantly spicy tonka bean create a strong but pleasantly light fragrance. The small blue spray bottle with a minimalist design and the well-known brand logo is a visual asset to any bathroom, but can also be easily stowed away in your luggage.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia Club Eau de Cologne Spray 50 ml
listings.description: In 2022, Acqua di Parma presents the Colonia Club eau de cologne spray, a fine fragrance for the summer. Created for men and women, the fragrance has top notes of pink pepper, bergamot, lemon and black pepper. Rosemary and shiso form the heart note, while the base consists of musk and cedar wood. In keeping with the fresh green fragrance , the label and cap of the bottle are green. The unisex fragrance itself is crystal clear and the bottle naturally has the typical Acqua di Parma shape. With the Colonia Club eau de cologne spray, the traditional Italian company is targeting all men and women who prefer light fragrances in summer. One for everyone and everywhere We know that Acqua di Parma has its headquarters in Parma, of course. In spring and summer, the air there is filled with green, woody, herbaceous aromas, the scents of flowers, spices and herbs. The ladies love this presence just as much as the men. So what could be more obvious than to capture the fragrance in an eau de cologne spray. Anyone expecting an olfactory bomb is likely to be disappointed. But if you want to wear an elegant and at the same time restrained unisex fragrance , the Acqua di Parma Eau de Cologne Spray Colonia Club is just right for you.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Gelsomino a Freddo Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Gelsomino a Freddo eau de parfum spray from Acqua di Parma is a special composition from the Signatures of the Sun collection. The fragrance owes its uniqueness to the traditional technique of cold enfleurage. In this elaborate process, freshly harvested jasmine flowers are gently pressed onto purified shea butter to extract the purest and finest olfactory molecules. The result is an intensely jasmine-like fragrance with a rich nuance that skilfully combines floral brightness with smoky and woody facets. The gender-neutral character of the fragrance has a modern and balanced effect. The fragrance composition opens with a fresh top note of Italian lemon, pink pepper and artemisia. The pure jasmine obtained through enfleurage unfolds in the heart, accompanied by the smoky nuances of black tea and a powdery hint of iris. This complex heart note gives the fragrance its unmistakable depth. In the base note, guaiac wood, cypriol and patchouli provide a warm, woody finish that harmoniously rounds off the composition. The eau de parfum is presented in the transparent glass bottle that is characteristic of the Signatures of the Sun range, with an elegant black cap that emphasises the simple and sophisticated design.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Eau de Toilette Spray Mandorlo di Sicilia 50 ml
listings.description: Sicily: Ancient ruins, Mount Etna with its overwhelming sight, miniature villages in pastel colours and a landscape of breathtaking beauty. Mandorlo di Sicilia captures this special atmosphere and has a flattering, gentle effect thanks to the essential oils. A warm, sensual fragrance for tender dreams of Italy. The warm sensuality of this fragrance is awakened by the sparkling opening formula of bergamot and aromatic star anise. Jasmine and fruity white peach intertwine in the heart notes. The base note is heralded by a gentle coffee accord and cedarwood is embedded in the sensual delicacy of white musk and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Zafferano 50 ml
listings.description: The Acqua di Parma Zafferano Eau de Parfum Spray is an intense fragrance for men and women characterised by versatile essences. The exquisite unisex fragrance from the Signatures Of The Sun line takes you on a journey through the world. Impress with the precious perfume on a special occasion and use it as a conscious companion for special moments to remind you of them again and again. Your elegant appearance with Zafferano The top note of the fragrance by Acqua di Parma starts with fruity and spicy accords. Orange and mandarin motivate right from the start and ensure a good mood, while bergamot and coriander in Zafferano Eau de Parfum Spray bring the right sweetness and spice. A feminine component can be found in the heart note: it is the sensual rose, accompanied by jasmine and geranium as well as orange blossom and a hint of saffron. The base notes of patchouli, vanilla and tonka bean lend the perfume a masculine touch. The elegant and high-priced Zafferano Eau de Parfum Spray from the Signatures Of The Sun collection by Acqua di Parma is sure to soon become one of the absolute highlights on your shelf.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Arancia di Capri Eau de Parfum Spray La Riserva 50 ml
listings.description: The La Riserva eau de parfum spray from the Arancia di Capri line by Acqua di Parma is a fragrance that is equally suitable for men and women. It allows its wearers to experience the unique landscape of the rocky island of Capri up close, so that they are always accompanied by the enchanting Mediterranean atmosphere. Like a holiday that never ends The La Riserva eau de parfum spray transports its users to a breathtaking region with unrivalled nature, where they can enjoy the pleasant climate and leave their everyday worries behind. To make this possible, Acqua di Parma has given this perfume a sophisticated fragrance pyramid. The top notes include blood orange, mandarin and petitgrain . The heart note contains basil and rosemary . Finally, the base note contains suede and cedarwood . This has created a citrusy aroma which, in addition to its fragrance, also impresses with its freshness, which provides its wearer with vitality and is therefore the ideal accompaniment throughout the day. In addition to its unmistakable fragrance, the perfume from the Arancia di Capri line by Acqua di Parma also impresses with its extremely tastefully designed bottle, which, like its cap, is an intense and appealing blue, reminiscent of the sea around the island.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Mirto di Panarea Eau de Parfum Spray La Riserva 50 ml
listings.description: The La Riserva Eau de Parfum Spray from the Mirto di Panarea line by Acqua di Parma is a sunny and gentle fragrance that you won't forget in a hurry. This paradisiacal fragrance is incredibly multi-faceted, intense in a pleasant way and extremely elegant at the same time. It is a tribute to the unique landscapes on the romantic Italian island of Panarea and the fascinating wild myrtle that is native to the island. The speciality: the perfume is obtained in a very complex maceration process that takes a whole two months. This gives La Riserva Eau de Parfum Spray an extraordinary structure and depth . Perfectly balanced and absolutely harmonious Mirto di Panarea by Acqua di Parma enchants with enchanting essences of sage, juniper berries and cedrat in the top note. The heart note features not only fine lavender essence, but also myrrh absolute. Both are skilfully rounded off with myrtle essence. The crowning finale is the beguiling base note with labdanum absolute, patchouli and lentiscus absolute. The result is an unmistakable and unique composition that shines in perfect harmony and revitalises the senses. A perfume full of expressiveness and strength that is also charming and feminine in a sophisticated way.</p

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Fame Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Rabanne Fame Eau de Parfum Spray is a powerful yet sensual women's fragrance that emphasises its wearer's multifaceted nature and uniqueness. The fragrance emphasises the playful, romantic nature of femininity as well as its sensual traits. The perfume is suitable for women who like to express their individuality in an exclusive setting. With Fame Eau de Parfum Spray, the exceptional designer Rabanne succeeds in enveloping every woman in a fascinating and mysterious aura . A sensual fragrance for the exclusive moments in life In the top note, the citrus-fresh lightness of bergamot paired with the sweet fruitiness of tropical mango opens the elegant fragrance experience. The heart note brings out the oriental components of seductive jasmine and smoky, spicy incense. In the base note, the sweetness of vanilla and the aroma of soft sandalwood take the lead. This makes Fame Eau de Parfum Spray by Rabanne an olfactory hymn to femininity that subtly emphasises the different characteristics of women. A sophisticated fragrance for all seasons, which is particularly captivating in the warmer months thanks to its sweetness. The extravagant glass flacon in an eye-catching and opulent design leaves no doubt that this fragrance emphasises the uniqueness of its wearer and skilfully brings it to the fore. A highlight in any bathroom.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Phantom In Red Parfum Elixir 50 ml
listings.description: The Rabanne Phantom In Red Parfum Elixir is an intense reinterpretation of the well-known Phantom line, which is characterised by a high concentration of fragrance oils. This Parfum Elixir unfolds a complex, amber-aromatic and woody profile that picks up on the characteristic lavender note of the series and expands it with unexpected nuances. The opening is a combination of fruity plum liqueur and saffron, which creates a striking first impression. At the heart of the fragrance, classic lavender, sage and orange blossom combine to form a harmonious whole. The composition is rounded off by a warm base of benzoin, tobacco, oud and amberwood, which lends the fragrance depth and longevity. The design of the bottle picks up on the futuristic robot aesthetic and creates visual highlights with red accents and a black dot in a red oval on the top. It is a fragrance that has a multi-layered structure thanks to its earthy and woody facets and the integration of citrus notes such as bergamot oil. Fragrance family: Earthy-woody with amber-aromatic facets. Head notes: Plum liqueur and saffron. Heart notes: Lavender, sage and orange blossom. Base notes: Benzoin, tobacco, oud and amberwood. Special feature: High concentration as a perfume elixir for long-lasting intensity.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Invictus Elixir Parfum Elixir 50 ml
listings.description: The Rabanne 1 Million Night Parfum Elixir unfurls an intense fragrance composition that offers a present radiance for the evening hours. The top note of mandarin opens the olfactory experience with a citrus-fresh prelude and ensures a clear first impression after spraying. The heart note of maple syrup adds a subtle sweetness that gives the fragrance a warm structure. The base of amber and benzoin rounds off the woody profile and leaves a long-lasting, ambery-balsamic finish. This harmonised combination makes the perfume particularly suitable for going out or festive occasions. As a vegan Intense Eau de Parfum, the creation has a high fragrance concentration, which means that just a few sprays are enough for a clearly perceptible result. The striking bottle in the shape of a goblet with a black and gold colour gradient visually completes the concept. Intense eau de parfum with a high fragrance concentration for long-lasting perceptibility Woody and ambery-balsamic fragrance with a fresh opening Vegan formulation that is completely free from animal ingredients Warm heart note of maple syrup for a pleasant fragrance development throughout the evening

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Olympéa Elixir Eau de Parfum Intense 30 ml
listings.description: The Rabanne Fame Intense Eau de Parfum envelops the senses with a warm, floral-woody fragrance composition that is reminiscent of the special atmosphere of Parisian dusk. Immediately after spraying, a fresh, slightly tropical top note of coconut and bergamot unfolds, providing a pleasant start to the fragrance experience. The perfume then develops a deep, intense presence through the heart notes of sunny jasmine, incense, ylang-ylang and patchouli. This combination is ideal for special occasions, elegant evening events or moments when an expressive appearance is desired in everyday life. The base note of sandalwood, musk and cedarwood gives the fragrance a long-lasting character, so that the composition remains reliably perceptible on the skin for many hours. The full potential of the individual fragrance chords can be unleashed by spraying onto pulsating areas of the body such as the inside of the wrists, the neck or behind the ears. The bulbous, transparent glass bottle with its elegant gold application rounds off the high-quality fragrance experience in a visually appealing way. listings.rawTitle: Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: A fragrance bouquet as colourful and versatile as its composer - but with a deep black name that skilfully underlines the seduction of the perfume: Crystal Noir by Versace is an unforgettably beautiful fragrance for exciting experiences in the evening or at night. On the one hand delicate and unobtrusive, on the other unmistakably feminine and intense - the Eau de Parfum Spray delights its wearers with these characteristics. Crystal Noir by Versace consists of various woody, fruity and floral accords . The fragrance bouquet opens with top notes of spicy ginger, intense cardamom and pepper. Fresh and light, this first scent envelops the wearer. This is followed by a warm, feminine note composed of fresh orange blossom and floral gardenia, without forgetting the peony. Finally, a woody aura awaits the wearer, resulting from the base note with sandalwood, ambergris and musk. If you can resist this perfume on your skin, it's your own fault...</h2 The Eau de Parfum Spray is also visually impressive to match its contents: cuboid in shape, with a striking cap and in the sensual colours of burgundy and black, it is waiting to be discovered by you. For yourself or as a gift!

listings.rawTitle: Versace Versense Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Versace Versense is an eau de toilette that presents a composition of freshness and sensuality. The fragrance opens with a vibrant blend of Mediterranean fruits, in which bergamot, green mandarin and tangy citrus fruits meet the gentle sweetness of fig and pear. An elegant floral bouquet unfolds at the heart of the creation. Delicate notes of lily and jasmine combine with the special presence of narcissus and are rounded off with a hint of spicy cardamom. The base note gives the perfume a warm and earthy depth. A harmonious combination of sandalwood, cedarwood and the characteristic aroma of the olive tree is underlined by gentle musk. This woody-floral fragrance is a suitable companion for everyday wear, especially in the warmer months of the year. Base note: A warm base of sandalwood, cedar and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Dylan Purple pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Versace takes you straight to Italy with Dylan Purple pour Femme! The summery country is bursting with joie de vivre - and you can too with this eau de parfum spray! Fruity notes will envelop you and bring the typical "dolce vita" to wherever you apply the fragrance. Plus point: Like all Versace fragrances, Dylan Purple also comes in an eye-catching bottle that is a harmonious addition to your collection. Exciting fragrance journey through Italy's sunny side The floral-fruity fragrance character of Dylan Purple pour Femme captures the positive characteristics of Italy. On the one hand, there are the fresh accords of pear juice and bitter orange and the floral accords of rose and iris . On the other hand, there are the warm and sensual nuances such as cedarwood, musk and amber, which represent the flirtatious and seductive side of Italy. The well-known fragrance brand behind the perfume has thought of everything here! The eau de parfum spray is also visually impressive with its characteristic bottle, which is a vibrant pink-violet colour on the one hand and stands for pure elegance with its golden cap on the other. If you already have similar fragrances from Versace, Dylan Purple will also fit in perfectly as a decorative element in the bathroom or on the dressing table.

listings.rawTitle: DKNY 24/7 Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Discover DKNY 24/7 Eau de Parfum Spray, a fragrance that captures the never-sleeping energy of the city of New York. This perfume by Donna Karan New York is the perfect choice for the self-confident, dynamic woman who wants to savour every moment of her life to the full. The perfume opens with a surprising and invigorating top note of spicy pepper, fruity quince and refreshing rhubarb. This unique combination awakens the senses and immediately conveys a feeling of energy and vitality. A lush bouquet of flowers unfolds at the heart of DKNY's Eau de Parfum Spray. Jasmine, rose and intense tuberose combine to create a seductive floral composition that radiates elegance and femininity. This floral heart note forms the perfect transition between the fresh opening and the warm base. The base note of 24/7 rounds off the fragrance harmoniously and ensures its longevity. The woody, ambery scent of ambroxan gives the fragrance depth and character, while sensual musk provides a warm, cosy note. This combination creates an unforgettable fragrance signature that lasts all day. DKNY 24/7 Eau de Parfum Spray is a versatile fragrance that accompanies you from morning to night. It is just as suitable for a busy day at the office as it is for going out in the evening. The modern and elegant bottle design reflects the urban character of the fragrance and makes it a real eye-catcher on any dressing table.

listings.description: The Dsquared2 ICON Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Spray has truly earned its name: the fragrance pyramid of this perfume is at least as iconic as the bottle. It shows in an impressive way how such a simple contrast between black and white can still attract attention almost magically. However, the big highlight of this perfume awaits you with the first spritz: it is immediately apparent why the bottle has such a high-contrast design - because the composition of this perfume is also characterised by many contrasts and natural counterparts. A masculine yet light fragrance On the nose, Dsquared2 ICON Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Spray opens with sparkling citrus fruits, which are given both a warm and spicy note by the addition of ginger. The play of contrasts in Dsquared2 ICON Pour Homme Eau de Parfum Spray continues in the heart, where spicy icons such as clary sage meet the floral and often rather soft accords of geranium, black tulip and lavender. In the base note, woody accords set the tone together with patchouli - the result is a masculine, modern, contrasting and, above all, bold fragrance that is highly addictive.

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 Wood Pour Homme Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The men's fragrance Wood Pour Homme by Dsquared² was launched in 2018 together with the Eau de Toilette Spray Wood Pour Femme. As the name suggests, the fragrance is fresh and woody . The Wood Pour Homme bottle has a classic shape and is coloured a transparent brown. The closure of the bottle is reminiscent of a wooden cork, further emphasising the character of the fragrance. Equipped with above-average longevity and sillage, the eau de toilette spray delights with its masculine and modern presence that suits all occasions. More wood from Dsquared² for him Alberto Morillas creates a top note of mandarin, Sicilian lemon and Calabrian bergamot for the Wood Pour Homme fragrance. In the heart note, cardamom and ginger meet green-tart violet leaves. Finally, vetiver and ambrox combine with light-coloured woods to create a fine base note. The eau de toilette spray is a worthy successor to the numerous fragrances from Dsquared² that are dedicated to the theme of wood. The almost purist structure makes the fragrance interesting not only for lovers of woody scents. Dsquared² would like to divide the spirits, but with Wood Pour Homme this will be difficult, because it is the perfect summer fragrance for men.

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 Original Wood Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Original Wood Eau de Parfum Spray by Dsquared2 is a powerful fragrance composition inspired by the strength and complexity of wood. The fragrance opens with an invigorating freshness of violet leaf and aquatic notes, complemented by the spicy warmth of cardamom from Guatemala. A striking woody accord of vetiver, cedarwood and silver fir unfolds in the heart, reminiscent of the clear atmosphere of a forest after a rain shower. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a warm and creamy base of musk, Indonesian patchouli and herbal amber, which lends the fragrance a long-lasting depth. Presented in a straightforward bottle with brand-typical elements, Original Wood is a versatile companion for everyday life and special moments. Fragrance character: Woody, fresh and spicy Top note: A composition of violet leaf, aquatic notes and cardamom. Heart note: A striking woody accord of vetiver, cedarwood and silver fir. Base note: Warm notes of musk, patchouli and amber.

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 Green Wood Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Green Wood Eau de Toilette Spray by Dsquared2 is a composition based on the interplay of fresh, spicy and woody notes. It opens with an energetic combination of tangy lemon and spicy bourbon pepper, accompanied by the aromatic plant santolina. In the heart note, the intense character of the fragrance unfolds through earthy vetiver, striking cedarwood and warm resins. This woody depth is rounded off in the base by a blend of ambroxan, cypriol and musk, which ensures a long-lasting and expressive finish. The fragrance is presented in an elegant, green glass bottle with a wooden cap that emphasises the natural aesthetic of the creation. Green Wood is a modern yet timeless everyday companion that leaves a confident signature. listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 ICON Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The ICON Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray by Dsquared2 is a multi-layered, floral-fruity composition that exudes elegance and modernity. The fragrance opens with a sparkling top note of Italian mandarin, lemon and pear, which is given a lively freshness by blackcurrant and a hint of pink pepper. At the heart of the creation, a feminine bouquet of jasmine unfolds, which is given an appealing sweetness by a fine praline note without dominating. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a warm and sensual base note. This is where sandalwood, soft musk and sweet vanilla meet the special woody notes of Akigalawood and ash wood, which lend the perfume a long-lasting depth. The result is a multi-faceted fragrance that emphasises a self-confident yet graceful aura. Fragrance direction: Floral-fruity Top notes: Italian mandarin, lemon, pear, pink pepper Heart note: jasmine, praline Base notes: sandalwood, musk, vanilla, acigalawood

listings.rawTitle: Dsquared2 Red Wood Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Red Wood Eau de Toilette Spray by Dsquared2 was created in 2019 and is a fruity and woody fragrance for women. It is not just the bright red colour of the bottle that makes the fragrance stand out. After all, the eau de toilette spray has top notes of cranberry and pink pepper. The heart note mixes roses and magnolias with lychees, while the base consists of musk, amberwood and cedarwood. Red Wood by Dsquared2 has above-average longevity and sillage, which is particularly suited to all women who like sweet fragrances. Wood can be so sexy With a name like Red Wood, you would naturally expect an eau de toilette spray with woody aromas. But the fragrance from Dsquared2 goes beyond that. Because the wood is the centrepiece of the fragrance. At the same time, however, the perfumers have succeeded in creating a fantastically feminine eau de toilette spray. The women's fragrance is sweet in a grown-up way. It is sexy , it is confident and suits many different occasions, both during the day and in the evening. Dsquared2 scores particularly well with this fragrance in the cool and cold season. If you like woods, you have to try Red Wood.

GIVENCHY GENTLEMAN GIVENCHY Eau de Parfum Spray Réserve Privée 60 ml
listings.description: The Gentleman Givenchy Réserve Privée Eau de Parfum Spray unfolds a fascinating duality, inspired by the world of exquisite spirits and high perfume art. This woody-floral amber composition is characterised by an unusual ingredient: an absolute of whisky extracted in Grasse from the barley of a Scottish distillery. In the top note, this warm, characteristic aroma meets the freshness of Italian bergamot. This is followed by a heart note that combines the powdery elegance of iris with the sweetness of chestnut and balsamic benzoin resin. The base of Virginia cedarwood, Haitian vetiver and Indonesian patchouli lends the fragrance a long-lasting, earthy depth. The result is a harmonious and intense composition that impresses with its sophistication and expressive character. Fragrance family: woody-floral-amber Speciality: Contains an exclusive absolute of whisky Character: Intense and harmonious Fragrance notes: Iris, chestnut and cedar wood

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY L'Interdit Eau de Parfum Spray Rouge 35 ml
listings.description: GIVENCHY L'INTERDIT Rouge Eau de Parfum Spray is a composition that captivates with its sensual, spicy and floral facets. The fragrance opens with the zesty essence of blood orange and the characteristic warmth of ginger extract. A spicy accord of allspice leaf lends the top note a distinctive depth. At the heart of the creation, an elegant floral bouquet of orange blossom absolute, jasmine and tuberose unfolds. This floral heart gives way to a warm and smoky base, in which woody nuances of patchouli, vetiver and sandalwood come together. The result is an elegant and long-lasting fragrance with an intense, spicy-floral presence. The perfume is presented in a translucent bottle, the interior of which is finished with a red lacquer – a tribute to the iconic colour of the House of Givenchy. A sensual, spicy fragrance with floral and woody notes. A composition of blood orange, ginger, tuberose and jasmine. The base is formed by warm accords of patchouli, vetiver and sandalwood. Presented in a translucent bottle with a red lacquer finish on the inside.

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY L'Interdit Elixir Eau de Parfum Spray 35 ml
listings.description: The GIVENCHY L’Interdit Elixir Eau de Parfum Spray offers a multi-layered fragrance composition that enriches special moments with a distinctive note. The elegant glass bottle, with its deep red colour gradient, adds a stylish touch to any dressing table. The floral-woody-gourmand profile blends fruity and warm nuances into a harmonious whole. An opening note of black cherry lends the fragrance an intense freshness that creates a pleasant sensation immediately upon application. At the heart, white blossoms such as orange blossom, tuberose and jasmine sambac unfold their full aroma, emphasising an elegant aura. These floral elements are ideal for making a confident impression at evening events or when going out. The base note combines oakwood extract, rum, davana and vanilla. These deep, rich ingredients round off the olfactory experience and ensure a long-lasting presence, meaning there is no need to reapply frequently throughout the evening. listings.description: The GIVENCHY IRRÉSISTIBLE Eau de Parfum Spray is a floral-fruity fragrance composition with warm, woody accents. The Damask rose from Turkey takes centre stage, unfolding its full splendour in the heart note and accompanied by powdery iris butter. The fragrance opens with a fresh combination of juicy pear and ambrette, which gives the fragrance a light, inviting nuance. The base of cedarwood and blond wood provides a soft and long-lasting finish that emphasises the elegant structure of the perfume. Developed by the renowned perfumers Fanny Bal, Anne Flipo and Dominique Ropion, this fragrance is a modern yet timeless creation. It is suitable for every occasion and every season without being overpowering. The bottle is also available in an environmentally friendly, refillable version. listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Essential Eau de Toilette Spray 75 ml
listings.description: The Lacoste Essential Eau de Toilette Spray unfolds a fragrance character that is characterised by an invigorating freshness and woody elegance. The heart of the fragrance develops further, combining the delicacy of rose with the pointed sharpness of black pepper to create a sophisticated and masculine blend. A warm and sensual base of sandalwood and patchouli harmoniously rounds off the composition and lends it a pleasant depth. Designed as an uncomplicated companion for the day, this French-made eau de toilette emphasises a confident yet relaxed aura. The fragrance is presented in a simple, cuboid bottle in a striking shade of green. A men's fragrance with a fresh, woody and spicy scent composition. Combines sparkling notes of bergamot and mandarin with warm sandalwood and patchouli. Characterised by an invigorating, elegant and sensual character. Ideal as an uncomplicated fragrance companion for everyday wear.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Lacoste Original Eau de Parfum Spray 60 ml
listings.description: The Lacoste Original Eau de Parfum Spray presents itself as a modern and unmistakable fragrance from the woody fougère family. Its composition opens with a dynamic freshness in which the sparkling notes of bergamot meet the subtle spiciness of pink pepper. This lively introduction flows smoothly into an aromatic heart note in which classic lavender and clear clary sage form a harmonious and spicy combination. listings.rawTitle: Lacoste L.12.12 Noir Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Lacoste L.12.12 Noir Eau de Toilette Spray is a men's fragrance inspired by the brand's iconic polo shirt. This aromatic-woody fougère composition opens with an invigorating top note that combines the juicy freshness of watermelon with pineapple and red berries. A hint of basil adds a spicy facet to the opening. The heart of the fragrance then unfolds, characterised by the clear notes of lavender and lemon verbena, which are complemented by Egyptian basil and create an aromatic character. The fragrance concludes with a deep base note. This is where the intense flavours of dark chocolate meet earthy patchouli, warm cashmeran and coumarin, giving the fragrance a special depth. With its classic intensity, the eau de toilette is particularly suitable for the evening or the transitional months. The simple, black bottle echoes the design of the polo shirt and features an embroidered crocodile emblem. Fragrance family: Aromatic, Fougère, Woody Top notes: watermelon, pineapple, red berries, basil Heart notes: lavender, lemon verbena, Egyptian basil Base notes: dark chocolate, patchouli, cashmeran, coumarin Character: Classic intensity

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Lacoste Original Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Striking elegance meets dynamic freshness in this olfactory creation, which is a modern interpretation of the fougère woody amber family. This lively introduction flows smoothly into an aromatic heart characterised by the classic notes of lavender and clary sage. The complex base ensures a long-lasting and warm finish, interweaving creamy sandalwood, earthy patchouli, sweet tonka bean and amber extremes. The design of the bottle also echoes the brand's aesthetic codes: The square shape with rounded corners, the shiny black cap and the dark green tint around the edge emphasise the high-quality character. The white label is emblazoned with the familiar green crocodile logo, which together with the silver lettering creates a stylish accent. Made in France, this fragrance embodies a successful balance of tradition and contemporary style that can be worn on a wide variety of occasions. listings.rawTitle: Jil Sander Sunset Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Sunset by Jil Sander captivates with its summery character, characterised by floral and fruity accords . They immediately remind the wearer of a romantic sunset on the beach! Treat yourself to a break from everyday life with this fragrance whenever you need it - without actually having to go on holiday! Sunny moments with Jil Sander The Jil Sander fragrance was created largely with ingredients of natural origin. This means you literally get a tribute to nature in the bottle. The eau de parfum spray gradually unfolds its various fragrance notes. The opening welcomes you with an apart floral note of rose absolute, the heart becomes fruity with peach and finally patchouli joins in as a warm component . The bottle has a simple design and yet is very expressive with its deep red colour. Think of the glowing sun as it slowly sets and presents itself in the most beautiful shades of colour! The bottle has captured this moment for you. The yellow Sunset lettering catches the eye and immediately shows you what to expect. It is a fragrance full of radiance and sunny, beautiful moments - whenever you need them!

listings.rawTitle: Jil Sander Sun Eau de Parfum Spray 75 ml
listings.description: Sun is a summer-fresh fragrance from Jil Sander. The eau de parfum spray is unmistakable. A few drops sprayed on the skin provide relaxation and are reminiscent of exotic warm beach days with a refreshing breeze. Sun radiates good humour, sunshine and a feeling of freedom. No woman can relax more beautifully than with this eau de parfum spray from Jil Sander. The wonderful and unmistakable fragrance captivates with its fresh, fruity and oriental-floral aromas. Whether in the office during the day, shopping in the city or on an evening out for two: Sun is the ideal companion. The fragrance symphony by Jil Sander stands for romance, feminine elegance and sporty strength. Sun is a classic and irresistible . The women's fragrance from 1989 features top notes of African orange tree, bergamot, redcurrant leaves, rosewood and rosewood. The heart note reveals itself after just a few minutes with orris root, ylang-ylang, carnation, rose and fresh lily of the valley. The base notes of amber, styrax, tonka bean, sandalwood, styrax, vanilla, musk and patchouli round off the fragrance for women. It surrounds every woman with a sensual esprit. The eau de parfum spray lies gently on the skin. A fragrance by Jil Sander for feminine women with charisma.

listings.rawTitle: Jil Sander Sunset Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in the sensual world of Jil Sander with the Sunset Eau de Parfum Spray Intense. This exquisite fragrance is more than just a perfume - it is an ode to the magic of sunset. The top note opens with tangy lemon and spicy pink pepper, bringing an unmistakable fresh breeze to your day. It immediately gives way to a floral heart note of jasmine and rose. These floral nuances are reminiscent of a romantic stroll through a garden in bloom, while the sunset bathes the sky in warm colours. Magical fragrance for women by Jil Sander But the real centrepiece of Sunset Eau de Parfum Spray Intense is revealed in the base note. Here, sensual accents of amber and vanilla unfold, embedded in the warm aroma of sandalwood. This fine fragrance experience, reminiscent of an exotic journey, will take your breath away. Whether you are preparing for a special occasion or simply want to enhance your everyday life, this sunset fragrance is a must-have. The Eau de Parfum Spray Intense represents the modern woman who is both delicate and strong, who has the ability to transform every moment of her life into something special. The flacon reflects the elegance and class of Jil Sander. With a minimalist design, but with a striking colour scheme and golden lettering, similar to the colours of a breathtaking sunset, it radiates a modern aesthetic.

listings.rawTitle: Cacharel Yes I Am Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Yes I Am Eau de Parfum Spray by Cacharel is a multi-faceted composition that expresses self-confidence and modern femininity. This spicy-floral fragrance opens with a sparkling top note of fruity raspberry and invigorating mandarin peel, which creates a lively and playful opening. At the heart of the creation, a multi-layered bouquet of white gardenia and jasmine unfolds, which is given a fascinating depth by the subtle sharpness of ginger blossom and the warmth of amber. The base rounds off the fragrance experience with an extraordinary creamy, spicy accord in which notes of warm milk meet fine sandalwood and aromatic cardamom. This harmonious combination of sweet, spicy and floral elements gives the fragrance its long-lasting and intense character. The eau de parfum is presented in an iconic bottle, the design of which is reminiscent of a lipstick and visually emphasises the sensual radiance of the fragrance. Spicy-floral fragrance composition with fruity-creamy accents. Combines notes of raspberry, ginger blossom, warm milk and cardamom. Striking bottle in the design of a classic lipstick. Long-lasting fragrance with an intense presence.

listings.rawTitle: Cacharel Eden Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Cacharel Eden Eau de Parfum Spray is a timeless composition that has been inspiring since its creation in 1994 by perfumer Jean Guichard. The fragrance belongs to the family of floral-fruity perfumes and unfolds a multi-layered presence. It opens with a refreshing and sparkling top note of mandarin, bergamot and lemon, which is complemented by fruity nuances of peach. The heart of the composition reveals an opulent floral bouquet in which delicate water lily, lotus, lily of the valley and jasmine combine to create a feminine accord. The base note ensures a long-lasting and harmonious finish. This is where warm and sensual components such as sandalwood, patchouli, tonka bean and cedarwood come together and give the fragrance its depth. Eden presents itself as a lively and elegant fragrance that is suitable for a variety of occasions and is available in a stylish spray bottle. A floral and fruity fragrance for women from 1994 Composition of tangy fruits and an opulent floral heart Warm base note with sandalwood, patchouli and tonka bean Elegant and lively fragrance character for a variety of occasions

Created by perfumer Alain Alchenberger, the fragrance belongs to the floral-fruity family and unfolds in several facets. It opens with a tangy combination of juicy mandarin and crisp apple, which is given a special finesse by the delicate, apricot-like note of osmanthus. At the heart of the composition is a clear floral bouquet in which elegant freesia and creamy magnolia combine to form a harmonious whole. The base note provides a gentle and long-lasting finish with powdery iris and soft musk for a subtle, clean finish. With its airy and fresh character, this fragrance is an ideal companion for dynamic everyday life and emphasises a carefree, modern style. A fragrance from the floral-fruity fragrance family. A fresh composition with notes of apple, mandarin and magnolia. Possesses a light, airy and unobtrusive character. The base of iris and musk provides a gentle finish.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Ralph's Club Eau de Parfum Spray New York 60 ml
listings.description: Ralph's Club New York by Ralph Lauren is a men's fragrance that captures the flair of a metropolis in an elegant composition. The eau de parfum belongs to the fougère-amber-fruity fragrance family and opens with a fresh top note of blackcurrant, Italian green mandarin and Calabrian bergamot. In the heart, an interplay of lavender, bourbon geranium and Australian sandalwood unfolds, leading into a warm, woody-balsamic base. Notes of bourbon vanilla from Madagascar, fir balsam and oak moss lend the fragrance an expressive depth and a balanced character. The composition is characterised by a remarkable presence and a long-lasting finish. The fragrance is presented in a minimalist bottle with a translucent silver finish, whose black diamond logo is inspired by New York architecture and emphasises the urban, sophisticated style of the perfume. An urban men's fragrance from the fougère-amber-fruity fragrance family. Composition of fruity top notes, a heart of lavender and sandalwood and a woody-balsamic base. Characterised by a long-lasting presence. Presented in a minimalist bottle inspired by New York architecture.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Ralph's Club Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Ralph's Club Eau de Parfum Spray by Ralph Lauren is a composition that exudes self-confidence and understated elegance. This men's fragrance, created by perfumer Dominique Ropion, opens with an aromatic freshness of lavandin and clary sage, which is subtly complemented by a fine note of cardamom. At the heart of the creation, the striking warmth of Virginia cedarwood unfolds, harmoniously interacting with rose geranium absolute and echoing the lavender and sage notes. The base anchors the fragrance experience for a long time with the earthy tones of vetiver and patchouli and the soft depth of cashmeran. This woody-spicy fragrance signature is present, but not dominant, and is therefore suitable for everyday wear as well as for special moments in the evening. The matt black bottle with copper-coloured accents and the iconic monogram on the hinged lid reflects the sophisticated character of the fragrance. A woody, spicy men's fragrance with an elegant appeal. Composition with notes of lavender, Virginia cedarwood and vetiver. Versatile for everyday wear and special occasions. Eau de Parfum with a long-lasting presence.

listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Polo Blue Eau de Parfum Spray 75 ml
listings.description: The Polo Blue Eau de Parfum Spray by Ralph Lauren is a composition inspired by the vastness of the ocean and the energy of a clear sky. Created by perfumer Carlos Benaïm, the fragrance opens with an invigorating wave of maritime notes combined with the juicy freshness of melon, cucumber and tangy mandarin. An aromatic bouquet unfolds in the heart, in which spicy basil meets the earthy tones of sage and clary sage. The base note lends the fragrance an elegant depth with a blend of soft suede, vetiver, woody notes and musk. The result is a multi-layered, aquatic fragrance character that is just as suitable for everyday wear as it is for various occasions. The characteristic cobalt blue bottle emphasises the powerful and free charisma of the fragrance creation.
