listings.rawTitle: Ralph Lauren Polo Blue Eau de Toilette Spray 40 ml
listings.description: The Ralph Lauren Polo Blue Eau de Toilette Spray captures the freedom of the open sky and the energy of the open ocean in one fragrance. Since its launch in 2003, this aromatic-fougère men's fragrance has been characterised by a fresh and aquatic composition. It opens with an invigorating blend of juicy melon, crisp cucumber and tangy mandarin. An aromatic bouquet of basil and sage unfolds in the heart, harmoniously rounded off by geranium. The base lends the fragrance a masculine depth and a lasting impression with warm wood tones, musk and a hint of suede. The simple, royal blue bottle with the iconic logo reflects the clear and elegant character of the fragrance and makes it a timeless classic for everyday use, especially on warmer days. Fragrance direction: Aromatic fougère Character: Fresh, aquatic, woody Head notes: Melon, cucumber, mandarin Heart notes: Basil, sage, geranium Base notes: Musk, woody notes, suede

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born In Roma Donna Eau de Parfum Spray Intense 30 ml
listings.description: Valentino Donna Born In Roma Eau de Parfum Spray Intense is a tribute to the eternal city of Rome and its mesmerising sunsets. This powerful and warm women's fragrance captures the character of its wearer in a floral amber composition. It opens with intense vanilla, which meets the radiance of jasmine in the heart note. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a base of warm benzoin, which ensures a long-lasting presence. The bottle itself is a statement, inspired by Valentino's iconic Rockstud line. The pyramid-shaped design, a nod to Roman architecture, combines a deep black leather look with a vibrant pink colour, embodying the motto "Pink is Punk". The perfume can be applied to warm areas of skin such as the neck or the inside of the wrists from a distance of around 20 cm for the fragrance to unfold in a special way. Intense, warm fragrance for women with a floral amber note Fragrance composition of vanilla, jasmine and benzoin Inspired by the sunsets of Rome Flacon in the iconic Valentino Rockstud design

listings.description: The Polo Blue fragrance by Ralph Lauren is a powerful yet elegant interpretation of the iconic fragrance collection. Since its launch in 2022, this men's fragrance has inspired with its high concentration and multi-layered, aromatic-woody character. The olfactory journey begins with an invigorating top note, in which the sparkling freshness of grapefruit and bergamot sets the tone. The fragrance develops a present and striking aura that is suitable for special occasions throughout the year. listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley Vanilla Eau de Toilette Spray 25 ml
listings.description: The Vanilla Eau de Toilette Spray by Alyssa Ashley is a harmonious composition that combines fresh accents with warm nuances. Since 1990, this fragrance has stood for an unmistakable combination of effervescence and gentle sweetness. The top note opens the olfactory experience with invigorating accords of bergamot and lemon, which provide a clear and bright prelude. A floral bouquet then unfolds at the heart of the creation, in which jasmine plays a central role and creates an elegant transition. The arrangement is supported by a dominant base note of vanilla, which gives the eau de toilette its characteristic, creamy and soft character. Subtle hints of caramel or musk can also be detected, emphasising the depth of the fragrance. The brand has also opted for a classic design: a rectangular glass bottle provides a clear view of the yellow-coloured liquid inside. A beige-coloured, shiny cap and the striking yellow label with the curved red lettering "Vanilla" complete the look. The balanced blend of ingredients makes the spray suitable for daily use and is gentle on the skin. listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley Vanilla Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Since 1968, the Alyssa Ashley label has been known for capturing the classic fragrances of the flower power generation in original recipes and new fragrance formulas in flacons. Musk, patchouli and vanilla, among others, inspire the "créateurs de parfum" behind the label to constantly create new fragrances. Sensual, sweet, elegant: perfumes with a strong vanilla note are a timeless, enduring trend for women and increasingly for men. For more than 100 years, these sweet fragrances have found a place on the shelves of the most exclusive perfumeries. With the unisex fragrance Vanilla , Alyssa Ashley enriched the long line of successful vanilla fragrance creations in 1990 with her own new interpretation on the theme of vanilla. Vanilla by Alyssa Ashley - an uncompromising fragrance The top note opens with the invigorating tropical fruits bergamot and lemon. This tart, tangy opening ensures that the eau de parfum spray does not lose itself in an excess of sweetness later on. The floral heart note is characterised by the intense yet delicate aroma of jasmine blossom. Deep and powdery, the base note is grounding with vanilla essences. The result is an irresistible eau de parfum spray for lovers of sweet fragrances. If you want to wrap yourself in vanilla from head to toe, you will find numerous care products from the same fragrance line here.

listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley Essence De Patchouli Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Essence De Patchouli by Alyssa Ashley gets to the point The Essence De Patchouli eau de parfum spray draws attention to itself with an unusual combination . The perfume captivates with its simple top and heart notes, which consist solely of geranium, roses and iris roots. It becomes opulent and interesting in the base, which, in keeping with the name, naturally consists primarily of patchouli. The eau de parfum spray also features vanilla and musk, coumarin and French labdanum as well as guaiac wood and Virginia cedar. The result is a long-lasting, very sensual and warm perfume that is simply perfect for all women who embrace and know how to deal with their sensual femininity. With Essence De Patchouli, Alyssa Ashley celebrates femininity, the beauty that women stand for and the strength that is inherent in every woman. The aromatic, sensual fragrance has been around since 2009 and you should definitely give it a try if you like warm fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley Ambre Gris Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Since its launch in 2002, Ambre Gris Eau de Parfum Spray by Alyssa Ashley has been synonymous with a multi-faceted and profound fragrance signature. The composition combines fresh, citrusy elements with warm, ambery accords to create a harmonious overall picture. The olfactory experience opens with a sparkling top note in which Calabrian bergamot and Sicilian lemon meet, lending a certain lightness to the opening. This is followed by a floral heart, which is characterised by the fine aromas of Bulgarian rose, Indian jasmine and orange blossom. The complex base note, which combines precious ambergris, sandalwood and Madagascar vanilla with Virginia cedarwood and musk, ensures a long-lasting and sensual finish. This blend lends the fragrance a timeless elegance that can unfold regardless of the season. The design of the bottle also reflects the classic claim: a rectangular clear glass container reveals the light-coloured liquid and is crowned by a black label with gold lettering and a shiny, gold cap. The intertwined symbol embossed on the front rounds off the visual appearance and emphasises the brand's identity. Combination of fresh citrus notes and warm amber accords Contains high-quality essences such as Bulgarian rose and Madagascar vanilla Classic clear glass bottle with elegant gold and black accents Timeless fragrance composition that is suitable for every season

listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley White Musk Eau de Toilette Spray 25 ml
listings.description: The White Musk Eau de Toilette Spray by Alyssa Ashley is a fragrance composition that combines timeless elegance with a clear structure. Known for its sophisticated interpretation of the musk theme, this fragrance uses synthetic components to create a pure and soft aroma that does not contain any animal ingredients. The olfactory prelude is a fresh top note in which sparkling bergamot blends with the spicy accents of tarragon. This is followed by a complex heart note that unfolds a lush floral bouquet. Here, nuances of jasmine, rose and ylang-ylang meet the floral accords of lilac and geranium, giving the perfume a multi-layered floral depth. Acqua di Gioia is a tribute to optimism and a connection with nature. listings.rawTitle: Armani Emporio Armani You Eau de Parfum Spray Stronger With You Powerfully 50 ml
listings.description: The Emporio Armani You Eau de Parfum Spray Stronger With You Powerfully expands the Italian fashion house's popular fragrance collection with an intense and characterful composition. This men's fragrance presents itself as a powerful interpretation of the classic fougère structure, enriched with warm amber accents. The opening surprises with a dynamic interplay of fresh mandarin and bergamot, which meet the spicy sharpness of black pepper. An aromatic depth unfolds in the heart, characterised by diva lavender and a striking accord of spices such as saffron, cinnamon and clove. These spicy facets are subtly rounded off by fruity nuances of apricot or cherry. The base note provides a long-lasting and warm finish, combining sweet vanilla and bourbon vanilla with the characteristic aroma of candied and roasted chestnut. Amberwood and leather lend the base an additional masculine structure. The rectangular glass bottle with its rounded corners and metallic cap visually emphasises the robustness of the fragrance. Fragrance family: Ambery fougère with spicy and warm accents. Top notes: Fresh citrus notes of mandarin and bergamot combined with black pepper. Heart note: Aromatic lavender meets spices such as saffron and cinnamon. Base note: Warm vanilla accords combined with roasted chestnut and amberwood. Design: Striking glass bottle with metallic cap and dark-coloured liquid.

A woody, aromatic fragrance with a sensual depth. Long-lasting fragrance full of character. Composition of fresh, spicy and warm notes. Presented in an elegant and refillable bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Acqua di Giò Homme Parfum- refillable 30 ml
listings.description: Armani Acqua di Giò Homme Parfum captures the infinite expanse and powerful freshness of the sea in an intense fragrance for men. The composition opens with sparkling bergamot from Calabria and aquatic marine notes reminiscent of an invigorating coastal breeze. At the heart, an aromatic bouquet of geranium, lavender and sustainably sourced clary sage unfolds, lending the fragrance a modern depth. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a base of Guatemalan patchouli and vetiver, which provide a woody and masculine signature. This fragrance experience is presented in an elegant bottle with a design that reflects the timeless aesthetics of Giorgio Armani with a black gradient lacquer effect and a magnetic cap. In the spirit of more conscious consumption, the bottle is refillable. Fragrance direction: Aromatic, woody and aquatic . Fragrance notes: A composition of marine notes, lavender and patchouli. Fragrance intensity: An intense eau de parfum with a long-lasting character. Special feature: Refillable bottle to reduce packaging material.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Emporio Armani You Parfum Spray Absolutely 50 ml
listings.description: Stronger With You Absolutely by Emporio Armani is a composition with an intense and sensual presence. The fragrance opens with a striking rum accord, which is given a special facet by tangy bergamot and resinous elemi resin. Aromatic diva lavender from the south of France unfolds in the heart note, combined with essential davana oil. The base gives the perfume its depth and long-lasting character through a combination of Madagascan vanilla, an accord of glazed chestnut, smoky cedarwood and warm patchouli. As part of the fougère fragrance family, the perfume is characterised by ambery and spicy accents that create a warm, gourmand aura. The bottle has a sophisticated design to match the fragrance: the simple glass casing displays the rum-coloured liquid, while a smoky lacquer finish on the base of the bottle visually emphasises the intensity of the composition. An intense men's fragrance with a sensual aura Fragrance family: Fougère with ambery and spicy notes Main notes: Rum accord, diva lavender, vanilla and glazed chestnut Warm and gourmand character

listings.rawTitle: Armani Acqua di Giò Homme Eau de Parfum Spray - refillable Profondo 30 ml
listings.description: Acqua di Giò Profondo by Armani is an intense interpretation of the classic maritime fragrance that explores a new depth. The aromatic-aquatic fougère composition opens with the sparkling freshness of green mandarin and bergamot, accompanied by clear marine notes. An aromatic bouquet of rosemary, lavender and cypress unfolds in the heart, giving the fragrance a distinctive facet. The base note anchors the olfactory experience with woody nuances of patchouli and cedarwood, which are given a modern signature by mineral ambergris and a hint of musk. The deep blue bottle with its silver-grey accents is reminiscent of the unfathomable vastness of the ocean. As an eau de parfum, this fragrance is also designed to be refillable. The spray head can be removed so that the bottle can be easily refilled with the separately available refill bottle. An aromatic fougère fragrance with an aquatic character . Composition of green mandarin, rosemary and mineral amber. The bottle of the eau de parfum is refillable. Modern interpretation with a deep, woody-maritime signature.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Code Homme Eau de Parfum Spray - refillable 30 ml
listings.description: The Armani Code Homme Eau de Parfum is a modern interpretation of an ambery and spicy fougère fragrance that captivates with its contrasting notes. The composition opens with the sparkling and invigorating freshness of green mandarin, which provides a dynamic prelude. An aromatic-woody melange unfolds in the heart note, in which the characteristic spiciness of nutmeg essence meets the gentle tones of lavender. This combination creates a fascinating depth that is completed in the base note. A rich tonka bean absolute dominates here, giving the fragrance its characteristic, warm and sensual signature. Cedarwood and amber round off the creation and create an elegant, long-lasting impression. The iconic black bottle with golden accents is not only a visual statement, but has also been deliberately designed to be refillable to allow for sustainable use. Amber-like, spicy fougère fragrance composition . A combination of green mandarin, nutmeg and tonka bean. Combines dynamic freshness with sensual warmth. Iconic bottle with practical refill function.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Emporio Armani Eau de Parfum Spray Emporio She 50 ml
listings.description: The Emporio Armani She Eau de Parfum Spray is a composition that captivates with its soft and feminine aura. It opens with a fruity combination of mandarin and pear, which blends harmoniously into a floral heart note of delicate jasmine and heliotrope. At the centre of the fragrance is a soft vanilla essence, which is accompanied by an accord of angelica and creates a subtle, warm presence. The fragrance character is deliberately unobtrusive and remains pleasantly close to the skin, making it a suitable companion for everyday wear, especially during the cooler seasons such as autumn and winter. To optimise the bouquet, we recommend spraying the fragrance onto warm areas of skin, such as the inside of the wrists, from a distance of around 20 cm. Bottled in a simple yet sophisticated bottle, the design emphasises the subtle elegance of the fragrance creation. Fragrance character: Gentle, feminine and warm Fragrance notes: A composition of vanilla, jasmine, mandarin and pear Occasion: An ideal companion for everyday wear and the cooler seasons Presentation: Bottled in a timelessly elegant bottle

listings.rawTitle: Armani My Way Eau de Parfum Spray Sunny Vanilla 30 ml
listings.description: The composition of Giorgio Armani My Way Eau de Parfum Spray Sunny Vanilla presents itself as a radiant interpretation of the well-known My Way collection. This fragrance, which was launched in 2025, combines fruity accents with a floral depth and gourmand nuances. It opens with a tangy combination of bergamot and pineapple, which can provide immediate freshness. At the heart, an opulent bouquet of tuberose and a special jasmine grandiflorum superinfusion unfolds, emphasising the floral signature of the line. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a warm base of vanilla infusion and a creamy musk accord. Particularly noteworthy is the origin of the vanilla used, which comes from the Sava region in Madagascar and is part of a sustainable sourcing programme. The jasmine is also obtained in a natural and sustainable way. Visually, the bottle reflects the elegance of the contents: a transparent glass container reveals the delicate pink-coloured liquid, while the striking golden cap with its organic shape adds a sophisticated accent. Blue lettering on the glass echoes the classic aesthetic of the brand. Fruity-floral gourmand fragrance with notes of pineapple and bergamot Heart notes of tuberose and jasmine grandiflorum superinfusion Warm base with vanilla from Madagascar and creamy musk Use of sustainably sourced ingredients Elegant bottle with organically shaped, golden cap

listings.rawTitle: Isabey Paris Gardénia Eau de Parfum Spray 10 ml
listings.description: The Gardénia Eau de Parfum Spray by Isabey Paris enchants with its powdery, woody bouquet that is refreshed by tangerine. Romantic, creamy fragrance for women with ylang-ylang In 1924, Maurice Loewe opened his perfume house Isabey in Paris, whose fragrances were soon celebrated in Parisian society and received many awards. In 1941, at the beginning of the Second World War, the house had to close, but was revived in 2006 by the perfume company Panouge. The brand produces the original fragrances according to a slightly modernised recipe, bringing perfumes to the market that are reminiscent of the 1920s and have lost none of their seductive appeal . Gardénia Eau de Parfum Spray by Isabey Paris is a romantic fragrance for women that has been available since 2006. When sprayed on, it releases the refreshing notes of tangerine and African orange blossom , which are given an enchanting powdery accent by ylang-ylang. In the heart note, the floral tones of gardenia, rose, jasmine and iris come together and then flow into a warm base consisting of musk, sandalwood and ambergris.

listings.rawTitle: Masakï Matsushïma Matsu Sunshine Eau de Parfum Spray 10 ml
listings.description: A bright yellow colour not only dominates the look, but also reflects the olfactory character of the Masakï Matsushïma Matsu Sunshine Eau de Parfum spray. This creation by the Japanese designer combines Asian minimalism with the French art of perfumery and aims to create a sunny, positive aura. The opening is already full of energy with sparkling notes of lemon that meet the gentle sweetness of fig and herbaceous davana. This is followed by a pronounced floral heart that decisively characterises the composition and lends it a soft note. Chords of exotic frangipani, jasmine, yellow freesia and ylang-ylang combine to create a harmonious melody. To give the fragrance the necessary depth, the base is characterised by warmer, woody nuances such as sandalwood, musk and ambroxan, which form a gentle contrast to the initial freshness. The design of the bottle also consistently picks up on this theme: The curved, semi-circular shape in rich yellow is visually reminiscent of the sun and sits comfortably in the hand thanks to the integrated side handle. It is a fruity-floral fragrance that can be worn in a variety of ways. The fragrance opens with a floral lightness of albizia blossom and jasmine, which is given an exciting facet by the subtle spiciness of pink pepper. At the heart, a warm and creamy interplay of sweet vanilla and a gentle chestnut accord unfolds, giving the fragrance its gourmand character. The base note of fine sandalwood provides elegant depth and a long-lasting presence. The result is a modern, floral-woody fragrance that creates a fascinating balance between soft and powerful notes and emphasises a confident, unconventional style. Floral-woody fragrance with gourmand accents Composition of jasmine, chestnut, vanilla and sandalwood Combines sensual and powerful notes An eau de parfum with an expressive character

listings.rawTitle: Zadig & Voltaire Zadig Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Zadig Eau de Parfum Spray by Zadig & Voltaire is a woody-floral fragrance that captures the essence of an independent and strong personality. The composition opens with an extraordinary top note of a posidonia accord, black and white sesame and a light ginger spiciness. At the heart of the creation, a luminous bouquet of neroli essence and orange blossom unfolds, leading into a warm base. There, sensual, roasted vanilla, a creamy Chantilly accord and fine sandalwood combine to create an unforgettable aura. The fragrance is presented in an eye-catching, wing-shaped bottle with a jewel-like metal finish. The spray head can be unscrewed to refill the bottle. The formula is also vegan-certified and consists of around 89% ingredients of natural origin. Woody-floral fragrance composition with amber notes Composition of sesame, orange blossom and roasted vanilla Refillable bottle in a wing-shaped design Vegan-certified formula Consists of approx. 89% ingredients of natural origin

The composition opens with an energetic top note in which the tangy freshness of grapefruit meets the striking spiciness of black pepper. This initial vibrancy flows smoothly into a warm and captivating heart note, characterised by the contrasting nuances of sweet vanilla and mystical incense. Fine sandalwood provides a long-lasting and profound base, giving the fragrance a creamy yet masculine aura. Encased in a minimalist, transparent bottle typical of the brand, this fragrance embodies an authentic and self-confident style. A men's fragrance from the woody-spicy fragrance family. Composition of grapefruit, black pepper, vanilla, incense and sandalwood. Exudes a charismatic and confident aura. Presented in a minimalist and transparent bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Zadig & Voltaire Zadig Eau de Parfum Spray Intense 30 ml
listings.description: ZADIG L'INTENSE is the powerful new fragrance signature from the house - a floriental-woody Eau de Parfum Intense for women who uncompromisingly go their own way. Inspired by the iconic ZADIG Eau de Parfum, this more intense interpretation takes the feeling of freedom to a new level. The composition opens with a fascinating contrast of golden and black sesame, electrified by spicy ginger. In the heart, bright orange blossom unfolds, subtly accentuated by a touch of leather that gives the fragrance character and depth. A sensual base of gourmand vanilla and creamy, musky sandalwood provides long-lasting warmth and addictive potential. With 90% ingredients of natural origin and a vegan formulation, the fragrance combines intensity with modern sophistication. The iconic wing-shaped bottle shines in metallic gold and embodies new beginnings, strength and boundless radiance. - Floriental-woody fragrance with an intense, sensual signature - Sesame and ginger opening with striking energy - Orange blossom with a leather accent for modern depth - Vanilla & sandalwood for a warm, addictive dry-down - Vegan formula with 90% ingredients of natural origin

listings.rawTitle: Zadig & Voltaire This is Her! Eau de Parfum Spray Undressed 50 ml
listings.description: Zadig & Voltaire presents This is Her! Undressed, a light and sensual fragrance composition that radiates natural elegance. Released in 2023, the eau de parfum spray is characterised by a harmonious combination of warm, woody accords and the gentle sweetness of creamy vanilla. Soft floral notes round off the fragrance, while nuances of sandalwood add a subtle depth. The creation unfolds an authentic, silky character that is reminiscent of the feeling of skin on skin. Compared to previous versions, this fragrance is deliberately fresher and less intense, making it an ideal companion for everyday wear and all year round. Its uncomplicated nature suits different occasions and emphasises an independent, life-affirming style. listings.rawTitle: Zadig & Voltaire This is Her! Eau de Parfum Spray Intense This is Really Her! 30 ml
listings.description: With This is Her! This is Really Her!, Zadig & Voltaire presents an intense floral amber fragrance for women that captivates with its bold composition. The fragrance journey begins with a sparkling top note of pink berries and basil, which provides an invigorating opening. A unique metallic accord unfolds at the heart of the creation, combining with notes of rose and chestnut to create a fascinating melange. The Eau de Parfum Intense is rounded off by a warm and sensual base that combines facets of honey, patchouli and sandalwood. The fragrance accompanies its wearer from day to night. Matching the character of the fragrance, the bottle has a modern design inspired by metallic leather. It is also made from 15% recycled glass and is lighter than its predecessors. listings.rawTitle: Zadig & Voltaire This is Her! Red Hot Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Zadig & Voltaire This is Her! Red Hot Eau de Parfum envelops the body in a fruity-spicy composition that is ideal for both everyday life and special occasions. The transparent red bottle with its wave-like structure visually captures the modern character of the fragrance. Immediately after spraying, the top note of blackberry opens the fragrance experience and instantly imparts a fresh, fruity presence. As the fragrance develops, red jasmine in the heart note unfolds its floral facets, lending the scent a pleasant depth. Finally, the base note of red vinyl leather rounds off the profile, leaving a distinctive, slightly spicy note. This balanced combination creates a long-lasting companion that supports a confident aura from morning meetings to evening dinners. A few targeted sprays on the pulse points on the neck or wrists are enough to bring out the intense aroma to its fullest. Zesty notes of lemon and orange open the fragrance experience, leaving a refreshing impression immediately after application. As the fragrance develops, floral and spicy notes such as rosemary, jasmine, rose, lily of the valley, petitgrain and cardamom unfold. This delicate balance creates a multi-layered presence that skilfully emphasises your personal style. The base note of oakmoss rounds off the profile and gives the fragrance a long-lasting, warm character. The integrated spray head allows the Eau de Cologne to be applied precisely and sparingly. Just one or two sprays onto the pulse points are enough to create a pleasant scent that lasts for many hours. listings.rawTitle: Annayake Tomo Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Annayake Tomo Eau de Toilette Spray is a masculine, woody fragrance composition that is characterised by a dynamic and multi-faceted development. The fragrance opens with an invigorating freshness, combining aromatic notes of lavender and rosemary with the brightness of citrus fruits and a hint of cardamom. This initial lightness soon gives way to a warm and intense heart, in which the striking presence of tobacco meets a spicy blend of coriander and sage. This combination gives the fragrance its unmistakable character. Finally, a mysterious and alluring depth unfolds in the base, which lingers on the skin for a long time. Chords of tonka bean, resinous labdanum and black musk, accompanied by soft woody notes such as sandalwood, create a memorable finish. The result is a fragrance with velvety and slightly smoky facets that offers a pleasant presence for everyday wear. A masculine fragrance with a woody, spicy character. listings.rawTitle: Eisenberg L'Art du Parfum Eau de Parfum Spray J'OSE 30 ml
listings.description: The EISENBERG J'OSE HOMME Eau de Parfum Spray presents itself as a composition full of character and expressive contrasts. The fragrance opens with an invigorating top note, in which the sparkling nuances of lemon and bergamot combine with the clear freshness of mint to create a dynamic opening. Shortly afterwards, the aromatic heart unfolds, which is given a special depth by the interplay of lavender, wormwood and an intense, striking coffee accord. Woody notes such as patchouli and sandalwood provide a warm and present base, which meet the soft facets of moss, amber and musk. A hint of vanilla and tonka bean rounds off the olfactory experience with a subtle sweetness and lends it an unmistakably sensual dimension. The entire composition is multi-layered and leaves an elegant impression without being overpowering. Aromatic, woody fragrance with a multi-layered character. Combines a fresh top note of lemon and mint with a heart of coffee and lavender. The warm base of sandalwood, patchouli, amber and musk provides a sensual finish. Lends an elegant and unforgettable, but not overpowering presence.

listings.rawTitle: Eisenberg L'Art du Parfum Eau de Parfum Spray J'OSE 30 ml
listings.description: J'ose Femme Eau de Parfum Spray has been an iconic fragrance from the house of Eisenberg since its launch in 2000. This creation by José Eisenberg is characterised by a multi-faceted and balanced character. It opens with a refreshing composition of tangy lemon and cool mint, which is given an exciting twist by the special note of Armoise Citronnelle. A captivating bouquet unfolds at the heart of the fragrance, in which aromatic lavender and delicate jasmine combine with a striking coffee accord to create an unmistakable blend. The base note ensures a long-lasting and warm finish, combining sensual amber, musk and patchouli with the precious woody notes of sandalwood and cedarwood. J'ose Femme is a play of contrasts that creates an elegant balance between invigorating and profound accords. listings.description: The Diabolique Homme eau de parfum spray from the L'Art du Parfum collection by EISENBERG is a composition that impresses with its multi-layered facets. The fragrance initially unfolds with a fresh note of yellow mandarin and bergamot, which is given a stimulating depth by the spicy presence of cardamom. The fragrance is presented in a simple, dark glass bottle that reflects the modern aesthetic of the brand. listings.rawTitle: Eisenberg L'Art du Parfum Eau de Parfum Spray LE PÉCHÉ 50 ml
listings.description: The eau de parfum Le Péché Homme is part of the L'Art du Parfum line from Eisenberg Paris and presents a complex olfactory combination of woody, floral and musky elements. At the beginning, a top note unfolds that is characterised by the presence of osmanthus and subtle nuances of orange blossom and hibiscus. This rather light opening is in deliberate contrast to the further development of the fragrance. At the heart of the creation, jasmine combines with the sweetness of vanilla and transparent amber, giving the composition significantly more depth. Finally, the base note grounds the fragrance experience in powerful, earthy accords. Patchouli and sandalwood merge with vetiver and musk to create a long-lasting finish. Visually, the bottle reflects the clear lines of the brand. The container is square and in a deep black colour, on which the lettering "LE PÉCHÉ" and the brand name stand out in contrasting white capital letters. A transparent spray head with a silver finish and a black cap complete the design of this eau de parfum. Woody-floral fragrance for men with a musky character Top notes of osmanthus, hibiscus and orange blossom Warm base of patchouli, sandalwood, vetiver and musk Square, black bottle with white lettering Part of the L'Art du Parfum collection by Eisenberg Paris

listings.rawTitle: Eisenberg L'Art du Parfum Eau de Parfum Spray LE PÉCHÉ 100 ml
