listings.rawTitle: NISHANE X Collection Extrait de Parfum Spray Ani X 50 ml
listings.description: Fragrance abundance pays off The Ani X Extrait de Parfum is proof that many well-balanced fragrances make for an extraordinary creation. This perfume from NISHANE in the dark, flat 50 ml glass bottle with the gold-coloured lid is extravagant even on the outside. The black X behind the Nishane lettering is a particularly striking feature. The perfume from the X Collection with its subtly fruity-sweet, oriental-sensual orientation has been delighting women since 2023. Men will also find this unisex Ani X Extrait de Parfum interesting. The fragrance creation, which is part of the X Collection, exerts a mysterious allure on both sexes. Proven, natural fragrance nuances work together Intensity and depth characterise the individual fragrance notes of Ani X Extrait de Parfum alongside the variety of aromas. 16 different substances are involved in the pyramid of fragrance notes. In the top note, bergamot, honeydew melon, Thai ginger, cardamom, lime and pink pepper open the fragrance round as a successful mix. Light and fresh, green apple and blackcurrant lead to patchouli, rose and sage in the heart note. Musk, sandalwood, sweet vanilla and fine cedarwood complete the special fragrance experience in the base. The result is a perfume from NISHANE that feels attractive.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE X Collection Extrait de Parfum Spray Wulong Cha X 50 ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in the sensual world of Wulong Cha X Extrait de Parfum from the X Collection by NISHANE. This is a perfume that captures the essence of elegance and sophistication. Inspired by the exquisite Oolong tea, this perfume unfolds in a symphony of flavours that enchant the senses and leave an unforgettable aura. Exclusive perfume from NISHANE The top note opens with a fresh breeze of citrus fruits that gently blend with the green notes of tea. A hint of bergamot gives the fragrance a tangy liveliness, while the subtle nuances of mandarin and yuzu add a sweet, seductive note. At its heart, Wulong Cha X Extrait de Parfum from NISHANE's X Collection unfolds a bouquet of floral and spicy notes. Magnolia and thyme blossom, enveloped by the warmth of green tea, while a pinch of cardamom and pink pepper come to the fore to give the fragrance an exotic, spicy depth. The base note forms the foundation of the fragrance, a sensual blend of musk and fig. These rich, earthy elements lend the fragrance a seductive depth and ensure a long-lasting, beguiling impression on the skin. Wulong Cha X Extrait de Parfum from NISHANE's X Collection is a perfume that takes the art of perfumery to a new level.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Thorns Become Roses Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The Nishane Thorns Become Roses Extrait de Parfum offers an intense fragrance composition that enriches everyday life with a floral presence. A clear glass bottle with a striking, ribbon-shaped gold cap and a delicate rose motif holds the golden essence. Thanks to the high fragrance concentration of this Extrait de Parfum, even a small amount is enough to create a lasting olfactory aura that lasts all day. This allows for economical use and makes the fragrance a long-lasting companion for festive occasions or everyday working life. The floral notes, inspired by the rose that gives the fragrance its name, unfold gradually on the skin, offering a multi-layered olfactory experience. Those who wear this fragrance enjoy a harmonious balance of intense and gentle accords that emphasise an elegant presence. The perfume adapts effortlessly to different situations and lends every appearance a subtle yet distinctly perceptible touch. The fine spray head distributes the liquid evenly, which helps ensure it feels comfortable to wear and allows for precise application to the desired areas of the body. This makes it easy to incorporate the fragrance into your daily routine, leaving a distinctive impression. The high fragrance concentration allows for economical and long-lasting use in everyday life. Floral notes unfold gradually for a varied fragrance experience. A fine spray head distributes the perfume evenly and precisely onto the skin. The versatile composition adapts effortlessly to different occasions.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Prestige Extrait de Parfum Spray NEFS 50 ml
listings.description: In 2019, NISHANE presents NEFS as an extrait de parfum spray in the Prestige Collection. As is almost always the case with this brand, it is a unisex fragrance. It has a spicy and sweet presence, has above-average longevity and sillage and not only inspires with exclusivity. According to NISHANE, NEFS Extrait de Parfum Spray is a luxurious interpretation of oriental notes. Chris Maurice has created a top note of honey, saffron, sage, figs and violet for the fragrance from the Prestige Collection. For the heart, he uses rose geranium, jasmine, osmanthus, roses and nutmeg. The base of cedarwood, oud, gurjun balsam, vanilla, leather, cinnamon, amber and whiskey is truly opulent. Olfactory luxury that invites you to dream NISHANE has not only given the Prestige Collection a particularly luxurious look, but has also created captivating fragrances for the range. The fragrance of the NEFS Extrait de Parfum Spray is incredibly seductive, very sensual, incredibly flattering and like a dream from 1001 Nights. But without the kitsch. Noble, elegant , feminine and masculine and wonderfully delicately composed, this fragrance is the perfect fusion of Orient and Occident. The NEFS Extrait de Parfum Spray from NISHANE is the perfect companion on cool evenings and when going out.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Tuberoza Extrait de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: White flowers form the main accord of Tuberóza . The extrait de parfum spray from NISHANE impresses with its woody, aromatic fragrance. Launched in 2014, the creation was intended as a fragrance for women. However, the extrait de parfum spray is now presented as a unisex perfume that also appeals to men. The NISHANE brand from Istanbul is recognised worldwide for its unique take on perfume production. Their fragrant creations are a testament to tradition and modern visions. Tuberóza is a perfume from the amber-floral fragrance family Even as a plant, the tuberose from the agave genus enchants onlookers with its picturesque white flowers. The tuberose does not even have to be in bloom to become a fragrant ingredient in a perfume. If the Extrait de Parfum Spray Tuberóza by NISHANE were a colour, it would probably be a powerfully radiant blend of different shades of yellow, tinged with a golden touch. As a fragrance, the Eau de Parfum Spray Tuberóza radiates as wonderfully as a sunny day. The volatile top note is characterised by fruity, fresh aromas of orange blossom and sweet orange. The composition is accompanied by ylang-ylang and mugwort. The heart notes include tuberose, marigold, gardenia and jasmine. The base is formed by musk, vetiver, sandalwood and ambergris.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE X Collection Extrait de Parfum Spray Hundred Silent Ways X 50 ml
listings.description: The NISHANE X Collection Hundred Silent Ways X Extrait de Parfum is a real eye-catcher thanks to its bottle alone. It comes with a square silhouette, a creatively shaped golden cap and a golden body - which is emphasised even more by the large black and red "X". The scent of this perfume is similarly spectacular, emphasising the unmistakable luxury of the French fragrance house in a variety of ways. Floral and powdery notes meet gourmand accords in this perfume. NISHANE X Collection Hundred Silent Ways X Extrait de Parfum is an even more intense version of the original fragrance - also ideal for those who already love the eau de parfum. Versatile composition with many elegant highlights Due to the sweet mandarin and juicy peach, the NISHANE X Collection Hundred Silent Ways X Extrait de Parfum opens together with the tuberose in an impressive way. A Mediterranean feeling immediately sets in, with a certain depth that almost takes on aristocratic traits. This is followed by a floral bouquet composed of powdery iris, heliotrope and gardenia, among others. The base note combines the sweet with the harsh by skilfully combining vanilla and leather accords.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE X Collection Extrait de Parfum Spray Hacivat X 50 ml
listings.description: In homage to the popular classic, NISHANE presents Hacivat X, a modern and versatile fragrance interpretation. The composition opens with a tangy combination of juicy pineapple, fresh bergamot and the subtle spiciness of pink pepper. At the heart of the fragrance, a clear bouquet of lime, jasmine and Tunisian orange blossom unfolds, providing an invigorating facet. The base note anchors the extrait de parfum with a warm, earthy depth. Haitian vetiver, patchouli and cedarwood create a long-lasting and elegant finish. In its creamy white bottle with a striking golden cap, Hacivat X reflects the luxurious character of the X Collection. This chypre fragrance is an expression of joie de vivre and is suitable for various occasions throughout the year. A modern interpretation of a chypre fragrance . Pineapple, bergamot and pink pepper top notes. Heart notes of lime, jasmine and orange blossom. Base of vetiver, patchouli and cedarwood. Presented in an elegant bottle with golden details.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE X Collection Extrait de Parfum Tuberóza X 50 ml
listings.description: NISHANE Tuberóza X is an exquisite fragrance creation from the house's anniversary edition, the X-Collection. Developed by master perfumer Dominique Ropion, this extrait de parfum is a modern homage to tuberose that emphasises its characteristic facets in an impressive way. The composition begins with a bright top note of mandarin and ylang-ylang, which gently transitions into a floral heart. Here, Indian tuberose unfolds its full, honey-like splendour, elegantly accompanied by powdery violet and a sophisticated lipstick accord. In the base, the fragrance finds its conclusion in a warm, creamy embrace of amber, sandalwood and velvety musk. The result is a sensual yet delicate fragrance with an unmistakably elegant aura, created as a unisex perfume for special moments. Floral-floral extrait de parfum from the NISHANE X-Collection A new interpretation with Indian tuberose at the centre Composition with notes of ylang-ylang, violet and sandalwood Warm, powdery and sensual character Created by the renowned perfumer Dominique Ropion

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Time Capsule Eau de Parfum Spray Tero 50 ml
listings.description: NISHANE Time Capsule Tero Eau de Parfum Spray unfolds a composition that harmoniously combines earthy and sweet notes. This fragrance from the Time Capsule Collection opens with a striking combination of salted caramel and the distinctive spiciness of black and Sichuan pepper. A heart of warm cinnamon and earthy patchouli then unfolds, lending the creation a pleasant depth. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with Haitian vetiver oil, amber and oak wood and ensures a long-lasting, woody character. The extrait de parfum is presented in an elegant glass bottle, the design of which emphasises the value of the contents. Tero is a versatile fragrance that is particularly suitable for the cooler months and creates a balance between sweet gourmand accents and spicy, woody facets. Fragrance family: gourmand, spicy, woody Head notes: Salted caramel, black pepper, Sichuan pepper Heart notes: Patchouli, cinnamon Base notes: Vetiver oil, amber, oak wood

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Prestige Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: NISHANE Prestige Extrait de Parfum is a sophisticated composition that captivates with its harmonious combination of contrasting notes. The top note combines sweet figs, warm honey, spicy saffron, aromatic sage and delicate violet to create an inviting opening. The heart note unfolds a floral bouquet in which the refreshing green geranium combines with the sensual aromas of rose, osmanthus and jasmine, complemented by the striking warmth of nutmeg. The base note is characterised by intense and warm tones. Amber, oud and leather create a deep, velvety foundation that is rounded off by the sweet nuance of vanilla. Cedarwood and cinnamon also add a spicy and woody dimension that lends the composition additional complexity. The perfume is not only characterised by its special fragrance structure, but also impresses with its above-average longevity and sillage. As a unisex fragrance, it appeals to anyone looking for a seductive, sensual and elegant statement.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Shadow Play Extrait de Parfum Spray ZENNE 50 ml
listings.description: As part of NISHANE's Shadow Play collection, ZENNE is a fragrant homage to the spirited and self-confident main character of the traditional Turkish shadow play of the same name. Created by perfumer Jorge Lee, the composition opens with a multi-layered, fruity note of blackcurrant, grapefruit and rhubarb. At the heart of the fragrance, an elegant bouquet of gardenia and Turkish rose unfolds, accompanied by creamy sandalwood nuances and reminiscent of the atmosphere of a garden. The base of musk, ambergris and vanilla gives the fragrance a warm depth and a long-lasting radiance. The high concentration as an extrait de parfum creates a particularly intense fragrance experience that emphasises the character of its wearer. A fruity-floral unisex fragrance inspired by the character "Zenne". Fragrance notes of blackcurrant, Turkish rose and warm vanilla. A particularly intense fragrance experience thanks to the high concentration as an extrait de parfum. Created by perfumer Jorge Lee as part of the Shadow Play collection.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE X Collection Extrait de Parfum Spray Fan Your Flames X 50 ml
listings.description: Fan Your Flames X from the X Collection by NISHANE is a fascinating unisex fragrance that impresses with its warm and spicy composition. The opening unfolds an extraordinary blend of creamy coconut and sweet rum, which is given a special depth by the resinous nuances of mastic resin. At the heart of the creation, aromatic tobacco combines with the earthy sweetness of tonka bean and the unusual note of carrot, while thyme adds a subtle, herbal facet. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a base of earthy patchouli, woody cedar and classic oakmoss. This gives the extrait de parfum a long-lasting presence and makes it a multi-layered creation that combines tropical notes with deep, woody-spicy accords. Warm, spicy unisex fragrance with tropical notes Highly concentrated extrait de parfum Composition of coconut, rum, tobacco and woody notes Part of the exclusive NISHANE X Collection

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE No Boundaries Extrait de Parfum Spray EGE /ΑΙΓΑΙΟ 50 ml
listings.description: EGE /ΑΙΓΑΙΟ is an extrait de parfum spray by NISHANE and comes from the No Boundaries Collection. The fresh and aquatic fragrance has been available for men and women since 2020. The German name of the fragrance is Aegean, which can be read in Turkish and Greek on the turquoise-blue bottle. Composed by Ilias Ermenidis, the EGE /ΑΙΓΑΙΟΟ Extrait de Parfum Spray has top notes of fresh tart yuzu, aniseed and violet leaves. The heart notes of green cardamom, mint and basil are spicy. Everything is rounded off by incense and liquorice, which is as sweet as it is spicy. Created as a unisex fragrance, EGE /ΑΙΓΑΙΟ is not an extrait de parfum spray for everyone. The fragrance was created for those who transcend their boundaries or have none in the first place, just like the name of the collection. No Boundaries, no limits. An aquat that is simply so wonderfully different Admittedly, there are plenty of aquatic summer fragrances. But none are like the NISHANE EGE /ΑΙΓΑΙΟΟ Extrait de Parfum Spray. Fresh, aromatic, light , expressive and present , the fragrance from the No Boundaries Collection literally cries out for warm and hot days. But it also divides opinion. Some people love it, others can't relate to the scent of the Aegean. Find out for yourself what the extrait de parfum spray is for you and let the Turkish luxury label NISHANE surprise you.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Prestige Extrait de Parfum Spray MANA 50 ml
listings.description: The NISHANE MANA Extrait de Parfum Spray from the Prestige Collection is a leathery, spicy unisex fragrance with oriental and spicy influences . NISHANE is a niche label for luxury fragrances that are as sophisticated and powerful as they are seductive and mysterious. The MANA Extrait de Parfum Spray from the Prestige Collection is aimed at women and men who position themselves away from the mainstream and savour every day of life to the full. It is a fragrance that inspires the imagination and intoxicates the senses. Due to its intensity, this fragrance is particularly suitable for the evening and special occasions. An impressive fragrance that epitomises luxury, elegance and love an unmistakable and fascinating aura . The flacon in golden and black tones gives the MANA Extrait de Parfum Spray from the Prestige Collection by NISHANE a powerful and animalistic aura - a real eye-catcher in any bathroom.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Shadow Play Extrait de Parfum Spray KARAGOZ 50 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the fun-loving character Karagöz from the traditional Turkish shadow play, KARAGOZ Extrait de Parfum Spray is part of NISHANE's Shadow Play collection. This unisex fragrance is characterised by its fruity-green-woody character and captures the essence of humour and straightforwardness. The composition opens with a lively top note of sweet pineapple and dark grape, accompanied by a fresh herbal accord. At the heart of the fragrance, an interplay of neroli, jasmine and patchouli unfolds, lending the creation an aromatic warmth and complexity. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a base of vetiver, eaglewood (oud) and amber, which provides a sweet, earthy and woody finish. Developed by perfumer Jorge Lee, the fragrance skilfully combines different traditions to create a multi-layered composition that radiates strength and charisma. Fruity-green-woody unisex fragrance Composition with pineapple, neroli and eagle wood (oud) Inspired by the character Karagöz from the Turkish shadow play Part of the Shadow Play collection from NISHANE

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Miniature Art Extrait de Parfum Spray SULTAN VETIVER 50 ml
listings.description: Sultan Vetiver by NISHANE is a composition that is entirely dedicated to the versatility of vetiver. The fragrance opens with a clear, earthy note of Javanese vetiver, accompanied by the slight spiciness of pink pepper and the freshness of bergamot. As the fragrance progresses, warmer, woodier facets come to the fore, combining bourbon and Haitian vetiver with neroli and tonka bean. This combination gives the fragrance a pleasant depth. The base note rounds off the experience with amberwood and a hint of leather, giving the extrait de parfum a long-lasting and expressive character. As part of the Miniature Art Collection, the fragrance is presented in an elegant bottle that reflects the value of the ingredients. A woody, aromatic fragrance for all genders Combines different types of vetiver from Java, Haiti and Brazil. Evolves from a fresh, earthy note to a warm, woody base. Formulated as a highly concentrated extrait de parfum. Part of the exclusive Miniature Art Collection from NISHANE.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Miniature Art Extrait de Parfum Spray AMBRA CALABRIA 50 ml
listings.description: Modern classic from Istanbul AMBRA CALABRIA Extrait de Parfum Spray is a fragrance from the Turkish perfume brand NISHANE . This brand was founded in 2012 by Mert Guzel and Murat Katran and has since made a name for itself in the perfume aficionado scene. AMBRA CALABRIA was released in 2014, making it one of the oldest fragrances from NISHANE . The fact that it is still being produced after so many years proves that the creators have hit a nerve with this fragrance. AMBRA CALABRIA is a fresh, citrusy fragrance with bergamot, galbanum and green leaves as top notes. The heart notes are jasmine and coriander, while the base notes are musk, amber and vanilla. This makes AMBRA CALABRIA Extrait de Parfum Spray a mix of heavy and fresh notes , resulting in an extraordinary impression. In line with the current trend, AMBRA CALABRIA Extrait de Parfum Spray is categorised as a unisex fragrance , although many testers consider it to be more masculine and it is also predominantly bought by men. It is part of the Miniature Art collection, which consists of small, 50 ml bottles. The Miniature Art collection also includes other classic fragrances from NISHANE.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Imaginative Extrait de Parfum Spray B-612 50 ml
listings.description: The B-612 Extrait de Parfum Spray is part of the NISHANE Imaginative Collection. The unisex fragrance is fougère-like and spicy . As is so often the case with NISHANE, the longevity and sillage are above average. Launched in 2018 and composed by Chris Maurice, B-612 Extrait de Parfum Spray has top notes of rose geranium, cypress and lavender. Noble cashmere wood and spicy sandalwood meet patchouli and cedar in the heart note. Oak moss, tonka beans and musk round off the fragrance from the Imaginative Collection. The luxurious all-rounder for all occasions and seasons was inspired by a world-famous, enchanting story: that of the Little Prince. A heavenly fragrance, descended to earth According to the story by Antoine de Saint-Exupèry, the Little Prince came from the comet B-612, and the Extrait de Parfum Spray by NISHANE was created as a tribute to this enchanting story. The fragrance is an invitation to dream, let your mind wander and simply see things with different eyes. Lavender and cypress create a captivating interplay that is elegant and modern . Expressive and subtle at the same time, the fragrance gives you the choice of whether you recognise the little prince or a completely different inspiration in the NISHANE Imaginative Collection B-612 Extrait de Parfum Spray.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Signature Extrait de Parfum Spray PACHULÍ KOZHA 50 ml
listings.description: Free, spontaneous and erotic: this is how the NISHANE PACHULÍ KOZHA Extrait de Parfum Spray presents itself. The creation is one of the most popular fragrances from the Istanbul-based label. With its voluminous fragrance, it is also considered one of the strongest patchouli perfumes on the fragrance and cosmetics market. Leathery and earthy in its signature, this unisex fragrance is perfect for the modern man and the self-confident woman. With NISHANE PACHULÍ KOZHA Extrait de Parfum Spray, the Istanbul-based perfume label once again demonstrates its excellent flair for the unusual. NISHANE is a Turkish word that translates as "sign". The signature of this composition bears witness to an awareness of traditions and roots combined with modern visions. Greetings from the Orient NISHANE PACHULÍ KOZHA Extrait de Parfum Spray combines the warm passion of the Orient with the cool modernity of the West. This signature enchants lovers of erotic fragrances with wonderfully intense notes. Launched in 2014, the perfume belongs to the leather fragrance family. Its top notes are based on camomile, hyacinth and mugwort in combination with ylang-ylang. The heart note is characterised by a distinct scent of patchouli and a noble hint of black pepper. The base note is characterised by leather and incense, delicately embraced by a hint of honey.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Abundance Extrait de Parfum Spray NANSHE 50 ml
listings.description: The NANSHE Extrait de Parfum Spray from the Abundance Collection by NISHANE is a woody-powdery fragrance . Nanshe is the Sumerian goddess of fertility, water and justice. She also watches over prophecies and people's dreams. It is therefore not surprising that the Turkish luxury label NISHANE has named the first fragrance in the Abundance Collection after this goddess. Opulently designed and with extraordinary longevity and sillage, NANSHE Extrait de Parfum Spray will delight anyone looking for something exclusive. Yuzu, cardamom, carrot seed and bergamot are the top notes. Ylang-ylang, rose absolute, water flowers, water fruits and jasmine sambac absolute form the heart. For the base, NISHANE drew on the flavours of sandalwood, patchouli, musk, iris and powdery notes. A fragrance for him and her, but not for everyone NANSHE is an extrait de parfum spray for women and men . Just like the goddess after whom it was named, the fragrance is a true, albeit exclusive all-rounder . NISHANE has created the Extrait de Parfum Spray for all people who want to emphasise their personal style anytime and anywhere. With this sensual and extremely elegant perfume from the Abundance Collection, this is a breeze - especially if you like roses, as they are clearly in the foreground here.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Signature Extrait de Parfum Spray AFRIKA-OLIFANT 50 ml
listings.description: The NISHANE AFRIKA-OLIFANT Extrait de Parfum Spray from the Signature Collection is an animalic-spicy unisex fragrance with woody, leathery, smoky and oriental influences . It is a very distinctive, eye-catching and unmistakable luxury fragrance that puts both women and men in the deserved spotlight. The AFRIKA-OLIFANT Extrait de Parfum Spray from NISHANE's Signature Collection impresses with its above-average longevity and intense sillage . This lush, voluminous and olfactorily exciting fragrance celebrates life and exudes both romance and self-confidence. A fascinating fragrance that positions itself far from the mainstream Top notes of ambergris, frankincense, myrrh and labdanum open this extraordinary fragrance experience. In the heart note, castoreum, civet, leather and oud take the lead and steer the fragrance in a very extravagant direction. The base note is characterised by accords of muscenone(R), thibetone, mouscone and civetone. It is the multitude of unusual and exotic fragrance components that gives this perfume its special and unique orientation and effect. The glass flacon is minimalist in design - typical of NISHANE. The AFRIKA-OLIFANT Extrait de Parfum Spray from the Signature Collection is particularly suitable for the autumn and winter months of the year due to its intensity and depth.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Time Capsule Eau de Parfum Spray Papilefiko 50 ml
listings.description: The NISHANE Papilefiko Eau de Parfum Spray from the Time Capsule Collection is a spicy unisex fragrance with green, fresh, resinous and woody influences - and the scent of the Orient is also reflected in this extravagant luxury fragrance. "Papilefiko" means "butterfly effect" - small flap of wings, big effect . The perfect statement for this extraordinary fragrance, which envelops both men and women in a mysterious and fascinating aura . It is all about savouring life and enjoying the attention. The fragrance composition impresses with its above-average longevity and intense sillage. A first-class fragrance that leaves a pleasant memory Cardamom, coriander and citrus notes unfold their stimulating aromas in the top note. The heart notes are followed by the sounds of Provençal lavender, artemisia and jasmine. The base note is characterised by nuances of fir balsam, moss and styrax. It is the interplay of these extraordinary elements that gives the NISHANE Papilefiko Eau de Parfum Spray from the Time Capsule Collection its unmistakable character . The flacon is simple, stylish and minimalist in design - typical of this luxury label. The Papilefiko Eau de Parfum Spray from the Time Capsule Collection by NISHANE is suitable for every season and can be worn at work, at leisure or on festive occasions.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Time Capsule Extrait de Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The Turkish label NISHANE was founded in 2012. The fascinating perfume in the Time Capsule collection strikes a balance between Western and Oriental influences. In the Extrait de Parfum Papilefiko and Tero , both released in 2022, the ingredients merge into a time capsule of different cultures. When it is opened, a harmonious unisex perfume appears. The unmistakable minimalist flacon design of the luxury brand is typical of this fragrance line. The niche fragrances are suitable for leisure time and for going out in the cooler months of the year. NISHANE Time Capsule Papilefiko - spicy-sweet butterfly effect With this extrait de parfum, perfumer Dominique Ropion has once again created an extraordinary work of fragrance art: spicy - sweet - woody - green - fruity . The top note already reveals a beautiful fruity flavour in the combination of coriander, cardamom and citrus notes. The floral heart note unobtrusively combines radiant jasmine with lavender and artemisia. The green spice of the base note is achieved with fir balsam and moss, while styrax adds sweet, woody and creamy, resinous nuances to the soft unisex fragrance. NISHANE Time Capsule Tera - spicy, earthy sophistication This elegant creation by internationally renowned perfume artist Carlos Benaïm smells sweet - spicy - gourmand - woody - earthy . The extrait de parfum contains a top note full of salty caramel sweetness, with Szechuan pepper absolute and black pepper adding spicy notes. The heart note of Tero is like an autumn forest: patchouli exudes an earthy warmth, while cinnamon breaks through the autumn leaves like a ray of sunshine. The base is reminiscent of a night-time walk on the beach: amber radiates its warm, golden glow, while oak wood captures the salty sea air and sweet vetiver gives the fragrance depth and grounding.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Prestige Extrait de Parfum Spray SHEM 50 ml
listings.description: The Prestige SHEM Extrait de Parfum by NISHANE is an experience in a class of its own. Wrapped in a bottle that radiates pure elegance, a fragrance unfolds that is unrivalled. With every spritz, this perfume transports its wearer to the alleyways of Istanbul, where tradition meets modernity. On first application, the nose is greeted by a symphonic blend of exquisite notes. Delicate floral accords dance harmoniously with the deep nuances of woody undertones. A hint of oriental mysticism resonates in every note, while earthy components lend depth to the entire creation. Luxurious perfume for the modern woman The character of Prestige SHEM Extrait de Parfum by NISHANE reflects the splendour and diversity of cultures that have clashed over the centuries at the crossroads of East and West. Elegance interweaves with passion, strength meets tenderness: an ode to the modern woman who stands with both feet on the ground and never forgets her roots. After the initial fragrance impulse has set in, a warm, sensual base develops. Geranium and vetiver cuddle up to the skin, conveying a feeling of security and timeless beauty. NISHANE, with its tireless pursuit of perfection, has created a work of art with Prestige SHEM Extrait de Parfum - a perfume that not only smells good, but also tells a story, a narrative about travelling, encounters and the eternal dance between tradition and progress.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Prestige Extrait de Parfum Spray HACIVAT OUD 50 ml
listings.description: The HACIVAT OUD Extrait de Parfum will be released in 2023 in the Prestice Collection by NISHANE. Composed for men and women, the perfume has a woody and citrusy presence that is particularly suited to the warm season. The grand master of fragrances, Dominique Ropion, gives the perfume an opulent and above-average durability and sillage. He blends citric notes with black pepper, pink pepper and pineapple in the top note. The heart note is characterised by the presence of incense, frankincense resin and jasmine. Patchouli from Indonesia, vetiver from Haiti, oud and vanilla round off this elegant and sensual creation. The perfume from NISHANE's Prestige Collection comes in an elaborately crafted bottle whose luxurious appearance perfectly complements the HACIVAT OUD Extrait de Parfum. Sometimes it just has to be luxury When you see the bottle and realise that the longevity and sillage are above average, you quickly think that Prestige HACIVAT OUD Extrait de Parfum is only for special occasions. However, the perfume from the NISHANE Prestige Collection actually has the potential to become a favourite fragrance. It is suitable for all occasions, day and night, all year round. NISHANE has created the fragrance for all people who also value something special when choosing their fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Rumi Extrait de Parfum Spray FAN YOUR FLAMES 50 ml
listings.description: NISHANE Rumi FAN YOUR FLAMES Extrait de Parfum Spray is a luxurious and extravagant unisex fragrance with a woody-spicy orientation and sweet, smoky and gourmand influences . This elegant fragrance is aimed at both women and men who enjoy presenting themselves in a secretive, seductive and equally self-confident way. The exquisite components make FAN YOUR FLAMES Extrait de Parfum Spray by NISHANE Rumi a true masterpiece of the art of perfumery. A striking, first-class fragrance that exudes pure luxury The top note opens with nuances of coconut and aromatic rum. In the heart note, tobacco and tonka bean nestle into this extraordinary fragrance experience. The sophisticated perfume is rounded off in the base with accords of oakmoss and Chinese cedar. The glass bottle has a minimalist design. A simple cuboid with a slightly asymmetrical, gold-coloured cap stylishly accentuates the NISHANE Rumi FAN YOUR FLAMES Extrait de Parfum Spray. The unmistakable fragrance is particularly suitable for the cooler months of the year thanks to its depth and warmth. It perfectly sets the scene for its wearer on special occasions, evening events or even a candlelit dinner on a first date. This fascinating fragrance composition definitely leaves a pleasant, lasting impression.

listings.rawTitle: ASABI Fragrances Eau de Parfum Spray No 3 100 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray No 3 by ASABI is a sweet and gourmand fragrance. The longevity and sillage are above average, as is typical for the label's fragrances. Like the other ASABI fragrances, the Eau de Parfum Spray No 3 is of course a unisex perfume. The top note consists of bergamot, neroli and caramel. Roses, iris and jasmine make up the floral heart note. The base of musk and vanilla is creamy and delicate. They complete the dreamlike, beautiful fragrance that invites you to unwind. Sensual, elegant , both feminine and masculine, Eau de Parfum Spray No 3 is one of the young label's most popular fragrances. You decide who the fragrance is for ASABI didn't want to put a label on its fragrances. Feminine, masculine, East, West - why categorise when, with a little effort and sensitivity, you can create a fragrance that is neither one nor the other? ASABI had exactly these guidelines and ideas and the Eau de Parfum Spray No 3 fulfils these requirements with ease, while at the same time being slightly mysterious. You can't help but become curious about the label, which puts so much thought into a perfume even before it is created.

listings.rawTitle: ASABI Fragrances Eau de Parfum Spray Oud 100 ml
listings.description: ASABI loves fragrances, men and women alike appreciate the brand. Unisex perfumes are very popular and save resources because both members of a household wear the same fragrance. The perfume gives the wearer a noble oriental note of exquisite extracts in a perfect creation. This oud eau de parfum spray enchants the senses and awakens a longing for distant journeys. Bergamot, lychee and peach form an outstanding combination. The light citrus note, enveloped by the sweet lychee and the scent of ripe peaches in the top note, creates a fruity, stimulating dream of oriental freshness. Oud Eau de Parfum Spray by ASABI is a luxurious fragrance In the heart note, the perfume releases the warming scent of rose and peony, which harmonise perfectly with oud and jasmine. As a fruity element, pomegranate emphasises the aroma of this fragrance with its tart sweetness. The base of long-lasting fragrances consists of notes that ground, calm and strengthen the personality of the wearer. Musk, wood, amber and vanilla strengthen well-being. Due to its fruity note , ASABI perfume is suitable as a spring and summer fragrance and exudes a pleasant scent in warm autumn.

listings.rawTitle: ASABI Fragrances Eau de Parfum Spray L'Omertà 100 ml
listings.description: Launched in 2022, the unisex fragrance L'Omertà Eau de Parfum Spray by ASABI presents - like all fragrances from the trendy label - a fascinating synthesis of magnificent oriental and elegant western fragrance accords. Its select ingredients are designed for exclusivity. An olfactory interplay of Orient and Occident The very modern, woody-citrus composition , whose perfumer should remain unknown according to the maxims of the ASABI brand, opens with a sweet-floral, subtly herbaceous accent of Indian davana. Sparkling notes of lemon lend the perfume an invigorating freshness, while aquatic nuances provide a shimmering lightness. The heart note of L'Omertà Eau de Parfum Spray belongs to the radiant Iris . Extracted from the rhizome of the plant, this precious essence captivates with its intense floral-fruity fragrances, surrounded by a warm, woody touch. Mysterious elegance is the theme of the base in ASABI L'Omertà Eau de Parfum Spray. Noble sandalwood plays with nuances of sensual amber, while an accent of moss provides depth full of character. A very multi-layered perfume that combines the splendid, colourful richness of the Orient with the chic and lightness of Western climes. It creates an expressive, stylish flair both during the day and in the evening.

listings.rawTitle: ASABI Fragrances Eau de Parfum Spray No 4 100 ml
listings.description: There are still not that many fragrances from ASABI, an extremely unusual label. One fragrance is the fruity and woody Eau de Parfum Spray No 4, which is naturally for men and women, has above-average longevity and an elegant sillage. The unknown perfumer created the top note with fruity and green notes. The heart note also features fruity notes together with the scent of aniseed. Amber, vanilla and musk play the leading roles in the base. ASABI Eau de Parfum Spray No 4 is an elegant, sensual all-rounder that appeals to both men and women and is suitable all year round. Niche can be this beautiful The simple design of the bottle of ASABI's Eau de Parfum Spray No 4 also arouses curiosity. The label wraps all fragrances in the same flacons, but gives them different garments so that the fragrances can be distinguished immediately. The elegant yet lightly dreamy radiance of Eau de Parfum Spray No 4 casts a spell over everyone. The fragrance is something special, it flatters its wearers, fulfils ASABI's requirements for absolute neutrality in terms of East-West or feminine-masculine and proves how wonderful a niche fragrance can be.

listings.rawTitle: ASABI Fragrances Eau de Parfum Spray No 2 100 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray No 2 is, how could it be otherwise, the second fragrance from ASABI. It is sweet and spicy , was created for men and women and impresses with its above-average longevity and sillage. However, the Eau de Parfum Spray No 2 by ASABI does not need an expansive or even opulent fragrance pyramid to achieve this; there are just four components in this fine fragrance. Jasmine and saffron are mixed in the top note, followed by cedarwood in the middle and amber in the base. The label sees its fragrances as neither Eastern nor Western, neither for women nor for men. The aim was to make the fragrances as neutral and at the same time as expressive as possible. And they have really succeeded. Elegant, neither masculine nor feminine, but a real all-rounder The fragrances from ASABI really suit everyone, everywhere. The Eau de Parfum Spray No 2 is clearly perceptible , but does not impose itself and flatters its wearer. ASABI has succeeded in creating an enchanting fragrance that will appeal to anyone who likes to wear a special presence but doesn't want an olfactory bomb. Anyone who is not yet familiar with the label from Halver should take the opportunity to test one of the exclusive fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: ASABI Fragrances Eau de Parfum Spray Intense 100 ml
listings.description: One of ASABI's fragrances is the Eau de Parfum Spray Intense. The fragrance is spicy-fresh and was created for men and women. It is not known when ASABI Eau de Parfum Spray Intense was launched. What makes ASABI fragrances so different is their origin. A group of passionate fragrance lovers wanted to create a fragrance that was neither from the East nor the West and that was aimed as much at women as it was at men. All fragrances should be melting pots, just like the creatives behind this label, whose name means impulsive and energetic in Arabic. And that fits perfectly, including with this eau de parfum, which is generally considered to be the label's first fragrance because it has no number. From the world for the world The Eau de Parfum Spray Intense favours neither women nor men and has no clear classification. That is the intention. A top note of lavender gives way to a heart note of myrrh before the base of tonka bean, vanilla and lavender appears. ASABI itself thought that the Eau de Parfum Spray Intense would be perfect for the summer , when you don't want to complain and just want to go through the day and evening full of vigour.

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Classic Collection Extrait de Parfum Spray Salaria 100 ml
listings.description: The Giardino Benessere Salaria Extrait de Parfum Spray is a versatile unisex fragrance from the renowned Classic Collection of the Italian niche brand. The simple, transparent glass bottle with its silver-coloured cap emphasises the elegant aesthetics of the creation. The composition developed by Paolo and Tiziana Terenzi offers a long-lasting fragrance experience that enriches everyday life olfactorily. Thanks to its high concentration as an extrait de parfum, just a few sprays are enough to create an aura of presence. This ensures an extremely economical application. The perfume is ideal for everyday use in the office as well as for special occasions in the evening. The harmonious blend of ingredients allows the fragrance to unfold individually on the skin. This exclusive creation subtly emphasises personal charisma. Fragrance enthusiasts will find an appealing addition to their collection that can be easily integrated into their daily routine. Highly concentrated extrait de parfum for a long-lasting fragrance presence Versatile unisex fragrance for everyday wear and special occasions Economical application thanks to intensive fragrance formulation Exclusive niche creation from Italian production

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Giardino Dell Eden Extrait de Parfum Elenis 100 ml
listings.description: Elenis is inspired by a perfect place full of harmony, where everything is in balance. The fragrance stands for a transformation that touches not only the body but also the soul and is an expression of longing. It reveals itself slowly and invites you to listen carefully and recognise the timeless beauty it contains. Elenis is a creamy, warm-smelling perfume with vanilla, heliotrope and caramelised honey notes that is not simply sweet, but rich and multi-layered. Heart notes of chestnut honey and cane sugar add depth, while base notes of coffee, milk butter and frangipani create a soft, velvety warmth. The fragrance feels like a harmonious whole that unfolds slowly and lingers on the skin for a long time.

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Giardino Dell Eden Extrait de Parfum Aetera 100 ml
listings.description: Aetera is inspired by a special moment between day and night, when everything falls silent and only a subtle breeze blows. This fragrance captures the feeling of a floating, almost invisible moment that is more palpable than tangible. It stands for a living connection between memory, movement and the invisible. Aetera is a light, floral-fresh fragrance with vanilla, jasmine and mimosa that lies on the skin like a gentle breeze. In the heart, sweet and sensual notes of cane sugar, tonka bean and exotic flowers combine to create a harmonious melody. The base of amber, musk, patchouli and oakmoss gives the fragrance depth and warmth, so that it lingers in the air like a delicate echo.

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Titani Collection Extrait de Parfum Oceania 100 ml
listings.description: ]Giardino Benessere - Oceania Extrait de Parfum from the Titani Collection. The special has its price. The intense fragrance is like a force of nature . It is reminiscent of the power of the Titans, who, according to legend, were involved in the creation of the earth. They also ruled over the deep blue oceans, whose green-blue colour in the beautiful bottle of Oceania Extrait de Parfum preserves the costly essence . The freshness of the sea, combined with the best of nature The Oceania Extrait de Parfum from the Titani Collection by Giardino Benessere is hard to describe. It is like a magic potion , which gives the wearer attractive powers. A citrusy, fruity fragrance that is incomparable to anything else. Top notes of bergamot with cardamom , orange and exclusive oxygen molecules from Terenzi's magic kitchen gently envelop the perfume creation. Notes of blackcurrant, lavender, passion fruit, pepper, nutmeg and peach come together at the heart of the fragrance. The whole is underpinned by moss and woods .</p

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Classic Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Woodstock Patchouli 100 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Woodstock Patchouli from the Classic Collection by Giardino Benessere places the multi-layered and earthy note of patchouli at the centre of a complex fragrance architecture. The opening already surprises with a combination of fruity accents of plum and date, which meet an aromatic hint of rum and the floral presence of jasmine sambac. This lively opening flows smoothly into a spicy heart note in which patchouli once again dominates, this time accompanied by the dryness of cedarwood and the spicy pungency of nutmeg. At this point, smoky incense nuances lend the composition a mysterious depth. A warm base forms the foundation of the fragrance, in which Madagascar vanilla and amber form a harmonious combination with soft musk. Visually, the rectangular glass bottle with its clear, pale yellow liquid reflects the purity of the essences. A silver-coloured label and the domed silver cap add elegant accents. This woody, spicy creation dispenses with specific gender categorisation and instead focuses on the olfactory experience of high-quality ingredients. Woody, spicy fragrance character with a central patchouli note Fruity opening with plum, date and rum Heart notes of cedarwood, nutmeg and incense Warm base with vanilla, amber and musk Elegant glass bottle with silver-coloured details

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Giardino Dell Eden Extrait de Parfum Hortus 100 ml
listings.description: Hortus Extrait de Parfum, a fragrance like in the Garden of Eden Giardino Benessere presents Hortus Extrait de Parfum , a perfume that combines the enchanting scents of a paradisiacal garden. Legend has it that all fruits and flowers are united in the Garden of Eden. Giardino Benessere has succeeded in bringing this concert of fragrances to life in its Hortus perfume. Incidentally, the name Hortus comes from Latin and means "garden". The fruity-floral creation has a firm place in the Giardino dell Eden line. In addition to flowers and fruits, spices and woody notes also play a role. An olfactory delight not just for garden fans: Hortus Extrait de Parfum from the Giardino dell Eden line is suitable as a unisex fragrance for men and women who love natural fragrances and appreciate a slightly exotic allure. The fragrance journey begins with top notes of freesia, lavender, osmanthus and violet, complemented by cardamom, orange and lemon. The heart notes are dominated by jasmine, plum, plum blossom, lotus and ylang-ylang. The base note consists of musk, sandalwood and birch. Ebony, elm, oak and oakmoss also add woody accents. The perfume from the Giardino dell Eden collection by Giardino Benessere comes in a floral bottle to match the contents.

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Giardino Dell Eden Extrait de Parfum Sublime 100 ml
listings.description: Flowery and fruity: the Sublime Extrait de Parfum by Giardino Benessere The Sublime Extrait de Parfum is a new creation from Giardino Benessere. The perfume is a unisex fragrance from the Giardino dell Eden line that delights men and women alike. With its floral-fruity radiance , it is perfect for the warm season, but also brings back the lightness of summer in colder periods. The floral design of the bottle conceals a mysterious blend of flowers, fruits and woody accents. The perfume from the Giardino dell Eden line is therefore a perfect glimpse into the Garden of Eden, the paradise we all dream of. The exciting composition of Sublime Extrait de Parfum Let yourself be surprised! At first sniff, you will discover top notes of dog rose, apricot blossom, blackcurrant, peach blossom and neroli, rounded off with a hint of pepper. The heart note of the perfume consists of lily of the valley, magnolia, peach blossom and violet as well as orris, better known as violet root. Now saffron also comes into play, as well as teak and cedarwood. The new fragrance by Giardino Benessere is given stability and fullness with the base note, consisting of various woody ingredients such as birchwood, sandalwood, oak and ebony. Other ingredients such as patchouli, ambergris, musk and incense complete the perfume from the Giardino dell Eden line. <p

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Titani Collection Extrait de Parfum Kronos 100 ml
listings.description: A powerful yet elegant composition is revealed in Kronos Extrait de Parfum from the Titani Collection by Giardino Benessere. Created by Paolo Terenzi, this fragrance is characterised by a high concentration of precious essences that ensure remarkable longevity and intensity on the skin. The olfactory progression begins with a sophisticated top note in which the powdery facet of iris meets the delicate freshness of orange blossom and white carnation. This floral opening flows smoothly into a spicy depth characterised by the striking notes of black pepper and cinnamon. These spices are accompanied by a classic rose accord and warm amber, giving the heart a complex structure. The foundation of this unisex creation is a warm, woody base that gives the fragrance its long-lasting character. Precious Cambodian oud, creamy sandalwood and sweet vanilla combine with musk to create a harmonious finish. The design also underlines the sophisticated character of the perfume: a shiny, dark bottle with rounded edges and a solid, silver-coloured cap ensures an aesthetic presentation. The round, engraved metal emblem on the front rounds off the high-quality visual appearance of this niche fragrance. High fragrance concentration: As an extrait de parfum, the fragrance offers a particularly long-lasting intensity. Multi-layered fragrance notes: A combination of floral iris, spicy cinnamon and deep Cambodian oud. Unisex character: The woody-spicy composition is equally suitable for all genders Elegant design: The dark, shiny bottle with silver accents and engraving has a very high-quality look.

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Titani Collection Extrait de Parfum Febe 100 ml
listings.description: Inspired by Greek mythology and the Titan of Light, this creation presents itself as a radiant and multi-layered composition from the renowned Titani Collection. The extrait de parfum opens with a dynamic blend of sparkling bergamot, lemon and the exotic sweetness of passion fruit and cassis, which creates an immediate presence. As the fragrance progresses, an extremely complex heart unfolds, in which elegant floral accords of magnolia and ylang-ylang meet the juicy, fruity nuances of peach and raspberry. This sophisticated bouquet is complemented by spicy cinnamon, aromatic lavender and a fascinating hint of absinthe, which gives the fragrance a special depth and structure. The long-lasting olfactory experience culminates in a warm, enveloping base that harmoniously combines creamy caramel and vanilla with earthy patchouli, musk and amber. Visually, the rectangular, gold-coloured bottle with its gently rounded edges and shiny, silver-coloured cap reflects the minimalist elegance of the contents. Fragrance: A multi-faceted combination of fruity, floral and spicy notes with a gourmand finish. Head note: Sparkling bergamot and lemon meet passion fruit and cassis. Heart note: A complex interplay of magnolia, ylang-ylang, peach, raspberry, cinnamon, lavender and absinthe. Base note: Warm accords of caramel, vanilla, musk, amber and patchouli. Design: High-quality, gold-coloured bottle with silver accents from the Titani Collection.

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Titani Collection Extrait de Parfum Iperione 100 ml
listings.description: The inspiration for this complex fragrance composition comes from Greek mythology with the Titan of Light. The Giardino Benessere Titani Collection Iperione Extrait de Parfum is presented in a solid, rectangular bottle that stands out with its brown colour and shiny, metallic silver-coloured cap. In the olfactory opening, an interesting note of ambergris and mastic unfolds, which meets the fruity nuance of raspberries and the powdery elegance of Florentine iris. This is followed by a multi-layered heart in which floral accents of rose, lily of the valley and osmanthus blend harmoniously with the deep, characterful aroma of oud from Laos. A warm base rounds off the experience. Indian oud, earthy cypriol, musk and amber provide a long-lasting and intense finish. This unisex creation is characterised by its high concentration of natural essences and skilfully combines woody and floral elements. The round, silver emblem on the front bears the name of the fragrance and emphasises the aesthetic design of this niche fragrance. Fragrance family: Woody-floral composition with musky accents Head note: Combination of raspberry, ambergris, iris and mastic Heart note: Floral bouquet of rose and osmanthus meets oud from Laos Base note: Deep accords of Indian oud, amber, musk and cypriol Design: Rectangular bottle in brown with silver cap and emblem

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity for Men After Shave 100 ml
listings.description: After shaving, the Eternity for men after shave from Calvin Klein offers a pleasant feeling on the skin. The fluid texture is easy to spread on the face and leaves a subtle fragrance that accompanies you throughout the day. The composition opens with notes of mandarin and lavender, which create a fresh and clear aura. Spicy accents of basil and sage then unfold, giving the fragrance an aromatic depth. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a base of sandalwood and amber, which provides a warm and woody finish. The aftershave comes in a sleek glass bottle with a shiny metallic cap that reflects the brand's timeless design. It is suitable for different skin types and complements the fragrance line of the same name. Liquid after shave with a classic fragrance Combination of fresh, spicy and woody notes Head notes: Mandarin, lavender, green botanicals Heart notes: Basil, geranium, sage Base notes: Sandalwood, rosewood, amber

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Body spray Hair & Body Mist Smooth Berry 100 ml
listings.description: The Calvin Klein cK smooth berry hair & body perfume mist envelops the senses in a fruity fragrance composition. The gentle berry notes give a fresh feeling that accompanies you unobtrusively with every step. Users spray the fine mist directly onto the skin or into the hair to create a subtle fragrance aura. This versatile application option saves on bathroom fuss and supports quick styling. Thanks to its handy size of 100 millilitres, the spray fits perfectly in any bag and offers an uncomplicated refresher on the go after sport or in the office. The lightweight spray head distributes the liquid evenly, which favours a weightless feel on the skin and in the hair. Visually, the product comes in a modern, pink-coloured bottle with a pink cap. The unisex spray enriches your personal fragrance routine and leaves behind a pleasant hint of fruity berries. Fruity berry notes for a fresh feeling Versatile application options on the skin and in the hair Handy 100 ml size for easy transport Fine spray mist for even distribution without weighing it down

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Sensual Skin Lotion 200 ml
listings.description: This addictive, oriental fragrance contrasts exotic fruits and seductive blossoms with a creamy note oozing with sex appeal. The Sensual Skin Lotion is enriched with shea butter, honey and vitamins A, C and E. A special moisturising formula leaves the skin feeling silky-soft and with a pleasant scent.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Obsession for Men After Shave 125 ml
listings.description: Refreshing clarity after shaving. Extremely clean-cut and masculine with a subtle power of attraction – such is the demeanour of the men’s fragrance Obsession by Calvin Klein. Spirited and fascinating in its emotional clarity, just like the man wearing it. The Aftershave gives you a pure rejuvenating boost after shaving. At once, the skin feels comfortably cool. At the same time, it is refreshingly revitalised. The optimal start to the day.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Reveal Men Hair & Body Shampoo 200 ml
Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb After Shave Balm 100 ml
listings.description: The Spicebomb After Shave Balm from Viktor & Rolf gives the skin a refreshing energy boost and cools the skin after shaving. This prevents redness and razor burn and allows minor injuries to heal more quickly. The spicy fragrance also makes this balm seductively addictive.

listings.rawTitle: Village Lavender Hand & Nail Cream 100 ml
listings.description: The tube stands out visually thanks to its elegant design with purple and gold diamond decoration, complemented by a central image of lavender flowers on a beige ribbon. This aesthetic presentation encloses a formulation that has been specially designed for the needs of hands and nails. Dry areas of skin that are exposed to daily stress are at the centre of the application of this unisex product. The Village Lavender Hand & Nail Cream is characterised by a pleasant texture that spreads evenly and is quickly absorbed. A key feature is the fragrance, which conveys the typical notes of lavender and is clearly perceptible during application. The composition contains vitamins and nutrients that aim to support the appearance of the skin and nails. The cuticles can also benefit from the rich consistency. The product leaves a feeling of suppleness on the skin's surface without weighing it down. By combining hand and nail components, the cream offers a comprehensive solution for the daily routine. Combined application for hands and nails Contains vitamins and nutrients Characteristic lavender fragrance Designed for dry and stressed skin Rich texture for a smooth skin feel

listings.rawTitle: Cartier La Panthère Discovery Set La Panthère Eau de Toilette 2 ml + La Panthère Eau de Parfum 2 ml + La Panthère Parfum 2 ml + Baiser Volé Eau de Parfum 2 ml + Baiser Volé Parfum 2 ml / 1 Stk.
listings.description: Would you like to discover Cartier fragrances? Then the Discovery Set is just the thing for you! You can also present the brand's broad portfolio of fragrances to a friend in this way. There are five practical trial sizes, each containing 2 ml , which are sure to lead to you finding one or more new favourite fragrances! Three times La Panthère, two times Baiser Volé One of Cartier's iconic fragrances is La Panthère, which is reminiscent of the famous piece of jewellery. It is part of the Discovery Set as both an eau de toilette and an eau de parfum. There is also the pure La Panthère perfume. You will love this fragrance if you like elegant perfumes with floral and fruity notes. The accords include chypre, gardenia and apricot. Another fragrance from the house of Cartier is Baiser Volé. This is also included in the Discovery Set. You can try the eau de parfum version and the pure perfume. The fragrance is floral, which is particularly evident in the heart note of lily and rose. The bergamot top note and the vanilla base round off the fragrance. The Discovery Set also makes a good visual impression, as it beguiles in the timeless Cartier box.

listings.rawTitle: Cartier Pasha de Cartier After-Shave 100 ml

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Gucci Bloom Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Gucci Bloom Eau de Toilette Spray is a special kind of Gucci fragrance: it is the first ever fragrance from the Italians for which Alessandro Michele is entirely responsible. At the centre of his vision is the modern woman, who can take over entire rooms and change days for the better with her zest for life, openness and strength of character. The world-famous perfumer Alberto Morillas followed Alessandro Michele's vision by gathering a floral bouquet from all over the world for the eau de toilette spray. The cosmopolitan vein of the fragrance is unmistakable - from the first spritz to the particularly gentle heart note. A very typical Gucci composition For Gucci Bloom, Morillas first travelled to India, where he collected natural tuberose and then combined it with jasmine bud extract. Here, too, no effort was spared for the Gucci fragrance: the buds are treated in a gentle co-extraction process in order to preserve the natural scent of jasmine in all its diversity. The iris note, which forms the basis for Gucci Bloom, is also striking. The eau de toilette spray comes in a matching pale pink rectangular bottle and a floral, excitingly designed outer packaging - both of which naturally bear the world-famous Gucci logo.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Absolute Eau de Parfum Spray Absolute 90 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Absolute is a rebellious fragrance. Absolute has helped Gucci to break free from the shackles of traditional woody creations. Perfumer Alberto Morillas made a significant contribution to the creation of the fragrance by discovering Goldenwood, the natural extract from the Nootka cypress, in the archives of the Royal Botanical Gardens under a glass bell jar. In combination with the special leather accord Woodleather, he made this fragrance extract the basis of the Eau de Parfum Spray Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Absolute. What is particularly pleasant for the wearer is that Absolute by Gucci does not change after the first application. A complex fragrance structure - Eau de Parfum Spray Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Absolute Absolute by Gucci is characterised by woody, dry notes that convey complexity and depth. The fragrance starts with impressions of leather in the top note, which already give rise to anticipation of the upcoming unfolding moments of Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Absolute. The eau de parfum spray fulfils these with seductive accents of patchouli oils, which surround the wearer with an irresistible aura in three different forms. The Absolute fragrance experience by Gucci closes successfully at the base with fresh and earthy accords of vetiver grass.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Black XS for Her Eau de Parfum Spray 80 ml
listings.description: Black XS for Her is an eau de parfum spray by Paco Rabanne and was launched in 2018. It is a floral-sweet fragrance for women and is a flanker of the Eau de Toilette Black XS for her, which was released in 2007. The black and red bottle arouses curiosity and looks like a classic bottle from times gone by, but the fragrance inside is a modern eau de parfum spray that simply delights. Paco Rabanne has often proven that he understands women's fragrances perfectly - and he has confirmed this with Black XS for Her. What takes a long time finally becomes good It took 11 years for the eau de toilette to be accompanied by an eau de parfum spray, but the wait was worth it. The top note consists of pink pepper and tamarind blossom. The top notes of Paco Rabanne Black XS for Her include black violets, cocoa blossoms and Christmas roses. The base is characterised by dry and creamy woods and vanilla. The fragrance is just as suitable for everyday wear as it is as an evening perfume. Whether you are a fan of the eau de toilette or not, you absolutely must get to know the eau de parfum spray, it is a fragrance in its own right .

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Black XS Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The radical charm of a woody-oriental fragrance combines with the sparkling citrus notes of Calabria and calamansi. Black XS enters the room with a surge of fresh energy. A men's fragrance that radiates unique strength and presence.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Fame Parfum Perfume refill 200 ml
listings.description: Fame is a fragrance by Paco Rabanne that lives up to its name. Playful, sensual and strong , this perfume (refillable) is an ode to the woman of today. Fame is an eau de parfum characterised by typical Parisian charm - a perfume with absolute addictive potential! Noble jasmine, magical musk and the unique intensity of incense combine to create a composition that displays an individual seductive power to which every woman will gladly surrender. A fine perfume (refillable) by Paco Rabanne - a thoroughly feminine fragrance Fruity, sweet, a little floral, but above all seductive - the fragrance pyramid of the perfume scores with a top note of mango and bergamot. The heart opens with jasmine and incense, while vanilla and sandalwood form the supporting base. This extravagant and timeless creation has an irresistible appeal for both men and women. Initiated by perfumers Dora Baghriche-Arnaud, Marie Salamagne, Alberto Morillas and Fabrice Pellegrin, the fragrance is a tribute to femininity, which today involves so much more than pure beauty. Fame Perfume (refillable) by Paco Rabanne emphasises the individual character of its wearer and gives her the fame she deserves. This composition stands for inner strength and emphasises an individual character. The eau de toilette opens with a dynamic opening in which the freshness of mandarin meets spicy coriander. In the heart, an urban aura unfolds through notes of violet and resin, which give the fragrance a special depth. The base is formed by a warm and sensual base of ambergris, leather, labdanum and cedar. Together, this results in a woody, spicy fragrance that leaves a striking and unmistakable impression and is suitable as an everyday companion. Fragrance direction: Woody and spicy Head notes: Mandarin, coriander Heart notes: Violet, resin Base notes: Amber, leather, cedar Character: Expressive and striking

listings.rawTitle: Diesel Only the Brave Eau de Parfum Spray 35 ml
listings.description: The Diesel Only The Brave Eau de Parfum Spray is a composition that impresses with its interplay of invigorating freshness and intense depth. It opens with the juicy note of Italian mandarin, which creates a sparkling first impression. The aromatic spiciness of French clary sage unfolds at the heart of the fragrance, creating an exciting contrast to the initial citrus freshness. The base note anchors the composition with warm, woody and leathery accents that give the fragrance an unmistakably masculine and urban character. As an eau de parfum, this version offers a higher fragrance concentration and therefore a long-lasting presence. The bottle itself is a clear statement: shaped like a clenched fist, it symbolises strength and determination. A ring with the Diesel anagram on two fingers rounds off the striking design. A powerful men's fragrance with a woody-fresh character. Intense composition with notes of mandarin, clary sage and leather. Long-lasting fragrance experience as an eau de parfum. Striking flacon in the design of a clenched fist with a Diesel ring.

listings.rawTitle: Diesel D by Diesel Eau de Toilette Spray - refillable 50 ml
listings.description: D by Diesel is a fragrance that is made for everyone and has universal appeal. The eau de toilette spray unfolds as an intense fougère-amber composition that radiates self-confidence. It opens with a dynamic combination of spicy ginger and aromatic lavender from Provence. At the heart of the creation is a unique denim-cotton accord that lends a clear, fresh texture and is reminiscent of the feel of a favourite pair of jeans. The base note of warm vanilla from Madagascar rounds off the fragrance with a gentle depth and ensures a lasting impression. The essence is presented in a transparent, grey bottle, the cap of which is based on the iconic rivet of a pair of Diesel jeans. The spray is also designed to be refillable for conscious use. An intense fougère amber fragrance for all genders . Composition of spicy ginger, denim-cotton accord and warm vanilla. Iconic bottle in the design of a Diesel Jeans rivet. Refillable eau de toilette spray for sustainable use.

listings.rawTitle: DKNY DKNY Women Eau de Parfum Spray Energizing 50 ml
listings.description: DKNY Women - A floral fragrance with city flair. Pure energy, like rush hour in the city. A fresh shot of blood orange in ice-cold vodka, plus a touch of sun-ripened tomato leaves. The effect is fresh, green, natural and moist - like freshly mown grass in Central Park. listings.rawTitle: DKNY Golden Delicious Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: DKNY Golden Delicious is a radiant, modern fragrance with floral notes that create an exciting contrast: The top note is a refreshing medley of orange blossom water, sparkling mirabelle plum and Golden Delicious apple. DKNY Golden Delicious is a fragrance that seduces the senses and whose design is as elegant as it is majestic.

Floral accords unfold at the heart of the fragrance, with tuberose and lily of the valley adding a clear yet gentle facet. The result is a carefree fragrance that is suitable for everyday wear and emphasises a positive aura. The bottle, whose shape is reminiscent of an apple, reflects the urban character of the fragrance with its modern design made of transparent glass and silver-coloured metal. Presented in an apple-shaped bottle.

listings.rawTitle: DKNY Be Delicious Latte Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Vanilla Drizzle 50 ml
listings.description: The DKNY Be Delicious Latte Eau de Parfum Spray envelops the senses in a gentle, creamy fragrance. The distinctive, rounded bottle features an attractive design with creamy white and swirling beige accents. Warm vanilla notes blend with subtle coffee undertones to create an olfactory experience reminiscent of a freshly brewed hot drink. This harmonious blend is ideal for everyday use and lends a cosy, inviting atmosphere to every moment. listings.rawTitle: DKNY Be Delicious Eau de Parfum Spray 100% 50 ml
listings.description: The DKNY 100% Be Delicious Eau de Parfum Spray is a new release from 2021 that utilises fruity and floral accords as an everyday fragrance. For women who want to wear their true and unadulterated self on their bodies as a fragrance, the DKNY 100% Be Delicious Eau de Parfum Spray can be worn on its own or combined with the manufacturer's Be Delicious fragrance. This gives you even more freedom when choosing your perfume for the day - making this creation ideal for all those who like to layer their fragrances. The fragrance in detail Blackcurrants provide a fullminant opening , the berries are sourced exclusively from responsible and controlled cultivation. These fruity accords in DKNY 100% Be Delicious Eau de Parfum Spray are complemented by delicate orange blossom and a hint of sandalwood, which the perfumers then set in a musky frame. The result is fragrance notes that are as reduced as they are varied, which develop an unmistakable fragrance silhouette over a longer period of wear. This fragrance creation is just as suitable for a trip to the supermarket as it is for a romantic dinner, a holiday or any other adventure, big or small.

listings.rawTitle: DKNY Be Delicious Latte Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Matcha Latte 50 ml
listings.description: The DKNY Be Delicious Matcha Latte Eau de Parfum Spray brings a refreshing yet warm fragrance to your everyday life. Its floral-fruity profile offers a balanced scent experience that is ideal for a wide variety of occasions. Immediately after spraying, apple, mandarin and pink pepper open the top notes, creating an invigorating start to the day. As the fragrance develops, the heart notes of matcha, jasmine and rose unfold to form a harmonious centre, lending the fragrance an elegant presence. The fragrance is rounded off by a base note of sandalwood, amber and musk, which leaves a long-lasting, gentle depth. The bottle, with its marbled dessert-inspired design and green cap, adds a modern visual touch. To allow the aromas to unfold to their full potential, simply spray the perfume onto clean skin, avoiding the eye area. With a 50 ml capacity, the product fits comfortably in your handbag, making it easy to refresh the fragrance whilst out and about. Floral-fruity Eau de Parfum for everyday use Top notes of apple, mandarin and pink pepper Heart notes of matcha, jasmine and rose for a harmonious fragrance experience Base notes of sandalwood, amber and musk Practical 50 ml size for use on the go

listings.rawTitle: DKNY Be Delicious Eau de Parfum Spray Orchard St. 30 ml
listings.description: The Orchard St. Eau de Parfum Spray has a striking look: bright magenta with yellow stylised apples arouses the interest of modern, fashion-conscious women . The name Orchard St. is aptly chosen. On the one hand, it refers to a well-known street on the Lower East Side in New York. Secondly, Orchard means orchard - a reference to a fresh and fruity perfume with many facets. Orchard St. by DKNY: urban, spirited, modern The Be Delicious Orchard St. Eau de Parfum Spray is part of a long tradition of Be Delicious fragrances. The first DKNY perfume with this name is legendary. Its apple bottle is reminiscent of the Big Apple in New York. Subsequent fragrance creations take up the apple theme. Orchard St. is keen to experiment: what can be combined with the delicious scent of aromatic apples ? The result is a wonderful fragrance experience that will quickly become a secret favourite in your personal collection. In the top note, apple flavour blends with blackcurrant, grapefruit and a hint of pepper. In the heart note, the fruits are joined by flowers: it is a combination of raspberry and pomegranate with iris and jasmine blossom. The eau de parfum spray ends with warm cedarwood and fine leather notes.

listings.description: The Coach Dreams Eau de Parfum Spray is a fragrance inspired by the freedom and adventure of a road trip across the USA. This fruity-floral fragrance opens with a vibrant top note of bitter orange and pear, creating a fresh opening. At the heart of the creation, a unique bouquet of delicate gardenia and rare cactus blossom unfolds. For the fragrance to develop to its full potential, the spray can be applied to pulse points such as the wrists or the area behind the earlobes.
