listings.rawTitle: Coach Platinum Eau de Parfum Spray 60 ml
listings.description: Inspired by a journey across America and the vibrant energy of New York, Coach Platinum Eau de Parfum Spray presents itself as an olfactory interpretation of freedom and dynamism. Fresh notes open the fragrance experience immediately upon spraying, with the spicy aroma of black pepper meeting the fruity sweetness of pineapple. This lively opening is complemented by the characteristic, slightly resinous note of juniper berries, which adds a cool nuance. As the fragrance develops, a floral yet earthy heart unfolds, in which clary sage blends harmoniously with geranium and soft cashmeran. The complex base note ensures a long-lasting, warm and sensual finish. Here, creamy sandalwood and earthy patchouli blend with a distinctive accord of vanilla leather, lending the fragrance a special depth. Visually, too, the bottle reflects the brand’s modern elegance. The vessel captivates with a mirror-like, silver surface, on which the iconic horse-drawn carriage is depicted as a detailed embossed motif. A black leather label, attached to a delicate metal chain on the spray head, rounds off the design and emphasises the composition’s premium character. This woody fragrance is ideal for lovers of multi-layered aromas who seek both freshness and warmth. Fragrance profile: Woody and warm with a sensual aura. Top note: A fresh combination of black pepper, pineapple and juniper berries. Heart note: Aromatic accords of sage, geranium and cashmeran. Base note: Deep nuances of patchouli, sandalwood and vanilla leather. Bottle: A gleaming silver design with an embossed logo and a leather tag.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Floral Blush Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: With Floral Blush, the developers at Coach have created a fragrance that pays homage to the refreshing lightness of summer. This Eau de Parfum Spray is ideal for all women who fully embrace their femininity and approach life with a spirit of adventure, esprit and joie de vivre. Experience the delightful facets of summer Experience the wonderfully feminine fragrance that plays with your femininity with its floral accents. Floral Blush opens with the refreshing accords of grapefruit and goji berry at the top. At the heart, the lovely flavours of peony and peach form a captivating combination. The base of white precious woods and musk creates a magical fragrance composition that beguiles the senses and caresses the wearer throughout the day. Available as an eau de parfum spray, this fragrance from Coach is very rich and lingers on the skin for a long time. Floral Blush is the ideal perfume for all occasions . The body lotion is also available in our online shop to match the eau de parfum.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Green Eau de Toilette Spray 60 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the calming atmosphere of green oases amidst the dynamic energy of the city, Coach Green Eau de Toilette presents itself. The composition opens with a fruity note of kiwi, which gives the fragrance an invigorating freshness. Aromatic rosemary unfolds in the heart, adding a spicy yet clear facet. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a base of earthy crystal moss, which provides a woody depth and a long-lasting impression. This fragrance embodies a feeling of balance and vitality. The bottle reflects the elegance of the brand, with a colour gradient from rich to light green and the engraved horse-drawn carriage logo. A silver-coloured cap and a pendant made of green faux leather complete the appealing design. Fragrance: Woody and fruity Head note: kiwi Heart note: rosemary Base note: crystal moss Character: Invigorating and balanced

listings.rawTitle: Pierre Guillaume Paris Black Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Poudre de Riz 50 ml
listings.description: Poudre de Riz by Pierre Guillaume Paris pays homage to the powdery elegance of times gone by. This fragrance unfolds with a gentle yet present aura that is reminiscent of the nostalgic charm of fine face powder. At the centre of the composition is an accord of rice powder, which is given a special depth by notes of caramel and roasted nuances. Floral accents of damask rose and tiare absolute combine harmoniously with the warmth of coconut and vanilla. A base of sandalwood, iris, cedar and tonka bean rounds off the olfactory experience and gives the eau de parfum spray a creamy, almost tactile texture. Captured in a minimalist bottle with clean lines, the design reflects the subtle sophistication of the fragrance. Inspired by the nostalgic scent of face powder Combines floral notes with warm, creamy accords Contains nuances of rice powder, rose, vanilla and sandalwood Presented in an elegant, minimalist bottle

listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Cloud Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Zarkoperfume Cloud Collection No. 4 Eau de Parfum Spray is characterised by a fascinating interplay of visual aesthetics and complex fragrance architecture. Even at first glance, the transparent glass bottle reveals a golden liquid which, thanks to countless fine particles, creates a vibrant, almost magical shimmer with every movement. Olfactorily, the fragrance opens with a zesty yet fruity top note, in which fresh aromas of blackberry, Japanese yuzu and mandarin dynamically blend with the subtle spiciness of pink pepper and Szechuan pepper. This freshness transitions seamlessly into a multifaceted heart, which combines floral accents of jasmine, white orchid and orange blossom with the creamy nuance of coconut and a tart hint of black tea. The warm base note ensures a harmonious finish, blending powdery musk, exquisite sandalwood and sweet Madagascan vanilla with deep woody accords such as cashmerewood and dreamwood. This careful balance gives the fragrance a long-lasting, fruity-sweet yet elegantly woody character. As an Eau de Parfum, the fragrance oils unfold intensely and linger on the wearer for many hours. The minimalist design, with its striking black cap, adds a modern finishing touch to the overall look. A fruity-sweet fragrance with floral and woody accents Contains visually shimmering gold particles in the transparent bottle A multi-layered composition featuring blackberry, coconut and vanilla Warm base notes of sandalwood, musk and dreamwood Intense Eau de Parfum spray in a 100 ml size

listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume e`L Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The e'L Eau de Parfum Spray by Zarkoperfume evokes the cool expanses and serene freshness of Nordic landscapes. Launched in 2013, the fragrance is characterised by a subtle yet distinct character that deliberately defies traditional categories and is designed as a unisex scent. The top note opens the olfactory experience with zesty accents of pomegranate, harmoniously accompanied by delicate white blossoms. As the fragrance develops, a distinctly green heart unfolds, defined primarily by notes of Indian green tea and special ozone accords, lending the creation a clean and invigorating aura. This airy lightness eventually gives way to a gentle base, where white, sweet musk meets light woods, ensuring a warm, lasting finish. Thanks to its clear structure, the perfume is particularly well-suited for daytime wear or during the warmer seasons. The bottle’s design emphasises the brand’s minimalist approach: a cylindrical container made of clear glass offers an unobstructed view of the liquid, whilst a golden atomiser and a white label with gold lettering provide elegant accents. Floral green fragrance with fresh ozone and tea notes Top notes of pomegranate and white blossoms Base notes of white musk and light woods Minimalist glass bottle with gold detailing A discreet, Nordic-inspired fragrance composition

listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Classic Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Woody accords take centre stage in this Danish creation, which is characterised by a clear yet complex structure. At the heart of the Buddha-Wood Eau de Parfum Spray lies the eponymous Buddha wood, which plays a central role here and provides a deep base note. In harmonious combination with Australian sandalwood, a creamy yet distinctive fragrance signature emerges, which significantly shapes the character of the perfume. This olfactory interplay is complemented by soft nuances of cashmere wood and a delicate musk accord, which lend the Eau de Parfum a gentle roundness and allow the individual components to blend seamlessly together. The transparent, round glass bottle, with its minimalist design, emphasises the modern philosophy of the Zarkoperfume brand. A gold-coloured spray head and the white label with gold lettering add elegant touches whilst allowing a clear view of the light-coloured liquid inside. Conceived as a unisex fragrance, the composition eschews traditional gender associations. On the skin, the perfume can develop in its own unique way, as the molecules interact with the wearer’s own body chemistry. The carefully balanced ingredients ensure a long-lasting fragrance experience that provides an elegant accompaniment both in everyday life and on special occasions. Fragrance profile: A creamy, woody eau de parfum with a focus on fine woods. Main notes: A composition of Buddha wood, Australian sandalwood, cashmere wood and musk. Target audience: Developed as a unisex fragrance and therefore suitable for all genders. Design: Minimalist, round glass bottle with gold detailing and a white label. Character: A seductive and memorable blend that unfolds uniquely on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Inception Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Zarkoperfume Inception Eau de Parfum Spray unveils a composition characterised by a multi-layered structure. Inspired by the idea of an evolving fragrance experience, this unisex fragrance combines a sequence of notes that develop over time. The opening is characterised by crisp ozonic and citrus accords, which provide an immediate sense of freshness. As the fragrance unfolds, floral and spicy nuances come to the fore, lending the scent an extra dimension. The base note consists of warm, woody elements that lend the composition a gentle depth. The minimalist design of the bottle reflects the fragrance’s modern character and makes it an elegant accessory. A unisex fragrance with a six-stage scent structure. Opens with fresh ozonic and citrus notes. Develops into floral and spicy heart notes. Built on a warm, woody base. Presented in a minimalist and elegant glass bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Classic Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Danish fragrance house Zarkoperfume made a name for itself with the development of so-called molecular fragrances : these fragrances are created from natural and synthetically produced aromas. An Eau de Parfum Spray from Zarkoperfume has the unique property of blending, at a molecular level, with the skin’s own natural odours once sprayed on. This creates a personalised scent that smells slightly different on every wearer. To date, Zarkoperfume has produced several highly acclaimed unisex fragrances . The latest release from 2022 is the Eau de Parfum spray ‘Youth’. Youth – A fruity-woody ‘feel-good summer fragrance’ Peach, pear, melon and green apple combine to create a fruity, zesty opening in the top note. In the heart note, plum meets floral essences: jasmine, Bulgarian rose and unnamed white blossoms come into play. The base note grounds the fragrance with a powdery accord: sandalwood and musk, amongst others, carry the fruit notes with feather-light ease. Youth presents itself as an uplifting fragrance cocktail that evokes memories of the carefree, light-hearted atmosphere of balmy summer evenings.

listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Classic Collection Eau de Pafum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Sending Love by Zarkoperfume is a loving fragrant message characterised by a multifaceted composition. It opens with a lively top note of sweet lemon, green lime and mandarin, which is given a special freshness by the exotic nuance of dragon fruit. At the heart of the fragrance, a gourmand accord of creamy toffee and white chocolate unfolds, blending harmoniously with the sweetness of peach and the warmth of cedarwood. The base note anchors the creation with a gentle musk accord, sweet vanilla, warm amber and dark woods, lending the Eau de Parfum an intimate and sensual depth. This fragrance from the Danish niche label, which combines classic perfumery with Nordic molecular science, is developed in accordance with vegan and cruelty-free standards. A multifaceted fragrance composition with fruity, gourmand and woody notes. A creation featuring zesty citrus fruits, sweet toffee, white chocolate and warm woods. Developed in accordance with vegan and cruelty-free standards.

listings.rawTitle: Zarkoperfume Classic Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Carate Urio 100 ml
listings.description: Handcrafted in Denmark, the Carate Urio Eau de Parfum Spray captures the relaxed atmosphere of a summer’s day on Lake Como. This molecular composition from Zarkoperfume’s Classic Collection is characterised by a multi-layered progression that evokes memories of travel and carefree moments. Initially, fruity and playful accords of juicy pear, sweet strawberry and candied apple dominate the top note. The composition then gently transitions into a floral heart, where white blossoms, pink rose and iris blend to create a powdery yet light melody. Deep nuances of musk, sandalwood and cedarwood in the base note provide a warm and sensual finish. As this is a molecular fragrance, the essence interacts with the wearer’s own skin chemistry, creating a completely individual signature that can manifest differently on each person. Visually, the Eau de Parfum is presented in a simple, rectangular glass bottle with rounded corners, which reveals the pale yellow liquid and is enhanced by a white label with a gold frame and a gold cap. A fruity-floral fragrance pyramid with notes of pear, rose and sandalwood Molecular composition for a personalised fragrance development on the skin Handcrafted in Denmark and produced cruelty-free Inspired by the scenic atmosphere of Carate Urio on Lake Como High-quality glass bottle with golden accents

listings.rawTitle: MUGLER Alien Eau de Parfum Spray Refillable 15 ml
listings.description: Alien by MUGLER is a striking fragrance composition that has been known for its special charisma since its launch in 2005. Developed by perfumers Dominique Ropion and Laurent Bruyere, the eau de parfum unfolds in three olfactory revelations. It opens with the radiant note of jasmine sambac, followed by the woody warmth of cashmere wood at the heart of the fragrance. The base note of white amber rounds off the composition and lends it a mysterious depth. Together, these essences create a floral-woody amber fragrance that emphasises an elegant and mystical aura. The fragrance is presented in a bottle reminiscent of a polished gemstone. This bottle is refillable in the spirit of conscious use. For optimum development, we recommend spraying onto warm areas of the body from a distance of around 20 cm. The product is flammable until dry, so avoid contact with the eyes or irritated skin. Fragrance: Floral-woody with amber notes Main notes: Jasmine sambac, cashmere wood and white amber Special feature: Refillable bottle in gemstone design Product type: Eau de Parfum Spray

listings.rawTitle: MUGLER Angel Eau de Parfum Spray Refillable Standing Star 25 ml
listings.description: The MUGLER Angel Eau de Parfum is an iconic fragrance that is designed to last right from the start. Its unmistakable composition is characterised by a combination of praline-like notes, patchouli and vanilla, complemented by red fruits and a warm, sensual base. These elements come together to create a sweet and spicy fragrance experience. The characteristic bottle in the shape of a five-pointed star is not only a visual highlight, it is also reusable. By simply unscrewing the pump atomiser, the bottle with the refill container can be easily refilled at home without losing any product. This sustainable approach reduces the consumption of glass, plastic and cardboard compared to buying a completely new bottle. Refillable bottle in the iconic star design Gourmand fragrance composition with praline, patchouli and vanilla Sustainable concept to reduce packaging material Intense eau de parfum

listings.rawTitle: MUGLER Alien Eau de Parfum Spray - refillable Pulp 30 ml
listings.description: The MUGLER Alien Pulp Eau de Parfum unfolds a fruity-floral fragrance composition that enriches everyday moments with a special aromatic note. The top note of fruity raspberry gives a pleasantly fresh feeling when sprayed on, providing an aromatic accompaniment to the start of the day. At the heart, creamy jasmine extract develops a soft aroma that supports an inviting aura and discreetly emphasises your own presence. The base of velvety musk and woody cashmeran rounds off the fragrance experience and leaves an elegant impression on the skin. This balanced combination is ideal for everyday wear at work and equally suitable for evening occasions. The glass bottle has a multi-faceted ombré design with gold-coloured accents. The integrated refill system makes it easy to refill the container and helps to conserve resources in everyday use. The French-made perfume is available in various sizes and blends seamlessly into your personal fragrance routine. Fruity-floral fragrance profile with raspberry, jasmine and musk Versatile use for everyday work and evening occasions Resource-saving, easily refillable bottle system Fragrance composition made in France in various sizes

listings.rawTitle: MUGLER Alien Eau de Parfum Spray - refillable Goddess 30 ml
listings.description: With a radiant composition of floral, earthy and woody notes, MUGLER Alien Goddess Eau de Parfum Spray presents itself as a modern interpretation of classic fragrance structures. The olfactory signature opens with the sparkling freshness of Italian bergamot, which meets a soft, creamy accord of coconut water to create an invigorating opening. At the centre of the creation is a super-infusion of jasmine grandiflorum, whose blossoms are harvested in India, harmoniously complemented by the powdery nuances of heliotrope. A warm, balsamic finish is provided by the deep base note, which combines high-quality bourbon vanilla from Madagascar with cashmeran and benzoin resin. Visually, the fragrance stands out with its golden bottle, whose faceted, geometric shape is reminiscent of a precious talisman. The design picks up on the theme of the sunrise and looks both luxurious and futuristic thanks to its crystal-like structure and metallic lustre. A key feature of this eau de parfum spray is its sustainable concept, as the artfully designed bottle can be refilled at any time. This fragrance was created in 2021 by perfumers Nathalie Lorson and Marie Salamagne. Floral-woody fragrance profile with warm amber nuances Refillable bottle in a golden, geometric talisman design Top notes of Italian bergamot and coconut water Base note with bourbon vanilla from Madagascar and cashmeran

listings.rawTitle: MUGLER Alien Eau de Parfum Spray - refillable Goddess 90 ml
listings.description: With a radiant composition of floral, earthy and woody notes, MUGLER Alien Goddess Eau de Parfum Spray presents itself as a modern interpretation of classic fragrance structures. The olfactory signature opens with the sparkling freshness of Italian bergamot, which meets a soft, creamy accord of coconut water to create an invigorating opening. At the centre of the creation is a super-infusion of jasmine grandiflorum, whose blossoms are harvested in India, harmoniously complemented by the powdery nuances of heliotrope. A warm, balsamic finish is provided by the deep base note, which combines high-quality bourbon vanilla from Madagascar with cashmeran and benzoin resin. Visually, the fragrance stands out with its golden bottle, whose faceted, geometric shape is reminiscent of a precious talisman. The design picks up on the theme of the sunrise and looks both luxurious and futuristic thanks to its crystal-like structure and metallic lustre. A key feature of this eau de parfum spray is its sustainable concept, as the artfully designed bottle can be refilled at any time. This fragrance was created in 2021 by perfumers Nathalie Lorson and Marie Salamagne. listings.rawTitle: MUGLER A*Men Eau de Toilette Spray Refillable Rubber 50 ml
listings.description: The MUGLER A*Men Eau de Toilette Spray in the refillable Rubber version offers a distinctive fragrance composition for everyday use. The matt black bottle, with its rubberised surface and blue star, sits comfortably and securely in the hand when in use. Fresh top notes of bergamot, lavender and cool mint open the fragrance experience and provide an invigorating sensation immediately after spraying. As the fragrance develops, a complex heart note unfolds, blending roasted Arabica coffee, patchouli and cedar. This combination gives the fragrance a woody depth that lingers for many hours, eliminating the need for frequent reapplication throughout the day. A warm base of Bourbon vanilla, chocolate and caramel rounds off the profile. These sweet nuances create a pleasant aura that comes into its own particularly on cooler days or in the evening. Thanks to the refillable system, the fragrance can be replenished time and again in an environmentally friendly way. The integrated atomiser dispenses the eau de toilette evenly, so that just a few sprays are enough for a long-lasting result. A woody and warm fragrance composition with coffee, vanilla and patchouli An invigorating opening with fresh mint and bergamot A resource-saving, refillable system for long-term use Fine atomiser ensures even and economical application Long-lasting fragrance for everyday wear and evening occasions

listings.rawTitle: MUGLER Angel Eau de Parfum Spray Blush 25 ml
listings.description: The MUGLER Angel Blush Eau de Parfum Spray adds a velvety, warm fragrance to everyday life. The asymmetrical, star-shaped glass bottle allows the pink-coloured liquid to shimmer subtly through its multi-faceted surface. The top note of almond milk opens the fragrance experience and gives a soft feeling immediately after spraying. Creamy musk then unfolds its character in the heart, leaving a pleasant presence on the skin. listings.description: The olfactory spectrum of the MUGLER Alien Hypersense Eau de Parfum spray reveals a modern and multi-faceted evolution of the classic Alien signature. High fragrance concentration for a long-lasting presence in everyday life A versatile unisex composition to enhance your personal charisma A warm fragrance aura, inspired by traditional Tuscan fabrics Economical use thanks to intense fragrance release

Widian Rose Arabia Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Ginger 100 ml
listings.description: With a fascinating balance of invigorating freshness and piquant spice, the Ginger eau de parfum spray expands the Rose Arabia Collection from Widian. Released in 2024, this composition was developed by perfumer Hamid Merati-Kashani and is characterised by a complex, multi-layered fragrance structure. The opening is characterised by a tangy aroma of lemon and bergamot, which meets the eponymous, slightly peppery note of ginger and paradisone. This energetic opening leads into a floral heart in which fine nuances of violet and magnolia combine with the molecule Hedione. The base provides a long-lasting and warm finish, combining woody elements of patchouli and sandalwood with modern ambrox. The design of the bottle reflects the value of the contents: a smooth, curved glass shape is complemented by a sophisticated label in black and gold and a cylindrical, gold-coloured cap, giving the overall look an elegant aesthetic. Fragrance character: A fresh, spicy composition with tropical notes. Head notes: Invigorating blend of ginger, lemon, bergamot and paradisone. Base: Warm finish with patchouli, sandalwood and ambrox. Design: Elegant glass bottle with a curved shape and golden accents. Background: Created by Hamid Merati-Kashani, released in 2024.

listings.rawTitle: Widian Rose Arabia Collection Eau de Parfum Spray White 100 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray White from the Rose Arabia Collection by Widian is a multi-layered fragrance composition that harmoniously combines floral and fruity notes. The opening opens with a juicy blend of peach and plum, subtly underlined by the spicy freshness of coriander. At the heart of the creation, an opulent bouquet of delicate violet, peony, freesia and exotic ylang-ylang unfolds, which is given a gentle depth by the powdery sweetness of heliotrope. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience and gives it a long-lasting presence. Here, warm accords of patchouli, cedar and sandalwood meet creamy Madagascar vanilla, incense and the subtle warmth of tonka bean and white musk. The fragrance is presented in an elegant, oval glass bottle whose simple shape is accentuated by a shiny, gold-coloured cap. A floral-fruity fragrance from the Rose Arabia Collection. Top notes of peach, plum and coriander. Floral heart of violet, peony, freesia and ylang-ylang. Warm, woody base with vanilla, incense and white musk.

listings.rawTitle: Widian Velvet Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Yasat 100 ml
listings.description: Widian and Yasat Eau de Parfum Spray - an outstanding combination. With the Velvet Collection, the perfumers have created a graceful and highly effective unisex fragrance for men and women. This fragrance is inspired by faraway destinations that invite you to dream . Housed in a high-quality 50 ml pump bottle, the Widian perfume itself is a special visual feature. The perfume from the Velvet Collection Yasat is the name of an island in Abu Dhabi surrounded by sky-blue waters. Delicately scented flowers and the flair of the coast and fresh sea breeze give the perfume its name. Which ingredients create the unmistakable fragrance experience of Yasat Eau de Parfum Spray? Firstly, there is the top note: bergamot and cardamom define this part of the Widian fragrance. The heart note: Cedarwood, sandalwood and caramel round off the fragrance. The final note is a base of amber, vanilla and musk, creating an enchanting fragrance experience. Beautiful packaging completes the luxurious overall impression of the Velvet Collection. Yasat Eau de Parfum Spray - beguiling and elegant The eau de parfum in the Velvet Collection contains floral and sensual oriental fragrances that transport all users into a magical world of elegance and grace. With the Yasat Extrait de Parfum from Widian, the world of perfume can be experienced anew every day.</p

listings.rawTitle: Widian Sapphire Collection Extrait de Parfum Granada 50 ml
listings.description: This fragrance from the Sapphire Collection was inspired by the majesty of the Alhambra on the Sabikah hill in Granada, Spain. Widian celebrates this cultural speciality with a fragrance experience of rose scent, juniper and fiery nuances . Just one spray of Granada Extrait de Parfum envelops the wearer in oriental seduction. Dreamy perfume with exotic hints Widian gives its special fragrance from the Sapphire Collection a multi-layered base note of amber and vetiver, oakmoss and labdanum, patchouli and musk. The Granada Extrait de Parfum then unfolds its top notes of bergamot and raspberry as well as pink and black pepper. The perfume continues to exude its heart notes of juniper and rose, cedarwood and cinnamon. The overall composition recalls the woody spice of Arabian oases, flowery gardens and oriental bazaars . A single spray is enough to activate the scent of Widian on the skin. Granada Extrait de Parfum adheres particularly well to damp skin or damp hair. For an intense fragrance experience over many hours, the pulse on the neck and hands and the skin behind the ears, which is well supplied with blood, are particularly suitable areas of application. If you don't want direct skin contact, you can also spray a small amount of the fragrance from the Sapphire Collection onto a silk scarf.

listings.rawTitle: Widian Black Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Black II 100 ml
listings.description: The Black II Eau de Parfum Spray by Widian from the Black Collection offers a luxurious fragrance with a warm and pleasantly woody note. The top note in the perfume is characterised by refreshing citrus notes, which have a pleasantly invigorating effect and give the fragrance a light and bright scent . In the heart note, however, the Black II Eau de Parfum Spray in the Black Collection unfolds its very special charm. This is where floral nuances and exotic spices come into their own and round off the overall result. For this reason, this fragrance is ideal for both men and women. Unique fragrance in charming packaging Widian has succeeded in developing a fragrance with the Black Collection, and more specifically with the Black II Eau de Parfum Spray, which not only impresses with its scent, but also with its presentation . The beautifully shaped and elegant bottle is not only a real eye-catcher in any bathroom, but is also very easy to transport. Carried in your handbag or jacket pocket, you can easily refresh your Widian fragrance whenever you need to. The fragrance lasts a long time and is very compatible with many different skin types.</p

listings.rawTitle: Widian Velvet Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Liwa 100 ml
listings.description: The Liwa Eau de Parfum Spray from the Velvet Collection by Widian impresses with its high concentration of precious fragrance oils and provides a long-lasting fragrance experience. This unisex fragrance opens the composition with radiant bergamot, fine saffron, delicate jasmine and tart, fresh artemisia in the top note. Precious amberwood, white flowers and velvety geranium merge in the heart. In the base, cedarwood, velvety patchouli, creamy sandalwood, earthy vetiver and mystical oud incense unfold their warmth and depth. This oriental-spicy masterpiece reveals a fascinating balance between sumptuous sensuality and refined freshness. A sensual luxury fragrance for special moments The Liwa Eau de Parfum Spray takes you on an olfactory journey through mysterious desert oases and reflects the magic of sunlight and shadow with its tale of Arabian legends. The elegant perfume bottle of the Velvet Collection sets luxurious highlights with its velvety finish and golden accents, making it a stylish accessory in its own right. This perfume unfolds its bouquet particularly impressively on the neck and wrists . A few spritzes are enough to benefit from the opulent fragrance architecture all day long. Widian recommends applying Liwa Eau de Parfum Spray sparingly to ensure that the multi-faceted structure is always perfectly accentuated.

listings.rawTitle: Widian Gold Collection Extrait de Parfum Samar 50 ml
listings.description: Samar Extrait de Parfum by Widian, a fragrance in a class of its own The Samar Extrait de Parfum by Widian scores with a spicy flair that conveys an exotic oriental impression. Philippine Courtière has created an extraordinary fragrance with this perfume from the Gold Collection . The creation opens with top notes of bergamot, clove, raspberry and pink pepper. In the heart note, floral components such as gardenia, osmanthus and jasmine complement the fragrance experience. A hint of cinnamon leads into the strong base, consisting of labdanum, vanilla, oud and patchouli. A perfume made for your personal style If you are looking for a personalised fragrance, the Samar Extrait de Parfum by Widian is the perfect choice. The elegant bottle is a real eye-catcher on your dressing table or in the bathroom. The gold-coloured cap perfectly matches the contents and the Gold Collection. By the way: This perfume with a smoky note is designed as a unisex fragrance . Whether you use it as a woman to emphasise your personality or as a gentleman who likes to surround himself with a sophisticated fragrance, Samar is worth discovering. Of course, the fragrance creation from the Gold Collection is also interesting for couples who want to emphasise their similarities with the right fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: DKNY Be Delicious Latte Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Toasted Pistachio 50 ml
listings.description: The DKNY Be Delicious Latte Pistachio Eau de Parfum Spray brings an extraordinary fragrance composition to everyday life. The bottle features an attractive design with marbled brown tones and a metallic stem. The top notes open the fragrance experience with roasted pistachio, Italian bergamot and bitter orange, creating a warm yet fresh presence. At the heart, a combination of latte macchiato, vanilla orchid and white peony unfolds. This harmonious blend lends the fragrance a gentle depth, making it ideal for relaxed afternoons or everyday use. Thanks to the high fragrance concentration of the Eau de Parfum, the composition lingers for a long time, meaning that a sparing application in the morning is often enough to last the whole day. The fine atomiser allows for precise and even application to the skin. When applying, simply avoid contact with the eyes. With a 50-millilitre capacity, the product comes in a practical size that fits comfortably in your bag and is ideal for taking with you on the go. Fragrance composition with notes of roasted pistachio and latte macchiato Long-lasting scent thanks to its Eau de Parfum formulation Fine atomiser for precise and even application Practical 50-ml size for everyday use and when on the go

A true love potion for the man who likes to indulge in sensuous pleasures .

listings.rawTitle: Escada Escada Magnetism Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Escada Magnetism Eau de Parfum unveils a composition that harmoniously blends fruity, floral and warm notes. It opens with a blend of blackcurrant, lychee, melon and pineapple, creating an invigorating first impression. As the fragrance develops, a heart of floral accords unfolds, in which jasmine, magnolia and freesia blend to form a multi-layered bouquet. Green leaves and basil add fresh accents. The base of the fragrance is defined by a combination of caramel, vanilla and sandalwood. Complemented by patchouli and amber, these notes lend the composition a pleasant depth and a warm character. The Eau de Parfum is presented in a faceted bottle in a bold shade of magenta, the design of which emphasises the fragrance’s modern character. A composition of fruity, floral and warm notes. Etro Palais Jamais Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY GENTLEMAN SOCIETY Eau de Parfum Spray refillable / 40 ml
listings.description: The Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum Spray by Givenchy is a striking composition that combines woody and floral facets. The fragrance opens with a fresh top note of spicy cardamom and aromatic sage. A multi-layered character unfolds at the heart of the creation, where the floral note of wild narcissus meets an intense vetiver accord. This comes from both Haiti and Madagascar and lends the heart note an earthy depth. The warm base note rounds off the fragrance experience. Sweet vanilla, palo santo and clear cedarwood merge here to create a long-lasting finish. Available since 2023, the eau de parfum is presented in an elegant, deep black lacquered bottle, the design of which is enhanced by a newly interpreted 4G monogram made of silver metal. Fragrance family: Aromatic-woody Head notes of green cardamom and fresh sage Heart notes of wild narcissus and a vetiver accord Base of vanilla, palo santo and cedar wood Black lacquered bottle with silver 4G monogram

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY L'Interdit Parfum 35 ml
listings.description: GIVENCHY L'INTERDIT Eau de Parfum is a composition that plays with the allure of the forbidden and unites apparent opposites in one fragrance. This floral-woody fragrance breaks with convention through an olfactory structure based on the contrast between a radiant bouquet of white flowers and intense, earthy notes. Orange blossom, jasmine and tuberose unfold their luminous presence before meeting the darker accents of vetiver and patchouli. This unexpected combination creates an unforgettable and elegant sillage with good longevity. Re-launched as a modern interpretation of the 1957 original, the fragrance is part of a collection that also includes other variations such as the lighter Eau de Toilette or the fiery L'INTERDIT Rouge. Its multi-layered structure makes it a suitable companion all year round. Fragrance direction: Flowery-woody Character: A contrast of white flowers and dark, earthy notes Speciality: Modern reinterpretation of a classic from 1957 Versatility: Suitable for every season

listings.description: The GIVENCHY GENTLEMAN SOCIETY Ambrée Eau de Parfum Spray is a woody-floral fragrance composition. It opens with spicy notes of clary sage, juniper berries and nutmeg, which fade into a floral heart of iris concrete and narcissus absolute. In the base, the special depth of the fragrance unfolds through an interplay of a vetiver quartet and a warm amber facet. Chords of leather, tobacco, balsamic Peruvian balsam and vanilla absolute from Madagascar round off the creation and lend it an intense and multi-layered character. The elegant impression is emphasised by the iconic bottle, which is adorned with a gold-coloured coat of arms. Thanks to its long-lasting presence, the eau de parfum is particularly suitable for evening occasions or the cooler months of the year. Woody-floral fragrance with an intense, warm radiance . A composition of narcissus absolute, iris and a vetiver quartet. Warm base notes with amber, vanilla, tobacco and leather. Presented in an elegant bottle with a gold-coloured crest.

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY IRRÉSISTIBLE Eau de Parfum Spray Nectar 35 ml
listings.description: IRRESISTIBLE NECTAR Eau de Parfum is a seductive fragrance creation that combines floral elegance with gourmand sensuality. At its centre is a radiant, modern femininity that radiates freedom, pleasure and magnetic attraction. The fragrance opens with the luminous freshness of neroli, which lends an invigorating lightness to the opening. At the heart, the iconic rose blends with a creamy pistachio accord to create a surprisingly delicious composition that is both elegant and irresistible. The base of soft vanilla wood envelops the skin with warm depth and ensures a long-lasting, sensual finish. The iconic prismatic bottle emphasises this character with French sophistication and timeless aesthetics. Inspired by the extraordinary collaboration between GIVENCHY and Parisian pastry chef François Daubinet, this fragrance combines haute parfumerie with the art of the finest pastry to create an olfactory moment of pleasure. Floral-gourmand fragrance with sensual depth Radiant neroli opening with iconic rose Creamy pistachio accord for a delicious twist Warm vanilla wood for a long-lasting finish Elegant prismatic bottle with French esprit

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY GENTLEMAN SOCIETY Eau de Parfum Spray Sport 60 ml
listings.description: Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum Sport is a dynamic men's fragrance that combines fresh energy with elegant depth. The composition combines sparkling citrus notes with floral and woody accents and is aimed at men who embody determination, style and movement. The opening inspires with a vitalising citrus freshness that immediately invigorates and lends clarity. At the heart, the characterful narcissus unfolds, lending the fragrance a striking, modern elegance and harmonising powerfully with the multi-faceted vetiver. Warm amber woods in the base provide a sensual finish and lend the fragrance a long-lasting, sophisticated presence. listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY L'Interdit Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: GIVENCHY L'INTERDIT Eau de Toilette Spray is characterised by its luminous yet sensual duality. listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY PI Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Pi Eau de Toilette Spray by Givenchy is a multi-layered composition that captivates with its woody and sweet notes. It opens with a fresh and aromatic top note, in which rosemary, mandarin, tarragon and basil create an invigorating first impression. This characterful fragrance is an ideal companion, especially in the cooler months of the year, but also unfolds its presence all year round. listings.description: The Supra Florale Eau de Parfum Spray from MUGLER is a new, limited edition interpretation of the successful Alien Goddess series. The fragrance journey begins with top notes of cactus blossom and pear, which lead into a heart of Indian jasmine and jasmine grandiflorum. Long-lasting accords of ambergris and moss unfold in the base note, lending the fragrance a woody depth. The creation transforms the well-known sun jasmine into a so-called "extraterrestrial supra-flower", a modern combination of three blossoms. The experience is rounded off by the rose gold bottle, which emphasises the radiant colour of the perfume. listings.rawTitle: MUGLER Angel Muse Eau de Parfum Spray Refillable 30 ml

Its elegant bottle is reminiscent of a futuristic, cosmic object and is characterised by the embossed Mugler star. It can be refilled at any time. Exquisite fragrance with an addictive factor for the sensual, adventurous woman The Eau de Parfum Spray Refillable Angel Muse by MUGLER is a richly contrasting fragrance experience with its juicy, tangy fruity notes and woody facets. At the beginning, the tart, sparkling aromas of grapefruit and red berries meet soft hazelnut notes. The heart note seduces the senses with delicately melting, addictive hazelnut cream. The intense tones of vetiver and patchouli explode in the base note and bring the fragrance to a glamorous close. Experience unforgettable hours with the fascinating Angel Muse fragrance!

The fragrance is perfect for everyday wear, but also creates an extraordinary radiance in the evening. MUGLER Cologne Eau de Cologne Spray Come Together has the potential to quickly become your favourite fragrance due to its clarity and longevity . MUGLER Angel Eau de Toilette Spray Refillable 100 ml
listings.description: The MUGLER Angel Eau de Toilette Spray Refillable reveals a modern and luminous facet of the well-known fragrance signature. This floral, fruity and gourmand fragrance strikes a balance between invigorating freshness and pleasant sweetness. The opening is a clear combination of tangy mandarin and delicate peony, which creates an immediate lightness. This is followed by a gourmand heart note in which flavours of apple and praline combine to form a harmonious whole. The composition is carried by a velvety base of patchouli and blond woods, which gives the eau de toilette a warm depth. The individual fragrance phases flow smoothly into one another and create a natural radiance. Visually, the fragrance is presented in a star-shaped bottle whose multi-faceted surface reflects light at different angles and allows colours ranging from soft pink to light blue to flow into one another. Floral, fruity and gourmand fragrance character Fragrance notes of mandarin, peony, apple, praline and patchouli Refillable, star-shaped bottle with colour gradient Faceted glass design with metallic accents

listings.rawTitle: MUGLER Angel Eau de Parfum Spray 15 ml
listings.description: With its launch in 1992, this creation by Olivier Cresp and Yves de Chirin defined the gourmand genre and established itself as an icon of the amber-vanilla fragrance family. The olfactory journey begins with a clear top note in which the freshness of Calabrian bergamot meets the fruity nuance of raspberry. A multi-layered heart then unfolds, combining sweet praline and pistachio with floral elements such as rose and white flowers. The eau de parfum is given significant depth by its complex base, which combines striking patchouli with warm vanilla absolute, acigalawood and other woody accents. This deliberate contrast of initial freshness and intense sweetness gives the fragrance its unmistakable and recognisable character. The shimmering bluish liquid is encased in an asymmetrical, star-shaped glass flacon whose precisely cut facets refract the light. A shiny silver spray device rounds off the visual appearance. The design is also conceived so that the bottle remains refillable, which emphasises the longevity of the object. For the ideal development of the fragrance molecules, spraying a fine cloud into the air is suitable for gently moistening the body with the aromas. Fragrance family: Amber Vanilla with a distinctly gourmand character Head notes of bergamot and raspberry meet praline in the heart Intense base with patchouli, vanilla and Akigalawood Refillable, star-shaped glass bottle with light reflections

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Ugolini Oxford Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Oxford eau de parfum spray by Roberto Ugolini has been available since 2018. The woody, spicy fragrance was created for men and women. It is not a fragrance for very young people. Rather, the Oxford eau de parfum spray is aimed at people who are looking for something special and appreciate it. Roberto Ugolini is far from being mainstream, but it is not a niche label either. With its above-average longevity and sillage, Oxford by Roberto Ugolini is a wonderful companion for the cooler days and evenings of the year. Elegant and mysterious, stylish and harmonious The top note of Roberto Ugolini Oxford consists of grapefruit and orange. Rose geranium leaves and pink and black pepper are added in the heart note. They are complemented in the opulent base by vetiver, styrax, vanilla, patchouli, sandalwood and cedarwood. The fragrance definitely has a masculine presence that flatters men. However, the wonderfully unsweet fragrance also scores on feminine skin with its almost mysterious appearance. The Eau de Parfum Spray appeals to the senses and is definitely reminiscent of the venerable city, which is not only known for its educational institutions, but also for its style and history.

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Ugolini Marzocco Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Marzocco eau de parfum spray by Roberto Ugolini is an olfactory homage to the city of Florence and its proud heraldic animal, the Marzocco lion. This expressive unisex fragrance is presented in a striking violet bottle, typical of the Tuscan metropolis, which reflects the elegance of its contents. Created by perfumers Maurizio Cerizza and Cristian Calabrò, the composition opens with an invigorating and sparkling top note of mandarin, lime and lemon. A floral bouquet of delicate orange blossom and jasmine then unfolds at the heart of the fragrance, lending the perfume a soft and elegant depth. The multi-layered fragrance experience is rounded off by a warm and creamy base note. This is where sweet vanilla, earthy patchouli and striking cedarwood meet gentle musk and other precious woods. The interplay of these carefully selected notes creates a sweet, fruity yet citrusy fragrance character that is particularly suitable for cooler days or elegant occasions. A sweet, creamy and citrusy-fruity unisex fragrance. Inspired by the city of Florence and its heraldic animal, the lion Marzocco. Composition of citrus fruits, white flowers and a warm base of vanilla, woods and musk. Created by the perfumers Maurizio Cerizza and Cristian Calabrò.

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Ugolini 17 Rosso Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Roberto Ugolini 17 Rosso is a tribute to the traditional craftsmanship and address of the renowned shoemaker's workshop in Florence. This multi-layered unisex fragrance unfolds as a complex, woody-floral composition with a warm, spicy character. It opens with a fresh yet fruity note of white peach, mint and green raspberry leaves, refined with the special warmth of saffron and cananga oil. The heart of the fragrance combines a floral bouquet of damask rose and peony with the light spiciness of pink pepper and nasturtium. The base rounds off the olfactory experience with deep, earthy and resinous accords, including styrax resin, ambrette seed, amyris, vetiver and cedarwood. As an extrait de parfum, the creation has a high fragrance oil concentration of 30%. The bottle itself is a design statement: made from characteristic red glass, adorned with an elegant leather label and topped with a polished horn cap, it reflects the aesthetics and origins of the brand. Layered, woody-floral unisex fragrance Highly concentrated extrait de parfum with 30% fragrance oil Composition of fruity, floral and spicy-woody notes Artfully designed bottle in red with leather and horn details

listings.rawTitle: GIVENCHY GENTLEMAN SOCIETY Eau de Parfum Spray Extrême 100 ml
listings.description: The Gentleman Society Extrême Eau de Parfum Spray presents itself with a powerful composition of floral, spicy and woody notes. The opening surprises with a striking freshness, characterised by nutmeg and iced peppermint, accompanied by aromatic clary sage. A complex structure unfolds in the heart, where the absolute of wild narcissus and iris concrete meet a multi-layered quartet of vetiver. This interplay is complemented by an unexpected note of coffee absolute, which lends the fragrance a special depth and texture. Warm accords of cedar and sandalwood as well as vanilla absolute and patchouli essence provide a long-lasting finish. This version from 2024 reinterprets the original signature and noticeably intensifies the fragrance experience. The design also reflects the modern, edgy character. The deep black, lacquered bottle bears the striking 4G logo in a dark gunmetal finish, echoing aesthetic elements of haute couture, while recycled glass is used in part in the production process. listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Eau de Toilette Spray Music Festival 100 ml
listings.description: Replica by Maison Martin Margiela really is a replica: a replica of love , of summer, of carefree lightness. Anyone who puts on this eau de toilette spray can feel it: a hint of a walk on the beach, a pinch of palpitations and adrenaline, a chord of all-inclusive holidays under the Caribbean sun. With bergamot, lemon and pink pepper, the top note in this eau de toilette spray makes for a brilliant opening. These fragrances are fresh, exciting and incredibly youthful. Further energy is released in the heart: coconut, aquatic notes, heliotrope and ylang-ylang are a promise of days off when you can relax . To make new plans. To go new ways. To feel new strength. The fragrances in the base of Replica by Maison Martin Margiela lead to authentic, spicy moments: with musk, benzoin resin and cedar. Replica by Maison Martin Margiela is an authentic fragrance that manages to be purist and playful at the same time. Cheerful and light, sweet and dominant, spicy and tangy: this eau de toilette spray combines all the components that make life worth living and creates a particularly exquisite, aromatic ambience. Can you feel the sand on your skin, taste the salt on your lips? Fragrances like this are pure holiday, even in the grey of everyday life. Indulge yourself with a hint of nostalgic memories and a taste of more. Every day.

listings.rawTitle: Michael Michalsky Ecstatic for Women Eau de Parfum Spray 25 ml
listings.description: Michael Michalsky Ecstatic for Women Eau de Parfum Spray, released in 2024, is guaranteed to send you into ecstasy with its fruity accords and powdery scent . While the bottle of this perfume with its deep red colour remains pleasantly in the background, the fragrance of Michael Michalsky Ecstatic for Women Eau de Parfum Spray captivates with a lot of courage for the extraordinary and extroverted. This perfume is as sweet as it is powdery, with floral accords defining the fragrance silhouette as well as some deliberately placed creamy and fresh accents. This makes the perfume a super all-rounder that even brings a touch of spring and summer into winter. A feminine fragrance adventure for modern women The top note of Michael Michalsky Ecstatic for Women Eau de Parfum Spray opens with a combination of juicy orange blossom and fresh, sparkling bergamot. The heart of the fragrance pyramid then becomes far more floral, with the trio of white jasmine, neroli and sweet honey acting as representatives of spring, before becoming even sweeter in the base note. Here, the perfumers have combined chords of praline with vanilla and white musk. The result is a lively and spectacular women's fragrance that is just as suitable for the day as it is for the night.

listings.rawTitle: Michael Michalsky Intense for Men Eau de Toilette Spray 25 ml
listings.description: The Michael Michalsky Intense for Men Eau de Toilette Spray is a woody, spicy fragrance composition that exudes a sporty, masculine character. The opening is refreshing and dynamic with top notes of cardamom, mint, pink pepper and subtle violet leaf. This is followed by the multi-faceted heart of the fragrance, in which the sweetness of pineapple combines with the aromatic sounds of lavender, sage and a hint of cinnamon to create an exciting blend. This composition creates a harmonious transition to the base note, which gives the eau de toilette its depth and lasting impression. Here, warm accents of vanilla and chestnut meet a striking woody note of amber, cedar and guaiac wood. listings.description: The Hypnôse Eau de Parfum Spray by Lancôme is a fascinating fragrance composition that combines woody notes with a warm, floral aura. The heart of the fragrance then unfolds, in which the creamy warmth of vanilla blends harmoniously with sun-kissed jasmine accents to create a sensual bouquet. The base note of earthy vetiver rounds off the olfactory experience and gives the composition a long-lasting depth and a clear, woody structure. This fragrance is captured in an elegant, curved bottle, whose twisted crystal look is a modern homage to the Lancôme classic "Magie" from the 1950s. Developed by renowned perfumers Annick Menardo and Thierry Wasser, Hypnôse was launched in 2005. A woody fragrance with warm, floral accents. A composition of passion flower, vanilla, jasmine and vetiver. Presented in an elegant bottle with twisted lines. Created by perfumers Annick Menardo and Thierry Wasser.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Emporio Armani You Eau de Parfum Spray Stronger With You Intensely 30 ml
listings.description: Stronger With You Intensely by Giorgio Armani is a fragrance that exudes a confident and warm aura based on an intense fougère signature. This composition opens with a lively top note in which the savoury spiciness of pink pepper meets the fresh accents of juniper and violet leaf. The heart of the fragrance then unfolds, revealing a fascinating tension: aromatic notes of lavender and sage are enveloped by an unexpected, gourmand facet of cinnamon and creamy caramel. This combination gives the fragrance a modern yet attractive centre. The base note provides a long-lasting and memorable finish. Here, a blend of warm vanilla, tonka bean and amberwood merges with a soft suede accord, giving the eau de parfum its unmistakable depth and lasting character. Fragrance character: An intense fougère fragrance with a spicy, warm and gourmand aura. Key notes: A composition of pink pepper, lavender, caramel, vanilla and suede. Fragrance type: Long-lasting eau de parfum with striking depth and presence.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Acqua di Giò Femme Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani's Acqua di Giò Femme Eau de Toilette Spray is a composition that evokes the lightness of a summer breeze and the vastness of the sea. This fragrance is characterised by its floral-aquatic character and captures a carefree, clear atmosphere. It opens with a tangy top note of juicy melon and sweet pear, which makes for a refreshing first impression. As the fragrance progresses, the heart of the eau de toilette unfolds into a multi-layered floral bouquet. Here, the aromas of hyacinth, delicate jasmine, classic rose and lovely lily of the valley combine to form a harmonious whole. The base note provides a gentle and warm depth, combining musk and sandalwood to give the fragrance a sensual radiance. The eau de toilette can be sprayed onto warm areas of skin such as the wrists or décolleté for a comprehensive fragrance experience. Fragrance direction: Floral-aquatic Head note: melon, pear Heart notes: hyacinth, jasmine, rose, lily of the valley Base note: musk, sandalwood Product type: Eau de toilette spray

listings.description: The Emporio Armani Stronger With You Amber Eau de Parfum Spray is a composition that captivates with its warm and elegant facets. As a unisex fragrance from 2023, it adds a sensual dimension to the Stronger With You collection. The fragrance journey begins with a top note of Provençal lavender, which lends a clear and inviting freshness. Rich amber then unfolds at the heart of the composition, creating a luxurious depth and characterising the fragrance. The base of bourbon vanilla and tonka bean harmoniously rounds off the olfactory experience and leaves a sweet and long-lasting impression. In its entirety, a balance is created between fresh, warm and sweet notes. The design of the bottle reflects the contents: the transparent, amber-coloured glass, accentuated by diagonal golden lines and a spherical, gold-coloured cap, underlines the elegant character of the perfume. listings.rawTitle: Armani Eaux Pour Homme Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Since its launch in 1984, Armani Eaux Pour Homme has been recognised as a classic that embodies the essence of timeless Italian elegance. This composition is a tribute to stylish restraint and clean lines. The fragrance opens with a sparkling and invigorating composition of citrus fruits such as bergamot, mandarin and lemon, which is given a green freshness by a fine note of basil. A multi-layered, aromatic bouquet unfolds in the heart, in which lavender and nutmeg meet warm, spicy accents of clove and cinnamon. This heart note gives the fragrance its unmistakable character. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with earthy, woody nuances of sandalwood, patchouli and moss and provides a pleasant depth. The eau de toilette is characterised by its discreet character and is an expression of cultivated style, ideal for occasions where an unobtrusive but present fragrance is desired. A timeless fragrance classic that epitomises Italian elegance. Fresh opening with a composition of sparkling citrus notes and basil. Aromatic, spicy heart with lavender, nutmeg and cinnamon. Warm, woody base note with sandalwood, patchouli and moss. Decent fragrance radiance for a stylish and understated appearance.

listings.rawTitle: Armani Eaux Pour Homme Eau de Toilette Spray Eau de Nuit 100 ml
listings.description: The Armani Eaux Pour Homme Eau de Nuit Eau de Toilette Spray is a sophisticated interpretation of the 1984 classic. Launched in 2013 by perfumer Marie Salamagne, this composition pays homage to the elegance of the night. The fragrance opens with the invigorating freshness of bergamot, which meets the spicy accent of pink pepper. At the heart, a multi-layered bouquet of powdery iris, heliotrope and the warm notes of cardamom and nutmeg unfold, giving the fragrance its special depth. The base note rounds off the experience with sensual ambergris, creamy tonka bean and striking cedarwood, creating an unmistakably masculine signature. The result is a sophisticated fragrance that is particularly suitable for the evening hours or stylish occasions in the cooler months. The deep black, opaque bottle reflects the mysterious and sophisticated character of the creation. Elegant and masculine fragrance composition for the evening . Combines fresh bergamot with spicy and warm woody notes. Created by perfumer Marie Salamagne for Giorgio Armani. Presented in an elegant, deep black bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Bettina Barty Summer Vanilla Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: A touch of summer with Eau de Toilette The Summer Vanilla eau de toilette spray from Bettina Barty is a true women's perfume. The elegant, slim glass bottle with a metal lid and spray device embodies youthfulness and lightness. This Summer Vanilla Eau de Toilette Spray is recommended for fun-loving, self-confident, spontaneous women. The perfume is beguiling, sensual and enchanting. It can attract attention on various occasions. The combination of floral, oriental, sweet and warm nuances creates a pleasant, trusting atmosphere. This means that the wearer of such fragrances is positively recognised and accepted as a person. A perfume that exudes feminine flair The eau de toilette spray Summer Vanilla by Bettina Barty is attractive and conveys a pleasant cosiness. The fruity and spicy components from the various fragrance notes combine and complement each other perfectly with floral and woody nuances. The top note opens fruity and spicy with bergamot, cloves and cinnamon. In the heart note, jasmine and rose bring floral notes into play, while cedar adds a woody-tart touch. Amber, musk and vanilla are responsible for an interesting mix in the base note. The tart, woody scent of amber, the animalistic, warm nuances of musk and the aphrodisiac, sweetish components of vanilla complement each other harmoniously.

listings.rawTitle: Bettina Barty Lila Vanilla Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Lila Vanilla Eau de Toilette Spray by Bettina Barty is a unique fragrance characterised by its sweet and seductive notes. Inspired by the natural elegance and gentle power of vanilla, this eau de toilette combines the warmth of vanilla with a delicate floral note reminiscent of a walk in a blooming garden. At the heart of Lila Vanilla Eau de Toilette Spray by Bettina Barty is sensual vanilla, known for its calming yet stimulating properties. The vanilla is surrounded by a hint of delicate floral notes that lend the fragrance a light and airy quality. This combination makes the perfume ideal for everyday use as well as for special occasions where a subtle yet striking presence is desired. Parfume for the modern woman The bottle of Lila Vanilla Eau de Toilette Spray by Bettina Barty is characterised by its elegant and modern design. It fits perfectly on any dressing table and is a real eye-catcher. The spray allows a fine and even application so that the fragrance is gently distributed on the skin and has a long-lasting effect. The perfume offers a perfect balance of warmth and lightness, making it suitable for all seasons: a charming and irresistible fragrance that enchants the senses and conveys a feeling of well-being and elegance - ideal for the modern woman who wants to emphasise her femininity with a touch of mystery.

listings.rawTitle: Jean-Charles Brosseau Ombre Rose Eau de Parfum Spray L'Original 75 ml
listings.description: Ombre Rose is a women's fragrance with a sweet and romantic note. The eau de parfum spray has a clear character that is nevertheless not overpowering. The women's fragrance by Jean Charles Brosseau exudes a hint of summer and sunshine. The pleasant and aromatic ingredients envelop the wearer's body like a veil, allowing her to shine in a seductive light. An eau de parfum spray with a sensual character The perfume Ombre Rose accompanies its wearer throughout the day with a fragrant aura. With this fragrance composition, master perfumer Jean Charles Brosseau has once again proven that sensuality, feminine elegance and summery freshness can be easily combined.

listings.rawTitle: Jean-Charles Brosseau Ombre Rose Eau de Parfum Spray Edition d'Exception 100 ml
listings.description: One of Jean-Charles Brosseau's oldest fragrances is the Eau de Parfum Spray Ombre Rose. It was released in 1981 and has been in continuous production ever since. As a special gift, the designer also released the powdery-floral fragrance as Ombre Rose Edition d'Exception. The collector's bottle is hexagonal as usual and decorated with floral reliefs. However, compared to the normal bottle, the bottle of the Edition d'Exception is completely clad in shimmering gold. The Eau de Parfum Spray by Jean-Charles Brosseau therefore looks like a precious piece of jewellery that should definitely be part of your collection. Jean-Charles Brosseau adorns you Ombre Rose Edition d'Exception is a feminine fragrance that delights with an opulent olfactory pyramid. The top notes are composed of rose geranium, peach, rosewood and aldehydes. A bouquet of lily of the valley, roses, vetiver, ylang-ylang, iris root, cedar and sandalwood awaits you in the heart note. The long-lasting finish is formed from heliotrope, musk, iris, vanilla, tonka beans, honey and cinnamon. The soft, delicate aromas make the eau de parfum spray the perfect fragrance for all women who are aware of their sensuality and femininity and who see this as a strength. Ombre Rose Edition d'Exception is just right for romantic hours for two, but also for a strong appearance in the evening.

listings.rawTitle: Jean-Charles Brosseau Ombre Bleue Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Ombre Bleue Eau de Parfum Spray by Jean-Charles Brosseau is an olfactory interpretation of a sunny day by the sea, reminiscent of carefree holiday moments and distant travels. The floral composition starts with an opening of carnation and orange blossom, which gently fades into the heart note. At the centre of the fragrance, a rich bouquet of lily of the valley, jasmine, rose and lily unfolds, giving the perfume its pure, solar character. The multi-layered base provides a warm yet fresh finish. This is where chords of benzoin resin, ambergris, musk and vanilla meet maritime notes, sand and cedar. The perfume, originally created in 1987 and reissued in 2023, is presented as an eau de parfum with moderate intensity and longevity. A floral fragrance inspired by the beach, sun and sea. Composition of orange blossom, lily, rose and maritime accords. Eau de Parfum with moderate intensity and longevity. Created in 1987 and reissued in 2023.

listings.rawTitle: Jean-Charles Brosseau Ombre Platine Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The eau de parfum spray Ombre Platine by Jean-Charles Brosseau shows at first glance why it bears this name. The fragrance for women is concealed in a metallic flacon that gives no indication of its interior. The flacon not only protects the eau de parfum spray, it also makes you incredibly curious. At the same time, the bottle looks very elegant with its carved reliefs and transparent cap in a warm orange colour. Since 2011, Ombre Platine has been surprising with a fruity and spicy fragrance that stands out from other women's fragrances. Walk on different paths With Ombre Platine, Jean-Charles Brosseau proves that a women's fragrance does not always have to be floral. The top note consists of pink pepper, red apples, blackcurrant and bergamot. The heart note is almost gourmand thanks to the use of plums, milk and coconut. They blend with the scent of tuberose and lilies. Cedar, sandalwood, Peru balsam and vanilla combine for the base note. The blend of fruity, soft, sweet and resinous notes makes Ombre Platine an unforgettable fragrance that will simply delight you. The eau de parfum spray by Jean-Charles Brosseau is suitable for all seasons and occasions and will accompany you throughout the day and even in the evening if you wish.

listings.rawTitle: Jean-Charles Brosseau Ombre Rubis Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The visual appearance immediately catches the eye with a deep red, octagonal bottle decorated with raised ornamental patterns. Hidden inside this ruby-coloured container is a composition that opens with a fresh and invigorating accord of bergamot, crisp apple and rhubarb. This opening is complemented by delicate mimosa, which lends the first impression a light effervescence. This fruity introduction then transitions gently into a floral heart note in which water jasmine meets orange blossom and violet leaf. Blackcurrant adds another interesting facet and deepens the fragrance profile. For a warm and lasting finish, the fragrance has a rich base of Madagascar vanilla, coconut and cedarwood, which is rounded off with resinous styrax and powdery iris. The Eau de Parfum Spray combines these multi-layered elements to create a luminous and sophisticated fragrance experience that is suitable for both day and evening wear thanks to its balance. A spherical golden cap and a silver ring on the neck of the bottle complete the high-quality design by Jean-Charles Brosseau. Fruity-floral fragrance composition with a warm base note Top notes of rhubarb, apple, mimosa and bergamot Heart note combines water jasmine, orange blossom and violet leaf Base of vanilla, coconut, cedarwood and iris Octagonal, deep red bottle with gold cap

listings.rawTitle: Jean-Charles Brosseau Ombre Orientale Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Ombre Orientale by Jean-Charles Brosseau is a composition that captivates with its warm and multi-faceted notes. The fragrance opens with a fruity, spicy combination of precious saffron, blackcurrant and tangy bergamot. A hint of apple and the subtle spiciness of pink pepper lend a special dynamic to the opening. A floral bouquet unfolds in the heart, combining delicate violet, rose and orange blossom with the sweet freshness of raspberry to create a harmonious blend. The base note gives the eau de parfum its depth and long-lasting character. Warm and earthy accords of patchouli, precious oud, amber, iris and creamy sandalwood create a lasting impression and elegantly round off the fragrance experience. Fragrance direction: Spicy-woody Top note with saffron, blackcurrant and pink pepper Floral heart of violet, rose and orange blossom Warm base with patchouli, oud, amber and sandalwood Available as an eau de parfum spray

listings.rawTitle: Jean-Charles Brosseau Ombre Musquèe Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Jean-Charles Brosseau Ombre Musquèe presents itself as a multi-faceted composition that harmoniously combines spicy and woody accords. The opening surprises with a lively freshness in which fruity notes of apple and mandarin meet the subtle spiciness of pink pepper. The heart of the eau de parfum then unfolds, interweaving warm cinnamon nuances with the gentle sweetness of peach. This olfactory interplay is complemented by powdery accents of violet and tonka bean. This multi-layered melange concludes with a deep base characterised by white musk, cedar and sandalwood as well as a striking hint of leather. The fragrance also sets clear visual accents with its white, faceted bottle. The bottle is characterised by a raised pattern of various geometric and floral elements, while a round, copper-coloured cap elegantly rounds off the design. A metallic ring with the engraved inscription "CHARLES BROSS" emphasises the detailed design of the 100 ml bottle. Eau de Parfum Spray with a spicy, woody character Top notes of apple, mandarin and pink pepper Heart note combines cinnamon, peach, tonka bean and violet Base note with white musk, cedarwood, sandalwood and leather White bottle with geometric relief and copper-coloured cap

listings.description: The octagonal bottle of the Ombre Azurite eau de parfum spray is characterised by a deep, vibrant blue. Jean-Charles Brosseau presents a creation that stands out visually with geometric and floral patterns on the glass surface and a golden ball cap. The fragrance itself belongs to the floral-green family of perfumes and is characterised by a multi-layered structure. It opens with a fresh top note in which the fruity flavours of pear and bergamot blend with the light spiciness of pink pepper. This is followed by a heart note that emphasises floral and aquatic elements. Water jasmine and water lily combine with the soft nuances of peach, lending the arrangement a certain lightness. Memories of the atmosphere of the Côte d'Azur and maritime breezes are often evoked. In the base note, the composition concludes with warmer, earthy tones. Here, cedar and sandalwood harmonise with creamy tonka bean and powdery iris. The interplay of these ingredients creates a fragrance with fresh, spicy and sensual facets. Fragrance family: Floral-green with fresh and spicy accents Head note: A blend of pear, pink pepper and bergamot Heart notes: Floral and fruity tones of water jasmine, water lily and peach Base note: Warm finish with cedar, tonka bean, sandalwood and iris Design: Striking, blue bottle in an octagonal shape with a golden cap

listings.rawTitle: Widian Black Collection Extrait de Parfum Black I 50 ml
listings.description: The Widian Black I Extrait de Parfum is a warm and multi-layered fragrance composition inspired by the inviting atmosphere and hospitality of a traditional coffee ceremony. The fragrance opens with spicy notes of cinnamon and cardamom, which immediately exude an enveloping warmth. At the heart of the composition, a mystical smoke of incense unfolds, which meets woody accords of cypress and sandalwood and gives the fragrance a special depth. The base note of musk and fine cedar wood ensures a long-lasting, dry and elegant finish. A subtle hint of French vanilla rounds off the experience without dominating the composition. Presented in an artfully faceted, deep black bottle with fine golden embellishments, the design also reflects the exclusivity of the contents. As an extrait de parfum, this unisex fragrance has a high concentration for an intense fragrance experience. A warm, spicy-woody fragrance character Composition of cinnamon, incense and cedar wood High fragrance concentration as an extrait de parfum Designed for all genders

listings.rawTitle: Widian Black Collection Extrait de Parfum Black III 50 ml
listings.description: The extravagant composition Widian Black III Extrait de Parfum from the exclusive Black Collection sets new standards. This unisex perfume combines fresh citrus nuances with sophisticated wood and leather accords. An olfactory experience that evokes memories and has a modern feel at the same time. Citrusy, minty opening The top note of Black III Extrait de Parfum combines hand-picked bergamot with spearmint to create an invigorating freshness . This opening of the Widian Black Collection unfolds a cool lightness and gives the creation an immediate presence. The interplay of these components creates the characteristic opening of this precious fragrance. Warm depth and a sensual base Rough woody notes and majestic leather dominate the heart of the fragrance, exuding a deep warmth . The base reveals a composition of vanilla, moss, patchouli and sandalwood, which envelop each other harmoniously and guarantee a lasting, warm and balsamic finish. Embedded in a multi-faceted bottle, the architecture of the Sheikh Zayid Mosque in Abu Dhabi reflects the oriental inspiration. The simple yet impressive design emphasises the luxurious aura of this exclusive fragrance. Whether in the office during the day or at elegant evening events, the Widian Black III Extrait de Parfum extrait really comes into its own in the cooler months of the year. With remarkable longevity and subtle sillage, it accompanies you through the day in style. This powerful complexity makes this perfume from the Black Collection a timeless classic .</p

listings.rawTitle: Widian Black Collection Extrait de Parfum Black IV 50 ml
listings.description: Black IV Extrait de Parfum from the Black Collection by Widian is a high-quality, gender-neutral fragrance. Unisex fragrances are becoming increasingly popular. This is made possible by the neutral fragrance notes which, when combined, create an unmistakable scent. Bergamot provides freshness in the top note. It has an attractive effect, while the sweetness of plum has a calming effect. Blackcurrant balances between these two fruity notes. Riper blackcurrants lend a sweeter note, while young blackcurrants are more sparkling and challenging. Black IV Extrait de Parfum unfolds the scents of various flowers in the heart note. Only the rose stands out clearly and gives the perfume a lovely scent. Exceptional fragrances from the Black Collection by Widian The base note combines a certain heaviness with the scent of leather. It has a dominating effect and strengthens the wearer's appearance. The scent of leather is harmoniously enveloped by vanilla. The Black IV Extrait de Parfum by Widian from the Black Collection is an ideal and above all neutral gift, suitable for any occasion. The perfume can be worn in both the warm and cold seasons. While it emphasises the freshness of flowers in summer, it intensifies the longing for security in winter.

The Widian Rose Arabia Collection is ideal for anyone looking for floral elegance in a delicate and lasting fragrance The opening of this fragrance begins with lively rose freshness and is rounded off with delicate green nuances. A rose bouquet unfolds at the heart of the Cotton Eau de Parfum Spray, emphasising the feminine side of this unisex fragrance. The base of the Widian Rose Arabia Collection presents itself with warm, oriental notes - a soft foundation of musk and precious woods that gives the fragrance depth and longevity. Why you will love this fragrance Unisex composition: not just for women! Men also enjoy the velvety rose and oriental combination of Cotton Eau de Parfum Spray. Multi-layered and modern: From freshness to warm sensuality - a perfume that adapts to your day. Suitable for everyday wear & special at the same time: Elegant enough for special occasions, discreet enough for the office. Appearance & application The clear spray bottle with its elegant design fits perfectly in any bathroom or handbag. listings.rawTitle: Widian Rose Arabia Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Melogold 100 ml
listings.description: Widian Melogold is a composition based on the fascinating contrast of sparkling freshness and profound warmth. Created by perfumer Nathalie Lorson, the fragrance opens with an invigorating combination of grapefruit and juniper berries, refined by the noble spice of saffron. At the heart, an interplay of delicate violet and fruity raspberry unfolds, which meets a striking leather accord and gives the fragrance its unmistakable character. The base note rounds off the olfactory experience with warm cashmeran, earthy vetiver and soft musk, giving the eau de parfum a long-lasting depth. This elegant yet untamed balance between intensity and lightness is also reflected in the design of the bottle, whose golden liquid shimmers through clear glass and is topped off with a shiny cap. A leather fragrance with fruity, fresh and warm notes. Composition of grapefruit, leather, violet and cashmeran. An eau de parfum for all genders. Part of the exclusive Rose Arabia collection by Widian.
