listings.rawTitle: XERJOFF Casamorati Gran Ballo Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Gran Ballo by XERJOFF is part of the incomparable Casamorati Collection. The floral and fruity fragrance was launched in 2013. It is sometimes labelled as unisex, but it is actually for women and was inspired by a glamorous party in times long past. The place: a palazzo. The occasion: a nobleman has invited to a bridal show. Young noble ladies flock to the palace to find their Prince Charming. But only one of them wears this fragrance, which is so perfectly suited to her self-confident and sensual charisma. Gran Ballo, the grand ball, traditionally takes place in spring or summer, where the eau de parfum spray is simply perfect. This ball can also be celebrated during the day The top note of the XERJOFF Casamorati fragrance Gran Ballo consists of wild strawberries and tangerine peel. Jasmine sambac and gardenia are complemented by fresh honeysuckle in the heart note. Vanilla and caramel lend a certain sweetness to the base, which is rounded off aromatically and slightly creamy by sandalwood and amber. Inspired by a young lady being introduced to society, the fragrance of Gran Ballo is nevertheless not girly or playful. Rather, the XERJOFF Eau de Parfum Spray has a light and lively elegance that suits all women.

listings.rawTitle: XERJOFF Casamorati 1888 Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The spicy-floral fragrance 1888 by XERJOFF is an ode to the authentic and self-confident men and women of today. 1888 is a unisex fragrance and impresses with its above-average durability, presence and authenticity. The name says it all and is reminiscent of the original recipes of the 19th century fragrance company Casamorati, which was taken over and rescued by XERJOFF. The Eau de Parfum Spray is striking, sensual and luxurious. It is clearly recognisable. Coriander, saffron, garden cloves and pepper form the spicy-floral opening in the top note. The heart note is more floral with neroli, ylang-ylang and roses, while the unisex fragrance is refined with amber, patchouli, birch essence and sandalwood. The result is an elegant, casual and sensual fragrance philosophy. 1888 is an extravagant eau de parfum spray for men and women with style. The eau de parfum spray is an olfactory delight. The fragrance is captivating without being overpowering. It is for men and women who are successful and romantic at the same time. The brown glass bottle with the golden cap is a statement of elegance and makes a decorative statement. This fragrance from XERJOFF is pure luxury. It pays homage to the classic Italian style, which is timeless. This is how elegant unisex fragrances go!

listings.rawTitle: XERJOFF Casamorati Lira Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The XERJOFF Lira Eau de Parfum Spray is part of the Casamorati 1888 collection and its name is reminiscent of the classical and ancient plucked instrument - the lyre. The fragrance is a tribute to femininity and is therefore aimed at women who have both feet firmly on the ground and are not afraid of new challenges. Self-confident, theatrical and with a touch of decadence - this perfume is a true cult fragrance. Here, Mediterranean, sparkling elements meet floral and sweet-gourmand sounds - a fascinating composition that stimulates the imagination . The spices of the Orient unite with liquorice flowers, and refreshing citrus notes combine harmoniously with caramel - the Lira Eau de Parfum Spray by XERJOFF is like an intoxication of the senses. An exclusive fragrance for the sophisticated woman Bergamot, blood orange and lavender exude their aromas in the top note. In the heart note, jasmine, Bulgarian rose, liquorice and cinnamon join this fragrance composition. The base note is characterised by caramel, musk and vanilla. A unique combination of unusual nuances that show that XERJOFF never submits to the mainstream, but goes its own way, which arouses curiosity and raises questions . This fragrance is definitely a pleasant memory. The bottle is just as eye-catching as its contents and is the centrepiece of any bathroom. The XERJOFF Lira Eau de Parfum Spray is pompous, opulent and luxurious - just as the modern woman of today deserves.

listings.rawTitle: XERJOFF Casamorati Fiore d'Ulivo Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Fiore d'Ulivo is an eau de parfum spray by XERJOFF for the lady of the world! The origins of this fragrance go back to the small perfumery Casamorati, which Signore Casamorati opened in 1888 with his own creations. XERJOFF continues this tradition so that the unique fragrance Fiore d'Ulivo is preserved. At the time, Signore Casamorati was honoured for his fragrance creations with a golden pin from Queen Margarethe of Italy. A fragrance like a Mediterranean spring Fiore d'Ulivo gives every wearer the radiance of a sunny spring day on the Mediterranean. The flair of Bella Italia emerges with pretty olive blossoms that exude a subtle sweetness and are only in full splendour for a few days. This moment has been captured in the Eau de Parfum Spray. It is framed by citrus notes and lotus blossom with top notes of magnolia and jasmine. Floral aspects define the fragrance, which finishes with long-lasting base notes of olive, amber and musk .

listings.rawTitle: XERJOFF Casamorati Bouquet Ideale Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: With each fragrance creation, Sergio Momo, the founder of XERJOFF, demonstrates his close connection with Italian perfume tradition. His decision to revive the traditional house of Casamorati is a win for every perfume lover. Who would want to miss an elegant fragrance like Bouquet Ideale, whose bright red bottle is a small work of art? The sweet and spicy women's fragrance is a surprising reinterpretation of popular fragrances from the original Casamorati collection. Bouquet Ideale by XERJOFF: a luxurious fragrance for you Sergio Momo and his perfumers have specialised in stylish niche fragrances . They see the advantage of not having to make any compromises. This creative freedom allows them to offer perfume lovers all over the world elegant fragrances with an unmistakable character. They do not copy the successful Casamorati fragrances, but recreate them. The result is perfumes that are as irresistible to today's perfume lovers as Casamorati perfumes were to their time. The Eau de Parfum Spray Bouquet Ideale is an insider tip for women who love elegant luxury fragrances. Its sensual, spicy heart note consists of nutmeg and cinnamon. For the heart note, the creator of the women's fragrance, Jacques Flori, blends guaiac and papyrus with beguiling amyris oil. A multi-layered, warm blend of coumarin, tobacco blossom, labdanum and musk brings the eau de parfum spray to a close.

listings.rawTitle: XERJOFF Casamorati Mefisto Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Casamorati Mefisto Eau de Parfum Spray by Xerjoff pays homage to classic Italian perfumery, reinterpreted in a modern and multi-layered composition. This fragrance initially unfolds with an invigorating top note in which the sparkling freshness of pomelo, bergamot and lime meets the clear, aromatic accents of lavender. This opening creates a dynamic first impression. At the heart of the composition is a classic floral bouquet characterised by the timeless elegance of Damask rose and powdery Florentino iris. Delicate white flowers such as neroli add a further layer of sophistication and harmoniously round off the heart note. The finish is warm and long-lasting: a rich base of precious Mysore sandalwood, cedarwood and earthy Haitian vetiver combines with the gentle sweetness of bourbon vanilla, amber and musk. The creation is presented in a luxurious Art Nouveau-style bottle that emphasises the artistic inspiration of the Casamorati line. Fragrance family: Fresh and aromatic with woody accents. Head note: A citrusy opening with lavender, pomelo, bergamot and lime. Heart note: A floral heart of damask rose, iris florentino and neroli. Base note: A warm base of sandalwood, cedarwood, vanilla, amber and musk.

listings.rawTitle: XERJOFF Casamorati Dolce Amalfi Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml

For a summery, light fragrance, Mefisto Gentiluomo, the devilish gentleman, has outstanding longevity and sillage. Like all fragrances in the Casamorati collection, the Gentiluomo eau de parfum spray is dedicated to a time when the world was much more relaxed. The Casamorati range pays homage to the Casamorati label from 1861, whose recipes were rescued by XERJOFF. A summer for men, but not only The top note of Mefisto Gentiluomo consists of bergamot, lemon and lavender. The heart is carried by violet, rose and iris, while the base is formed from musk, amber and cedarwood. This light and delightfully relaxed combination also makes Gentiluomo Eau de Parfum Spray a favourite with women. They like the complete absence of sweet flavours just as much as the men, for whom the XERJOFF fragrance was originally created. With Eau de Parfum Spray Gentiluomo, the Italian luxury label XERJOFF proves that fresh summer fragrances don't have to be mainstream to really suit anytime and anywhere when the temperatures rise outside.

listings.rawTitle: XERJOFF Casamorati Casa Futura Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: XERJOFF Casamorati Casa Futura Eau de Parfum Spray recalls the art movement of Futurism at the beginning of the 20th century. This pioneering phase lasted from 1909 to 1944, and the aim of this movement was to translate the power and dynamism of the modern world into art and thus immortalise it. The XERJOFF Casamorati Casa Futura Eau de Parfum Spray interprets the philosophy of the time in the form of this unique fragrance, reflecting the progress, modernity and romanticism of this formative period. A well thought-out, unique fragrance that has a story to tell . A unisex fragrance that revives the art of days gone by In the top note, sparkling bergamot, lovely lavender and spicy rosemary exude their aromas. Notes of rose, patchouli, geranium, garyl and diphylleia follow in the heart. This fragrance composition is perfected in the base with the sounds of cedarwood, sandalwood and musk. The golden, slightly ornate bottle is pompous and elegant. Both the labelling on the bottle and the packaging are extremely modern and futuristic in design - combining tradition and progress in a sophisticated way. The fascinating fragrance is aimed equally at men and women who want to showcase their individuality and play an active role in shaping the future . The XERJOFF Casamorati Casa Futura Eau de Parfum Spray is therefore a fragrance that distances itself from the mainstream and embodies its very own message.

The base note gives the perfume its warm, earthy depth and ensures a long-lasting, seductive finish. Precious woods and soft vanilla notes combine to create a harmonious accord that rounds off the fragrance and lends it an aura of elegance and sophistication. Rumi HUNDRED SILENT WAYS Extrait de Parfum Spray by NISHANE is more than just a perfume - it is an ode to love, beauty and the poetry of life.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Shadow Play Extrait de Parfum HACIVAT 50 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the traditional Turkish shadow puppet Hacivat, this extrait de parfum is an artful chypre composition for all genders. The fragrance opens with a lively and fruity top note of pineapple, bergamot and grapefruit, which creates a refreshing first impression. A harmonious combination of jasmine, patchouli and cedarwood unfolds at the heart of the creation, adding floral and woody accents. The base note anchors the perfume with warm and earthy tones of oakmoss, clearwood and dry woods, giving the fragrance an elegant depth and remarkable longevity. Created in 2017 by perfumer Jorge Lee, the composition is characterised by its balance between freshness and warmth. The stylish character is emphasised by the white bottle with its artistically curved, gold-coloured cap. An elegant chypre fragrance for all genders . Combines a fruity, fresh top note with a warm, woody base. Highly concentrated as an extrait de parfum for a long-lasting presence. Composition of pineapple, jasmine, cedarwood and oakmoss.

listings.rawTitle: NISHANE Miniature Art Extrait de Parfum Spray WŪLÓNG CHÁ 50 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the traditional Chinese tea ceremony, WŪLÓNG CHÁ by NISHANE celebrates the special flavour of oolong tea. This extrait de parfum opens with a clear, citrusy freshness of bergamot, orange and mandarin, which forms the prelude to the heart of the composition. This is where the characteristic, slightly tart aroma of oolong tea unfolds, subtly accompanied by a spicy nutmeg note. In the base, a combination of soft musk and Mediterranean fig provides a gentle and rounded finish that lends the fragrance a subtle depth. As a unisex fragrance from the Miniature Art Collection, WŪLÓNG CHÁ is a modern and sophisticated interpretation of tea culture that harmoniously combines freshness and restrained warmth. listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Titani Collection Extrait de Parfum Rea 100 ml
listings.description: The Titani Collection by Giardino Benessere presents Rea, a multi-faceted extrait de parfum that embodies the artistic vision of the Italian house. Paolo and Tiziana Terenzi drew their inspiration for this creation from the mythical world of the Titans and the nature of Italy. A fruity-floral opening characterises the first impression, with notes of imperial iris and magnolia meeting the citrusy nuances of orange and mandarin. As the composition develops, a multi-layered heart unfolds. Here, floral accords of lavender, rose and jasmine combine with the spicy character of pink pepper and the striking aroma of Tuscan leather and cedar. The fragrance experience is rounded off with a base of oak. Visually, the bottle reflects the exclusivity: a flat, rectangular container made of pink-coloured material bears a shiny metallic emblem with the lettering REA. A conically shaped, silver-coloured cap crowns the design of this unisex fragrance. Extrait de Parfum from the Titani Collection inspired by Titans Top notes of iris, magnolia, orange and mandarin Complex heart of leather, cedar, pink pepper and flowers Rectangular bottle in pink with silver-coloured cap Creation by Italian perfumers Paolo and Tiziana Terenzi

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Titani Collection Extrait de Parfum Themis 100 ml
listings.description: The fragrances from the Titani Collection by Giardino Benessere were inspired by Greek mythology. This includes Themis Extrait de Parfum, which was launched in 2020. Designed for men and women, the fragrance has an oriental and spicy scent. Paolo Terenzi invites you to take a stroll through the bazaar with the Titani Collection Themis Extrait de Parfum. There you will find a wide variety of fragrances that immediately conjure up wonderful images in the mind. The perfumer, who is an established name in the world of fragrances, also succeeds in doing this with this unisex perfume. Peru balsam, precious saffron and fine star anise form the top note. It continues with Indian oud, Indian sandalwood, Indonesian gurjun balsam and benzoin in the heart. Opulent, olfactory luxury from the master To round off the Themis Extrait de Parfum from the Titani Collection, the founder of Giardino Benessere uses the scents of vanilla, cypriol, Cambodian oud and Indian patchouli. On cool days and evenings, the extrait de parfum is a fine all-rounder whose presence is noticeable but not intrusive . After all, Paolo Terenzi only uses high-quality components in all of his creations, and their quality speaks for itself. Anyone looking for something special will find it in the Titani Collection by Giardino Benessere with Themis Extrait de Parfum Spray.

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Titani Collection Extrait de Parfum Thetys 100 ml
listings.description: Thetys Extrait de Parfum is an oriental unisex fragrance launched in 2018 by Giardino Benessere. The niche fragrance from the renowned Italian luxury label run by siblings Paolo and Tiziana Terenzi is part of the Titani Collection inspired by Greek mythology. Paolo Terenzi's composition dedicated to Thetys is as powerful as the goddess herself. The daughter of Uranus is the ruler of the oceans and one of the most powerful Titans in mythology. Giardino Benessere Thetys Extrait de Parfum - a seductive fragrance with delicious notes The perfume from the successful Titani Collection captivates with warm and spicy accents that beguile the senses with their unique purity. Even the top note is irresistibly addictive with delicious notes of aromatic coffee, dark chocolate and sweet vanilla. Nuances of delicate jasmine tempt you to dream. The warm, velvety heart of the perfume is dominated by fragrant flowers. The star of the show is the proud, intensely fragrant Damask rose, again gently framed by a hint of jasmine. Amber emphasises the mythical flair of the composition. The foundation of Giardino Benessere Thetys Extrait de Parfum is dedicated to elegant and sensual notes. With accents of vanilla, soft musk, resinous cedar and patchouli, the particularly long-lasting fragrance from the Titani Collection ends impressively.

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Titani Collection Extrait de Parfum Crio 100 ml
listings.description: The name says it all. Giardino Benessere Titani Collection Crio Extrait de Parfum is a very powerful, intense fragrance . Launched in 2018, the aromatic-floral composition from the Terenci siblings symbolises the character of Kreios, one of the most powerful Titans in Greek mythology, with precious olfactory accents. Kreios, the brother of Kronos, is said to have the power to stop the course of the stars with cryogenic ice. The multi-faceted fragrance pyramid of this extraordinary unisex perfume, which is an impressive addition to the luxury label's Titans collection, is correspondingly intense. Resistible elegance in an extraordinary composition Fresh, elegant accents of dewy orange blossom and aromatic tea open the Giardino Benessere Titani Collection Crio Extrait de Parfum fragrance. The dominant notes are embedded in a beguilingly fragrant bouquet of Damask roses and iris. The heart note demonstrates powerful strength with aromatic oakmoss and tangy red pepper, which is gently reined in by the delicate tuberose. Delicious tonka bean adds a touch of sensuality to the fragrance. In the base, Giardino Benessere Titani Collection Crio Extrait de Parfum fascinates with elegant notes of Tuscan leather as well as opoponax and benzoin resin, rounded off by intense aromas of soft musk. A decidedly energetic, vitalising fragrance that brings mythology to life.

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Titani Collection Extrait de Parfum Stereope 100 ml
listings.description: The Stereope Extrait de Parfum by Giardino Benessere is presented in a bright green bottle in the Titani Collection in 2022. The fragrance is unisex and green-citrusy . This makes Paolo Terenzi's creation ideal for summer and all other warm days and evenings. The perfumer, who is also responsible for Tiziana Terenzi, also shows what he can do in the compositions of Giardino Benessere. The top note of Stereope Extrait de Parfum consists of the scent of Brazilian oranges, Calabrian bergamot, juniper, Indonesian teakwood as well as lemons and grapefruit from Italy. The heart note blends ginger, sage, coriander, Guatemalan cardamom and artemisia. The base combines the flavours of musk, bourbon vanilla, oud from Cambodia and patchouli from Singapore. That certain luxury, even for everyday life The Titani Collection Stereope Extrait de Parfum impresses with its summery, fresh and fruity composition. At the same time, the fragrance also proves that the two creatives behind the Giardino Benessere label are not only masters of unusual fragrances for very special moments, but also sensual and elegant creations for every day . However, they remain completely true to themselves, because the Stereope Extrait de Parfum from the Titani Collection is of course not mainstream.

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Titani Collection Extrait de Parfum Giapeto 100 ml
listings.description: Giardino Benessere Giapeto Extrait de Parfum is a balsamic-aromatic unisex fragrance from 2022. The art perfume from the Titani Collection, inspired by Greek mythology, is dedicated to the hero Giapeto. Giapeto, also known as Lapetos, is said to possess supernatural powers and is considered one of the pillars of the universe. The fragrance notes of this sophisticated composition are correspondingly energetic and powerful. Perfumer Paolo Terenzi, one of the founders of the successful luxury label, places precious spicy aromas at the centre of his creation. A hint of delicate flowers adds depth of character to the fragrance from the Titani Collection. Giardino Benessere Giapeto Extrait de Parfum - modern facets of energy and strength The extraordinary fragrance composition opens with a firework of flavours . Finely spicy cardamom from Guatemala, spicy cumin and labdanum, the fragrant resin from cistus, are joined by precious saffron. In the heart note, resinous-woody and green accents of Virginia cedar, Indian nagarmotha - a type of cypress reminiscent of Cyprus grass - and gurjun balsam are given a radiantly soft flair by the scent of delicate lily of the valley. Like all fragrances in Giardino Benessere's Titani Collection, the base of Giapeto Extrait de Parfum is sensually elegant with notes of musk, ambergris, vanilla, eaglewood and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Titani Collection Extrait de Parfum Arge 100 ml
listings.description: The Titani Collection by Giardino Benessere is an olfactory homage to Greek mythology . With the unisex fragrance Arge Extrait de Parfum, the Italian cult label of the Terenzi siblings adds a multi-faceted composition to its successful collection of niche perfumes. Just as Arge - the son of Gaea and Uranus - symbolises the union of heaven and earth, the fruity-floral perfume launched in 2022 presents an irresistible synthesis of the treasures of the Garden of Eden with otherworldly, aphrodisiac floral notes. The perfumer of this exhilaratingly elegant composition is brand founder Paolo Terenzi himself. Giardino Benessere Arge Extrait de Parfum - a cornucopia of fascinating fragrance notes Like an olfactory painting, this extraordinary perfume from the Titani Collection presents an abundance of fruits and flowers . Sweet fruits lend a seductive moment to the opening. Ripe peaches from Romagna and aromatic Brazilian passion fruit are joined by juicy raspberries from the peaks of the Dolomites. The heart of the fragrance is a cornucopia of fascinating flowers with accents of Bulgarian rose, magnolia, tuberose, lily of the valley and heliotrope. With an impressive accord of suede, Atlas cedar, sandalwood, vanilla, ambergris, musk and patchouli, the artful Arge Extrait de Parfum fragrance from the Giardino Benessere Titani Collection ends with a touch of sensuality.

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Titani Collection Extrait de Parfum Ceo 100 ml
listings.description: Launched in 2023, Ceo Extrait de Parfum is a multi-faceted addition to the Titani Collection from Italian label Giardino Benessere. Inspired by the mythological figure of the Titan, who symbolises the rational mind, this fragrance embodies a balance of power and refined elegance. Visually, this character is reflected in a rectangular glass bottle in a shimmering metallic lime green, accentuated by a shiny silver cap. The olfactory profile opens with a dynamic top note that combines fruity essences of Brazilian orange, Calabrian bergamot and Sicilian grapefruit with the floral nuance of Bulgarian rose and spicy Ceylon cinnamon. This is followed by a complex centrepiece that contrasts the freshness of Italian mint and Chinese ginger with the depth of Tuscan leather and Singapore patchouli. The long-lasting finish is provided by a solid base that combines warm accords of bourbon vanilla, grey ambergris and Sudanese opoponax with earthy oakmoss. Both men and women can wear this extrait de parfum, as the carefully balanced ingredients unfold regardless of gender norms. Extrait de Parfum from the Titani Collection (launch 2023) Unisex fragrance with a citrus-floral and woody character Top notes of orange, bergamot, cinnamon and rose Base of bourbon vanilla, ambergris and oakmoss Metallised bottle in lime green with silver cap

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Titani Collection Extrait de Parfum Mnemosine 100 ml
listings.description: Titani Collection Mnemosine Extrait de Parfum by Giardino Benessere is a creation that is as sensual as it is invigorating. Let this extraordinary perfume accompany you throughout the day. It doesn't matter what the occasion is: you can wear the fragrance for work and leisure alike. It wafts around you like a breath of extraordinary freshness, giving you a special feeling of well-being. Choose the Titani Collection Mnemosine Extrait de Parfum by Giardino Benessere if you want to treat yourself to a special fragrance. The lovingly designed flacon in the enchanting colour violet with the shiny silver cap and the emblem in the same colour on the front looks very elegant. If you are looking for a special gift, the Titani Collection Mnemosine Extrait de Parfum by Giardino Benessere is also a very good choice. The fragrance is designed for women of all ages. It is subtle, yet intense enough to be noticed. And in a particularly positive way. The perfume is a combination of numerous active ingredients of natural origin. You will find bergamot and blackcurrant in the top notes, jasmine and narcissus in the heart notes, rounded off with vanilla and a dash of musk in the base notes. You are choosing a perfect fragrance for every occasion.

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Titani Collection Extrait de Parfum Teia 100 ml
listings.description: As part of the Titans Collection, Teia Extrait de Parfum is presented in a striking red bottle with rounded edges, which is enhanced by a silver emblem and a matching cap. The creation by Paolo and Tiziana Terenzi is characterised by a particularly high concentration of fragrance oils, which favours intense perception and long-lasting adhesion to the skin. The olfactory opening combines spicy cardamom from Guatemala with the floral nuances of Bulgarian lavender and earthy Haitian vetiver and amber. As the fragrance progresses, a multi-layered heart note unfolds, in which incense from Oman meets Laotian oud and Lebanese cedarwood. This interplay is complemented by accords of Tuscan leather and vanilla from Madagascar. Warm tones of saffron, patchouli, musk and sandalwood round off the fragrance. This complex composition is gender-neutral and offers a multi-faceted fragrance experience. High fragrance oil concentration as an extrait de parfum for long-lasting fragrance Multi-layered composition with notes of oud, leather, spices and woods Part of the exclusive Titans Collection by Giardino Benessere High-quality, red bottle with silver details Gender-neutral fragrance character

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Titani Collection Extrait de Parfum Hyades 100 ml
listings.description: The aquatic and fruity fragrance Hyades as an extrait de parfum by Giardino Benessere is an exquisite perfume from the Titani Collection. It is aimed at both men and women. The high-quality fragrance is ideal for special occasions, as it mixes special nuances and is sure to be remembered for a long time. Travelling the world with the fragrance At least mentally, Hyades Extrait de Parfum will have you travelling the world in no time. The fruity pineapple could welcome you to Hawaii, the intense lavender to France. Star anise and bergamot add a little more variety to the top note. In the heart note, you will encounter spicy ginger (like at a bazaar in the Far East?) and the queen of flowers, rose. Geranium and apple are also present to create a sweet, fruity accord. In the base, you are gently grounded with ambergris, tonka bean and various woods. Giardino Benessere lands a hit for him and her with Hyades Extrait de Parfum. Look forward to this unusual and therefore charming perfume from the Titani Collection or choose it as an exclusive gift.

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Titani Collection Extrait de Parfum Dasos 100 ml
listings.description: Dasos Extrait de Parfum is an exquisite creation for all those who not only wear fragrances, but live for them. It is part of the Titani Collection from Giardino Benessere. The brand is known for its high quality standards . Perfume is not just any product. It should both inspire people and protect nature. Sustainability is one of the most important goals. This applies to the plant-based raw materials for the perfume as well as the packaging. Dasos Extrait de Parfum: a treasure of nature The Titani Collection by Giardino Benessere is inspired by Greek mythology. The legends of the Titans tell of the origins of the world. The perfumers want to capture these forces of nature in their creations. Dasos Extrait de Parfum is dedicated to the deity of unspoilt forests. Here, nature can unfold unhindered according to its own rules. Dasos from the Titani Collection by Giardino Benessere is an exceptionally multi-layered unisex fragrance . Spices and herbs characterise the top notes of nutmeg, saffron, lavender and thyme. The heart note consists of precious ingredients from all over the world. These include Italian oak, Indian patchouli, Tahitian vetiver and Lebanese cedar. The composition ends on a sensual oriental note: Incense and oud mingle with ambergris, oakmoss and ebony.

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Classic Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Rosa Dorotea 100 ml
listings.description: An olfactory stroll through a blossoming garden awaits lovers of fine fragrances with this creation from the Classic Collection. The composition opens with a fresh and fruity combination of tea rose, blackcurrant and sweet melon. A lush bouquet then unfolds in the heart, where the red rose meets floral accords of lily, magnolia and iris. This heart note is complemented by nuances of exotic passion fruit and green tea, giving the fragrance an interesting and multi-layered facet. The interplay of essences is always balanced. Base notes of cedarwood, white musk and amber provide a warm and lasting finish, giving the eau de parfum spray the necessary depth. Visually, the product is presented in a transparent, rectangular bottle that reveals the clear liquid. A cylindrical, silver-coloured cap and the round, silver label embossed with "Rosa Dorotea" emphasise the elegant design. With this fragrance, Giardino Benessere focuses on a harmonious interplay of classic and modern elements, creating a timeless fragrance experience. Floral-fruity fragrance composition with a focus on rose accords Top notes of tea rose, blackcurrant and melon Multi-layered heart with red rose, passion fruit and green tea Warm base notes of cedar wood, white musk and amber Elegant, transparent bottle with silver accents

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Titani Collection Extrait de Parfum Herà 100 ml
listings.description: Herà Extrait de Parfum is a unisex fragrance from the Titani Collection by Giardino Benessere. The incomparable combination of floral and woody fragrances makes the perfume an indispensable companion for men and women. A fragrance for him and her There are fragrances for men and fragrances for women. However, some fragrances are so fascinating that it is impossible to categorise them by gender. Herà Extrait de Parfum is a fragrance that appeals to both men and women. It starts with the fruity fragrances : bergamot, rose, lemon and orange. They refresh and give the wearer a lively start to the day. The heart notes of cedar, amber, orris and ylang-ylang soon assert themselves. The base notes of the perfume from the Titani Collection by Giardino Benessere are woody scents such as oakmoss, musk, patchouli and sandalwood. If you spray Herà Extrait de Parfum on the back of your neck or hand in the morning, you won't have to worry about attracting attention.

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Titani Collection Extrait de Parfum Hadès 100 ml
listings.description: Mysterious, sensual and seductive: Hadès Extrait de Parfum Giardino Benessere presents Hadès Extrait de Parfum from the Titani Collection , a fragrance for men and women. The fragrance is aromatic and green , but conceals a sensual secret thanks to the sophisticated composition by perfumer Paolo Terenzi. The ingredients form a successful combination. The name alludes to Greek mythology and places Hades, the brother of Zeus and ruler of the underworld, at the centre. The elegant bottle in mysterious black with silver accents is also a fascinating eye-catcher. A unisex perfume with that certain something The Giardino Benessere perfume starts with a fruity, spicy top note. It contains grapefruit, vanilla, coffee, myrtle, neroli and algae. The heart note focuses on floral components such as geranium and rose, gently rounded off with thyme, salt and cedarwood. Finally, Hadès Extrait de Parfum from the Titani Collection is rounded off with oakmoss, caramel, cedarwood, musk and benzoin. Anyone wearing this fragrance is at the centre of attention: The exclusive fragrance composition attracts attention without being intrusive. On the contrary, the exciting fragrance from the Titani Collection by Giardino Benessere arouses curiosity and tempts you to discover the seductive secret more closely!

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Classic Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Amber 100 ml
listings.description: The Giardino Benessere Classic Collection Amber Eau de Parfum Spray unfolds a composition that captivates with its warm and enveloping notes. This fragrance is characterised by a multi-layered structure in which spicy and woody accents blend harmoniously. The base is formed by rich amber notes that give the fragrance a pleasant depth and a long-lasting character. This foundation is complemented by subtle nuances that lend the fragrance a subtle complexity and expressive presence. The eau de parfum is suitable for a variety of occasions and leaves a lasting, positive impression. Presented in an elegant, transparent glass bottle with a silver-coloured cap, the design also reflects the timeless quality of the fragrance. A warm and enveloping fragrance character Harmonious combination of spicy and woody accents Rich amber notes in the base Multi-layered composition with pleasant depth Presented in a timelessly elegant bottle

listings.rawTitle: Giardino Benessere Classic Collection Eau de Parfum Spray Cotton Flower 100 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the pure atmosphere of vast landscapes, Giardino Benessere presents an olfactory interpretation of lightness and elegance with Cotton Flower. As part of the Classic Collection, this composition is characterised by the deliberate avoidance of a direct cotton note, instead evoking an association of freshness and purity through a complex interplay of white flowers and woods. The opening begins with a floral blend of gardenia and rose, which is complemented by the fine citrus notes of bergamot. As the fragrance progresses, a spicy heart develops in which characterful cloves meet jasmine and peony. This structure gives the eau de parfum a certain depth without losing its initial clarity. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a warm base of oak, patchouli and tonka bean, which ensures a long-lasting and harmonious finish. Developed by Tiziana and Paolo Terenzi and produced in Italy, the perfume combines floral, musky and woody accords to create a balanced overall picture that can be worn regardless of gender boundaries. Fragrance character: A balanced blend of floral, musky and woody notes. Top notes: Opens with bergamot, gardenia and rose. Heart note: Combines spicy cloves with jasmine and peony. Base note: Finishes with oak, patchouli and tonka bean. Concept: Olfactory representation of cotton blossom through white flowers and spices.

Trussardi Amber Oud Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
Trussardi Leviero Collection Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
Valentino Born In Roma Uomo Eau de Toilette Spray Yellow Dream 100 ml

This eau de toilette unfolds with an invigorating opening in which the tangy freshness of Italian mandarin and lime meets the exotic sweetness of pineapple. This lively top note transitions into a multi-faceted heart, which is given an unexpected, gourmand warmth by a spicy accord of gingerbread and ginger. Classic notes of lavender and geranium lend the composition a timeless, elegant structure. In the base, the fragrance concludes with a sensual and long-lasting blend of creamy vanilla, warm amber and the striking depth of cedarwood. The result is a balanced composition that harmoniously combines freshness and warmth and radiates modern elegance. A spicy, fruity fragrance for men . A revitalising top note with mandarin, lime and pineapple. Spicy heart of gingerbread, ginger, lavender and geranium. Warm base with vanilla, amber and cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born In Roma Uomo Ruby Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Valentino Born In Roma Uomo Rendez-Vous Ruby Eau de Toilette Spray is a modern fragrance composition that harmoniously blends fruity and woody notes. A crisp raspberry accord opens the fragrance experience, adding an invigorating touch to everyday life. At its heart, an aromatic lavender note unfolds. This floral centre creates a pleasant balance, making it ideal for everyday use, whether at the office or in your free time. The fragrance concludes with a creamy woody note. This warm base note lingers on the skin and rounds off the profile. The striking glass bottle with its distinctive studs reflects the brand’s identity. Thanks to the fine spray, the eau de toilette can be applied precisely and reveals its multi-layered facets evenly. The combination of fruity and woody elements offers a versatile fragrance signature for a variety of occasions. Fragrance family: Woody, fruity and gourmand Top note with a crisp raspberry accord Heart note of aromatic lavender Warm base with creamy woody nuances Precision spray head for even application

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Valentina Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Valentino Valentina Eau de Parfum Spray is a composition that combines classic elegance with modern playfulness. Inspired by the Italian way of life and the atmosphere of Roman gardens on a summer morning, a multi-layered fragrance character unfolds. The opening is a special combination of the freshness of bergamot and the earthy note of truffle, accompanied by a hint of strawberry. At the heart of the composition is a bouquet of jasmine, orange blossom and tuberose, which gives the fragrance its floral depth. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a warm and sensual base of vanilla, cedarwood and amber. The result is a feminine fragrance that has a long-lasting yet understated presence and is suitable for a variety of occasions. Fragrance: Floral-fruity with warm notes Character: An elegant and sensual composition Fragrance notes: Bergamot, truffle, jasmine, vanilla and cedarwood Occasion: Suitable for day and evening wear

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Flame Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Versace Eros Flame Eau de Parfum Spray is a composition based on the masterful interplay of contrasts. The fragrance created by Olivier Pescheux combines cold and warmth, light and shadow to create an aromatic, woody experience. It opens with a spirited wave of sparkling Italian citrus fruits such as chinotto, mandarin and lime, which meet the intense character of black pepper and wild rosemary. Chords of pepperwood and geranium unfold in the heart before the fragrance fades into a warm and sensual base. Here, precious woods such as Texan cedarwood and sandalwood combine with the gentle sweetness of tonka bean and vanilla to create a long-lasting and memorable finish. As a reinterpretation of the well-known Eros, this variant offers a fresher, woodier facet. The fragrance is presented in a bright red bottle with golden accents, which visually emphasises the passionate energy of the composition. listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Najim Perfume 50 ml
listings.description: Versace Eros Nauim Parfum presents itself as an intense fragrance composition in the form of a pure perfume. Thanks to the high concentration of fragrance oils, the fragrance is characterised by its remarkable longevity. The luxurious character of the creation is also reflected in the bottle: in a shiny gold tone, a Greek key pattern in relief adorns the rectangular shape. The iconic Medusa logo in the centre completes the striking design and makes the bottle a visual highlight. Inspired by the colour and fragrance spectrum of the desert before dawn, a lively and bright composition unfolds. It opens with fresh notes of Italian mandarin and light yellow mandarin, which are given a subtle sweetness by a hint of caramel. At the heart of the creation, spicy cardamom and precious agarwood (oud) combine to create a multi-faceted heart note. The base of earthy patchouli, vetiver and incense lends the fragrance a warm depth and rounds off the olfactory experience. This radiant radiance makes the perfume a pleasant companion.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Dylan Blush Pink Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Versace Dylan Blush Pink Eau de Parfum Spray offers you a citrus-floral fragrance composition that can be effortlessly integrated into your everyday life. The pale pink bottle with silver-coloured details and the iconic Medusa head design creates an elegant visual accent. The top note of lemon, pomegranate and bergamot opens the fragrance experience and can give you a refreshing feeling in the morning. Jasmine, lemon blossom and peony then unfold their floral facets as heart notes, which discreetly emphasise your personal charisma on special occasions or in the office. The warm base notes of wood, musk, sandalwood and ambroxan round off the profile and ensure that the aromas linger on your skin for a long time so that you don't have to keep spraying. As the vegan formulation is completely free from silicones, parabens, paraffins and sulphates, the perfume fits perfectly into a conscious beauty routine. The fine spray mist also allows you to apply the product precisely and evenly, making it very economical. listings.rawTitle: Versace Crystal Noir Perfume 90 ml
listings.description: Crystal Noir from Versace has a mysterious appearance. The dark, shimmering, large cap of the bottle looks like an artistically cut gemstone. What might the fragrance be like that matches this precious appearance? Antoine Lie is responsible for this enchanting fragrance creation. It is designed for modern, self-confident women who appreciate attention and like to dress stylishly and elegantly. Crystal Noir: a luxury perfume from Versace Crystal Noir surprises with an unusual character. Spicy, floral and oriental notes blend to create a multi-layered fragrance experience. It is light and fresh - perfect for warm summer days. The creation is clean and creamy, with light fruity accents. Despite this lightness, the Versace women's perfume feels rich and deep. It is an ideal fragrance composition for all women who love expressive, sensual fragrances but do not want to wear a heavy perfume. The top note of the fragrance composition is stimulating and spicy. The typical, refreshing notes of ginger root blend with aromatic cardamom and pepper. A summery bouquet blooms in the heart note. It consists of peony, gardenia and fragrant orange blossom. A hint of coconut adds a tropical accent. The women's perfume ends on a warm, soft and sensual note: Musk meets sandalwood and amber.

listings.description: Cartier Baiser Volé is a perfume that places the white lily in all its facets at the centre of its composition. The result is a floral, powdery and elegant women's fragrance that captivates with its straightforward yet present nature and is suitable for a wide variety of occasions. listings.rawTitle: Moschino Cheap & Chic Eau de Toilette Spray So Real 30 ml
listings.description: Anything but cheap: Cheap & Chic by Moschino is an eau de toilette spray that will amaze you with its floral cheerfulness . Irresistible accords that come across as light-hearted and with lots of sex appeal inspire and make you want this fragrance. Every day anew. Cheap & Chic by Moschino in an extravagant, artistically daring black and red bottle is a feast for the eyes in any bathroom thanks to its design alone. And then there's the fragrance: the top notes of lime, peach and mandarin exude pure summer freshness. This eau de toilette spray starts so stringently cheerful that it is difficult to remain serious . Rose, freesia, water lily and alpine violet pulsate in the heart, creating a girlish, romantic atmosphere with powdery notes that create an incredibly youthful aura. In the base, cedar, soft vanilla, coriander and musk provide a calm, tart counterbalance. This is why Cheap & Chic by Moschino is never too light, never too sweet and will also win over those fragrance fans who appreciate balanced scents. Who is this eau de toilette spray suitable for? For anyone who wants to feel young, free and exhilarated. Cheap & Chic by Moschino breaks down boundaries with its cheerfulness, the fragrances create space for new impressions and experiences and come with a message: whatever makes you happy is allowed. Discipline, yes, but with time-outs that are really fun. Fragrances like this convey the true savoir vivre!

listings.rawTitle: Moschino Gold Fresh Couture Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Gold Fresh Couture by Moschino is a true ode to femininity. It is attractive and at the same time provides a wonderfully pleasant feeling. The new, sparkling haute couture women's fragrance lends fascinating sensuality and bright elegance. A surprisingly ingenious golden bottle, paradoxically designed like a cleaning bottle, surrounds the precious Eau de Parfum Spray. With an ironic wink, Moschino has transformed an everyday cleaning container into a shimmering golden, luxurious bottle. The result is a mixture of high-end and everyday world, resulting in a luxurious object of desire that surrounds the seductive women's fragrance Gold Fresh Couture. The Eau de Parfum Spray Gold Fresh Couture by Moschino conveys a fruity, floral and woody fragrance The Eau de Parfum Spray by Moschino conveys seductive and intoxicating sensations. In the lively top note, Mandarine Dorée Orpur harmonises with a sorbet of pear and rhubarb granita. The hint of a juicy and exquisite white vine peach gently caresses the floral swirl of the heart note. This presents itself with a white, enchanting lace around mahonia and a seductive scent of jasmine and golden chain orchid. With accents of sandalwood, vanilla and musk akigala, Gold Fresh Couture achieves a perfect finale.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Signature Eau de Parfum Spray Elixir 50 ml
listings.description: A colour gradient from intense red to delicate pink characterises the geometrically shaped, faceted bottle of this eau de parfum, which is enhanced by a black cap with golden details. The Montblanc Signature Elixir Eau de Parfum Spray reveals a complex fragrance architecture that interweaves floral and woody nuances. It opens with a striking note of red orchid, which is given an invigorating facet by the freshness of bergamot and grapefruit. As the fragrance progresses, the heart of the creation unfolds, focusing on a modern interpretation of vanilla, accompanied by the soft accords of tonka bean. This creamy sweetness is grounded by a structured base note in which amberwood and sandalwood blend with deep resins and a hint of leather. The interplay of these components creates a warm, long-lasting character that lingers gently on the skin. The composition is an intensified evolution of the classic signature and particularly emphasises the sensual aspects of the woods and spices it contains. Fragrance character: Warm, floral and woody with an intense vanilla note. Top notes: red orchid, bergamot, grapefruit. Heart note: vanilla, tonka bean. Base note: amberwood, sandalwood, resins, leather, vanilla absolute. Flacon: Faceted glass with colour gradient from red to pink and golden accents.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Legend Red Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Montblanc Eau de Parfum Spray Legend Red for men will be released in spring 2022. The fragrance in the bright red bottle is fresh and citrusy and was developed by Anne Flipo and Nicolas Beaulieu. They add cardamom, grapefruit and blood orange to the top notes. Cedar, clary sage and juniper then appear. The creation is rounded off with mahogany wood, satin cedar and tonka beans. Montblanc Legend Red is an elegant, masculine fragrance with a fine sillage. With its casual and laid-back appearance, the eau de parfum spray is just right for men who prefer discreet fragrances. Stylish elegance for stylish men Of course, there are times when a strong sillage is required. As a rule, however, this is not the case. The well-groomed man of today does not want to bring tears to his eyes, but would rather score points with decent masculinity . The Montblanc Legend Red Eau de Parfum Spray fulfils this wish. The fragrance emphasises the self-confident personality of its wearer without imposing itself. And fans of the label will be delighted that the elegant red bottle contains a modern fragrance with a clear Montblanc DNA. If you haven't had the chance yet, seize the opportunity and grab it now.

A heart note of delicate apple blossom then gently unfolds, lending the arrangement a floral, unobtrusive lightness. A solid bed of warm woods provides the necessary depth and long-lasting presence. listings.rawTitle: Tiffany & Co. Tiffany Eau de Parfum Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Tiffany's new signature fragrance has captured the expression of luxury, glamour and the romance of New York. Tiffany Eau de Parfum is a radiant modern fragrance that opens with vibrant top notes of Vert de Mandarine. In the heart note, the precious iris flower is the main ingredient. This lends strength and femininity and grounds the composition with sophistication and elegance. Patchouli base notes in a shell of calming musk scents Patchouli base notes in a shell of soothing musk scents create a sensual feeling on the skin. Master perfumer Daniela Andrier has drawn inspiration from her passion for gemstones and jewellery to create a modern version of the most precious ingredients of traditional haute perfumery. The sparkling floral musk fragrance is a modern take on the most precious ingredients. Tiffany's connection to iris dates back to the earliest sketches in the Tiffany archive and is closely linked to the essence of the house. The glass bottle is reminiscent of the cut of the iconic Tiffany Lucida® and yellow Tiffany diamonds. Inside, the fine liquid with its gossamer blue tint allows the precise cut of the bottle to shine. The fragrance is presented in the unmistakable Tiffany Blue Box® - an internationally recognised symbol of style and elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Tiffany & Co. Tiffany & Love For Him Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The eau de toilette spray Tiffany & Love For Him is, of course, from Tiffany & Co. The fragrance is floral-fougère-like and delights with its enormous longevity and fine sillage. Tiffany & Co. created this fragrance with the aim of creating an all-rounder for everyday wear. Gentlemen expecting an olfactory bomb may therefore be disappointed. However, Tiffany & Love For Him is suitable for spring, summer, autumn, work and leisure. This fragrance can also be worn very well for an elegant dinner. Because it is discreet, but at the same time masculine and elegant to wear. It doesn't always have to be overpowering Tiffany & Love For Him opens with top notes of cardamom, mandarin and ginger. The fragrance continues with heart notes of cypress, rose geranium, lavender and juniper. The eau de toilette spray from Tiffany & Co. is rounded off with vetiver, sandalwood and blue sequoia. Thanks to this subtle and restrained composition, the eau de toilette spray is truly a beautiful all-rounder that presents itself as a long-lasting companion. If you like subtle masculine fragrances, you should definitely give this men's fragrance a try.

listings.rawTitle: Tiffany & Co. Rose Gold Eau de Parfum Spray Intense 30 ml
listings.description: Tiffany & Co Rose Gold is an Eau de Parfum Spray Intense that reveals a glamorous fragrance journey . Wrap yourself in the feminine perfume, which is seen as a tribute to the famous brand that became known for its expert handling of precious metals and its elegant jewellery. A few accords for a stunning potpourri Would you have thought that it only takes a few elements to create a breathtaking effect? That's the case with Rose Gold Eau de Parfum Spray Intense. The top note emphasises the spicy pepper, surrounded only slightly by a hint of citrus. The heart note is dominated by sweet orange blossom, gently garnished with a touch of jasmine and rose oil, which adds an oriental and romantic touch. And the base note is all about patchouli, which comes across as warm and sensual and is only marginally accompanied by warm woods. The long-lasting perfume is looking forward to accompanying you in your everyday life and giving every moment something special . Or wear the fragrance by Tiffany & Co. on occasions that already have something magical about them - and deliberately crown them with the Rose Gold Eau de Parfum Spray Intense.

Acqua Alpes 2221 Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Seefeld near Innsbruck was the inspiration for this refreshingly light unisex fragrance . The small municipality is located in the Tyrolean Alps between the Wetterstein and Karwendel mountains. The perfumers at Acqua Alpes have captured the charming atmosphere of the region for Eau de Parfum Spray 2221. Aquatic and floral notes characterise this exquisite and stimulating fragrance creation. The 2221 Eau de Parfum Spray: inspired by the Alps Acqua Alpes: the name says it all. Clear mountain water is an essential component of the young company's creations. Thanks to its composition, this water is ideal for perfume production. It allows the subtle nuances of all the ingredients to come to the fore. As a result, each eau de parfum spray is multi-faceted and elegant. The fragrance of 2221 transports you to the revitalising and diverse world of the Alps. Water, mountains, clear air and a unique flora characterise Seefeld and its surroundings. The creation presents itself with a fruity, spicy blend when applied to the skin: Juicy oranges and sweet peach mingle with coriander to create a seductive top note. The heart note resembles a bouquet of elegant white flowers. Jasmine, tuberose and gardenia combine to create an extraordinary fragrance experience. A pleasant final accord of vetiver, sandalwood and white musk gives the fragrance warmth and depth.

Engelsrufer Aurora Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Engelsrufer Eau de Parfum Spray Aurora immerses you in the scent of dawn . In Greek mythology, the legendary Aurora appears alongside the sun goddess and the moon goddess. The eau de parfum spray therefore fits perfectly into the esoteric tradition of the now classic jewellery that promises the wearer good luck and protection from disaster. Instead of the lucky jewellery, the eau de parfum spray now offers you a fragrant companion. Let yourself be whisked away into the mysterious world of Greek mythology in the morning and enjoy the exotic scent of dawn. Aurora is everything - but ordinary. Exotic fragrance experience in the spirit of Greek mythology The long-lasting eau de parfum from Engelsrufer is the ideal companion for everyday wear, but also for very special occasions. Simply apply a few drops to your favourite places using the practical spray dispenser and surprise those around you with the exotic and unusual scent of dawn.

listings.rawTitle: Engelsrufer Heaven Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Engelsrufer Heaven Eau de Parfum Spray presents itself as a chypre-floral composition and adds another radiant facet to the brand's portfolio. Fruity nuances of bergamot, pear and raspberry open the fragrance experience in the top note and ensure a noticeably fresh start. This is followed by a floral heart, which is characterised by accords of jasmine and peony, with subtle notes of forget-me-not also playing a role in the development. Elements such as amber, patchouli and musk provide a warm and slightly earthy finish in the profound base note. This specific olfactory structure gives the fragrance a character that is suitable for everyday use as well as for more elegant occasions. The careful composition of the ingredients is intended to convey a feeling of carefree lightness and freedom, which is closely linked to the inspiring concept of the "guardian angel". Visually, the glass flacon picks up on this freshness by displaying an elegant colour gradient from transparent to a soft green. A spherical cap with the filigree and decorative embellishments typical of the brand harmoniously rounds off the aesthetic design. Chypre-floral fragrance family with fruity accents Top notes of bergamot, pear and raspberry Floral heart with jasmine and peony Warm base notes of amber, patchouli and musk Flacon with green colour gradient and decorated ball cap

listings.rawTitle: Engelsrufer Adore You Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Engelsrufer Adore You Eau de Parfum Spray presents itself as a multi-layered fragrance composition that harmoniously combines floral and fruity notes. The composition unfolds with a top note that combines the freshness of rhubarb with the light sweetness of lychee and a hint of pink pepper. A floral heart of rose, lily of the valley and jasmine then develops, giving the fragrance a classic yet present depth. The base note rounds off the olfactory experience with the warm and soft accents of cedarwood, musk and amber. This combination creates a balanced character that can be worn both in everyday life and on special occasions. The fragrance is housed in an elegant, rose-coloured bottle, whose spherical design is enhanced by a filigree, gold-coloured ornament on the cap. A composition of fruity and floral notes. Top notes of rhubarb, lychee and pink pepper. Heart notes of rose, lily of the valley and jasmine. Base note with cedar wood, musk and amber. Elegant flacon design in rose and gold.

listings.rawTitle: Engelsrufer With Love Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The With Love fragrance composition from Engelsrufer is heavenly beautiful. 100 millilitres of joie de vivre and liveliness await the wearer of this special perfume. A top note of fresh peony and cheerful pink pepper greets you as the first essence of the eau de parfum spray. The fragrance is then joined by a floral heart note of playful lily of the valley and proud rose, as well as Arabian jasmine. Warm white musk and persistent amberwood await you in the base note. The perfume is thus a potpourri of fruity-fresh and deeply floral elements that lead into an exciting finish of woody notes. Enchantingly beautiful: even the bottle Engelsrufer is a company that is primarily known for its characteristic jewellery products with sound beads. Angels are at the forefront of the jewellery, but also of the special eau de parfum, which was added to the product range in 2017. Even the bottle is reminiscent of the dreamy and romantic worlds in which angels are at home. In a soft pink colour, the fragrance is presented in a girlish heart shape, decorated with ornate elements in a sparkling silver tone. Not only the elegant bottle, but also the stimulating blend of different aromas make the Eau de Parfum Spray With Love a loving gift.

listings.rawTitle: Engelsrufer Luna Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Secretive, mysterious and magical - this is Luna, the eau de parfum spray from Engelsrufer. The fragrance is concealed in a matching, mythical bottle. With a spritz of the perfume, you can unlock the secrets of the composition from 2016. These range from floral essences in the top note to fruity elements in the heart note and woody naturalness in the base note. Let yourself be enchanted! The Luna eau de parfum spray takes you on an uncertain journey through fragrances. It opens with rose, violet and jasmine, which form a floral combination and leave their girlish charm on the wearer's skin. The heart notes of white peach and blackcurrant then greet you, visually resembling the dark-coloured bottle. The base note consists of musk, amber and vanilla, leaving an intense fragrance on the skin. The Engelsrufer brand is actually known for its jewellery, which is themed around heavenly friends. The fragrance compositions are also reminiscent of the celestial beings. Luna is the counterpart to the Engelsrufer jewellery of the same name, which combines the four elements of air, water, fire and earth. In the fragrance, however, fruits, flowers and woods are skilfully interwoven into a pleasant potpourri.

listings.rawTitle: Annayake Dojou for Her Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: With a clear, hexagonal design, the transparent bottle of Annayake Dojou for Her attracts attention and reveals the delicate rosé-coloured contents. The olfactory journey begins with a dynamic top note that combines fiery pepper and aromatic juniper berries with the freshness of bergamot. This first impression is complemented by fruity blackcurrant and the exotic nuance of ylang-ylang. As it progresses, the heart note reveals a velvety texture, characterised by the floral accords of orange blossom and mimosa, which are gently underlined by cashmere wood. The composition is harmoniously rounded off in the base, where earthy vetiver meets creamy sandalwood. Warm vanilla and amber provide a long-lasting, powdery finish. The design is completed by a label with Japanese characters and a light gold, metallic cap, which emphasises the aesthetic combination of tradition and modernity. This floral-woody fragrance skilfully combines spicy accents with soft, warm elements. Fragrance direction: A floral-woody composition with a powdery finish. Top notes: A vibrant blend of pepper, bergamot, juniper berries, blackcurrant and ylang-ylang. Heart and base notes: Floral accents of orange blossom and mimosa meet a warm base of vetiver, vanilla, sandalwood and amber. listings.rawTitle: Annayake Kagari for Her Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Annayake Kagari for Her Eau de Parfum Spray is an elegant fragrance composition that was created in France in 2023 and captivates with its multi-layered aromas. The fragrance opens with a fruity, warm and spicy top note that combines the sweetness of juicy pear with the slight spiciness of ginger and the freshness of mandarin. This invigorating opening leads into the floral, gourmand heart of the composition. Here, delicate notes of heliotrope, also known as vanilla blossom, meet the fine, lovely aromas of neroli and orange blossom. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a deep and warm base. A harmonious interplay of earthy patchouli, sweet praline, creamy tonka bean and a hint of vanilla gives the perfume its long-lasting character and leaves behind a seductive, woody aura. A floral-gourmand fragrance with woody accents. Fruity, spicy top notes of pear, ginger and mandarin orange. Floral heart with heliotrope, neroli and orange blossom. Warm, sweet base note of patchouli, praline, tonka bean and vanilla. Elegant and long-lasting fragrance composition.

listings.rawTitle: Annayake KOGAÏ for Man Eau De Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: A dynamic freshness meets deep, woody accords in this eau de toilette. listings.rawTitle: Eisenberg L'Art du Parfum Émulsion Parfumée Corps J'OSE 150 ml
listings.description: The J'ose Émulsion Parfumée Corps is a fragrant body emulsion from the EISENBERG L'Art du Parfum line that envelops the body in an unmistakable veil of fragrance. As a tribute to courage and boldness, the fragrance was created by José Eisenberg himself, whose name is echoed in the title "J'ose" (I dare). The composition is rich and elegant, characterised by an exciting contrast. Initially, fresh notes of bergamot, lemon and mint unfold, creating an invigorating aura. These are followed by a sensual heart note of lavender and rounded off by a warm base of vanilla, sandalwood and musk. The creamy emulsion can be gently spread and massaged into the skin after showering or bathing. It leaves a pleasant feeling and subtly perfumes the body with the characteristic J'ose fragrance. Scented body emulsion with the provocative J'ose fragrance. Creamy texture for a pleasant application after showering or bathing. listings.rawTitle: Eisenberg Les Secrets Eau de Parfum Spray SECRET N°VII ÉCHO LUMINEUX 50 ml
listings.description: The Secret VII Ècho Lumineux Eau de Parfum Spray from Eisenberg is characterised by a harmonious combination of floral and chypre nuances. As part of the Les Secrets collection, this creation stands for a multi-layered fragrance experience that begins with a fruity freshness. The top notes of sparkling bergamot and the tart note of blackcurrant come together to create an invigorating opening. A lush bouquet then unfolds at the heart of the composition, where accords of jasmine, osmanthus flower and rose form the floral centre. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a warm and persistent base in which creamy sandalwood, earthy patchouli, moss and musk provide a gentle finish. The interplay of fresh citrus notes and the deeper woody elements creates an interesting balance. Visually, the rectangular bottle with its rounded shoulders reflects the value of the contents. The light yellow liquid shimmers through the glass, while a silver-coloured cap with a hexagonal pattern completes the design. The practical spray format allows the eau de parfum to be precisely dispensed and is suitable for both everyday wear and special moments. Fragrance family: Chypre and floral with fresh and woody accents Head notes: bergamot and blackcurrant Heart notes: jasmine, osmanthus flower and rose Base notes: sandalwood, patchouli, moss and musk Design: Rectangular glass bottle with silver-coloured cap

listings.rawTitle: Eisenberg Les Secrets Eau de Parfum Spray SECRET N°I PALISSANDRE NOIR 50 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Secret I Palissandre Noir by Eisenberg is characterised by a fascinating interplay of intense woods and warm spices. As part of the Les Orientaux Latins line, this creation reveals a multi-layered fragrance pyramid that combines power and elegance. It opens with an invigorating blend of bergamot and mandarin, complemented by the distinctive spice of pepper and saffron and a subtle hint of wormwood. The heart of the fragrance is dominated by the eponymous rosewood, which is accompanied by cedarwood and earthy patchouli and gives the perfume its characteristic core. These powerful woody notes merge gently into a long-lasting base. There, ladan resin and musk provide a resinous depth, while sandalwood and vanilla contribute a soft, rounding warmth. The design of the bottle picks up on the theme of mystery visually, with a silver key on a black ribbon adorning the neck of the bottle and creating an elegant contrast to the gold-coloured liquid. Fragrance: A woody-spicy composition with warm accents. Head note: Fresh bergamot and mandarin meet saffron, pepper and wormwood. Heart note: The character is characterised by rosewood, cedar wood and patchouli. Base note: A soft finish with sandalwood, vanilla, musk and ladan resin. Design: High-quality glass bottle with decorative key ring.

listings.rawTitle: Eisenberg Les Secrets Eau de Parfum Spray SECRET N°VI CUIR D'ORIENT 30 ml

Visually, the creation is presented in a clear, rectangular glass bottle that reveals the amber-coloured liquid and is enhanced by a silver lid and a decorative key on the neck of the bottle. Made in France, this fragrance stands for precision craftsmanship and a careful selection of ingredients. Fragrance: Spicy and leathery with fruity and floral facets. Base note: Warm finish with rosewood, sandalwood, amber, praline and musk. Design: High-quality glass bottle with silver cap and characteristic key ring.

Molinard Habanita Eau de Parfum Spray 75 ml
listings.description: Molinard's fragrance has a long tradition. Founded in 1747, the company is one of the oldest French perfume manufacturers. Since 1900, Molinard's headquarters have been located in a perfume house in Provence, specially designed by Gustave Eiffel. One of Molinard's best-known fragrances is Habanita. It was first launched on the market in 1921. In 1988, the Habanita fragrance formula was changed slightly. Another reinterpretation of the original has been available as an eau de parfum spray since 2012. The fragrance is now more concentrated and comes in a newly designed bottle. This is a modification of the original bottle, which came from the workshop of the renowned French glass artist Rene Lalique. Like its classic model, the current bottle of the fragrance is black in colour and is decorated with an elegant motif from the 1920s. Habanita, the eau de parfum with around 600 different ingredients , also contains the same ingredients as the original in its new edition. Only the mixing ratio has changed slightly. The mysterious and addictive fragrance is available as an eau de parfum spray in either a 30 ml flacon or a 75 ml flacon. The top notes are dominated by petitgrain, ylang-ylang, orange blossom, raspberry, peach, bergamot, mastic resin and rose geranium. Jasmine, lilac, orris root, mimosa, nutmeg, Provence rose, Taif rose, vetiver, heliotrope and cedar emerge in the heart note. In the base note, leather, musk, amber, patchouli, sandalwood, oakmoss, Madagascar vanilla and benzoin resin give the eau de parfum spray its unmistakable note.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Les Éléments Eau de Parfum Spray Violette 75 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Violette was launched in 2015 as part of Molinard's Les Éléments range. With this series, Molinard aims to celebrate the most famous flavours in the fragrance world. In keeping with the colour of the bottle, Les Éléments Eau de Parfum Spray Violette is dedicated to violets and is almost a solitary fragrance. This is because both the top note and the heart note of the perfume are exclusively violets. In the base, the violet is complemented by violet leaves, fresh iris and white musk. Despite this, the fragrance of Violette Eau de Parfum Spray is floral and sweet , rather than green and tart, as you might expect. Often seen, often underestimated Everyone knows violets, those inconspicuous little purple flowers with velvety green leaves. Molinard has succeeded in giving violets a whole new presence. In the Les Éléments range, violets finally get the place they deserve with the Eau de Parfum Spray Violette. The fragrance is fresh and friendly, delicately present but not overpowering. It is a feminine and very elegant perfume that proves that violets can also be sweet and are often underestimated. Molinard finally brings the violet out of the shadows and into the sunshine.

The result is a balanced fragrance experience that radiates lightness. Bottled in an elegant, purple bottle, the design reflects the value of the contents. A floral-fruity fragrance from the "Les Éléments" collection. Combines notes of osmanthus, jasmine and apricot. The top note consists of bergamot, mandarin and pink pepper. Rounded off with a base of iris and white musk. Created by the traditional perfume house Molinard from Grasse.

In the top notes, fruity accents of pear and berries combine with delicate petals to create a refreshing yet subtle presence. The fragrance unfolds further in the heart note with the majestic iris and graceful rose, which provide a floral depth and give the perfume its characteristic note. The base of the perfume is characterised by warm and woody aromas. Cashmere wood, musk and cedar form a gentle yet powerful foundation that lends the fragrance a long-lasting and inviting warmth. This combination of floral and woody notes makes Molinard Les Éléments Iris a multi-faceted fragrance that is both classic and modern. The perfume is a tribute to the traditional art of perfumery that captivates with its aesthetic sophistication and versatility. This eau de parfum by Molinard is an exquisite choice for anyone looking for a fragrance that offers depth and lightness in equal measure. The carefully selected ingredients and masterful composition make it a special companion for any occasion.</p

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Les Éléments Eau de Parfum Spray Vanille Patchouli 75 ml
listings.description: With Molinard Les Éléments Eau de Parfum Spray Vanilla Patchouli, the name says it all. The sweet and gourmand fragrance perfectly emphasises the elements of vanilla and patchouli. The perfume also impresses with light oriental and spicy influences without neglecting the main theme. Les Éléments Eau de Parfum Spray Vanilla Patchouli by Molinard is a romantic, loving and feminine fragrance that celebrates femininity and reflects a lust for life - a composition that reflects style, self-confidence and romance . Seductive elegance meets luxurious joie de vivre The top notes are sandalwood and patchouli. Vanilla and benzoin follow in the heart note. White musk and vanilla enhance the pleasant fragrance effect in the base note and emphasise that this is a concentrated and equally sophisticated fragrance concept . The simple glass bottle in intense violet is elegant and minimalist . Molinard Les Éléments Eau de Parfum Spray Vanilla Patchouli can be worn all year round, but is particularly effective in the cooler seasons thanks to its depth and warmth. The perfume puts its wearer in the deserved limelight in the evening and at special events. Women who wrap themselves in this fragrance attract a lot of attention and admiring glances .

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Les Éléments Eau de Parfum Spray Figue 75 ml
listings.description: As part of the "Les Éléments" collection, Molinard presents Figue Eau de Parfum Spray, a composition reminiscent of a sunny Mediterranean garden. The fragrance opens with a sparkling top note of the eponymous fig, lemon and cassis. At the heart of the creation, the green aspects of fig leaves unfold, accompanied by soft floral notes and jasmine sambac. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a warm base of cedar, musk and amberwood, which lends the perfume a gentle depth. Launched in 2020, this composition captures the different facets of the fig, from its fruity sweetness to the fresh note of its leaves, and combines them into a harmonious fragrance. A fresh yet warm fragrance with fig at the centre Composition of fruity, green and woody notes Eau de Parfum Spray from the "Les Éléments" collection Combines lemon and cassis top notes with a base of cedar and musk

listings.rawTitle: Molinard La Collection Personnelle Eau de Parfum Spray Vents et Marées 75 ml
listings.description: Molinard Vents et Marées Eau de Parfum Spray from La Collection Personnelle is a fresh and fruity unisex fragrance with floral and subtle woody influences . The perfumer had a special image in mind for this fragrance. He saw the sea with its tides in a light breeze. The waves washed foam onto the beach and the blossoms of white flowers scattered across the surface of the water. A very calm, romantic and emotional image that reflects freshness as well as lightness and light-heartedness . The Vents et Marées Eau de Parfum Spray from Molinard's La Collection Personnelle is therefore an invitation to relax, dream and savour the beautiful moments in life. An intoxicating fragrance that gives wings to your thoughts Clementine, grapefruit and blackcurrant exude their appetising aromas in the top note. The heart is characterised by floral notes of freesia and rose. In the base, musk, sandalwood and tonka bean round off this extraordinary fragrance in a sophisticated way. Molinard Vents et Marées Eau de Parfum Spray from La Collection Personnelle can be worn all year round, but is particularly effective in the warmer months . The fragrance envelops its wearer in an irresistible aura whether at work, at leisure or on a first date.
