listings.rawTitle: Molinard Les Fraîcheurs Eau de Parfum Spray Citrus Noir 75 ml
listings.description: Citrusy and fresh , slightly floral and woody is how the Citrus Noir eau de parfum spray from Molinard presents itself. Launched in 2019, the fragrance from the Les Fraîcheurs range is just right for summer. The unisex fragrance, whose name translates as "nocturnal lemon", is not only convincing during the day when everyone wants to keep a cool head. The Eau de Parfum Spray Citrus Noir is also a great fragrance in the evening and for going out, which is just as popular in the club as it is at a party at the beach club. Its presence is refreshing, perceptible but not overpowering. This is exactly how a Molinard Les Fraîcheurs fragrance should be. Summer doesn't just have hot days The top note of Citrus Noir Eau de Parfum Spray begins with calamondin orange, elemi resin, bergamot and lemons. The heart note continues with sweet jasmine and fine cypress. Finally, Molinard blends vetiver, incense and, of course, amber into the fine fragrance. Les Fraîcheurs Eau de Parfum Spray Citrus Noir naturally also has a long-lasting presence and fine sillage. Molinard repeatedly creates fragrant jewels for the urban man, sometimes more, sometimes less expansive, but always elegant and wonderfully wearable.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Les Éléments Eau de Parfum Spray Vanille Fruitée 75 ml
listings.description: Do you love sophisticated fragrances full of femininity? Then the Vanille Fruitée Eau de Parfum Spray is just the right fragrance for you! It comes from the traditional company Molinard. It was founded in 1849 in Grasse, France, where the heart of perfume production beats. The family business focuses on high-quality ingredients and essences that have their origins in the south of France. From here, Molinard products have conquered the whole world thanks to their high quality. A fragrance full of sensuality and warmth Vanille Fruitée Eau de Parfum Spray exudes a flair of pure femininity that seems to envelop you warmly like a smooth silk scarf. The perfume from the Les Éléments range is perfect for women who feel feminine and seductive , yet full of freedom and spontaneity. In the top note, the fragrance welcomes you with the nuances of bergamot and clove, which are individual and lively. The heart notes of raspberry, heliotrope and orchid gradually unfold, adding a sweet hint of lush blossoms. The fragrance experience is carried by the base notes of vanilla, musk and benzoin, which create a deeply sensual, sweetly warm, balsamic combination. Les Éléments Vanille Fruitée Eau de Parfum Spray - for an adventure of fragrances!

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Les Fraîcheurs Eau de Parfum Spray Gingembre 75 ml
listings.description: As part of the renowned "La Fraîcheur" collection, the traditional house from Grasse presents a composition that elegantly places the vibrant aroma of ginger centre stage. Sparkling accords of bergamot and mandarin open the fragrance experience and combine with the green, clear freshness of verbena to create an extremely invigorating opening. The heart of the eau de parfum then unfolds with the eponymous ginger, whose characteristic, spicy note meets soft, floral jasmine and delicately spicy nutmeg. This sophisticated combination creates an exciting olfactory interplay between cool freshness and gentle spice. The fragrance finds a harmonious, rounded finish in a solid base of warm amber, deep woody accords and earthy vetiver. The classic, rectangular bottle also emphasises the value of the creation visually. A heavy, brown metal cap and copper-coloured lettering correspond stylishly with an artistic, purple-coloured drawing on the front. The striking seal with the inscription "Made in Grasse" and the reference to the year of foundation, 1849, subtly refer to the manufacturer's long history and expertise. Fragrance family: Citrusy-spicy eau de parfum Head notes: bergamot, mandarin and verbena Heart notes: ginger, jasmine and nutmeg Base notes: amber, woody accords and vetiver Part of the "La Fraîcheur" line from Molinard

listings.rawTitle: Molinard La Collection Privée Eau de Parfum Spray Ambré Lumière Eau de Parfum Spray 90 ml + Travel Spray 7,5 ml / 97,5 ml
listings.description: This eau de parfum from La Collection Privée is a shining example of historic craftsmanship from Grasse. Molinard Ambré Lumière captures the essence of warmth and light in a complex, gender-neutral composition. The top note awakens the senses with a lively blend of Russian coriander, Italian lemon and Chinese eucalyptus, gently accompanied by a fine almond nuance. This is followed by a floral heart in which rose and ylang-ylang combine with the deep, resinous resonance of ambergris. The base note anchors the fragrance for a long time with earthy vetiver from Haiti, Indonesian patchouli and soft musk, while benzoin and tolu balsam add a balsamic sweetness. Visually, the heavy glass flacon stands out with its striking vertical grooves, shimmering purple base and elegant, cylindrical copper-look cap. The label proudly refers to the company's tradition since 1849. This set offers both the generous 90 ml bottle and a handy 7.5 ml roll-on, which means the amber-coloured fragrance is always to hand when travelling. Extensive fragrance set: Contains a 90 ml eau de parfum bottle and a practical 7.5 ml roll-on for travelling Multi-layered fragrance pyramid: A combination of fresh citrus notes, floral heart and a warm base of musk and patchouli. Traditional design: high-quality glass bottle with vertical grooves, copper-coloured cap and purple base accent. Warm character: An ambery and spicy unisex fragrance that is part of the exclusive La Collection Privée.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Les Éléments Eau de Parfum Spray Vétiver 75 ml
listings.description: The family-run company Molinard introduced the Vétiver Eau de Parfum Spray in the 2021 Les Éléments collection. The fragrance is spicy-fruity and has woody notes. Housed in a large violet bottle, Les Éléments Vétiver Eau de Parfum Spray is designed for men and women. Its fine sillage caresses the senses and leaves you wanting more. Feminine and masculine flavours combine to create a casual, laid-back fragrance with a wonderfully natural effect. To achieve this, the unnamed perfumer created a top note of pink pepper, grapefruit and blood orange. Lavender and violet give the bottle its colour and are joined by amber in the heart note. For the base, moss and tobacco are used together with the eponymous vetiver from Haiti and Java. Stylish nonchalance for many occasions Most men and many women prefer to avoid sweet flavours , especially in summer. The fine Les Éléments Vétiver Eau de Parfum Spray from Molinard is perfect for this. The fragrance has no sweetness at all, apart from blood orange and grapefruit, neither of which stand for sweetness, but for a refreshing tartness. Molinard Vétiver Eau de Parfum Spray really appeals to all people who prefer expressive fragrances with that certain something on warm days and evenings.

listings.rawTitle: Molinard Les Fraîcheurs Eau de Parfum Spray Méditerranée 75 ml
listings.description: The "La Fraîcheur" collection from the traditional French house Molinard is dedicated to the olfactory atmosphere of the Mediterranean with this creation. Aquatic accords open the fragrance experience and, thanks to the use of calone, are reminiscent of a fresh sea breeze that gently hits the skin. As the fragrance progresses, a multi-layered heart unfolds, combining sunny, floral notes of tiare blossom with the green, spicy nuances of sage and classic rose. Ciste labdanum adds a slightly resinous facet that harmoniously introduces the transition to the base. The interplay of immortelle and white musk gives the composition a warm consistency. Sandalwood and cashmeran provide a woody, soft finish that lends depth to the character of the fragrance. Visually, the rectangular, transparent bottle reflects the clarity of the colourless liquid. A gold-coloured cap and orange lettering add elegant accents to the glass, while an illustration of purple coral artfully picks up on the maritime theme. This unisex fragrance conveys the feeling of sunshine and travelling in a light but present form. Fragrance character: Fresh, floral and aquatic with marine accents Head and heart notes: calone (sea breeze), tiare blossom, sage, rose and labdanum Base notes: immortelle, white musk, sandalwood and cashmeran Design: Transparent glass bottle with gold cap and purple coral illustration Collection: Part of the "La Fraîcheur" range from Molinard

Molinard, a créateur parfumeur since 1849, combines traditional craftsmanship with timeless fragrances. Elegant glass bottle with purple colour gradient and copper-coloured cap. Part of the exclusive La Collection Privée from the traditional house of Molinard.

listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley Rose Musk Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Rose Musk eau de parfum spray from Alyssa Ashley has been available since 2020. The floral-woody fragrance has been created for men and women and impresses with its casual elegance. In the top note, the fragrance plays with the aromas of rose and blackcurrant. Saffron and labdanum form the heart note. Musk and cedar wood round everything off in the base. Rose Musk Eau de Parfum Spray is a flanker of Musk, the classic fragrance created by Alyssa Ashley in 1968. Hardly any other fragrance has been available unchanged for so long and the numerous flankers emphasise its elegance and wearability. Splendidly aromatic and summery and sensual The fragrance of the Eau de Parfum Spray Rose Musk proves with ease that roses and musk are also suitable in summer and for men. Expressly designed as a unisex fragrance, even in a bottle with the symbols for him and her, Rose Musk Eau de Parfum Spray is as elegant as it is casual , as sensual as it is wearable and as masculine as it is feminine . Alyssa Ashley has simply mastered the art of musk-based unisex fragrances. Enjoy the understated luxury that this unisex fragrance expresses and experience for yourself just how beautiful the new Musk Flanker is.

listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley Cedro Musk Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The eau de parfum spray Cedro Musk by Alyssa Ashley was launched at almost the same time as Red Berry Musk. The fragrance is fresh and citrusy and is also a unisex perfume. As an extension of the popular Musk series, the eau de parfum is wonderfully wearable and scores with its lightness, which is not only suitable on warm days, but then especially well. The top note of Cedro Musk consists of fresh notes, oranges, lemons and cedar. They meet spicy laurel and tarragon as well as soft jasmine in the heart note. The base is characterised by musk, amber, patchouli, guaiac wood and cedar wood. This makes spring and summer even more fun The classic bottle of Alyssa Ashley Eau de Parfum Spray Cedro Musk is easily recognisable by its yellow label, which shines like the summer sun. It puts you in a good mood just like the fragrance itself. The composition has only a little sweetness , but wonderful woody and fruity, fresh and spicy aromas, which not only men like. As harmonious and elegant as the Cedro Musk Eau de Parfum Spray by Alyssa Ashley is, it has real signature potential for anyone who likes things light yet elegant. Try the fragrance for yourself.

listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley Ambre Rouge Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Alyssa Ashley Ambre Rouge Eau de Parfum Spray is a unisex composition that combines fruity vibrancy with a warm, deep base. The opening already surprises with a spicy pinch of pepper that meets the clear freshness of mandarin, creating a dynamic opening. At the heart, the blackberry unfolds as the central character of the fragrance. As natural extraction processes for red fruits are often limited, carefully balanced notes ensure an authentic aroma that introduces tart, citrusy and herbaceous-green facets. This fruity experience is complemented by floral accents of red rose and hibiscus, which lend the fragrance a soft complexity. The creation is rounded off sensually in the base note, where earthy patchouli meets the depth of amber and benzoin. This blend appeals to extroverted characters who value individuality. The rectangular glass bottle allows a clear view of the clear liquid and is enhanced by a gold-coloured lid. On the front, a red label with the golden inscription "AMBRE ROUGE" provides a colourful accent, while engraved, intertwined circles harmoniously complement the design. Fragrance: Fruity-floral unisex fragrance with a warm amber base. Top note: A fresh combination of mandarin and spicy pepper. Heart note: Dominant blackberry with green nuances, accompanied by rose and hibiscus. Base note: Deep accords of patchouli, benzoin and amber. Design: Rectangular glass bottle with gold details and red label.

listings.rawTitle: Linari Angelo di Fiume Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Angelo di Fiume by Linari is a multi-faceted unisex fragrance characterised by a harmonious balance of fruity, floral and warm notes. The composition opens with a lively top note of wild cherry, wild raspberry, Italian orange and bergamot. A bouquet of ylang-ylang, delicate rose petals and jasmine unfolds in the heart, which is given a special depth by a note of sweet caramel. The base rounds off the fragrance experience and combines Madagascar vanilla and Siamese benjoin with sandalwood, white musk and patchouli. Created by Rainer Diersche in 2008, the eau de parfum spray presents a multi-layered yet balanced fragrance signature. Multi-layered unisex fragrance Fruity-floral composition with sweet accents Warm base notes with vanilla, sandalwood and musk Available as an eau de parfum spray

listings.rawTitle: Linari Vista sul Mare Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Vista sul Mare Eau de Parfum Spray by Linari is a multi-layered composition that captivates with its distinctly fresh, aquatic character. This niche fragrance from 2008 opens with the sparkling and invigorating clarity of bergamot in the top note, which immediately creates a refreshing aura. A multi-faceted interplay unfolds at the heart of the creation, harmoniously combining floral and spicy elements. Here, the light spiciness of red pepper meets the aromatic depth of clove, while delicate hints of lily of the valley and wild rose create a floral softness. Carefully selected essences of cedarwood and earthy patchouli provide a warm and present base, rounded off by the gentle presence of white musk and amber. These give the fragrance a special structure and a long-lasting finish. The eau de parfum is presented in a simple and sophisticated bottle. A niche fragrance with a spicy-floral and fresh-aquatic orientation. The composition combines sparkling bergamot with a heart of pepper, clove and floral notes. A warm base of cedarwood, patchouli, musk and amber gives the fragrance depth and structure.

listings.rawTitle: Linari Notte Bianca Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the special atmosphere of a sleepless night, Notte Bianca presents itself as a multi-faceted unisex fragrance. The composition starts with an invigorating top note of pink grapefruit, bergamot and Italian orange, which provides a fresh opening. At the heart of the fragrance, a complex interplay of spicy and aromatic components such as star anise, clove and sage unfolds, complemented by subtle woody nuances. The eau de parfum is rounded off by a warm base of Haitian vetiver, tonka bean, white musk and amber, which gives the fragrance depth. Notte Bianca is a balanced and elegant creation that impresses with its subtle character and remains pleasantly close to the skin, making it a suitable companion for special occasions in the evening. The purist flacon emphasises the modern aspirations of the Linari brand. Spicy-fresh unisex fragrance Composition of fruity, spicy and woody notes Elegant and subtle fragrance character Ideal for evening occasions

listings.rawTitle: Linari Acqua Santa Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: With Acqua Santa, Linari offers a pure, rather innocent fragrance. The fragrance with bergamot and cassis, coriander and patchouli is almost like crystal-clear holy water. Rose petals, jasmine and ylang-ylang give the fragrance a light, floral bouquet, while tonka bean, sweet caramel and musk round off the seductive, sensual scent.

listings.rawTitle: Linari Mare Pacifico Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Mare Pacifico Eau de Parfum Spray by Linari is a composition that is reminiscent of the vastness of the ocean. The fragrance opens with a clear combination of lemon, cypress and mate, accompanied by birch leaves. Aquatic notes unfold in the heart, which are given a salty freshness by seaweed and calone. A hint of rose adds a gentle, floral facet. The base forms a foundation of sandalwood, patchouli and cephalis, which is rounded off by musk and gives the fragrance a pleasant depth. Created by perfumer Mark Buxton, the elegance of the fragrance notes is also reflected in the bottle. The clear glass with a wave-like design and the striking wengé wood cap emphasise the high-quality character of the creation. Aquatic-woody fragrance character Top notes of lemon, cypress and mate Heart note with maritime accords and rose Base of sandalwood, patchouli and musk Elegant flacon design with real wood clasp

listings.rawTitle: Linari Porta Del Cielo Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Porta Del Cielo is an eau de parfum spray from the Linari brand. The eau de parfum spray has a floral fragrance with an oriental character. Star perfumer Mark Buxton has channelled a great deal of craftsmanship and many years of experience into the creation of the fragrance. Pamper your senses Linari Porta Del Cielo is based on essences of pineapple, raspberry, bergamot, muguet and freesia. The heart note is characterised by floral components of violet, cashmere wood, sandalwood, lily of the valley and orange blossom. Vanilla, musk, tonka bean, ladan resin and benzoin resin create an unmistakable fragrance that is characterised by versatility and versatility. The unisex fragrance can be worn on any occasion: Whether for leisure or at work. The fragrant aromas revitalise the senses and give you freshness and energy throughout the day!

listings.rawTitle: Linari Eleganza Luminosa Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Eleganza Luminosa fragrance composition from Linari is a multi-faceted eau de parfum that impresses with its clear structure. Egon Oelkers was responsible for this creation and focussed on a harmonious interplay of freshness and floral depth. The opening is very invigorating thanks to a combination of sun-ripened orange, aromatic bergamot and tangy Amalfi lemon. These citrusy accents lead smoothly into the heart of the fragrance, which is dominated by a lush floral bouquet. This is where the delicate notes of freesia, rose, jasmine and lily of the valley unfold and lend the perfume a soft character. A solid base rounds off the olfactory experience and provides the necessary stability. Warm sandalwood and earthy patchouli come together, while musk and vanilla accords provide a gentle depth. The Eau de Parfum Spray is available in a 100 ml size and is suitable for lovers of complex, citrus-floral fragrances. The careful selection of ingredients emphasises the brand's high standards of quality and aesthetics. Citrus-floral fragrance family with a complex character Fresh top notes of orange, bergamot and Amalfi lemon Floral heart with rose, jasmine and lily of the valley Warm base notes of sandalwood, vanilla and patchouli Created by the renowned perfumer Egon Oelkers

Coriander, cardamom and selected woods combine with tonka bean to create the unforgettably intense "Tabac Man" fragrance.

listings.description: Established since 1959, Tabac Original presents itself as a fragrance composition with an unmistakable character. The eau de cologne unfolds in a harmonious sequence of sparkling and spicy notes. It opens with fresh accents of bergamot, lemon and neroli, which are given an invigorating depth by a hint of black pepper. This is followed by a heart of lavender, geranium and camomile, which lends the composition a gentle, floral complexity. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with warm, woody nuances of sandalwood, vetiver and oak. Musk and ambergris ensure a long-lasting and balanced finish. The bottle in a simple, white design with a striking brown cap emphasises the classic appeal of the fragrance. A classic fragrance with a spicy, fresh character Head notes of bergamot, lemon and black pepper Heart notes of lavender, geranium and camomile Base notes of sandalwood, vetiver and musk Presented in the iconic bottle design

listings.rawTitle: Tabac Tabac Original Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The aromatic men's fragrance by Tabac Original is guaranteed to deliver what the name promises: the eau de toilette spray exudes an incredibly spicy and very intense fragrance. Although the perfume does not necessarily smell like tobacco, it does achieve the distinctive spiciness of good tobacco by using bergamot and pepper as top notes, while this composition is complemented by other different woods and musk. The result is a particularly masculine and heavy eau de toilette spray. For men who want to try something new The spicy men's fragrance is ideal for men who want to try an intense yet harmonious fragrance as a perfume. Tabac Original gives its own men's fragrance an intense note of masculinity and delivers it in either a 30 ml, 50 ml or 100 ml bottle. The bottle itself is in a simple and uncomplicated white-brown colour and has accompanied the successful fragrance series in this form for decades.

All that remains is the fragrance of the perfume of the same name. An after shave spray with an exotic fragrance Tabac Original is a perfume and aftershave with an extremely spicy fragrance. It is infused with exotic essences that leave you wanting more. The skin is extremely irritated after shaving and requires a high level of care and protection. This protection is provided by Tabac After Shave. At the same time, you can benefit from an unusual men's fragrance that envelops its wearer like a protective aura. The men's fragrance has a long-lasting effect and can be applied in any situation.

An after shave balm with a revitalising effect Anyone who has ever used the After Shave Balm Tabac Original knows about its soothing effect. Thanks to its intense and long-lasting presence, the eau de parfum is particularly suitable for the autumn and winter season. listings.description: Marbert Woman Eau de Parfum Elixir enriches everyday life with a warm, floral and sensual fragrance. The simple, modern glass bottle with its silver cap offers a glimpse of the amber-coloured essence. From the very first spray, a top note of bergamot and ylang-ylang opens the fragrance experience and brings a pleasant freshness to the morning. The balanced blend makes the perfume a perfect companion for a wide variety of occasions, from a relaxed afternoon to an evening meal at a restaurant. listings.rawTitle: Marbert Homme Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: A composition that captivates with its fresh, woody character: Marbert Homme Eau de Toilette Spray is a classic fragrance that has been prized for its distinctive character since 1988. The olfactory journey begins with an invigorating top note, in which spicy accents blend with the freshness of bergamot, lime and maritime undertones. At the heart, a multi-layered bouquet of geranium, sandalwood and leather unfolds, given a pleasant depth by the earthy notes of oakmoss, vetiver and patchouli. The base of Virginia cedar harmoniously rounds off the fragrance experience. Thanks to its balanced concentration as an Eau de Toilette, the fragrance is suitable for everyday use and emphasises a well-groomed appearance. The simple glass bottle, with its clear, rectangular shape and dark cap, reflects the timeless elegance of the composition. Fragrance family: Woody-Chypre Top notes: Spices, galbanum, bergamot, lime, marine accords Middle notes: Geranium, sandalwood, leather, oakmoss, vetiver, patchouli Base note: Virginia cedar Fragrance concentration: Eau de Toilette

listings.rawTitle: Marbert Gentleman Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Where can you find a real gentleman these days? Here we have a real gem among men's fragrances. The classic Marbert Gentleman Eau de Toilette impresses with a charming composition of various citrus notes with woody-masculine accords. Ideal for the casually elegant gentleman of the world who knows how to be a gentleman from time to time.

listings.rawTitle: Marbert Man Pure Black Intense Eau de Toilette Spray 125 ml
listings.description: The slender, black bottle, with its gold-coloured cap and striking logo, already conveys the visual elegance of this fragrance. Marbert Man Pure Black Intense is a spicy, woody composition that combines powerful accords with a harmonious warmth. The opening reveals a complex interplay of green apple and cardamom, accompanied by violet and galbanum, creating a fresh yet spicy first impression. This is followed by a multifaceted heart note, in which sweet toffee and melon meet floral geranium and clear, aquatic notes. This blend lends the Eau de Toilette Spray a distinctive and multi-layered character. The base note provides a long-lasting finish, characterised by distinctive cedarwood, vetiver and musk. These earthy tones are complemented by soft vanilla and amber, creating a subtle sweetness that rounds off the fragrance experience. Developed by the traditional German brand Marbert, this perfume is particularly well suited for the evening or special occasions due to its intensity. Spicy-woody fragrance character with a slightly sweet note Top notes of cardamom, green apple and violet Heart notes of toffee, melon and aquatic accords Base notes of cedarwood, vanilla, amber and vetiver Black bottle with gold detailing

listings.description: Marbert Man Classic Steel Blue Eau de Toilette Spray is a composition that blends fresh and woody notes. The fragrance opens with a crisp, invigorating top note characterised by aquatic and citrus accents. As the fragrance develops, a heart note emerges in which spicy and floral elements blend harmoniously. These lend the fragrance a balanced depth. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with warm, woody and earthy nuances, ensuring a long-lasting and distinctive character. The Eau de Toilette is presented in a simple, transparent bottle with a bluish sheen and a black cap, which emphasises the classic design. It is an understated fragrance composition for everyday wear. An Eau de Toilette with a fresh, woody character. Combines aquatic notes with spicy and floral accents. Features a base of warm, earthy nuances. Presented in a classic, transparent bottle. Suitable as an understated fragrance for everyday wear.

listings.rawTitle: Marbert Miss Marbert Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: A harmonious blend of floral and fruity notes defines the character of Miss Marbert. listings.rawTitle: Marbert Man Classic Sport Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Dynamism and pure energy define the distinctive character of Marbert Man Classic Sport Eau de Toilette Spray. The design of the rectangular bottle alone signals the clear focus of the creation with its clean lines, black cap and a striking red ‘SPORT’ rectangle. The light blue liquid shimmers through the transparent glass, visually reflecting the freshness of the composition and emphasising the theme of sportiness. The olfactory journey begins with an extremely invigorating top note, in which zesty bergamot and ripe mandarin meet the delicate spice of cardamom and artemisia. As the fragrance develops, a complex and multi-layered heart unfolds, skilfully combining aromatic herbs such as lavender and juniper with the light sweetness of honey and cinnamon. Floral accents of rose, jasmine and orange blossom add a subtle, intriguing depth to the composition. The rich base note ensures a long-lasting and warm finish, blending the noble woody tones of cedar and sandalwood with amber, musk and earthy patchouli. Tonka bean harmoniously rounds off the overall fragrance profile. This fragrance combines sporty lightness with timeless, classic elegance. Fragrance profile: Fresh and sporty with a combination of citrus and spicy notes. Top note: An invigorating opening of bergamot, mandarin, cardamom and artemisia. Middle note: A complex blend of juniper, lavender, honey, cinnamon and floral elements. Base note: A warm finish with cedarwood, sandalwood, amber, musk and patchouli. Design: Rectangular glass bottle with light blue liquid and striking red lettering.

listings.description: Experience the golden heyday of the Persian Empire - captured in an extraordinary fragrance. Inspired by the splendour of King Darius' palace in Persepolis, where gold, fine brocades and the heady scent of incense filled the air, this fragrance captures the essence of royal elegance. At the centre is Artastun - the young, exceptionally beautiful favourite wife of the king. Surrounded by flowers, wrapped in delicate organza and the finest linen, she cared for her hair with vanilla and patchouli. Her scent was unmistakable, her charisma divine - so much so that Darius had a statue made of pure gold erected in her honour. Centuries later, the recipe for her favourite fragrance was discovered on a preserved clay tablet - and reinterpreted by master perfumers. The result: a precious fragrance that begins with warm vanilla notes, develops into soft patchouli and is accompanied by delicate roses and powdery accents. An olfactory masterpiece - a tribute to the sensuality and beauty of the Orient, captured in an elegant golden bottle.</b

listings.rawTitle: Laura Biagiotti Roma Eau de Toilette Spray Fiori Bianchi 50 ml
listings.description: Roma Fiori Bianchi is perhaps Laura Biagiotti's most famous women's fragrance after Roma itself. The Italian metropolis has once again inspired an unforgettable perfume. Master perfumer Nathalie Lorson has created a classic with this Laura Biagiotti fragrance. Her eau de toilette spray is feminine, lively and elegant. The defining notes are subtly oriental, woody and floral . Roma Fiori Bianchi by Laura Biagiotti A walk through Rome: what is there to discover? The numerous sights are just one part of the city. The Mediterranean flora is another. The beguiling scent of Roman flowers, trees and shrubs characterise Roma Aeterna just as much as its history. The city can be experienced with all the senses. Tangy, fruity, tart and spicy: bergamot has an unmistakable character that clearly distinguishes it from other citrus fruits. It unfolds its fragrance in the top note of Roma Fiori Bianchi. It is complemented by the soft, sweet flavours of pear. The floral splendour of Roman gardens comes to the fore in the heart note: jasmine, gardenia and violet. Nathalie Lorson creates a slight contrast with the bittersweet flavour of almond. The base accord exudes warmth and sensuality. Australian sandalwood and tonka beans round off this exclusive eau de toilette spray.

listings.rawTitle: Laura Biagiotti AQVE ROMANE Eau de Toilette Spray Uva Dulcis 100 ml
listings.description: AQVE ROMANE Uva Dulcis, a perfume by Laura Biagiotti that celebrates the finer things in life, is concealed in a gorgeous pink bottle ! The Uva Dulcis Eau de Toilette Spray exudes pure happiness and good humour after just a few spritzes. But there is also a sensual component as the crowning glory. The fragrance is a tribute to Italian cities with their rich heritage, which is sometimes revealed in dreamlike landscapes and sometimes in historical sights. As diverse as the cities is AQVE ROMANE: experience a mix of elegance and lightness when you embark on a fragrance journey with Uva Dulcis Eau de Toilette Spray. The top note pampers you with pure fruit, composed of plum and pomegranate, almost as if from an Italian orchard. In the heart note, the sublime rose comes to the fore, making the perfume more sophisticated and creating a clearly feminine character. With the counterpart of pepper, however, it not only remains romantic, but becomes wonderfully spicy - just as the Dolce Vita can be. In the base, cedarwood, patchouli and oak interweave to create a naturally beautiful finish that leaves behind warmth and sensuality. Let yourself be seduced by the perfume from Laura Biagiotti!

listings.rawTitle: Laura Biagiotti Forever Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Forever by Laura Biagiotti is a tribute to women's love in all its facets. Deep friendships are just as much a part of a woman's deep emotions as her love for her partner or her children. And as versatile as a woman's love can be, so too is the lovely fragrance of this unique perfume. A breathtakingly feminine fragrance cocktail in a stylish, graceful bottle Forever Eau de Parfum Spray by Laura Biagiotti opens with fruity, fresh top notes of sun-ripened, juicy fruits and lemony notes. At the heart, this fragrance shines with sensual, seductive charm, emphasised by the aromas of rose, violet and lily. Tonka bean, musk and praline successfully round off the explosive fragrance creation in the base and give this Eau de Parfum Spray its warm, cosy character. Wear the eau de parfum spray for any occasion and enjoy the good feeling of unconditional affection. The Forever body lotion by Laura Biagiotti is also available in our online shop to match this fragrance.

Laura Biagiotti AQVE ROMANE Eau de Toilette Spray Divinum Ficus 100 ml
listings.description: Laura Biagiotti presents the Divinum Ficus Eau de Toilette Spray in the AQVE ROMANE Collection in 2024. Suzy Le Helly is the nose behind the green-fresh fragrance , which was composed like a perfume. The top note combines green pepper, corn mint, Italian bergamot and basil. The heart notes of artichoke, bay leaf, figs and capers are appetising. A frame of musk, sandalwood and cedarwood frames AQVE ROMANE Divinum Ficus Eau de Toilette Spray by Laura Biagiotti. For many people, Romana is a destination of longing. Rivers, mountains, lakes and forests, everything seems somehow enchanted . And the air there smells like a perfume. So it was only natural to pay homage to Romana in the AQVE ROMANE Collection. Lively, colourful and so beautiful Divinum Ficus Eau de Toilette Spray is one of three fragrances from the AQVE ROMANE Collection that have different scents and colours. Red, yellow and green, they are reminiscent of the gardens and rivers of Romana. With them, you can bring Romana into your home as a perfume - whenever you feel like it. It makes no difference whether you prefer the Laura Biagiotti Divinum Ficus Eau de Toilette Spray, one of the other two fragrances or whether you indulge yourself with all three.

listings.rawTitle: Laura Biagiotti Roma Eau de Toilette Spray Pink 25 ml

The heart note combines delicate floral accords of rosebuds and peonies with sensual neroli essence. Finally, the warm tones of sandalwood form an intoxicating combination with vanilla and musk. Unrivalled fragrances for sensual women who radiate joie de vivre With its irresistible composition, Roma Eau de Toilette Spray Rosa by Laura Biagiotti embodies pure joie de vivre and seductive femininity. The city of Rome with its many facets - from its classic, romantic past to its bright modernity - served as a source of inspiration. The bottle, designed in a delicate pink, also symbolises the versatile and promising city of Rome. Wear the enchanting fragrances from Laura Biagiotti on very special occasions and let yourself be enchanted by their unique composition!

Refined blend for a sophisticated look The top note starts promisingly with lavender, laurel and hazelnut. A blend that seems unusual at first glance, but is immediately memorable in a pleasant way! Karl Lagerfeld then relies on the tried and tested scents of cedar, oak and sandalwood, which first unfold in the heart and then in the base notes of the spray for men. Moss and vanilla are added in the base, giving the wearer of Classic Grey lasting expressiveness. Self-confidence and elegance are the qualities that Karl Lagerfeld's fragrance gives you. This gives the fragrance a warm, clean and slightly woody aura that makes it an unobtrusive companion for every day. listings.description: Lady Knize by Knize is a fragrance that not only has enormous longevity and sillage. Launched in 1938, the fragrance is still produced unchanged. This makes the floral and spicy women's perfume one of the longest-lasting fragrances ever. With the Eau de Parfum Mini Luxe shaker bottle, you not only have the option of always having this extraordinary perfume with you. You also have the opportunity to get to know the wonderful feminine fragrance. The special thing about the Eau de Parfum Mini Luxe pouring bottle is that, as a splash bottle, it has a narrower neck than other bottles so as not to release too much of the precious liquid at once. Luxury far from the mainstream Lady Knize has a top note of tuberose and jasmine. The heart note continues with cloves and coriander. The Knize perfume is rounded off with sandalwood, musk and amber. Rarely has a tuberose been staged as elegantly as in this perfume from the Knize label. The perfume is graceful, elegant, feminine , sensual and above all soft and strong at the same time - a true lady. If you are curious, treat yourself to the fragrance for your handbag with the Eau de Parfum Mini Luxe shaker bottle from Lady Knize.

listings.description: Bring a piece of joy directly into your home with the Happiness Eau de Parfum Spray from Betty Barclay. A fragrance that truly honours its name in an enchanting way - with every spritz, the joy and sense of well-being increases, as if you were dancing through a colourful field of blooming flowers. Happiness Eau de Parfum Spray is an exclusive creation from Betty Barclay , known for its timelessly elegant yet modern designs. This perfume captures the essence of happiness and contentment in an elegant bottle that will stand out in any perfume collection. Perfect perfume for everyday use It begins with a tangy top note of juicy fruit that immediately puts a smile on your face. A heart note of soft floral notes then unfolds, transporting you to a warm, sun-drenched garden. The base note of ambergris and musk gives the fragrance a sensual depth and persistence that lasts all day. The Happiness Eau de Parfum Spray by Betty Barclay is more than just a perfume - it is an expression of joie de vivre. This fragrance not only makes you feel fresh and confident, but also symbolises happiness and joy. It is perfect for everyday use, but also for special occasions when you want to share your joy with others.

listings.rawTitle: Betty Barclay Tender Blossom Eau de Parfum Spray 20 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Tender Blossom by Betty Barclay is a seductive fragrance like a freshly picked bouquet of flowers. And therefore ideal for young women who love floral fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Betty Barclay Pure Style Eau de Toilette Spray 20 ml
listings.description: The Betty Barclay pure style fragrance is the perfect accessory for a glamorous appearance. It discreetly emphasises the individuality of its wearer. Betty Barclay pure style is a transparent and purist fragrance that is nevertheless feminine and soft. With notes of bergamot, white freesia, white peach, white amber, cedarwood, white musk, magnolia, jasmine and lily of the valley.

listings.rawTitle: Betty Barclay Pure Flower Eau de Toilette Spray 20 ml
listings.description: In 2024, the Betty Barclay Pure Flower Eau de Toilette Spray is launched at the same time as the perfume of the same name. The eau de toilette spray is naturally for women and has a sweet floral presence. Perfumer Mirella Pomina is responsible for the eau de toilette and the perfume. She has created a top note of aldehydes, white lavender and reseda for Pure Flower. The heart note is initially floral and introduces roses and peonies, which are complemented by vetiver. Amber, vanilla and musk make up the base and give the Betty Barclay fragrance a soft, almost creamy finish. This further emphasises the femininity of its wearer. Romantic and yet mature Fresh and floral, delicate and soft, with a subtle presence, Betty Barclay Pure Flower Eau de Toilette Spray is simply perfect for warm and hot days in the city. You want to be well groomed, but you don't want to weigh yourself down with a perfume or impose yourself olfactorily on others. Even on the beach, if you want to wear a light fragrance, it's just right. And if you want something a little more, then simply reach for Pure Flower Parfum, whose composition is identical to the Eau de Toilette Spray.

listings.rawTitle: Betty Barclay Woman 3 Eau de Toilette Spray 20 ml
listings.description: Are you passionate about fashion and style? Then the bold scent of Betty Barclay WOMAN ? 3 is just right for you. Enjoy it: a modern floral and fresh notes for the passionate woman.

listings.description: In this composition, gentle, floral accords blend with fruity nuances to create a light and uplifting fragrance experience. This is followed by a floral heart, in which freesia and jasmine harmoniously blend with soft cashmere wood. This combination creates a seamless transition to the base note. listings.rawTitle: s.Oliver For Her Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: For Her by s.Oliver is an elegant, floral fragrance. It combines red pepper, lychee and bergamot. Rose, peony and magnolia lend the composition a feminine sensuality. Set against a powdery, balsamic base of iris, musk and amber, the feminine charm of For Her comes to a velvety conclusion. Unlike the Eau de Toilette, the Eau de Parfum offers a more intense fragrance that also lasts longer on the skin. The For Her body lotion by s.Oliver is a lovely complement to this.

listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley Cashmeran Vanilla Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Alyssa Ashley Cashmeran Vanilla Eau de Parfum Spray is a seductive, sensually stimulating fragrance for women with earthy-sweet and woody nuances. With its delicate arrangement of sweet and floral elements paired with a hint of spice, this fragrance envelops its wearer in a warm yet vibrant aura . Romantic and caressing, this is how the Cashmeran Vanilla Eau de Parfum Spray by Alyssa Ashley presents itself. A composition for women who move confidently through life and know how to enjoy extraordinary moments to the fullest . It also makes a pleasantly lasting impression for an evening flirt or an elegant candlelit dinner. An exquisite perfume for the pleasurable moments in life In the top note, bright notes of refreshing bergamot and night jasmine open the fragrance composition. White amber, iris and warm vanilla follow in the heart notes. In the base, the sounds of musk, cashmeran, patchouli and salted caramel take the lead in this extraordinary composition, rounding off the fragrance in a sophisticated way. The Alyssa Ashley Cashmeran Vanilla Eau de Parfum Spray is particularly suitable for the cooler seasons and can be worn at work, during leisure time and at exclusive evening events. The classically stylish glass bottle emphasises the elegance of the fragrance as well as that of its wearer.

listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley Ambre Marine Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: With Ambre Marine Eau de Parfum Spray, Alyssa Ashley presents a wonderfully fresh, elegant unisex fragrance. It presents itself as multi-layered and invites you to rediscover it again and again. Finely balanced fruity and floral fragrances give the perfume a light-hearted character. Marine notes are the central element of the composition. Ambre Marine Eau de Parfum Spray: in love with the sea A perfume like a long summer's day by the sea. Ambre Marine Eau de Parfum Spray captures and holds the many scents of the beach. Marine notes form the centrepiece of the creation. They evoke numerous associations: the salt of seawater on the skin, a gentle breeze wafting the scent of grasses, dry wood and seaweed. This subject is perfect for a modern unisex fragrance that is not specifically reserved for men or women. Alyssa Ashley's marvellous composition is suitable for all connoisseurs of exquisite fragrances. An invigorating accord opens the exciting fragrance composition. Zesty lemon and invigorating peppermint are complemented by a hint of delicate lotus blossom. The heart note is dedicated to white flowers: orange blossom, water lilies and white roses unfold a delicate floral character. The base is formed by light amber, narcissus and iris.

listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley White Patchouli Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Alyssa Ashley White Patchouli Eau de Parfum Spray is an exclusive unisex fragrance that envelops men and women alike in a fascinating aura. This extravagant fragrance pays homage to the intensely fragrant patchouli plant. The fragrance is aimed at men and women who enjoy life and are aware of their uniqueness. Sensual, seductive, but also self-confident and elegant - this is how the White Patchouli Eau de Parfum Spray by Alyssa Ashley presents itself. The exquisite perfume can be worn at any time of year, but comes into its own particularly well in the warmer months. A fragrance that focuses on the passionate aroma of patchouli In the top note, nuances of appetising orange blossom and yellow mandarin open the extraordinary fragrance experience. In the heart note, patchouli, sweet jasmine, iris and spices nestle into the elegant composition. The fragrance is rounded off in the base with the sounds of warm sandalwood, vetiver and Iso E Super. The White Patchouli Eau de Parfum Spray by Alyssa Ashley has an unmistakable and fascinating character that will linger in your memory. The solid glass bottle leaves no doubt that this is a unisex fragrance. The symbols of femininity and masculinity are stylishly incorporated into the glass.

listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley Tonka Musk Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The third fragrance in the new Musk Flanker range from Alyssa Ashley is the Tonka Musk eau de parfum spray. Like the other two, the woody and spicy fragrance is unisex. Alyssa Ashley is constantly coming up with new creations based on musk. Because its flavours are simply incredibly diverse. To give the Tonka Musk eau de parfum spray its elegance, the unisex fragrance has a top note of cinnamon. The heart note features tonka beans and black amber. Vanilla and musk round everything off in the base and create a soft, warm and, above all, not too sweet fragrance. Its radiance ensures that this Alyssa Ashley fragrance is simply perfect for the cooler days and evenings of the year. High-quality like a niche fragrance and wonderfully affordable Even though Tonka Musk Eau de Parfum Spray is not a niche fragrance, it is not mainstream. It is simply an enchanting unisex fragrance that will delight anyone who likes a sophisticated scent but doesn't want to miss out on that little something extra. The combination of cinnamon, musk and tonka beans in particular appeals to the senses. It radiates a sensuality that men also like. Let yourself be captivated by the trilogy of musk and convince yourself of the quality of the fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley Oud Patchouli Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Alyssa Ashley Oud Patchouli Eau de Parfum Spray is a floral-woody unisex fragrance with resinous and oriental influences . Extraordinary, seductive and sensual - this exclusive fragrance envelops its wearer in an incomparable aura. The Oud Patchouli Eau de Parfum Spray by Alyssa Ashley takes you into a fairytale world full of fascinating moments . It emphasises the extravagant and unique nature of the woman or man and thus becomes an olfactory experience of a special kind that transports you to the world of One Thousand and One Nights. An exclusive fragrance experience that stimulates the senses The top notes of aromatic rose and spicy pink pepper open this extraordinary fragrance experience. The heart note combines nuances of geranium with the spiciness of saffron, supported by the sweetness of labdanum. The fragrance is rounded off in the base note with deep, woody notes of oud, vetiver, guaiac wood, sandalwood and patchouli. This creates a sophisticated balance of the individual elements that make Alyssa Ashley Oud Patchouli Eau de Parfum Spray a unique fragrance with an extravagant twist . Due to its deep, intense accords, this perfume is particularly suitable for the cooler seasons. The solid glass bottle with its inlaid symbols of femininity and masculinity leaves no doubt that this is a sophisticated and focussed unisex fragrance.

Amber, patchouli and vetiver emerge as base notes, radiating a powerful energy. They fire the imagination and trigger erotic thoughts of breathtaking seduction and absolute passion in women.

listings.rawTitle: Michael Kors Absolu Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Michael Kors Absolu Pour Femme is a luminous fragrance that is characterised by its floral-fruity composition. It opens with a bright and inviting blend of juicy pear and fresh Italian mandarin for a sparkling opening. At the heart of this creation, Damask rose unfolds its full splendour and lends the eau de parfum an opulent, floral texture. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience in a soft and sensual way. Here, warm accords of Madagascar vanilla, aromatic tonka bean and gentle benzoin resin combine to create a long-lasting and profound finish. The Italian-made perfume is presented in a bottle that exudes luxury and modernity. Its upright, rectangular shape is made of glass with a shiny metallic surface that shimmers in a warm copper or rose gold colour. The outside is adorned with curved, irregular metallic applications that lend the design a dynamic and organic touch. The colour-coordinated, rectangular lid also bears the discreetly engraved brand name "MICHAEL KORS", completing the harmonious overall look of this eau de parfum spray.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Fresh Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau So Fresh is a floral-fruity composition that captures the carefree atmosphere of a sunny day. listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Inspired by Marc Jacobs' personal mantra 'I am perfect as I am', the Perfect Eau de Parfum Spray is a tribute to optimism, self-acceptance and one's own uniqueness. This floral fragrance, created by perfumer Domitille Michalon-Bertier, is an unconventional yet harmonious composition for anyone who celebrates their individuality. It begins with a sparkling opening in which the fruity notes of rhubarb meet the sunny character of narcissus, creating a lively first impression. At the heart of the composition, the soft and creamy texture of almond milk unfolds, giving the fragrance an unexpected softness and a modern facet. The base note of cashmeran rounds off the fragrance experience and leaves behind a delicate, pleasant veil. The interplay of these notes results in a multi-faceted fragrance that emphasises personal charisma without imposing itself. A floral fragrance composition that celebrates individuality . Lively top notes of rhubarb and narcissus. Creamy heart note with soft almond milk. Soft base note of cashmeran for a delicate finish.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Freshness and light-heartedness are at the heart of this fragrance, which has held a firm place in the world of perfumes since its launch in 2007. The eau de toilette opens with a lively top note, in which fruity accents of wild strawberries blend with the zesty aroma of ruby-red grapefruit. This opening is complemented by green violet leaves, which lend a natural and crisp nuance. At the heart of the fragrance, a lush, floral bouquet then unfolds. Here, velvety violet blossoms meet the brightness of jasmine and gardenia, lending the composition an elegant and feminine aura. The base note ensures a harmonious and soft finish, combining warm accords of vanilla and musk with white woods and sandalwood. Visually, too, the product stands out as a distinctive design piece. The clear glass bottle reveals the pale yellow liquid within and is topped with a cap adorned with iconic white plastic daisies. This fragrance belongs to the floral, woody musk family and embodies a timeless, fruity-floral experience. Fragrance family: Floral, woody musk fragrance with fruity accents. Top note: A combination of wild strawberries, ruby-red grapefruit and violet leaves. Heart note: A floral bouquet of violet blossoms, jasmine and gardenia. Base note: A warm finish with vanilla, musk and light woods. Design: Transparent bottle with a distinctive daisy-shaped cap.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Eau de Parfum Spray Absolute 30 ml
listings.description: A new intensity is revealed with the Marc Jacobs Perfect Absolute Eau de Parfum Spray. Launched in 2025, this composition reinterprets its well-known predecessor in a more concentrated way and belongs to the fragrance family of warm, amber-like notes. The olfactory opening is marked by a distinctive accord of caramelised fig, which conveys a pleasant sweetness. At the heart of the creation, pure jasmine absolue then unfolds, clearly emphasising the floral character of the blend. The overall fragrance experience is finally rounded off by a rich, deep amber accord in the base note. Thanks to its dense composition, the fragrance unfolds with long-lasting depth. Visually, too, the bottle reflects the depth of its contents. The glass is a deep ruby red and bears the golden lettering “PERFECT MARC JACOBS ABSOLUTE” on the front. A gold-coloured element bearing the initials “M” and “J” adorns the neck of the bottle, whilst the cap features a large, dark bow and a transparent, faceted upper section. The entire formulation of this Eau de Parfum is also vegan. Concentrated Eau de Parfum with warm, floral and amber-like notes Fragrance composition of caramelised fig, jasmine absolu and an amber accord Dark red glass bottle with gold lettering and a striking bow embellishment Vegan formulation Launched in 2025

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs’ Daisy Wild Eau So Intense Eau de Parfum Spray pays homage to the untamed beauty of nature, captured in an intense fragrance. The result is an olfactory experience that takes the senses on a journey into the great outdoors and leaves behind an aura of carefree elegance. listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Dream Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Daisy Dream is an eau de toilette that exudes an airy, light and playful aura. Launched in 2014, the fragrance opens with a sparkling top note that combines the sweetness of blackberry and pear with the freshness of grapefruit. Shortly afterwards, the floral heart of the composition unfolds, a bouquet of delicate wisteria, jasmine and the subtle fruitiness of lychee. These notes give the fragrance its unmistakable floral character. The base brings the fragrance experience to a gentle conclusion. This is where creamy coconut water, white woods and a hint of musk come together to create a soft impression. The fragrance is an ideal companion for everyday wear as well as for warmer seasons and captures the essence of a carefree day. The bottle itself is a piece of jewellery, decorated with white and gold daisies on the silver cap. Fragrance direction: Floral-fruity Top notes: blackberry, pear, grapefruit Heart note: wisteria, jasmine, lychee Base notes: coconut water, white woods, musk Fragrance character: Fresh, light and playful

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Nuit Eau de Parfum Spray 10 ml
listings.description: The Estée Lauder Bronze Goddess Nuit Eau de Parfum Spray turns day into night - in a charming, sensual way! Experience precious moments with the perfume that emphasises your femininity and brings out your mysterious side. Bronze Goddess Nuit is your reliable companion for romantic dinners under the stars as well as for a break in the middle of the day. Magical and enchanting Spicy, even slightly smoky, but still exuding pure femininity with a hint of flowers: this is how the Eau de Parfum Spray by Estée Lauder can be aptly described. The mystical side of this exquisite fragrance is omnipresent and transports you to a world full of magic. Experience marvellous sunsets or the view of the stars, even if only during a short dream journey in everyday life. The fragrance nuances of Bronze Goddess Nuit are very versatile and start with sweet bergamot and exotic ylang-ylang. A peppery accord keeps the perfume interesting and exciting. A bouquet of flowers then unfolds, accompanied by coconut, which reminds you of faraway destinations in places like the Caribbean. Enjoy your personal everyday time-out again and again - with the fragrance from Estée Lauder!

listings.rawTitle: Charlotte Meentzen Meentzen for Men Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Meentzen for Men is an invigorating, masculine fragrance from Charlotte Meentzen. The German company is known for its effective, sustainable natural cosmetics. The company's founders already knew that beautiful hair and skin require natural care products. Scientific findings are increasingly playing a role in modern products. Together with traditional knowledge of nourishing plant substances, they form the basis for unique natural cosmetics. This applies to the skin and hair care products as well as to every Charlotte Meentzen perfume. Meentzen for Men: a pleasantly fresh fragrance for men The Meentzen for Men range presents products that have been developed for the special needs of men's skin. They moisturise the skin and provide it with important active ingredients. This cannot be achieved with a single care product. That's why the men's skincare range is so diverse. A perfume is naturally part of this. Because many men appreciate a fragrance that discreetly emphasises their well-groomed appearance. Aquatic, fruity, woody : This eau de parfum spray is a natural, multi-faceted fragrance creation. The top note blends invigorating aquatic notes with juicy mandarin. The heart note is dedicated to the intense scent of neroli. It is complemented by cedarwood. A sensual base accord of amber and white musk rounds off the eau de parfum spray.

listings.rawTitle: Charlotte Meentzen Silk & Pure Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Silk & Pure Eau de Toilette Spray by Charlotte Meentzen is characterised by lightness and a clear structure. The olfactory journey begins with a top note that combines tangy bergamot and exotic passion fruit to create a fruity opening. This first impression is complemented by other fresh accords that add dynamism to the fragrance. The heart note then comes to the fore, focussing on the delicate, floral nuances of lily of the valley and violet. The base, in which amber and cedarwood combine to create a woody foundation, ensures a lasting finish. The outer appearance reflects the delicacy of the contents: the cylindrical bottle is made of transparent, pink-coloured glass and has gently rounded shoulders. A shiny silver cap provides a cool contrast to the warm colour of the glass. The words "silk & pure" can be read on the front in elegant typography, complemented by the description "Vaporisateur Spray". The spray head allows the eau de toilette to be applied evenly. Floral-fresh fragrance composition with fruity accents Head notes of bergamot and passion fruit Heart notes of lily of the valley and violet and a base of amber and cedar wood Cylindrical pink glass bottle with silver cap Contents: 50 ml eau de toilette spray

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The One For Men Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: This eau de parfum, launched in 2015, is a deeper and denser interpretation of the classic fragrance concept. Designed by Olivier Polge, the composition is characterised by a higher concentration of fragrance oils, which ensures a long-lasting fragrance experience. The opening is characterised by a combination of grapefruit, coriander and basil, which conveys an aromatic yet elegant freshness. As the fragrance progresses, a spicy heart unfolds, in which striking notes of ginger and cardamom meet the subtle nuance of orange blossom. These elements finally merge into a persistent base characterised by accords of tobacco, amber and cedar wood, giving the perfume its woody character. The design of the bottle emphasises the value of the contents: A heavy, rectangular glass body reveals the brown liquid and is topped with a colour-coordinated, dark brown cap. The clear, geometric lines are only accentuated by a silver inscription on the front, which completes the overall aesthetic look. Fragrance: Warm and spicy with woody and aromatic elements Head note: A fresh blend of grapefruit, coriander and basil. Heart note: Spicy accents of ginger and cardamom as well as orange blossom. Base note: Deep accords of tobacco, amber and cedarwood. Design: Rectangular glass bottle with brown contents and dark brown cap.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana The Only One Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Only One captures the essence of elegant, mesmerising femininity. This composition impresses with a modern combination of violet and coffee notes. Like the woman it represents, the fragrance is a complex interplay of contrasts. This beguiling creation draws its special charm from the unexpected mocha violet note. The violet opens up the fragrance and combines with subtle notes of bergamot to create a lively, fresh and juicy bouquet. A harmonious whole emerges in the heart note with the fusion of seductive notes of rich coffee and charming iris, while the base delicately envelops the senses with a coating of vanilla and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Man Extreme Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: With the Man Extreme perfume, Jimmy Choo presents a deeper, more intense interpretation of the popular fragrance. Man Extreme is an intense eau de parfum spray that leaves an irresistible and powerful scent trail. The explosive top note combines burning red thyme with spicy black pepper, perfectly balanced by invigorating citrus notes. At the heart of the fragrance, a unique aromatic accord unfolds, in which geranium, lavandin and clary sage combine to create an incomparably fresh composition. The striking base note anchors a powerful woody-ambery masculinity, in which the sensuality of tonka bean blends with the intensity of vetiver and raises the fascination of the fragrance to a new level. Intense Eau de Parfum Spray for Adventurers by Jimmy Choo The iconic Jimmy Choo Man bottle has been reinterpreted for this edition in a deep red lacquer. The red and silver cap in crocodile design emphasises the modern, sophisticated look. Man Extreme Eau de Parfum Spray is the perfect fragrance for self-confident men who seek the extraordinary and are ready to experience new adventures. An olfactory invitation to transcend boundaries. The pronounced longevity and moderate sillage make this perfume the ideal companion for day and night. Whether in a business meeting or on a romantic date - Man Extreme emphasises the natural charisma of its wearer in a subtle yet impressive way.</p

listings.description: Sancti (Eau-delà) by Liquides Imaginaires is a unisex fragrance that bridges the gap between the spiritual and the modern. The heart of the fragrance combines the spicy warmth of cardamom and coriander with aromatic lavender, rosemary and the balsamic note of fir balsam. The base anchors the perfume with deep, resinous notes of frankincense, myrrh and benzoin, rounded off with woody accords of cedar, vetiver and patchouli as well as the gentle warmth of amber, cistus and musk. Created by perfumer Sonia Constant, Sancti (Eau-delà) is an olfactory interpretation conceived as a tribute to spiritual clarity. A unisex fragrance inspired by the atmosphere of holy water and modern incense. Opens with an invigorating top note of citrus and cypress. Unfolds a spicy-aromatic heart and a deep, resinous-woody base. A composition by perfumer Sonia Constant.

The eau de parfum opens with a combination of mandarin, saffron and orange blossom. Jasmine and a solar note then unfold in the heart, lending the fragrance a special warmth.
