As part of the Les Eaux de L'Âme range, the fragrance sees itself as an artistic means of expression that captures a mysterious narrative in a bottle. Aromatic unisex fragrance with sensual and spicy notes A composition of mandarin, jasmine, patchouli and vanilla. Inspired by a mysterious, smoky atmosphere. Part of the artistic collection Les Eaux de L'Âme.

listings.rawTitle: Liquides Imaginaires Les Eaux de L'Âme Eau de Parfum Spray Âme du Coeur 100 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Âme du Coeur by Liquides Imaginaires is a composition that captures emotions in a fragrance. The opening is characterised by a multi-faceted blend of tangy blood orange, grapefruit and mandarin, accompanied by the spicy pungency of ginger, pink and black pepper. This lively top note is complemented by cardamom, cypress and elemi resin, giving the fragrance remarkable depth right from the start. At the heart of the composition, a warm and slightly gourmand character unfolds through the combination of cocoa and guaiac wood. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with the soft notes of tonka bean and vanillin, while vetiver, cedarwood and akigalawood provide a woody and long-lasting finish. The bottle itself, with its elegant design of red glass and silver-coloured elements, reflects the precious character of the fragrance. Fragrance family: spicy, aromatic, woody Top notes: blood orange, grapefruit, ginger, pepper, cardamom Heart notes: cocoa, guaiac wood Base note: tonka bean, vanillin, vetiver, cedar wood

listings.rawTitle: Liquides Imaginaires Les Eaux Sanguines Extrait de Parfum Spray Dom Rosa Millésimé 100 ml
listings.description: To celebrate its 10th anniversary, Liquides Imaginaires presents Dom Rosa Millésimé, a more intense extrait de parfum version of the iconic fragrance. This composition, created by perfumer Sonia Constant, is a tribute to the perfectly matured champagne rose. The opening is sparkling and fruity, characterised by a champagne accord that combines with notes of grapefruit and pear. At the heart of the creation is the opulent Damask rose, surrounded by the rare spice of clove and a hint of mystical incense, which lends the fragrance a multi-faceted depth. The base note rounds off the experience with an elegant and velvety foundation of cedarwood, vetiver and guaiac wood, ensuring remarkable longevity. As part of the unisex trilogy "Les Eaux Sanguines", this floral-woody fragrance is aimed at sophisticated personalities who appreciate a refined and charismatic composition with a pronounced sillage for special moments. An anniversary edition as a highly concentrated extrait de parfum. A multi-faceted composition of champagne accord, damask rose and woody notes. Unisex fragrance with intense sillage and long lasting power.

listings.rawTitle: Liquides Imaginaires Alchemical Trilogy Eau de Parfum Spray Lunatique 100 ml
listings.description: The Lunatique eau de parfum spray from the Alchemical Trilogy by Liquides Imaginaires unfolds a composition full of contrasts. The fragrance begins with a sparkling yet spicy top note that combines juniper, Szechuan pepper and pink berries with the fruity sweetness of pear. As the fragrance progresses, a complex heart develops, combining incense and blackcurrant with floral accents of iris and cyclamen. The base note gives the fragrance a warm and deep structure. Here, woody notes such as sandalwood and oud meet the soft nuances of leather, musk and tonka bean. The result is a multi-layered fragrance experience that is characterised by its balance of fruity, spicy and woody elements. The bottle itself emphasises the character of the fragrance with its elegant and minimalist design. Fragrance family: Spicy, fruity, woody Top notes: juniper, Szechuan pepper, pear, pink berries Heart notes: incense, blackcurrant, iris, ginger Base notes: leather, oud, sandalwood, musk, tonka bean

listings.rawTitle: Liquides Imaginaires Les Eaux Imaginaire Eau de Parfum Spray Fleuve Tendre 100 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Fleuve Tendre by Liquides Imaginaires unfolds a composition inspired by the legendary "Carte de Tendre", an allegorical map of love. The fragrance opens with a spicy yet fresh top note of mandarin, black pepper and cardamom. A floral bouquet unfolds in the heart, harmoniously combining notes of rose water and geranium. The base note lends the fragrance a warm and earthy depth with vetiver, patchouli and tonka bean. This interplay of aromas creates a multi-layered fragrance experience that combines both spicy and gentle facets. The fragrance comes in a cylindrical glass bottle with blue liquid, which is rounded off with silver-coloured metal elements and an elegantly shaped cap. Inspired by the allegorical map of love . Combines spicy, floral and woody notes. Top notes of mandarin, black pepper and cardamom. Heart notes of rose water and geranium. Warm base with vetiver, patchouli and tonka bean.

listings.rawTitle: Liquides Imaginaires Les Eaux de L'Est Eau de Parfum Spray Tapis Volant 100 ml
listings.description: The Tapis Volant eau de parfum spray from the Les Eaux de L'Est collection offers an olfactory journey to weightless heights. The composition from the Liquides Imaginaires brand is dedicated to pure imagination and tells the story of an imaginary hanging garden or a legendary flying object from ancient myths. The opening is a radiant brightness created by sparkling bergamot and airy aldehydes, while carrot seeds add a subtle, interesting nuance. At the heart, an elegant, powdery iris accord unfolds, meeting so-called cold spices and floral notes of jasmine. This unusual combination gives the fragrance a floating, almost ethereal lightness. The base note, in which soft white musk blends harmoniously with creamy sandalwood and earthy vetiver, provides a warm and lasting finish. Tonka bean and ambrofix add a gentle depth that can linger on the skin for a long time. Visually, the creation is presented in a cylindrical glass flacon that reveals the liquid it contains. A striking gold-coloured cap, which widens towards the top and features a fine decorative pattern, stylishly crowns the design. The golden lettering on the glass emphasises the character of this unisex fragrance, which was developed by perfumers Quentin Bisch and Nisrine Grillie. Fragrance character: An airy and ethereal blend of floral, spicy and woody notes. Head note: Fresh accents of bergamot, aldehydes and carrot seed. Heart note: An interplay of powdery iris, jasmine and cold spices. Base note: Warm finish with sandalwood, vetiver, tonka bean and white musk. Design: High-quality glass bottle with golden, decorated cap and golden lettering.

listings.rawTitle: Liquides Imaginaires Les Eaux de L'Âme Eau de Parfum Spray Âme de Fleur 100 ml
Liquides Imaginaires Les Eaux Sanguines Eau de Parfum Spray Bello Rabelo 100 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the adventurous journey across the Douro River, Bello Rabelo unfolds a fragrance character of particular depth. The composition opens with a striking note of port wine, accompanied by the sweetness of dried fruit. A warm heart of balsamic accents and spicy immortelle, also known as immortelle, develops as the fragrance progresses. These notes create a harmonious link to the base, in which woody notes combine with the warmth of benzoin and a hint of vanilla. The eau de parfum spray is presented in an elegant, cylindrical bottle with a transparent body that reveals the dark red liquid. The silver-coloured cap rounds off the high-quality appearance and makes the fragrance an olfactory experience with a powerful and charming temperament. Fragrance family: gourmand, woody, resinous Head notes: Port wine accord, dried fruits Heart notes: Balsamic note, immortelle (immortelle), cistus Base notes: Amberwood, benzoin, vanilla, woody notes

listings.rawTitle: Liquides Imaginaires Les Eaux Delà Eau de Parfum Spray Tumultu 100 ml
listings.description: Tumultu by Liquides Imaginaires is an eau de parfum spray from the Les Eaux Delà collection, which is known for its symbolic and emotional fragrance creations. This composition interprets the image of a cloud-like mist of water and unfolds a light, sensual essence. It opens with a fresh note of grapefruit, which fades into a heart of delicate coconut milk. This milky-sweet nuance lends the fragrance a special softness and is reminiscent of the atmosphere of antique luxury baths. A warm, woody base of cedarwood, patchouli and sandalwood then develops, giving the fragrance a long-lasting, full-bodied character. Bottled in an elegant and high-quality bottle, Tumultu is aimed at all those who appreciate extraordinary and profound fragrance experiences. Sensual, woody unisex fragrance Composition of grapefruit, coconut milk and sandalwood Part of the emblematic Les Eaux Delà collection Light and full-bodied fragrance character

listings.rawTitle: Reuzel Wood & Spice Aftershave 100 ml
listings.description: A well-rounded skincare routine for men benefits from Reuzel's Wood & Spice aftershave. Applied to the face, it stimulates freshly shaved skin, leaves it feeling pleasant and also refines pores . Added to this is the pleasantly fresh scent of citrus, cloves and sandalwood and the unique bottle, which features a guillotine. The transparent bottle with its black lid contains 100 ml of the aftershave. A look behind the brand: Who is Reuzel? If you want to pronounce the name of the brand, try "roo-zul". Despite the English-sounding name, it is neither an American nor a British term. Instead, it and the product range - including the Wood & Spice aftershave - originate from the Netherlands. Reuzel means "lard". The products are developed and manufactured in Rotterdam. Rock'n'roll and punk have played a role in this brand from the very beginning and can be found throughout the entire skincare range. <p

listings.rawTitle: Reuzel Wood & Spice Solid Cologne 35 g
listings.description: The Reuzel Wood & Spice Solid Cologne presents itself as a practical alternative to liquid fragrances. The solid, wax-based texture is housed in a compact metal tin that is ideal for use on the go or when travelling. When applied to the skin, a composition of warm woody notes and a hint of spice unfolds. The intensity of the fragrance can be customised by the amount applied. The formula is designed to spread easily and leave a pleasant feeling on the skin. Inspired by the traditional art of barbering, this solid cologne offers an uncomplicated way to refresh your personal fragrance throughout the day. Solid texture with a wax base Scented composition of wood and spices Practical metal tin for travelling Individually customisable fragrance intensity Easy and targeted application

listings.rawTitle: Berdoues Collection Grands Crus Eau de Parfum Spray Assam Of India 100 ml
listings.description: Parfum Assam Of India by Berdoues is a stimulating and very sophisticated fragrance from the wonderful Parfums Grands Crus. Assam tea grows above sea level. It offers a strong blend of sophistication, differentiation and character. This wonderful composition of Indian tea, Mentonic lemon and a rounding off with Mysore sandalwood powerfully calls for adventure.

listings.rawTitle: Berdoues Collection Grands Crus Eau de Parfum Spray Maasaï Mara 100 ml
listings.description: The Maasaï Mara eau de parfum spray from the Berdoues Grands Crus collection is a tribute to the unspoilt nature of the African wilderness. Created in 2017 by perfumer Philippe Romano, this unisex fragrance has an earthy, spicy character with warm nuances reminiscent of honey. At the centre of the composition are a few but expressive ingredients: Egyptian blue camomile combines with the resinous aroma of Spanish labdanum. A special note is added by South African buchu, whose fresh aroma, slightly reminiscent of blackcurrant, appeals to the senses. The perfume is produced in France and comes in a simple, rectangular bottle with a colourful pattern on the back inspired by traditional Maasai cloths. Maasaï Mara is a fragrance with a clear presence that captures the raw beauty of a unique landscape. Earthy, spicy unisex fragrance with warm nuances Inspired by the natural landscape of the Maasai Mara Composition of blue camomile, labdanum and buchu Made in France

listings.rawTitle: Berdoues Collection Grands Crus Eau de Parfum Spray Peng Lai 100 ml
listings.description: It's not hard to guess that the Peng Lai eau de parfum from the Collection Grands Crus was inspired by Asia. The floral and sweet fragrance is natural, like all fragrances from the Berdoues Collection Grands Crus for men and women. The bottle is decorated with cranes spreading their wings among lotus blossoms and taking to the skies. This fits perfectly with the clear fragrance, which was created for summer and spring. Equipped with unusual longevity and sillage, Peng Lai eau de parfum delights with its cheerful presence for many hours. This time, the Collection Grands Crus takes you to Asia The fragrance treasures of the Far East can be found in the Peng Lai eau de parfum by Berdoues. The fragrance comes without a fragrance pyramid, but with tonka beans from Brazil, which meet benzoin from Laos and osmanthus from China. The lightness of this fragrance from the Berdoues Collection Grands Crus makes it the perfect companion for leisure and work. It also proves that niche fragrances don't always have to be extreme . Quite the opposite: Peng Lai eau de parfum is soft, round and very pleasant to wear - an eau de parfum that you need to get to know.

listings.rawTitle: Berdoues Collection Grands Crus Eau de Parfum Spray Selva Do Brazil 100 ml
listings.description: The Selva Do Brazil Eau de Parfum Spray from the Collection Grands Crus by Berdoues is a composition reminiscent of the unspoilt nature of the Brazilian rainforest. This fragrance captures the invigorating atmosphere after a tropical rainfall, when nature awakens in all its splendour. The top note opens with the sparkling freshness of petitgrain from Paraguay, which creates a clear and green prelude. Tonka bean from Brazil unfolds at the heart of the creation, lending the fragrance a subtle, warm and spicy depth. The olfactory experience is rounded off with Gaiac wood from Argentina in the base note, which provides a long-lasting, woody and earthy presence. The result is a balanced fragrance that exudes both freshness and a gentle warmth and develops pleasantly on the skin. Inspired by the atmosphere of the Brazilian rainforest. Combines sparkling petitgrain with warm tonka bean. A woody base of Gaiac wood provides depth. Part of the Berdoues Grands Crus Collection. A fresh yet earthy fragrance character.

listings.rawTitle: Berdoues Collection Grands Crus Eau de Parfum Spray  Somei Yoshino 100 ml
listings.description: Parfum Somei Yoshino by Berdoues is a delicate and very clear perfume from the wonderful Parfums Grands Crus. The Yoshino cherry tree is the most popular tree in Japan because of its spectacular cherry blossoms. In Somei Yoshino, the delicate scent of cherry blossoms is combined with Indonesian patchouli and Indian jasmine. This delicate fragrance encourages you to pause and take a deep breath.

listings.rawTitle: Berdoues Collection Grands Crus Eau de Parfum Spray Guaria Morada 100 ml
listings.description: The lush and colourful flora of Costa Rica serves as the olfactory model for this composition from Berdoues. A rectangular glass bottle attracts attention with a detailed floral pattern in pink, rose and green, while a shiny black cap elegantly rounds off the design. At the centre of the fragrance experience is a harmonious combination of different worlds. Fruity nuances of Brazilian orange open the fragrance and provide a clear, fresh accent. This tangy note is then combined with the soft, woody character of Amyris from Haiti, creating a pleasant balance. Indonesian patchouli completes the arrangement in the base and lends it a subtle, earthy depth. The interplay of the individual components creates a fine balance between floral sweetness and tropical, slightly gourmand accents. As part of the Collection Grands Crus, the Eau de Parfum Spray represents an interpretation of exotic landscapes, captured in a high-quality bottle. Both the careful selection of ingredients and the visual design reflect the diversity of nature. The fragrance presents itself as a floral-fruity blend that is present without being heavy. Fragrance character: Floral-fruity composition with tropical and gourmand accents. Main notes: A blend of Brazilian orange, Haitian amyris and Indonesian patchouli. Inspiration: Olfactory interpretation of the flora of Costa Rica. Design: Rectangular glass bottle with colourful floral pattern and black cap. Collection: Part of the exclusive Berdoues Collection Grands Crus.

listings.rawTitle: Berdoues Collection Grands Crus Eau de Parfum Spray Matahari Di Bali 100 ml
listings.description: The Matahari Di Bali eau de parfum spray from the Berdoues Grands Crus collection offers an olfactory journey to Bali. This fragrance composition captures the atmosphere of the Indonesian island with a carefully balanced selection of notes. At the centre is the exotic frangipani flower, whose floral and slightly sweet aroma shapes the character of the perfume. This heart note is complemented by the warm, spicy accents of ylang-ylang, which lend the fragrance a pleasant depth. A base of cedar wood rounds off the composition and provides a gentle, woody balance. The result is a sunny and floral fragrance that unfolds harmoniously on the skin. The perfume is presented in an elegant glass bottle, the design of which is reminiscent of tropical vegetation and visually emphasises the inspiration of the fragrance. Inspired by the atmosphere of Bali Floral notes of frangipani blossom Spicy accents from ylang-ylang Rounded off with a base of cedar wood Part of the Berdoues Collection Grands Crus

listings.rawTitle: Gainsboro G-Man Hair & Body Shampoo 400 ml
listings.description: The Gainsboro G-Man Hair & Body Shampoo offers a practical cleansing solution for the whole body. The formulation is designed to gently cleanse both hair and skin without drying it out. With its pleasant texture, the product is easy to lather and spread, making the daily routine uncomplicated. After use, it leaves the skin and hair feeling clean and refreshed. The shampoo exudes a subtle, appealing fragrance that remains subtly perceptible throughout the day. Bottled in an elegant, black bottle with golden accents, the product blends stylishly into any bathroom. Practical 2-in-1 application for hair and body Enables gentle cleansing Leaves you feeling clean and refreshed Emits a subtle, long-lasting fragrance Elegant packaging design in black and gold

listings.rawTitle: Berdoues 1902 Naturelle 125 ml
listings.description: Naturelle from the Eau de Cologne line by Berdoues is a perfume with natural fragrance notes. Perfume manufacturers find the right notes in nature to create a wonderful fragrance. Berdoues does the same with Parfum Naturelle. Fruity nuances have an invigorating effect, which is why lemon, mandarin or orange are a must. The manufacturer opted for the mixture of zestiness and sweetness that orange exudes. Neroli, on the other hand, has a spicy to floral fragrance. The slight spiciness ensures a striking and, above all, long-lasting fragrance on the skin. Amber adds sensuality to the perfume. Its sensual sweetness exudes a touch of harmony. Eau de Cologne for special moments While Berdoues eau de cologne is intended for daytime use, this perfume is perfect for special evenings. Naturelle is unobtrusive , delicate and yet supports the pleasant scent of a woman's body. For some years now, manufacturers have been focussing on delicate fragrances that do not immediately take over the entire room. More and more, caterers tend to ask their guests to apply the perfume more discreetly out of consideration for other guests. Ladies can't go wrong with this fragrance and benefit from fragrant aromas.

listings.rawTitle: Berdoues 1902 Orange Basilic 125 ml
listings.description: Berdoues Orange Basilic Eau de Cologne envelops the body in a citrusy, aromatic fragrance that blends perfectly into everyday life. The simple, elegant glass bottle with its silver-coloured cap looks stylish in any bathroom. A combination of blood orange, mandarin and lemon creates a pleasantly fresh sensation, providing a dynamic start to the day, particularly on warm days or straight after a shower. Subtle notes of basil and white musk round off the fragrance profile and lend the composition a gentle depth. Designed as a unisex fragrance, the product is suitable for everyone and offers flexible use in a shared household. The formula consists of 98 per cent naturally derived ingredients, which enhances the authentic fragrance experience. With a generous 125 millilitres, this creation – manufactured in France – provides a long-lasting supply for regular use. Just a few sprays are enough to create a subtle scent. A citrus-scented unisex fragrance for everyday use Fragrance notes of blood orange, mandarin, lemon, basil and white musk Contains 98 per cent ingredients of natural origin Generous 125-ml size, made in France

listings.rawTitle: Berdoues Fragrance Mist Fragrance Mist Agrumes 200 ml
listings.description: A touch of summer freshness surrounds the body with the Berdoues Fragrance Mist Agrumes. This body spray from the Hesperides fragrance family is characterised by a lively composition of sparkling citrus notes, dominated by lemon in the top note. The fruity flavour of sweet orange unfolds at the heart of the fragrance, while a base of musk lends the arrangement a gentle, rounding depth. Particular attention is paid to the aqueous formulation, which is completely alcohol-free and can therefore be perceived as particularly gentle even in direct contact with the skin. The formula is enriched with glycerine and aloe vera juice powder and is based on ingredients that are 95% natural in origin. Thanks to essential oils such as Citrus Limon Peel Oil and Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil, an authentic fragrance experience is created. This special composition allows the spray to wet the skin and leave it feeling moisturised without leaving a sticky residue. The light texture is suitable for extensive use on the entire body. The product is made in France and comes in a transparent spray bottle with a green and orange plant motif design. It is a unisex fragrance that transcends classic gender classifications and can be used at any time of day. Alcohol-free formulation with aloe vera and glycerine Fragrance notes of lemon, sweet orange and musk 95% ingredients of natural origin Unisex body spray from the Hesperides fragrance family Made in France

listings.rawTitle: Berdoues Eaux de Toilette 95% Organics Mille Fleurs 100 ml
listings.description: With a harmonious combination of fruity and floral accords, Berdoues Eau de Toilette 95% Organics Mille Fleurs pays homage to nature. The opening of this fragrance creation is sparkling and fresh, characterised by the clear nuances of pear and cassis. The centrepiece of the eau de toilette then unfolds, revealing a multi-faceted floral bouquet of pivoine, fleur d'oranger and ylang-ylang. These floral elements gently fade into a persistent base defined by warm tones of fève tonka, cedarwood and white musk. Made in the south of France, the Maison de Parfums Berdoues uses a conscious formulation for this product. The liquid consists of 95% ingredients of natural origin and contains pure vegetable alcohol. The use of colourants, parabens and phenoxyethanol is completely avoided during production. This purity is visually reflected in the transparent glass bottle, which is topped with a silver, cylindrical lid. The white label with its delicate pink border and the striking lettering "1902" refers to the brand's long history. It is a vegan composition that has been dermatologically tested and embodies the expertise of French perfumery. Fragrance composition: fruity top notes of pear and cassis meet a floral heart of ylang-ylang and orange blossom. Naturalness: The formula is vegan and consists of 95% ingredients of natural origin. Purity: Free from colourants, parabens and phenoxyethanol. Origin: Traditional production in France ("Fabriqué en France"). Design: Elegant glass bottle with silver cap and historic "1902" lettering.

listings.rawTitle: Berdoues Fragrance Mist Fragrance Mist Coconut 200 ml
listings.description: This body spray combines French flair with a carefully selected fragrance composition that blends soft and fresh notes. The Berdoues Fragrance Mist Coconut combines, in its olfactory pyramid, the zesty freshness of bergamot with the characteristic note of coconut and a rounded base of musk. Designed as an alcohol-free formulation, the product features a composition consisting of 95 per cent ingredients of natural origin. The ingredients include, amongst others, organic aloe vera, glycerine and the ingredient Aquaxyl. Thanks to the fine atomiser on the transparent 200 ml bottle, the liquid can be applied over a wide area of the body as a light mist. As ingredients of natural origin are used, the colour of the liquid may change slightly over time; however, this does not affect the fragrance’s properties. The vegan spray is an option for external use when a subtle scent is desired. Fragrance notes of bergamot, coconut and musk Alcohol-free and vegan formula 95% ingredients of natural origin Contains organic aloe vera and glycerine 200 ml bottle with a fine atomiser

listings.rawTitle: Berdoues Fragrance Mist Fragrance Mist Neroli 200 ml
listings.description: This specially developed fragrance mist from Berdoues offers an olfactory experience that captures the delicate blossom of the orange. The composition is based on a harmonious combination of floral neroli, sparkling petit grain and a soft base of musk. Unlike many conventional eau de toilettes, Fragrance Mist Neroli is formulated to be completely alcohol-free. This means that it can be applied to the skin without causing any harm, even in direct sunlight. The base of the liquid consists of 95 per cent ingredients of natural origin. These include organic aloe vera and glycerine, which enrich the texture and can have a positive effect on the feel of the skin. The spray is applied to the body as a fine mist and leaves behind its characteristic, sunny fragrance. The vegan product is traditionally made in France, which is also indicated on the floral label of the transparent 200 ml bottle. The orange and dark blue design reflects the freshness of the contents. The light formulation makes the mist ideal for a subtle fragrance in everyday life. Fragrance notes of neroli, petit grain and musk Alcohol-free and vegan formulation 95% ingredients of natural origin Contains organic aloe vera and glycerine Made in France

listings.rawTitle: Berdoues Fragrance Mist Fragrance Mist Cerisier 200 ml
listings.description: The Berdoues Fragrance Mist Cerisier is an alcohol-free body spray based on a 95% natural formula. At the centre of the olfactory composition is the delicate note of cherry blossom, which forms the top note and gives the fragrance its fruity character. This aroma is complemented by floral accents of rose in the heart, while musk provides a gentle finish in the base note. The formula contains glycerine and Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice Powder, among other ingredients, and deliberately avoids the use of alcohol. The silver-coloured spray head allows the liquid to be dispersed as a fine mist that lightly envelops the body like a cloud. Visually, the transparent 200 ml bottle with its colourful floral illustrations and clear design underlines the origin of the product, which is manufactured in France. As the label states that it is a Brume Parfumée Hydratante, the formulation may have hydrating properties. This scented mist is suitable for use at any time of day and offers an alternative to heavy perfumes. The combination of water, plant-based ingredients and selected fragrance oils such as limonene and linalool defines this unisex product. Fruity fragrance composition with notes of cherry blossom, rose and musk Alcohol-free formulation with 95% ingredients of natural origin Contains glycerine and aloe vera powder Made in France (Made in France) Fine spray mist in a transparent 200 ml bottle

listings.rawTitle: J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin Leder 6 Refill Diffuser 500 ml
listings.description: With the J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin Leather 6 Refill Diffuser, the elegant room fragrance bottle can be easily refilled. This composition presents a complex interplay of contrasting notes that create a characterful yet inviting atmosphere in the living room. A striking leather accord meets the subtle spiciness of saffron blossom in the top note, creating an immediate presence. This robust opening flows smoothly into a surprisingly soft heart note, in which warm milk and vanilla combine harmoniously. The multi-layered olfactory experience is rounded off by a mysterious base of incense and Japanese styrax, which provides a smoky depth. Inspired by the historic classic "Spanish Leather" from 1921, the fragrance interprets the theme of leather in a modern and sophisticated way. The white container with black cap contains 500 ml of the fragrance liquid and allows the existing diffuser to be reused in a resource-saving way. The number of sticks used can be used to individually regulate the intensity of the fragrance in the room. Thanks to the high-quality formulation, the fragrance is distributed evenly and for a long time without the need to turn the sticks regularly. Refill bottle for room fragrance with 500 ml content Scent profile with notes of leather, saffron, milk, vanilla and incense Modern interpretation of the classic "Spanish Leather" Enables individual regulation of the fragrance intensity Even distribution without turning the sticks

listings.rawTitle: J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin Berliner Linde Refill Diffuser 500 ml
listings.description: The J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin Berliner Linde room fragrance is fruity and floral , absolutely unisex. With its inspiration in its name, the fragrance is composed like a perfume. Naturally, lime blossom is part of the top note, while the other part is the noble magnolia. Mandarin and sweet jasmine form the heart, which in turn gives way to a base of red pepper and cedarwood. The bottle of the fragrance is elegant, plain black and reminiscent of an apothecary bottle. The Berliner Linde room fragrance by J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin is also available as a refill diffuser so that the bottle does not have to be constantly replaced. The refill diffuser contains 500 ml of the exquisite room fragrance for you. Luxury from Germany for your rooms The elegant room fragrance from the Berlin niche label J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin emits its scent completely silently thanks to the well-known diffuser technology, without open flames or a mist that settles on the furniture and floor. Elegant black rattan sticks, matching the black bottle of the Berlin Linden room fragrance, distribute the fragrance and certainly help to enhance the ambience in the rooms. You also save a lot of money with the refill diffuser, just as you help the environment because the refill consumes fewer resources .

listings.rawTitle: J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin Leder 6 Refillable Diffuser 450 ml
listings.description: This composition combines the tradition of Berlin perfumery with a modern attitude to life in a unique way. With the J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin Leather 6 Refillable Diffuser, you can easily renew the distinctive room fragrance in your own home. As a contemporary interpretation of the classic "Spanish Leather" from 1921, the creation unfolds a character that captivates with both dark depth and warm accents. In the top note, powerful leather accords meet the spice of saffron and the fine nuances of osmanthus blossom. The heart note forms an exciting contrast, in which milk and vanilla combine to create a surprising softness. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a smoky base of incense and Japanese styrax resin, which lends the room fragrance a mysterious aura. This 500 ml refill bottle is used to refill the separately available diffuser. The fragrance molecules are distributed silently via the sticks, whereby the intensity of the room fragrance can be individually varied by the number of sticks used. The result is a room climate that is reminiscent of the pulsating energy and hidden places of Berlin. 500 ml refill bottle for room fragrance diffuser Fragrance notes: Leather, saffron, milk, vanilla, incense Character: Smoky, leathery and warm-spicy Modern interpretation of the classic from 1921 Individual intensity control via sticks

listings.rawTitle: J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin Berliner Linde Refillable Diffuser 450 ml
listings.description: This is the air of Berlin! Spring is coming to your home with the fine room fragrance Berliner Linde from J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin. The refreshing scent of lime blossom is supported by magnolia, mandarin and jasmine. In the base, the elegant room fragrance also smells of a pinch of red pepper and dark, slightly spicy cedarwood. Presented in a refillable diffuser, the fresh, citrusy floral fragrance is ideal for the living room, dining room or even the home spa. Acqua di Parma Le Nobili Eau de Parfum Spray Peonia Nobile 50 ml
listings.description: Peonia Nobile is an eau de parfum spray by Acqua di Parma. The perfume was launched in 2016 and offers a floral-fresh fragrance . It celebrates the noble peony, whose Latin name is Paeonia. But it's not just the name of the perfume that arouses curiosity, the bottle does too. After all, it hints at a sensual, feminine fragrance . As you would expect from Acqua di Parma, the shape of the bottle is rather simple, but it is decorated in gold. The fragrance inside the bottle itself is pale pink and looks very romantic at first glance. And that was precisely the intention of the manufactory with Peonia Nobile. Sensuality without being heavy The eau de parfum spray opens the fragrance with raspberries and black pepper. Followed by the opulent heart notes of Turkish rose, Egyptian rose geranium, freesia and, of course, peony, it becomes floral before forming a long-lasting finish. The gentle notes of musk, patchouli and amber also join the perfume. The result is an eau de parfum spray that you can wear both during the day and in the evening. With Peonia Nobile, Acqua di Parma has achieved the feat of creating a perfume that is light, yet present.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia Eau de Cologne Spray Colonia Pura 50 ml
listings.description: The Colonia Pura Eau de Cologne Spray by Acqua di Parma is a refreshing, sparkling fragrance for the modern, authentic man. The attractive fragrance composition begins with sunny bergamot, delicious petitgrain and fruity, juicy oranges that transport you to the sun-kissed shores of the Mediterranean. In the heart note, the irresistible combination of strong spicy notes with delicate floral tones is captivating. The charismatic aroma of coriander meets the floral accents of Indian jasmine and intoxicating narcissus. The finish is characterised by woody accents of cedarwood and patchouli, refined by a hint of musk. Refined and modern fragrances for self-confident men With its sparkling, aquatic notes, Colonia Pura Eau de Cologne Spray by Acqua di Parma awakens the spirits and makes you want to face the day. As a modern, sensual interpretation of the classic Italian eau de cologne, it emphasises the masculine charisma and elegance of its wearer. Enjoy the stylish fragrances from Acqua di Parma day after day!

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Eau de Toilette Spray Mandarino di Sicilia 50 ml
listings.description: The Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Mandarino di Sicilia fragrance brings the ambience of Sicily into your own four walls or accompanies you on the go as a gentle eau de toilette spray. The mediterranean and refreshing perfume was directly inspired by the diverse landscapes of the Italian island . Travel in your mind to the largest island in the Mediterranean : With Blu Mediterraneo Mandarino di Sicilia, you can experience Sicily in all its splendour! Firstly, you stroll among the characteristic fruit trees, smelling lemon and orange, mandarin and lime, even blood orange and bergamot in the top note. The eponymous mandarin stands out and envelops you with its sweetness. This is followed by a romantic walk by the sea, with refreshing notes such as mint and petitgrain that make the waves seem to lie at your feet. But Italy's island naturally also has a sensual side, charmingly captured in the perfume with nuances such as patchouli, cedarwood and musk in the base, reminiscent of exquisite moments of pleasure. The special thing about the unisex fragrance from Acqua di Parma is that it is made from early-harvested green mandarins, which exude a sunny, cheerful fragrance . With the eau de toilette spray, you will always start the day motivated and in a good mood!

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Le Nobili Eau de Parfum Spray Rosa Nobile 50 ml
listings.description: With the Rosa Nobile Eau de Parfum Spray, the perfume designers at Acqua di Parma have created a worthy monument to the undisputed queen of all flowers. New fragrances often have to be compared with other perfume varieties - but this one need not fear comparison and will quickly take its well-deserved place among the great fragrances. The queen of fragrances has many faces Even in ancient times, the rose was considered a precious plant, not only because of its marvellous and incomparable fragrance, but also because of its healing properties. The rose is not only nourishing and beneficial for the skin, it can also heal the soul. It is said to help against sadness, lovesickness and jealousy. It symbolises pride and strength, but also devotion, passion and true love. All of these characteristics flow into the Eau de Parfum Spray Rosa Nobile by Acqua di Parma and make this fragrance a unique fragrance experience. New fragrances - playing with fire New fragrances from Acqua di Parma are always awaited with excitement and anticipation. Of course, there is a reason for this, because few understand the exquisite balance required to create an outstanding fragrance like the fragrance designers at the traditional Italian manufacturer. The Rosa Nobile eau de parfum spray once again creates a fragrance experience that enchants all the senses. A perfume not just for lovers, but one that celebrates pride and love itself. Precious ingredients such as peony, Sicilian mandarin, Calabrian bergamot, lily of the valley and violet create a floral depth reminiscent of nights spent in exotic gardens waiting for the one you love. Pepper, spicy cedarwood, mysterious ambergris and sensual musk complete this fragrance.

Davidoff Adventure Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Inspired by unspoilt nature and the spirit of exploration in distant lands, Davidoff Adventure Eau de Toilette Spray is a woody-spicy fragrance. The fragrance opens with a fresh blend of bergamot, mandarin and lemon, complemented by the green notes of tea and yerba mate, and a subtle hint of black pepper. At its heart, a distinctive duo of spicy allspice and sesame unfolds, lending the fragrance a special depth. The base notes of warm cedarwood, earthy vetiver and a hint of musk ensure a distinctive finish. With its fresh intensity, this fragrance is a perfect companion for the day, particularly in spring and autumn. listings.description: Davidoff’s Champion Eau de Toilette Spray is a carefully crafted blend of woody and aromatic notes. As the fragrance develops, the heart unfolds, where spicy clary sage meets the green, slightly resinous nuances of galbanum. This combination lends an interesting depth. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with the earthy tones of oakmoss and the warm character of cedarwood. The bottle design reflects these characteristics: The shape of a dumbbell, crafted from dark glass and silver-coloured metal elements, emphasises the fragrance’s energetic yet crisp style. Fragrance family: Woody-aromatic Top notes: Bergamot, lemon Heart note: Clary sage, galbanum Base note: Cedarwood, oakmoss Character: Fresh, spicy, crisp

listings.description: Davidoff The Game Eau de Toilette Spray is a woody-aromatic fragrance for men that captivates with a composition of striking contrasts. It opens with a fresh gin accord, created from the zesty note of juniper berries, which provides a surprising opening. At the heart of the composition, the powdery elegance of iris unfolds, accompanied by precious woods. This combination lends the fragrance a special depth and a sophisticated structure. The base note of powerful blackwood rounds off the olfactory experience and ensures a lasting, expressive impression. The Eau de Toilette Spray embodies an aura of elegance and self-confidence, and with its dynamic character, it emphasises a straightforward and confident presence. listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Zino Eau de Toilette Spray 125 ml
listings.description: Zino by Davidoff is a fragrance that is regarded as a timeless classic amongst men’s fragrances and captivates with its sophisticated character. This Eau de Toilette spray unfolds a woody-spicy scent profile composed of a variety of notes. The opening is fresh and aromatic, created by a combination of bergamot and lavender, complemented by the subtle nuances of Brazilian rosewood and clary sage. At the heart of the composition, a floral bouquet unfolds, in which notes of jasmine, lily of the valley, rose and geranium, lending the fragrance an elegant depth. The base note provides a distinctive and expressive finish. Here, warm accords of sandalwood and cedar meet earthy patchouli and a subtle hint of vanilla. Since its launch in 1986, this fragrance has established itself as a timeless expression of style. The packaging is also deliberately free of any additional cellophane film. A classic men’s fragrance with a woody, spicy character. A composition of fresh, floral and warm woody notes. The base note combines sandalwood, cedar, patchouli and vanilla. Packaging without additional cellophane.

listings.rawTitle: Trussardi Riflesso Eau de Toilette Spray Blue Vibe 50 ml
listings.description: In 2017, the legendary Italian fashion label Trussardi launched Riflesso Eau de Toilette Spray, an extraordinary fragrance for the confident man of today. The name Riflesso translates to light or reflection and precisely describes the effect of this masculine fragrance, which remains in the memory for a long time and has a high recognition value . The fragrance combines masculine and dominant components with delicate hints of flowers and fruity essences. In this way, it perfectly reflects the different facets of modern men, who are dynamic and determined, but also have a sensitive and sensual side. A masterpiece from Trussardi The eau de toilette spray delights with its sensitive and subtle composition. The top note consists of fresh green apple, pink grapefruit and expressive bergamot. The endearing heart note then comes into its own with violet leaf, lavender and rose geranium. The base note underpins the fragrance and gives it depth with hints of Italian leather, warm tonka bean and vetiver.

listings.description: Inspired by the stylish atmosphere of the famous Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II in Milan, Passeggiata In Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II is an olfactory journey into the heart of Italian elegance. This eau de parfum spray from Trussardi's "Le Vie di Milano" collection captures the flair of the historic coffee houses. The composition opens with an inviting top note of aromatic hazelnut, intense coffee and a hint of cinnamon. This is followed by a heart of tuberose and jasmine sambac, which is given a special depth by a gentle coconut accent. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a warm base of cedarwood, creamy vanilla and white musk, which gives the fragrance a velvety and long-lasting character. The unisex fragrance is a tribute to sophisticated living and is aimed at lovers of expressive gourmand compositions. Gourmand-aromatic unisex fragrance Head notes of hazelnut, coffee and cinnamon Heart notes of coconut, tuberose and jasmine Base of cedarwood, vanilla and musk Part of the "Le Vie di Milano" collection

listings.rawTitle: Trussardi Le Vie di Milano Eau de Parfum Spray Walking In Porta Venezia 100 ml
listings.description: The eau de parfum spray Walking In Porta Venezia complements the renowned Le Vie di Milano collection from Trussardi and is an olfactory interpretation of the famous Milanese neighbourhood. Pierre-Constantin Guéros is responsible for this composition, which was launched in 2022 and is intended to capture the atmosphere of historic walks through the city's first public park. Aromatic facets characterise the opening, in which spicy star anise meets the freshness of lemon oil and accentuated black pepper. As the fragrance progresses, a heart unfolds that is inspired by the so-called "Fée Verte" and characterised by the use of wormwood oil and absinthe oil. These notes are accompanied by floral elements such as Madagascar geranium and violet leaves. A deep base rounds off the fragrance experience by combining patchouli oil and fir balsam absolute with cedarwood oil. Bourbon vanilla provides a gentle contrast to the woody accords. Visually, the light grey bottle with its golden cap in the shape of a greyhound's head reflects the brand's aesthetic codes. Fragrance character: A woody-floral composition with aromatic nuances. Head note: Combination of star anise, lemon oil and black pepper. Heart notes: wormwood and absinthe oil meet geranium and violet leaves. Base note: Multi-layered finish with patchouli, fir balsam, cedarwood and vanilla. Design: Elegant, light grey bottle with a striking greyhound cap in gold.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Ultra Blue Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: In 2021, Montblanc presents the Eau de Parfum Spray Explorer Ultra Blue. The fragrance is, of course, for men and has a citrusy and fresh presence that not only inspires in summer. The top notes combine pink pepper, citrus fruits and Italian bergamot. The trio of perfumers Antoine Maisondieu, Olivier Pescheux and Jordi Fernandez have selected ambergris and maritime notes for the heart. These notes are combined in the base with leather, woody notes and patchouli from Indonesia. The result is a light fragrance for men who want to look smart even in high temperatures. The Eau de Parfum Spray Explorer Ultra Blue is the perfect companion, especially for work and leisure. Fresh and with a subtle masculinity Montblanc is a household name for many men, not only for its luxurious writing instruments, but also for its elegant men's fragrances. A Montblanc fragrance stands for style and elegance , for expression and perceptibility, for masculinity and for discreet charisma. The Eau de Parfum Spray Explorer Ultra Blue also impresses with a kind of understatement that many men like. Because it is neither intrusive nor overpowering. Just right for the summer and anyone who wants to be masculine but not heavy.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: L'Homme Eau de Parfum by Yves Saint Laurent is a men's fragrance that is characterised by its woody, aromatic signature. The composition opens with a sparkling combination of bitter orange, bergamot and lemon, accentuated by the slight spiciness of ginger. In the heart of the fragrance, an interplay of lavender, geranium and violet unfolds, accompanied by spicy notes such as pepper and basil, giving the fragrance depth. The base is deliberately restrained and consists of warm accords of tonka bean, vetiver and cedar and oak wood. A speciality is the oak wood fusion, which is distilled from the wood shavings of cognac barrels and adds a subtle, smoky warmth. The simple bottle with its hexagonal cap emphasises the elegant and timeless character of the fragrance. Fragrance direction: woody-aromatic Character: A composition of sparkling freshness and spicy depth Base note: Warm woody accords with a special oak wood fusion

listings.rawTitle: Korres Aegean Bronze Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Immerse yourself in the radiant warmth of the Aegean sun with this eau de parfum spray from KORRES. This olfactory perfume homage perfectly captures the magic of an endless Greek summer and the seductive beauty of sun-kissed skin. Imagine the golden hour on a secluded cove: The salty sea breeze mingling with the scent of warm sand and the sweet warmth of the setting sun. The essence of Greek summer Aegean Bronze is a sensual perfume that feels like liquid sunlight on the skin. The eau de parfum spray unfolds an irresistibly warm and slightly sweet aura that is both invigorating and deeply soothing - a reminder of carefree days by the sea. The composition exudes a natural elegance and subtle exoticism that immediately puts you in a holiday mood. As an intense eau de parfum, Aegean Bronze offers a long-lasting fragrance experience that accompanies you throughout the day. Inspired by the unique beauty of Greece and formulated with the expertise of KORRES, this fragrance is perfect for the modern woman who radiates joie de vivre and natural sensuality. Wrap yourself in the golden shimmer of Aegean Bronze and wear the feeling of summer on your skin!

listings.description: The Replica Jazz Club Eau de Toilette Spray by Maison Margiela captures the unique atmosphere of a traditional jazz club in a woody, spicy fragrance. The composition starts with an invigorating top note of pink pepper, lemon and neroli oil, which creates a fresh opening. listings.description: "Dance with the waves, move with the sea. Let the rhythm of the water set your soul free." They still exist, the small wonders of this earth - and we love them precisely because they are so hidden and so fantastically beautiful. The best place to get to from Hamilton Island is the 8-kilometre-long Whitehaven Beach, a beach on the east coast of Australia's Whitsunday Island. With a quartz content of almost 99%, it is considered one of the whitest beaches in the world and is one of the ecological highlights and cleanest beaches in the world. With a bit of luck, you can swim with giant turtles and dolphins in this wonderful place. Magically attracted and moved by the irresistibly beautiful nature here, Chris and Criss are overwhelmed by a state of tense calm that turns into a feeling of profound emotion and peaceful gratitude. What the two of them experience here cannot be put into words. Bliss and humility are the best words to describe their feelings. If the colours in this memory were fragrant, it would be crystal turquoise, quartz silver, ultramarine and heart red. Pure, timeless and indescribably beautiful. Chris and Criss have captured this unique spectacle of colours in the new fragrance duo WHITE HEAVEN BEACH. WHITE HEAVEN BEACH is like a delicate breath of freedom and happiness . The floral opening is emphasised by white rose and fruity-feminine ingredients of lychee and lemon. A powdery-soft heart note rises weightlessly from the white jasmine bouquet and is subtly contrasted by orange blossom, lily of the valley and iris. The finishing touch is then provided by the warm gourmand notes of bourbon vanilla, white musk, cotton blossom and white woods. Elegant and stylish: an expression of pure femininity.

listings.description: 'Rain on Sylt – a frequent spectacle: The air shimmers as though electrified and heralds an imminent shower, lending the flora new strength. listings.description: With a design that deliberately plays on the aesthetics of everyday objects, Fresh Couture Eau de Toilette comes in the form of a conventional spray bottle for cleaning products. Behind this humorous and ironic façade, with its transparent blue contents, lies a carefully crafted fragrance composition from the floral-woody family. Launched in 2015, the fragrance opens with a fresh top note, in which accords of bergamot and mandarin blend with the exotic notes of ylang-ylang. As the fragrance develops, a fruity yet floral heart comes to the fore, combining sweet hints of raspberry with the elegance of white peony and osmanthus. This perfume, manufactured in Italy, is sensually rounded off by a base note of light woods, white patchouli and ambroxan. This combination lends the fragrance a modern character that emphasises the deliberate contrast between the unassuming bottle and the high-quality contents. listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Signature Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Signature is an Eau de Parfum Spray by Montblanc and was launched in 2020. The fragrance is for women and has a sweet and floral presence. The white bottle, which is elegantly faceted, conceals a women's fragrance that definitely has what it takes to be a fresh signature perfume. Montblanc chose this name for the eau de parfum spray for good reason. Incidentally, the fragrance was created by Nathalie Gracia-Cetto and Guillaume Flavigny. A fragrance for women can be this beautiful and light The clementine top note of the fragrance gives way to a floral heart note. Magnolias, ylang-ylang and peonies romp around in it. White musk, vanilla and benzoin round off the fragrance in the base. Although Montblanc is actually better known for men's fragrances, the Signature eau de parfum spray proves that the label is also a master of fine women's fragrances . If you are not yet familiar with the label and the fragrance, take the opportunity to treat yourself to this fine perfume. Signature is perfect for everyday wear at work and leisure and will stay by your side for many hours.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Legend Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: With the fresh, woody Eau de Parfum Spray Legend, the Hamburg-based luxury label Montblanc is continuing its line of 'legendary' men's fragrances, which have long since achieved cult status. Launched in 2020, the fragrance is, like its predecessors, a creation by star perfumer Olivier Pescheux . Following the fresh fougère composition from 2011, the casually elegant Spirit version presented in 2016 and the seductively sensual Night version presented in 2018, a creation with an emphatically intense signature and sensual, charming orientation is now being presented. This gives the Eau de Parfum Spray Legend by Montblanc impressive longevity and particularly good sillage. An exclusive, successful perfume with innovative charm The new version of Montblanc Legend also captivates with the familiar and successful accord with notes of beguilingly fragrant jasmine and soft, green moss, underlaid with sweet and tart nuances of bergamot. However, the Eau de Parfum Spray from 2020 expands the exquisite fragrance sequence with green, aromatic facets of dewy violet leaves and seductively graceful magnolia. Strong accents of resinous wood and fresh, soft leather add irresistibly elegant nuances to the composition. Lovers of the original perfume will also find the original notes in this excitingly modern fragrance and yet be delighted by the deep radiance of the characterful new creation.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Explorer Platinum Eau de Parfum Spray 60 ml
listings.description: Anyone who first thinks of high-quality writing instruments when they hear the name Montblanc is not entirely wrong: in fact, the Explorer Platinum men's fragrance also comes from the portfolio of the famous Swiss luxury brand. Perfume lovers have known Montblanc for more than two decades. In 2001, a separate perfume range, "Presence", was added to the already well-developed brand portfolio of luxury accessories such as briefcases, jewellery and wristwatches. The Explorer perfume range was launched in 2019 with the perfume of the same name, which quickly became very popular . With Explorer Platinum Eau de Parfum Spray, Montblanc has launched a fragrance that bridges the gap between spicy and sweet woody notes - a perfume that is appreciated for its distinctive originality. With a top note of violet leaf and a heart note of aromatic-balsamic clary sage, the men's fragrance gains sweetness and freshness. The eau de parfum spray is rounded off with a base note of cedar wood, which carries and summarises the composition with its dark depth. Explorer Platinum Eau de Parfum Spray was created by three well-known perfume artists: the highly experienced Fabrice Pellegrin, who has already worked for a number of major perfume houses from Dior to Gaultier, Bruno Jovanovicz (e.g. Armani, Lagerfeld) and Nathalie Lorsson, whose list of previous activities also reads like a Who's Who of famous perfume brands. The perfume is supplied in a high-quality silver bottle in the typical Explorer look.

At the centre of the fragrance is the interplay of French lavender and Moroccan orange blossom, complemented by musky accords. The composition opens with notes of bergamot and mandarin before moving into a heart of lavender and orange blossom. A base of vanilla bourbon, heliotrope and amber rounds off the fragrance experience. The asymmetrical bottle with its gold-coloured chains and the iconic Cassandre logo combines classic couture elements with modern aesthetics. A special focus is placed on the sustainable concept: the fragrance is refillable, which is a resource-saving alternative to buying a new one. The 100 ml refill is suitable for the 10 ml, 30 ml, 50 ml and 90 ml bottle sizes and is easy to use. Floral composition with notes of lavender, orange blossom and vanilla. Iconic bottle in a couture design with the Cassandre logo. Refillable system for a more conscious use of resources. The 100-ml refill is compatible with the 10-ml, 30-ml, 50-ml and 90-ml bottles.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Eau de Parfum Spray - refillable 40 ml
listings.description: MYSLF by Yves Saint Laurent is a modern men's fragrance that emphasises the versatility of its own personality with a woody-floral composition. The fragrance opens with a lively freshness created by the citrusy accords of Calabrian bergamot and green bergamot. At the heart of the fragrance is an absolute of orange blossom from Tunisia, developed exclusively for the House of Yves Saint Laurent, which gives the perfume its characteristic note. The base note rounds off the olfactory experience with a woody, sensual accord of Indonesian patchouli and Ambrofix™, which gives the fragrance texture and a long-lasting sillage. The design of the bottle is not only purist and modern, but also designed for sustainability. All bottle sizes are refillable, which reduces the consumption of glass, metal, plastic and paper compared to buying several new bottles. The bottle itself contains recycled glass and the outer packaging is FSC™ Mix-certified. Modern men's fragrance with a woody-floral character Fragrance composition of fresh bergamot, orange blossom and patchouli All bottle sizes are refillable Refill concept to reduce packaging material Flacon contains recycled glass and FSC™ Mix-certified cardboard

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Parfum Spray 40 ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Parfum is a composition based on the interplay of fresh and woody notes. The fragrance opens with a clear combination of bergamot, ginger and apple, which is complemented by aldehydes. Aromatic nuances of sage, juniper and geranium unfold in the heart, giving the perfume its fougère character. The base anchors the creation with warm and earthy tones of cedarwood, vetiver and amberwood, rounded off by the depth of incense and tonka bean. The fragrance is characterised by a long-lasting presence. Its fragrance progression remains remarkably stable for hours, giving it a straightforward character. Fragrance direction: Aromatic fougère Character: Fresh, spicy, woody Top notes: bergamot, ginger, apple Special feature: Long-lasting with stable fragrance development

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium is an eau de parfum spray that fascinates with its contrasting composition and energetic character. The fragrance initially unfolds with a sparkling freshness of pear accords and pink pepper, which gently leads into a floral heart. The heart note combines the delicacy of white flowers such as jasmine and orange blossom with the unmistakable aroma of black coffee, giving the composition a special depth and lively tension. The base note forms a warm and sensual finish: Intense vanilla meets woody nuances of patchouli and cedar, leaving a long-lasting impression. This multi-layered fragrance emphasises a self-confident charisma. The iconic bottle is presented in a matching deep black colour, enhanced with a sparkling glitter finish that reflects the glamorous and mysterious side of the perfume. An eau de parfum with a warm, spicy and floral character. A composition of notes of black coffee, white flowers and vanilla. Intense and long-lasting fragrance character. Presented in an iconic, glittering black bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum Spray Intense Intense 30 ml
listings.description: The Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum Spray Intense presents itself as a powerful and feminine interpretation of the well-known Libre fragrance. The composition unfolds through an interplay of contrasting notes that create a warm and elegant aura. At the heart of the fragrance, diva lavender from Provence meets an extravagant orchid accord. This floral bouquet is complemented by orange blossom with its honey-like facets, which lend the creation a special warmth. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with a vanilla-amber accord and vetiver, which leaves an earthy and slightly smoky aftertaste. This eau de parfum spray is characterised by remarkable longevity and a present sillage that underlines the woody-floral character of the fragrance. An intensified and powerful version of the Libre fragrance. Floral composition with diva lavender, orchid and orange blossom. Warm base notes of vanilla, amber and earthy vetiver. A fragrance with remarkable longevity and sillage.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum Spray Berry Crush 30 ml
listings.description: The Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum Spray Berry Crush presents itself as a fruity-floral reinterpretation of the well-known Libre signature. Juicy raspberries open the composition in the top note and give the fragrance a lively, berry character. A creamy coconut note unfolds in the heart, bringing a gentle warmth to the arrangement. The base note combines classic diva lavender from France with Moroccan orange blossom and Madagascan vanilla, creating a harmonious balance between freshness and sensuality. This fragrance is characterised by a higher concentration of perfume oils, which can ensure a long-lasting presence on the skin. The bottle picks up on the berry theme visually and comes in vibrant red tones reminiscent of ripe fruit. The design retains the elegant, slim shape of a dinner jacket, accentuated by the iconic, gold-coloured Cassandre logo that wraps around the glass bottle. An asymmetrical, black cap with golden details completes the jewel-like appearance. Compared to other variants in the line, the focus here is clearly on the fruity accents, while the lavender note remains somewhat more subtle in the background. Fragrance family: Fruity-floral with warm undertones. Main notes: Raspberry, creamy coconut, lavender and vanilla. Character: A fruitier, modern interpretation of the classic Libre fragrance. Design: Elegant glass bottle in berry red tones with gold logo detail. Concentration: Eau de Parfum for an intense fragrance experience.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent La Nuit De L'Homme Eau de Toilette Spray 60 ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent presents La Nuit De L'Homme, an eau de toilette spray that is characterised by its exciting contrasts and elegant radiance. The hexagonal bottle reflects the complexity of the fragrance with its stylish colour gradient from dark to light tones. listings.rawTitle: Tommy Hilfiger Tommy Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Since its launch in 1995, Tommy Eau de Toilette Spray has epitomised a modern, aromatic classic. The composition starts with an invigorating freshness characterised by mint, lavender and tangy grapefruit, while bergamot provides a citrusy accent. An interesting heart note develops as the fragrance progresses, combining fruity Granny Smith apples and cranberries with the spice of cinnamon and nutmeg. This interplay is complemented by floral aspects of cactus blossom and rose. A warm and lasting finish is provided by the base note, which combines elements such as driftwood, maple and poplar with the softness of cotton and ambergris. This fragrance signature captures the atmosphere of a road trip through vast landscapes and symbolises independence. Visually, the rectangular, slightly rounded glass bottle with its "HILFIGER" and "EST. 1985" engravings on the sides and the blue lettering emphasise the timeless character of the brand. Design: Classic glass bottle with silver cap and brand engraving.

listings.rawTitle: Tommy Hilfiger Freedom Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Tommy Hilfiger Freedom Eau de Parfum Spray offers a refreshing fragrance composition that adds a dynamic touch to everyday life. The ribbed glass bottle, with its striking red cap, is a stylish addition to any perfume collection. Fruity and floral notes blend to create a harmonious fragrance experience that leaves a pleasant lightness on the skin. Hints of apple blossom and mandarin open the fragrance, ensuring an invigorating start to the day. As the fragrance develops, floral notes such as jasmine unfold, lending the creation a timeless elegance. A base of cedarwood rounds the composition off, lending the scent a gentle depth. Thanks to its balanced formulation, the perfume can be worn effortlessly on a wide variety of occasions, whether at the office or in your free time. Just a few sprays are enough to create a long-lasting scent that subtly and unobtrusively enhances your personal presence. listings.rawTitle: Tommy Hilfiger Bold Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Tommy Hilfiger (TH) Bold is a strong, fresh fragrance for a man who is looking for new challenges. He embodies the fragrance exactly as he presents himself. Sporty, fresh and masculine.

listings.rawTitle: Tommy Hilfiger Impact Together Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Tommy Hilfiger developed the eponymous brand with a connection to the USA in 1985. Since then, his focus has been on sporty and elegant products. Initially designing only fashion, he introduced his first perfume for men, "Tommy", in 1994. It remains a popular classic to this day and is considered a quality product on which his other fragrances are based. This also applies to the newly released Impact Together Eau de Toilette Spray. It is a men's perfume that elegantly emphasises nonchalance as a daytime fragrance and powerfully brings robust masculinity to the fore with intense spicy components. Tommy Hilfiger Impact Together for the purposeful, modern man This eau de toilette spray opens with an exciting tingle in the nose and a balsamic, spicy top note with pepper. Slightly spicy, the perfume radiates powerful energy - perfect for a successful, motivated start to the day . After a few moments, a woody and earthy note follows, paired with floral and smoky nuances of mugwort and sage. In combination, these heart notes give men a strongly masculine yet slightly playful aura that inspires and energises. A fascinating and motivating aroma emanates from vetiver as a base note. In Tommy Hilfiger Impact Together Eau de Toilette Spray, it exudes strongly smoky and woody fragrance components with undertones of earthy accents and a fine chocolate flavour. This creates an oriental odeur touch that beguiles the senses and creates a lasting, attractive impression .

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The power within. Burberry Goddess tells a story of self-discovery. The new campaign follows Emma Mackey and a pride of lionesses. With her confident, strong, friendly presence, Emma epitomises the spirit of Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum. This unique fragrance has a vegan formulation led by a powerful vanilla trio. Top notes of vanilla infusion with woody nuances, heart notes of vanilla caviar with luscious sweetness and base notes of vanilla absolute enriched with luminous lavender. Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum is contained in an elegant square bottle designed to be refilled. The refill is available separately. The pale pink packaging, decorated with a golden medallion, is a nod to the brand's rich tradition.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: In 2022, Burberry introduces the Eau de Parfum Spray Hero. The fragrance is sweet and woody and is intended for men. Created by perfumer Aurélien Guichard, however, it does not need a pyramid to develop its rather long-lasting presence. Pine needles meet benzoin, atlas cedar combines with Himalayan cedar and Virginia cedar before incense gently envelops everything. The composition of the Eau de Parfum Spray Hero not only has sweet and woody sides, but also resinous elements that prevent the fragrance from becoming too sweet. With Hero, Burberry presents an eau de parfum spray that breaks away a little from the label's well-known British understatement. Modern and casual, elegant Sweet men's fragrances are rarely found at Burberry, which makes this composition all the more exciting. Gentlemen who like it sweet and slightly resinous will get their money's worth with Hero. Especially because the fragrance develops into a really woody drydown over time. Burberry has once again proven that it has a good feel for elegant and timeless trends. And although the fragrance is sweet, it is also masculine , but with a conscious nonchalance , and does not impose itself, after all, it is an eau de parfum spray for the city, where it is often far too crowded and you don't want to wear expansive fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense Spray Refillable / 30 ml
listings.description: Discover the divine essence of femininity with the exquisite Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense Spray from Burberry. This extraordinary perfume is a tribute to the timeless elegance and inner strength of every woman. Its skilfully crafted bottle, which reflects the iconic Burberry design, conceals a fragrance that combines sensuality and sophistication in perfect harmony. Exclusive perfume from Burberry The olfactory experience begins with a gentle breeze of lavender in the top note. This calming opening envelops you in an aura of serenity and freshness, reminiscent of sun-soaked lavender fields in Provence. It is the perfect introduction to a fragrance journey that will enchant your senses. A seductive composition of warm, sweet vanilla unfolds at the heart of Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense Spray. This heart note gives the fragrance a creamy depth and a subtle sweetness reminiscent of golden honey and sun-warmed skin. The vanilla caresses your senses and envelops you in an aura of comfort and sensuality. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with earthy, sensual patchouli. This powerful note gives the perfume depth and character, while at the same time creating a mysterious, almost mystical aura. The patchouli is reminiscent of exotic lands and lends the fragrance an irresistible allure that lingers for a long time. Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense Spray is more than just a fragrance - it is an experience, a transformation. With its intense formulation, the fragrance lasts all day and into the night, perfect for special occasions or when you just want to feel like a goddess.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Burberry Hero is an eau de toilette spray for men launched in 2021. The fragrance is spicy and woody , the straightforward bottle was designed by Riccardo Tisci. Perfumer Aurèlien Guichard composed Hero without a fragrance pyramid. He blends cedar from Virginia, the Atlas Mountains and the Himalayas with spicy black pepper, aromatic juniper and resinous bergamot. Designed in this way, the Burberry Eau de Toilette Spray is masculine but not overpowering, elegant and expressive, yet at the same time refined and discreet. It is the perfect fragrance for everyday wear, where the well-groomed man of today wants to smell good but not overpowering. These heroes also score points in everyday life Hero is a men's fragrance that doesn't need a costume. Sporty and casual , elegant and wearable , the ideal companion for jeans and boots as well as a suit, the Hero eau de toilette spray from Burberry is just like the fashion of the popular British label. A touch of luxury that is evident in the quality and versatility, which does not play itself into the foreground, but is simply there. Very British, very gentlemanly. This fragrance is a real must-have, not just for die-hard Burberry fans, but for anyone who likes a strong yet discreet scent.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense Spray Amber Vanilla Refill / 150 ml
listings.description: Burberry Goddess Amber Vanilla Eau de Parfum Intense offers a warm, multi-layered fragrance composition for everyday wear. The top note, comprising aromatic lavender essence and sweet maple syrup, opens the fragrance experience and lends a touch of refined elegance to your appearance. At the heart of the fragrance, a sophisticated vanilla trio unfolds, creating an inviting aura with its toasted and caramelised notes. This combination is perfect for special evening occasions or moments of relaxation. Velvety amber notes in the base round off the profile and leave a distinctive impression. Spraying the fragrance directly onto pulse points such as the neck, wrists and décolletage intensifies the scent’s development and ensures a long-lasting presence. The refillable, square glass bottle, with its amber-coloured gradient and golden accents, perfectly encapsulates the elegant appearance. A multi-layered fragrance profile featuring lavender, maple syrup and a trio of vanilla notes A velvety amber base for a warm, inviting aura Applying it to pulse points intensifies the fragrance experience Suitable for everyday wear and special occasions Refillable glass bottle in an elegant design

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Perfume 150 ml
listings.description: With the Burberry Hero fragrance, the British designer house continues the success story of the eponymous fragrance range. The creation from 2024 combines balsamic, warm notes with smoky accents and a masculine, woody base . The result is a men's fragrance with a character that is as modern as it is elegant. Modern composition with a classic base The Burberry Hero fragrance opens with a top note dominated by cypriol oil. It sets a woody, earthy accent that is also reminiscent of leather. In the background, the heart note forms an exciting contrast with the warm, sweet and woody scent of amyris oil. The crowning glory of the composition is the base note of cedarwood, a classic ingredient for high-quality fragrances. This modern men's fragrance is perfect for making a statement. With its elegant charisma , it is perfect for the evening. It is equally at home at dinner, in a club or at special events. Burberry Hero perfume comes into its own in cooler weather thanks to its balsamic, woody character.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Hero Parfum Intense 50 ml
listings.description: Experience the fascinating world of Burberry with Parfum Intense, an extraordinary eau de parfum from the Hero collection that redefines modern masculinity. In this masterful composition, natural strength and elegance merge to create a fragrance with a strong character that sets new standards in the world of woody men's fragrances. The fresh essence of pine unfolds in the top note right at the beginning, its clear, natural presence immediately evoking memories of a walk through a majestic coniferous forest. This intense freshness transitions seamlessly into the heart note, where the warm, balsamic sweetness of benzoin unfolds and lends the fragrance a seductive depth and oriental sophistication. Parfum Intense Eau de Parfum Spray - powerful elegance in perfection In the harmonious finale, the composition is carried by precious cedarwood, whose warm, woody nuances blend perfectly with the previous notes and create a long-lasting, masculine signature. This balanced fragrance pyramid creates an unmistakable aura of self-confidence and timeless elegance. The modern design of the Hero bottle with its clear lines and striking shape picks up on the strength of character of the fragrance and emphasises its intensity as an eau de parfum spray. This creates a holistic fragrance experience that lingers on the skin for a long time. Parfum Intense from the Hero collection by Burberry is the ideal companion for today's man who values quality and style . As a worthy representative of the renowned Burberry men's fragrances, it impresses both in a business environment and on special occasions with its expressive yet discreet presence.</p

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Elixir Eau de Parfume Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Burberry Her Elixir Eau de Parfume Spray was released in 2022 and enriches the popular Her fragrance range with a fruity gourmand . Its opaque, deep pink bottle cleverly embodies the fragrance's character: intense, sensual and creamy. The smooth, warm accords make it the perfect cosy fragrance for the cool season. However, its cheerful fruitiness gives Her Elixir a special twist . This also makes the fragrance an uncomplicated companion on warm spring days. Her Elixir - the intensifying flanker The fragrance DNA is closely related to the classic Burberry Her, but Her Elixir has a little more of everything: more creaminess, a pronounced powdery note and more powerful berry accords . These fruity notes dominate the eau de parfume spray at first spray. Strawberry and blackberry as the only top notes create a fresh sweetness in the opening. The heart consists of clear, minimalist and elegant pure jasmine. The result is a carefree, feminine fragrance full of sensuality and joie de vivre. In the dry down, the Burberry Eau de Parfume Spray ends with lush accords of warm vanilla and cosy sandalwood and amber - a composition made for women who like to push boundaries. But beware: you'll probably find it hard to save yourself from compliments.
