For the confident goddess Goddess Burberry is created for the woman who wears her inner strength and beauty with confidence. This perfume is refillable and accompanies you confidently through all of life's situations. It gives you an irresistible aura of self-confidence and timeless elegance.</p

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Burberry Her Eau de Toilette Spray is a floral-fresh fragrance with fruity and green influences . The extravagant fragrance composition is suitable for women who want to emphasise their femininity and present themselves with confidence. Here, sensual sounds meet floral and sparkling notes. British model Fran Summers is the face of the perfume's advertising campaign. With her attractive, romantic and equally powerful charisma , she perfectly reflects the current zeitgeist and the direction of this perfume. The Her Eau de Toilette Spray by Burberry whets the appetite for more and envelops every woman in a cheerful, tender and extremely lively aura . A luxurious fragrance that invites you to dream In the top note, green bergamot, blackcurrant and pink pepper initially unfold their loving aromas. Honeysuckle, peony, rose and lily of the valley take the lead in the heart. In the base note, nuances of musk and cedar wood skilfully round off this unmistakable fragrance experience. Due to its lightness, Burberry Her Eau de Toilette Spray is particularly effective in the warmer seasons from spring to autumn . The minimalist and stylishly designed bottle made of solid glass with the atomiser placed on the side sets the scene for this fragrance in an appealing and tasteful way.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Her Eau de Parfum Intense Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Burberry Her Eau de Parfum Intense Spray takes the iconic fragrance of the traditional British brand and gives it a new, even more intense facet . It goes without saying that this perfume is perfect for anyone who already loves the classic creation for women. Like these, the Burberry Her Eau de Parfum Intense Spray uses a combination of oriental, powdery and fruity extracts to create a varied and multi-layered fragrance. The bottle, which comes in a beautiful pale pink, is also an eye-catcher - and is guaranteed to catch the eye in the bathroom at home. An intense, delicious and exclusive perfume for women The top note of Burberry Her Eau de Parfum Intense Spray opens with very striking and fruity extracts of strawberry. The heart note is also fruity, with floral accords dominating, with orange blossom standing out in particular. The base note uses amberwood to give the entire creation a subtle oriental and exotic touch. The overall fragrance, which is both warm and sparkling, is truly unique. The aura of luxury that this creation exudes from the first spritz is unmistakable - also very suitable for special occasions.</p

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau de Parfum Spray Eau So Extra 30 ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau So Extra Eau de Parfum unveils a multi-layered world of fragrance that accompanies everyday life with an inviting presence. The floral and gourmand notes are ideal for moments of relaxation as well as for special occasions. The scent of the real chocolate flower blends with creamy banana and fruity pear nectar to create a harmonious experience. Warm accents of vanilla and amber round off the profile and leave a lasting impression. Thanks to the high fragrance concentration, just a few sprays are enough to enjoy the composition for many hours, making it economical to use. The green glass bottle, with its cap adorned with colourful flower heads, reflects the character of the fragrance. When using the perfume, it is advisable to avoid contact with the eyes and to protect it from direct heat and flames. Floral gourmand fragrance with chocolate flower, banana and pear nectar Warm base notes of vanilla and amber for a long-lasting scent Intense Eau de Parfum concentration for economical use A versatile composition suitable for everyday wear and special occasions

It opens with a unique blend of toasted almonds and a hint of pink pepper, creating a nutty texture. listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Love Eau de Toilette Spray Eau So Sweet 30 ml
listings.description: Daisy Love Eau So Sweet by Marc Jacobs is a fragrance that evokes sweet light-heartedness and youthful optimism. This composition pays homage to life’s carefree moments and captures a playful spirit, inspired by values such as sisterhood and joy. The fragrance opens with a zesty blend of white raspberry, fresh bergamot and crystallised cloudberries, creating a fruity first impression. At the heart, a delicate bouquet of daisy tree petals unfolds, accompanied by a hint of jasmine milk, lending the eau de toilette its floral character. The base note provides a warm and sensual depth, blending sugar musk with elegant white iris wood. As an Eau de Toilette with a long-lasting formula, it is ideal for everyday wear and will particularly appeal to lovers of sweet gourmand notes who are looking for a fragrance signature that is both fresh and warm. Fragrance character: Sweet and fruity with floral and musky gourmand notes. Fragrance composition: A blend of white raspberry, daisy petals and sugar musk. Fragrance type: Long-lasting eau de toilette, ideal for everyday use.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Perfect Eau de Parfum Spray Just Perfect 30 ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Just Perfect Eau de Parfum adds a fruity, sweet scent to everyday life, leaving a pleasant impression. A fresh opening of strawberry accord, passion fruit, mandarin and raspberry offers a refreshing fragrance experience immediately after spraying. This zesty combination ensures a lively start to the morning. At its heart, the fragrance unfolds a harmonious blend of jasmine sambac, caramel, red apple and orange blossom petals. This heart note lends an elegant aura to your appearance, making it ideal for the office or a relaxed afternoon get-together. The base notes of vanilla absolute and amber sorbet round off the composition and ensure a warm finish. The fragrance thus reliably accompanies you well into the evening. The light blue bottle, with its striking white bow, is a stylish eye-catcher. The practical spray head allows for precise application of the eau de parfum. With its compact 30 ml size, it also fits effortlessly into any bag and offers a simple way to freshen up whilst out and about. listings.rawTitle: Chloé Chloé Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Chloé Eau de Parfum Spray is a modern and elegant interpretation of the classic rose, captured in a floral fragrance. The composition opens with a fresh top note of delicate pink peony, fruity lychee and airy freesia. At the heart of the fragrance, a delicate bouquet of magnolia and lily of the valley unfolds, giving way to a warm base. Notes of cedarwood, amber and a hint of honey lend the perfume its sensual, powdery and characterful finish. The overall result is a light and warm fragrance that combines French charm with a blend of floral notes and lively accents. The romantically designed bottle, inspired by the Chloé Fortune Plissé collection, emphasises the fragrance’s elegance. A silver-plated metal plate and a hand-tied beige bow complete the design. Its timeless appeal was recognised in 2024 with the Austrian Perfume Award in the ‘Classic Women’s Fragrances’ category. A floral fragrance offering a modern interpretation of the rose. A composition of peony, lychee, magnolia and cedarwood. A light, warm and powdery fragrance. An elegant pleated bottle with a hand-tied bow. Awarded “Women’s Classic” at the Austrian Perfume Awards 2024.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Chloé Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Chloé Chloé Eau de Parfum Spray is a modern and elegant interpretation of the classic rose, captured in a floral fragrance. The composition opens with a fresh top note of delicate pink peony, fruity lychee and airy freesia. At the heart of the fragrance, a delicate bouquet of magnolia and lily of the valley unfolds, giving way to a warm base. Notes of cedarwood, amber and a hint of honey lend the perfume its sensual, powdery and characterful finish. The overall result is a light and warm fragrance that combines French charm with a blend of floral notes and lively accents. The romantically designed bottle, inspired by the Chloé Fortune Plissé collection, emphasises the fragrance’s elegance. A silver-plated metal plate and a hand-tied beige bow complete the design. Its timeless appeal was recognised in 2024 with the Austrian Perfume Award in the ‘Classic Women’s Fragrances’ category. A floral fragrance offering a modern interpretation of the rose. A composition of peony, lychee, magnolia and cedarwood. A light, warm and powdery fragrance. An elegant pleated bottle with a hand-tied bow. Awarded “Women’s Classic” at the Austrian Perfume Awards 2024.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray is a floral chypre composition that combines gentle elegance with a sense of freedom. The fragrance opens with the floral freshness of freesia, which meets the sweet, fruity nuances of mirabelle plum in the heart note. In the base, intense oakmoss lends the composition a distinctive, mineral depth and rounds off the fragrance experience. This interplay creates a fragrance that is suitable for both everyday wear and special occasions. The bottle itself reflects the character of the perfume: transparent glass allows a rosé-beige shimmer to shine through, whilst the gold-coloured cap is adorned with a delicate leather strap. A floral chypre fragrance with mineral accents. A composition of fresh freesia, sweet mirabelle plum and intense oakmoss. Embodies a blend of natural elegance and freedom. Presented in a travel-inspired bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Love Story Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Love Story is an eau de parfum inspired by a modern romance set in the streets of Paris. The fragrance composition is floral and fresh, opening with a lively top note. Here, neroli and zesty citrus notes of bergamot, grapefruit and lemon meet the gentle sweetness of pear. As the fragrance develops, the heart unfolds: a bouquet of orange blossom, Madagascar jasmine and classic rose. Fruity accents of blackcurrant and peach lend the heart note a distinctive dimension. The fragrance concludes with a warm base of musk, cedar, patchouli and cashmere wood, which lends the fragrance its enduring character. The fragrance is presented in an elegant, delicate golden bottle, whose design emphasises the perfume’s allure. A fresh, floral fragrance A composition with notes of neroli, orange blossom and cedar Inspired by a modern love story in Paris Presented in an elegant, delicate golden bottle

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Le Parfum Eau de Parfum Spray Refillable 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Le Parfum, a fragrance created in France by perfumer Romain Almairac, is an intense interpretation of the classic signature. The opening unfolds with a powerful accord of orange blossom, which immediately exudes a warm presence and appeals to the senses. This is followed in the heart by an essence of rose, which significantly shapes the structure of the fragrance and lends it an elegant character. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a base of vanilla and tonka bean, which lends the Eau de Parfum Spray a certain depth without becoming overly sweet. Visually, the product captivates with its iconic fluted glass bottle, which holds a light golden liquid and is crowned by a silver cap. A beige label and a hand-tied bow in a dark Bordeaux shade around the neck of the bottle add splashes of colour. The entire range is designed to be refillable in 30 ml, 50 ml and 100 ml sizes, promoting the responsible use of resources. For the nuances to unfold over time, we recommend applying it to pulse points such as the neck, décolleté or the insides of the wrists. Fragrance composition: Powerful orange blossom in the top note, combined with rose essence and a base of vanilla and tonka bean. Character: A warm, intense fragrance that makes a statement without being too sweet. Design: Iconic flacon made of ribbed glass with a silver cap and a burgundy bow. Sustainability: The Eau de Parfum spray is designed to be refillable. Origin: Created by perfumer Romain Almairac and manufactured in France.

listings.description: Chloé’s L’Eau de Parfum Intense Spray is an elegant and powerful women’s fragrance characterised by a multi-faceted composition. listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray Nuit d'Egypt 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Nomade Nuit d'Égypte pays homage to the origins of perfumery and offers a modern interpretation of humanity’s first fragrance: kyphi. Created by perfumer Juliette Karagueuzoglou, this composition takes you on a fascinating journey. The fragrance opens with powerful accents of myrrh, which blend harmoniously with the spicy notes of ginger and cinnamon. At the heart, a bouquet of broom blossom nectar and the opulent orange blossom absolute—sourced directly from the Nile Delta—unfolds. Warm, balsamic nuances of cypriol and opoponax round off the heart note, before a soft vanilla note in the base provides a long-lasting finish. The Eau de Parfum consists of 90 per cent ingredients of natural origin. The bottle is adorned with a ribbon in ‘Egyptian Blue’, one of the oldest man-made pigments, which emphasises the fragrance’s refined character. The packaging also consists partly of recycled materials. An amber-floral fragrance with an intense and sophisticated character. A composition featuring notes of myrrh, orange blossom absolute and vanilla. Contains 90 per cent ingredients of natural origin. Inspired by the formula of the ancient Egyptian Kyphi perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray Jasmin Naturelle 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Nomade Jasmin Naturelle Eau de Parfum Spray is a fragrance inspired by the beauty of the world. At the heart of this feminine fragrance creation by perfumer Caroline Dumur lies Egyptian jasmine, responsibly hand-picked at sunrise. Its floral note blends in the heart with the gentle accent of date, whilst a base of warm vanilla and sandalwood lends a harmonious depth. The composition unfolds with a floral-spicy character and is characterised by a soft, elegant warmth that avoids any cloying sweetness. The formulation is vegan and consists of 100% naturally derived ingredients, with no artificial colourants. The bottle, in earthy ochre tones with a braided detail around the neck, reflects the fragrance’s cosmopolitan character. A feminine, floral-spicy fragrance A composition with notes of jasmine, date and vanilla Vegan formula made from 100% naturally derived ingredients Free from artificial colourings

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Chloé Eau de Parfum Spray Lumineuse 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Lumineuse is an Eau de Parfum created by perfumer Ane Ayo. At the heart of the composition, a full-bodied and complex rose unfolds, elegantly accompanied by velvety notes of Arabian jasmine. A subtle hint of vanilla lends the floral bouquet a special depth, gently underscored by warm amber and balsamic accents. The fragrance’s vegan formula consists of naturally derived fragrances, alcohol and water. The perfume is housed in an elegant, fluted glass bottle in a vintage style. A shiny silver cap and a beige ribbon with a delicate pink stitching adorn the design. The bottle is made from 25% recycled glass and the ribbon from 100% recycled polyester. The perfume is also available as a 150 ml refill pack. A floral fragrance with notes of rose, jasmine and vanilla. Vegan formulation with naturally derived fragrances. Bottle made from recycled materials and available as a refill pack. Elegant, vintage-style bottle design with a distinctive ribbon.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray Jardin d’Égypte 30 ml
listings.description: As the third creation in the Nomade Égypte range, the Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray Jardin d’Égypte takes you on an olfactory journey to the homeland of the brand’s founder, Gaby Aghion. The composition by perfumer Caroline Dumur captures the atmosphere of a sun-drenched Egyptian garden, where ancient traditions blend with modern lightness. The opening notes immediately surprise with an unusual combination of the rare cassia flower and papyrus, lending the fragrance a green, almost mystical freshness. At the heart, a complex interplay of sweet dates and figs unfolds, meeting a spicy kyphi accord. This ancient incense blend, refined with notes of cinnamon and myrrh, lends a resinous depth that nevertheless remains airy. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a warm base of creamy sandalwood, ambrette and solarwood, which lingers on the skin for a long time. Visually, the bottle reflects the connection to nature. The distinctive glass bottle, with its rounded shapes, offers a view of the pale yellow liquid. A woven element frames the front, whilst a green band and a matching tassel on the golden cap add splashes of colour. The golden metal element bearing the lettering “NOMADE” completes the elegant look. Fragrance family: Woody-amber with floral and resinous facets. Top notes: Cassie flower and papyrus for a fresh opening. Heart notes: Date, fig and a spicy kyphi accord (cinnamon, myrrh). Base notes: Sandalwood, Solarwood and ambrette provide warmth. Design: Transparent bottle with green details and a braided rim.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum Spray Lumière d'Égypte 50 ml
listings.description: The Nomade Lumière d'Égypte Eau de Parfum Spray pays homage to the majestic landscapes of Egypt. Inspired by a journey along the Nile, the fragrance opens with a floral and aquatic accord of blue lotus. This airy freshness gives way to a heart of velvety jasmine notes that unfold a sensual warmth. The fragrance concludes with a rich kyphi accord, a classic composition combining notes of cinnamon bark, sandalwood, myrrh, pink pepper and elemi oil. This blend creates a sophisticated fragrance composition that embodies fresh vegetation and the warmth of the desert. The iconic Nomade bottle emphasises the character of the fragrance with golden accents and an elegant blue-grey ribbon. Fragrance profile: Floral, warm Top note: Blue lotus accord Heart note: Jasmine Base note: Kyphi accord

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Chloé Eau de Parfum Spray Rose Naturelle Intense 30 ml
listings.description: Chloé Rose Naturelle Intense Eau de Parfum Spray is a modern and intense interpretation of the iconic rose. Created by perfumer Alexis Dadier, the composition is based entirely on ingredients of natural origin and contains no artificial additives whatsoever. It opens with a sweet, fresh note of bergamot, which gives way to a heart of pure neroli and the exquisite essence of organically grown rose. The base notes lend the fragrance its distinctive character: slightly smoky, upcycled oak wood meets creamy sandalwood and a hint of cedarwood. On the skin, this unfolds into a woody-rosy aroma with a velvety, creamy depth that deliberately sets itself apart from classic floral fragrances. This commitment to naturalness is also reflected in the packaging, which uses recycled materials for the bottle, ribbon and box. A modern, woody-rosy fragrance composition A vegan formula with ingredients of 100% natural origin Elegant heart note of organically grown rose and neroli Warm base note of creamy sandalwood and upcycled oakwood

listings.rawTitle: Laura Biagiotti Forever Eau de Parfum Spray Gold 30 ml
listings.description: The Forever Gold Eau de Parfum Spray complements the fragrances in the Laura Biagiotti Forever collection. The women's fragrance was launched in 2022 and has a floral-spicy presence . Annick Menardo is the nose and gives the eau de parfum spray a top note of plum, blackcurrant buds and Madagascan ginger. For the heart note, she uses the scents of jasmine, tuberose and ylang-ylang. Amber, vanilla and sandalwood form the delicate base. The composition is elegant, wonderfully wearable , feminine and sensual , but not heavy. This makes the Laura Biagiotti Forever Gold Eau de Parfum Spray perfect for spring or warm autumn days and evenings. A touch of Asia Plums and ginger are an extremely popular combination in Asia, both in the world of delicacies and in the world of fragrances. The freshness of the ginger and the slightly tart fruitiness of the plums are subtly framed in the sophisticated fragrance by Laura Biagiotti and exude a wonderful sensuality that is incredibly elegant. In keeping with the fragrance, the Forever Gold bottle is sophisticated and elegant, avoids straight lines, has a subtle golden glass and is also framed by golden elements. The Laura Biagiotti Forever Gold Eau de Parfum Spray is a visual and olfactory delight.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Le Sel d'Issey Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Le Sel d'Issey by Issey Miyake is an eau de parfum spray that celebrates the olfactory encounter between sea and earth. This woody-aquatic composition, created by Quentin Bisch, is characterised by its intense and powerful character. It opens with a spicy freshness of ginger, sea salt and incense. In the heart note, a maritime accord of seaweed and sea grass unfolds, accompanied by sand vetiver. The base provides a warm and earthy depth, combining notes of amber, recycled cedarwood and oakmoss. The perfume is certified vegan and its formula consists of 94% ingredients of natural origin. The refillable bottle made from 20% recycled glass underlines the aesthetics of the fragrance with its smoky grey colour gradient and gunmetal-look cap. Woody, aquatic and spicy fragrance Composition of sea salt, ginger, incense, cedarwood and oakmoss Vegan formula with 94% ingredients of natural origin Refillable bottle made from partially recycled glass

The composition combines floral elegance with warm amber notes, giving the perfume a modern, sensual aura. It opens with the sparkling freshness of organic green mandarin, which lends the fragrance a lively lightness. A sunny orange blossom unfolds in the heart, giving the perfume its feminine and luminous note. In the base, pistachio wood accords and creamy sandalwood of natural origin create a warm, elegant depth that lingers on the skin for a long time. The vegan formula consists of 90% ingredients of natural origin and is made with French alcohol of natural origin. listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme Eau de Toilette Spray 40 ml
listings.description: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme is an eau de toilette that is characterised by a clear, woody-aquatic signature. It opens with a sparkling freshness of Japanese yuzu, which meets mandarin and lemon flavours. At the heart of the composition, a special combination of aquatic nénuphar notes and the warm spice of nutmeg and cinnamon unfolds. These facets give the fragrance its characteristic depth. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with a powerful blend of tobacco, ambergris, sandalwood and vetiver, leaving a striking impression. The design of the bottle reflects the character of the fragrance: a simple, rectangular glass container with a matt grey metal cap. The product is available in different sizes and there is a refill bottle that is only compatible with the bottles labelled "RECHARGEABLE". A fragrance from the woody-aquatic fragrance family. Composition of fresh yuzu, spicy nutmeg and warm sandalwood. Presented in a clear, minimalist glass bottle. Available as an eau de toilette in 75 ml, 125 ml and 200 ml sizes.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Le Sel d'Issey Eau de Toilette Spray - refillable 50 ml
listings.description: Le Sel d'Issey is a watery, woody fragrance creation by Issey Miyake launched in 2024. At the centre of the composition is a powerful salt accord that is reminiscent of the untamed nature of the sea and is accompanied by fresh ginger. The heart note then combines maritime echoes of seaweed with the earthy texture of sand vetiver. A foundation of warm cedarwood and oakmoss gives the fragrance depth and a woody signature. The vegan fragrance is presented in a refillable bottle created by designer Tokujin Yoshioka and made from 20% recycled glass. The outer packaging also reflects a conscious use of resources, as it is made from FSC™-certified materials and a proportion of upcycled seaweed. Scent direction: Watery-woody Fragrance notes: Salt accord, sand vetiver, cedarwood Character: Maritime and powerful Properties: Vegan and refillable

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Parfum Spray by Issey Miyake is a more intense and warmer interpretation of the iconic classic fragrance. The floral-aquatic composition opens with a clear top note of lotus, freesia and rose, complemented by aquatic accents of calone. The delicate note of osmanthus unfolds in the heart, lending the fragrance a subtle depth. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a base of warm, precious woods that ensure a long-lasting impression. The fragrance finds its home in a slim, minimalist bottle. Crowned by a metal cap with a delicate sphere at the top, the design reflects the pure elegance of the composition. The formulation contains no acetone, ammonia, gluten or palm oil and was developed without animal testing. A refill bottle is also available for this product. listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Le Sel d'Issey Parfum 50 ml
listings.description: The Issey Miyake Le Sel D'Issey Eau de Parfum combines fresh, nature-inspired fragrance accords into a minimalist composition for everyday use. The fragrance is presented in an elegant, cylindrical glass bottle with a subtle colour gradient. The top notes of yuzu, bergamot and lemon create a crisp opening that evokes a revitalising sensation in the morning. This is followed by a spicy-floral heart note of cinnamon, geranium, lily of the valley and saffron, which unfolds its aromas and lends the fragrance profile a pleasant depth. Woody notes of musk, cedar and sandalwood, combined with Sichuan pepper and fir balsam, form the base, ensuring a long-lasting presence throughout the day. Thanks to its aquatic character, the fragrance can be worn in a variety of ways throughout all four seasons. For the fragrance to develop to its full potential, it is best to spray the perfume directly onto warm areas of skin such as the wrists or chest; however, those with sensitive skin should avoid direct skin contact. Avoiding light-coloured garments and thin fabrics when spraying will help protect the textiles. A minimalist, aquatic fragrance composition for versatile everyday use Top notes of yuzu and lemon for a fresh opening A woody-spicy base note ensures a long-lasting scent Suitable for wear all year round, in all four seasons Elegant bottle design with a subtle colour gradient

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Toilette Spray is the first fragrance from the House of Issey Miyake and a timeless composition inspired by the purity of water. Developed by perfumer Jacques Cavallier, this women's fragrance belongs to the family of floral-aquatic creations. The fragrance experience begins with a clear top note in which lotus and rose combine to create a light, transparent aura. At the heart, an opulent bouquet of lilies and an arrangement of fresh flowers unfolds, giving the fragrance its characteristic floral depth. The base note of precious woods provides a warm and lasting finish that harmoniously rounds off the composition. Facets of freesia, calone and musk emphasise the unmistakable aquatic character and lend the eau de toilette a sensual yet unobtrusive presence. The slim, conical bottle, whose shape is reminiscent of a drop of water, reflects the essence of the fragrance. Fragrance direction: Floral-aquatic Head note: lotus, rose Heart note: lily, fresh flowers Base note: Precious woods Character: Timeless, clear, sensual

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau Essentielle Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau Essentielle Eau de Parfum brings a floral, aquatic fragrance experience to everyday life. Inspired by the journey of a raindrop, this fragrance combines natural elements into a harmonious whole. The top note of green leaves and clear water notes creates a fresh feeling that offers a pleasant accompaniment, especially on warm days or during long working days in the office. At the heart of the fragrance, lilac and magnolia unfold a subtle floral presence that conveys an understated elegance. A hint of musk in the base rounds off the profile and leaves a gentle finish on the skin. The fine spray head distributes the eau de parfum evenly, making it easy and precise to apply in the morning. The light fragrance aura reliably accompanies the person applying it through various everyday situations without being overpowering. The minimalist, conical bottle with its matt, wood-like cap reflects the clear focus of the fragrance. listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme Eau de Parfum Spray Intense Wood&Wood 50 ml
listings.description: L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme Wood&Wood by Issey Miyake is an ode to the multifaceted power of nature, captured in a woody, citrusy fragrance. This intense composition from 2019 unfolds as an olfactory journey through the forest, revealing its depth with every spray. The opening is an invigorating combination of tangy grapefruit, which meets the spicy warmth of cardamom and the resinous aroma of elemi for a fresh first impression. At the heart of the fragrance is a striking duo of Virginia cedar and sandalwood. These powerful woods are complemented by a subtle apricot accent and the complexity of ambroxan, giving the heart note an unexpected softness. The base note anchors the experience with earthy notes of patchouli and Haitian vetiver. Additional woody accords and a hint of musk round off the Eau de Parfum Spray Intense and give it a long-lasting, present character that reflects the minimalist and modern style of the brand. listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Parfum Spray Intense 30 ml
listings.description: Inspired by the infinite power and depth of the ocean, Issey Miyake presents L'Eau d'Issey Eau de Parfum Spray Intense. This refillable women's fragrance unfolds an intense floral-aquatic signature, conceived by perfumer Amandine Clerc-Marie as a bold and innovative composition. At the heart of the fragrance is a special Posidonia accord that evokes the vast, vibrant underwater meadows and gives the perfume its unique character. This aquatic note is complemented by exotic ylang-ylang in the heart note, while a base of warm vanilla provides a sensual depth. The formula is vegan-certified and consists of 91% ingredients of natural origin. The design of the bottle also pays homage to nature: the silver-coloured cap imitates metallic water reflections and, as a patented innovation, is made entirely from wood, thus avoiding the use of plastic. As a sign of conscious use of resources, the bottle is refillable for the first time. At the heart of the composition, aquatic accords combine with the powdery elegance of iris and the spice of coriander to recreate the feeling of cool surf on the skin. The base note anchors the fragrance with warm, woody nuances of cedarwood and the salty depth of ambergris, reminiscent of sun-dried driftwood on the shore. The fragrance is presented in a minimalist bottle with a cotton label inspired by Maison Margiela's fashion labels, emphasising the unique character of the Replica range. A fresh and aquatic unisex fragrance with woody and spicy accents. Inspired by the memory of a sailing day at sea. Fragrance composition with notes of aldehydes, marine accords, iris and cedarwood. Part of the Replica collection, which captures specific moments and places olfactorily. Presented in a purist bottle with a characteristic fabric label.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Eau de Toilette Spray Under The Stars 30 ml
listings.description: The Replica Under The Stars Eau de Toilette Spray by Maison Margiela is a composition that evokes the atmosphere of a clear night in nature. The fragrance unfolds a warm, spicy character characterised by woody and leathery notes. It opens with a striking note of black pepper, which fades into a heart of a striking leather accord. In the base, the composition finds its depth through a sophisticated blend of oud infusion, labdanum resinoid and Virginia cedarwood. Subtle nuances of cinnamon leaves emphasise the spicy orientation of the fragrance. As an eau de toilette, the long-lasting fragrance develops from an intense, leathery presence to a softer finish. For optimal development, we recommend spraying onto the pulse points, for example after showering or bathing. Fragrance: Warm-spicy, woody, leathery Head note: Black pepper Heart note: leather accord Base note: oud infusion, labdanum resinoid, Virginia cedarwood Product type: Eau de toilette spray

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La vie est belle Eau de Parfum Spray Vanille Nude 30 ml
listings.description: Lancôme's La Vie Est Belle Vanille Nude Eau de Parfum Spray is a composition characterised by warmth and elegance. It opens with sunny jasmine Grandiflorum Solaire, whose flowers come from sustainable sources in the French region of Grasse and add a floral lightness. At the heart of the fragrance composition, the full flavour of frosted vanilla bourbon unfolds, which is also sustainably sourced from Madagascar and lends the fragrance a special depth. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a base of creamy white musk and soft sandalwood, which provides a delicate finish. The combination of these selected notes results in a sensual yet delicate fragrance character. This creation was developed by perfumers Anne Flipo and Dominique Ropion. The fragrance is presented in the typical bottle for the range, which is designed in a powdery pink colour for this edition and decorated with a glittering ribbon. A warm, floral fragrance character with a creamy finish. Composition of solar jasmine, frosted vanilla bourbon and white musk. Created by the renowned perfumers Anne Flipo and Dominique Ropion. Presented in the iconic bottle in a delicate, powdery pink shade.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Trésor Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Lancôme Trésor Eau de Parfum Spray is characterised by its subtle and romantic fragrance composition, which conveys a feeling of warmth. It opens with delicate notes of rose petals that combine with apricot and peach blossom. At the heart of the composition, an elegant bouquet of iris, lily of the valley and heliotrope unfolds, gently rounded off with a hint of vanilla. A base of sandalwood, musk and amber lends the fragrance a long-lasting, powdery depth. Created by perfumer Sophia Grojsman, Trésor is a timeless classic that harmoniously combines fruity, floral and woody accords. The bottle itself is modelled on a precious piece of jewellery with a faceted design that catches and reflects the light in a special way, while a black ring on the cap adds an elegant accent. A floral-powdery fragrance with fruity and woody accents. Composition of rose petals, iris, peach and sandalwood. Created by the perfumer Sophia Grojsman. Presented in a bottle modelled on a piece of polished jewellery.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La vie est belle Eau de Parfum Spray L'Elixir Very Cherry 10 ml
listings.description: Lancôme’s La Vie Est Belle L’Elixir Very Cherry Eau de Parfum is a reliable companion throughout the day with its fruity-woody composition. The top note of black cherry offers a crisp fragrance experience that ensures an immediate, vibrant start to your morning. As the fragrance develops, violet leaves, iris, sambac jasmine and Damask rose unfold into a floral bouquet that elegantly enhances your presence on special occasions or in the office. Finally, the base notes of warm oud, vanilla, patchouli, cocoa butter, soft leather and cedarwood gently blend with your skin. This deep combination gives the fragrance remarkable longevity, meaning you won’t need to reapply it even on long evenings. The handy 30-ml bottle fits effortlessly into any handbag, making it easy to carry with you throughout the day. Simply spray the eau de parfum onto clean skin and allow it to dry briefly to experience the full development of the fragrance notes. A fruity-floral fragrance composition with a distinctive top note of black cherry Long-lasting wear for a sustained fragrance experience without the need for reapplication A warm base note of oud, vanilla and cedarwood blends gently with the skin The compact 30 ml size is ideal for hassle-free everyday use

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo Man Aqua Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Jimmy Choo transports you to the world of the oceans with Man Aqua. The eau de toilette spray is a homage to the sea in its seeming infinity, beauty and strength. However, you will not only find refreshment in the fragrance, but also a versatile blend of different nuances that inspires and can provide a spontaneous, mental holiday in almost any situation! A fragrance full of ocean magic The stage is set for Man Aqua, whose top notes are already captivating with their sweet spiciness. It is a duet of cardamom and grapefruit that puts you in a good mood and marks the ideal start to the day. In the heart note, floral geranium meets clary sage, along with the aquatic marine note that gives Jimmy Choo Man Aqua Eau de Toilette Spray its name. At this point at the latest, you will feel as if you have been transported to the beach or are travelling by boat across the ocean, feeling the waves and the wind. The base note of the fragrance also emphasises this idea with salted moss, amber and patchouli. These elements have been deliberately interwoven to create a fragrance component that is reminiscent of seafaring. Even the bright blue bottle fits perfectly into the picture. Who will you treat to a mental journey to the sea?

listings.rawTitle: Liquides Imaginaires Fortis Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Fortis by Liquides Imaginaires is a creation characterised by a striking woody-spicy signature. The composition unfolds with a powerful top note of saffron, cumin, oud and cypriol, which leaves an intense first impression. At the heart of the fragrance, warm woody nuances of guaiac and cedar wood combine with amyris and vetiver to create a multi-layered accord. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with sandalwood, musk, amber, patchouli and a subtle hint of vanilla, giving the perfume a remarkable depth. Fortis presents itself as a complex and enveloping fragrance whose character is characterised by a smoky, spicy warmth. As an eau de parfum, it has a high concentration of fragrance oils. The spray can be applied to warm areas of skin for a long-lasting fragrance experience. Scent: Woody and spicy Character: Complex, enveloping, smoky-warm Head notes: Saffron, cumin, oud, cypriol Fragrance intensity: High (eau de parfum)

listings.rawTitle: Liquides Imaginaires Les Eaux de L'Est Eau de Parfum Spray Fleur de Sable 50 ml
listings.description: The inspiration for this extraordinary niche perfume comes from the idea of a crystalline flower that thrives in the midst of dry dunes and defies the harsh desert wind. As part of the Les Eaux de L'Est collection, the Liquides Imaginaires brand presents Fleur de Sable, an olfactory journey that artfully combines spicy and floral elements. It opens with a fresh, almost mineral combination of bergamot, mandarin and a pinch of pink pepper, accompanied by an imaginary wind note and salty accents. At the centre of the creation developed by Amélie Bourgeois is wild eglantine, also known as dog rose, which is given a gentle, characterful sharpness by the unusual addition of paprika. Nuances of black pepper, myrrh and iris, which combine harmoniously with ambroxan, provide a profound finish in the base note. The cylindrical bottle with its transparent glass underside and striking gold-coloured cap with embossed ring underlines the exclusivity of the eau de parfum spray. Floral-spicy fragrance composition with mineral and salty accents. Top note combines bergamot, pink pepper and a special wind note. Heart notes of wild dog rose (eglantine) and paprika. Base note with myrrh, iris, black pepper and ambroxan. Elegant bottle with gold-coloured details and transparent glass base.

listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu Fleur de Lait Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Fleur de Lait Eau de Parfum Spray by Miu Miu is a composition that is reminiscent of an exotic dessert and caresses the senses with a creamy texture. This floral-fruity fragrance is characterised by its bold yet feminine character, inspired by the carefree lightness of a mango dessert. The base note of velvety coconut milk rounds off the olfactory experience and lends it a pleasant, sweet depth. The interplay of fruity juiciness, floral delicacy and creamy warmth creates a sensual yet sophisticated fragrance experience. For optimum development, the spray can be applied to warm areas of skin such as the wrists or neck, where the body heat intensifies the notes. listings.description: Miu Miu L'eau de Muguet Eau de Parfum Spray captures a youthful and lively mood and presents itself as the first women's fragrance from the House of Miu Miu. The composition belongs to the olfactory family of fresh floral fragrances and is characterised by its contrasting facets. It opens with the clear and unmistakable note of lily of the valley, which gives the fragrance its characteristic freshness. As the fragrance progresses, green accords and the subtle nuances of dog rose unfold in the heart, leading to a surprising finale. The base note of Akigalawood provides depth and an exciting accent. This special woody accord with its earthy and subtly peppery notes creates a fascinating contrast to the floral lightness. The result is a clear, clean fragrance that emphasises a playful yet bold femininity. For optimal development, we recommend applying to warm areas of skin such as the wrists or neck, as body heat intensifies the fragrance notes. A fresh, floral fragrance with a contrasting character. listings.description: The J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin Finale Eau de Parfum Spray is a tribute to the vibrant stage life of Berlin, where classic elegance meets modern avant-garde. listings.rawTitle: J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin 1A - 33 Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The name, the fragrance, the brand - everything about this unisex fragrance is unusual. In 2012, the company J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin, originally founded in 1856, was revitalised by three young designers and began its triumphal march with the Eau de Parfum Spray 1A - 33. At the turn of the century, this was Berlin's car registration number. The bottle is just as classic as the name, with its straightforward shape standing out from the mass of ornate and decorated bottles. At the same time, it arouses curiosity about the clear, delicately golden contents. The fragrance 1A - 33 by J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin was first launched over 100 years ago for women; the 2012 reinterpretation is aimed at both men and women. A piece of Berlin history that everyone loves The eau de parfum spray is fresh and floral , perfect for summer and spring, with top notes of mandarin and red pepper. The design team created the heart note with lime blossom, magnolia and jasmine sambac. Finally, iris and cedarwood create a warm finish that makes 1A - 33 a very special summer unisex fragrance. Less is more and J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin has achieved the feat of creating an eau de parfum spray that perfectly combines freshness and warmth . Let yourself be seduced by this unusual fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin Bachanal Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin Bachanal Eau de Parfum accompanies you through your day with a multi-layered fragrance composition. The practical spray bottle, with its golden cylindrical design, holds 10 millilitres and fits perfectly into any bag for a hassle-free touch-up whilst out and about. The Berlin-based manufacturer crafts this fragrance by hand, combining selected ingredients to create a unique olfactory experience. Immediately after spraying, a top note of bergamot, bitter almond and pistachio opens the fragrance profile, creating a fresh yet slightly nutty impression. As the fragrance develops, the heart note unfolds with accords of coconut, geranium and patchouli. This combination lends the fragrance a pleasant depth, making it well-suited for evening occasions or special moments. The fragrance concludes with a warm base of vanilla absolute, cocoa resinoid and various woods. These base notes round off the fragrance experience and ensure a long-lasting presence. Thanks to the fine atomiser, the perfume can be applied precisely and sparingly. listings.description: The Rausch Eau de Parfum Spray by J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin is a composition inspired by the vibrant atmosphere of Berlin's nightlife. In the heart note, earthy nuances of cypriol and patchouli combine with the gentle sweetness of vanilla bean to create a harmonious interplay. The base rounds off the fragrance experience with deep amber and smoky oud, giving the perfume a mysterious and long-lasting aura. Developed by perfumer Véronique Nyberg, this fragrance character presents itself as a spicy-woody creation with a dark, sensual depth. The eau de parfum is produced in Germany and comes in a 50 ml glass bottle with atomiser. Spicy, woody fragrance with smoky and sweet accents Composition of red pepper, cypriol, vanilla bean, amber and oud. Inspired by the unique club culture of Berlin. listings.rawTitle: J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin Zeitgeist Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Zeitgeist fragrance by J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin captures the multi-layered atmosphere of the German capital in one composition. Inspired by the contrasts between urban nature and modern life, this eau de parfum combines aquatic freshness with warm, woody nuances. The composition opens with a clear, maritime note of calone and algae absolute, which is given subtle depth by amber xtreme and Peru balsam. As the fragrance progresses, a soft musk complex unfolds, lending the fragrance a gentle yet present aura. The fragrance experience is rounded off by the striking base note of leatherwood, which adds a woody, leathery accent. The result is a purist and contemporary fragrance that exudes understated elegance and is suitable for a variety of occasions. listings.rawTitle: J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin Fougair Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Unisex, spicy and fresh , that's the scent of the Fougair eau de parfum spray. It comes from the small but fine niche label J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin. Launched in 2021, the fine fragrance breaks new ground and leaves the path that J.F. Schwarzlose in Berlin set with its formulas at the beginning of the 20th century. Fougair Eau de Parfum Spray has top notes of fern, pink pepper and bergamot. The heart note consists of artemesia, boxwood and cypress. Fir balsam forms the intense prelude to the base and blends with amber and patchouli. When past and present become the future When the founders of J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin found the old formulas and adapted them to modern requirements and specifications, it was more than important to them to maintain the classic, the art and the olfactory aesthetics. And it is precisely these demands that new creations such as Fougair must also fulfil. The eau de parfum is expressive, but not overpowering. It is perceptible and discreet and a wonderful all-rounder that is suitable anytime and anywhere. J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin has not only created a new fragrance, but also a signature fragrance. Ladies and gentlemen who appreciate something special will love the Fougair eau de parfum spray.

listings.rawTitle: J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin Etrango Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Etrango by J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin is a unique and vibrant unisex fragrance that reflects the diversity and charm of the city of Berlin . The perfume manufacturer J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin is one of the most renowned houses in Germany. Since 1929, unique and fantastic fragrance creations have been created in the heart of Berlin, which are now sought after worldwide. The Eau de Parfum Spray in its glamorous gold and black bottle is also a coveted collector's item. Fragrance description Etrango J.F. Schwarzlose Berlin The unisex fragrance is inspired by exotic spices, fresh citrus fruits and the diversity that characterises the city of Berlin. It is opulent, exotic and sensual at the same time. The top note is dominated by the fresh scent of bergamot and rounded off with cumin and saffron . The imaginative heart is formed by precious jasmine and the noble Damask rose as well as a pinch of carnation. The base and the long-lasting part of the fragrance is made up of patchouli, oakmoss and cypriol . Other natural fragrance components round off this exclusive eau de parfum spray. Immerse yourself in the fantastic world of fragrances by J.F. Schwarzlose and experience a sensational and unforgettable perfume that is just as multifaceted and interesting as the capital city of Berlin.

listings.description: Acqua Alpes Oud 3333 is a complex fragrance composition inspired by the majestic Schaufelspitze in the Tyrolean Alps, whose altitude of 3333 metres gives the eau de parfum its name. The creation combines the freshness of pure Alpine spring water with a deep, spicy warmth. The fragrance opens with a stimulating blend of saffron, cardamom and a hint of mandarin. At the heart, a multi-layered bouquet of iris, incense and black pepper unfolds, giving the fragrance its special character. The base is rich and long-lasting, characterised by precious oud, also known as eaglewood, which is accompanied by sandalwood, amber and patchouli. This unisex perfume unfolds its spicy, woody elegance both during the day and in the evening. listings.rawTitle: Mercedes Benz Perfume Man Eau de Toilette Spray Star 30 ml
listings.description: The refreshing Mercedes Benz Perfume Man Star Eau de Toilette Spray delights men with a subtle fragrance nuance composed of the finest essences. Delicate fruity pears, tart oakmoss, woody notes of rosewood and genuine musk mallow seed combine to create a tantalising fragrance that transports masculine men into a world of adventure. Created exclusively by the luxury brand Mercedes, Mercedes Benz Perfume is a contemporary fragrance experience for active, sporty men who love fast cars. Perfumer Oliver Cresp created the fragrance in 2015 for the Mercedes fragrance world. The masculine spray is available in two different sizes. Man Star Eau de Toilette Spray - fragrance for discerning men The dominant Mercedes Benz Perfume Man Star Eau de Toilette Spray is bottled in a visually appealing bottle in the colours black, silver and blue. The dark bottle with the silver-coloured star on a shimmering blue background is a symbol of the luxurious cars from Mercedes. At first glance, it is reminiscent of a car key that promises an exciting drive. The name of the eau de toilette can be read on the side of the dark bottle. Each spray from the innovatively designed eau de toilette spray lasts a long time on the skin and hair.

listings.rawTitle: Mercedes Benz Perfume Woman in Red Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Woman in Red - interesting Eau de Parfum Spray A Mercedes Benz perfume like Woman in Red demonstrates the versatility of parfumdreams.de. This perfume for women is characterised by the harmony of its individual fragrance components. There are scents of fruit that meet jasmine and gardenia in the heart. In the base note, benzoin, patchouli, sandalwood and tonka bean round off the entire composition perfectly. The well-known perfumer Honorine Blanc was responsible for creating this fantastic fragrance. The Eau de Parfum Spray Mercedes Benz Perfume is a fragrance that is well worth trying. Personal experience is always the best. The secret lies between pear and tonka bean As is so often the case, the secret to an impressive fragrance experience is the successful combination of top, heart and base notes. The top note of the Eau de Parfum Spray Woman in Red begins with mandarin, cherry blossom, pear and pistachio. This is followed by heart notes of gardenia and jasmine sambac. The fragrance complex is rounded off in the base note with benzoin, patchouli, sandalwood and tonka bean. The end result is a very well harmonised product. Parts and fragrances that harmonise perfectly with each other are the basis for a reliably functioning combination of fragrance nuances. When fragrances go together, everything is good!

The result is a modern yet timeless fragrance that impresses with the sophisticated balance of its high-quality ingredients. listings.rawTitle: Mercedes Benz Perfume The Move Eau de Toilette Spray 60 ml
listings.description: "The Move" by Mercedes Benz Perfume is an eau de toilette spray made for the man who never stands still, is always on the move and is constantly setting himself new goals, which he intends to achieve with a pleasantly fresh fragrance behind him. The aromatic fragrance of "The Move" is dominated by various marine notes and transports its wearer to the sea, vibrant coastal cities and faraway lands. The minimalist bottle with its oval shape and innovative spray cap is also pleasantly eye-catching - the Mercedes logo is of course clearly visible on the front and is cleverly accentuated by the azure blue colour. To the sea with Mercedes Benz Perfume With its pleasantly light fragrance silhouette, the eau de toilette spray "The Move" is a successful all-rounder and escapes typical conventions. It is therefore undoubtedly aimed at a young or young-at-heart target group. The cardamom, tonka bean and grapefruit accords, for example, dominate this eau de toilette spray from Mercedes Benz Perfume. Many of the accords in this fragrance are those that we naturally associate with trips to the seaside. The eau de toilette is free from silicones, palm oil and parabens and has no oily ingredients, making it feel almost weightless.

listings.rawTitle: Mercedes Benz Perfume Air, Sea & Land Eau de Parfum Spray Sea 30 ml
listings.description: Like the Air product, the Sea Eau de Parfum Spray from Mercedes Benz Perfume is inspired by nature . Sea & Land and the air are the inspiration for these unique fragrances. A perfume like this conveys the longing for freedom and the departure for something new. The whole thing is packaged in a very stylish, refillable bottle made of aluminium and recycled glass. Even the outer packaging is something special: it contains small amounts of algae. Every perfume in this range is unusual and aromatic release for suppressed energies . The balancing base is formed by the woody scent of patchouli and the resinous and tart note of turmeric. The Sea Eau de Parfum Spray is just as special as the Parfum Air and the Land product. This fragrance trilogy conveys the elements of air, sea and land in an intense way.

A special feature: this perfume can be worn on its own or combined with the other two creations from the Air, Sea & Land collection. This creates a unique fragrance experience.

Fresh all-rounder with modern appeal The fresh aura of Air Eau de Parfum Spray is created by a top note of mugwort in combination with citrusy essences. This is mixed with a further floral accent of angelica in the heart note. A masculine, spicy-woody base of turmeric leaf and patchouli discreetly rounds off this fragrance for men by Mercedes Benz Perfume. Air Eau de Parfum Spray is a light fragrance with an uncomplicated character. This makes it the perfect choice for a wide variety of occasions - for business, sport and leisure. A special feature: this perfume can be worn on its own or combined with the other two creations from the Air, Sea & Land collection. This creates a unique fragrance experience.

The eau de parfum is presented in an elegant bottle with a design that reflects the brand's values and exudes a modern aesthetic. listings.rawTitle: Mercedes Benz Perfume Floral Fantasy Eau de Toilette Spray 60 ml
listings.description: With the Mercedes Benz Perfume Floral Fantasy Eau de Toilette Spray, there are literally no limits to your imagination - at least not when it comes to choosing your perfume. This feminine creation clearly demonstrates that neither beautiful cars nor multi-layered fragrances are the exclusive preserve of men. The feminine perfume, which features a beautiful floral bouquet on the bottle, is almost weightlessly light, is suitable for everyday wear as well as the office and, unsurprisingly, captivates with many beautiful floral fragrance accords. A perfume as colourful as spring The Mercedes Benz Perfume Floral Fantasy Eau de Toilette Spray opens with a multi-layered top note that harmonises powerful blackcurrants with carrot seeds, various citrus fruits and blood orange. The fruity fruit platter is then complemented by the eponymous floral accords in the heart note of Mercedes Benz Perfume Floral Fantasy Eau de Toilette Spray: Neroli, tea leaves and carrot seeds make for an imaginative and by no means standardised composition that demonstrates a great love of creativity. In order to ground the fruity-floral fragrance silhouette and wrap it in a subtle frame, the fragrance finally moves on to various warm woods, moss and musk in its base note.

listings.rawTitle: Mercedes Benz Perfume Air, Sea & Land Eau de Parfum Spray 60 ml
listings.description: Many people know Mercedes Benz from the automotive industry. The vehicle manufacturer is one of the best-known German companies in the automotive industry. Mercedes Benz Perfume is a noble series that not only inspires car drivers. The Air, Sea & Land perfume is a three-part fragrance that combines the elements of everyday life. The Air eau de parfum spray contains airy fragrance notes that have an energising effect. The sea exudes maritime odours and there are so many natural scents on land that it takes a special sense of smell to create a fragrance worthy of Mercedes. The top note is dominated by the spiciness of pepper. A powerful fragrance that sharpens the wearer's senses. Although there are many masculine elements in the fragrance spray, it is by no means masculine in character. Eau de Parfum Spray from the Mercedes Benz Perfume line Cocoa is considered a sweet in everyday life. Natural cocoa is very aromatic, slightly sour and only tastes and smells pleasant when sweetness is added. In the Eau de Parfum Spray, cocoa dominates in the heart note. In the base note, Air, Sea & Land by Mercedes Benz Perfume contains the harmonious scent of tonka bean. The fragrance combination is the ideal gift for self-confident people.

listings.rawTitle: Mercedes Benz Perfume Sign Eau de Toilette Spray Your Attitude / 50 ml
listings.description: In 2022, Mercedes Benz Perfume introduces the Sign Your Attitude Eau de Toilette Spray. It is a fresh green part of the Sign Collection and was developed for men. Like every perfume from the Mercedes Benz Perfume Sign Collection, the eau de toilette spray comes in a striking bottle that is instantly recognisable. After all, the star is emblazoned on the large rectangular bottle. The Sign Your Attitude bottle is silver in colour, while the other perfume bottles in the collection are black and blue. The perfumer of the eau de toilette spray is the great Fabrice Pellegrin. He combines the flavours of bergamot, ginger and mandarin in the top note. Lavender, cinnamon, nutmeg and cypress form the centre, with amberwood as a soloist at the end. Full luxury, on the street and in the bottle Mercedes Benz Perfume takes luxury off the street and puts it on the skin. Your Attitude Eau de Toilette is for men who like to appear well-groomed , but don't want to surround themselves with an overpowering perfume. The eau de toilette spray is simply the perfect companion anytime and anywhere, just like its travelling equivalent. The fragrance is simply a must, not just for fans of Mercedes Benz.

Roberto Ugolini Derby Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Roberto Ugolini: This name stands for the Florentine way of life. Born into a family of shoemakers, he learnt the traditional craft at an early age. Simple repair work was followed by the step to becoming a shoe designer. His Italian flair for fashion and exceptional craftsmanship allowed him to design and produce marvellous shoe models. His fragrances are inspired by the characteristics of the shoes. With Derby, he presents an elegant spicy, woody unisex fragrance . Derby: a stylish, sporty fragrance for him and her The Derby is a versatile shoe model. Depending on the design, it can be worn with an elegant suit or casual chic. It is comfortable in any case. And when the shoe is made by a master of his trade like Roberto Ugolini, it is a stylish, unique model. The two perfumers Cristian Calabrò and Maurizio Cerizza have created a multi-faceted eau de parfum spray to match the shoe type, which can be worn by men and women on numerous occasions. The herbaceous, spicy fragrance of mugwort, basil and cardamom forms the top note. Cinnamon, caraway and allspice mingle with jasmine and myrrh in the heart note. The eau de parfum spray closes with a complex base accord of patchouli, birch, vetiver and musk, complemented by fine sandalwood and cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Ugolini 4 Rosso Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: 4 Rosso - an unusual name for an eau de parfum spray. But anyone who has ever visited Florence can solve the riddle. It is a business address that is marked in red in the Italian city. To be precise, it is the address of Roberto Ugolini, the Florentine shoe designer. The luxurious, exciting fragrance is aimed at all perfume lovers who attach particular importance to style and elegance. 4 Rosso - a creative unisex fragrance with Italian flair Most of Roberto Ugolini's fragrance creations are dedicated to shoe types and their peculiarities. The two Rosso fragrances are somewhat different. As with its predecessor 17 Rosso, 4 Rosso also focuses on the current business address of the renowned shoe designer. This fragrance reflects his creativity and craftsmanship. It is a reminder of how a harmonious whole is created from numerous, sometimes very different individual parts. The attractive eau de parfum spray will appeal to ladies and men alike. The multi-layered Ugolini fragrance opens unusually with saffron, smoky notes, angelica and a dash of bergamot. In the heart note, damask rose and ylang-ylang are given a spicy sharpness by black pepper. The base accord of musk, guaiac and ambergris is refined with sweet caramel and bourbon vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Ugolini Azzurro Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Azzurro Eau de Parfum Spray by Roberto Ugolini is an olfactory creation that captivates with its fruity, aquatic character. The fragrance opens with a lively and sparkling top note of grapefruit, juicy strawberry and a hint of coconut, which is elegantly accentuated by the subtle spiciness of pink pepper. A multi-layered bouquet of precious damask rose, davana and delicate magnolia unfolds in the heart note. This floral elegance is elevated to a special level by the fruity depth of blackcurrant and a sparkling champagne note. A warm and gentle base of amberwood, musk and ambergris rounds off the composition and gives it a pleasant depth. Designed as a unisex fragrance, Azzurro shows remarkable versatility and is suitable as a fresh, light companion for day and evening, especially on warmer days. It is a fragrance for all those who appreciate an unusual yet harmonious composition. Fragrance direction: Fruity, aquatic Character: Fresh, light and versatile Fragrance notes: A composition of fruits, flowers and warm woods Special feature: A universally applicable unisex fragrance

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Ugolini Loafer Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Loafer is actually the name of a Roberto Ugolini eau de parfum spray. The fragrance is floral and spicy , is aimed at both men and women and impresses with its above-average longevity. Why Roberto Ugolini named his fragrance after the loafer shoe is actually quite easy to explain. Loafers are fun, are popular and worn by men and women alike, are super comfortable, offer a casual elegance and are very pleasant to wear. Just like the Loafer eau de parfum spray. It really can be that simple Maybe it's a quirk, maybe it's effective advertising to name a perfume after a shoe. In any case, you can't get the scent out of your nose. This is due to the top notes of orange and cloves, the heart notes of rose geranium, nutmeg, amber and ylang-ylang and the base notes of vanilla, musk and patchouli. After a strong opening, the fragrance develops beautifully. In its entirety, Roberto Ugolini Eau de Parfum Spray delights with its expressive sillage, which is expressly masculine for men. For women, on the other hand, the unisex fragrance is more elegant, spicy and soft . In any case, this creation is incredibly harmonious and simply perfect for chilly days.

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Ugolini Kitten Heel Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The inspiration for this eau de parfum comes from the mid-heeled shoe of the same name, which stands for timeless elegance and carefree comfort. Roberto Ugolini translates these attributes into a multi-faceted olfactory composition that harmoniously combines fruity and woody nuances. The fragrance opens with a lively blend of rose geranium and exotic ylang-ylang, accompanied by fruity accents reminiscent of the sweetness of peach or apricot. As the fragrance develops, a warm, deep heart unfolds, in which amber, sandalwood and patchouli meet the slightly smoky aroma of guaiac wood. This complex structure finally leads to a soft base of musk, vanilla and tonka bean, which gives the fragrance a creamy and long-lasting finish. Visually, the bottle reflects the Florentine brand's tradition of craftsmanship. The striking red glass corresponds with a beige label, which is adorned with a golden rim and the brand crest. A marbled clasp in shades of white and brown, reminiscent of natural horn, and leather-look applications emphasise the close connection to traditional shoe craftsmanship. Made in Italy, the creation offers an intense presence with a fragrance oil concentration of 20%. Fruity-woody fragrance profile with creamy accents Contains notes of ylang-ylang, sandalwood, amber and vanilla High fragrance oil concentration of 20% for long-lasting fragrance Red glass bottle with horn-look cap Unisex fragrance, made in Italy

listings.rawTitle: Roberto Ugolini High Heel White Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The High Heel White eau de parfum spray is an exception from Roberto Ugolini. The green and spicy fragrance from 2019 is the only women's fragrance from this great label. In keeping with the name, the bottle of the fragrance is white and has a wooden cap. For Roberto Ugolini, high heels are the epitome of femininity, the expression of style, charm and a certain sex appeal. These extremely feminine shoes were introduced by style icons such as Marlene Dietrich at the beginning of the last century. In memory of this grande dame, the Eau de Parfum Spray High Heel White is sensual, sexy, feminine, elegant and perfect for the grand entrance, wherever and whenever it takes place. Feminine doesn't have to be sweet Roberto Ugolini shows how beautiful unsweet fragrances can be with the Eau de Parfum Spray High Heel White. The top note consists of mandarins and lemons as well as galbanum and coriander. The heart note carries the flavours of iris, roses, lily of the valley, rose geranium and cardamom. The base of woods, incense, tonka bean, amberwood, patchouli and vanilla is soft. If you like expressive fragrances without sweetness, then High Heels White is a must. Because the freshness and harmony of this fragrance is unrivalled. A real all-rounder.

listings.rawTitle: Toni Gard Toni Eau de Parfum Spray 40 ml
listings.description: The Toni Eau de Parfum Spray by Toni Gard offers a modern interpretation of a fragrance that breaks away from classic structures. Instead of a sequence of top, heart and base notes, this molecular composition unfolds immediately upon contact with the skin. There, the fragrance develops a very personal and individual signature. The composition is characterised by a clear, woody character that emerges from a sophisticated blend of white cedarwood and woody amber. Facets of ambroxan and musk lend the creation a subtle depth and warmth. Conceived entirely without floral notes, the result is a straightforward and purist fragrance experience. The perfume is positioned as a unisex fragrance and is aimed at anyone looking for something special. The formula is also 100 per cent vegan and was produced without animal testing. Molecular fragrance without a classic fragrance pyramid Woody composition with white cedarwood, ambroxan and musk Unfolds immediately and develops individually on every skin Designed as a unisex fragrance 100% vegan and produced without animal testing

listings.rawTitle: Toni Gard Seaside Woman Eau de Parfum Spray 40 ml
listings.description: Seaside Woman is a fresh, light fragrance by Toni Gard. Toni Gard is an established fashion and design house from Düsseldorf that was founded in the mid-1960s. The company's philosophy has always been to create elegant and luxurious products that are not too obtrusive, but rather emphasise a good dose of understatement . And the Seaside Woman eau de parfum spray fits in perfectly with this guiding principle. A fragrance with a fruity note Seaside Woman is just the right perfume for confident women who want to emphasise their youthfulness and freshness at the same time. It is also intended to convey the beautiful, free feeling of a relaxing day by the sea. Aromatically, the notes of melon, cassis, juniper berries, lemon, amber, musk and soft woods as well as roses, magnolias and lily of the valley in the heart note create a successful overall composition. The eau de parfum spray is available in either a 40-millilitre or 90-millilitre bottle. The design of the bottle itself exudes a restrained yet fresh elegance that perfectly complements the fragrance.

It also has a special feature: Typical elements of women's fragrances are left out. listings.rawTitle: Toni Gard My Honey Eau de Parfum Spray 40 ml
listings.description: The My Honey Eau de Parfum Spray by Toni Gard is a composition that combines fruity lightness with floral elegance. The fragrance opens with a sparkling top note that combines the juicy flavours of honeydew, nectarine and mirabelle plum with a hint of red fruits. Shortly afterwards, the centrepiece of the fragrance unfolds: a delicate bouquet of lotus blossom, white jasmine and magnolia, which provides a clear note. In the base, the composition is completed by the warm accents of light woods and soft musk. This base note gives the fragrance a pleasant depth and ensures that the fruity sweetness is harmoniously balanced. The result is a discreet and unobtrusive fragrance that is ideal for everyday wear and leisure and leaves behind a natural aura. The fragrance opens with a sparkling top note that combines the juicy flavours of honeydew, nectarine and mirabelle plum with a hint of red fruits. Shortly afterwards, the centrepiece of the fragrance unfolds: a delicate bouquet of lotus blossom, white jasmine and magnolia, which provides a clear note. In the base, the composition is completed by the warm accents of light woods and soft musk. This base note gives the fragrance a pleasant depth and ensures that the fruity sweetness is harmoniously balanced. The result is a discreet and unobtrusive fragrance that is ideal for everyday wear and leisure and leaves behind a natural aura. Since 1965, the lifestyle and fashion brand TONI GARD has been developing elegant, high-class fashion and beauty products for men who always move with the times and dare to remain a gentleman through and through. The eau de toilette spray for the modern gentleman The designer's fragrances and cosmetics are made with exclusive ingredients that give each perfume and moisturising cream its individual, intensifying effect. TONI GARD's Eau de Toilette Spray TRUE has been composed by its perfumers from citrus extracts, violet blossom, musk, iris and moss. A fragrance that radiates strength and straightforwardness: "Understatement means luxury" , as TONI GARD once formulated it as a credo for his fashion label and the traditional Düsseldorf house.
