BULLFROG Men's fragrances Eau de Parfum Spray N.1 100 ml
listings.description: The Secret Potion N.1 Eau de Parfum Spray by BULLFROG pays homage to the mysterious atmosphere of speakeasy bars during the Prohibition era in the 1920s. As the first fragrance from the Italian brand, which has its origins in a barbershop in Milan, it presents itself as an olfactory cocktail full of sophistication and depth. The composition opens with top notes of bergamot, patchouli, black pepper and a hint of cinnamon. At the heart, the unmistakable character of the fragrance is revealed through the prominent notes of rum, whisky and absinthe, which meet a warm leather accord. This interplay captures the mood of a secret meeting place. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a base of vanilla, amber, vetiver and the distinctive flavours of tobacco and coffee beans. Made in Italy, this woody, aromatic eau de parfum is aimed at anyone who appreciates an elegant and nostalgic fragrance with a strong character. Inspired by the mysterious atmosphere of the speakeasy bars of the 1920s. A woody-aromatic fragrance composition with warm and spicy notes. Characteristic aromas of rum, whisky, leather and tobacco characterise the fragrance. Eau de Parfum in a 100 ml bottle, made in Italy.

listings.rawTitle: BULLFROG Elisir Eau de Parfum Spray N.1 Deadly Nightshade 100 ml
listings.description: Elisir N.1 Deadly Nightshade Eau de Parfum Spray from BULLFROG is a very special fragrance. Because it is the first organic perfume from the barbershop label. BULLFROG is known for its uncompromising men's fragrances, which often only bear the name of one ingredient, around which the men's fragrances are then designed. But Elisir N.1 Deadly Nightshade Eau de Parfum Spray is different. The top note features fruity oranges and citrusy bergamot. The heart note features black orchids with tonka beans and leather. They are complemented by tobacco and cedarwood in the base. Men love this fragrance from BULLFROG, because it was inspired by a visit to the barbershop. This is masculine elegance in absolute perfection. Really just for him There are numerous men's fragrances that are also aimed, at least covertly, at women. However, Elisir N.1 Deadly Nightshade Eau de Parfum Spray is reserved exclusively for men. When creating it, BULLFROG had men in mind who also want to appear well-groomed and with a wonderfully masculine, woody and spicy fragrance in their leisure time. Deadly Nightshade is a fragrance with above-average longevity and a strong sillage. Just right for men who are also looking for something special in their fragrances in organic quality.

listings.rawTitle: BULLFROG Elements Eau de Toilette Spray Earth 100 ml
listings.description: The Elements collection from BULLFROG is dedicated to the four fundamental forces of nature, with ElementsEarth Eau de Toilette Spray capturing the essence of the earth. This composition aims to interpret stability and groundedness olfactorily. The fragrance opens with fresh citrus notes of mandarin, orange and bitter grapefruit. This invigorating start flows smoothly into a spicy heart note. This is where exotic spices and striking Sichuan pepper meet the floral accents of African rose geranium. A warm base of various woods rounds off the fragrance and gives it its characteristic, long-lasting finish. The design visually emphasises the concept with a transparent glass bottle that reveals the light yellow liquid. A brown label with a drawn rock motif and the black cap complete the look. Made in Italy, this fragrance stands for a harmonious combination of freshness and warmth. Fragrance family: A balanced blend of woody and citrusy notes. Top notes: Fresh accents of mandarin, orange and bitter grapefruit. Heart note: Spicy interplay of Sichuan pepper, exotic spices and African rose geranium. Base note: Warm, earthy woody notes for a solid finish. Design: 100 ml glass bottle with themed rock motif label, made in Italy.

listings.rawTitle: BULLFROG Men's fragrances Eau de Parfum Spray N.2 100 ml
listings.description: BULLFROG Eau de Parfum Spray Secret Potion N.2 is one of those men's fragrances that is almost impossible to describe. We'll try anyway: Cool art work by Ramon Maiden meets a spicy, delicate fragrance from BULLFROG. Secret composition as a special fragrance feature Normally, we would present the essences that make up the top, heart and base notes of the fragrance here. However, as the name suggests, the composition of Eau de Parfum Spray Secret Potion N.2 remains a secret. Are you ready to embark on an adventure? This time, the potpourri is aimed at fans of the mystical. The fragrance was inspired by a tattoo parlour. It captures the different works of art, but also the artist's worries and thoughts. The bottle features a frog sculpted by Ramon Maiden, who looks like a real gentleman: with a hat and a casual look. Like all men's fragrances from BULLFROG, there is a distinctive mix inside that only gradually reveals itself to the wearer. There are spicy accords, but earthy notes will also unfold. There is also a hint of wood. Do you also trust in the well-kept secret of Eau de Parfum Spray Secret Potion N.2?

listings.rawTitle: BULLFROG Elisir Eau de Parfum Spray N.2 Palo Santo 100 ml
listings.description: Elisir N.2 Palo Santo Eau de Parfum Spray is one of the aromatic men's fragrances from BULLFROG. The fragrance is spicy and woody and has a captivatingly beautiful and wonderfully short list of ingredients. Just four ingredients are enough for BULLFROG to create an elegant, very wearable masculine fragrance. Bergamot and amber, patchouli and palo santo create Elisir N.2 Palo Santo Eau de Parfum Spray. Palo Santo, the sacred wood, not only gives the fragrance its name, but also its wonderful aura. Palo Santo is a balsam tree, from the same family as myrrh and frankincense, and is strictly protected. Noble men's fragrances that are not mainstream Masculine, elegant, wearable and yet so far removed from the mainstream - these are the men's fragrances from BULLFROG. It is therefore not surprising that the label uses rare woods such as palo santo. The interplay of shade and smoke not only suits every time of day and season, it also emphasises a masculine charisma that doesn't need any grand gestures. With Elisir N.2 Palo Santo Eau de Parfum Spray, BULLFROG is targeting men who like to visit a barbershop and who are aware of the special nature of this men's grooming product and the associated aromas. These men don't wear mainstream men's fragrances , but value something special.

listings.rawTitle: BULLFROG Elements Eau de Toilette Spray Air 100 ml
listings.description: The Air Eau de Toilette Spray is part of the Elements Collection by BULLFROG launched in 2022. It has a fresh and woody presence that symbolises the freshness and lightness of air. BULLFROG wanted to capture the four basic elements of fire, water, earth and air in fine fragrances, but did not want to create a perfume. This is because most men prefer a somewhat lighter presence. The BULLFROG Elements Air Eau de Toilette Spray has a surprising fragrance pyramid. The top notes are fig leaves and green notes. The heart note combines orris roots with almond milk and fig juice, both of which are rarely found in a perfume. The fragrance is rounded off with vanilla and woody notes. On masculine skin, this composition develops into a sensual presence that flatters its wearer. Dreamy, thoughtful or both A man can have his head in the clouds and still have both feet firmly on the ground. And BULLFROG has developed Elements Air Eau de Toilette Spray precisely for these men. He puts his money where his mouth is and can easily get his hands dirty. But he can also simply relax. And relaxing is even easier when a fine fragrance touches the senses without weighing them down like a perfume.

listings.rawTitle: BULLFROG Elements Eau de Toilette Spray Water 100 ml
listings.description: In a collection dedicated to the four elements, the Elements Water Eau de Toilette Spray from BULLFROG is a must-have. Structured like a perfume, with a fine fragrance pyramid, the eau de toilette has a fine spicy-woody fragrance . The top notes of ginger and cardamom create a fresh opening. The heart note combines black basil with sage and cedarwood. Amber opens the base and rounds everything off with patchouli and sequoia. BULLFROG dedicates Elements Water Eau de Toilette Spray to men who are constantly on the move, who move things forward and for whom standing still is a horror. Fresh and carefree and constantly on the move Water is not a perfume, but water has a scent. Water is constantly on the move and is the most powerful drink in the world. It brings change and promotes life, has a primal power, but can also gently caress. BULLFROG also attributes this versatility to the men who wear Elements Water Eau de Toilette Spray. They want a light, fresh and modern fragrance that emphasises their personality. They don't need a perfume that weighs them down. And why should they? The masculine Water Eau de Toilette Spray is always and everywhere the perfect companion .

listings.rawTitle: BULLFROG Elisir Eau de Parfum Spray N.3 Dark Honey 100 ml
listings.description: Complex aromas come together in Elisir N.3 Dark Honey Eau de Parfum Spray to create an olfactory experience that is reminiscent of the tradition of old apothecary art. The Bullfrog brand presents a composition that deliberately plays with contrasts and creates a warm, woody mood. It opens with a fresh top note, in which tangy bergamot and grapefruit mingle with the green accents of galbanum. At the centre of the creation, however, is the eponymous dark honey, which lends the fragrance a deep, gourmand facet. This central accord is grounded by a solid base of leather and woods, which gives the eau de parfum its distinctive and long-lasting character. The combination of sweet and tart nuances creates a multi-layered fragrance profile that evolves as the fragrance is worn. The product also reflects this aesthetic visually: a brown glass bottle with a wooden cap and copper-coloured lettering underlines the classic style of the Elisir range. It is a fragrance that maintains balance and is ideal for lovers of ambery, leathery notes. Woody, gourmand fragrance profile with a distinctive honey note Layered composition of citrus, leather and woods Classic design in a brown glass bottle with wooden cap Inspired by traditional recipes and elixirs Long-lasting eau de parfum concentration

listings.rawTitle: BULLFROG Men's fragrances Eau de Parfum Spray N.3 100 ml
listings.description: BULLFROG men's fragrances such as Secret Potion N.3 Eau de Parfum Spray are always very elegant and wearable. The fragrance of Secret Potion N.3 Eau de Parfum Spray is spicy-aquatic and is perfect, but not just for summer. Spices, aromatic herbs and maritime notes - that's all this fine fragrance needs to emphasise the masculine charisma of its wearer. The fragrance was created for men who value something special. For them, grooming is more than just a shave in the morning. They celebrate a classic wet shave just as much as they regularly visit a barbershop - or would if they had one nearby. The men who use BULLFROG men's fragrances want to wear a purely masculine presence that is far removed from the mainstream and yet is not an olfactory cudgel. This is how beautiful a masculine fragrance can be At least when it comes from the barbershop label BULLFROG. Founded by Romano Brida, the label combines the classic American barbershop principle with the certain style and flair that the Italians are known for. This is applied not only to the barbershop products in the line, but also to all of the brand's men's fragrances. And thanks to the men's fragrances, such as Secret Potion N.3 Eau de Parfum Spray, you can now enjoy BULLFROG everywhere.

listings.rawTitle: BULLFROG Elements Eau de Toilette Spray Fire 100 ml
listings.description: An olfactory interpretation of the elemental forces, BULLFROG Elements Fire Eau de Toilette Spray is a striking part of a collection that captures the four elements of nature. This special composition is dedicated to the untamed and passionate energy of fire and translates this inspiration into a modern, multi-layered fragrance experience. The opening is particularly lively and fresh, characterised by the sparkling aromas of mandarin and various citrus peels, which are immediately present. An exciting contrast then develops in the heart of the fragrance, where the cool, herbaceous freshness of mint meets the dark, fruity notes of blackcurrant. The entire fragrance profile is rounded off by a classic, earthy base note, in which patchouli and oakmoss provide the necessary stability and depth. The eau de toilette thus harmoniously combines fruity accents with a solid, earthy base. The design of the bottle also picks up on the theme visually: The light yellow liquid is contained in a round, transparent glass bottle, which is adorned with a red label with a stylised flame graphic and a black, cylindrical cap. Lively citrus fragrance with top notes of mandarin and citrus peel Contrasting heart notes of mint and blackcurrant Earthy base of patchouli and oakmoss for depth and longevity Part of the Elements collection, inspired by the element of fire Transparent glass bottle with themed red label

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Genova Classic Eau de Cologne Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Acqua di Genova - Eau de Cologne Spray Classic is a fragrance with a wonderfully fresh note and very aromatic . This fragrance was created in 1853 by the famous perfumer Stefano Frecceri, who dedicated it to the Royal House of Savoy. The eau de cologne spray is equally suitable for men and women . The Acqua di Genova Eau de Cologne Spray is classic and wonderfully invigorating for all occasions. Subtle, aromatic and refreshing . Acqua di Genova - the scent of the Mediterranean Acqua di Genova Classic delights with its top notes of bergamot, orange, neroli, rosemary, lime and lavender . The heart of this fragrance enchants with floral citrus notes of jasmine, rose and orange , underpinned by amber, patchouli, sandalwood and musk . A truly classic fragrance that never goes out of fashion, caresses the senses and delights the heart .</p

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Genova 1853 Men Eau de Toilette Spray 100 ml
listings.description: The Acqua di Genova 1853 Men Eau de Toilette Spray is a fragrance with a rich history, originally composed in 1853 by Stefano Frecceri for the Royal Court of Savoy. As a creation of the traditional Italian brand, this perfume embodies timeless elegance. The composition opens with an invigorating freshness of bergamot, mandarin and lemon. In the heart note, an aromatic bouquet of lavender, neroli and rose unfolds, which is given a striking depth by spicy pepper and sandalwood. The base rounds off the fragrance experience with warm notes of musk and patchouli, giving it a long-lasting character. The woody, aromatic chypre fragrance is characterised by its tart, fresh yet elegant orientation. It is presented in a stylish bottle with a vintage feel that emphasises its luxurious character. A woody, aromatic men's fragrance with a tart, fresh character . Composition of citrus fruits, lavender, pepper and sandalwood. A historic fragrance classic from the year 1853. Presented in an elegant 100 ml bottle with vintage charm.

listings.rawTitle: Angel Schlesser Les Eaux d'un Instant Eau de Toilette Spray Immense Peony 100 ml
listings.description: In 2020, Angel Schlesser presents the Les Eaux d'un Instant collection with the eau de toilette spray "Immense Peony". The fragrance is unisex and has been given a floral and fresh presence by Ane Ayo. The perfumer only needs three ingredients to achieve this, so that each level of the fragrance pyramid presents a solo fragrance. Juicy and fruity strawberry carry the top note. The heart note features the eponymous peony, while soft musk forms the base. With the Immense Peony Eau de Toilette Spray, Angel Schlesser presents women and men with a wonderfully soft, only slightly sweet fresh fragrance that simply always fits. Casual, casual, elegant - a real all-rounder The Immense Peony Eau de Toilette Spray from the Les Eaux d'un Instant range is not a fragrance for special occasions. The Spanish fashion label Angel Schlesser wants you to be able to wear the unisex fragrance anytime you want. In your free time, at work, during the day or in the evening. Simply enjoy this wonderful peony, which also suits men so well. The Immense Peony Eau de Toilette Spray is a truly ravishing addition to the magnificent Les Eaux d'un Instant range, which has proven that Angel Schlesser can do more than fashion.

listings.rawTitle: Angel Schlesser Les Eaux d'un Instant Eau de Toilette Spray Vibrant Woody Mandarin 100 ml
listings.description: Vibrant Woody Mandarin Eau de Toilette Spray is a charming men's fragrance by Angel Schlesser from the Les Eaux d'un Instant collection. The fragrance character is lively and fresh , reminiscent of a wonderful walk on the beach. The creators found inspiration in the natural world of Italy, for example combining the fruity scent of mandarins with the floral charm of lavender . The overall result is a radiant men's fragrance that brings the feeling of a holiday into your everyday life. Wonderfully versatile Vibrant Woody Mandarin Eau de Toilette Spray Discover the fragrance by Angel Schlesser! Look forward to the versatile ingredients of Les Eaux d'un Instant Vibrant Woody Mandarin Eau de Toilette men's fragrance. It captivates right from the top note with an exciting mix of cardamom, mandarin and lemon. Fresh and spicy, it gently tickles the nose and makes you curious for more. And you get more in the heart note with lovely lavender and violet fragrance, garnished with pink pepper. It is a hint of flowers, but never too feminine. This is also ensured by the tart base. Here, the creator of Vibrant Woody Mandarin Eau de Toilette Spray relies on classic men's fragrances such as patchouli, tonka bean and cedarwood.

listings.rawTitle: Angel Schlesser Les Eaux d'un Instant Eau de Toilette Spray Instinctive Marine 100 ml
listings.description: The Instinctive Marine Eau de Toilette Spray comes from the Les Eaux d'un Instant collection launched by Angel Schlesser in 2020. The fragrance is of course unisex and was composed by Amandine Clerc-Marie from only three ingredients . As you would expect from a fragrance called Instinctive Marine Eau de Toilette Spray, the top note is made up of a variety of marine notes that are fresh, salty, vibrant and so unique. Lavender carries the heart note, proving that this plant is rightly one of the greats in the fragrance world. Everything is rounded off by creamy, soft and powdery tonka beans in the base. Sensuality from Angel Schlesser that delights HER and HIM It is easy to categorise the fresh and spicy Les Eaux d'un Instant Instinctive Marine Eau de Toilette Spray as a pure women's fragrance. However, it is also extremely popular with men because the maritime notes develop into an irresistible, present and casually casual fragrance on masculine skin with creamy tonka beans. If you know Angel Schlesser as a pure fashion label that values sustainability, then just take a sniff of the fragrances from the Les Eaux d'un Instant collection. You will be amazed.

listings.rawTitle: Angel Schlesser Les Eaux d'un Instant Eau de Toilette Spray Luminous Violet 100 ml
listings.description: With the Luminous Violet Eau de Toilette Spray Les Eaux d'un Instant by Angel Schlesser , you can make yourself or a loved one very happy. It is a fragrance that is described by the manufacturer as unisex . This means that both men and women can wear this special fragrance. The flacon is attractively coloured in a delicate purple to match the individual fragrance. It comes in discreet packaging, making the perfume Luminous Violet Eau de Toilette Spray Les Eaux d'un Instant by Angel Schlesser ideal as a gift . The contents of a bottle of Luminous Violet Eau de Toilette Spray Les Eaux d'un Instant by Angel Schlesser are very economical: you opt for a large 100 ml bottle. The note is decent and equally timeless and suitable for any occasion. The top note blends bergamot with delicate pear and the stimulating scent of tea. Freesia, peony and violet are added as heart notes. A pinch of salt enhances this sweet fragrance. Vanilla and cedarwood form the base note and make the perfume particularly individual . It covers the skin like a pleasant veil for a whole day.

listings.rawTitle: Angel Schlesser Les Eaux d'un Instant Eau de Toilette Spray Intimate White Flowers 100 ml
listings.description: The Intimate White Flowers Eau de Toilette Spray comes from the Les Eaux d'un Instant collection by Angel Schlesser. Ane Ayo created the fragrance for men and women with a floral and fresh presence. As with the other fragrances in the Angel Schlesser Les Eaux d'un Instant collection, the Intimate White Flowers Eau de Toilette Spray uses very few aromas. Four, to be precise. Monoi, another name for tiare, is the top note. White flowers and jasmine take over in the heart note before the base of pure vanilla appears. The fragrance is radiantly bright , with a subtle sweetness and a wonderful aroma. Sustainable fashion and equally sustainable fragrances from Spain Each fragrance from the Les Eaux d'un Instant collection epitomises the elegance of the modern woman who is self-aware, who takes what she wants and doesn't wait for anything. Why should she? Life is too short for that. The fashion is elegant, casual, chic and functional and inspires both at work and at play. Just like the splendidly feminine Intimate White Flowers Eau de Toilette Spray. This fragrance by Angel Schlesser accompanies you wherever you go, whenever you want it to.

listings.rawTitle: Angel Schlesser Les Eaux d'un Instant Eau de Toilette Spray Profound Orange Wood 100 ml
listings.description: In 2020, the Spanish label Angel Schlesser presents the Les Eaux d'un Instant collection. It also includes the Profound Orange Wood Eau de Toilette Spray. The fragrance is fruity and woody and was designed by Nathalie Lorson for men and women. She has created a fragrance that makes do with few, but all the more beautiful flavours. In keeping with the fashion that Angel Schlesser produces in Spain and where great importance is attached to sustainability, the fragrances are also very natural and emphasise the style of the wearer in a way that is both simple and sophisticated . And the fine Les Eaux d'un Instant Profound Orange Wood Eau de Toilette Spray shows that this does not require any over-the-top combinations. Summery light and wonderfully sensual The top note introduces fruity oranges as soloists. Citrusy, earthy petitgrain opens the heart note and combines with orange tree wood. In the base, patchouli offers a whole host of different flavours with an intense presence. If you have only known Angel Schlesser's fashion so far, take the opportunity to get to know fragrances such as the enchanting and elegant Profound Orange Wood Eau de Toilette Spray with the Les Eaux d'un Instant collection. Experience how the fragrance enhances your days and evenings.

listings.rawTitle: Angel Schlesser Les Eaux d'un Instant Eau de Toilette Spray Tempting Bergamot 100 ml
listings.description: The Tempting Bergamot Eau de Toilette Spray presented in 2020 also comes from the Les Eaux d'un Instant range by Angel Schlesser. The fresh and creamy fragrance is for men and women and was composed by Alberto Morillas. Three ingredients are enough for the king of fragrances to compose the delicate Les Eaux d'un Instant Tempting Bergamot Eau de Toilette Spray for Angel Schlesser. Bergamot is, of course, the soloist in the top note. The experienced perfumer uses hedione for the heart. Everything is then rounded off by the diverse aromas of musk. The seductive bergamot, as the name of the fragrance translates, is light, neither feminine nor masculine but incredibly wearable. An all-rounder for everyone and always Angel Schlesser is of course world-famous as a fashion label. But its fragrances, such as the Les Eaux d'un Instant collection, are also captivating more and more people. This is because Angel Schlesser attaches just as much importance to the high quality of each fragrance as it does to fashion. Attention is paid to sustainability, environmental compatibility and versatility. Casual and elegant fashion combined with casual and elegant fragrances puts you in a good mood. If you are not yet familiar with the brand's fragrances, why not try the Tempting Bergamot Eau de Toilette Spray?

listings.rawTitle: Angel Schlesser Les Eaux d'un Instant Eau de Toilette Spray Splendid Orange Blossom 100 ml
listings.description: The unisex fragrance Angel Schlesser Les Eaux d'un Instant Splendid Orange Blossom Eau de Toilette Spray pampers you with a refreshing sweetness of fruit . On summery days, the perfume emphasises the good mood, while on rainy days it transports you to places like Tunisia or Morocco. This is because the extracts of bitter orange blossom, which characterise the scent of Angel Schlesser's fragrance, were obtained there. Good mood and holiday feelings In addition to bitter orange, bergamot opens the fragrance and immediately creates a positive mood. Feel lively and motivated with Les Eaux d'un Instant Splendid Orange Blossom Eau de Toilette Spray! The heart note also remains wonderfully fruity. The orange blossom tickles your nose and exudes a feeling of freedom, perhaps in a Mediterranean or exotic setting. The base note is pleasantly mysterious with patchouli, but still garnished with the warmth and light sweetness of vanilla. With Les Eaux d'un Instant Splendid Orange Blossom Eau de Toilette Spray by Angel Schlesser, you can always look forward to soothing, thoughtful breaks from everyday life or use it as a highlight for going out on a warm summer evening.

listings.rawTitle: Angel Schlesser Les Eaux d'un Instant Eau de Toilette Spray Blooming Grapefruit 100 ml
Widian Sapphire Collection Eau de Parfum Spray London 100 ml

The minimalist bottle with its clean lines and deep blue glass reflects the urban inspiration of London. The intensive longevity makes London Eau de Parfum the perfect companion for day and evening. Thanks to its understated elegance, the fragrance is suitable for both formal occasions and personal moments. Discover the sophistication of the Sapphire Collection with this eau de parfum. With this fragrance composition from the Sapphire Collection, Widian succeeds in emphasising every facet of individual personality and leaving a lasting impression. Let this perfume transport you to a world of sensuality and adventure .</p

listings.rawTitle: Versace Bright Crystal Absolu Eau de Parfum Spray Absolu 50 ml
listings.description: Versace Bright Crystal Absolu is a more intense interpretation of the popular Bright Crystal fragrance. Created by perfumer Alberto Morillas, this eau de parfum unfolds a fascinating floral-fruity composition. The opening captivates with a lively combination of tangy yuzu and juicy pomegranate, refined with a cool, icy accord. A bouquet of raspberry, delicate peony, magnolia and lotus blossom unfolds at the heart of the fragrance creation, giving the scent its feminine yet modern aura. A gentle base of acai wood, amber and musk harmoniously rounds off the fragrance experience without taking centre stage. The fragrance is particularly suitable for the spring and summer months and is an ideal companion for the day. The composition is presented in an elegant bottle in a vibrant shade of pink, with a cap reminiscent of a cut gemstone. Fragrance: Floral and fruity Character: An intense interpretation of the Bright Crystal classic Heart notes: Raspberry, peony, magnolia and lotus Concentration: Eau de Parfum

listings.rawTitle: Versace Bright Crystal Perfume 50 ml
listings.description: Typical Versace: the Bright Crystal women's perfume. This lively and fresh fragrance creation is a wonderful example of the qualities Donatella Versace admires in women: Strength, self-confidence and femininity. The perfume emphasises these qualities with its characterful fragrance. The perfume is floral and fresh with unusual accents. The luxury brand's fragrances are like its fashion collections: always glamorous and iconic. Designers and producers attach great importance to the highest quality, craftsmanship, creativity and innovation. Bright Crystal by Versace: incomparably feminine Alberto Morillas has come up with something special for this enchanting women's perfume. An unusual combination of citrusy, floral, aquatic notes . He masterfully combines these elements to create a light, feminine perfume. Donatella Versace's favourite bouquet of flowers served as inspiration for the perfume. The freshly picked flowers with their individual notes create a multi-faceted, energising fragrance - a wonderful base for an expressive women's perfume. Even the top note surprises with a rare combination. The juicy aroma of pomegranate is complemented by the citrusy notes of Japanese yuzu fruit. An ice chord evokes associations of frozen fruit. Wonderful floral fragrances characterise the heart note. Magnolia and lotus blend with peony. The soft base accord consists of musk and amber. This is complemented by the warm accents of acajou wood.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Man Eau Fraîche Extreme Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: With Man Eau Fraîche Extreme Eau de Parfum Spray, Versace is revisiting one of its perfume classics - this time in the extreme version, which intensifies the durability and freshness of the original creation even further. Designed for strong, self-confident and freedom-loving men who prefer to wear style and luxury directly on their bodies, the perfume is a successful balancing act between classic and modern. The Versace Man Eau Fraîche Extreme Eau de Parfum Spray contains typical accords for men's fragrances as well as some exciting innovations. These ensure that you can rediscover the fragrance every day. A classic spring and summer fragrance The original creation already delighted fragrance lovers with its remarkable longevity and freshness: even in summer, with high temperatures and often equally high humidity, the perfume knew how to get its wearer through the day. Versace Man Eau Fraîche Extreme Eau de Parfum Spray is no different: the citrusy notes of lemon are even fresher here, while the floral accords of orange blossom and geranium are even more pronounced. Clary sage and lavender are also omnipresent in this creation. The Italian fragrance creation exudes masculinity and a certain spiciness thanks to the pink pepper from Madagascar, among other things.</p

listings.rawTitle: Versace Dylan Turquoise Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Versace Dylan Turquoise Eau de Toilette Spray is a modern and youthful fragrance composition created by perfumer Sophie Labbe. The fragrance opens with a sparkling freshness of primofiore lemon, mandarin essence and a hint of pink pepper. A bouquet of jasmine blossom and freesia unfolds in the heart, which is given a special depth by the fruity notes of blackcurrant and guava. The base elegantly rounds off the fragrance experience with warm, vibrant woods, the exclusive Clearwood® note and white musk. This combination of floral, fruity and woody accords gives the eau de toilette its summery and sensual character. Sustainability was also prioritised during development, with over 85% of the formulation consisting of biodegradable ingredients from transparent supply chains. A fresh, floral-woody fragrance for women . Composition of tangy lemon, guava and sensual musk. Formulated with over 85% biodegradable ingredients. A modern and summery fragrance character.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Versace Crystal Noir is a fragrance with a mysterious and sensual aura. The composition opens with a fruity note of blackcurrant and black fig, accompanied by delicate violet. An opulent bouquet of white flowers unfolds in the heart, in which jasmine, tuberose and frangipani reveal their full splendour. The base lends the eau de toilette a warm and long-lasting depth with a blend of sandalwood, cashmere and a hint of vanilla. This intense fragrance character makes Crystal Noir an ideal companion for the evening and the cooler months of the year. Despite its concentration as an eau de toilette, the fragrance is characterised by remarkable longevity and leaves a lasting impression. A fragrance with a spicy, floral and sensual character. Combines notes of black fig, tuberose and sandalwood. Characterised by a long-lasting fragrance intensity. Especially suitable for the evening, autumn and winter seasons.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Dylan Blue Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Versace Dylan Blue Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray is a composition that combines strength and sensuality in a multi-faceted fragrance. The creation, created by perfumer Calice Becker, opens with a lively, fruity note. Flavours of cassis and crisp Granny Smith apple meet the special accents of white clover and shisolia, which provide an unmistakable freshness. At the heart of the fragrance, a rich floral bouquet unfolds, in which jasmine, elegant rose and peony combine with the gentle sweetness of peach to create a harmonious melody. This floral component is supported by a warm and woody base. Notes of light woods, musk and patchouli give the eau de parfum a balanced depth and a long-lasting character. The bottle is an expression of timeless elegance: inspired by an ancient Greek amphora, the design with its deep blue glass and gold-coloured details emphasises the Mediterranean aesthetic of the fragrance. A multi-faceted fragrance that exudes elegance and sensuality. Belongs to the family of woody-floral and fruity compositions. An interplay of fruity top notes, a floral heart and a warm, woody base. Presented in a bottle inspired by a Greek amphora with gold-coloured details.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Red Jeans Eau de Toilette Spray 75 ml
listings.description: With its Red Jeans Eau de Toilette Spray, the Italian luxury brand Versace invites you into a flowering, magnificent garden , which attracts locals and guests alike with its beguiling fragrance nuances alongside all its colourful splendour. In the top note, the perfume uses a prelude of freesia, ylang-ylang and redcurrant before the prominent floral accords hit the ground running in the heart. Gentle peony, delicate jasmine and the unspoilt, innocent violet are combined as a trio to create a heart note that is as intense as it is multi-layered. The Versace Red Jeans perfume finishes with sandalwood, musk and vanilla - all three together give the eau de toilette spray a pleasantly dense fragrance silhouette. A classic fragrance that never goes out of fashion It has been almost three decades since Versace introduced the first iteration of this future cult fragrance, Red Jeans Eau de Toilette Spray. The unmistakable charm of this perfume has not faded since then, as it is just as long-lasting and enduring as the fine essences under the bright red lid of the grapefruit-coloured bottle. Whether in summer or in the cold Central European season, this sparkling creation is a beautiful all-rounder that is always a good choice and is sure to soon become a constant in your bathroom at home.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Pour Homme Oud Noir Eau de Parfum Spray 100 ml
listings.description: Oud Noir is an eau de parfum spray of a special kind. The perfume by the brand Versace has a seductive and mystical character, which is intensive and has an aphrodisiac effect. The name Oud Noir is due to the fact that the eau de parfum spray contains one of the most precious essences of perfumery: Oud. This essence gives the perfume a woody and spicy note, which is responsible for an unmistakable fragrance. A perfume with an invigorating effect With its highly intensive leather note, the Versace perfume is suitable for all men, who want to move through life with style and elegance. A man with a strong personality will benefit from this unmistakable fragrance. The elegant design of the flacon already hints at the uniqueness of the fragrance. With aromas of black pepper, neroli and bitter orange, a fragrance is created, which encourages you to feel good and relax.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros pour Femme Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Eros pour Femme Eau de Toilette by Versace is a composition inspired by the power and attraction of Greek mythology. Launched in 2016, the fragrance belongs to the woody-floral family and is characterised by its multi-layered character. It opens with a sparkling combination of Sicilian lemon and mandarin, complemented by fruity accents of whitecurrant and raspberry. An aquatic hint rounds off the top note. A rich bouquet of jasmine, freesia and magnolia unfolds in the heart, which is refined by the delicate sweetness of orange blossom. The base anchors the composition with warm notes of ambroxan, patchouli and white musk, which lend the fragrance a subtle depth. As an eau de toilette, this fragrance is noticeably fresher and lighter than its eau de parfum version. The round, gold-coloured bottle, adorned with the iconic Medusa head, reflects the unmistakable style of Versace. A woody-floral fragrance for women with a fresh character. Composition of fruity citrus notes, a floral heart and a woody base. A lighter and fresher interpretation than the eau de parfum. Presented in a gold-coloured bottle with the characteristic Medusa head emblem.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK one Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Calvin Klein ck one Eau de Toilette Spray is an iconic unisex fragrance that has stood for pure and clear style since its launch in 1994. The fragrance composition starts with a sparkling and invigorating top note that combines citrusy accords of bergamot, lemon and mandarin with fruity nuances of pineapple and papaya. A hint of cardamom and fresh green tones add a special dynamic to the opening. As the fragrance progresses, a harmonious heart note unfolds, characterised by a floral bouquet of rose, violet and jasmine, which lends the fragrance a subtle complexity. listings.rawTitle: Village Rose Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The essence of an English garden in bloom seems to be captured in this fragrance arrangement. listings.rawTitle: Village Lavender Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The Lavender Eau de Toilette Spray from Village comes from the lavender-inspired fragrance and skincare range. This is made up of different cosmetic products, all of which spray the fragrance nuances on the skin, which are also picked up by the perfume in a much stronger intensity. The perfume in the range comes in a simple 50 ml bottle with a greenish transparent base and a golden cap. The front of the bottle also features the brand and series imprint, as well as the extra line "Natural Spray". The natural spray uses proven ingredients from nature and exudes a very floral aura overall. For all fans of floral fragrances As the name of the Village creation suggests, Lavender primarily exudes floral notes that revolve around lavender, perfecting it or even enhancing the intensity of lavender. The fine eau de toilette spray from the range is a wonderful everyday companion, but can also be used in the office or for sport. Even balmy spring and summer nights are wonderful for wearing a floral fragrance on your skin. Village has structured this fragrance in such a way that it is not limited to just one gender. Men and women alike can use Lavender Eau de Toilette Spray to wrap themselves in a floral and very friendly veil of fragrance. The friendly all-rounder for both sexes The perfume itself refines the scent of lavender with a breeze of delicate honey and very subtle aspects of hay. Ideally, the eau de toilette spray should be combined with a floral skincare product, such as the nourishing cosmetics from the Lavender range. In addition to the perfume, Village also offers a gentle shower gel, a pleasantly moisturising body lotion and a practical hand cream that ensures soft and intensively nourished hands, especially in winter.

listings.rawTitle: Cartier La Panthère Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: The La Panthère Eau de Parfum Spray by Cartier is a creation that exudes a captivating duality. This floral-fauve fragrance, composed by perfumer Mathilde Laurent, unfolds around a central note of radiant gardenia, known for its complex and feminine presence. It is contrasted by soft, velvety musky notes that lend the fragrance a sensual depth. The composition opens with a fresh, fruity facet of rhubarb, strawberry and bergamot before transitioning into an opulent heart of orange blossom, ylang-ylang and rose. A delicate chypre accord with oakmoss in the base rounds off the fragrance experience and lends it an elegant, long-lasting structure. This fragrance is captured in an ornate glass flacon, the inner cut of which forms the silhouette of a majestic panther and emphasises the luxurious character of the House of Cartier. A floral-chypre fragrance with a captivating character. Combines the central note of gardenia with velvety musk. Opens with a fruity-fresh composition of rhubarb and bergamot. The oakmoss base adds an elegant depth. Presented in an ornate bottle reminiscent of a panther.

listings.rawTitle: Alyssa Ashley Amber Musk Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: With the Amber Musk eau de parfum spray, the Alyssa Ashley label proves that a creamy and powdery fragrance can also be unisex. To emphasise this even further, even the bottle of the eau de parfum spray bears both the female and male symbol. As is so often the case with the Alyssa Ashley label, which was named after the founder's daughter, the fragrance has a very minimalist composition. The top note features only jasmine as a soloist, while the heart consists of iris and benzoin. The base intensifies once again and adds the flavours of vanilla, amber and musk to Amber Musk. A sensual summer fragrance It is easy to categorise the scent of Alyssa Ashley Eau de Parfum Spray Amber Musk in the world of women's fragrances. However, the fragrance pyramid actually reacts very differently to masculine skin than it does to feminine skin and proves that men can also wear sweet and powdery fragrances. They just have to dare. The sensual lightness of Amber Musk ensures that the eau de parfum spray is a wonderful companion on warm days - and even more so on warm evenings at the beach or rooftop bar. For all those who like it nourished, perceptible , yet subtle.

listings.rawTitle: Abercrombie & Fitch Fierce Eau de Cologne Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Since its launch in 2002, Fierce Eau de Cologne Spray by Abercrombie & Fitch has become a true fragrance classic for men. The woody-aromatic composition, created by the renowned perfumers Christophe Laudamiel, Bruno Jovanovic and Carlos Benaïm, impresses with its complexity and its present character. It opens with a dynamic top note that combines fresh citrus notes of orange and lemon with the spice of cardamom, petitgrain and a hint of fir resin, rounded off by a clear marine accord. In the heart of the fragrance, an aromatic bouquet of jasmine, lily of the valley and rose unfolds, which is given a special depth by the herbal nuances of rosemary and sage. The base note creates a warm and earthy finish: musk, oakmoss, vetiver and Brazilian rosewood provide a striking and lasting sillage. Fierce is an eau de cologne that lends a special presence with its unmistakable aura. A men's fragrance from the woody-aromatic fragrance family. A multi-layered composition with fresh, spicy and woody notes. Top notes of lemon, orange, cardamom and marine accords. Base notes of musk, oakmoss, vetiver and rosewood. Classified as an eau de cologne.

Luxurious perfume for special moments The top note of Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Elixir de Parfum Spray by Gucci opens with an invigorating blend of citrus fruits and spices that immediately attracts attention and creates an unforgettable first impression. Bergamot and orange blossom merge in a harmonious symphony that keeps freshness and spice in perfect balance. A floral elegance unfolds at the heart of the fragrance. These floral notes lend the perfume a deep, seductive aura that envelops the wearer in a cloak of mystery and attraction. The base note rounds off the olfactory experience with a powerful blend of woody and spicy elements. Ambroxan and cedarwood lend the perfume an earthy, masculine depth, while the hint of amber provides a sweet, tantalising warmth. The Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Elixir de Parfum Spray by Gucci is presented in an elegant, green bottle whose simple elegance and masculine aura perfectly reflect the luxurious contents. The lettering and iconic Gucci logo give the bottle a sophisticated touch and make it a real eye-catcher on any perfume shelf.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Gucci Flora Eau de Parfum Spray (Refillable) Gorgeous Orchid 30 ml
listings.description: With the Gucci fragrance Gorgeous Orchid Eau de Parfum Spray (Refillable), the Italian luxury brand has succeeded once again: Not only has the Gucci Flora series been given an extension in a bright yellow bottle, which is also refillable, but this fragrance also marks a real milestone. The Gorgeous Orchid Eau de Parfum Spray (Refillable) is the first ozone-floral gourmand perfume formulated by this time-honoured Italian fashion house. This alone makes the perfume a must-have for fans of the designers - but everyone else will also find it hard to get enough of the new fragrance in the Gucci Flora series. Pithy sweetness meets weightless lightness The Gucci Gorgeous Orchid Eau de Parfum Spray (Refillable) is above all a spring and summer fragrance: the ozonic accords, paired with vanilla, give this fragrance a lot of sweetness - at the same time, it is almost weightlessly light and never overpowering. The Gucci Flora fragrance undoubtedly provides a sensual element thanks to its fine essences of vanilla orchid: the Gucci creation also proves that exciting fragrances do not necessarily have to combine many accords. The reduced fragrance pyramid is perfect for anyone who appreciates "Quiet Luxury" - and the flacon with its unique floral pattern is an eye-catcher anyway.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Gucci Flora Eau de Parfum Intense  Gorgeous Gardenia 30 ml
listings.description: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia is an enchanting perfume by Gucci that captivates with the most intense fragrance in the Flora series. With lush floral power and enveloped by soft woody notes, this Eau de Parfum Intense is the perfect companion for all women who want to reflect pure joie de vivre with a floral fragrance. An intense duo of radiant freshness and sensual warmth A wonderfully fruity tangerine essence comes to the fore in the top note, which immediately gives this Eau de Parfum Intense a lively charm . The floral components of gardenia and hedione lend Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia its eponymous, jasmine-like freshness. This lively perfume by Gucci is rounded off with a smooth sandalwood essence that gives the fragrance depth and elegance. The scent is opulent and luxurious - comparable to a walk in the middle of a garden full of flowers. The combination of fruity sweetness, subtle floral freshness and warm woodiness creates a sensual, powerful fragrance experience that lingers in the memory.</p

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Parfum Absolu de Parfum 60 ml
listings.description: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Absolu de Parfum is an intense, woody-amber fragrance composition. The fragrance opens with a warm rum accord, which is given a special depth by the fine notes of bitter almond oil and orange blossom absolute. A rich melange of labdanum resinoid and tonka bean absolute unfolds in the heart, which is given a lively contrast by an accent of red chilli pepper. The olfactory experience is rounded off by a base of vanillin, a striking leather accord and benzoin resinoid, which gives the fragrance its long-lasting character. The eau de parfum is presented in a lacquered glass bottle with an elegant green colour gradient, which bears the Gucci Interlocking G logo and is closed by a black cap. Intense men's fragrance from the Amber Woody fragrance family. A composition of warm rum accord, red chilli pepper and leather. Rich and complex fragrance character for the evening. Presented in a glass bottle with a green colour gradient.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Gucci Guilty Eau de Parfum Spray gives the modern woman a strong and equally sensual aura. It is a fragrance that creates an unmistakable effect and remains positively memorable. In the top note, patchouli harmonises with amber and forms a skilful prelude to this fragrance experience. Floral notes of lilac, carnation and rose take the lead in the heart note. In the base note, fresh bergamot, mandarin and pink pepper round off this extraordinary fragrance composition from Gucci. The combination of floral and oriental influences makes this fragrance by Gucci very elegant, seductive and mysterious - just the way modern women present themselves today. The Gucci Guilty Eau de Parfum Spray therefore subtly emphasises femininity and is a tribute to women who go through life with confidence and courage. An exclusive and unforgettable fragrance experience Guilty means "guilty" and symbolises that it is worth crossing boundaries and constantly facing new challenges. It is precisely this attitude to life that is embodied by the advertising faces for this extraordinary and extravagant perfume from Gucci. The famous American actress Lana des Rey and the charismatic musician and actor Jered Leto represent this carefree, independent and almost rebellious lifestyle to perfection. Gucci Guilty Eau de Parfum Spray is the perfect fragrance for all day, leisure, work and also for the evening and special occasions.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Gucci Flora Eau de Parfum Spray Gorgeous Magnolia 30 ml
listings.description: The Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum Spray continues along the path that the Italian luxury brand embarked on some time ago with its floral creations. This Gucci perfume is centred around the magnolia, which the Gucci perfumers consider to be a beautiful flower with an often underestimated inner strength. For this reason, the magnolia was further enhanced for the Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum Spray: through the use of cranberries, which skilfully emphasise and highlight the sweet note of magnolia. The scratchberries in this perfume are rounded off with coconut and orange accords in the top note. A real perfume highlight - and not just for Gucci fans! In the heart note, the eponymous magnolia greets the senses, set in a frame of lily of the valley, jasmine and ylang-ylang. The Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum Spray seeks a brilliant finish in the base note with various light woods and patchouli, which the perfumers have achieved across the board. The same compliment also goes to the designers of the glass bottle, which is presented for the first time in a slimmer, slightly elongated shape. Once again, the Italian luxury brand proves that it has lost none of its love of detail over the years and decades.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Gucci Flora Eau de Parfum Spray Gorgeous Jasmine 30 ml
listings.description: The Italian brand Gucci was founded in 1921, when master saddler Gucci began selling his own leather goods. His products impressed customers with their outstanding craftsmanship and the finest leather material. Today, Gucci offers exclusive fashion, leather goods and accessories. The interlocking symbol of the stirrup is still the trademark of the Italian company. Since 2004, the brand has belonged to the French group Kering, which has continued the idea and quality in the spirit of the company founder. Floral dreams with Gucci Flora A carefree fragrance that embodies lightness and individuality: Gucci Flora inspires with a wonderful, floral fragrance. The top note features delicate aromas of pear blossom, reminiscent of the start of summer. The heart note consists of gardenia and sweet-smelling jasmine - pure romance. When the base note becomes noticeable, flavours of patchouli and sugar come to the fore. They combine with the nuances of the top and heart notes to create a dreamlike fragrance composition. Gorgeous Jasmine Eau de Parfum Spray can be taken anywhere and fits into even the smallest handbag. The fragrance accompanies you from morning to night. Packaged in an attractive pink bottle with a golden cap, Gorgeous Jasmine Eau de Parfum Spray makes an exclusive personalised gift.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum Spray by Gucci is an opulent women's fragrance with powdery, floral notes. The luxurious creation opens with enchanting tuberose, which transports you to the exotic landscapes of India. This is joined by the graceful accords of Arabian jasmine, which exude a refreshing green scent of delicate petals. At the centre of the composition is the mysterious, precious and extremely rare Rangunschlinger. This Asian beauty fascinates with its red flowers and has been used in a fragrance for the first time. Pleasant floral fragrances for sensual, imaginative women The Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum Spray by Gucci emphasises the feminine, sensual and playful side of its wearer with its delicious floral essences. It is the perfect choice for self-confident women who love floral and particularly intense fragrances. Indulge yourself day after day with this delicious perfume, start the morning with its stimulating aromas and let its seductive aura envelop you in the evening!

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Gucci Flora Eau de Parfum Spray Intense Gorgeous Orchid 30 ml
listings.description: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid Eau de Parfum Intense lends every appearance a long-lasting, floral-gourmand scent that enhances your self-confidence, particularly on evening occasions. As the fragrance with the highest concentration in the entire Flora collection, this creation offers an intense experience that lingers for a long time without requiring constant reapplication. The top note, a salty, ozonic accord, opens the fragrance experience with an airy lightness that is immediately perceptible as fresh. At the heart, the vanilla orchid unfolds a radiant, floral sweetness that lends the fragrance an inviting depth. Finally, dark cocoa in the base note rounds off the profile, leaving a warm, woody finish. This harmonious balance of fresh and warm nuances makes the perfume an ideal companion for special moments that call for an expressive character. The amber-coloured glass bottle with a golden cap and floral label brings a touch of luxurious naturalness to the dressing table. The highest fragrance concentration in the collection for a long-lasting scent experience Top note with a salty, ozonic accord for a fresh opening A heart note of vanilla orchid provides floral depth A base note of dark cocoa leaves a warm finish Ideal for evening occasions and special moments in everyday life

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum Spray Intense - refillable 30 ml
listings.description: The Prada Paradoxe Intense Eau de Parfum Spray is a powerful interpretation of the characteristic Paradoxe fragrance created in 2023 by perfumers Antoine Maisondieu, Nadege Le Garlantezec and Shyamala Maisondieu. This composition unfolds a new, expressive intensity and builds on the familiar pillars of the fragrance line. It opens with a fresh combination of juicy pear, sparkling bergamot and the essence of neroli. In the heart of the creation, the delicacy of jasmine meets an unexpected, earthy note of moss, while neroli continues to unfold its floral facets and provides floral depth. The base note anchors the fragrance for a long time with a warm and multi-layered blend of ambergris, bourbon vanilla and pure vanilla. Modern molecules such as Ambrofix and Serenolide give the base additional structure and warmth. The result is an ambery-floral fragrance with remarkable longevity and an expressive sillage. The eau de parfum is presented in a minimalist bottle that picks up on Prada's iconic triangular logo and is sustainably refillable thanks to its design. An intense, ambery-floral fragrance character. Composition of pear, neroli, jasmine and a warm vanilla-amber base. Characterised by a long-lasting presence. Refillable bottle in the iconic Prada triangle design.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum Spray Sweet Chemistry 30 ml
listings.description: With Prada Paradoxe Sweet Chemistry Eau de Parfum, a fruity-floral fragrance experience can be effortlessly incorporated into everyday life. This fragrance is ideal for those who appreciate a delicate balance between fruity and floral notes. The composition opens with a blackcurrant syrup accord, which ensures a fresh start to the day immediately after spraying. This is followed by the orange blossom absolute in the heart notes, which unfolds its aromas. This creates a subtle yet appealing scent that is equally suited to the office and evening engagements. The fragrance concludes with a neroli-milk accord in the base note, which leaves a gentle trace on the skin and harmoniously rounds off the olfactory profile. The striking, triangular glass bottle in transparent violet blends stylishly into any home perfume collection. Thanks to its well-thought-out, refillable design, the original bottle can be easily reused. This conserves resources and offers a practical way to enjoy the fragrance over a long period without having to buy a completely new bottle regularly. A fruity-floral fragrance composition for versatile use in various everyday situations Top note featuring a blackcurrant syrup accord for an immediate, crisp opening Heart note of orange blossom absolute and base note of a neroli milk accord Refillable system for resource-efficient and long-term reuse Distinctive, triangular bottle design for stylish storage

listings.rawTitle: Prada L'Homme Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Prada L'Homme is an eau de toilette that interprets classic ingredients in a modern way. The composition opens with a fresh yet spicy top note of neroli and pepper. At the heart of the fragrance, a multi-layered bouquet unfolds, combining floral accents of violet and geranium with the warm depth of amber. The fragrance experience is rounded off by a striking base note. This is where the woody nuances of cedar meet earthy patchouli, giving the fragrance its characteristic and long-lasting finish. As a woody-chypre fragrance, this creation from 2016 is particularly suitable for spring, summer and autumn. Fragrance family: chypre, woody Top notes: neroli and pepper Heart notes: violet, geranium and amber Base notes: cedar and patchouli

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Eau de Parfum Spray - refillable Virtual Flower 30 ml
listings.description: Prada Paradoxe Virtual Flower is a modern interpretation of floral fragrance notes that was launched in 2024. This floral-fresh composition opens with the sparkling vibrancy of Italian bergamot and transitions into a heart note that combines classic neroli with an avant-garde jasmine AI accord. This component, inspired by artificial intelligence, gives the fragrance its special character. A warm base of musk and ambrette rounds off the olfactory experience and ensures a gentle finish. Overall, the fragrance is clear, light and modern. The iconic, refillable bottle in the shape of a horizontal triangle emphasises the floral essence of the creation with its light pink liquid and polished edges. For optimal development, the eau de parfum can be applied from a distance of around 10 to 20 cm to areas of skin with good circulation. listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradigme Le Parfum 30 ml
listings.description: As an intense olfactory experience, Prada’s men’s fragrance Le Parfum enriches your daily routine and is ideal for both the working day and special evening occasions. The fragrance is presented in an elegant bottle that transitions from dark green to black, featuring silver accents. The base notes of warm amber woods and leathery vanilla lend the composition a deep presence that lingers on the skin for many hours. As a result, the fragrance reliably accompanies the wearer through long days without the need to reapply. At the same time, the floral note of gourmand geranium brings a subtle freshness to the profile, creating a pleasant olfactory experience immediately after application. The high-quality spray head distributes the essences evenly over the skin or clothing. A single spritz is all it takes to create a long-lasting aura, making it particularly economical and hassle-free to use in the morning. Those who prefer warm, woody notes will find this an expressive companion for a wide variety of situations. Long-lasting fragrance composition for all-day presence Warm base notes of amber woods and leathery vanilla Fresh accents from floral gourmand geranium Economical and even application thanks to fine atomisation

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Eau de Toilette Spray Funfair Evening 100 ml
listings.description: In the warm night air, laughter and playful melodies sound. The darkness is penetrated by colourful illuminated neon lights. Vibrant and illuminating colours define the image. listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Eau de Toilette Spray Lipstick On 100 ml
listings.description: Maison Martin Margiela only launched the Eau de Toilette Spray Replica Lipstick On in 2015. The women's fragrance comes in a simple bottle with a label that is somewhat reminiscent of pharmacy labelling. However, the floral-powdery fragrance inspires with absolute elegance and perfection. The pale pink colour hints at the feminine and romantic fragrance, which is incredibly feminine. Nevertheless, the eau de toilette spray is subtle and therefore wonderfully suitable for everyday wear. It is not a sweet fragrance that demands immediate and constant attention. Rather, with Replica Lipstick On, Maison Martin Margiela has created a constant companion that is present, yet remains in the background. A fragrance that simply inspires The fascination of this replica fragrance develops with heliotrope, neroli and bergamot in the top note. The centre immediately follows with iris concrete, orange blossom absolute and galbanum. Sweet and powdery are the aromatic base notes of tonka bean absolute, bourbon vanilla and patchouli. The eau de toilette spray was not created for girls, but for adult women who like to envelop themselves in subtle, soft fragrances. It is not for nothing that the eau de toilette from Maison Martin Margiela is called Lipstick On. Because the composition is actually reminiscent of the scent of a delicate rose-coloured lipstick.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Eau de Parfum Spray Across Sands 100 ml
listings.description: The Replica Across Sands Eau de Parfum Spray from Maison Martin Margiela brings back memories of walks in the warm desert sand. The unisex fragrances from the Replica series are designed to remind women and men of special moments and at the same time give a fragrant expression to dreams and fantasies. The spicy, woody notes of Across Sands meet the oriental depth of dates and oud, awakening a longing for infinite space. In the top note of the Replica Across Sands Eau de Parfum Spray from Maison Martin Margiela, warm cinnamon meets the spicy note of Davana, the pale-leaved mugwort, while Osmanthus brings a floral component to the mix. This is followed by an oriental heart note, which caresses the senses with the aroma of dates and sand strawflowers. The fragrance is built on a smoky, woody base, which gives it a satisfying depth. Oud, patchouli, labdanum and smoke spread a mysticism that creates vast desert landscapes in the mind's eye. The result is a harmoniously rounded unisex fragrance that is particularly attractive in the evening.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Eau de Parfum Spray Wicked Love 100 ml
listings.description: The Replica Wicked Love Eau de Parfum Spray from Parisian brand Maison Martin Margiela is a fragrance for men and women and was launched in 2017. With a sensational design, the elegant perfume impresses at first sight: the bottle is reminiscent of a medicine bottle and the label looks like a medical record. Presented in this way, it is immediately clear that an extraordinary, extravagant eau de parfum spray awaits. Stylish sex appeal in a spray bottle The name of this Replica unisex fragrance from Maison Martin Margiela also whets the appetite for more. Wicked Love could be translated as ‘sinful love’, which is reflective of the interplay of individual scents: the top note combines water hyacinth, green pepper and basil. In the heart note, sunny chords of Egyptian jasmine and Provence rose come together. The crowning glory is the blissful base note of cedar, white musk and vetiver, which adds a touch of mystery to this love affair of scents. The overall composition is designed to remind us of gun metal and roses – a fatal fusion of the masculine and the feminine, of sin and love, whose charm cannot be denied.

A moment that should last forever. For now, forever, #Forever! With the revival of the notes, a new story begins: fresher, more colourful and more fun! The combination of citrus and raspberry notes gives shape to bold optimism. Elegant, carefree femininity is expressed by Rosa Cassia, the new, unique distillate of blackcurrant and rose, which is highly sought after and unrivalled in perfumery. The unforgettable hint of patchouli nestles against cashmeran and sandalwood. Girl of Now Forever is much more than a fragrance: it is a celebration of youth, of friendship, of life! The unmistakable Girl of Now bottle has been given a new coral-coloured floral emblem. More pep, more fun, but still couture! The packaging is presented in the characteristic blue of enamel and is adorned with a whole whirlwind of flowers: coral-red azaleas, the pink of evening light and red mandarins.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Girl Of Now Eau de Parfum Spray Shine 90 ml
listings.description: The Girl Of Now Shine Eau de Parfum Spray by Elie Saab is a radiant fragrance composition with a mild, creamy sweetness. It opens with a fruity combination of juicy pear, pineapple and tangy mandarin, refined with a hint of nutty pistachio. At the heart of the fragrance, a floral bouquet of delicate jasmine, orange blossom and exotic ylang-ylang unfolds, which is given a special depth by a fine note of bitter almond. The base rounds off the olfactory experience with powdery iris, earthy patchouli and warm vanilla, giving the perfume a long-lasting, elegant character. The luxurious impression is emphasised by the gold-coloured bottle, whose cap is decorated with a shimmering velvety flower. Fragrance character: Floral, fruity and powdery-sweet Head notes: Pear, pineapple, pistachio and mandarin. Heart notes: Bitter almond, jasmine and orange blossom. Base notes: Iris, patchouli and vanilla. Flacon: Elegant, gold-coloured design with floral detail.

listings.description: Bridal Eau de Parfum Spray is an extravagant luxury fragrance that is part of the Le Parfum collection. Its delicate, beguiling fragrance notes are like the transparent, precious fabrics used to make a bride's dress. If you want to know the vision behind this fragrance, just take a look at Elie Saab's wedding dresses. They are incomparably feminine, expressive and precious. Bridal Eau de Parfum Spray - the scent of the bride Le Parfum - a fitting name for the collection of elegant women's fragrances by Elie Saab. They are a dreamy complement to his fashion creations. The focus is always on the beauty of women. The fragrance emphasises the feminine character of its wearer. It comes from the renowned perfumer Aurélien Guichard, who is known for his sensitive and multi-faceted fragrance compositions. Powdery, floral, sensual notes come together in this spectacular eau de parfum spray. The top note is dedicated to the fresh flavours of sun-kissed citrus fruits. Mandarin, neroli and orange blossom create a fresh but warm accord. Beguiling ylang-ylang and white gardenia blossoms form the heart note, which fits in wonderfully with the wedding theme. A hint of vanilla adds sweet accents. The final accord of the Le Parfum Bridal Eau de Parfum spray made from amber, musk and benzoin has a feminine and sensual effect.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Girl Of Now Eau de Parfum Spray Rose Petal 30 ml
listings.description: Flowery, fruity and wonderfully refreshing , the modern fragrance character of Girl Of Now Rose Petal envelops its wearer. The new interpretation of Elie Saab's iconic fragrance enchants with its versatile nuances, which range from intense fruits to romantic flowers and sensual woods. Look forward to a fragrance journey that will stay in your memory! Experience the clever blend of tried-and-tested classics and sophisticated highlights with Elie Saab's Girl Of Now Rose Petal eau de parfum spray. As the name promises, the rose makes its grand entrance in the heart note. But first, pink peach and Szechuan pepper whisk you away to Mediterranean holiday destinations and envelop you with their invigorating freshness. You then encounter the queen of flowers, garnished with an exotic-looking magnolia; another hint of a mental time-out in the near or far-flung destinations of the world. Finally, the perfume gently brings you back to the here and now with warm woods and white musk in the form of a charming and beguiling base note that harmoniously rounds off the eau de parfum spray. Care for your inner and outer radiance by emphasising your feminine side with the perfume from Elie Saab!

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab L’Homme Eau de Parfum Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Elie Saab’s L’Homme Eau de Parfum Spray features a woody, vetiver-inspired composition that captivates with its clear and well-defined notes. The fragrance opens with a fresh combination of Italian bergamot and lemon, accompanied by a subtle spiciness from Madagascan pink pepper. At the heart of the creation lies a blend of vetiver from Madagascar and Haiti, and Italian cedarwood, which gives the fragrance its characteristic woody core. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with earthy patchouli from Madagascar and warm myrrh, ensuring a long-lasting impression. The bottle’s design reflects the brand’s elegance: A black lacquered gradient on fluted glass and a leather-effect cap emphasise the fragrance’s sophisticated character. Fragrance family: Woody, Vetiver Top notes: Bergamot, lemon, pink pepper Heart notes: Vetiver, cedarwood Base notes: Patchouli, myrrh Character: Elegant, distinctive

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Girl Of Now Eau de Parfum Spray Lovely 90 ml
listings.description: In 2022, Elie Saab introduces the Girl Of Now Lovely Eau de Parfum Spray. The fragrance is fruity-floral and was created by Dominique Ropion for women. A delicate, elaborately crafted bottle contains a soft pink-coloured fragrance that tempts you to reach for it and apply it. If you give in to this temptation, you will experience top notes of mandarin peel, galbanum, pears, mint, rosemary and blackcurrant buds. In the floral heart note, orange blossom, rose absolute and frangipani are complemented by bitter almonds and aniseed. Ambroxan introduces the base, where it meets patchouli and tonka beans. Delicate femininity and romance Although the Elie Saab Girl Of Now Lovely Eau de Parfum Spray is feminine and romantic , it is not a fragrance for girls. Rather, the perfume is aimed at women who are at peace with themselves and their femininity. They always radiate a beautiful femininity that can be seen in jeans and trainers as well as in a light summer dress. That's why the Girl Of Now Lovely Eau de Parfum Spray by Elie Saab is an all-rounder for the warm days and evenings of the year. It appeals to modern women who know that they can be and have everything without sacrificing their femininity.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Elixir Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The fashion designer Elie Saab enjoyed working with dresses and modern cuts from a young age. He loved the sensual femininity that feels comfortable in fashionable creations. This idea inspired him. He realised his very personal vision of creating his own creations in 1981 when he was studying fashion in Paris. He then returned to Beirut and opened his first fashion atelier. He began with traditional bridal fashion and created wonderful dresses from fine fabrics such as silk, satin, the finest cotton and velvet. The fashion designer expanded his range. Among other things, he offers sophisticated fragrances for all those who love his creations and his lively style. Elegant and floral, idiosyncratic and attractive. Spring flair with a delicately feminine elixir and floral fragrance Every year, spring gives us new hope, vitality and new dreams. This new beginning is reflected both in fashion and in new fragrances. Elie Saab's Eau de Parfum Spray contains the incomparable scent of spring, fresh flowers and sunshine. This eau de parfum spray from the composition of Elie Saab Le Parfums was created through the interplay between light woody and fresh floral aromas. This wonderfully feminine elixir is based on the scent of fresh orange blossom.

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Elixir Eau de Parfum Spray Love 30 ml
listings.description: Elixir Love is a fascinating eau de parfum spray from Elie Saab that captures the essence of passion and elegance. This exquisite creation by the renowned Lebanese fashion designer Elie Saab is a tribute to femininity and embodies pure sensuality. Sensual perfume for the modern lady The perfume opens with a seductive top note that combines the sweet lushness of cherry with the delicate sophistication of rose. This fruity-floral symbiosis creates an enchanting first impression that immediately beguiles the senses. A floral accord of beguiling jasmine and fresh neroli unfolds at the heart of the eau de parfum spray. This balanced composition lends the fragrance a timeless elegance and emphasises the feminine aura of its wearer. The base note rounds off the olfactory experience perfectly. Here, woody ambroxan and earthy oakmoss merge to create a sensual foundation that gives the fragrance depth and longevity. This harmonious combination ensures a long-lasting, unforgettable impression. With the Elixir Love eau de parfum spray from Elie Saab, you will be enveloped in a touch of luxury and seduction. The perfume is the perfect choice for all those who are looking for the extraordinary and want to emphasise their personality with an unmistakable fragrance. Let yourself be enchanted by this olfactory masterpiece and discover the magic of "Elixir Love".

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Le Parfum L'Eau Couture Eau de Toilette Spray 30 ml
listings.description: Le Parfum L’Eau Couture by Elie Saab . A perfume like a poem, like a sweet dessert, like an enchanting tale – that’s the effect of the Eau de Toilette Spray by Elie Saab. In the top notes, fresh bergamot and aromatic magnolia appear. The heart notes are ruled by orange blossom, but it’s in the base notes that the scent becomes especially interesting. There, vanilla and green almonds appeal to your senses. And although Le Parfum L’Eau Couture is an eau de toilette spray, it does credit to its name. The scent acts like a perfume, is long lasting , and accompanies you all day long, if you wish it to. With this eau de toilette spray, Elie Saab has created a little work of art. The bitter green almond ultimately harmonises flawlessly with the sweet vanilla and creates an appetite for more. The scent is perfect for everyday life, charms young ladies in particular with its gentle sweetness, and can be worn just as easily at university as in the office.

listings.description: Seductive Dream by Guess is a feminine perfume for everyday moments. It gives the lady a lovely freshness and an attractive fragrance. The top note is fruity and dominated by bergamot, apple and pear. It is approachable and exudes the scent of a local orchard. The floral fragrance unfolds in the heart note. Here, Guess limits itself to proximity and combines two classics in Seductive Dream. In the eau de toilette spray, the floral fragrance consists of extracts of jasmine and rose. The floral heart note is completed by gardenia, a flower that primarily grows in China and Southeast Asia. Earthy to animal base Orcanox ensures that the eau de toilette spray is down-to-earth. Its woody to animalic fragrance is appealing. Amber exudes a hint of incense, which is heavy in the air in many houses of worship. Its resinous note has a calming effect, inevitably spreading the scent of the forest on the skin of the lady who applies this fragrance. The perfume gains warmth and sweetness from the vanilla. Seductive Dream by Guess is a great gift for in between. A enchanting eau de toilette spray for women who like to sprinkle their skin with a fruity-floral fragrance.</p

listings.rawTitle: Guess Seductive Eau de Toilette Spray Blue 30 ml
listings.description: The Seductive Blue Eau de Toilette Spray by Guess is an unconventional and daring fragrance with a seductive aura. The perfume enchants with a fruity-floral composition and evokes memories of endless beaches and holidays by the sea - a fragrance that awakens the lightness in you, is fun and takes you away from everyday life for a while and into a paradise full of joie de vivre and cheerfulness. If you want to subtly underline your own personal sensuality, Seductive Blue by Guess will definitely be your new favourite fragrance. And by the way, the elegant azure blue bottle brings atmospheric beach vibes to your bathroom! The perfume with the extraordinary fragrance composition As soon as you open it, the eau de toilette spray will enchant you with notes of fruity pear and summery bergamot. In the heart, cyclamen, peony, rose water and freesia dance a sunny round dance, while the charming base is composed of plum, musk, patchouli and a hint of amber - an extraordinary potpourri that appeals to all the senses and has a delicate magic: subtly sweet, but also sparkling, passionate and wonderfully fresh. Suitable for special moments, but also the magic of everyday life. Application: Simply spray sparingly onto healthy skin.

The artistic red design on the front is particularly striking, evoking associations with fans or palm leaves and stylishly emphasising the white lettering "AIGNER", "ICON" and "ELIXIR". This fragrance creation stands for a stylish companion that combines classic sophistication with modern accents. Fragrance: A harmonious blend of fruity and floral notes with a warm base. Top note: Fresh accents of mandarin and peach. Heart note: A floral interplay of jasmine, orange blossom and heliotrope. Base note: Creamy finish with vanilla, tonka bean and sandalwood. Flacon design: Rectangular clear glass with pink-coloured liquid and decorative red fan motif.
