listings.rawTitle: Pana Dora Sweden Swedish Leather Extrait de Parfum 100 ml
listings.description: Pana Dora Sweden presents Swedish Leather - a mesmerising extrait de parfum that captures the essence of Scandinavian elegance. This woody, spicy fragrance masterpiece pays homage to the tradition of Swedish leather craftsmanship and is aimed at self-confident men and women alike. Experience the perfect balance between tradition and modernity with Swedish Leather by Pana Dora Sweden - a perfume that enchants the senses and awakens a longing for the North. Exclusive extrait de parfum for men and women The Swedish Leather fragrance by Pana Dora Sweden unfolds in a fascinating spectrum of scents. The top note opens with the sweet fruitiness of osmanthus, paired with the spicy warmth of saffron. Aromatic sage, spiritual incense and exotic ylang-ylang complete this impressive opening. At the heart of the fragrance, a striking leather note blends harmoniously with fresh basil, earthy resin nuances and the delicate sweetness of violet. The base note rounds off the composition with a symphony of precious agarwood, sensual musk and creamy sandalwood. There are also accents of rich tobacco and aromatic cedar, which give the fragrance depth and longevity. Whether in the office, on a night out or on a special occasion - this perfume gives you an aura of sophistication and naturalness . The highly concentrated extrait de parfum formulation ensures a long-lasting and gently unfolding fragrance experience.

The perfume is presented in the iconic bottle made of heavy frosted glass. A chrome metal collar and a dark blue metal cap with the Armani monogram emphasise the design. The bottle is refillable and available in sustainable packaging. An intense composition that combines maritime freshness and woody depth. Fragrance notes of bergamot, immortelle, vetiver and patchouli. Iconic bottle made of heavy frosted glass with dark blue metal cap. Refillable design in sustainable packaging.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Fame Parfum Parfum 30 ml

The perfume captures the irresistible spirit of the Parisian night: sensual jasmine meets mesmerising incense and addictive musk to reveal a sensual facet of femininity. Full of precious ingredients for intense desire, every drop brings out the FAME star in you.

Here, aromatic lavender, beguiling jasmine and precious iris combine to create a harmonious accord that gives the perfume its distinctive powdery character. The base note provides a sensual finish, giving the fragrance depth and warmth. Warm notes of soft suede merge with the earthy depth of patchouli and the gentle presence of violet to create an elegant and enveloping foundation. Fragrance character: Floral, powdery and sensual Top notes: Italian mandarin, neroli and tomato Heart notes: lavender, jasmine and iris Base notes: suede, violet and patchouli

listings.description: The Eau de Toilette Spray Girl is presented by Rochas 2021. The floral and sweet fragrance is feminine and captivates with a mature yet romantic presence. Created by Anne Flipo and IFF, the top notes are neroli, pink pepper and blackcurrant. The heart note brings the flavours of orange blossom, jasmine and orchid. Woody notes appear in the base, with sandalwood and cedarwood complemented by vanilla. The result is a wonderful fragrance for spring and summer, when the temperatures slowly rise. The Eau de Toilette Spray Girl by Rochas is clearly perceptible, but not overpowering or heavy. This all-rounder is for you Girl is a women's fragrance that really always works. The eau de toilette spray scores just as well in your free time as it does at work, in the evening or when going out. No matter where you go, Rochas Girl will accompany you. After all, the fragrance is aimed at all women who go through life in a relaxed manner, who can laugh at themselves and who feel just as comfortable in jeans as they do in a dress. With this fragrance, you appear groomed and elegant , but also casual and casual . And because it is a Rochas Eau de Toilette, it also offers that certain luxury.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Green Tea Fragrance Mist 236 ml
listings.description: A light breeze that carries the scent of fresh green tea - that is the essence of the Green Tea Fine Fragrance Mist by Elizabeth Arden. This body spray unfolds with a tangy top note of lemon, bergamot and mint, which provides an invigorating opening. At the heart of the composition, the clear notes of green tea combine with soft jasmine and spicy carnation, giving the fragrance a balanced and harmonious depth. The base of oakmoss and amber rounds off the fragrance experience with a subtle, earthy warmth. The composition is deliberately kept light and covers the skin like a delicate veil. The design of the spray bottle reflects the natural freshness of the contents with its soft green tone and stylised tea leaf. A refreshing and light body spray . Combines tangy citrus notes with the clear aroma of green tea. Rounded off with a warm base of oakmoss and amber. Ideal for a subtle scent throughout the day. In an elegant spray bottle with a tea leaf motif.

The heart of the fragrance combines a rich floral bouquet of rose, ylang-ylang, violet and lily of the valley with the characteristic note of orris root. Sandalwood and cedarwood add a soft, woody facet. The base anchors the composition with the warmth of musk, tonka bean, honey and a hint of vanilla, giving the eau de toilette a sophisticated character. With its moderate fragrance intensity, it is a suitable companion for the day at any time of year. As the fragrance progresses, a heart of jasmine unfolds, whose floral facets are complemented by ambergris. The base note rounds off the fragrance experience with the warm tones of brown sugar and earthy moss. Developed by perfumer Emilie Bouge, this eau de parfum is designed for all genders. Fragrance direction: Flowery-woody Head note: Black pepper, blood orange, exotic fruits Heart note: jasmine, ambergris Base note: brown sugar, moss Character: unisex fragrance

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La vie est belle Eau de Parfum Spray refillable Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml + Eau de Parfum Spray 10 ml / 1 Stk.
listings.description: La Vie Est Belle by Lancôme is an eau de parfum that embodies joie de vivre in a fragrance. At the centre of the composition is the noble iris pallida from France, which is accompanied by the depth of sustainably sourced patchouli from Bali and a warm gourmand vanilla accord. The fragrance is housed in the iconic "le Sourire de Cristal" bottle, whose shape is reminiscent of a smile. A grey ribbon on the neck symbolises freedom. This version of the eau de parfum spray is refillable, enabling a more conscious use of resources. The bottle can be easily refilled at home: The spray attachment is unscrewed, the refill is put on and the filling process stops automatically as soon as the bottle is full. For optimum development, the perfume is applied to warm areas of skin such as the wrists or décolleté. Fragrance composition with iris pallida, patchouli and a gourmand vanilla accord. Iconic glass bottle "le Sourire de Cristal" (the crystal smile). Refillable design for reduced material consumption. Simple refill mechanism with automatic stop.

listings.rawTitle: Liquides Imaginaires Les Eaux Imaginaire Eau de Parfum Spray Île Pourpre 100 ml
listings.description: The olfactory journey to the "purple island" begins with an unusual, green freshness. Shiso leaves combine with the fine acidity of Italian bergamot and the subtle spiciness of ginger in the top note, while angelica seeds and incense add the first aromatic accents. The characteristic, dark fruity aroma of black fig then unfolds at the centre of the composition. This heart note is given a complex and multi-layered depth by the addition of fenugreek, davana and iris. The eau de parfum is supported by a solid base of cedar, patchouli and cashmeran, which is rounded off with ambroxan and provides a woody finish. As part of the Les Eaux Imaginaire collection, this creation represents the artisanal expertise of the Parisian brand Liquides Imaginaires. The design also emphasises its mystical character: the cylindrical bottle has a dark red body emblazoned with the silver lettering "ÎLE POURPRE". A solid silver cap with an engraved diamond pattern on the neck of the bottle completes the overall aesthetic look of this unisex fragrance produced in France. Fragrance: Aromatic and spicy with a distinctive note of black fig and shiso. Collection: Part of the Les Eaux Imaginaire line from Liquides Imaginaires. Design: Dark red glass bottle with silver cap and diamond engraving. Base: Warm accords of cedar, patchouli, cashmeran and ambroxan. Origin: High-quality eau de parfum, made in France.

listings.rawTitle: Chopard Wish Eau de Parfum Spray Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml + Perfumed Shower Gel 75 ml / 1 Stk.
listings.description: The Chopard Wish Eau de Parfum Spray is a multi-faceted fragrance composition for women that has been inspiring since 1999. Captured in a bottle whose design is reminiscent of an artfully cut diamond, the outer appearance already reflects the character of the contents. The fragrance opens with a playful top note, in which fruity flavours of strawberry, pear and coconut combine with the delicate blossoms of honeysuckle and acacia. The heart of the fragrance then unfolds, a harmonious combination of floral notes such as violet and orchid, which is given a special depth by sweet accents of honey and milk. The base forms a long-lasting and warm finish. This is where creamy notes of vanilla, caramel and toffee meet the woody elegance of sandalwood and the sensuality of amber and incense. The result is a complex and feminine fragrance that leaves behind an unmistakable aura. A multi-faceted fragrance with floral and sweet notes. Iconic bottle in the design of a cut diamond. Composition of fruity, floral and warm gourmand accords. Created by perfumer Nathalie Lorson in 1999.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Luna Rossa Eau de Parfum Spray - refillable Ocean Refill / 150 ml
listings.description: The Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum is a modern, woody-ambery composition based on fascinating contrasts. The fragrance opens with the sparkling freshness of grapefruit, which gives the top note a clear and dynamic radiance. As it progresses, an elegant combination of smoky incense and striking woody notes unfolds in the heart, lending the creation a special depth and luxurious character. The multi-layered fragrance experience is rounded off by a warm and enveloping base that combines vanilla with a sophisticated amber accord. A special feature here is the use of the innovative AmberXtreme™ molecule, which emphasises the intensity of the base notes and ensures a long-lasting impression. The base note gives the perfume its depth and consistency. This is where warm musk nuances meet amber and are rounded off with a subtle hint of vanilla. This foundation provides the fresh, intense finish to the fragrance experience. The perfume develops its notes best when applied from a distance of 15 to 20 cm to warm areas of the body, such as the inside of the wrists or the skin behind the earlobes.
